reviews.comment: Go to lectures, and do all the homework. Buy the note packet for class, attending SIs and doing the practice test helped me to do well on the test

Best instructor I've had so far at Iowa State. Clem really cares about you getting a good grade and will tell you exactly what you need to study for. Her lectures are great, so do not miss them. Taking this class without going to class will make it so much harder for you. She makes the content easy to understand, so don't miss class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Does a great job explaining each concept in detail, assigns relevant homework assignments, and has very fair exams. Professor Clem a great example of an ideal college professor.
Really cares about each student. Best prof I have ever had for sure!
She made coming to lecture fun and I paid attention in class.
Great professor! Makes class fun and tells good stories. Material can be a little tricky.
She is an amazing professor and cares about her students. She tells you everything that will be on the exams. Also, she is very interesting to listen to and has some good stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Although this was my hardest class, she was an AMAZING professor. She is very caring and respectful about EVERYONE in the class, even though there are over 200 students in the lecture. She is always sending reminders about homework, exams, extra credit, SI sessions, etc. Study hard for the exams and work hard on the project!

Dr. Clem is the best! She takes a class that could be a pain and makes it as interesting as she can. He lectures are incredible and she is quite funny, too. Homework and LS each week you can easy get 100% on. Exams and projects are moderately difficult but she is helpful with questions, even late night emails. You WILL be OK in this class with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Do the homework. If you can find a group of people to work with, the class is pretty simple. You don't need the book but you will want the PowerPoint slide notebook and the access codes. One big project towards the end of the semester, but again, if you have some acquaintances it's a breeze.

Clem is an amazing teacher who is always willing to help her students. Attendance is important because you go over a lot of materials each day. 1 LearnSmart and 1 homework assignment due each week. START YOUR PROJECT EARLY. IT IS NOT THAT HARD BUT YOU JUST NEED TIME.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you have to take Acct 284, take it with Anne. She makes you want to be there and explains everything so clearly.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Anne is a pretty good professor. Her class is set up so that you can get 100% on your homework. There's a semester project which wasn't bad but I would recommend starting right away. Her exams are easy if you do the homework. You will use the book so at least buy the online version.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Tests are somewhat difficult. Class is not mandatory but it helps you learn the material. Go to the SI exam reviews!

Professor Clem was very good. She uses real work examples that really help you understand the content and really want you to succeed. The tests are very difficult but there is a huge project that gets you a ton of points if you do it. Also some good extra credit opportunities
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Anne Clem is the best professor I've ever had. She gave you what you needed and told you what you needed to do to get an A, without spoon feeding you. I genuinely learned so much about accounting and I never felt unprepared for an exam. Don't take this if you're lazy or want to be spoonfed. She wants you to do well in both her class and at ISU.

Very easy project points & extra credit are available. If you do the work and attend class, clem will hand you an A on a silver platter. Her engaged tone and expert lectures make the material easy to understand. A lot of online homework for this class. Just do it. Its easy.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Clem has a good enthusiastic tone when she teaches which I respect, but the thing about her is that when you email her asking a question she doesnt really care. i asked her a specific question on the homework one time, and she told me to look in the book. Like maybe the reason why i asked in the first place was bc i couldnt find it in the book.

Dr. Clem is amazing! I would talk every class of hers if my schedule allowed! She makes the lectures fun and interesting. I took this as an 8 am but she made it worth getting up for. Great to listen to. Definitely take notes and use those plus the exam review for studying. Overall great teacher and class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Clem is an awesome instructor. She's easy to understand, simplifies difficult concepts very well, gives real world examples and does a lot of demonstrations. Gives lots of opportunities to receive points too, through homework, projects, exams, and some EC. Always willing to go the extra mile to help students as well. Great experience!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Acct284 with Clem was a class I just wanted to take it get done with, but it was much more complicated than that. All three of her midterms were very difficult and much more in depth than what we did in class. I studied for several days and hours before each exam and struggled to do average. The project and homework were easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tests were ridiculously hard for the material and practice she gave us.  I took Organic Chemistry 2 that same summer and got a better grade in that class than this basic Accounting course.  There wasn't enough time given on tests and questions were confusing to understand.  Project was long and just busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Clem was by far one of my favorite professors so far. Even though class is not necessary I would suggest going because she gives good tips on how to do things and gives you ways to help remember material for the test. There are two assignments per chapter three test and a final as well as a project.

Really knows her stuff and makes the classes worth  while. Made the subject easy to understand and would recommend getting into her class. Exams and homework weren't difficult as long as you attend class.

Professor Clem is a great professor when it comes to lecturing. Really makes sure everyone understands the material before moving on.  I  wish she wouldn't tell so many personal stories during class time. We could probably finish the lecture in 30 minutes w/o the stories. If you have a question, she may email back, but it will probably be vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She explains the content really well and makes class interesting by telling funny, personal stories. She really wants you to succeed in the class, so you should definitely show up and pay attention. There is a project, but it's honestly not that bad if you don't wait till last minute. Easy extra credit offered towards the end of the semester.

Anne is a decent professor at most, and I say that not because I have a problem with her teaching It's simply her attitude when she emails back. There was a time when I asked her a question about the Homework that we had to do, and she told me to "refer to the text." I don't want to sound like I have a problem looking in my book, but really?
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is a very good professor. Come to class and  you will do just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Clem has such a good structure set for the class! She posts her slides online right up front so you can take notes directly on them. Course project is laid out very well with step-by-step help. Homework prepares you well for exams. Explains everything VERY WELL in her lectures. Also adds fun stories and makes the time enjoyable.

Wonderful teacher. Breaks down just about everything she talks about. Uses interesting examples and stories, which is tough to do for a subject like accounting. Very knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and caring. She has PowerPoints that she'll post online that are directly related to the test, but I strongly suggest to go to her lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Excellent professor. Knows exactly what material to focus on and does a great job explaining the hardest parts during lectures. Lots of great stories and anecdotes too, that actually relate to our topics. Really understands how students work and learn. Tests are harder than average, but everything you need is in the notes, just be sure to study.

Dr. Clem makes accounting seem super easy. She explains concepts, and what she talks about in class is the only information on the exams. If I could take any other class in the world with her, I would in a heartbeat. Such a sweet lady, and she really wants everyone to learn and succeed.

I'm usually not a fan of my businesses classes but Clem made this one pretty good. She's got a good delivery in lecture that's both informative and generally entertaining enough. Has a good feel for how students operate and has super realistic expectations in terms of required work.

I'm literally in love with Dr. Clem. Her tests are tough if you don't study, but she gives 3 extra credit opportunities throughout the semester and she is super easy to talk to. She is definitely one of my favorite professors on campus!

She seems really nice and willing to help and made the lectures about as interesting as they could be. The tests were tough though, and weren't much like the practice exams, the homework or what we talked about in class.

I want to take all of my Accounting courses through her. She's very clear about what she expects and she prepares her students for tests very well. People who complain are those jerks who spend all of lecture chatting with their friends.

I love her! She was an awesome professor who really connected with her students.  She made accounting easier than I thought it would be to learn! Open to questions and gave good feedback.  I would take another class with her!
284 is a pretty easy class. I didn't go to lecture for 12ish weeks of the semester and still got a B+. Make sure to do the learnsmarts and homeworks and it's a piece of cake.
Anne really cares about her students. This is a tough class that requires the online textbook as it contains an access code for homework. Go to class and do the homework and you will be fine.

- Clear lecture explanations - Easy homework(basically provided you with solutions) - Easy test (with almost full detail about the test,sometimes  even tells u the exact question) - Easy project (provide tons of help: office hours, SI session, help lab, whichever u prefer)  What else could you ask for?  :)

Take Accounting 284 with Anne Clem!  Show up for class, take the notes (I recommend purchasing them from CopyWorks right across from campus or printing them off each day before the lecture) Do the homework, and Study for exams using the practice exams. Definitely  attend the SI sessions for help early on if you need extra help.

Homework is tedious, but it does help you learn the material. Lectures aren't too bad. She tries her hardest to keep the class engaged and usually lets you out 10 minutes early. Definitely suggest taking 284 with Clem.

I struggled with accounting but Professor Clem made it a lot more clear for me! She's a great professor and is very enthusiastic with her students. It's a tough class but with her teaching it you should be fine.

Nice. Homework is extremely easy, group project is easy as well. Tests take preparation and overall aren't easy. If you screw up on one test, you might not get an A because there isn't a curve either. However it's almost impossible to get below a B. Just show up to class and do homework and you'll be fine.

Clem is an amazing professor! You can tell she is passionate about accounting, and she makes the class interesting even though it's a gigantic lecture. Her tests are straight forward and basically just like the practice ones. Homework can be a little tedious but not too bad. She also tells great stories which makes class more interesting.
Take this class with Dr. Clem if possible.  She's an amazing professor that makes you want to come to class.  Very good use of lecture time, provides you with the materials you need to do well.
Great lady! Very helpful and pationate about what she teaches. Relates to college very well.

Clem is a great teacher and really knows what she is teaching. She is super organized and very clear during lectures. By far the best Acct 284 teacher at ISU. Homework is super easy, just time consuming. The tests are kinda difficult, so make sure you study! There is one semester project and it is pretty simple, just start early!

Dr. Clem was really a great professor. She makes the material understandable, and she has a lot of interesting or funny stories that relate to the class.... she's very hip. Tests were okay and taken in the online testing center, learnsmart homework and quizzes were the other part of your grade along with a group project.
Take this class with Clem and you can't go wrong. Make sure to go to class and take notes, she does a great job at explaining each chapter. Wouldn't have picked any other professor!

Anne is a wonderful teacher. She truly cares about students.... and Cyclone basketball. The homework is really easy  and the tests are average. The group project can be finished in about 4 hours, but you probably want to split up into a couple work days.

Dr. Clem is an outstanding professor. She makes her lectures on accounting topics very personable. She explains the topics and does in-class problems. Make sure to read the textbook too as there are weekly homework assignments & reading quizzes. There isn't much extra credit and tests are average. The semester project helps boost your grade though.
She's is awesome
Do the practice tests and you'll do well on the tests. Project is time consuming. She's a great lecturer and willing to help.

Clem is a great lecturer who makes sure her students understand the material covered in class. The tests require studying and the project should not be done in one night. If you keep up with the class it is pretty easy to get a B or better.

Very good professor! Good at explaining things. She seemed a little strict at first (doesn't allow computers in class) but you get used to it. Used the book a lot. There's a semester project but if you start early and keep working on it, it's not too bad! Tests taken in online testing center. We usually got out of class 15-20 minutes early! :)
The best teacher I ever had in ISU!

Dr. Clem is the best professor I've had at Iowa State. Tests aren't too hard as long as you follow along in class and do your homework. Does in-class examples that help a lot. Be sure to visit her office hours- she's super nice and genuinely cares about her students. I would definitely recommend taking 284 with Clem.

Clem is one of the best professors I've had at Iowa St. She can be fun, but knows how to teach. Pay attention in class and do all the homework assignments and you do fine. Also don't wait to do the semester long project, get it done early. It's easy, but be sure to do a little each week. I recommend her.
I felt like she truly cared to help the students learn and do well. Class is a little boring but she has some funny stories.

didnt really use the textbook, just pay attention in every class and study your notes. you could do terrible on all the exams and still do well in the class by doing all online homeworks quizzes and LearnSmarts SEMESTER PROJECT - met with my partners once a week every week for an hour to work on project. do not wait until the night before its due!

Awesome professor! Explains notes clearly and goes through multiple examples during class, and she always let you out early to "enjoy your day!" Tests are somewhat challenging but exactly from the notes packet. Start the project early and go to the help room and you'll have it done in a couple hours.

Clem is great!! I Had a ton of accounting experience before taking the class so a lot of it was review. She tells the funniest stories about family/personal experiences which makes class go much faster. Lets students out early and cancels class often, too. Learned A LOT, CLEM IS ONE OF MY FAVORITE PROFESSORS AT ISU!!

This class is so easy... Take it with clem, do the online homework assingments, ace the multiple choice tests, you'll get a good grade. She is a really great professor though, and builds her relationship with the class by telling stories and making jokes. She's awesome.

Great professor! I'm awful at math, but I actually understand everything that she teaches because of the way she does it. Lets you out of class early almost everyday and doesn't talk exclusively about accounting all the time

She is an amazing teacher! The class was difficult given that it's a math class but she made it as easy as possible. She genuinely cares about her students and tries to do everything to help the students. Theres no comparison at all with her and the other professors. She stands alone. No questions asked, THE BEST.
she explains her materials very well. definitely a recommended professor.

She is amazing. She does tons of examples and really wants her students to do well. She does examples from the book and makes up her own, plus gives you plenty of time to do everything. She also lets you go early sometimes because she has kids and can tell when people aren't learning.
She does an excellent job of teaching! And to top it off she's really HOT!!

She is amazing. She makes accounting interesting and fun. The homework is super easy and the quizzes aren't that bad either. She gives out credit. Plus the final project is super easy. Love her, love the class.

Professor Clem is amazing.  Not everyone may be good at accounting, but with extra credit offerings, pretty much guaranteed homework points, simple quizzes, and a project that had a 94% average for us this spring, she gives you every possible tool do well. She was a delight.
Probably my favorite teacher so far at ISU.  I'm an engineer and loved the class.  Fairly interesting material and she taught it well.  Tells funny stories about her family.  class is a blast
Super Helpful and energetic. And if you need help just ask. Shes awesome!

This is a great class to take if you are trying to get your CPA. She is a great professor who seems to really know the material and care about her students. There is homework due for each chapter but if you try she usually gives you full credit. There is a small current events presentation and a fairly short project. Go to class and work problems.
Very good professior,expaines everything in good detail.  Exams are fairly easy if you study.
AMAZING!! loved this teacher one of my favorites... go to class and pay attention.. find old tests if you can and do the examples from the book.. memorize the notes
Clem is awesome!  You'll love her.  She makes things easy to understand and gives you the opportunity to earn an easy A.  Go to class, it helps.

I did well on the first test but bombed the second. She explains the basics well but expects you to immediately understand the material and what she is doing. Doesn't leave enough time to fully explain her examples. Do well on the project to save your grade.

great teacher! I didnt know a thing about accounting before this class and she really helped a lot! Study the old test she gives you because they are pretty similar to the new ones. Easy to get all of the homework and quiz points and project isnt to bad either. Definitly take her!
Really good!!! Very clear, understands you don't want to be there, gives extra credit for attendance. The only bad thing is if she sees you sleeping, she wakes you up.
She is a great instructor. Be lucky if you get her.

She is an incredible teacher! She loves what she does and is always making sure that the students understand what is going on! Fast paced, don't miss class! Quizzes and homework pretty easy. She works out examples in class. Tests aren't hard either! Wonderful teacher I highly recommend her!
She runs the class hard and will point out sleepers, yell at people leaving earlier, and those arriving late.

Very very very good professor.  Knows your question before you ask it.  Incredibly organized and could teach the class blindfolded.  Knows her stuff and will help you figure it out if you don't get it.  TA's were good and review sessions were offered and were very helpful.

The best Accounting instuctor I have ever had at ISU! The material is tough but Prof. Clem does a great job teaching. Exams are typically easier than quizzes and homework in my opinion. Make sure you take notes and do the inclass examples. If you do that, you will be fine!

Awesome teacher. Makes lecture interesting, works with problems in the book, and explains exactly what is going on. Makes the material easy to understand and explains everything that will appear on the test. Not a lot of extra credit, but you don't really need it if you go to class. Some people might get stuff out of the books, others might not.

She is the best teacher for 284--she loves what she teaches.  Go to class; you get extra credit quite often, get let out early, and the notes in class are the only things needed to study for tests.  If you do the homework and study for the tests, easy, EASY B.
Great overall!!! she spoon feeds u the test, and offers quite a bit of extra credit as long as u go to class
Great teacher, extremely helpful..made accounting less boring and easier for me.  I would definitely reccommend her.

Excellent teacher. Offers lots of extra credit (definitely do it; it's easy). Test were not too difficult. Review sessions that were offered before tests helped a lot. She is funny but sometimes gets off topic. She is very in touch with her students. Easy to get an A in class if you do the extra credit. A++ Take Acct284 with her if possible.

Very helpful with me b/c I got really sick during the semester. She was very willing to help out and get me back on track. Always answered any questions quickly through email. Classes were better than most of my classes. Keeps you entertained. Has in class quizzes, but you know when they are coming Her grading system is great! TAKE THIS CLASS W HER
Talks about her kids way too much and can speed through the material sometimes.  Otherwise an alright professor.

Awesome teacher. She gives out a hunk of extra credit. Tests are very doable. Quizes and homework are easy as well. Some of the material can be difficult, but she teaches it very very well. Also, she loves to stop once and a while and talk about her home life, which is pretty funny most of the time. Highly recommended!
Very good teacher.  I learned a lot.
If you can go to class and take notes (which she gives you slides to write on) and pay attention, you can pass this class with at least a B. AWESOME PROFESSOR! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Dr. Clem is an amazing teacher. She is very helpfun. She actually uses the book you buy in class for examples. She wants her students to suceed. I would reccomend her for a teacher! Best teacher at Iowa State University!!

I loved her!  She was friendly and appears to be really passionate about the subject.  I found 284 harder than 285 but Clem is easy to listen to and willing to help the students whenever.  Highly recommended!
Cool Professor. Show up to class, she makes the notes crystal clear and relevant to the exams/quizzes. She also gives out a ton of extra credit.
great teacher
Great teacher. Does a good job of providing examples for the material and making sure that Accounting makes sense. Not an easy job.

Amazing professor, clear on lectures and made sure we understood before going on.  GO TO CLASS! She gave out xtra credit atleast 1 a week, especially when it is cold out. Tests are easy if you study, the SI sessions helped and sometimes were the same questions on the exam. Don't wait on the last minute to do project and get a good partner for it!

She knows her stuff. I suggest not missing class b/c what she discusses on the slides is important. Don't wait until the last minute to do your project. It's just easier to get it done asap. I recommend her for this course, though.
She's a good prof. Go to class when it's a cold day, because she gives a lot of extra credit. Start working on your project early. Take her if you can.

She is quite possibly the best professor at Iowa State. She makes the class interesting and fun. Attendance is not required, but she gives extra credit quizzes sometimes for showing up. Practice tests are REALLY similar to actual tests. Do the practice tests, look over the notes, and go to class, and you will do well.

She is a very "personal" professor who likes to share her life stories and her kids are her life. The tests were hard and the lectures could get boring, but she does a pretty good job and is super helpful if you ask for it. It's a hard class period. I gave up on going to lecture everyday and studying a lot and still pulled off a B.
Great Teacher.  Material can get a little confusing but does a great job of explaining.  Very funny stories. Truly cares about her students.
She is an awesome teacher!  The best teacher at ISU I would say!

She is wonderful! Makes class interesting, gives extra credit during lecture, has take-home quizes. Shows interest in students and huge sports fan. tests can be difficult - only 20 q's. Reading, doing the homework, and going to SI really help.
SHE was very clear, very helpful, and extremely understanding.
Clem is awesome!  She is very helpful and appears to have a general interest in her students.  She gives you every opportunity to do well in her class.
I hated this class and the teacher.
I love Mrs. Clem and her horror storties from her home life and her kids. They make class go faster and not so damn boring. plus she give free quiz points!
Attend classes & read the bolded sections of the book, and you'll have no problems. Very helpful!
Keeps the lectures interesting and is well planned for class!
No Comments
keeps things fun and lively

Very helpful teacher.  Makes the lectures interesting with stories and has some very good examples for problems.  Makes the learning fun and easy.  Very helpful outside of class and will do just about anything for anyone if they need help.  Best teacher I have had in 4 semesters here.
She is an awesome teacher. If you want to learn something she is the teacher for you. She is a good teacher and she will help at anytime you need it. Best teacher I have had of all of them at ISU.
She has some hilarious stories and is really entertaining in class.
Really great teacher, can interact with students on a high level, funny stories, great class
Was very good.  She is awesome.  A++++++.  She explains everything very well.
She is the reason I am still in school.
Great Professor! Very Helpful and fair
Makes accounting easier than it is
Great teacher. Always helpful. Very clearly explains concepts in class.
Fabulous teacher, and all around very nice person. Definately take this class with her if you can-she makes everything very clear and is helpful.
No Comments
She's great, made accounting seem easier than it is.  Enthusiastic and knows her stuff.  Take this class with her.
She is such a great teacher!  She actually made accounting interesting and NOT boring!  Take this class from her
Great teacher!
Very rude to class and does not teach well.
If you go to class and study hard you will be fine.

I think people are generally too harsh on Dr. Biederman. Her tests are very similar to the lectures/learning objectives that she posts. All lectures are recorded and easy to follow. Overall, a pretty easy class that does not require much studying.

She purposely makes the exams much harder than they need to be. She also regularly teste material on the exams that is never covered in lecture slides, homework, or practice tests. Take literally any other section because this one is not worth it.
I don't like her. Wouldn't recommend. She will stop in the middle of a sentence when someone is barely talking
I didn't like her

She only reads off the slides during lecture, almost all of which have huge blocks of text. Sometimes she shows videos in class but it's not very worth it to go since she posts the slides anyways. Very exam heavy, I think I had one every two-three weeks, but they're relatively easy if you study and take the practice exams.

I took this course with a friend and we both agreed that the course was fairly simple, just heavy on content. The course is pretty test-heavy, however it's easy to do well with minimal studying. Her practice exams are very similar to the real ones, and everything in her lectures is true to what is on the exam. I enjoyed taking this class!

Don't get me started
Me and my roommate have studied hours and hours together for this class and yet we still get the bare minimum.We are both A students and it is very difficult to study without proper notes that line up to the Exams. I have never rated a professor in my life but I'm telling you pick the other teacher when it comes to this class.
You can be an A student in high school, study HOURS for her tests, and still do bad

Tests are nothing like her notes; she includes things that we talked about maybe once on the exams. The class does horribly on each exam, and she acts surprised. Don't even bother reading the textbook because it's nothing like what we talk about in class. She often rambles about things that don't matter or won't be on the test.

Dr Biederman cares about what she's talking about, but she takes it too far. If she hears the slightest sound in the 400 person lecture hall, she stops the lecture until it stops. She also frequently goes on tangents about plants and such, even when we're not on that unit. She offers extra credit and amnesty weekends around exams for each unit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't ever take a class with her. The exams are extremely difficult and the class average is normally around 60%. She reads straight off the slides so there's no point in even going to class. She says to look at the learning objectives and do the practice exams but the exams are not even comparable to anything we learned in class.

If you can take anyone else, please do, save yourself. She has random questions on the exam, 5 exams in a semester, over 500 slides of information per unit (roughly every 2 weeks), it is just extreme.

Exams are nothing like any of the practice. Almost always have oddball questions that we talked about for a minute in class. She does read off the slides, but talks about other stuff. If you have to take this course, get another instructor for your own sake.

she's awful. her exams are NOTHING like anything we learn in class and never actually teaches what's on the exams, i do good on practice exams and all assignments yet have failed every exam this semester. she's a literally devil

Her exams are awful. I have studied non stop all of the material provided and open the exam and be completely confused. It is like the exams are for a completely different class. She gives us a dynamic study module, and practice exams that mean noting because they are not relevant on the actual exam. Studying the book & notes is also irrelevant.

She reads off her slides so fast, there's no point to try and take notes in class. Her slides lack any real information. She relies on pictures and 3-word sentences. She always seemed annoyed if someone in class asked a question. She tests on seemingly random topics and doesn't let you view your exam after unless you request an appointment.

One of the worst professors. Reads directly off her slides in lecture and goes through them too fast. Will throw a FIT if she hears someone even whisper in her class. Exams are the most random questions ever and practice exams don't help. Fairly rude and entitled. Would never take a class with her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So basically, if you can choose another professor please do. She goes over a lot of material, and she goes really fast, so it is hard to keep up. You'll get the same questions on the practice exams, and then none of them will be on the real exam. I had to get a tutor. (I have As in all of my other classes)

She doesn't know how to seperate work from home, she share way too much and when she is teaching she literally just reads the slides, and yells if someone just whispers, she is kinda a b. Also her tests have the most random things ever on them, so guess you have to read the textbook

I was worried about Dr. Biederman but found her not to be as bad as I thought she would be. She posts all of the lecture slides ahead of time and reads word for word, so you know all of the content that will be on the exam. Her practice exams are really helpful. She is much easier to talk to in person, even though she may seem rude during lectures.

Her lectures are absolutely pointless and hard to understand. She reads off the slides constantly and is just not getting at getting the point across. She isn't a very welcoming person, don't be caught even making a sound in lecture. She has a weird obsession of animal reproduction. 0/10

she mostly just reads off the slides and attendance isn't required, so hardly anyone shows up to class. i read the textbook like twice in the semester and didn't really need it. her practice tests and DSMs were helpful for studying, but some questions on the exams were so random and poorly formatted. she does show cool videos though

I thought she did a good job of connecting the reading material to the slides that she created. She didn't just read off the slides, she used the slides to guide her presentation of the material the way anyone does who uses a powerpoint lecture format does. 

Really good depth to the material. Wish freshmen wouldn't talk so much during lectures...

Her lectures are pointless she reads directly off the slides (I would know because I attended almost every lecture). I even went back through and took my own notes for the exam. I studied for 10+ hours for every exam and majority of them earned a D or F. Even went back over all my homework, practice exams, etc. Her exams are google questions.
If you can dodge having this professor I would recommend it.

Attendance is not required. She reads off her lecture slides so there no point in going to class. Don't even think about talking in her class, she will hear you and give you the death stare or even better ask you to leave. You will have 5 exams with no cumulative final. Exams aren't bad, look over the practice tests and your notes before the exam.

I didn't attend lecture more than once a week and did just fine if not better. Five total tests, no final exam, easy if you prepare. She reads directly from her slides posted on Canvas, the only thing you won't get by not attending lecture is her review/practice questions. Don't even try to talk while she lectures, she'll hear you from a mile away.

I didn't attend class more than once a week and did just fine, if not better. Tests are easy if you prepare, no final exam. She reads straight from slides posted on Canvas, the only thing you won't get by not attending lecture is her review/practice questions. Don't even try to talk while she lectures because she will hear you from a mile away.

Honestly did not go to class after the first week and I did fine. The lectures don't seem to help at all. She just reads off the slides, which are accessible online. I just took notes on the lecture slides and reviewed the unit objectives for the exam. The only grades are from once a week homework assignments and exams. She was really petty though.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor was truly the most annoying, petty person I've ever had the displeasure of seeing. Her lectures were entirely unhelpful and you could learn everything better doing it on your own. Exams much harder and longer than other 211 class offered.
Kind of an eccentric person, very difficult to learn from. You get about the same experience reading the slides at home as going to class. Doesn't explain things very well.
She doesn't help you at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She runs through 78 slides in the span of 50 minutes. I have to start my notes an 1hr and 30min before lecture just to stay caught up, and STILL she manages to pass me in that time. It doesn't help that she is extremely petty.
Does not care about her students and makes things harder than they need to be. Also, can be a little petty.

The lecture slides are extremely compacted, but she always teaches way too fast, giving no time for any of us actually to absorb the information she's teaching. Also, the way she explains things only further confuses me. Also, don't talk at all while she's teaching, or else she'll rage quit, stare at you, and YELL yell at you. Just warning ya'll.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Personally, I will never take a class from her ever again. She is rude towards her students, and she makes learning biology the worst part of my semester. And her classes are graded on attendance, so it takes everything in me to even face her. Overall, not a good professor.

She was a bad teacher. She read straight from the lecture slides and posted them. You really did not have to go to class. Lecture was not engaging. The only good thing she did was post learning objectives that correlated with her slides and most of the test questions. She really likes herself and would throw tantrums if people even whispered.

I learned a lot from this class. I didn't think it was too difficult, but that might be because I took AP biology in high school. All of the tests are multiple-choice and her homework helped me study for tests.

There are very few assignments that are counted towards your grade outside of the actual exams, which could be pretty difficult. The best way to prepare yourself for her exams is to study the objectives for each unit, this really helped me get through her class. I don't think I would take another class with her in the future though.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Biederman's lectures felt useless to go to, as the slides that she read directly from were accessible from the Canvas page. Tests also had questions that felt unimportant or obscure; one I had was on the exact percentage of Iowa prairie left, with options like 5%, 2%, and .1%. She seemed passionate about the subject, however.

During lectures, she only reads off of the slides that are posted online, so no one shows up. Will sometimes create assignments that are difficult to find on Canvas, so I was unable to complete them because I did not know they existed.

The test are all over the slides. The lectures can help, but for a lot of the people I know they stopped going and their grade improved. She just reads off the slides, the slides however are very well made. To study review slides and do practice tests. Personality wise she is sort of petty and annoying, this can be seen through her emails.
She makes the tests off the slide shows. For some kids it doesn't help to go to lectures. To do good in the class just study off the slide shows and do a few practice test. She is a little petty.
She reads off of the slides and added unnecessary comments about the notes.

Slides were just read off of and no extra information was said during lecture. No study guides given out like other bio professors. Lots of material that was on the practice tests weren't on the exams and they were very hard to prepare for. Spent lots of time studying. Extra credit hard to do unless you have extra time. Do not get this professor.

I would not reccommend taking from this teacher. I dropped because all of her tests were so hard and worth 80 points per exam. She spoke really fast during lectures so it was really difficult to take notes. Exams were nothing like the practice tests.
She makes it very hard to learn
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I feel like her exams (which are every other week) are so hard to prepare for, it seems like everything the tells us to do like do the practice exams, go to s.i., etc doesn't help at all. idk where she gets these exam questions from bc they don't seem to be from the slides or the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was the worst professor I have ever had. Tests are 78% of your grade so not only do they make a large impact on you there are very few and small homework. There is no opportunity to boost your grade so pray you're a good test taker. Forget about extra credit to make up for this terrible style of teaching because there will be none.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was hesitant to take BIOL211 with Dr. Biederman based on other reviews in here, but I found her to be an excellent professor. Lectures are entertaining and expectations are clear. She is very fair and will work with you if you need reasonable accommodations as long as you are proactive about requesting them well in advance of deadlines.

It's a big lecture so there isn't much participation. I can tell that she likes the topic but there isn't much to keep you engaged since it is just a lecture. For the class I took we had exams every two weeks which seems like a lot but was actually helpful since it was less info you have to remember at once, plus she lets you take a note sheet in.

I thought Biederman was an okay teacher. I didn't like how she would read off of every slide and didn't have much to say for input. Some of her tests are very specific and hard. She doesn't curve exams but does offer extra credit. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but it was helpful. Her slides were posted, and there's online recording of the lectures.

Dr. Biederman was not my favorite professor, purely because of her testing methods. I felt the tests were extremely hard and the questions seemed random and hard to study for. I went to almost all the lectures and still did not do as well as I had hoped.

I personally thought that Dr. Biederman was an alright professor. Her exams are thorough, and as long as you do the practice exams before the actual exam, you should be alright. The only thing I dislike is when she lectures; she just reads off the slides and never really adds anything, so attending lectures isn't important.

Insanely hard teacher. Tests felt like random trivia of specific details I would have never thought to memorize. I watched every single lecture video and took detailed notes and still did poorly on the exams. I had her for Bio211 as well and she was just as hard then.
AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

One of the worst professors I have ever encountered. Provides a practice exam to prep for the exam, but after the second exam shared that those who had taken it 10+ times had lower scores than those that took it fewer times. Lots of typos in quizzes, class material, etc. Is unwilling to assist in your succeeding and just tells you to try harder.

Only reads off of slides and the tests are super specific and studying doesn't help at all. She doesn't give any feedback and actually sent an email after the 2nd exam (didn't give us an average but showed that nobody scored over 80%) that said to study harder and pay more attention. Honestly just kind of a bitter person in general.

Awful professor, only reads from slides, attending lectures barely helps. Exams are insanely specific and not a good test of the material. Very difficult exams, purely memorization of pointless material.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Exams were every other week, which was annoying but also nice because we weren't tested on as much material.

She goes through content quickly, no use in going to class. Don't get the textbook, everything on the test will be on the slides. Do the practice tests multiple times, the test is very similar. I didn't get a good grade in the class because the tests can be difficult, but if you get her teaching style at first you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Biederman reads directly off her slides, so there is no point of going to lecture. I stopped going for the last month of class and still got an A. She offers extra credit and a lot of easy homework, but her tests are difficult, and you do not learn the material. Take the practice tests many times since they are almost exactly like the tests.

She read off the slides for every lecture and didn't really expand on the content she was teaching. She gives you practice exams to take which are extremely helpful to do well in the class. She seems super passionate about the class and I learned some interesting content.

There are 7 tests over the course of the semester, none of which are incredibly difficult. There is also no final. Homework 1-3 times a week for 5 points, with unlimited attempts. You don't need to go to lecture but it helps. There are extra credit opportunities that are very easy. As a whole, I would recommend her.

The lectures are online and she bases it to not be in-person. There are exams pretty much every other week but no final which is nice. In lectures, she tends to read off the slides and not expand but seems extremely passionate about biology and nature. The homework is from the textbook but not horrible to complete. For a required course, not bad!

Usually, 1 or 2 reading assignments per week is pretty easy. The killer is her exams. 7 exams over 16 weeks. They are also in testing center. Exams are identical to practice exams but I still never got over a 80% on an exam even when studying days in advance. The lecture is fine but pretty much worthless since she talks too fast to take notes.

She is a terrible lecturer, goes in-depth about the things she could just skip over, and skips over the things she needs to go in-depth about. There is an exam every two weeks and the practice quizzes help, but not much. Be prepared to not understand anything because this class moves so fast. The best thing I did in this class was I got a tutor.

Everything learned in lecture is available on Canvas, don't need to be in class to understand. Reading and online module for each chapter, book required. Frequent, every other week, lower credit, 50 points, exams. 3 extra credit opportunities available. Really nice professor, good sense of humor, passionate. Accessibility friendly, wears a mask!
Really nice professor with a good sense of humor. I wish she taught more upper-level classes!

Easy enough to pass. My only issue was that some of the exam questions or poorly worded or had the occasional typo or grammar error. The practice exams have a lot of the same questions as the exams so do those five plus times making sure you know the answers and you'll do well on the exams. No final. Easy homework points and some small extra credit

Biederman is quirky and fun. I would suggest having her add you to the cybox for exact lecture slides. She reads straight from the slides, her slides do not make much sense though. There are in lecture activities. If you don't go to lecture, be prepared to get a C+ at best. Exams are hard, there are 7. The practice exams do not help much.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's mean.

If you apply yourself, attend lectures, and study you should do well. She makes things easy to understand and somewhat interesting. All notes covered in class are put online so attendance isn't really necessary. That being said, if you are an average student I would recommend attending class to do better on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lori Biederman probably should not be teaching. In general. She is a researcher and cannot lecture worth a hoot. Being frank, I skipped most lectures because I found that I learned more while not in class, because of how terrible she lectures. Exams were fine, textbook isn't the most necessary thing, she played more videos than actually taught.

Biederman is OK. All of her lectures are online but going to class can make a letter grade difference. Incredibly test heavy class, there are 7 exams and the only other things that go into the grade book are the homework assignments and the 10 points extra credit. She is very passionate about biology but not too caring about her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Passionate about biology, but moves super fast through lecture. thought she was decent until I sent her polite email asking simple question about grading. Her response was extremely rude and unprofessional. You will get a good grade if you try, but she will not even TRY to work with you, even if you are a good student.

She puts the powerpoints online so the lecture is basically the same as reading the powerpoints. Her SI instructor, Shaelyn, is amazing and I would highly recommend going to her sessions they help a ton.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I hated Lori Biedermans class. I heard she is on academic probation as of the year 2019 so do not even get her as a professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her slides are well explained/written and she is passionate in lecture. The videos she includes in lecture are well chosen for helping to convey points. She does not tolerate other people talking when she is speaking, which is understandable. Her extra credit assignments are nice. Study the slides closely for exams.

Recently changed class structure so older reviews are somewhat dated. She doubled the amount of questions on each exam so a lot of questions are overly specific. I spent a lot of time memorizing every little thing on her slides, cause nothing was off limits. I did fine, it was just annoying. EC was nice of her to offer though.

She reads right off the slides but will occasionally offer extra information and sometimes even test answers to those that show up. Homework is online modules that you can only get 100% on unless you don't do it. She gets annoyed by people talking or packing up early. But overall, she makes things pretty easy.

This class is an easy A. She reads right off the slides that are also posted on canvas so attendance isn't always mediatory but sometimes she will offer extra credit to students who show up to Fridays classes. She also posts practice quizzes on canvas that are almost identical to the exams. if you're struggling just tell her. she loves working 1on1

Attending class is not necessary at all. Lori reads directly off the slides, and very quickly at that. Handwritten notes will generally not work if you attempt them in this class because she goes so fast. Most all of the test questions are taken directly from her review questions that she posts on Canvas, and if you memorize those, you'll be ok.

Dr. Biederman is gives a decent lecture and is excited about the material she presents. The class is also pretty easy, the practice questions are pretty much the exam. However, she will stop lecture to call out anybody that makes any sort of noise and say they are welcome to leave and seems surprised when people stopped showing up to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She was very nice, but went through each slide after three seconds so it was impossible to take notes in lecture. I skipped every single class after the first test and I still got a good grade. Always do the reviews for the test because those are the exam questions. Online homework several times a week.
Lori is a good teacher but can be hard to follow during lecture with her exuberant personality. She is slightly scattered when presenting information but is pretty decent.

Lori is a fine professor. She gets side tracked sometimes. Lectures are hardly engaging; she doesn't require attendance or ask TopHat questions in class. All of the HW is online, with about 2 assignments per week, and you will need a book of some sort (online is good.) Exams are easy and online, she drops the lowest and the final isn't cumulative.

I had her for my first semester biology class! Do all the homework carefully and those are easy points. She also offers a lot of extra credit so do that too! The exams are all multiple choice and are off of her lectures. The review questions she posts are basically the exam for that unit. Going to SI also helped a lot! I would recommend her!

Lectures are pretty striaghtforward. You can skip class and look at lecture notes and book and do pretty well. Exams are pretty difficult and usually go much more in depth than lectures ever do. Gives some extra credit but not an easy class.

Easy homework, but extremely difficult exams. I got 3 D's after studying for hours on the exams. Worse yet, I could have studied for another 2 weeks for each exam and still ended up with the exact same grade every time. Does not teach applied concepts, but that's what 90% of the exam questions are. Talks so fast in class you cant even take notes.
Nice that you don't have to go to class, homework easy and all online. Tests really hard NEED to study.

Stay away! Insanely large amounts of complicated info thrown at you extrememly quickly. At least 15 terms youve never heard before in EVERY class period. Unless you want an F or you want your other classes to suffer cuz of this one, stay away from Dr Biederman!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Absolutely everything you need to know will be on her slides and study guides that she puts on blackboard. There are also a few extra credit options over the course of the semester. Basically, she wants everyone to pass and she loves teaching the course content so it's a great course and teacher.
Great class.  Much better than the second half with that other guy

Dr Bedermann was a great professor and made biology interesting. She does move fast so I would advise printing the notes out and highlighting  andjotting things down as she goes. All her information on the tests can be found in the lecture notes and the study guides she provides are extremely helpful. She loves biology and shares it with the class.
Great prof

Lori was the reason I switched my major to Biology! I loved the class and she was an amazing professor. She really cares about Biology too. She didn't have any clicker points so lectures were optional but I would definitely attend. She also had 6 tests, and drops the lowest score. She does go fast through her slides so copy them before class.

Dr. Biederman was super chill and you could tell she loves Biology. The only thing I would have to say is to take notes before the lecture. all of her powerpoints are online, and she moves through slides fairly quickly! also look at the study guides they really help.

There is no reason to go to class, she has a way of making 10 minute worth of slides last 50 minutes. In my opinion, Biederman is a below average teacher. She jumps all over the place talking about random tangents. It just depends if you actually want to gain knowledge or have an easy class, because it is not a very difficult class.

I took Biol 211 from her during her first semester teaching it and she was all over the place. There were way too many tests, lectures were long, boring, and useless, except there were a million clicker points and pop quizzes. She opened a test the Thurs before spring break, when I was going out of the country, and wouldn't let me take it early.
She has a lot of energy and enthusiasm.  She makes you earn your grade, but all of the information is available.  Much better than the other instructor
Everything on the exam was a heading in the powerpoints.  If you paid attention and came to class you should do fine.  Make sure you do the homework.  Those are easy points.

VERY NICE! Very enthusiastic about bio but is not great at teaching. Go to class because she likes to include random test questions about little things she says in class. Loves to share videos which can help with learning but they can get repetitive sometimes. Very hard to prepare for tests, never know what will be on them. Doesn't follow the book.
I have taken this class 3 times.  Dr. Biederman is the reason I passed this time.

Dr. Biederman co-taught the class with Dr. Hufford, but Hufford was definitely the better one. Dr. Biederman often mispronounced words, read off of her slides, and relied on random videos of sloths. For her tests, I straight up memorized her powerpoint slides. At least for the final she told you word for word what was on it.
I really enjoyed the use of videos in lecture.  It made the points clear and were nicely put into the lectures
I wish she taught the whole semester
Really good instructor.  Doesn't hand hold, but cares and keeps class fun.

If you can avoid taking the class with her, do it! Class isn't mandatory, which is a good thing because she reads directly off of the slides she puts online anyways. The material has absolutely nothing to do with the tests she gives. Don't ask her questions, because she wont know the answer. If you end up with her, do the E.C. and the homework
She talks SOOO fast. Be ready to learn it on your own.

The class itself isn't horrid; however information given in the class doesn't line up with the tests.  There is plenty of extra cedit, but not nearly enough to counter a bad test score.  Lectures are long and she reads almost directly from the powerpoints so attending the class isn't really required.  You can just look the powerpoints up later.

She is a very nice person, but does not teach the material very well. She will usually read the material right off the powerpoint slides and will dance around the questions that are asked. The tests are unfairly tough and have different verbatim that what was discussed in class. No matter how well you study, the tests will stump you in some way.

The class itself is more memorization then anything, the information is just buried in the lectures. The tests are pretty rough, but because the class average is low, and they aren't worth too many points you'll be ok if you do the homework on time.

Worst professor ever, I thought it was taught to never read off your slides. She not only does that but the test are ridiculously hard! Most of the time the test average was 50%.  She never updated grades to see where we were standing, if I could I would of steered clear of this professor. Take my word for it, do yourself a favor.

Exams are much harder than you would expect them to be based off of how broadly she teaches the class.  She stumbles her way through the lecture.  She reads directly off of the power point and can barely answer questions that students have.

Worst professor I have ever had. I am a BIO major, but this class was just awful. She reads off power points that are taken word-for-word from the book and shows dumb videos in class. She sometimes takes attendance. Overall disorganized and confusing. She doesn't seem to know very much about biology. This semester cannot end soon enough.

She has tests every other week over 3 chapters. She doesn't explain the material at all. She just reads straight off of her PowerPoints. She rushes through her lectures so she can jam as much information into them as possible. You basically have to learn the material, in detail, yourself

Very difficult class. The content itself shouldn't have been too hard considering it is an intro to bio class. Powerpoints were disorganized and hard to follow. She seemed to get confused when questions were brought up in class, leaving the students confused. She is nice overall, yet unfairly hard quizzes & tests.

Everything that everyone says about this professor is true. The clapping is constant and loud, zero time for tophats, and she is not sure how to work the grade book. Despite this, it is still the easiest A for an advanced bio ever
Easy online human bio class. Lecture each week was easy to follow and the questions are on quizlets.

I dropped this course very soon after taking it purely because of this instructor – which is a shame considering how interested I was in the course. Her English is not the best but the big issue was that the textbook for the course is entirely written by herself!! It is incredibly hard to read through and has consistently incorrect grammar.

I love this course! It offers a hybrid format with engaging discussions, insightful TopHat questions, and real-world clinical outcomes. Each session fosters critical thinking and idea-sharing, creating an inspiring and productive learning environment. It's a great option for anyone considering a career in the medical field.

Her grasp of the American medical system is poor. During lectures, she makes many mistakes, confusing students and talking back to them when questioning the mistake for clarification. She has a tendency to not understand any reason for missing class and refuses to allow make-up points for in class work. She also tends to reads emails w/o replying.

She wears a microphone and claps during her lectures and its really loud and bothers me. Would not take solely because of this. It hurts my brain. She goes through tophats way too fast. Usain bolt couldnt even keep up with the speed she clicks through them at. Pretty easy class though would recommend taking it online.

The content is amazing, bringing anatomy to life in an engaging way with multiple case histories. The Visible Body software is an incredible tool, making it much easier to visualize and understand complex anatomical organs. Dr. Bastawros was consistently available for questions, providing clear and insightful answers to my questions.

She does come off as rude sometimes so if you are sensitive and care about a nicer professor I would skip her class. The exams and all the work (quizzes, homework, group projects) were online and open book. As long as you read the textbook, listen to her little notes in class, and have your notes organized you will do fine.

There are two mid-term exams, 2 attempts each. There is a lot of group work, including one ~50 minute presentation, so make sure to find a good group at the start. If you read the textbook, take notes, and do the study guide questions you should be just fine. She doesn't have amazing English which can make communication difficult at times.

Professor leads Pre-Med studies and doesn't know much about the US medical system. Very unclear english. Can be nice if you talk to her but she doesn't care about her students. I recommend taking it online if you need the credit but if you truly want to learn you have to apply yourself heavily. Definetly wouldn't recommend, waste of time.

Dr. Bastawros is an M.D., so she likes to focus on the clinical applications of anatomy which is good if you're looking at med school, but not really for any other pre-health major. The "lab" is all online and super easy. You only meet once a week, but there is TopHat and group worksheets so attendance is required. Exams are online with 2 attempts.

If it's online bio 155 its extremely easy. 3 quizzes and one test every 2-3 weeks. Most of it is reviewable on quizlet or somewhere on the internet. I don't know why everyone says its so bad. I didn't mind it, idk if id take a class with them in person tho.

The material itself isn't too hard but half the time you can't even understand what she is trying to say in her lectures. Emailed her at the end of the semester three times about one of my grades that was incorrect and she never responded to me.

BIOL 350 is a flipped lecture so she does not lecture during lecture time. Lecture time is meant for answering questions, TopHat, and group worksheets. She expects you to watch the online lectures before coming to class. She can be very unclear at times as well as questions things unclearly on exams and homework.
She expects you to teach yourself everything before the lecture, and then you actually do assignments during the lecture time. Visible body labs are super easy .
She is very easy. I definitely recommend taking it online it definitely makes a difference.

I like Dr. B! I had her for anatomy too and she is actually very kind and accommodating if you go talk to her. The class was a must take for pre med or anyone curious about reproduction, I found the notes easy to understand. Some questions are worded difficult, but it was not the end of the world. Quizzes and assignments are fair.

The class was fine and fairly easy. She is very moody, rude, and sometimes blatantly disrespectful to students. No assignment are on the syllabus and she is a poor communicator. Constantly contradicts herself. Wont answer questions.She tried to assign hw during dead week(not on syllabus), against university policy, until someone argued against it.

Unclear syllabus and project rubric to the point that we didnt know what to do and when we asked for help, she responded with info as though we should have known about it. No point breakdown on the rubric, no direction on the actual required aspects. Lectures are boring.
She is a terrible communicator. She would only reply to one aspect of my emails, ignoring the rest. Do not take BIOL 155 for your natural science requirement.

One of the best classes I have taken at ISU. A lot of work and assignments, so you need to keep track of the deadlines. The content is very useful and applicable to life. The clinical cases were enjoyable as Im looking into med school. Virtual cadaver is fun to play with. At the beginning it is confusing, but later you used to it.

Dr. B ruined anatomy for me. I couldn't understand her in the recorded lectures, notes were not helpful on exams or worksheets, virtual body "lab" was a joke. I loved anatomy in HS and was looking forward to this class, but was extremely disappointed. Google taught me more than she did. Only good thing is that exams are unlimited attempts.

This class was completely virtual this semester. Each week, she posts the lectures, virtual body courseware assignments, group assignment, and weekly quiz. You have to have good organizational skills to actually watch the lectures and complete the assignments on your own. Interesting content but I wish I could have learned it in a classroom.

Dr. B definitely knows the content but in class, she contradicts herself a lot. We had to ask for clarification all semester because the ppt would say one thing and she would say something different. The slides had a lot of misspellings making it hard to take good notes. There is no rubric for the group projects so you are going to be flying blind.

This is one of my favorite classes at ISU. The instructor taught it in a way that is applicable to life. I enjoyed case histories. They allowed me to understand the topics. She is easily accessible and responds to my emails quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: this class is horrible, she is a horrible communicator, she cannot write test to save her life. she doesnt know how to explain things, asking questions makes things wrose. tophat is WAY harder than it needs to be. if you ignore everything she says and explains and you teach yourself youll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Heavy lectures, but exam questions are straightforward. if you pay attention in lectures, it is very easy to get full points in the exam. Contents are very interesting.
Dr. Bastawros cares about her students wanting them to learn and succeed. Having this class will make you learn histology in depth with a well educated instructor.

The material was taught well and it was taught well in a clinical applicable way that I found very interesting and helpful for my future in medicine. Although some students complain about Dr Bastawros, I think she was a great professor for this class and expected her students to put in the work that is necessary for a 300 level course.

Bottom line: Dr. Bastawros fails to communicate effectively. She is unable to present information clearly or concisely, and she is unable to clarify student questions. Her exams and quizzes would be easy if they were more literatehowever, FREQUENT spelling and grammar errors make everything twice as difficult. Be very wary of her courses.
Her grammar is so bad it makes tests/quizzes/tophat way harder than they need to be
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Bastawros is clueless in most topics. She refutes basic facts about the human body that are undeniabley true and is confused by her own statements. Her accent also leaves a slight language barrier. The slides have so many typos in them they are unreadable. She is uneducated and not fit to teach anatomy. Asking her questions leads to more confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Anatomy software,TopHat, Quizzes, Case Studies, in-class questions for credit. It was nice that she gave credit for our effort at every point in the class, I personally did not like the Q&A paper writing she asked us to do, but later I realized that it actually helped understand and remember certain concepts better. She is very helpful.
Very nice pace of materials. animation is very helpful. discussion topics are variable with extra-credit points. i enjoy the class.

You will have a lot of class activities, attendance is mandatory. Topics are tough but interesting. A lot of case studies in class. The professor is friendly, give you more time to complete the activities then explain it in more details. Heavy loaded in class work. You will enjoy the class specially if you plan to graduate or medical school.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr Bastawros is very nice, care about her students. She is easy to get in touch off class, and explain questions in more details. Lectures are heavy with lot of assignments but paying attention in class would make it easily to pass and have good grade. I would recommend have anatomy class with her. She is very knowledgeable.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This is heavy loaded course work but enjoyable. If you pay attention in class, it is easy to have good score in the exams. The professor is very competent in anatomy; you feel she is enjoy teaching it. She care about her students learning, always patient and repeat a point several times in different way. She makes me enjoy the study of anatomy.

The worst professor I've ever had. So many grammatical, spelling, and punctuation errors on slides that they are pretty useless. Does not speak clearly. Came off as very rude toward students and any questions that were asked in class, so people became scared of her and stopped asking questions/didn't respond to her when she asked something.

I enjoyed the freedom of online course, you could work at your own pace, unit materials is available all time. Dr. Bastawros is so nice. Respond to my emails promptly. She is very cooperative, understand and accommodate private situations; do some extension of deadline as appropriate. Thank you

Literally show up, participate, you will get a LEAST 25 points of extra credit in a 600 point class. Show up and present your student project, get 100 free points. She's also very accessible outside of class and very willing to help. Take every class you can with Bastawros because you WILL get an A if you make an effort to know her and participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I have learned a lot about human biology. The professor is so cooperative and respond to email promptly and respectively. enjoyed the extra-credit work!
this is a very good class, a lot of gained information that could be used in practical life. the professor is so knowledgeable and very friendly.

She uses lots of case studies but if you show up to class and actually participate you'll do well. No homework, few quizzes, minimal tests. Put in the effort and pay attention and this is a great class to learn about more in depth structures and the "why" to what happens in our bodies. English is not her first language so be flexible when in class.
Disrespectful towards students, does not attempt to help you understand better. Would not recommend.

Disrespectful when talking to students. She is rude when you try to ask questions and does not seem to care about students. Not helpful at all and not a good professor. Makes you feel unwelcome and stupid in class.
It is one of my favorite classes, with a lot of clinical cases, that were very interesting, since I am applying to medical school. I really enjoyed the class very much.

Dr. Bastawros is friendly and a nice person to discuss topics with, but her lectures are very confusing and the exams are very hard. Her accent does make her a little hard to understand and questions are not written clearly. This class is also taught at a level most students aren't at. Claims exam averages are 90%+ but majority seem to struggle.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Among the worst professors I have ever had. She is completely incompetent, and unaware of the suffering of the class. Her English language skills are poor and her grammar is nonexistent; the notes and her lectures have to be carefully decoded to be even superficially understood. She is terrible at using the microphone and administering Tophat ?s.

I took this class online, and I thought it was great. She was very prompt on responding to my emails however,  I understand the lanugage barrier some of the other studetns are talking about. When she would email me back it was sometimes hard to understand what she was trying to say. She let me take a test that I had missed the deadline for also.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not nearly as bad as everyone is making her seem. Our tests were pretty much all repeated questions from TopHat/Quizzes, which are all available online and repeated from years past, and there was a bunch of extra points possible! She's very nice and helpful, so a few grammatical errors in slides shouldn't change if you take the class.

This class was HARD. Textbook is almost useless, way too dense for this class. Sometimes she is hard to understand and her grammar and spelling sometimes make test/quiz questions unnecessarily confusing. Good thing she doesn't change her tests much, so you can find the answers online.

Huge language barrier.  She doesn't know how to explain concepts in English.  Contradicts her slides when she is explaining information.  Her tests have multiple grammatical errors as do her slides.  Would NOT recommend her.

Yeah, just run. This class is a joke. She will forget to make tests, she will change things on the syllabus ALL the time, her grading is impossible to understand. I didn't even know my actual grade until the term ended. She was honestly the worst teacher I had at ISU. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND!! You will hate this class. DO NOT TAKE!!!!

She was no help, lectures are vague and the book doesn't fill in the blanks. She is sloppy with deadlines and isn't organized in the slightest. She's hard to understand and her syllabus won't help you AT ALL! This class was the worst, period. Do Not Take!

Tests are tough and somewhat unclear but not completely impossible (I got C's but my friend got A's and B's). Her mini tests in lab are also very difficult and take a lot of time to study for.  Her lab midterm and final are much easier and help to raise your grade, as well as the final project. Overall, a tough but not impossible course.
Very hard class. Not worth time and effort.

She is a good person but horrible at teaching.  Her exams are horrendously difficult and her teaching methods aren't effective.  Her lab quizzes are also very difficult. Apart from the language barrier, she isn't very helpful. Her class is one of the hardest I have taken.  She also seems arrogant at times. I tried in her class and ended up with a C
She has a thick hispanic accent which makes it hard to understand her while she's lecturing. I learned more out of class teaching myself than going to class.

This was one of the worst classes I've ever taken. Her questions are very unclear and not straight forward in the least. She does not explain the material well and her notes are lacking material which is on the test. If you take this class take notes on what she says and not just the notes she gives you.

She was hard to understand and her lectures were just reading off the slides one by one. Very boring and had to get a tutor. She is not helpful and there was a language barrier.Dont reccommend hard class and exams are difficult.

I got much more out of reading the book than listening to her lectures.  She frequently had trouble explaining her points using proper English; it was a fluency problem, not her accent.  She also had difficulty controlling the class.  I wouldn't recommend her.
Very hard to understand. If it were not for the clicker quizzes I would not have shown up
Very unclear, doesn't outline the class well or explain the material.
Must attend every class because she does clicker quiz questions every day. She doesn't use a book at all so if you miss it's hard to get the lecture notes.

If you think he's a bad professor because his class was boring, you are challenged. I took his GEO 4390 class as well and you actually get to learn more about geology in a much smaller class (7 students). Great class good professor. Quit pouting.
this guy blows
