The only hefty amount of homework you'll have are the readings. You have to get them done before class or you won't understand anything (6-15 pages long), and he always cancels. If you're okay with losing hella money, then I'd recommend him! If you don't wanna lose $60-$80 per cancellation (often), don't do it. Big fat waste of my money with him.
I don't recommend him at all.

Is a good professor. I did the bare minimum for this class and still found it pretty easy. The exams are pretty simple; it's just the stuff he writes notes about in class. He posts a study guide usually a week in advance. Make sure to do all the readings and take notes when in lecture.

He canceled class last minute more than once, and lectures are boring but straightforward. His handwriting is poor, and lecture notes aren't posted online, but you can ask for them. Only one paper, four tests, plus reading points. Tests are easy if you attend review days and complete readings. He's nice, easy to reach, and pretty understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved this guy! Cracked jokes and made the material really easy to understand. Attendance is not mandatory but if you don't go you won't understand the material as well. posts no notes outside of class. There's a lot of reading involved but he's always open to answering questions and helping. also he had a lot of days where he canceled class.
As long as you take notes and study those before an exam, you will be fine. I play games when I am not taking notes and I average 95% on exams. You'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He just reads the articles and projects his terrible handwriting, in the in-class exams expects you to remember things he says in lectures. Does not put assignments on canvas, until they are graded. Changed the syllabus multiple times during the semester. Also does not post his notes after class. Extremely boring especially for a mandatory class.

Professor Long means well but teaches in an old-school way. With almost no assignments, one mistake can hurt your grade significantly. As a 4.0 sophomore double major, I found this class tougher than my major-related courses. The TAs grade harshly, like you're a philosophy student. Other professors for this class are easier, so choose wisely.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Long is one of the worst professors I have had. Skip class, you won't pass because he will not post anything and expects you to use what he talks about on time to formulate your papers. Harsh grader and no instructions posted. Doesn't use slides just projects his awful handwriting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Long class moral theory and practice wasn't too difficult. I put in minimal work and still got a good grade. I also asked him for an extension on a paper and he gave me a 3 day extension. His course was also pretty interesting. Another plus is he sounds and has the same mannerisms as Dax Flame (from 21 jump street).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You do not want this professor

She is very nice and accessible at office hours, but lectures are meaningless. Attendance is required due to graded practices, but no meaningful information is shared. Her lectures are nonsensical rambling with no clear points, most of my learning was outside sources. Semester-long project isn't too bad, but she doesn't give any meaningful feedback
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This teacher is unbelievably awful. Her lectures mean absolutely nothing, and you won't learn anything in the course without reading the book. She is the only professor who actually teaches this course and it is required for MIS majors. I 10/10 believe she should be fired or sent back to school to learn how to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Super nice lady, but her lectures are just completely unorganized rambling about upcoming due dates and vague concepts. Her "modules" don't tell you anything, and you have to guess what content is going to be on every exam. Good luck finding the material, it isn't posted anywhere.

Do NOT choose this professor if you can avoid it. Her grading rubrics make no sense, and the TA would knock off points for criteria not listed in the rubric. The prof rambles on the entire class period and her assignments are regularly confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Did not learn a single thing from lectures, learned everything on my own or with my group.

Pretty much every class, she just rambles on about the same problem and doesn't really go over anything. She is a very nice lady, but you are better off reading the textbook and just showing up to the class for the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She makes herself available with office hours and is friendly; but is awful at actually teaching you anything. All of the "lectures" are pointless and just consist of her talking vaguely about the material and assignments coming up. She essentially treats the class like an online course with in-person discussions instead of lectures.

When it comes to databases Zhu Dan is one of the best there is on the subject. Her class isn't too difficult until the last portion of the course where there is a large portion of a project due and the final. Overall, the class was okay as the content does become difficult towards the end.
She will lecture about topics then quiz and test you about other topics. There is no sense of an actual structure in the class.

Honestly, she gets a bad rep on here but the class I took with her wasn't too bad. As long as you do the assignments and watch her lecture videos you'll be fine. The projects are a bit long but they will teach you so much.

Classes are random and does not really teach any material to you. Exams are very hard because the material is never taught. Pop up quizzes once every week and does not prepare you well for exams or quizzes. Takes attendance every day even though she does not say she is. She does offer extra credit assignments at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Yikes

She is the worst professor i have had at Iowa state. We spend at lest 30 minutes of a 50 minute class discussing random, not relevant things. Don't take her she is horrible! She does know her stuff but she is not good at teaching it to students.

Very good teacher, very  easy to work with .Has a bad wrap on here but it's unwarranted. She has definitely improved as a professor and it shows that she is actively taking advice from students to improve.

She knows DBMS pretty well. I feel its one of her areas of strength. its up-to you to extract as much as you want from her classes. Try to meet her regularly to get into her good books. you will benefit eventually :)

She has got a good experience in writing research papers and also she has done a lot of research work which you can easily find out by looking at her profile. She has given really useful feedback and made us read different research papers of different  topics and gave us a good opportunity to explore out own research interests. She is friendly too.

Not sure about previous semesters, but this one was ridiculously easy. Exams were 95% word for word copied from the book's online quizzes and we got to use a cheat sheet. Assignments were all group based, so quite easy to do. Project was kind of vague, but doable. I agree she has little insight of her own, but the class it not that bad.

She seems like she knows a lot, but never answer ANY question from students.There was one occasion where she just stands there for about a couple of minutes b'coz no one helped her answering the question...until one of us helped her out. Never prepare her own ppt slide.She used the ones from the book without providing much further info. AVOID HER!!

Worst prof I've ever had. There was no direction to the class and it was hard to tell what was expected of us. We only had a final exam but it was over stuff hardly covered during the first part of the semester (everybody failed the exam). Try to avoid her if possible!

Absolutely do NOT take any class from her. Terrible teacher, the worst I have seen in college. I needed the class, and the only reason I got a B+ was because I had learned everything she taught before. She had to curve everything.
Definitely the worst professor I have ever had.  If you want any help, you might as well go to the TA or just give up, she doesn't care.

Terrible teacher. The worst teacher at ISU. Can't understand anything she says. Is not good at getting her point across. Doesn't care about students - she didn't learn anyones name throughout the semester. Avoid at all costs.
Horrible way of teaching...Dont learn too much and tests suck.  Grades Hard
No Comments
Her class is not that hard to follow, but her test is. She's a nice professor, knows her stuff well. Overall, I would give an A-

It might be hard to stay awake in her class, but if you manage to listen to her lecture and do in-class exercises, you have NO worries AT ALL. She explains everything that was taught in MIS 432 in just two lectures in a simple and concise and clear way.

Some of us are absolutely sure that she knows what she is talking about, we just arent sure if she is a great teacher.  she could do rdbms in her head, but falling asleep after 5 minutes of lecture because its so dry doesnt help.
Her definitions are clear as MUD.  Refernces are all over the place, no flow to the class.  Be discussing one thing one second then off on another without a word.
he was really nice!! i always stayed back to ask questions and it helped a lot
Pretty good TA, would take again
I had him for a math140 recitation. good at explaining and helpful during office hours. Would take another class with him but it's the last math class I needed lol

I have had him for two separate classes and am about to have him for a third class. I think he is an exceptional professor and very kind. I have a few disabilities that can make classes hard at times, but he was always understanding when I needed a moment. He does grade at the end of the semester, but gives you time to rework your project before.

Andren is a very nice and caring professor, maybe a little eccentric. His rubrics for assignments are very clear and extremely thorough. He is also happy to give feedback whenever you need it, and has even given me advice for other classes. Waits until the end of the year to grade assignments, but makes it clear how he feels about your work.

Oz was a wonderful professor to have! He is very nice, and very chill about projects! As long as you try in his class, that is all he cares about! My only problem with him is he never grades. It it 2 days until the end of the year as of right now, and I still do not have a grade for this class, which is very frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Legit one of the chillest guys in the Graphic Department. Gives a bunch of cool advice and tricks. The workload is never too heavy, and overall it's just a nice class to be in.

She has the most annoying voice I've ever heard. The lectures drag on forever and she just reads off the slides with not much to add in content. You'll get done writing the notes off a slide and she'll still regurgitate whatever was on them for another 5 mins. The work is easy, but I literally had to swap courses because I fell asleep every class.
She has clear expectations and guidelines and is hilarious.

Dee was one of the best professors I had. She is very caring and makes her lecture engaging. She gives you a packet every module where you fill in the blanks and posts everything on Canvas. The packets had everything that would be on exams. You got extra credit if you missed less than 7 classes which is more than fair in my opinion.

Having taken this course at the beginning of my freshman year, I am grateful for Dee's empathy and flexibility. Being able to find work arounds for attendance points, receiving extra credit for COMST Club, and the helpful and directive feedback that she returns on assignments make this class not only easy in itself, but also easy to recover in.

Dee is sweet and loves to joke around and her lectures are interesting. She is a very engaging speaker and gives fill in the blank notes so you don't have to write more than you listen. Dee doesn't allow computer or phone use during class time. Her lectures go by pretty quickly and the content is really useful.

Dee is AMAZING! If you can take a class with her, you have to! She is so caring and creates a good relationship with all of her students. Class comprises homework assignments for each chapter, an exam every 2 chapters (online), and 2 essays (one due midterm, one due finals). This was my all-time favorite class of the semester!! Highly recommend!
Dee is great, she's been my favorite teacher this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dee is absolutely amazing. She does a phenomenal job with lectures and supplements learning for her students. I actually found this class very interesting for being interpersonal communications. Dee really cares for her students!
Super understanding and caring. Great to talk to, super cute and funny. As long as you participate and put effort into the class, all will be good.
Hard class taught by a strong confident woman with a lot of experience.

Dee is a fun professor and she often uses her own experience to illustrate her points. You do use the textbook often and many assignments come straight for the information there. If you listen in class, Dee says points out essay questions and if you just look over her note packet you should be fine for the 3 exams
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dee is a wonderful person, but she lacks a lot in instructional ability. She isn't consistent with what she says. One day she says the speech is for two people, the next class she says it's for 3 or more people. She changes assignment due dates regularly, so you have less time to spend on big speeches. Overall, I wasn't impressed with this class.

One of my favorite professors I've had at ISU so far. Great person, interesting, reachable outside of class, and works with you in terms of grades and due dates. You need the textbook for this class, you will use it often for homework. There are pop quizzes, but she often will let you use a partner, notes for 1 minute, etc. Interesting course too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She has no idea what she is talking about. She often pronounces words incorrectly and she reads the book the regurgitates back into a power point. She is an easy grader. But does not use blackboard or regularly update you on your grades.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dee is super helpful. I hated printing out take home tests and assignments and she was super cool with letting me send them over email. Go to class! After 4 misses she will drop your grade. Small class was awesome and we all got to really know each other.
Takes attendance every day :( but the class is extremely easy. Fill in notes, tells you whats on the test, extra credit options. Can do without the book probably.
Very stubborn and stuck in her ways but cares a lot about the success of her students. Very hard exams.

She made examples so you don't fall asleep as much, but the class is basically putting vocabulary labels on everyday situations(ie thinking of other things during a conversation is "psychological noise). the class wasn't particularly helpful.
She was a hard TA for Speech but very fair, honest, and understanding.  She did exercises to help you relax and prepare for you speeches.
I was terrified of speech but she made it easier.

A great professor. When we talked to her about her text-heavy slides, she was ready to remedy it, and the next class came with some great and engaging content. Also, she has always been very kind, and I learned a lot.

Professor Swanner's teaching Geology 100 is truly one of the most boring lectures you will ever attend, with paragraphs loaded on her slides. Swanner had to include extra credit exam make-ups (reason I passed her class) because of how low our class averages were compared to other Geology 100 classes, which should reflect on her teaching strategies.

In the entire hour and 15 minutes of class, Professor Swanner is reading off the slides for lectures without any more information except what is on the PowerPoint. Also, she never knows the answer when a student asks her a question. Personally, I feel like she doesn't truly know what she is talking about or know any information on Geology.

Lectures are extremely boring. Long paragraphs on the slides and she reads them off and doesn't give any time to copy down the notes. Material is so easy, but she makes it so hard and confusing. I learned this better in 7th grade.
Unfair grader, gives no feedback, doesn't allow students to learn from mistakes. Not a hard class, but you won't learn anything.

Dr. Swanner is one of the best professors I have had at Iowa State. If you go to lecture and pay attention even a little bit you'll do fine on the quizzes. We only had a midterm and final but, at least for fall 2020, it was a take home that was open note so it was not hard at all.

Easily the worst professor I've had so far at ISU. She lectures like she's a 7th grader giving a presentation and reads off of the slides. Can rarely answer a question during lecture and her powerpoints have whole paragraphs on them. You'll be responsible for 41 units worth of dense material that is impossible to absorb on the final.

Dont even think about taking her class. She is absolute garbage. I question if she even knows a single thing about geochemistry. She states daily "this isnt my area of study" or "I'm not familiar with this material" about every single subject. If you are confused about a topic, don't even try to get a better explanation, she won't give you one.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever come across, has no interest in helping students get better as when she does not know something she either says "I do not work with this or am not specialized with it" or completely gives up. I did not learn anything taking her class and would recommend to take any class besides anything with her leading it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is an awful lecturer who reads from her notes during class and makes so many errors on the board it becomes hard to decipher what is right and wrong. Most of the time she relied on students to correct her. Swanner's knowledge of the material is very basic and she only understands it her way.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: As a senior at ISU, Dr. Swanner is one of the hardest professors I've had as far as grading exams and the essay goes. However, she gives really well thought out feedback and commits to making sure her students get better. She's also one of the few professors I've had at ISU that loves her research and loves teaching her classes in equal amounts.

I would suggest another studio teacher if possible. She assigns a lot of homework that will keep you up late in the studio for multiple nights to finish projects because the deadlines are early. Nice lady, but very high expectations.

Very chill and sometimes fun, but likes to get stuff done. Feedback can sometimes be confusing, it's hard to tell if she likes an idea or hates it, but overall she wants you to make your own decisions. Her grading was pretty straightforward, just put effort in and fulfill the criteria. One of the few professors I've gotten along well with at ISU!

I'm not a huge fan of her. She is very confusing as her attitude, things she says, and the tone she uses is constantly changing and contradicting itself. Her feedback or critiques of your work come off as rude and she seems to play favorites. One day she loves my project and the next it's the worst thing she's ever seen. Wouldn't pick her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I personally enjoyed her as my professor; she gives good feedback and is overall nice. She is more of a strict grader but recognizes hard work. She shows no favoritism it seems.
Chill but can get annoying

She can be cool at times, but overall she's a very strict professor. She's not always empathetic or understanding about student circumstances compared to other professors I've had. Her feedback can be helpful, but it sometimes comes off as blunt or overly critical. She gets frustrated easily and sometimes her tone can feel unnecessarily mean.

This semester, it was online AND asynchronous (not usual). Not great, but I do appreciate that this format fit my schedule. Lots of reading. Mostly discussion board posts. Modules were locked by week, which meant no looking ahead at assignments, and the grading criteria were somewhat lacking in specificity. Feedback was detailed, rich, and timely.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Emery is not joking about her content, but I don't think that's a bad thing. You have to do homework and participate in class; while it's not graded on participation, it helps. It's also a little bit about luck because the whole class is partner-based, which I loved, because my group is awesome, but the group can make or break the class.

Often the lectures are her talking and talking and talking. She doesn't take criticism well and tries to convince you that she is a good professor- the students are the problem. You have a minimum of three writing assignments due in a week, and the TAs leave SO much commentary- even if you fix their suggestions, they still take random points off.

She and the TAs did not agree on grading so there was lots of variance. She expects us to complete the work before coming to class and then spends most of the week going over the exact same information. Group work heavy. I dreaded going to this class just because it was the same thing over and over, week after week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: The professor expects you to teach yourself the lesson before class, and then she spends the whole week going over it (waste of time).  Professor and TAs never agreed on grading, so you never knew what you were going to get.  So many assignments and continued to assign things during Prep/dead week. I would've skipped if attendance wasn't mandatory.

This professor expects you to watch videos on your own time and teach yourself, and do group projects outside of class. Professor did not show up any Tuesday and instead the TA's were expected to teach, and she did not show up for a total of 5/6 Thursdays with absolutely no warning or explanation even though she grades us based on our attendance.
She never attended class the TAs did all the speaking. We were expected to watch lecture videos, and complete homework before coming. She took attendance, and the lectures were a joke.

I have no personal bias against this professor, just the class in general. I believe this should be a 400-level course because you do everything outside of class, then come to class to ask questions or to be presented with review information from what you studied on your own. Attendance points = a joke. This class has crushed my GPA and my soul.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The grading scale for this class is ridiculous. I check my grades for this class constantly because your grade is either going down, or moving up slowly. I haven't retained any information, and it feels like a chore attending this class.
Horrible, expects us to teach ourselves!

Alyssa tries to be caring to her students but it really doesnt come across well. She is a tough grader and expects you to read her mind to know the exact answer she wants. The grading system is weird and class time is not spent wisely. You have to watch lectures outside of class.

Emery does not care about her students, just that she teaches the content. The course is not structured fairly and you don't get full points if you don't give maximum effort on every single thing. She expects you to read her mind when answering questions and there are VERY few points to earn in the class overall, fat L guys.

The WORST professor at ISU. Emery takes too much time in class to try and be "relatable" with the age of students in the course. I took this course 2 years ago and I STILL have nightmares about this woman. Very uncaring, never empathetic, and overall just a horrible class filled with opinionated ideas. Do exactly as she says, and you'll do fine.

Professor Emery is not a caring professor. On the first day of class, I showed up only a couple of minutes late to class. She proceeded to embarrass me in front of the whole lecture class. She doesn't respect students and acts as if her class is more important than any other. Would not recommend it. If I could give a zero, I would.

Dr Emery herself is a great professor to have. The course, however, is absolutely brutal. This is probably my least favorite class at ISU so far. You have to stay on top of it and be good in a group as there are group and individual assignments due at the end of each week. The grading is HARSH but they provide really helpful feedback. No EC.

Do not let the older reviews scare you. Jason is incredibly helpful if you show up. He provides hints for the quizzes and homework during lectures, and lots of extra credit opportunities. Plus, the final is optional if you choose to average your first two exam grades instead. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it makes a huge difference in your grade.

Jason is a great professor, and the information in the class is helpful if you are pursuing a career in the audit field. The course is difficult, but if you go to class, pay attention, and take notes you will do fine. You will have to study hard for the exams as they are difficult, but if you listen to his hints in class you will be ok.

His teaching is relatively straight-forward and uses retired CPA questions on every single exam. You'll also have various group projects throughout the semester, which are pretty easy as long as you sit next to the right people on the first day. There are also case studies that you do in class, which are easy so long as you read them before class.

The class average was a 64% on the first exam and in class he said "this is what he expected the outcome would look like". If the whole class fails the exam maybe it's on you? DO NOT take this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This dude teaches an audit course but only worked in audit for like 9 months. He has NO idea what he's talking about. Take a different professor, dude sucks.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: great professor! He is very personal and cares about his students!
Highly recommend taking this class with this professor as a last resort.
My professor was awesome and super helpful!
The professor was always willing to help and answer any questions that I had.
one of the best accounting professors at Iowa State.
He is one of the best accounting professors at Iowa State.
Lectures are very dry. Poor communication throughout the semester. Beware of the final!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The class is difficult but he gave great feedback. Definitely care about his students.

Gives a cumulative final for an introductory audit course, not really helping. states in the first class students will fail exams because it is difficult. Lectures drag and seem to make no sense whatsoever. Even if he is a good researcher, not a great professor. Loved the projects and case studies, other than that a bumpy ride.
Great Professor!

Lectures must be hand written and submitted for credit weekly. Group project is a nightmare. He is a terrible professor. I do not learn from his lectures whatsoever. The textbook is very vocabulary heavy - good luck trying to learn from it if you don't understand what he is trying to teach in lecture.

Julius is a  nice guy but I'm not a fan of how he runs his courses and especially critiques. He doesn't really let you present your own work and he gives 0 feedback or time for feedback from classmates either, which I really hate because I put a lot of time into my work and I want to know what people think and what is working/what I can improve on.

Julius is one of the best teachers, mentor and friends I've had at this school. If there is anyone that guides you in the right creative path, it would be Julius. He's caring, understanding and has a great sense of graphic design history, ideologies, and practices. I highly recommend Julius to students of all years. He's the best of the best.

He is very good at one-on-one check-ins throughout class, and makes sure you know he is available if you have questions. Assignments are fun, as he gives you more creative freedom with them. Passionate about design and type.

Gives great feedback (especially if you approach him first), funny, approachable, very intelligent, but talks so much. His lectures can be redundant, but he gives out a lot of great information & is extremely knowledgeable about the industry. Assignments were interesting and he gives a reasonable amount of time for them.

(DSN 102 not ARTGR270) Finley is a very easy teacher, with only 3 projects throughout the year one being a group project, expectations were very minimal. He talks ALOT so be ready for that, if you ask a simple question he may give a 3-5 minute answer. I did the minimal to receive a B+, worked very little in class and outside of class.

This review is for **DSN 102**, Julius talks a lot, so if you ask a question, be prepared for a long answer. He is very laid back, I did very minimal work in this class, and most of the time sat on my phone and he did not care. You have a very long time to do projects, and even if you turn them in with half-effort you will still get a decent grade.

I have had Julius for multiple semesters and he is my favorite professor. He is so kind and gives great constructive feedback to better you as a designer. If you do not know how to do something, he will walk you through it and genuinely cares about all his students. He is very understanding, you learn so much and grow as a designer.
literally never stops talking like ever idk how he doesn't realize how redundant he is

Projects are guided, workflows are clear, and resources are abundant. He has a knack for breaking down complex projects in a way that makes them manageable and fun. This is something I have carried over into my job. Listen intently, and you gain technical knowledge/insights vital to succeeding as a designer. Take him to skill up your portfolio.

He is super long winded. Ask a questionget ready for a 10 min answer. He doesnt lecture well either. Just on the project brief. Makes you watch other videos outside of class. Gives alright feedback in class. Not super free outside of class. Is very organized. Doesnt like to have conversations he just talks and talks. Half of projects animation.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Finley is an average teacher. He grades very harshly especially when he does not give many suggestions at all during class as he relies on students giving suggestions. He posts tutorial videos which is nice. Be prepared to sit through a very long studio as he talks the entire 3 hours. Not the worst class ever but not the greatest.

I think Julius is a nice guy. He is chill and easy going. You don't have to be in class at all but he strongly advises coming to them. He has about 3-4 projects given during the semester. He gives class time to work on it. If you ask for feedback he will send you a whole book of feedback to fix. Sitting through critique sucks. He grades tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Julius is a very approachable guy, but when it comes to critique - he will wait for the last possible second to give you any constructive feedback. Some critiques may last all-class (3 hours) or multiple classes (6+ hours). The good news is class attendance isn't mandatory. Skip class to get work done because work time is barely given.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Had in ARTGR 2710. I LOVE Carol, easily the best Professor I've had. She gives great advice but doesn't pressure you to do anything, and encourages you to do what feels right for your projects. She's very nice and caring, and is understanding of student stress. I've never been stressed out for critiques in her class. Always choose Carol if you can!

very good at intro level classes, will take extra time teaching students who don't know the software and will push student who do know it to do better work. easy grader and very relaxed, does a lot of group and in progress critiques. also shows lots of student examples in class and patient with everyone

Professor Faber is nice but doesn't give any real feedback. She gives you several ideas but none of them are similar to each other and does not give clear instructions which I really struggle with. She also responds to student stress or perfectionist tendencies with "just don't" which does not help at all. She is a very easy grader though I guess.
Love her. I would gladly take any class she was teaching. She is so fun and offers unique feedback. She does studios and little differently, but honestly I enjoyed them more than my other studios.

I LOVE Carol and would gladly take any class she teaches! She is so helpful at guiding you throughout each project and helping you figure out your art style if you feel lost. You will get plenty of one-on-one interaction and great feedback. She is also so kind and empathetic. Due dates were not strict other than the final critiques, which was nice.

I really enjoyed having Carol as a professor. She was always pretty nice and understanding. She does things a bit differently than other studios, but I enjoyed the way she did assignments. She also gives you much creative freedom as long as it follows the general project guidelines. She pushes you with your projects, but in a good way. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: CAROL IS AWESOME! I have really enjoyed having Carol as a professor this year. I had her for 270 and enjoyed her class so much that I took her course for ARTGR 271 as well. She is very encouraging and gives lots of feedback. She is very understanding of time and circumstance and gives ample time for projects. Complete each step of the projects :)

Seemed great on the first day, but soon found she loved to repeat instructions multiple times, make passive-aggressive comments, and was overall very patronizing. She seems to take things personally and gets VERY upset if you are at all late or need to miss a class. Apparently going into debt to take an art class makes you a prisoner in her class.

Very encouraging and helpful, Faber wants you to explore your interests and use them to your advantage. She gives good advice and will talk about any topic you want; she is very kind and understanding. She lets you interpret the project description broadly. She just wants to see you succeed and be happy with your work.  Wonderful and encouraging!

Rude, entitled woman. Gets very upset if you work on anything else in her class besides crappy photoshop tutorials. Does not care about image quality, just checking off her list of requirements. Will make snarky passive-aggressive comments that often contradict herself. Really wish was not a required class. Wish I had more than 3 skips allowed.

Took photography with Faber, learned a lot about cameras and photography.  I didn't know anything about them before though, so anyone who knows anything about photography will have an easy time.  Make sure you don't get on her bad side - get to class on time, don't forget things more than twice, be polite, etc - she can have a temper some days.

Fleming cares alot about her students but she does not tolerate bs, she is willing to help out any students willing to be active in her class but if you are not there and not participating she can come off as a hard professor. She is not flexible with deadlines but they are generally reasonable, the workload is not very consistent from week to week

Susan did try her best but overall was not a great a professor. The exam were super hard and she even bragged about the averages being low. Attendance was not “mandatory” but there was always an in class assignment. Overall, did not like this class.
Professional. Knows her industry.
Professor closes homework so you don't get late points nor can you review the materials to study from.

She was fairly disorganized in some of her lectures, and went through the slides very fast, making it hard to take any notes. The notes that were taken were taken too fast to be sufficient for the tests. Overall, the class was easy, and she was very charismatic within her lectures, but I wouldn't take her again.

I think Susan was a great professor. Attendance is mandatory (in class assignments) and tests were a bit difficult, but you get 2 pages front and back on each exam and you'll do fine as long as you take the time to do the study guides. Susan made the class fun and was very friendly and caring about her students.
Bad to OK professor, attendance mandatory and tests are way too difficult for an intro level class.
Susan is great, just a lot of course work for a class that is taken as an elective for most students. Client semester project is fun, again just a lot of work for an elective course.
Genuinely one of the worst instructors I've had across any level of anything ever. Pretty rude and inconsiderate to students as well.
Exam averages were 70% and she said that was good! Makes attendance "mandatory" and flies through lectures way too fast. Take another prof if possible

Really chill lady, you can tell she actually cares about what she's teaching. She is a tough grader but lays it out on the table on the first day. Basically if you show up, participate, answer questions, and do what you're supposed to do, you'll get an A. She was probably my most relatable professor by far.
Class is a group project-heavy. Focus on creating a good relationship with her, and she will be a lot more caring and forgiving. Answered all of my questions with good feedback.

Exam review sheets and discussed concepts in class are not correlated to the exam question structure. Susan is disorganized and can leave you quite confused when the exam comes around, and little from class work, homework, and study materials correlate to the actual exam. The exams need restructuring, at least in a way that isn't misleading.

Nothing on the exam review is similar to the test. She allows for two pages of notes, and I crammed all of the exam reviews on there, and I used maybe 10% of it. The other parts were just not useful and not even on the exam. God forbid there's a review document with any stuff related to the test.

Susan Fleming is extremely unorganized, either losing papers turned in or forgetting to grade things, requiring me to go out of my way to have my grade be put in correctly. Her class structure is horrible, she never takes responsibility and is never willing to admit she's wrong. Do not take this class if you want a strong connection with your prof.

When I turned in assignments that were completed she would almost every time enter them as a 0/5 until I reached out to her regarding my grades. She also claimed that my group never came to class (we were there every day of the semester) and then she switched our team name to "The Over Sleepers."
i dont like her

TAKE MARKETING WITH PROF FLEMING! Her lectures are interesting and she truly cares about all of her students. She makes being in a big lecture hall feel personal and intimate. I recommend trying to sit in the front because she really makes an effort to get to know you and it seriously pays off. All exams are online.
Class was a bit disorganized and wasn't sure what to be doing on the group project at first. Otherwise fairly easy to get an A in if you attend class and do the group projects.

Professor Fleming is a really nice lady who cares about her students. Overall, it is a laid-back course that is very easy to pass. However, to earn an A, you need to go above and beyond what is expected of you, and if you are not a marketing major, this can be frustrating. Overall a good experience; if you are a marketing major, you will love her.

There are participation points every day, so attendance is mandatory. Susan was very slow to respond to emails, and I usually had to send her at least one follow-up email to get a response. She tried too hard to get students to like her -- she tried to act young and cool. Class is very boring, and I did not learn much from it. Easy class though.
Class is filled with assignments that just serve the purpose of wasting time. Semester long group project that is a joke. Easy class though.

Prof Fleming cares so much about her students! Her lectures are really engaging & fun. Make sure to come to class, because there's discussion guides every day and your team will rate you for your group participation.

She was amazing! I learned so much from her class. Not to mention she really cares for you.

Also, compared to the other marketing professors, I felt I learned so much from her and it was easier too! Just show up to class!

I found the lectures really pointless and the semester long group project felt like a waste. If you take her class make sure your group selects something you are really interested in or it will be a terrible experience. Tests had poorly worded and often misspelled questions. Large amount of extra credit is the main thing to save my grade.
Great professor! She is super interactive with her lectures and gives you time in class to work on the group projects which are a significant chunk of the grade. Learned a lot from her
Great professor, one of my favorites. Would recommend.

Professor Fleming is my favorite professor I've had so far at ISU. MKT 340 was super easy and she did a great job setting up the course in a way where I was able to do the work at my own pace, and nothing felt like a surprise on the exams or assignments. I definitely recommend taking MKT 340 with her if you are looking at different professors!

A decent choice for professor, but makes you go above and beyond. Concepts are very abstract and you need to put the time into the class. Very hard to navigate the canvas page, and not a clear syllabus for what is do throughout the semester. Responds to emails very quickly and wants to help.

Fleming is a great professor and sets high expectations for her students. She makes you work for your grade. You work on an individual semester-long project which is fun and challenging. Easy EC points offered. You learn a lot from this class, which makes for intense exams(4, and one final). Super rewarding class and you become a better student.

Professor Fleming is a solid choice for MKT 340. The class is not difficult as long as you read the textbook, watch the lecture videos, and turn in your work in time. She makes the class easy to navigate for online students.

Before taking MKT340 with Prof Fleming I was a bit nervous because I had read previous "reviews" of her on here and they were discouraging to say the least. I enjoyed her & her class a lot! It wasn't too hard but there was a lot of group work, which personally I find annoying. The exams were challenging but not too hard if you have a general idea.

Do not take the class with her... she doesn't tell you clearly when things are due and didn't tell my class when an exam opened up until the day it opened. She also told our class that shes trying her best to hide the fact shes not organized. Wish i liked her but she is just not it :/

340 with Susan was about as average as classes get. Not the most exciting material but Susan does a good job of making the topics interesting. For my section there was a group project and test for every module. There is a lot of work to complete, but the class is a fairly easy A due to the large amounts of extra credit offered.

Most unorganized prof @ISU. Exams and each group project are due before we have learned the content. Won't respond to emails in time and takes forever to grade. Horrible tech skills- made us take a corrupt exam & canvas is a mess. Doesn't clearly answer student questions and always talks about herself, but never accepts responsibility for problems.

Do NOT take this class. She is very unorganized, takes weeks to enter grades, and wastes everyones time in class. She also constantly showed up to class late, failed to respond to emails, and would not be prepared to lead class. We even had a testing center exam that corrupted and when students approached her she made no changes.

Great teacher! I really enjoyed coming to class everyday. This is her first semester so there were some issues but she always addressed them. The group project is a lot of work, but if you just follow the guidelines youll do great!

Awful teacher. She is so unorganized it makes my head spin. This class could be easy but half the time you dont even know what the shes talking about. The group project is bull and so unorganized the way she puts it

Susan is the worst professor I've ever had. Her lectures are completely pointless; her exams are solely based off of the textbook. While in class we could be working on the ridiculously large group project that is split in 4 different parts, but instead we watch pointless videos that benefit us in no way. I hope this is her first and last year @ISU

I did not like her teaching style, the class was not hard but just her lectures were so dreadful. She did give good assignments and exams werent too bad. She also gave extra credit on exams, adding 1-5 extra points just for showing up on rainy days, or random days.
A fun Professor. Cares, but doesnt really do much math in lecture and she says thats for lab. Labs can be really helpful, and if you are in a group it is very helpful.
Very strict on being on time in class, and not leaving for the bathroom.
She was just an all around bad professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lectures were hard to follow. Exams were not straightforward and the average was in the 55-65% range. It also takes her weeks on weeks to grade exams so you never know what your grade is really at. When she says your exam grades will be put in the next day they will not be and it will take another week to even see them.

All the lectures are her writing on a screen, so if you miss class, you miss the entire lecture since she doesn't post her notes. She also tends to teach something wrong and then has to re-due a whole section to correct herself. The study guides are hundreds of questions long and all the students were pushing to finish on time during exams
The class takes effort, but the professor explains concepts well. Study guides are extensive, but tools like Unstuckstudy can help manage the workload. Overall, a challenging yet rewarding course.
Worst professor I've ever had, you can tell she does not care about her students. You have to write down every word she says. The study guides are also terrible and no help.

Amani is a great teacher and this is a great class if you want to learn more about the ag markets, espically corn. However, she tends to lecutre on and on about things until about 30 minutes left of her class to than go over the new material. Besides that, I definetly suggest this class as it is also a very easy class to help boost your GPA.

Amani's approach to teaching is that you sit there and write down every word of her lectures. They seem to take forever, are extremely redundant, and are borderline incoherent. I hated every second of classtime. For exam prep she gives you 300+ multiple choice questions with the answers and 50 might be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had her my freshman year for econ 101 and 102. Best way to start college. She was a tough grader and had a lot of topics to cover, but god was she a great teacher. Genuinely still think about her and how she is one of my favorite teachers of all time.

Amani is a great teacher, but I have one gripe. Exams will have 25 -30 questions. Exam Study guides will have around 200-250 questions. And our final exam study guide was 54 pages, 750 questions. This is just absurdly difficult to study, and it feels impossible with other classes.

Attendance is NOT mandatory, but she offers extra credit every time the class attendance is below 70%. There are very few things to be graded by, so ATTEND CLASS! She does not post most things online because she wants you to go to class, and you will get points for going to class. GO!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was difficult for me, but if you put in the work and study you'll be fine. Professor Elobeid gives a lot of extra credit opportunities, exams are in class and she tells you exactly what will be on the exam. She explains everything more than once and answers questions. She is your best bet for Econ 102.

Class was fairly difficult but Dr. Amani was always giving out extra credit for attending class. Would say there was an extra credit opportunity every week. Lectures were fairly long but receiving extra credit for attending was always worth it. Dont miss a class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hard class that requires some effort, but she is a good teacher who cares and does more than just read a power point.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great person, bad teacher. Her test for econ 235 was nothing like what she talked about in class. Doesn't grade on a curve. Canvas won't show your accurate grade because she won't go through the effort to weigh it correctly so you won't know your grade until it's too late. Also talks super fast in lectures, hard to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amani was very understanding with the whole Covid thing, and gave lots of extra credit opportunities and practice problems to ensure understanding.
The class was all online due to COVID, there were lectures online, she does a great job explaining the content, and is always happy to help if you have questions.

Amazing at communication and extremely helpful answering my questions. Her voice can sometimes grate the ears but you'll come to love how clear confident she teaches/talks. Knows her stuff, really tries her best for the students, and is a sweetheart deep inside. She cares about you lots, especially if you care about learning/understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you show up, pay attention, and take notes you will be fine. When the class went online, she made the appropriate accommodations. You will know exactly what will be on the exams. Attendance is "optional" but she takes attendance for extra credit so just show up. DON'T BE LATE, she will call you out and is one of her biggest pet peeves.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: As a person, Dr Amani was very nice and her lectures were engaging. But, her syllabus was misleading. She wrote attendance would not be taken/wasn't mandatory. But she did take attendance on top hat and if you were absent, your grade was impacted. Extra credit was said to be optional, but your grade was affected negatively if you did not do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor for this course. Econ is not my thing at all but this professor helped me understand it and I managed to get an A. She lets you know what will be on the exams so there is no confusion. If you attend the lectures and take notes you'll be good for the exams. The homework can be hard sometimes. Put in work and you'll get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amani is a really good lecturer and tells you exactly what is going to be on exams. The homework assignments can get a little confusing, but she's always available for questions. She's a solid choice and you'll do well as long as you show up to lectures and take good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took Econ 101 and 102 with Amani. You pretty much have to go to lectures to know what is going on in the class. If you take notes, she tells you exactly the type of problem that's going to be on the exam and tells you to mark it down. If you don't understand something, go to her office hours and she'll give you the exact notes you need for the exam
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great teacher, was able to email with quick response. One test was dropped. Take advantage of extra credit and study sample tests all multiple choice questions come from them. Tells class what the short answer questions will be If you show up. Just showing up will get you extra credit at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amani was great in lecture. She used multiple forms of examples to get an idea across. However, this means its is almost essential you go to lecture if you want to to well. It's easy to tell yourself to skip - but don't. You'll thank yourself once finals come around. Overall, Amani's class wasn't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, taking Amanis class was ok. However, when she says there will be 25 multiple choice questions and 1 short answer for your first midterm, dont believe her. She has about 10 short answer questions that you need to be ready for. Otherwise, Amani has a no nonsense personality, and cares about her students. + If your late to class, dont come.

Amani is one of the professors that plans and organizes this study abroad class to the UAE. She really cares about her students and wants them to get outside their comfort zone. This class taught me to look at things through a different lens. Show up to class, do your best, add to the conversation, easy (and fun) A for this class. 100% recommend.

I can very easily say this that she's the best professor I have taken classes with during my college career. She makes sure you get the material. Always available and willing to help and wants her students to succeed. Simply the best professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's super nice, but never come late to class. She'll call you out in front of everyone in the lecture hall.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good person, bad teacher.

Amani really wants her students to succeed. She gives test answers in class and mentions multiple times that they will be on the test. Tests can be long, but everything on it you have shes to the answers for ahead of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great teacher, really makes sure you learn the material, like REALLY MAKES SURE. She goes over things 200 times before moving on. Despite being a good teacher and lecturer, she has a real attitude. Very rude to students who try to sneak in late to an early, non-mandatory lecture. Sorry college is hard and we aren't perfect like she is.

Very solid professor. Each individual exam is 25% of grade (she takes the two best of the three), so take seriously. The sample tests she gives are literally word for word, so study those hard and then the written questions she gives you in class. I highly recommend her as a professor. Very thorough. Go to class!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Ms. Amani is the best professor in Iowa State. Just GO to class and STUDY two days earlier for each exam, and I guarantee you a straight A. She gives lots of extra credit during class, if you do not go, you missed it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Strict on students coming in late or leaving early, and isn't afraid to call you out for being loud in class. However she does a very good job of explaining the material, and genuinely cares about student success. She has plenty of extra credit opportunities for those that show up to class too!

Homework is easy. Tests are easy IF you go to class. She defiantly rewards students who go to class such as extra credit and exam questions. Do not need the book! Final is worth 30% of your grade but if you go to class it will be easy.
Overall great professor. Very thorough with her explanations. She tells you exactly what concepts will be on the exam in class. I really enjoyed her class.

Amani is a great professor, she goes over everything slowly and explains it in detail. She also gives a lot of extra credit out if you attend classes. She is very easy to talk to out of class and cares about her students

Dr. Amani is a great professor. Highly recommend taking a class with her. She gives excellent lectures and is always willing to help. Gives lots of extra credit. Go to class, she tells you what is on the exam.

Dr. Amani is an excellent professor. She truly cares about the success of her students. She gives out a lot of extra credit and gives sample exams with the exact questions on the actual exam. Excellent lectures. She only has two rules: don't come late and dont talk. I highly recommend Amani. She is great
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amani was a great professor. Exams are multiple choice and short answer, if you attend lecture then she tells you as she covers material, exactly what will be on the exam. Tons of extra credit. Small amount of homework for each chapter. No reason you can't get an A if you attend lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Amani is my favorite professor here on campus. She goes at a slow rate to make sure that students really understand the subject. She pulls multiple choice questions straight from the practice exams so study those religiously. If you show up and take notes, you'll get an A in this class.

Easiest class I have ever taken at Iowa state. She does a good job at explaining concepts in everyday language and walking through everything she demonstrates. Answers questions thoroughly when asked.

Your grade is made of tophat, tests, and homework assignments. She gives you three midterms but drops your lowest score. She's super understanding and is willing to work with you to make sure you understand things.

Amani is an AMAZING professor, I will be taking her for Econ 102. I never really enjoyed Econ in high school but she made me learn to like it. Tests are not that hard if you study. She gives you a practice exam before the exam and if you memorize those questions you will be fine. She normally tells you the short answer that will be on the exam.

Amani is a fantastic professor! She thoroughly explains everything and won't rush through the material if students are asking questions and seem confused. She gives out many extra credit opportunities if you go to class. Show up for lecture and you'll pass the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Gives extra credit. Lectures: She helps you understand by talking in every day language. Go and you should be solid on exams and hmw. Try not to miss! Best teacher I've had! Truly helps outside of class if needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I would highly suggest taking any  course with Dr. Amani. She understands that Econ is not everyone's forte, and works hard to ensure people still gain something from the class. Extra credit is SO IMPORTANT, so do it. I will reward you when it comes down to the final exam, plus its easy points. Go to class & go to office hours! Caring & helpful.

I really liked Amani as a teacher. Her lectures are not required, but I would highly recommend going because she will tell you exactly what will be on the test and give you extra credit. She does a great job explaining the material and will always put things in simple "every day language" which really helps. Her tests were really long and hard.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I had Amani for Econ 101 and 102 and did extremely well in both. She doesn't take attendance but give random extra credit in class and goes over some of the written test questions. There is a homework assignment about every week but it doesn't take very long to complete.

One of the best teachers i've had so far. Go to class! She explains the content extremely well, so you don't need to buy the book. She also offers extra credit through TopHat & other quick assignments. DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS and the tests will be easy.

If you don't go to class, you might struggle on the essay part of the test. Extra credit is given often, but only will know about it if you show up to class. If you don't get an A, it is your own fault. Best professor for Econ 101/102 and an easy A.
Easiest class I've ever taken
Easiest class I've taken at ISU, hands down. Take Econ with Dr. Elobeid if you can!!!

Econ with Amani is possibly the easiest thing you will ever experience. Honestly, if you go to class, you should not have a single problem getting a 93% in the class. If you go to EVERY class and do the extra credit, you've basically earned yourself a 100%. Posts the MC test online with answers before you take it. Tells you in class about the FRQ.

The practice exams she puts on blackboard have the same questions she picks from for the exams.  If you show up to class she likes to give out extra credit opportunities and codes for exams.  Overall a pretty easy course if you do the weekly homework and look over the practice exams before the exams.

Easiest class ever. Gives you sample tests that are the same as exams. Gives lots of extra credit. Do it. It's easy and worth a lot in the end. Gets boring listening to her repeat things over and over but breezed through the semester. One homework assignment per chapter and she always takes more than a week to complete the chapter.
Dr. Amani was amazing. If you do not go to class, you will get a bad grade. She explains what to study for the exams and al of the short response questions are one step she hasn't worked in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her voice is not monotenous and does a really good job of getting the concept across. Does not put up with anyone'a BS AND I LOVE IT

Great teacher! You have to pay attention to really understand the material. I would go to class though because she gives keywords that can be used for extra credit on the tests. I would take another class from her! If I would've put in more effort I would've got a much better grade.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I love Amani! Dr. Elobeid is the best econ professor I've had. She gives you all the resources you need to be successful in the course. Attendance isn't required, but if you go she gives out a lot of extra credit! I would love to take another course with her. Her practice exams are nearly the same as the real thing!
She is a great Econ 101 professor! She goes at a pretty slow pace, and is very understandable. She also gives a lot of extra credit for the people that show up to class, so make sure to go!

One of the best ECON teachers at ISU. Go to class, pay attention to her examples and do the sample tests and you'll do fine on the tests. 3 attempts on the homework assignments and also gives out a ton of extra credit so show up for that. Overall, she is a great professor and would recommend her class to anyone considering taking it.
Really good professor, I really liked the way of teaching
Best Econ teacher on campus by far. She tells you exactly what will be on the tests. Go to class and you'll get an easy A

Take econ with Elobeid!!!! Especially if you aren't great at econ. She can be repetitive during lecture but it's for your benefit. She tells you what will be on the test if you go to lecture and gives you a study guide that has all the multiple choice questions for the exam.
She favours those who show up to class. Test parts usually come up during lecture.
Easiest class I have ever taken period. Only buy the MyEcon code and dont buy the book .
Easy. All her tests are questions from the sample tests. Also, there is a ton of extra credit

She's a pretty good professor, and teaches a relatively easy to class to pass. If you do the work and attend class, you will get by with an A. You could maybe pull it out of your ass even if you do not go.   She gives extra credit and extra credit assignments for those who do attend lectures. The lectures can be repetitive.

The lectures are long and sort of redundant, but the information is clear. She gives a sample test with all of the multiple choice answers, but the written portion is difficult. She gives a lot of extra credit if you go to class.

Amani is probably the best econ professor you can have at Iowa state. All tests answers are posted before so all you have to do is memorize the answers. Also gives lots of extra credit just for showing up to class, otherwise it is not mandatory. Very easy class, and homework is easy as well.

She was sometimes rude and condescending when talking to students. Review sessions were helpful, but she was sometimes rude to students for not asking the questions correctly. Overall it was a super easy class, but I would have taken a harder class if I felt like they were more respectful/helpful.

Amani is hands down the best professor to have for either Econ 101 or Econ 102.  If you go to class you can get extra credit.  If not just study the sample tests she posts online and you will pass.  She takes 25 questions from the tests she posts.  If you go to class then you learn what short answer questions will be on the test and how to solve it
Awesome Professor and gives a lot extra credit. Go to class and study for the tests and you will be fine.

From Day 1 she told us exactly what we needed to get an A in the class. She gives you a giant practice test with all of the multiple choice question for every test, from which she then picks the questions. It is so easy to get an A as long as you put it the time and attend class! She was awesome and I would highly recommend her.

While Amani may not have the best teaching methods during her lectures, she is seriously the nicest lady you'll ever meet. She gives loads of easy extra credit, is always willing to help people 1 on 1, gives you the exact exam questions ahead of time, and does review sessions before each exam. Just go to class and study and its an easy A.
She is a really nice lady and as long as you study with the material she gives you, you will do great on the tests.

If you have't had any experience in Econ, make sure you go to class and pay attention. She repeats herself a ton so there is no way not to get the concept, unless you don't pay attention. Exams are easy if you review the practice exams given to you.

She is really good at explaining and relating things to the real world. If you have trouble understanding something then you can go to her after class and she will generally help you. If you go to class, pay attention, and attend the review sessions before the exam then you will get an A. Extremely easy class and it really helped me out.

When she lectures it is like she is talking to a group of 4th graders. It goes so slow I couldn't make it through it and would just zone off, bombed the first test. After that I stopped going to class and have been doing amazing ever since, just do the sample test and if you don't care about extra credit going to class isn't necessary.

She is extremely easy and gives out a lot of extra credit if you attend class. I found the midterms effortless because she gives out sample test with questions from the test. She does get frustrated in class because of low class participation; however, that is understandable because it is bad. Taking Econ 101? I would recommend taking it with her

If you go to class, you will most likely get extra credit when you show up. So go to class! The exams are given out pre-exam so as long as you study that you should be good. She also holds review sessions, so it should be easy to get an A

Amani Elobied is a great economics teacher. She takes you through all of the basics and will go back and help students if they ever need help.  She doesn't require that you go to class and if you have a good understanding of basic economics topics you would probably be fine skipping out every once in a while.

Good teacher but insists on repeating material for much too long. Also in a huge class refuses to use microphone.  Hard to pay attention.  If you're in this class you'll be fine just put forth effort.  If you're signing up for Econ 101 though, pick a different prof.

She makes the material understandable and relates it to lots of real-world scenarios. She notices if you attend class, so if you're struggling, she goes above and beyond to help you out. Test are mostly multiple choice.

You will do a lot better in the course if you go to class. The only problem with this is the lectures are so long, repetitive and boring you probably won't be able to pay attention. The tests have a long short answer section which makes them very difficult. If you can listen in class and get the test questions from her you will be okay.

Elobeid has been one of my favorite professors at Iowa State! She gives out a lot of extra credit, but only to those who go to class. GO TO CLASS. She gives you the essay questions to her tests if you go to class which helps out a lot! She my seem "up tight" but she just wants a respectful classroom which I enjoyed! Overall GREAT teacher.

Professor Elobeid sets her class up very nicely. I'm not the best at Econ but she made the class way easier. If you go to office hours, she's really helpful and loves students to contact her for help. She gives a lot of extra credit if you show up and simple assignment. Glad i took Econ 102 with her!

She is a great professor and she always make sure students understand what she is teaching. Knows her material well and encourage students to ask questions. She doesn't like it when people talk in her class which is great cause I get super distracted by it. Always give extra credit just by showing up or doing some simple tasks.
I never went to class. she gives you the exams before the test. she gets mad if u come late or leave early so i didn't ever go to class.

Lectures are so boring and almost dont matter. Gives Extra Credit in class (only reason I went). Basically gives you the answers in class and on the practice tests, you just have to put forth the effort.

I hate this professor literally, if I could back to the past, I must change the lecture section. This professor did not announce any tiny information that  is really useful in test through blackboard. Also, her explain was so hard to understand instantly.  Above all things, the essay question in exam is really tough to solve in given time, even tho

She is the best professor that I have ever seen, she is such a gambler, never listen her.  Never uploading lecture and did not announce about exams. I asked about final exam like 4 times with same question, it was about exam but she lied to me. Even if i got A on this course, you have to spend your time more than 5 credit courses.

She was hard to understand at times and would repeat everything constantly. Plus she gets her slides from a website so she seems to get lost at times with them and has trouble following along. She will normally give you answers to the tests before hand but cant be trusted cause they sometimes change.

Amani is a great instructor. Her lectures are boring, so read the book beforehand so you can follow it easier. Also, sit in the front. As long as you attend lecture, you have opportunity to receive extra credit and test questions that are word for word on the tests. Easy class to get an A in as long as you seek help early and go over practice tests
Have to go to class to do well in the class. Repeats herself a lot, but gives you the tests.
Extremely hard to understand, constantly repeats herself, I'll give her props on how easy she made that tests; you just have to memorize the practice test. Overall, can't stand her

Repeats herself endlessly, makes simple concepts much more complex than they need to be. However, her homework is easy and the tests are made up of questions from the practice exams. Never opened my textbook.
Must go to class! Gives exams questions in class. super easy class if you go to class. I hate econ and still got B in this class.

Not a good professor he forgets when he has exams set. He doesn't answer emails, not helpful in the least you ask a question and you get that's not a specific enough question, he likes to finally explain what he wants out of the assignment a day before or the day its due, get ready for the first 2 assignments to be all EXCEL. DO NOT RECOMEND!!
Great Professor always willing to help.

Dr. Miguez is a great teacher and really cares about his students. He makes a lot of funny jokes, which makes class fun. For 2, 3, and the final exams, he has repeat questions from the previous exams, which is nice. If you go to class and study for the exams, do the hw, and quizzes, you should pass easily.

Dr. Miguez is a likeable guy. He 's from Argentina but speaks very clearly. A funny/awkward sense of humor. Out of a class of 200, he could remember  half of the students names.  To make tests easy, they included many clicker questions. Hard to get below B. 1 test gets dropped. Not overly helpful/flexible with grading or scheduling difficulties.
There are weekly assignments that never take too long to do also the quizes are super easy if you read the material.

Professor Silva was genuinely one of the funniest professors I've ever had. The class was super fun - definitely recommend taking it with a friend or two! It's very easy to get an A if you take advantage of the extra credit opportunities and retakes, but I won't lie, the tests and quizzes were actually tough sometimes (but still very doable).

Love this class and the professor! He is very easy going and genuinely just wants everyone to learn about wine and share his passion for it. He communicates well with students and I enjoyed going to his lectures. The class is essentially just about wine tasting, two attempts for quizzes and exams online, and LOTS of extra credit.

The labs for this class were so much fun! He is a great professor and really cares about how the students do. Each lab is over a different food processing topic using different foods. One of the BEST professors at Iowa State University. I would definitely take this class again.

No complaints about this professor, more of the class which freshmen are forced to take. Usually one quiz and one exercise due a week, sometimes you get two weeks to complete them too. She is also very helpful if you need help with anything while taking her class.

Online lectures are long and very wordy to get through. But the material on the weekly quizzes is exactly the same as you learn watching the online videos. I will say that all the deadlines are strict deadlines which is fine, but if you miss just one exercise your grade will drop by a lot. There is extra credit. The class overall is just average.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very strict grading and late policies.

She was ok. SHE DO NOT PLAY ABOUT THEM DEADLINES. I literally had a conference I had to attend for Iowa State and asked her for an extension in advanced and she said no. I'm pretty sure if I said I was sick she would still say no. If you get stuck with her, you have a better chance going through the TA but not guaranteed.

Terrible communication, and terrible email etiquette. She claims her 1 credit course is to University standards but takes 3 weeks to grade one assignment, and then places the grades in the grade book during finals week without the ability to improve our grades. Harsh teacher.

The videos each module were excessively long. Sometimes the weekly exercises were really easy, but they're graded very specific and sometimes have confusing instructions. She always posted the weekly modules late, even by over a day and a half. Passive aggressive in emails. Took forever to grade.This felt like it should be more than 1 credit hour.
Terrible class overall.

She was unwilling to accommodate any health challenges I faced this semester. Despite providing documentation, including ER visit notes and surgery notes, she refused to accept any late work. Instead of offering flexibility or support, she simply informed me that I would need to retake the class next semester.

Nothing overly positive or negative to say about this class. The professor took forever to reply to emails though. And when she did reply it was a bit passive aggressive. Otherwise the class was fine. One quiz a week and then a project. Definitely felt like the class should be worth more than 1 credit.
She's alright. I didn't have any problems in her class, but many other people did. As long as you follow the instructions, it should be a very easy class.
