She always writes notes on the screen and her handwriting is atrocious. The exams are a complete joke, you get the 45 minutes to answer 35 questions and the class average ends up being 40-60%.

Her lectures are the hardest thing to understand and she doesn't give you time to ask questions. She talks nonstop for an hour and 20. Her exam are harder than they need to be and set you up for failure. 100% don't recommend taking this class with her.

Miyoung is a joke. I can’t understand what concepts she is trying to cover in class because she wanders so much. She simply does not know how to teach a lecture bigger than 30 people. If she was a ring leader of a circus, I would give her a 10/10 but unfortunately she is a college professor and is not good at her job.
Can hardly understand her, and lectures are very unorganized.

Professor Oh's lectures are boring, and often fail to cover the content that is assessed in homework and exams. The online homework is severely disconnected from what Professor Oh lectures about. Professor Oh is very disconnected from her students and lacks an understanding of how to run a course. Very difficult for a 3 credit entry level course.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Passed me with a 59 so that's good I guess but the class was crazy hard compared to people that took 301 with other professors.

I'm an econ major so take this however you want. People saying this class was hard must not have participated - especially this year with it online. She had every single test answer available in practice tests, and the short answer questions were identical to our extra credit assignment the day before. Not getting an A this year is ridiculous.

Bottom line for this ECON101 class: Exams are HARD and homework is a breeze. You can spend about 30 minutes a week on this class and finish all the homework. She offers a significant amount of extra credit opportunities, but the exams are very difficult. Study a lot for the short answer portion of exams, typically those parts carry a lot of weight.

I had this class online, not all lectures were recorded by Miyoung, but her lectures were really good, she went more in depth than other profs who uploaded the videos. She did a great job explaining the material. Tests are tough, but the worst test score gets dropped which is nice. Lots of extra credit too. I recommend Miyoung over other profs!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dont take Miyoung. Shes nice, but her lectures are not adequate. They are very dry and dont cover everything. Her textbook readings are very long and dry as well. Very difficult to raise your grade at all if you fall behind. She speaks clearly tho and is charming. Will help with homework if you come to office hours. Tests are very difficult tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Miyoung is a nice person and means well, but she is not a good teacher. Her lectures don't make a lot of sense and it can be hard to take notes. The exams were hard and don't follow the lecture well. We had to post on an online discussion board that we had to pay for, and it was 10% of the grade. I would take a different professor if possible.

Miyoung Oh is honestly not that bad of a teacher. But the way she has class set up is terrible. She uses an online discussion board you have to pay for that contributes nothing to your learning, yet its 10% of your grade. On the plus side, she gives a pretty good amount of extra credit for participation in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I have not taken any economics classes up until this one, and I had a very difficult time through out the class. Miyoung's lectures are boring, and only skim the surface of topics that you are assessed on with homework and exams. On top of that, she has a bit of an accent. Hearing new concepts from someone who can't speak clear English is hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: for anyone who has never taken economics before in high school, DO NOT TAKE HER Ive taken economics in high school so this was a beeze, is easier than high school as long as you did satisfactory. She literally gives similar paractice tests before a test and its almost the same if you practiced properly. She has So many extra Cr.
Major Culture issue and test as exams are based off of her personal experiences not off of the text book she cant speak english fully so it is hard to understand her

Miyoung is nice but she tries too hard to get a LECTURE HALL to participate in class discussion. She goes through the presentation slides way too fast to take notes, and if you print her notes off they are poorly organized and you'll end up having 3 pages with the same graph on it. She talks really fast and is hard to understand.

I had her for both microeconomics and macroeconomics but she was much better in micro. Topics were explained in depth but in macroeconomics I had to do a lot of on my own leaning. Overall, weekly assignments are very easy but exams can be difficult as you get more into the course.

Her lectures can be dull and she goes through notes quickly which is hard to keep up with since she doesn't let you use your computer. I would say about 90% of the questions on tests are all either seen as examples in class already or are on the practice quizzes which I highly recommend taking. I personally never opened my textbook and did fine.

Professor Oh is a nice person, but she is not a good teacher. She presents from a power point and goes very quickly, so it is hard to write everything down. She does offer extra credit if you attend the lectures, which is nice, and if you meet with her after class or during her office hours she is very eager to help and answer any questions.

There is a lot of extra credit opportunities; if you go to the lectures and you do all of the pop quizzes you will get extra credit for those along with TopHat and something else too. The thing I hate most is that you can't have electronics so taking notes by hand gets really tedious & she goes through the slides way too fast so you miss a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Miyoung has a bit of an accent and her lectures can be very dull. However, she gives out a lot of extra credit (we could get up to 6.5%) if you show up and participate. Her tests aren't that bad as long as you do the practice exams. Also the online homework answers are on quizlet. Overall, put in a little bit of effort and you will get an A.

It is not difficult to pass Miyoung's class. Show up, look over the practice problems before the test (the most important part), and go take the test. Most of this class could be considered participation. She has an accent, but a little bit of context takes out any confusion. Miyoung was a very pleasant professor, and I enjoyed her class.

Miyoung's lectures can be boring but usually have quality content. She rushes her slides sometimes. She's a nice and funny professor with a bit of an accent. She makes the content super easy to understand in class, but outside I really had to look online for answers to stuff because the concepts were beyond the teaching. Exams are difficult.

Miyoung is a great professor at heart... and that's it. Her lectures are boring and she has no spacing while presenting from a powerpoint, so she rushes through slides that you write for and spends forever on slides that are useless. She tries to be funny but it doesn't always work out. She also does have an accent but it wasn't an issue for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Miyoung is a great professor. She makes it easy to pay attention to lectures. Every question on the tests you have seen before. Pay attention to the study guides and in class questions. She likes to award people for going to class by giving extra credit.
Tells you what will be on the test
Rough...

Miyoung is a great professor. Very clear on what she expects and gives you the test questions prior to the exams. Make sure to utilize the reviews she sends out! She also gives many extra credit opportunities. Her accent is difficult to get past in the beginning, but once you get past that the class is a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Rough class that should've been easy.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Extra credit is offered in almost every lecture. This professor did not post lecture notes online so it would be useful to attend lecture. Strongly against using electronic devices in class. Does not curve any exams or the class at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: I enjoyed her personality, but I had a hard time learning anything in this class. I took ECON101 to fill a major requirement. I would probably try to take it with someone else if I was to have to take it again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Language barrier makes things hard. She doesn't use common American knowledge, and there are too many answers, so if you think a common sense answer is correct, you're wrong.

Worst lecturer I've ever seen. From this semester, she cannnot allow us to drop one of the exam result. You have to take three exam and one final. Total is 4 and every week, you have to take online quiz homework. Not easy to understand her pronunciation as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Miyoung is an okay professor. Her lectures are really boring and are at a super slow pace. Hard to understand really anything going on, its pretyy much a repeat of the same thing every day. Tests and homework are easy, all you need to do is look up the concepts and learn them yourself. Not a tough class at all
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Miyoung is such a nice professor. Yet, the class is really hard. There is a lot of notes and I recommend printing the notes out to fill them in prior to the lecture. There are 3 tests and a final. Each test gets harder and harder, but she does drop the lowest of the 3 tests at the end of the semester. The book is only used a couple of times for hwk
Just take the class with her, you wont regret it

She wasn't the best professor but she was far from the worse. The lectures are really boring but the tests are easy. She gives you practice tests to use to study, and she takes questions from them to make the test so you should definitely do those. All in all, she needs improvement but it's definitely a passable class if you put in the time
Tests are easy, same as her review exams. She is really hard to understand and her lectures are boring so make sure u try to pay attention. She has lots of extra credit though.
I had no problems with her

I had a hard time keeping up in lecture but she had in class activites and uses tophat almost everyday. She provides practice tests before exams DO THESE she copy and pastes a large portion of the questions on the exam. Totally saved my grade
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I love Oh. Basically you're graded on in-class activities, homework on Blackboard once a week, exams, and some extra credit on tophat! She gives out practice tests with like 50 questions each chapter, and those are the same questions on the exams. 33 questions for each exam and 60 for final. Study class activities and practice tests and you're fine
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's not very good at explaining the content in class. TopHat is used almost everyday and you don't have to buy the book, but I personally thought it was very helpful to have. Make sure you understand how to do the hw problems before you take the tests.

Lectures can be a little hard to understand due to her accent. If you go in with even the most basic knowledge of economics, you really don't need them anyway (except maybe for top hat). Test questions come directly from the homework. I never used my book. Study the homework questions for an easy A.

I took Econ 101 with Ms. Oh last semester. She's honestly not that bad. Homework isn't very difficult, and as long as you study for the exams, you can easily get a good grade. Most students just don't seem to put in enough effort.

Every single homework question (and extra credit) answer the entire semester is both in the back of the book, and online if you just copy and paste the question into your search bar. 70% of the test questions are from the study guide, 15% from homework 15% from tophat (both in the book). This includes the final. Read the book yourself and you'll A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Really didn't care for her and her teaching style. Tests were very hard if you didn't understand the material and not very clear in her slides and lecture. Wouldn't recommend taking her class again at all.
Bad.
Very hard to understand and generally not a good learning environment.

I would say that Miyoung Oh's biggest issue based on my rating would be the language barrier as someone that has never had to deal with that and being new to college I found that it may have been the hardest class I have ever taken.  The material was not hard to understand but you better bet that you will be reading the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I gave Miyoung's class a three for difficultly, only because she tends to be hard to understand during class. If you read the book to the point where you understand the material the class shouldn't be too bad, but who actually wants to read the book? The test are very similar to her reviews; however, she tends to trick you by switching words around

Don't bother buying the book. All exams were from the study guides and you get two attempts on the homework. Whole class is cuved, so if the whole class does bad you're more likely to get a better grade. Fairly easy as long as you study the study guides. She gives partial credit even if Tophat is wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: she needs to stop showing her baby pictures and she needs to stop talking about her pregnancy so much. I don't see how talking about labour pain is relevant to Econ
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Yes she is very hard to understand when it comes to lecturing. The class understanding would be better if midterms were slip into multiple exams. Top Hat heavy! I would recommend choosing a different professor if possible!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: As an international student, her English is a little hard to understand but not that bad. Her lecture is clear. Not much homework. She gives materials to review before exam and those are very useful. Exams are not hard as her lecture materials. Overall, easy class.

She's really a pretty easy prof. Lectures can be boring but she's passionate about the material. Attendance is required for Top Hat points. All homework is on Blackboard and you get 2 attempts at the exact same questions. She gives TONS of review materials for midterms and most of the questions are identical to those on the homework/review.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She isn't that bad. You'll need to work hard on finding out how to look at previous homework problems, top hat questions, and you'll do perfectly fine and her having bad averages means we get more points anyways.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I cant understand a single word she says. I had to learn everything on Khan Academy.
Hard to understand, information on tests is not similar to lecture or homework content
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very hard to follow, English isn't the greatest. Very quiet when lecturing, often looses most of the class. Uses Top Hat almost every lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very hard to understand due to the accent. Lectures are very boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Her lectures are very boring but attendance is required because of in class participation questions which is 10% of final grade. Hard to understand at times due to accent. Class average on first test was 65%

Class seems confusing, but the tests are fairly easy. Make sure to take advantage of the two hw attempts to cushion your grade with 100%. Extra credit bumped me up from B+ to A so make sure to go to class!!! Really cares about students doing well but can be timid and sometimes hard to follow. A lot is taught that isn't essential for HW or tests.

Was hard to pay attention to. Many times not clear in her speaking. Tests were nothing like the homework or lecture notes. Homework  super easy. Says book is not required but many tests involve information solely from the book and not in the notes or covered on homework. Had a good heart. offers a lot of extra credit, not clear on what it goes to

She would read directly off the slides and expect you to gain a very deep understanding of the concept for the exams. I read the textbook at the beginning of the semester, stopped after the first exam, it did not help me. I went to her office hours to go over exams, and she was not very helpful. Every time I did something, my grade would go down.
I did not enjoy.

Lectures are disorganized and slides are very busy. On multiple occasions, she told the class to read through entire slide shows on our own because she couldn't get to it. Her study guides take hours and don't help on the exam. Only the booklets help. She is very rude and has made fun of student's questions in front of the class.

Dr. Boury is an engaging lecturer most of the time. She does go off on tangents quite often and rarely goes over material on the exams in person. You will need to do outside learning (textbook/Google) to prepare for exams, because she prefers to run applied case studies in class as opposed to lecturing on the material. TopHats daily for credit.

Great Professor. 
When I took micro 3020 though, the lectures weren't teaching a lot of new material, unless it was a case study. More like just glazing over info she expected you to learn by yourself. Lecture was very hard to pay attention to. Clear grading criteria and easy to ask questions before or after class. Lots of extra credit.
I took this class online, and whenever I had questions or needed clarification, I reached out to the professor. Unfortunately, I did not receive responses.

Dr. Boury was funny in class, but read directly off the lecture slides, making lectures very boring. There are in-class clicker questions and some group activities, so attendance is required. I recommend using her study guides for exams, as they cover a lot of material. There are some exam questions that are poorly written, which is frustrating.

This is the hardest class I've taken. I stopped watching her online lectures each week because they were so boring and didn't actually help me do good on the exams. You can fill out the study guides she provides and practice the quizlet, but the exams are still incredibly HARD. Don't take this class unless you absolutely have to!

I LOVE Dr. Boury! lectures are super engaging, she includes lots of diagrams and every few weeks we do a case study which is so interesting. She gives a detailed study guide for each week and it follows the lectures pretty closely so that was my lifeline during her class and made it pretty clear what would be on each exam!
Overall 10/10 recommend!!

This professor can teach but has the worst attitude I have ever seen from a professor towards students. She accused an entire class of cheating on the last assignment of the semester and waited to grade it until the last day of finals week. Never heard good things about her attitude in other courses and she is not afraid to be rude to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: These exams are actually so ridiculously hard for no reason. Multiple choice is worded so horribly just to try to confuse you. Some of them have 6 options all of them being similar options. I have fit all the review stuff onto my notecard and it still didn't matter because unless you know every fine detail of the huge amt of material you're screwed
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I hated this class her lecture space was so small and there were too many people, take this class online if possible, do not take in person
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Material isn't too hard. She makes study guides so you know exactly what to expect on exams. Exams also have 2 attempts, which is nice. The only time I had to read the textbook to fill out the study guide was for unit 1. I haven't read the textbook since. Watch the lecture videos before class and show up to get attendance points and you'll be fine.

She's a good professor. She reviewed topics in class the week before the exams. Some in class quizzes but you can work in groups for 50% of them. She allows a notecard to be used on exams and you have 2 tries on exams. She takes the better of the 2 scores. She makes quizlets or blookets you can also use to study. She has knowledge in teaching too.

She jumps around a lot and can get off-topic, but she makes the class interesting. She uses Blooket as a class review, which I found helpful. She posts Quizlets and Kahoots, so the reviewing for tests is very easy. We did solo quizzes and then a group quiz to get more points. Overall, if you go to lecture, you will pass, even if you miss a few.

Tough class, but using resources like Quizlet and Unstuckstudy alongside the textbook helped me grasp the material. Attendance is a must, but lectures can be dry. Exams are tricky, so stay on top of the study guides.

Hard Exams. I took it online, so I am not sure how it was for in person lectures. The online lectures were boring, but were very important when it came to filling out the study guides. Use the study guides for the exams!!! But that can only help you so much. She tries to trick you on exams and the final was MUCH harder than it needed to be.

She gets sassy when people ask her questions.She explains difficult concepts well but it is very boring to listen to.Expect to either read the textbook outside of class or watch her lecture videos on your own time,she doesn't go in detail through all the content during lecture.Class is fast paced.She has study guides but no practice exams.Hard exam
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: if you have her for bio 211 drop or change to a different teacher. Her lecture notes barley help when you take exams and her practice exams are nothing like the actual one. Some times there are fill in the blanks, but when you try to look back at when you're studying she never post the answers for them.
Not the best, she doesn't actually teach- she reads off powerpoints. Its hard to pay attention when it's uninteresting and i'm getting read to.

She is an awful teacher. Won't respond to emails. Will comment on exams but won't give feedback. Her exam questions are so out of pocket good luck trying to figure out where they come from. Can pass O chem with an A but worked my ass off to get a C in this class. I don't think it is the student. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS!

Did a great job with explaining what she was teaching. Quizzes were easy because they were mostly all vocabulary based. You really have to be able to apply knowledge on exams because it involves you using vocabulary to understand a longer question. I was told to take this class before coming here. Expected it to be easier because of that.

She was pretty good overall as a professor, but she is NOT good with computers. I had issues with some of my assignments bugging out and submitting before I was finished, hence the grade, and she had no idea how to help. Other than that, she was kind and understanding when students asked questions. Kinda funny too.

Dr. Boury is great! She made the content easy to understand and make connections with. I enjoyed the corny jokes she made during class, as they kept me awake. Content is heavy, but a lot of repetitions from previous biology knowledge. If you have a strong biology background, don't stress over this class. If not, put in the time to study for exams.
The lectures were very informational. She made test taking very easy. I would definitely recommend having her as your professor.

I had Dr. Boury for BIOL 211 and MICRO 101. She gives study guides for every unit, which are essential to success in her classes. They take a super long time to fill out but in my opinion, you don't need to be excessively thorough to still do well on exams. I didn't fill them out toward the back half of the class and that is reflected in my grade

She started every day with vocab games that really let me know where I needed help and asked the class which study guide problems we wanted to review.  Didn't waste my time by making study guides (they were hard to do but my friends and I split them up and it made the class so much easier).  She cared how I was doing and wanted me to succeed.

You have to teach yourself all the information at home. The class is meant for review. The majority of students did not go to class, and those that did were way behind on the material she was talking about. When she asked students what she could do better, they said "Teach more in class, less review", she got defensive and did not change a thing.

Study guides did not help me study for exams and when I emailed her where a study guide answer was, she would just say to watch the lecture. She would share quizlets and study resources but they were only vocabulary and not concepts. Study guides were long and one question asked many different things.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lets be real, she isn't your teacher she's your SI instructor. You will do everything outside of class and then review inside class. I'm talking 2-3 chapters reading, online recorded lectures and study guides by yourself and then to come into class with questions because she isn't going to teach but review it and attendance is mandatory for points
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I was told to take this class by my advisor, but I regret it. It happened to be my hardest class of the entire semester and it was an elective. Do not take it if it is not required or you are not a micro major... not worth it. She isn't a bad professor, but her tests are hard and she throws in one-word mistakes to throw the whole question off.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very caring towards her students and if you reach out to her for help she will make time to assist you. However her grades are mainly exams and they are not fairly easy. Though she does give study guides, you have to really pay attention in the lectures and to make special time to study out of class for a good grade.

I took Dr. Boury as a summer class online so it might be different in person during the fall and spring semester, but I pretty much taught the course to myself. The textbook is straightforward as are the test. I did one WebEx with her and she appeared to be a yeller so I did not attend any more. If you are focused and can teach yourself easy A.

I took this last year ... Absolutely hands down my favorite professor at Iowa State. She loves her subject and goes miles to make sure you'll fall in love with biology too. She uses good pictures and explanations. Do the learning catalytics quizzes! Her tests are sometimes hard, but studying pays off. I switched to biology because of her class!

I have had Dr. Boury for three separate lectures, Micro 302, Micro 101, and Bio 211. Boury has clear outlines for Micro 101 and Bio 211. The tests are easily doable if you have filled out the study guides and took the time to understand them. Micro 302 seemed to be less organized with random flip day, etc. Overall, a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She cares so much about her students. Her tests are very hard, however she does give study guides from which the test was written. It is just important to know those study guides inside and out. She drops a test at the end. There is just weekly homework, but they are easy to complete. She truly loves what she does, and is amazing at teaching.

There is quite a bit of homework. I spent about 3 hours outside of class each week, and more on exam weeks. There are 4 exams, each one you can take twice and then a final. The final is treacherous. The first two exams were easy, the last two were much harder. Do the study guides and homework. Beware of when flip days are due.
If you're a micro major. You know. Go to class. Nancy is cool and you will learn the material. Use the study guides, quizlets and ASK QUESTIONS. I bombed this semester cause 'RONA.
Dr. Boury is a nice professor and is there to help you and everything, but the class itself SUCKS and (in my opinion) she makes it way harder than it needs to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Disorganized, links don't work, changes test material the week of. Will randomly assign homework and you have 24 hours to complete it. Should be an easy and straightforward class, but she makes it a pain. She has out of classroom lectures so that she doesn't have to teach as much, and refuses to upload essential information for exams. Avoid Taking!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class was entertaining and gave a good overview of the different aspects of biology. Lectures were interesting and fun, and included points for participation. The tests could be tricky, but you were allowed two attempts and there were online study guides and quizlets for every unit. She is very easy to learn from!

Great prof. There is daily participation points, but I skipped about 7 lectures and still got my A. Make sure to review the study guides, there will be stuff on there that she tests on that isn't in the lecture. I only did the readings for lectures that I missed or unfamiliar topics.

Nancy Boury is a great Bio 211 teacher! She listens to her students feedback and gives two takes on each exam. She really cares about her students and has the option of making a "bio meme" as extra credit! Definitely would take her class again.
She always moves back exams or extends the time your have to take them. She also lets you take them twice. Homework is easy and you can skip a couple classes without getting decked for points
Gives study guides, holds study sessions before exams, makes lectures fun, clicker points, slide show + verbal presentation

Her tests are fair, and she only tests over what she teaches in the lectures. The homework is actually helpful and not a waste of your time so that is nice too. Normally I hate online classes but she did really well with this one. There is extra credit that isn't too much work but can really boost your grade. Overall a really good professor.

Though I liked professor Boury as a person, she is not the kind of professor I prefer as a teacher. A lot of the information you need for the exams come from the textbook and online learning. I also felt the lectures were very much a skim of the required material. She is very willing to help you outside of class and explain things in more detail.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: At first, I wasnt sure about her as an instructor; she made comments/accusations which discouraged me from coming to her to ask questions. However, she is a great professor. Her lectures are amazing and informative. My only hope is that she tries approaching/talking to students more carefully so they do not feel like theyre being talked down to.

She is not a good professor because her exams and very extremely specific and I am not good with exams that specific. She does not curve the class which it would help a lot of people in the class that are like me that work hard but are not good in exams. However, the class is very helpful for MCAT, and graduate and professional school overall.

Has "flip days" where we work in groups. I was scared at first, but having people to talk to in class really helped. We would get together to study for exams. She was great to talk to after class and during office hours and was happy to help answer questions. She has great stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is big on group learning. Therefore she has a horrible class structure and wastes your time. No clear schedule of her teaching material. Flipped days at least once a week with questions at minimum one hour. Class is still mandatory with group sheets you have to fill out and top hat questions. She is straight crazy. But tests are realistic.

Gives study guides that she copies and pastes questions onto exams from or changes them slightly. Takes clicker questions during class for credit. If you read and pay attention in lecture, you should be fine.
Very hard tests that touch very briefly on lecture notes. Good teacher overall but exams are difficult and uses lots of application and

Really sweet professor & seems like she cares about your education. If you don't put in the work, it's pretty difficult to get the grade you want. Come to class and you get participation points. Doesn't grade everything on time so you may not know what your current grade is. I never filled out the study guides and didn't hurt my grade that much

If you show up and do the study guides, you should be fine. They take a long time to do, but worth it. The exams are from the study guides and she answers most of the study guide questions in class. The clicker points an odd system, but otherwise, the class has been GREAT. Enthusiastic teacher that really cares and gives you all you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She doesnt prepare you for her test. Is an awful professor. Would tell you not to take any of her classes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not a good professor at all. Would not recommend. Her exams are very hard and she makes them with a pool of questions so you either get the hard test or the easy one. The highest I ever got on one of her exams was a 66%

My favorite professor at ISU and I just graduated. Clear expectations, e-mails if you miss more than a couple of classes, answers questions and connects info from other classes to Micro. I wish she taught more of my classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nancy made me and several of my peers feel very beneath her and was unwilling to help. I had a problem with a computer and lost any notes I had from her lectures, which are what makes up the test, and she offered little help the day before the exam. Goes over material that most have never seen before very quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Spent time after class to ask questions - she is VERY approachable, has great stories and cares how you're doing. Gives great study advice and fantastic study guides. If you don't do your work, she'll call you on it. I guess that's what they mean by "talking down"? I don't know - I've always felt like she wanted me to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I went in office hours to go over course materials because I was in the online section. She talked down to me and made snide remarks about me to her lecture sections which I heard about during lab. I found this discouraging & unprofessional and did not want to go back to office hours. Be careful about seeing her because she talks down to students.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She goes way through fast through slides-- so be sure to take notes beforehand on her powerpoint slides. She also gives more information in class than what is one the slides online. Tests are easy and can be taken twice.

Honestly, she's a good lecturer in general. I would give her an A+ for effort alone. But the way she talks to the students makes it look like she looks down on us. She takes up a lot of time making jokes instead of teaching us during valuable class time. Not a particularly fun class and she could be doing better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, gives you everything to succeed in class. If you ever go to her office hours look at her bookshelf and notice that it is full of books on teaching methods. She cares deeply about education and how to become a better lecturer. She is also an extremely interesting character with endless stories.

Shes super sweet and she really cares about her students. She is very clear about what she expects of you and what you need to do to pass the class (do the study guides duh). I cant wait to take more classes from her. My favorite professor.

She takes time after class to really talk with students - several of us would ask about bio and she spent 30 minutes going over plant cycles until we got it. Wish all my profs cared as much. Love all the homework and in class points.

She tries to be funny but I was too worried about passing to care. Bio211 is a heavy class with a ton of information and I always felt she was talking down to her students. She is VERY nitpicky about certain information, more so than other bio professors. Also her final is cumulative and the exams are longer in this class than other bio211 classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Attend class but optional---READ according to her assigned reading charts. Complete the study guides and assignments. Class is just a very concise review of what you read. The context is in your study guides. Attendance not required--I only went 6 times. Don't wait last minute to do study guides. Test study guide, assignment, readings STUDY!

She gives out study guides for every section. Do them! Also go to lectures, not all the information will be in the slides or the readings. She has a pretty dry sense of humor, but I personally enjoy it. She's easy to approach and loves when people ask questions or come in for help.

Dr. Boury does a great job of making sure that every student understands, and can usually tell when a student is confused. Make sure to read the syllabus clearly and be ask questions as this will help understand content. Attending class isn't required, but a lot of points can be received by participating in class room discussion and small groups.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class was very difficult for others and I. Quite a few of us went in for help and felt quite discouraged after meeting with Dr. Boury. She will send emails and say in class that she is there to help us succeed, but I did not get that feeling when meeting with her. She is quite rude and makes you feel ridiculous for asking simple questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Boury is a great teacher, but makes you work for it.  Slides don't have much info, so you have to watch the lectures to get much out of it.  Exams are tough, but she provides study guides and offers to help.  Went to her office last week and wish I had done so sooner, she made genetics look easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's really there for students.  Just got out of a study session and it really helps to be able to ask anything.  Love the stories about diseases.  Don't skip class, though and make sure to do the study guides as you go!

The class isn't difficult, if you watch the lectures at home (she does flipped classrooms) and participate in class, you'll be okay. If you're good at biology classes, you should be able to get a B+-A. The professor is not very responsive and does not always email back when you ask for help. When you go in for help, she's condescending and rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Be sure to fill out study guides over a course of time and make sure they are accurate! They're your best tool of getting good grades on the exams. Exams are tough, so spend a good amount of time studying for it. Attend lecture for easy clicker points. Homework answers all found online. You don't need to read textbook, but use to help fill guides.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's funny in class and always encourages students to come in and see her. I went into her office hours a lot and only one time she was extremely rude to me and told me if I guessed "C" was the correct answer on all of them I would have gotten a better grade on my exam. GO INTO HER OFFICE BETWEEN EXAM ATTEMPTS. She will go over the whole thing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's funny in class.  I learn a lot about why this matters (the Radium Girls story was creepy).  Tests are tough, but if you pay attention in class and do the study guides, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Boury is a very interesting woman. Lectures are word for word out of the book. Test are the worst. Class average is on test is about 68%. If you don't show up, you will miss attendance point and be lost when it come to the exam. There is little homework. If you don't study for the exams for hours for the exams expect to fail.

Her lectures can be somewhat interesting. Tests are way too in-depth. "Study guides" are loosely phrased questions that basically mean "know every little detail or you fail." Studied harder in this class than any other class I've ever taken and still did not do well. You either know the stuff or you don't, and the tests are like a foreign language.

Dr. Boury is an amazing teacher - she uses stories to make the info real.  Always available after class and reaches out to students that are struggling.  If you don't work in her class, you won't do well though.

Consistently started lecture 5-10 minutes late; always with an excuse as to why it was not her fault. Unclear in student expectations. Condescending. In short, she is an overqualified high school Biology teacher who spends more time talking about why science is fun/cool than actually doing or teaching science. Worst professor I have had to date...

Took her class online, lectures are between 20-40 min, one every single day.  Some days there are 2 or 3 to watch in one day.  Boury is really approachable and inspirational.  Although her test are very difficult, I could never manage to get a good grade, no matter how hard I studied there was SO much material.
Stop by during office hours - she really likes to help students!  We spent an hour on 4 problems one afternoon she walked me through it until the material "clicked".  Dr. B. rocks.
Quizzes are difficult, recorded lectures are confusing. NEVER replied my email. She is very unfriendly to online students. If you need take this class, DO NOT choose online version.
Great professor and always there when you need her. She takes so much of her time to research the most effective learning styles and incorporates all of them into her classes.

"Full flipped classroom" setup-- sucks for people with social anxiety, but I made it. You watch/read all lectures online before class then come to class for clickers and group work. Otherwise decent professor, knew what she was talking about and was pretty funny. Tests were kind of tough but her study guides are helpful.

She comes off scary in e-mails but once you confront her face to face about any concerns or questions, she is very very helpful.  I really enjoyed her class but you do have to be on your feet and take this course seriously.  She allows the quizzes to be retaken but it is different than the first attempt.  Clicker points matter, show up for class.
She is very passionate about biology. There is a lot of extra credit. Tests are difficult. Do the study guides and review her power points. You don't really need the textbook/

She gives a lot of chances for you to get all your points for clickers and homework but most of the points come from the 6 "quizzes" you take. Make sure to do the study guides and you'll do fine on them.

Even though I went to every single class, paid attention, took notes, and did homework, I still came out with a poor final grade. No matter how hard I studied, I could never get a good grade on the quizzes. The class is easy to understand and the homework helps, but the test questions are extremely difficult. I did not enjoy her as a professor.

If you go and talk to her in person she's very helpful - don't hesitate if you have a question she's not scary I promise. As long as you actually pay attention to the lecture and take notes (as well as read the chapters) you shouldn't have too much trouble with the overall class.

I was told this class would be a GPA booster because it was easy. It's not exactly the easiest, even though I love biology. Lectures are boring and she mostly just reads off the powerpoint. Does take clicker attendance, and she does sometimes do in-class activities. Her tests can be confusing, but do the study guides and you'll probably do ok.

She taught my first ever biology college class and it made for an even more rude of an awakening as you would think. Quizzes are extremely hard. Says that they follow the study guides word for word but I knew the study guides and still did not do well on the quizzes. I recommend taking it with someone else if you want to do well.
Quizzes are extremely hard. I'm a micro major and had a efficient knowledge of bio. It's hard, hard and hard. Good luck with her.
Shes the best

She encourages one way of studying the material. She has a thing called "flip day" where every other class requires working in groups and it's a waste of time because attendance is mandatory regardless of your circumstances. She is extremely rude when you need something from her. Exams are multiple choice which is not a good test of knowledge.

The study guides are very helpful and Dr. Boury allows two attempts on an exam. Some days you watch the lecture online before class and come to class to have a group discussion on it. This is helpful if you learn best by participating in groups.
Exams don't really match study guides and online assignments are irrelevant.
great professor! very helpful, study guides for tests and puts all her lecture notes online. Will clarify things you are fuzzy on if you ask her.

I will hopefully never take another class by her again. Her lectures are in depth and she articulates well. Unfortunately, it seems as though she doesn't like to be asked questions before or after class (she got irritated and wouldn't answer my question). Also, she get frustrated easily. Her quizzes do not relate to lecture.
Great professor and very helpful. Complete the study guides and keep up with the reading and you'll do great!

She seems like a nice lady, but what she discusses in the lectures and what the homework is relates very little to what the quizzes are about. She quizzes are very difficult, and even with the study guides, they are hard to study for.
She doesn't help at all. She is very boring. Her tests are extremely hard, and are not written well.

It's a hard class but she makes it interesting. She's willing to clarify and answer any question. The quizzes are very hard because are based on critical and analytical biology problems. DO NOT MEMORIZE THE BOOK! She gives study guides which are extremely helpful.
She does not write tests well, will update grades late and tendency to go on tangents that are not even the full truth. She is able to articulate the information well.

Loved the study guides and the stories.  Once I started doing the study guides, the exams were easy.  If you don't do your work or go to class, this course would be impossible!!  Dr. B. was friendly and always replied to e-mails and answered questions!

Bad class! I found her exams to be too hard for a lower level micro class. Also she was a bit unwilling to answer my questions. Her notes don't have much information on them that pertain to the study guides. I wouldn't recommend her to anyone.

Dr. Boury is the best teacher I had this semester! Her lectures are easy to follow and very imformative. She even lets us take our quizzes twice... and she let us have two attempts at the final as well! The class is pretty easy if you study and make use of the SI sessions. I wish she taught Bio 212!! Overall, she's freakin awesome.

I did better in this class when I stopped going to her lectures and just studied on my own. Her lectures are pointless and she goes on tangents for half of the class. Spends too much time showing videos that make no sense. If you want to pass the test, don't rely on her lectures.

Really disliked this class. I was pretty interested in biology before having her, but she made me hate going to class! Quizzes were very hard, and even though you get two attempts, you can never see which questions you missed! (Kind of defeats the purpose..) She was funny and friendly, but avoid her if you can so your GPA doesn't suffer!
Loved this teacher but reading the book is essential!! Test questions are very in depth and clicker questions can be difficult. This class was hard!
Clicker questions are easy points, but you have to be in class to get them! She's also pretty good at explanations of difficult concepts.

She was great in lecture! She really made sure to simplify the information so that you understand them. She has that "science dork" humor that I found hilarious. There is only one finaltest and the rest are quizzes and occasional homework. She gives you two chances for the quiz and makes a study guide for you. She really wants you to succeed!

Pretty easy class if you attend lecture and do the assigned homework, which is long, but helps you understand the material more. She allows 2 takes on quizzes, which are 25-26 questions. Throws in a personal story here and there to make the class enjoyable. She is approachable and will help if she can.

If you go to class you should be fine. You get two attempts on every quiz and she lets you have a maximum of 10 extra credit points. The homework takes a lot of time and it is for only a few points, but it does help you learn the information.

Dr. Boury does a pretty good job. Her quizzes are kind of hard and definitely require studying and reading the book a little, but she offers so many points through class assignments and clicker points that it's pretty hard to not do well. I recommend going to class because she doesn't include all the notes in her slides. Overall, a good prof.

LOVED HER! She is so passionate about biology and makes classes fun and interesting. The tests can be hard, but she gives you study guides that tell you exactly what will be on them and two attempts. She gives assignments and extra credit opportunities to help keep your grade up. One of my all time favorite teachers.

I love her. She is SO. INCREDIBLY. SMART. I went into this class very nervous-- I'm not too good at biology-- but now, it's one of my favorite classes. Is it easy? No. Impossible? No. She gives study guides for every quiz, and each quiz gets two attempts (different every time). Do the study guides and homework, and you'll get out with at least a B
One of my favorite professors by far. Keeps lectures interesting and gives study guides to go with each test. Also gives tons of easy assignments to help pad your grade.

My favorite teacher. I was nervous about Biology at first but because I have her I cannot wait to go to Biology class now. She makes everything seem so easy, and there a re a ton of free points in the class to make up for a bad quiz.. Great teacher.

I found her to be quite rude during class (like answering her daughter's phone calls) and she would frequently go off on tangents that wouldn't relate to biology. The assignments are incredibly long for hardly any points and when I went in to ask her for help her response pretty much was "Oh you should know this it was in the book".
My favorite teacher! She's so funny and tries her best to help all her students succeed.
Dr. B. Rocks - cool stories, shows how microbes influence everything.  Tough course, but the study guides helped and she was always available.
So unhelpful, a little disrespectful, and a bit socially tactless.  People skills do have a great effect on how well you teach, you know.  Took as a summer course & don't recommend it or her.
Summer speed was really tough, but I loved the analagies and taking the quiz 2x.  Dr. B. would always answer any questions I had - e-mail or office hours.

BAD! Starting out I thought it would be fine, 2 attempts on  quizzes, cliker points and homework but NO! I can barely pass the quizzes.They have nothing to do with lecture far more in depth.  She tries to trick you and makes the questions very difficult.  She goes very fast. DO NOT TAKE!

SHES AWFUL. DOnt take genetics with her!!!!!!!   Her lectures do NOT match her tests and she overload you with work. I have to learn SEVEN chapters in one week. She does NOT understand that all of this crap doesnt come easy to everyone. Horrible teacher.
great class. go to class, read through the book and its impossible to fail
Teaches well, but is sporadic. This is a class where relying on the book is crucial. Plan to put in a lot of time studying, the smallest portion of the material in class is fair game for the tests!
She went really fast, but you get two tries on the quizzes and clicker points, so it isn't terribly difficult.

I don't see how people do bad in her class. She keeps things interesting. I've never had any problems with her not e-mailing me back or issues with her office hours. You also get to retake all the quizzes and have one dropped. Plus extra credit you get to choose to do. The people bad talking probably didnt do the work but thats your own fault.

She acts like a crazy person and teaches too fast. She assumes you know everything coming into the class and she is just building on your previous knowledge. I came from a school of 45. I dont know anything. Before this class I really enjoyed bio but now I might switch my major.

Be prepared to be yelled at, including if you go to her "open" office hours. Don't expect her to return your e-mails. She is constantly cranky, and she is always right. Get on her "favorites list" or she will always dislike you and treat you accordingly.

She was a little cooky but I really enjoyed having her as a teacher! You could tell she is really interested in what she teaches. She made study guides for us to complete prior to each exam and even though they took awhile to complete they were definitely helpful in the end. I would recommend taking the class with her. She doesn't make it boring
Hilarious! Very entertaining and helpful.  Clicker points are cool and so are the two tries you get for the quizzes!

Too smart for her own good. Not super understanding. Went way to fast during lecture. Class was required for participation points which made it really disruptive because people would come but not pay attention and talk all the time.

She was not an easy professor to learn from.Lectures were not clear. She wasnot helpful at all and made you feel stupid if you asked questions in or after class. I would not recommend her as a professor. I got a horrible grade in the class and had to retake it. I got an A my second time around with another professor. That has to tell you something.
Vocab was a killer, but Dr. B. explained things well.  Was fantastic on a one-on-one.
horrible professor, i would reccomend no one take classes with her, not understanding.  Nit-picks everything.  shows bias
She made me feel stupid
Waste useful class time with science in the news. Can not control class, class spends more time talking then learning!
Great class but summer speed was tough.  Learned something new every day. Dr. B. would answer anything and really wanted us to succeed.  Tests were hard.

Dr. Boury was completely useless as an instructor for this class. All she did was sit there and watch while we presented papers in class. Then she had us write grant proposals which none of us had done before and never instructed us on how to do it.She treated everyone like they were stupider than her.  Overall terrible attitude and bad teaching.
Great prof, google "List of best ISU professors", she's in it and deserves it.

Teaches effectively, speaks loudly, exams aren't terribly difficult, and the assignments are few and far between. She does seem very intent on everyone being quiet in class, and will huff & puff until everyone shuts up, which can get annoying (especially if you have a loud or disrespectful classroom).
she is very nice

I really liked her as a teacher we have some idiots that sit in the front row and try to tell her how to teach and she just blows them off nicely. She really doesnt like talking in class but she is really clear at teaching and she is constantly making sexual jokes which is really hilarious. I really enjoyed her class but do homework!!!
The tests are difficult if you do not keep up with the material!
Pretty good professor

Dr. Boury is great. Definately go and talk to her if you don't understand something. She does expect you to have done the reading, and can go through topics kind of quickly. Doesn't tolerate distractions (iPods, talking, cell phones, etc) in class; which is another great thing about having her as a professor. Read & do homework, you'll do well!
Nancy was kind of an airhead which made it difficult to take her seriously at times.  Although she was quite good at her subject matter, I think that she was one of my least favorite to endure.

Dr B is a very good teacher. She has study guides for every chapter & I managed to get an A on every exam except one (88%, got dropped anyway) just by doing them. I never opened the book. She can seem a bit rude sometimes, but it's just an impression. She's nice, replies to e-mails quickly & loves teaching. You get points for attendance.
Shes a good teachers and has great notes but gets angry easily over little things, so try to keep the people around you quiet and you should be fine.

Dr. B is an amazing person - she is so smart and communicates well so you know that she knows what she's talking about. She's also my advisor - she was helpful in and out of class and some one I really looked up to and enjoyed having as a prof. I hope more are like her!
She definitely has enthusiasm for the class and really understands what she's teaching, but she can get pretty off-track rather easily.  Tests were pretty easy.
Really good teacher and a really interesting class if youre willing to do a little work.  Its not overly easy, but you'll learn a lot.
Dont take genetics with her.....
Great lectures, enthusiastic teaching, I wish I could take all my biology classes with Dr. Boury. Her study guides really do help for the tests. She does everything she can for the students.

This class was a ridiculous amount of work. Between homework, WebCT homework, WebCT discussions, quizzes and exams there was always something due. She could be really rude one-on-one, and had expectations that were, in my opinion, too high for the level she's teaching.

I wish she could teach all of my Bio classes because her tests are really easy and the review class before the test she bascially goes over everything that will be on the test. I took AP bio in high school so that might have helped but she is interesting and makes it easy to get an A.

She is probably the best bio 211 teacher. She makes it easy by giving you study guides for the tests that basically have all you need to know on them. I didn't read or study very hard but I did the study guides and came out with an 86 overall.

She is a horrible person to be teaching Biol 211.  She is brilliant but seems to think we are all just as brilliant.  You literally have to memorize the WHOLE book.  She has way too high of expectations on the exams because the exams are unbelievably hard!! Unless youre a Biology genious, avoid having her as your instructor!!

She SUCKS! It's like she's taking out her problems on us.  Her tests are harder than anything else, you have to not only learn and memorize every single word, but you have to do a Ph.D. on it in order for you to get a desent grade on her f***ed up tests.
I loved Dr. Boury, she puts a study guide online and if you study that and your notes getting an A on tests is very possible. She is fun and doesn't bore you to tears.

She is a very good teacher. I was not a big fan of Biology when I found out that I have to take the class, but she seems to know what she is doing and I am doing very well in the class, even though I had never taken biology before this year.

She is horrible, she gets off topic all of the time and she really doesnt know what she is talking about.  She makes stupid class discussions and gets way off topic, and then yells at us for talking when she started the conversation.
Fun, interesting, and great sense of humor.

She tests on material that is covered in the book. If you don't read EVERY tiny detail you will miss a lot of questions on the tests. She tests you on too many chapters and expects you to memorize EVERYTHING you read. Don't take her if you can help it!

Worst Prof. I've had at ISU, unclear expectations, gets derailed easily, writes insulting comments on students papers, does not cover close to the amount of material on the sylabus, Do not take Genetics with her if you can wait for a different section

Dr. Boury turned in the wrong grade for me and then it took her months to fix it with the registrar's office. She acted like it was my fault. She didn't seem very committed to her students. Also, she is really really weird.

Good teacher and easy to stay awake too. Lecture notes were clear for exams. Except towards the end of the semister I felt rushed and didn't do so hot on the last exam and final. Ended up with a B though.
Very good teacher, put almost everything on powerpoint notes.  Very easy to talk to and to get an A in her class (I had her for bio 201 and micro 201 and did well in both).

Boury is the best teacher i've had so far, and i'm in the 2nd semester of my sophomore year.. she makes jokes, and if you read for the quizzes, you will no doubt do well on the tests, and getting an A in this class is definetely possible.. just do the work :-)
She did a good job
Course workbook is extremely helpful.  I wish all teachers required these.  She also offers extra credit opportunities.

Professor Boury is a good teacher although she doesnt make class very interesting or exciting although she uses great pictures in her power points.  The tests are very easy not counting the one on plants.
Exams were extremely detailed while lectures were more conceptual.  She was frequently in a bad mood.
She's informative and makes class go by quick!! I never fall asleep and is always interested and intrigued by what she has to teach to us.
She is great.

Dr. Boury has been the coolest professor I ever had.  When she teaches she teaches with passion, which is very different from a lot of the professors that are here for just research alone.  No one tops Dr. B!
No Comments
Dr. B rocks!!!!
She's confusing sometimes. She wasn't very helpful.
No Comments
Oleg is a pretty good professor, however his teaching style is really different. Instead of lecture you are in a Zoom group doing practice questions, and rarely do we interact with Oleg himself.
Did you make a cut?

Oleg has a thick accent that can be hard to understand sometimes but if you need him to repeat something just ask. Class is structured around vids outside of class then group work in class for credit. Doing well in this class takes commitment but if you do everything he asks then you will do well. The TA's are also usually good.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Oleg is great, though he can be tricky when helping because he wants you to take the reins and figure things out. He acts moreso as a guide, but it is helpful in the long run.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dont get me wrong. This is a hard class, and its going to take a lot of your time for it. Oleg im sure is a really good professor, and I liked him, just not as much the teaching style. At times it did, but at times it also didnt 'click' for me with the way he was teaching. There is a lot of homework, which is to be expected from a summer class.

Took EM 3240 with him over the summer. There was homework due before class daily and exams every other week. In class assignments/ quizzes daily. Lots of effort required to succeed in his class, although it definitely will pay off during the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really really enjoyed Mechanics with Oleg. He put us in teams that we sat with the whole semester and had a flipped classroom, where we watch lectures outside of class and work on 2 example problems in class. He really really cares about you passing the class and is available on Telegram at almost any hour of the day. Seriously great professor!!!

Oleg was an incredible professor. He was available through the telegram system when help was needed and was enthusiastic/willing to provide help if I was stuck. There is A LOT of HW in the class and I STRONGLY recommend doing it all. Doing the HW itself preps you quite well for the exams. Top Hat is rough sometimes (half-credit participation).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The course EM 324 is based on TBL method and you watch lecture videos ahead of class and then answer top hat question in class which is about 15% of the grade. Oleg is barely accessible out of class but is available on telegram anytime of the day. He is hilarious but also wants full attention and participation from students while in class.

He works really hard for his students to succeed and it shows. There is a ton of homework, but it helps practice and do well on exams. The flipped classroom took a while to get used to, but it was very beneficial. He's very responsive over telegram and is extremely helpful. Strongly recommend taking a class with Oleg.
Easily accessible professor & well-structured course. You should do fine as long as you watch the lectures & do the HWs before each class. Exams were fair and on par with HW questions.

Oleg is a great professor, I respect him and his teaching, and would gladly take a class he teaches again. The course setup was awful, with it being online group work, and requiring both the homework and lectures being done out of class. Didn't make connections, didn't work as a team, and class felt pointless, but Oleg was always there to help.

He was an amazing professor who really seemed to care about the success of his students. The class is flipped, and the designated lecture time used for practice in groups. Having other students there to talk to and practice with makes learning and asking for help a lot less stressful and it makes class more fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: When it comes down to it, this course was a prime example of what happens when laziness and apathy overshadow genuine education. The instructor's lack of effort and disinterest in their students' success made for a terrible learning experience. I strongly advise against choosing a course with Oleg.

So this is a hard class, and he does his absolute best to teach it. He will respond to any questions within 10 minutes on telegram usually. Genuinely seems like a very caring guy who wants his students to succeed. The team-based learning sounds undesirable at first, but I really enjoyed it after a bit once you get to know your teammates.

Solid professor who knows the content well and is accessible to teach it to you. He also believes practice is key to understanding, so he assigns a ton of homework. The in-class problems will prepare you for the exam, so it is easy to learn the content just by participating.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: By far, the most accessible professor at Iowa State. He has a Telegram group chat set up for the entire class and is constantly responding to students' questions, and is very transparent about learning expectations. Also a very nice guy.

Professor Oleg is a great professor. EM 324 is a flipped class and TBL- meaning you watch the lectures before class and work on problems as a group during the scheduled lecture time. I was apprehensive about TBL at first but this class totally changed my mind. To do well in this class, you need to watch the lectures and do HW before class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class format is a lot of work with watching lectures before class but the online lectures are useful and make the class time useful to seeing problems and going more in-depth on the topics. Take mechanics with him you will not regret it.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Oleg gives lots of homework and in-class work, but if you complete it you will be well prepared for his exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Oleg is a sweetie pie, class is hard but study well and you will do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Follow the schedule and you will be fine. Always willing to answer questions, so make sure you ask. Fantastic professor. Lets see how you do.

Oleg was great! He responds to you at obscure hours, however, the class is difficult if you get 1 thing wrong :( Team based learning & having lectures before class aka the zoom call was extremely beneficial. I wish we had more time on tests!! 2 questions with multiple parts, only 25min/question & 5min to upload answers to Canvas was tricky to do.

Mechanics is just a difficult class, but Oleg's lectures and team-based learning helps a lot. Make sure to watch lectures before your class time. He is almost always available on Telegram to answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Professor. I took the class over the summer and it was very manageable. The class was one hour a day on weekdays. Homework varied but was around an hour a day with some being 5 minutes with others taking two-plus. If you do the homework and show up to class you will get an A. I worked 40 hours a week and was able to get a B.
Mechanics has difficult content but Oleg makes it pretty easy to understand and to do well on exams. Everything you need to know is covered in lectures/examples.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: EM 324 is just a hard class. Oleg made it bearable. His class is reversed, so you watch lectures outside of class time then take quizzes in class. Although this took time to get used to, overall it helped my learning a lot. This class will take a lot of time, so try your best to not take 18 credits at the same time.

Zarechnny's teaching style may be a little more work than some other professors, but it sets you up to succeed in the class. He is available for outside help almost at any time via telegram and will make sure you understand what you are confused about. In class tophats are directly relevant to the lectures and usually similar to exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was in his TBL section. I was not sure if I would like it going in, but it was definitely worth it. Oleg's lectures are pretty good, but having the book is also super useful to augment the videos. Overall, I would highly recommend taking mechanics of materials with Oleg.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Oleg is a good professor. He is always reachable by message. Watch videos before every class, and this is a very easy class (takes discipline though). Exams are usually straightforward, but make sure not to expect only new material on a test. Sometimes it is difficult to communicate your question to him without him saying to rewatch the lectures.

I took EM324 Team-based with Oleg and I'm very glad I did. You watch lectures before going to class then during class you work on problems in a team and TA's will come in and out and help you. A bit more work week to week than a regular class but it was well worth it. I pretty much just glanced over the notes and slides before exams and got all A's
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mechanics of Materials is difficult. That's a known fact for any engineering major, regardless of who you have. Despite the current COVID-19 restrictions though Oleg teaches the class pretty well. Watch videos before class, have group problems in-class, do home, rinse and repeat. Oleg's relatively easy to approach. Overall hard, but Oleg's good.

Mechanics is often a class that kids just need to pass. I actually had Oleg for Statics and failed it with him (lol). Now that I am older, I appreciate him as my professor more. Show up to class for TH, Stay on schedule for lectures, do HW, put in the normal time you should and you will be fine. He is also on his phone answering questions 24/4
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Let me clear one thing up - Mechanics is a hard class. No matter what professor you take it with, you will have to put in the work. Oleg provides you with all the tools you need to do well in this course, as long as you put in the effort to watch the lectures and do the assignments.

This class is fine until you don't understand a topic from the lectures. Trying to ask this professor some thing is impossible. He does not answer any questions you ask and will simply go on his own tangents, or simply tell you to watch the lectures. Which after having watched them twice, is exceedingly frustrating and unhelpful.

Oleg Zarechnyy's class was very structured. I was in his team based learning section. We watched videos of the topic before each lecture period and those explained things very well. It's a great idea to do the homework before lecture because the problems we do during class are very similar. Yeah very good choice, good teacher, easy to understand

Once you can get his accent he is great. He really cares about his students and tries to help. He will explain something so that you can understand and will keep trying until you do. He also as a bit of humor and makes class fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you have TBL, it my recommendation is to do the homework before class and you'll be prepared very well. I didn't do this always myself, but I would recommend it. If you understand all HW and In class stuff, you should do good on exams. Oleg cares about students very much and wants everyone to succeed. You can message him privately and he'll help

This subject is gross as it is, but Oleg's method of teaching worked wonders for me. Lectures mostly online and then group work during class. Everyone runs away from group work, but it works for this class. He has this app that you can text him on and he will answer almost anyone in less than 5 mins (sometimes even at 2 in the morning!). Nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great dude, he's pretty funny too. I had him in a group learning class for mechanics so he didn't do a lot of lecturing, but he did put up videos to watch before the class. He was a little hard to understand sometimes because of his accent, but its not incomprehensible. I really liked that he is always available to contact via telegram. Always.

Most accessible professor I have ever had. Great guy. Join his Telegram and ask him questions until you actually understand. Class is not difficult if you stay on top of each individual topic. If you dont actually learn the topic though you will have issues. Watch Olegs videos if he is using them
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He's a great guy! Knows his stuff very well and focuses on fundamentals(which is crucial). All test problems are based on fundamentals and usually, end up being similar to hw/in class problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took EM324 more than once. The first time, failed. The second time, dropped. Third time, passed. Professor Zarechnny was my professor each time for a reason. He created a group chat every time so students could ask him questions, and he was always super quick to respond. Know you will have to put in work but he is always helpful. DO THE HOMEWORK
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader
