reviews.comment: Terrible professor. Difficult to understand and doesn't seem to care about what or who he is teaching. There is a small amount of extra credit, but I'd rather have a good professor than extra credit. Has major attitude issues and can be quite passive aggressive. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I retook EM324 with Oleg after dropping it the previous semester with another professor. Oleg does a great job teaching, but to be successful you are going to have to put a lot of study time in. The class is difficult; to understand the material, you have to actually read the textbook and do all the assigned problems (more problems  better).

Mechanics is hard, but Oleg knows his stuff and is very willing to teach you if you put in the effort. While attendance is not "mandatory" lectures consist of top hat questions that help you understand the content better. The class is strongly graded off the 4 exams, about 85% so do your best on those. Do the Homework and do not chegg, it'll show.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have taken this class 3 times with three different professors at both University of Iowa and ISU. And I must say they don't come better than Oleg. His lecture notes are well organized! There is nothing wrong with his accent - half of you are just lazy and try to find cheap reasons to justify your 'not so good grade for the class'.
It's just a really difficult class. Prof Zarechnyy did a good job teaching it but the grading is kind of harsh for such a hard class ��

Dr. Z does a good job with mechanics compared to the rest of the department. He can be difficult to understand at times, but he covers everything that will be on the exams in depth which cant be said about the rest of the dept. He does not like to give homework, so be prepared for his random tophat quizzes in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Z is knowledgeable, very accessible but difficult to approach. He'll tell you to watch lecture when you ask about something said in lecture, will reluctantly explain if you press. Have thick skin and strong willpower if you want to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I feel that may of the more negative reviews here are a result of the difficulty of mechanics of materials and not of Dr. Zarechnyy's teaching. His lectures covered all the content we saw on exams, he offered many extra credit opportunities, and the telegram chat he set up made him the most accessible of any professor I've ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is always willing to help, give feedback, and go the extra step to help you understand. At the end of some lectures he may do a top hat quiz at random to check understanding, but half the time the top hat questions are extra credit points for exams. So it is wise to pay attention every class, because those extra cedit points go a long way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Zar is a wonderful professor who truly cares that students learn the material. Mechanics is a hard class no one can change that, it's supposed to be hard, but if you talk with him on telegram or in his office or email him, he will make sure you get on the right track and follows up to make sure you got sorted out. Informative lectures, helpful.

When this many engineering students consistently fail in a fundamental class that has straightforward material, it is a sign that the way the class is taught needs to change. He knows his stuff but the accent doesn't help (you miss important details that he says but doesn't write) and you could learn a lot more by just doing the textbook problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He seems to know what he is talking about but no matter how hard I try to pay attention in lecture, his accent is so thick I have trouble understanding what he is saying. This coupled with the fact that he covers material very fast makes it difficult to get anything useful out of lectures. Around 60% fail rate this semester according to my adviser.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I believe he knows what hes doing but he simply isnt able to convey it though his accent. Its hard to tell if hes a good professor though it. You wont be able to get the small details that you NEED to take this class. His grading is tough but not unreasonable. The extra credit helps a lot. Hes also really insulting when test come out.

He is the absolute worst. Grading on exams is random and unfair, has such a thick accent its hard to understand him. He does provide extra credit on Top-hat, but only 20% of the class gets the points for it. Mechanics is hard enough as it is and Oleg aka Putin does not make it any easier.

2 previous rater. Even your own classmates agreed that you didnt show the work, and your points were fairly deducted. This man is fair and gives points back to students who deserve it, and not to one who show no work. Who doesnt have accent?

This man is one of the most insulting professors you could have at this school. His grading for tests is unclear and unreasonable. You can get 90% by answer correctness but a D total for not showing basic algebra. You'll need to show up for class to do the quizzes but you won't get anything out of it because his accent is so thick. Don't take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He will provide tophat extra credit to make up for lack of curve. His accent can be thick so if you are in a large room sit up front. He is very straight forward and tries to be helpful. He make us study guides for last two exams which outlined how to do all the problem types. The exams are departmental and quite challenge if you haven't practiced.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Olegg is a great professor who has an extensive knowledge on statics. Has an accent which can be tough to understand. I recommend sitting closer to front as the mic he uses can make it harder to understand. He provides a lot of extra credit so take advantage. Very reachable thru office hours and thru messaging. He can struggle at answers questions.

Oleg overall is a good lecturer once you get past the accent (harder for some than others). His in-class examples are helpful as well as his practice exams. Gives Top Hat in-class extra credit. Answers in-lecture questions well and exams matter a bunch towards your grade. I would recommend taking Oleg for the EM classes for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Had Oleg for EM274 and thought he was horrible, now after taking EM 324 with someone else I realize how wrong I was. Oleg has a strong accent but I guess that's the only drawback. Dynamics makes a lot of sense when he teaches it and the in class assignments and practice papers helped a lot. I would definitely recommend him for all EM classes.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher, just follow his instructions and study his notes carefully you will pass
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Oleg is a great teacher if you can understand him. Mechanics is just hard in general.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you can get past the accent, his lectures and lecture slides are actually pretty helpful. He moves fast through his examples, but if you can stay with him he explains what he does decently. Very good about stopping to answer questions in lecture if needed. Go to class. He does in-class top hats for extra credit. Real grade savers on the exams.

reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Russian accent, but pretty easy to understand once you get used to it. Very, very intelligent man.

Dr. Zarechnyy is a great guy and a good professor. He cares about his students, isn't condescending and is helpful in office hours. EM 345 isn't a fun class no matter who teaches it. If you have the option to take it with Oleg, do it and study hard.
Awful professor. A little difficult to understand but doesn't know how to teach at all. Would not recommend to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

Dynamics is hard, but Oleg is the best instructor you could have for Dynamics right now at ISU.

Oleg is just the greatest! He has this dry sense of humor that really strikes you in the morning time. The course was tough, but not unbearable. Final exam was the hardest. If you do the homework correctly, you'll do fine on most exams.

Gives you what you need to pass. At first difficult to understand. But if you listen and follow his methods, you will pass the class. His drawings and writing are not the best by any means, but pay attention and do the example problems and passing the class will be a breeze.

Terrible.  For the online homework there is NO help whatsoever. No hints. If you get a problem wrong it says "answer withheld by instructor" He can't teach the class. I learn best by watching how problems are solved and he solves tons of examples in class. He speaks with an accent, but I had no problem understanding him. He is very helpful when you have questions. Go to class, do the homework and you will do well.

Thick accent and hard to understand during lecture not to mention all he really does is practice questions quickly and doesn't really  explain how to do them. Tests are usually a good amount harder than any questions he goes over so good luck. I'd suggest trying another teacher.

This guy is brutal. He cant teach statics, he just writes problems that he has pre-solved on the projector. cant speak English well, and has a thick accent. he grades super hard and makes fun of our class for doing poorly on his exams. the average grade on our second test was 45%. if he is your only option for statics you are better off waiting.

He does not teach concepts , just  solves problems in a heavy accent so you do not learn anything from his lectures.  If you have no earlier knowledge of statics it will be a frustrating experience.  He's an intelligent and nice guy but he simply cannot teach.
Very thoughtful with critiques and feedback and a very engaging teacher

Megan only gives critical feedback and appears to never like anything. Expects a lot of work to be done outside of class, and doesn't give a lot of time between deadlines. Reviews take up to 2 hours

Megen constantly asked her students to redo projects or do more no matter how much time they put in. She talks very condescendingly and rambles artsy words that don't make sense. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She ran the class week by week with no plan in sight. Discussions are led by students so the conversations often get off topic which she seemed to encourage. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

Megan is a fun professor to have. In class, she makes discussions entertaining and interesting. I will say that some of the assignments can be confusing and that it is easy to fall behind on work. I do think that she is a great professor.

 "Points are Abstract"

reviews.comment: Amazing very personable professor

Dr. O is THE G.O.A.T!!!!!! You can tell when she teaches that she loves her job and loves working with the students. She also is very good at remembering names, even if the class has over 100 people in it.

I also took COMST 311 with her (class wasn't listed as an option). She does a great job at giving feedback as long as you ask. She is not the best at responding to emails so I recommend talking to her after/before class or during office hours. As long as you take notes on her lectures and show up as often as you can, you will pass.

I recommend showing up, as a large chunk of your grade is in class activities, and you can not make them up if you miss. No midterm, no final. Weekly quiz online, pretty easy if you have notes. Every-other-week writing assignment, not hard.
Super sweet and understanding. NO LATE WORK. quizzes are mildly difficult. must attend class because of random attendance days that plummet your grade

There's a lot of completion-based assignments to easily boost your grade, but missing too many classes tanks your grade due to the weight participation points hold. She isn't super responsive to emails and won't budge on late work/attendance policies either, but there is a TA which can be helpful, and she is always available to talk after class.

Great professor! Can tell that she cares about her students and made lectures very easy to follow. However attendance was taken with TopHat, grade only consisted of coachme questions and quizzes over course content.

Very good professor. I thoroughly enjoyed this class. COMST 101 was a very easy A and Kelly was a great professor. I missed an assignment and she let me make it up solely because I hadn't missed one previously. Overall, her lectures are interesting and you can tell she cares about her students.

She was super entertaining in class and really cared about the students in her lecture. I enjoyed coming to her class and I also really liked that she didn't have class on Fridays. I would recommend.
her lectures were very engaging and she took the time to know a lot of peoples names. she's the best

Clear grading criteria; weekly online quizzes; weekly online textbook assignments; no exams, midterm, or final. Attendance is taken over EZ CheckMe (same concept as Top Hat). I enjoyed her as professor. She explains lectures thoroughly so that you are prepared for coursework.

She is clear with what she wants and how the quizzes are going to be. The grading is clear and it is an easy class. If you are a good communicator you may not even need to open the textbook, except for quizzes.

reviews.comment: Professor O. was great! took her online class in Summer 2020. In four weeks we learned a lot. She made the materials easier to study from and we had fun!

Dr. Odenweller did a fantastic job crunching a lot of information in four weeks. Everything was well organized and was outlined clearly including the grading criteria for attendance, quizzes, and activity assignments. She was available outside of virtual meeting times and made it easy for students to reach out and communicate. I'd have her again!

Dr. Odenweller was a great professor! She puts a lot of effort into her course content, so ensure not to take all the preparation she is doing for you for granted! Participation matters, so attend the lectures and take notes! For activity assignments, ACTUALLY note her feedback, it will help you earn back points later on.
If you can get a really solid grade just by attending all the lectures and do all the readings. She is also pretty relaxed when it comes to lectures so you always feel nice when participating.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I think she is a little bit tough on grading, but overall I believed she did a solid job at answering questions and explaining the course materials in many ways. The supplemental materials are usually really fun and interesting to look at.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I thought that it was intense for a course of four weeks. The only thing I would change would be that I would add one more day to turn in your assignments. Currently you have from Monday to Friday to read 3 chapters, do three quizzes and turn in an essay; I really think Saturday would be helpful. Other than that this course is amazing !!!
Professor O. really knows what she's talking about. She gives great feedback on all assignments and gives credit where credit is deserved.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: It felt like just enough work.

I thought that Dr. O was a great instructor for this course! She made the material easy to understand and presented it in an interesting way. I thought the lectures were helpful because it gave students the chance to hear Dr.O explain concepts and ask questions.

Dr. O. was always prepared for our weekly class meetings. She had ample materials on her powerpoint slides and did a great job of explaining the materials in every day language. She used our lectures to increase our knowledge of communication beyond the textbook. She was friendly, caring, and thoughtful with her feedback too! I recommend her class!

Dr. O was great! It was a quick 4 week online class but I learned SO much. She made the material easy to understand and I feel like I learned so much that is applicable to the outside world. Her assignments make you think but are not crazy difficult. Highly recommend class with Dr. O.
I really enjoyed my time in her class. She is one of the very few professors I feel actually cares for her students and how they do academically in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor O. was a great professor! I took her class online, and although there were weekly meetings, she really made sure that we learned and understood our textbook and communications. She made herself easily accessible even when we didn't have class through office hours, and responded to emails quickly. She made online class fun!

Dr. Odenweller is great at what she does and she makes the lectures very easy to engage in. She lays out everything you need very clearly and if you put in the work you will be successful in the class. Overall, it's an interesting course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Any COMST student dreads 404. Because of COVID, Dr. O. was excellent at accommodating the project and expectations to make it doable for us. She is very hands-on and helps you through all the hard steps of your project. She makes sure to give you full attention on your questions even if there's a line of students behind you.

She is a great professor. She really cares about her students and her lectures were very engaging. She is funny and encourages participation. This class had a lot of papers and quizzes, but no tests. You have to read to learn. It is not hard to get a good grade in this class.

Dr. O is fun and keeps the class engaged. TopHat is used for participation and attendance, so go to class. She makes a seating chart which is stupid, but you get used to it. Research participation is a part of the grade and she does let you do 5 extra research credits as part of your extra credit. Study guides aren't helpful so make sure to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: I was not a huge fan of Kelly. She treats the class like she is teaching a high school class. We had a lecture of about 200 students and had a seating arrangement. We were required to take place in university research studies which did not even relate to the class work, it was as if we were in a Psychology class. very biased professor
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. O was awesome! Knew how to keep her students engaged. Will throw in a few funny remarks. Thoroughly enjoyed her lectures. She makes you work for the A, but she gives great feedback! Definitely cares about her students. Personally my favorite teacher.
she is great and a super cool person. she is an amazing artist and person, you dont know her like i do. please stop the slander she is so sweet

I personally don't understand the hate on her, she is incredibly kind and understanding and passionate. As long as you work hard she is more than happy to accommodate you, the coursework can be a lot but she knows that and is lenient if you talk to her. Sweetie pie!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: She's actually a pretty good professor, despite what the other reviews say. The project descriptions are a bit vague, but that's the point, so you have room to create without many restrictions. She gives a lot of constructive criticism, which many people consider pure criticism, so make sure you know what constructive criticism is.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She sets a high bar, but grades your process more than the final product (although she does use a rubric for all 3 of the assignments). If you wanna coast through a class, this isn't the professor for you. She'll teach you the rigors of the design process and you might end up with something you're proud of. However, she can be overbearing at times.
Wants everything to be done her way, passive aggressive, doesnt properly explain projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: They either gives no feedback when asked or really specific suggestions that restrict students from using their creativity. When approached to about a problem, they disregard what you said and just hopes you the best. Theyre passive aggressive and does not explain projects clearly and students are left lost on what they need to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shes often rude and condescending to her students. Students dont get to express their own creativity in her class often, as she tends to control their work and thought processes to reflect what she wants them to be. Project explanations tend to be left vague, and students rarely understand what the end goal of the project is.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Be prepared to meet one of the worst professors in your entire college career. Extremely condescending and rude to her students, makes her class unnecessarily narrow minded and difficult. The class isn't ever about learning, it's about pleasing her. This class is required by design students, so if you get her, just brace yourself.

Exams are not supposed to be as tough and time-consuming as homework. Otherwise, it would have been called homework rather than an exam. There is a limit to how many questions you can put on your exam because it has much stricter time constraints and is closed-book.
