Prof. Urbatsch is an amazing professor and you won't regret taking a class with him.
Typical Dutch guy: very tall, very blunt.  He'll give you more comments than all other profs combined, but there is no sugarcoating so it can be tough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I learned a lot about things like inflation and sanctions that have been in the news so it was really useful, but ngl he and the class can be intense. People will be like oh you have a polisci class, at least that'll be easy, and lol no. It doesn't help that he's built, built like a Serbian NBA player, so that's scary but he's helpful if you ask.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
I took two classes with Professor Urbatsch in 2017: Political Game Theory and Political Behavior.

Urbatsch is the smartest man I have ever known. The bad reviews he may receive are likely attributed to the fact that he challenges your intellectual ability in comparison to the rest of the Department where professors grade to attract more students.
Worst class I have ever taken. Homework was impossible, learned absolutely nothing
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I'm not overly religious, but if you are about to take this class I'm praying for you. I didn't have the option to take it anywhere but online and it was a fairly self-explanatory setup. However, the ridiculous amount of readings and the impossibility of the hw made it awful. I know this class is mandatory but be prepared to cry.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is incredibly smart but unfortunately he seems to think that all his students also have an outrageously high IQ. He is a very interesting and funny person outside of class. Homework and tests are very difficult, but graded on a curve (and since it is difficult for everyone this really helps). World maps tests are your friends for the points.

Robert has a ridiculously high IQ but seemingly he can't find a book on how to be a useful professor. His supplementary material is absolutely useless and he has a hard time explaining even the most basic topics into something digestible. They should keep him locked away in Ross hall where he can focus on his lackluster research.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Boring class, but he's good. Answers email quickly, will set up appointments, very smart guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Urbatsch is probably the smartest man I've ever met in my life. He's super knowledgable and is overall a pretty cool guy. There lots of readings and out of class work you must to do though. His lectures are interesting and fun but they may or may not help you with the homework/exams. His exams are also insane but he does curve the grades.

First time for him teaching Poli Sci 101, he makes it way too difficult for first year students (as most in the class are). You have to do a lot of work on your own and outside of class, as he doesn't give very much info during lectures. The upside, he grades everything on a curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very smart and definitely knows what he's talking about. However, his tough grading and exams is absolutely ridiculous. If you're not a poli sci major and are taking a course for the first time DONT. Your GPA will thank you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: he is like something out of game of thrones. take a class with him for the experience, but take it pass-fail

I haven't taken any other political science or independent study classes so they could all be this awesome, but this was the best educational experience or class of my life. I learned so much from Dr. Urbatsch's knowledge and got a lot of pretty tasty lunches out of the class, too.

Goodness gracious the man is smart. I wish I had taken a different class with him, as this one isn't about voting or public opinion as the title might make you think. But if you can not be intimidated by him, he really is helpful and will respond to email right away. He is much more usful than the TA.

Amidst two Dr. Urbatsch classes, I will say what you're hoping to get out of a professor greatly influences your opinion. Dr. Urbatsch is undoubtedly the most intelligent man I've ever known. He is incredibly responsive and accessible for questions but makes all tests as hard as can possibly be (though he curves them immensly). A+ In my opinion.

The man knows everything. People would bring up random things like Australian migration or the Vietnam and he would be able to talk about it; and if you Googled what he said he was right, it was amazin. He kept wanting to have in class discussions and people didn't talk, so the class dragged sometimes. I don't know why he didn't just lecture more.

The class applies political science to all sorts of situations. It's pretty cool, and I'm glad I took it. There's a lot of math, but Prof. U will go all-out to help you get it if you want to put in the effort. This and Deam's space-policy class were the two best courses I took at ISU. Highly recommended.
Even with the material more difficult, Dr. Urbatsch is a fantastic professor and is able to explain the material in several different ways, making it a concept that anyone can grasp!

He's very intelligent. Probably one of the best professor I've ever had. The class is very informative.  The format of the exam is essay-based, which is a great indicator of  determining your understanding of the material. He grades easier than everyone thinks, but it's still a HARD class. Anyone who gives his easiness above a one is lying.

I definitely respect him. He's very very smart and willing to help and he treated everyone equal in the class. It is still unfair that his version of the class is so much harder than when its taught by anyone else. R is impossible and useless, and this class should not be at 8 am.

He is super intelligent and that is clear. He is fair, but if you aren't one of the "smart" kids then he is not as helpful and none of the readings have anything to do with the class' projects/papers. And get ready to write papers cause that's all it is.

Dr. Urbatsch is brilliant. He grades easier than you think - and he's incredibly interesting. Seek one-on-one help if you get stuck, as he is incredibly helpful and will stick with you until you get it. TAKE HIS CLASSES. He is hilarious and a genius. You will never learn more, or be more fascinated.
He doesn't realize that none of the students know what he is talking about.
A brilliant, extraordinary, and inspiring professor, mentor, and advisor. He is an amazing and wonderful person and is always available to help anyone who asks for it.
He is nice, but 301 is a BEAST. I think I would like other classes with him, if I weren't too chicken.

He's really smart. His responses to students in class and in email and in incredibly detailed comments on papers were amazing. He kept trying to have discussions that this one guy would run into the ground without making sense but that wasn't really his fault.  Would take again. Be warned, his quizzes are impossible.
He is such a smart guy that I didn't expect him to be as nice. You shouldn't miss this class because it is so cool! Best in my college life!

Be prepared to get very very logical. Its almost distracting how logical he is both in class and in office hours and emails, which he's really good about being resposnive to. Even at midnight. I like to think he's a raging metalhead who gets really freaky when the lights get low. You can also tell by how he talks about multicollinearity.

he has a total mr. jekyll and dr. hyde thing going on. he's really funny, friendly and helpful when you ask him questions about anything, but when it comes to grading he will use logic to crush you without mercy. good for a challenge, but frustrating if your not ready for it.

TAKE THIS CLASS!!! He moves fast, but he'll answer any question and he actually grades easier than you think.  The material is really interesting, a whole new way to think about politics, and he makes it hilarious.

Feeerociously smart. I learned a ton, but that ton will hang on my GPA like dead weight...grading is where the ferocious comes in. It's a great class as long as you're there to learn and not for an easy A.
Very accessable.  Fast with email and will sit there and answer tons of question.  Clarity is hard cause 301 is all unclear material, but I guess he presents it all right.

I'm suprised the comments are so positive, a lot of my friends really dislike the class.  But he will be incredibly helpful if  you ask him.  I like teh James Franco comment.  It gets at his wierd sort of cool or cool sort of wierd.
The comments here are just right for him: kind of crazy but really funny, be sure to read the one about The Big Banh Theory, but Anyone who gives says his easiness is above 1 is lying.
He can be great, mostly he just does his own thing though.  It remindgs me of James Franco, if he was less good-looking, love the dimples though.

He's a mystery. He is superhelpful in email and will meet with you for as long as it takes, but so so uncomfortable with people even though he's hilarious and there's no reason he shouldn't be cool. Like he dresses terribly, but I saw him playing soccer in the park and he has a six-pack.  Why wouldn't you show off that more? I don't get it.
Good teacher, pay attention in class. He will dock your grade if you are on your cellphone. Has essay tests that are pretty challenging. Take lots of notes!

Someone in class compared him to Shelldon from Big Bang Theory, that's exactly right. Same incredible brillaince, same interactions with other people, same weird attractiveness from the what's going on down there? factor. I don't think he's trying to prove you wrong so much of the time as much as he just knows you are wrong and will show you why.

The class and professor was just kind of awkward all around. Lecture was as amusing as it could have been considering content. It seems like his one goal is to prove you wrong.. that's basically all lecture is. The class has no statistical side anymore so it's kind of pointless.
I can't help but be completely attracted to this tall nerdy professor.  He's so intelligent and witty.  Do everything you can to take his classes.

Nice guy, Helpful. You have to learn this computer program which was the hardest part for me. But if you show up everyday and make the effort, he recognizes it. and he is kind of cute in a tall awkward kind of way.
Best man I have ever met. He is a God among men! Take his classes and love him for how awesome he is!
Brilliant and very tall! Best professor ever!
He expects a lot, but will help if you ask.  The TA didn't know what he was doing.

He's scary smart and doesn't realize not everyone understands everything, but if you ask questions he'll try hard to help.  He seems bored by the material and doesn't make it very inspiring.  He can be very funny, though.

Lectures are very long, drawn out, and often not very interesting.  Professor knows a lot about the material and is very knowledgeable.  Don't hesitate to ask for additional help, otherwise you will fall behind.  *Not an easy course!*
No Comments

Suraj Upadhaya really cares about his students and the lectures are chock-full of information. You have to come to class if you want to have any hope of what's going on, but when you do, you get a lot out of it. He wants you to be successful and will give extra help if you need it.

Suraj was a great professor for this class. It was a fun class covering lots of guest speakers, documentaries and group activities. The lectures were pretty interesting and the interviewing influencer assignment  was a great experience
One of the best professor I have taken class with. Suraj is nice person and he made class very interactive and student centric.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Knowledgeable professor. Knows what he is teaching. Shared lots of personal experiences. Some of his assignments were long and repetitive but overall good class to get idea about conservation paradigms in the US.

Suraj is a very good person and professor, but the content of FOR: 452 was horribly redundant and was just a recap of basic natural resource issues, and one of the most boring classes ever taken at Iowa State. His assignments are pointless and lectures are extremely bland. The content of the class is terrible, repetitive, and useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Drop this class if you get Dr. Roy. He is one of the most unhelpful professors I have had yet. From boring lectures to unwillingness to work with students, he has made STAT 305 a terrible class. Additionally, he is very rude when asking for help.

Hands down, the worst professor I have had in my life. He is so bad at teaching the content that I stopped going to class altogether. His lecture slides are the most useless thing ever. He is so rude if you talk to him. Doesn't upload practice exams. Doesn't care about how his students are doing in the class. I don't recommend his class to anyone!

Oh Boy is this guy is the worst professor i have ever had. He delivers terrible lectures and has no extra content on canvas to learn from besides a barebone formula sheet. He does not allow cheat sheets on exams unlike every other section. Do not even bother going to office hours he will borderline harass you for not knowing a concept.
Horrible professor. You are better off learning on your own. Clearly the department needs a better class of teachers around.

Teach poorly, and the highest video quality is 480p (720 x 480 resolution) which makes me hard to believe I'm in 2021 instead of 2000. Also, he always uses clothes or something else to scratch the mic !!!!! The scratch sound is at least 1.5 times louder than his speech. Watching his lecture videos is kind of torture for me.
Dr. Roy is clearly passionate about the subject. However, he is unable to teach the content well to students who are foreign to the concept. He will also speak to you in an incredibly demeaning way.
He was awful. You cannot understand what he saying. He is very rough, insult and impolite with students.

Dr. Roy did a great job in explaining the basics of statistical theory. The course had 11 homework assignments which helped solidify the concepts. The 2 mid-terms were challenging, but the lectures and homework really helped to be well-prepared for them. The final exam was much easier.

I was kind of dissapointed with the instructor. He failed to describe his ideas and critical concepts. His office hours are a complete joke. To make matters worse he is extremely unprofessional. Frankly speaking he has to be the worst instructor in the statistics department.

The class ranks as one of the worst I have ever experienced and the instructor clearly can not convey his ideas nor the content of his material. I would suggest others to not waste their time on this joke of a class.

Dr. Roy is a great teacher. He uses many practical examples and keeps interest peaked throughout the lecture. Homework can be difficult, as can tests, but its definitely do-able. He's always willing to help you learn the material as well.
I like teaching of Mr. V. Roy

I believe he has a very vast knowledge of the subject, but he is incredibly unhelpful. Never responds to emails, office hours are a joke, the notes dont always match up with the book. My whole class did terribly, I was very dedictaed and only missed two classes but I just could not grasp what he was attempting to teach. Overall..it sucked,.
I think he knows what he's talking about and understands statistics very well. But he can't seem to get them across as a teacher.

Mr. V is an alright teacher. If you attend class and actually take the notes while he teaches instead of printing them beforehand, this class is fairly simple. He is always asking for questions and seems very dedicated to statistics.

This professor has good intentions, but just isn't cut out to teach. He isn't very good at explaining things and gets frustrated when students do poorly on exams. It is hard to follow his teaching methods, and many students choose not to attend lecture. The class isn't difficult if you're willing to teach yourself the material.

Worst class I have taken. Lectures were not helpful so I basically had to teach myself. Student understanding does not seem to be a priority. There is no real schedule or syllabus yet we are somehow always behind. Expect to figure most of it out on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly, one of the worst classes I've taken. Lectures weren't helpful; I had to teach myself and rely on classmates to survive. There's no clear schedule or organized syllabus, yet we're constantly told we're “behind.” A lot of the class feels unproductive, which makes it hard to keep up. Overall, expect to figure most of it out on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class literally felt like military boot camp. He will go on rants and irrelevant tangents for 75% of the class and then claim that you're behind because "he had to slow down so students could understand the material". Homework questions will be written incorrectly, but you will be blamed for assuming he wrote them incorrectly.

He was a great professor and I learned a lot from him and his past experiences, but this was a really difficult class. There was a lot of homework that is very intense but necessary to understand the material. Get ready to work.

This teacher's lectures are pointless to attend. I get the same out of going to class that I do just looking at the slides at home and doing the readings. His lectures are boring, his slides are not as good as the other professor's, and he takes notes on a separate screen that are illegible.

In my opinion, he does not deserve a 2/5 stars. Some people might think he's boring, but he explains things slowly to make sure students will understand. Do the adaptive quizzes, take notes in class, read part of the textbook if you're confused, and use top hats and practice tests to study, and it won't be too hard.

Class is very difficult. The class was taught with Macintosh, which made it harder to understand. The lectures were very confusing and the slides used were bad, other than his use of an iPad to write illegible notes. The exams were very hard, as wording was confusing. I recommend taking this class in the fall, as there are different professors.

Vollbrecht taught alongside Myers for this course. The grade remained locked for entirety of the semester. Lectures were VERY slow-moving yet there is TopHat for extra credit. Some questions on the exams were worded poorly. Lectures were very difficult to sit through, recommend using textbook or reviewing notes on own time to learn material.

His hand writing is insanely awful, good luck reading his notes. He makes the content boring so I'd advise that you come to lecture with caffeine, as he only speaks in monotone and he will put you to sleep. The exams cover a lot of material that isn't covered in class, so prioritize reading the textbook instead of taking notes on the lecture.

There is a lot of extra credit from TopHat so go to class. The lectures are pretty boring and not that useful but you still need to go because of tophat. He posts the past years' exams on canvas which makes it really easy to study for the exams. The exams are almost identical to those so just study those and its an easy A
Don't like his teaching style. It's easy to fall asleep in class. There's nothing interesting about his material and he makes it harder for you to engage. Tests are difficult too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is incredibly boring, the lectures are terrible, and the tests dive into details never covered in lecture and you wouldn't even consider to be testable material. Don't take this class with Dr. Myers either, they're both terrible professors and will put you to sleep.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A lot of stuff on exams is never covered in lecture, a ton of stuff is out of readings. I would recommending going to SI and reviews to actually learn the material. Lectures are extremely boring and worthless besides the extra credit tophat questions. Do the practice exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Tests were almost impossible.  They went into detail far greater than what we went over in class.

This class is tough, and the material can be hard. However, he and another professor that teaches the other half of the class provide you with all the information you need to ace each test. If you do the practice exams, the problems in the book, and the questions they post online, you're good to go. Many of those questions are on the exams.

Pretty difficult test. Test averages were low, and the professor seemed to confuse himself quite often. Everything you need to study is off of the powerpoints provided, but the tests always went way more in depth. I would avoid taking this class with him.

He always confused himself in lecture and there was no consistency to the class. I felt as though he jumped around from topic to topic constantly. Also, it was really tough to pay attention in class because he talked in such a monotoned voice.

I really liked his style of teaching. He spent adequate amount of time on topics so he wouldn't have to rush through the course. He's helpful during his office hours, but you have to know what you're talking about.

This professor confused himself, and would tell us the wrong information. He jumped around from the elmo to the ppt making it very hard to follow. He was not a good teacher. Clicker questions were somewhat deceiving. When you did ask a question he would answer it but still did not explain things well. Avoid taking this class with him!
He seemed to confuse himself frequently but was very helpful if you asked questions.

Stat 226 is a tough class, but Ulrike made it much easier when asked! I can't say that the material was easy or even very well organized, but Ulrike herself was very helpful and responsive. I would recommend attending SI or getting a tutor if you want to do well, as the material is not well presented, and the exams are nothing like HW or quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is not meant to be an online course, she posts lecture videos, but they don't even have her in them. The exams have nothing to do with what we are learning, or what's on the study guide.

I really enjoyed this class. Lectures are spent practicing code along with the professor, which really helped me learn SAS. She clearly cares about her students, responds quickly, and adjusts schedule and material according to the needs of her students. I would definitely take another class with this professor. Homework, two midterms, and a final.

Dr. Genshel is a gem. She cares so much about her students as a whole and genuinely wants them to succeed. Her lectures can sometimes be slow, but it is helpful if you get confused about something or like classes to go at a slower pace. Homework is not too difficult, and she gives practice exams to prepare for her exams.

Dr. Genschel is super nice and enjoys talking about statistics. However, her lectures were quite boring. 99% of the class is just her lecturing aimlessly without paying much attention to the students. Some of the teaching techniques are also unnecessary too. I suggest finding a friend in the class and doing the homework assignments together.

For STAT484, it is just coding in SAS, she takes you through the codes that are needed for you to do on the homework. Little new statistical analysis concepts, just using what you know to inerpret SAS output. She always listens to feedback, and gives very helpful lectures and tries to make the class as good of a fit to students as possible.

The lectures are extremely helpful so I do not recommend skipping. Sometimes they're a little slow paced but I was never leaving the room confused. Always replies to emails fast. I have her again next semester and I am excited!

She is a great person and is easy to talk to if you are having problems in the class. Sometimes, the lectures are slow and she repeats things, but she just wants to make sure you know what you are doing.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. She cares about her students and wants to make sure everyone understands. She is very open to feedback about the course. There wasn't homework but there were weekly labs that weren't too difficult. The tests could be hard if you didn't prepare but you get a notecard and she only tested over things that we covered in lab.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: As Genschel's first time teaching this class she was very understanding and helpful. There was no homework but lab every week which was difficult if you aren't familiar with JMP. Only a couple exams but you get a notecard cheat sheet. Will randomly give in class points but it's a good idea to go to lecture anyway.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Don't buy textbook. Professor seems to talk more than she lectures. I would rather learn the material than be read the slides word for word. Other sections had better luck, so I would recommend finding a valuable TA who works hard to make sure their students understand. This professor forced us to learn everything on our own time by not teaching

She is overall a good professor but she could explain things a lot better. The class is really hard, I recommend a tutor if math isn't your thing. Keep up with the homework and quizzes and attend class because she gives participation/in-class activity points. Exams are difficult, prepare early!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Genschel is hands-down the best STAT226 professor! Stats is lame but she does her best to make sure her students understand the material and she wants everyone to succeed. Attendance isn't mandatory but it's key to knowing what's going on. She prints lots of handouts and examples so do them because they're really helpful to study from.

Professor Genschel was awesome. She's very kind and clearly cares about her students. Be prepared for the exams, because you will get rocked (like I did) if you do not adequately prepare for the first exam.   The lectures can be long and extremely boring, but she tries to find a niche between lecturing and doing classwork.  I didn't use a book.

She is always willing to answer any questions you may have on the material and homework. She makes an effort to get to know her students and memorizes their names in the first few weeks of class. Mostly follows a one/two days of lecture and one day of practice model for each module she teaches. Put in the work and go to class and you'll be fine.
Exams always harder than what she taught in class. Altough attendance is not mandatory, you will not fill in those blanks in the notes and miss somehow inclass project, each project takes 1 point.

She wants you to exceed in her class. Not quite an easy class to Ace, but if you put forth the effort attaining an A is possible. Do the homework because the test are somewhat identical to it. Go to class, quizzes are easy points. Final exam is an spitting image of all HW, Quizzes, and in class examples.
She is great and very nice , stat 226 is not as hard as imaged in her class

She is very helpful. Attendance isn't taken everyday, but she does give out quizzes (12 total) that you cannot make up. She goes through slides during lecture and you just follow  along and fill in the blanks. You go through examples which help a lot. HW is hard so it's nice to have examples. Turn in HW every week. There's 2 exams and 1 final.

Very helpful, class attendance is not mandatory but suggested -- you will miss quizzes and a lot of valuable information.  She does a great job at making Statistics as interesting as it can be.  Go to class, turn in homework every week, make sure you know all the information on reviews before test and you will do well.
Very nice and helpful.  Her class is hard and she demands alot out of you, but you learn alot at the same time.  Go to lecture and lab, don't need the book.

Very nice and always willing to help! Lectures arent mandatory but helpful. Labs can be tricky but ask questions and you should do fine. Tests are much harder than the hw and labs. Look over the study guides for the tests and it will help! Lots of hours for help room too!

It's easy to tell she loves stat and tries to get to know the class. However, it is still statistics and it's not easy. She can be a really picky grader so make sure to study labs, homeworks, and old tests. Even then you'll probably never get anything perfect.  Make sure to go to class, take notes, and pay attention and ask questions in lab.

Quite possible one of the best professors I have had at ISU. She cares about your work and will help if you ask. She knew everyones name by week 3 w/out taking attendance - so show up most of the time and you will do great

Attending class is not mandatory, but you will not pass the class if you skip lecture.  Doing the homework and labs are imperative as well.  Tests are difficult, but studying the old tests that she supplies are genuinely helpful.

Has a strict classroom control, especially in 326. She's very helpful, but her tests are a little harder than the Labs and Homework.  She has a slight grading curve, but will never tell you what it is.

She's a very bad professor.  Half her notes are blank slides you have to write a paragraph for in class.  Go to class to take notes.  She'll yell directly at you if you aren't paying attention.  Her tests are much harder than homework/labs.  She's too picky--you'll never get anything perfect.

She make the stuff clear to understand,but I would say you  will never get 100% because she is ssssoooo picky on the stuff and the exam is always harder than what she teach during the class. Her help only offer to individuals~

A great professor. She really teaches you the concepts, if you actually go to class and pay attention it is a pretty easy class. She is very willing to help students that actually go to her and ask for help and are not just looking for answers. She is also super nice and not intimidating when you go and ask for help.
Labs help you learn most of the information. It would be helpfull to attend class, labs, and the study sessions.

At first I didn't really like her, but in the end I found out she is very willing to help out. You should go to class everyday b/c you never know when she will give out worksheets. The homework can be hard at times, but do it because you may need the points. The exams are hard..nothing like the worksheets..I'd take this class w/ some else

This class blows.  She's a nice lady who tries hard and really loves statistics; it's just not a fun class especially when I will never use this as an accountant.  It's just ridiculous.  Take it with a friend or you'll probably have to take it again because you'll get sick of it and quit...
She's the worst teacher in ISU ever!!!She tells eveything with absolutely no main point and testing strange things all the time.She's not nice at all.A nightmire if you take her class@
Great teacher.  Strict but helpful.

Goes over material very slowly, every one should be able to pick it up. If you have problems she is willing to go over the material one on one and answer any questions you may have. Test are almost identical to the study guides she post for them. Oh ya, also VERY cute!

The class was required for me, so I had no other choice, but to take it for Finance.  I didnt like the fact that she made the tests twice as long as the semester before, and some of the material wasnt the same.  I also didnt like how the tests were graded.  I cant complain too much though for the grade I recieved, which was better that Stat 226.
Very hot and smart.

First of all: she's really easy on the eyes and has such a cute German accent, but it can be difficult to understand at times. Her tests might be a wee bit hard, but it is a 300-level, though I would have liked an A. A little confusing in lecture but it isn't the hardest subject in the first place, but she will work with you and is VERY helpful.

She's a pretty nice professor. Homeworks can be a headache at times. Hang on to them though, as well as the worksheets as they are very useful for studying for exams. Overall the class wasn't as bad as I imagined it would be.
Very formal definitions followed by 3000 examples.  Nice and very helpful outside of class

She did a really good job with a fairly hard topic. I started taking stat 401 with a different prof the previous semester and had to drop it, but Ulrike was entertaining, really wanted to make sure everyone understood, and made herself available. She loved statistics and it showed. Word of advice: attend the labs, it will make a world of difference

This class was easier than I imagined it would be. She was very willing to help you with problems as well as provide you with a formula sheet for the test. Homeworks sucked, but that is a department standard, she has no control over the homeworks. Homework isn't so bad if you get together with a group of people to work on it.
If you have to take this class it might as well be with her. Lectures are extremely boring. Do the example problems before tests and you will do well.
Often frusterating homework, but lots of examples done in class.  Still, regardless of how many examples we do, it never seems like enough.  Grades fairly & a decent lecturer.

very slow! you learn one thing and then the rest of class are examples. Homeworks are hard and pointless. Great teacher though! Doesn't make anything harder than it should be. be sure to catch her little side notes..very funny! she'll make you laugh.
Homework can be hard at times but the class is fun and she is very knowledgeable!
No Comments
No Comments

good professor but her classes are a bit boring since she really just reads off the board. shes still pretty engaging and funny. I'd definitely recommend her. also you get a few free unexcused absences before each one takes off from ur grade which i liked.

I LOVED my class with her! She is super funny and caring, and I would gladly have her as a professor again. Classwork is very fair and didn't take me more than 2 hours / week. Literally just show up to class and do the homework on time, it's almost impossible to not pass.
Willing to work with you and wants you to succeed.

She is the best professor I have had at ISU. The content of the class can be pretty challenging at times, but she truly wants everyone to succeed. There were quite a few online homework assignments and the exams can be challenging. A big part of your grade is attendance! Would hands down recommend her!

Great professor! The class was decently hard, but she took time to go back on material that we needed help with. Cares about the students and is very fun. Go to her office hours if you are struggling with the material.

She's a tough grader, but was the best professor I had all year. Very invested in all our academic and personal lives, which is so nice from a college professor. The tests were difficult and for our class it was difficult/rare to end with an A, but it wasn't really because of her, just because of the content.

Profe Lence was such a great professor and having a native spanish speaker was so helpful in learning spanish.  There is a good amount of homework but it's not difficult. She expects participation during class, but is always kind if you mess up when speaking. She is one of my favorite professors after having her for both 297 and 303B. Very caring.

Lence is truly one of the best professors I've ever had. She is funny, kind, and engaging when lecturing. There is a tedious amount of homework due before every class, but it's not bad. Do your work, participate, and study for the exams and you'll do great. She brought us candy and Argentinan candy for easter. 10/10 recommend!

Marta is a goat. I took her class after having a 2-year hiatus from Spanish and it was something that I did not regret despite my advisor's warnings. Although the grade I received was not the best I am happy with the take aways I got. I genuinely feel like I learned something in this class and can now speak decent Spanish.

Very helpful - She genuinely cares about students and wants to help. Her lectures are usually interesting, and she gets so excited about teaching! I loved her class, and would recommend her for anyone looking to take Spanish at ISU.

Profe Lence has easily been the best professor I have had at Iowa State. She always makes her classes fun and it is a nice change of pace compared to the run of the mill lecture. If you have any curiosity in taking a Spanish class I would HIGHLY recommend you take it with Profe Lence.

She is a great professor- the content can be tough sometimes but she's willing to go back and explain if needed. There's lots of partner conversation, and she's strict about speaking only Spanish in class, but it's not so bad after a couple weeks. She genuinely cares about her students and their learning, and it's evident in class.
Cares about your success

The tests can be hard and studying is a MUST, however the are not weighted very heavy as she feels that participation matters more as well as homework completion. Make sure to stay on top of homework assignments (that are usually on the textbook website). I would also recommend getting the paper version of the book as I liked taking notes in it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: You definitely learn a lot and sometimes it can be very fast paced. You have homework each time before class but it is not super time consuming. She is very nice but you definitely need to try to get a good grade in the class because if you don't do your work she will be a tough grader.

She is an excellent professor. This class is pretty difficult if you don't study. She isn't big into tests so they don't really count toward your grade. Always participate in class, that's where you can get points. She really wants you to improve and succeed She always makes sure you understand the concepts she is teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Marta is amazing. Very kind, helpful, and accessible. Makes learning Spanish fun and doable. I really learned a lot from her class. She will make you participate, and does a lot of speaking-centric activities in class activities. She will pull you out of your comfort zone in the best way and force you to improve a lot. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Marta is an excellent professor. She helps each student at their own level of spanish and there is no "expectation" per say for what level you have to be at by the end of class. She understands that everyone is at different points in their spanish level and takes that into account when speaking and communicating. Decent amount of busy work though

My favorite professor I've had at ISU yet. She was engaging, high energy, and very knowledgeable. She was kind and willing to help and made class enjoyable. Would definitely take a class with her again!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She is the best prof at ISU one hundred percent. From Argentina so she has an Italian type accent when she speaks Spanish. She is adorable and cares about the students and is amazing at explain Spanish.

Marta was very caring and made sure students understood what she expected. Sometimes the class was too fast pace, but it's up to you to make sure you don't fall behind. The written tests are easy, but it's hard to get help on the online homework. Overall great professor and I can't wait to have er again!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Marta is a wonderful professor. She is native to Argentina, which makes learning the language from her really fun. She is also really funny, which makes the class go by faster. Don't be on your phone, it's disrespectful and she'll notice. She's the best spanish professor I've ever had.

Marta is the nicest and sweetest professor I have ever had.  She is always willing to help you understand something.  The tests are very fair and clear. You can only miss two classes before your grade becomes affected.  There is online homework every night.  you have to buy the online component (Connect) so you might as well not buy the book.

She was very involved and was always willing to help when needed. She speaks in Spanish about 98% of the time, so understanding new grammar concepts was difficult. It is more of a you learn at home and go over homework in class type of learning.

Marta is awesome! She is so cheery in the mornings and always has a smile on her face! Her Spanish is very clear and easy to understand. She is always willing to explain things that you don't understand in class. Make sure you do your homework and pay attention so you know what you're doing on the exams and you'll be fine.

Marta is great! She is so caring and literally perfect. Span 297 is a transition course from high school Spanish to college, so there is lots of participation and conversation. It's hard at first, but fun. Everyday, she starts out with conversation between classmates with a set of questions, so beware of "alguien diferente!" Would recommend!

Marta was one of the best Spanish professors I have had at Iowa State! She was so nice and willing to help students. She only assigned three short essays and gave tons of feedback before giving a final grade. Class is mandatory to passing, and tests can be tricky, but overall a fairly easy course.

She is such a sweetheart.  Her Spanish is pretty easy to understand.  There are three papers to write but they're short and she's very helpful with them.  The tests are kinda tricky if you're not the best at grammar.  She's super willing to meet with you if you don't understand something.
We do basically the same thing in class ever single day.  We get assigned homework, we go over it one by one, a powerpoint, then repeat every day.  She doesn't give you much time to write essays.
Marta is clear about her expectations and is always willing to go the extra mile to help her students! She is fair and makes Spanish so enjoyable. Favorite teacher in my college career.

Profesora Marta was one of the best professors that I've had yet in college. She is always clear on what she expects, gives plenty of reminders, and does her best to make the class interesting. I wish that I would have gone to more office hours, because she had lots of advice for me. She is the reason that I decided to declare a Spanish major.

Marta makes class SO enjoyable, and she loves class participation. You'll often work with partners, which makes talking in Spanish much easier. The class is laid out very well, and there are homework assignments every day, but they're online and fairly easy. The pace of the class is great, and I couldn't imagine having a better teacher!

Syllabus is key to the class. Stay on track and you will do well. Quizzes and homework are not bad, do not forget to do them. She give you lots of time to revise papers and the class does peer review for all three. Show up to class with new words and phrases it will make her happy. Tests are more grammar based. I took two classes with her.
Best Spanish professor I have ever had. VERY helpful and understanding. Definitely take a class with her!

Marta always brings a smile to the class. She has a sense of humor which you can understand!She brought treats one time! The book is needed for vocab and grammar structure. Online homework pretty easy. Tests require knowledge of grammar, verb conjugation, and exceptions.

Marta is very helpful and truly loves teaching her native Spanish. She is willing to work with all students, especially if you work hard and participate in class. It is obvious that she is very passionate and excited about teaching Spanish.
Professor Lence is a genius. She brings a clarity to the language of spanish that is unsurpassed by any of my previous professors. She also has a flat stomach. Nuff said. She's a dimepiece.

Great teacher. 201 is a breeze if you have had several years of spanish in high school. She does a great job at making sure you learn. participation is part of the class so being shy is not much of an option.
She is one of my fav prof at ISU!! she is so helpful and truely wants you to learn.

She is very nice and very helpful. She will do whatever she can to help you do well in the class. The CLASS however is ABSURDLY HARD don't be fooled by the fact that it is a 101 class. You will spend a ridiculous amount of time working outside of class to keep up with the pace of the class. One of the hardest classes I have ever taken at ISU!

She's an extremely nice teacher and is willing to help you out whenever you need it. Her accent can be a little hard to understand at first but it's definitely not hard to get used to. Quizzes and tests (department exams) are easy.

She's a wonderful teacher!  She sometimes doesn't agree with "the man" so she does things her own way.  She understands that learning Spanish can be difficult and totally helps you out when you need it.  She is definatly an awesome teacher!

Doesn't show up to office hours, has no office hours listed and his office is off campus. His lectures are incoherent ramblings that have nothing to do with graded assignments, he doesn't have a syllabus, I'm pretty sure the TA he lists doesn't exist, and his grading consists of “-5 not enough” or “-3” and when questioned he forgets why.

Awful. I took EE 535 in Fall 24. Delivers out of context talks in class. Labs are for no good. You need to submit papers like reports every week, which will destroy your weekends. Depends only on two exams where questions will be very tough and you'll get no justification for your grades. Lectures will not be posted in Canvas. DON'T TAKE EE 535!!!

Dr. Dalal is a very intelligent man in many topics. Make sure you write down everything he puts on the board. I found the textbook helps, but you will do poorly if you don't attend class. He is old school, so do not expect things on canvas.

EE332 is not an easy class in any way. Attending lectures is crucial, material is not available elsewhere. Dr. Dalal knows the material well, is helpful, and appreciates interaction in the course, but has little sympathy for people who skip class. Review sessions and study guides are very helpful as well. Very few things in gradebook before final

Every student deserves a professor but not every professor deserves a student. Dalal has to be one of the worst professors at Iowa State. The stress of reading his terrible handwriting and whatever he has to ramble about makes for one of the worst learning environments. This man needs to get out of the undergraduate level or evaluated by the dept.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Worst professor at ISU. Never at office hours, but then yells at the class for not going to his office hours. Doesn't cover any useful material in lecture. Says certain material won't be on the exams and then the exams are entirely on that material. Brags about how smart he is when in reality he can barely use a computer

He's intelligent and fun to listen to. There's a lot to learn from lectures, but very little pertains to the curriculum. Homework routinely covers previously unmentioned topics, syllabus is very vague, and grades were never posted. Rarely responds to emails and is frequently condescending. No clue how I got a B based on the 2 times I got feedback.

Its really hard to make sense of his scribbles on the board and he is just kind of a jerk. I honestly have no idea how I passed this class I couldnt tell you one thing that I learned. I would take this with another prof if you can.

Very awful professor . I think he is ready for retirement. His lectures are hard to follow. His organizational skill are poor, which makes it hard to find important document. His speech patterns are broken. He will often not finish sentences or thoughts before starting new ones.

Very Awful. Likes to drop the stupid card on students. After every quiz we took, next time he will complain about how disappointed he was about us. Honestly, i do not pay thousands of dollar to a school with a teacher that i barely understand with a huge sense of ego.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you want to go to grad school for anything related to semiconductors .... take EE 332 with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Don't skip class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dalal makes it quite clear that teaching his undergraduate students is his lowest priority. He replied to 1 out of 6 emails over the course of the semester, he never showed up to his office hours, he never put a single score in the online gradebook, and he frequently condescends. I was excited to take this class; I regret that I took it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This has been by far my favorite course that I have taken at ISU. The material isn't going to be handed to you, but it gets much more intuitive as the class progresses. Dr. Dalal does genuinely cares about students learning, but like anything in EE, you have to earn your right to understand the material. Put the time in and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Would take again

reviews.comment: Avoid at all cost Go and panic

His course has no structure and lectures are all over the place. Very difficult to understand. Writing on white board looks like chicken scratches. No clear grading criteria. Tests material never discussed or covered in class. Shows up late to class. Terrible professor... AVOID AT ALL COSTS!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Took him a month to post syllabus, which was extremely vague. Shows up to class late often and rambles on about random topics, such as bears and how much he hates politicians. Gives quizzes irregularly, which rarely contain topics discussed in class. For example, the first and second week we discussed global warming but had quizzes on physics.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Look, he's not an easy teacher. He's old school and believes in learning the hard way. If you are not interested or don't find value in knowing the hard underlying physics of semiconductors, you won't like it. He won't be nice to you, but I guarantee that you will actually learn something. Don't skip class, you need all the info in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Dalal was very knowledgeable about the physics of semiconductors. He writes out his lectures on the whiteboard which makes following along easier as compared to powerpoint slides. The material is inherently difficult, so you will need to work hard to succeed and attendance is mandatory. He is down to Earth and very accommodating. Very funny.

His lectures consisted of him scribbling a lot of work that was hard to follow. The homework was over a lot of material he barely touched on and the book didn't really explain at all. One of the most difficult professors ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The best professor I have had in my life for learning semiconductors and solar cells. Dr. Dalal really cares about his students to learn the fundamental physics and science behind semiconductors and devices.  He is an inspirational professor. His digressions in the class are very interesting.

Have to work a little more than usual although its not that difficult of a class. Lectures can be hard to keep up with so its wise to sit up front. Tests and homework can be long and tedious but doable. His Study guides are very useful and make sure to make good crib sheets. Hes a interesting and great professor. His tangents are very entertaining

Here's what I've learned: 1) Dalal has no organizational skills. He illegibly scribbles all over the board without labels 2) Dalal has no idea how to use a computer. Never uploads anything to BB. 3) Dalal assumes that you have taken EE330 4) Semiconductors are your passion and you can dedicate 12+ hours a week to his class. AVOID IF POSSIBLE.
Never ever take class with him. Everything very hard. TA are bad too. Hard grading. He assumes everyone knows everything.

Dalal is clearly very passionate about teaching and incredibly intelligent. However, his class was brought down by his sometimes random, albeit entertaining tangents, and his patchwork syllabus. Some exams were straightforward, others covered material never before worked. Curve was helpful, and I truly enjoyed the class, but it had problems

Likes to brag about his grad students. Goes too fast in lecture and doesn’t post any notes. Never posts grades online. When he actually shows an example in class he’ll erase it right after writing it. Almost never in his office. If you aren't interested in semiconductors, take it with another professor and save yourself hours of unnecessary work
Great lecturer. Impossible quizzes. Fair tests. Very hard HW (no solutions). Does not post grades. Would recommend.

Prof Dalal's solid state electronics class was difficult but i felt that i learned something each lecture. Other professors will dryly read off lectures slides that they didn't even create but Prof Dalal takes the time to write all his notes on the board, and because of this i attended each lecture to make sure i had all the notes.

Difficult class and interesting material. Dalal assumes that you have taken EE230 and EE330.  I attended every class, but still felt like I missed a lot of concepts I needed to know. This made homework impossible to do well.                                Protip: use your notes on the quizzes - you're not supposed to, but you will do much worse tha

Dr. Dalal is a great teacher. He makes an effort to actually teach the material, rather than just showing slideshows. One will need to review notes, read the book, etc. to do well, but you will learn the material. He also tells interesting stories. Overall a great professor.

Great professor. Sure, the class requires that you read your textbook, review your notes, and pay attention - you might consider that hard. I'd call it an education. Regardless, Prof. Dalal is a great guy and loves to help answer questions. Get to know him, show him you're interested, and give a good effort and you'll be fine.

Excellent professor. His teaching helped me get a job at a top company (Intel) and helped give me the skills to succeed in the semis fab industry. He pushes you hard, but it's worth it. Naysayers are bitter because he makes you study.
Very demanding and not concerned about educating students. Only cares about research.

He is only interested in research and proving his knowledge to us. This class is so difficult because he doesn't deliver material clearly. Much of it isn't in the book either. This class is an insane amount of work for studying.
If the university and the state of Iowa listened to this man, he could get a Nobel Prize within the next 10 years.
best prep for grad school. very smart man
He teaches well

assigns a moderate amount of problems which he explains well. the exams are based on the problems and are very predictable. if you keep up with the homework it's easy. he's often available for questions.
Great teacher, always available for help.  Very passionate about teaching and loves the students he has.
very smart guy. really seems to care about the students

Dalal is an excellent professor as long as you put in a little effort and show up to class he will make sure you do well. He really cares that his students get good grades and learns the material. Excellent professor!

1. Stands in front of the board scribbling and mumbling incoherrently.  2. Turns around and says, "...And there you have, the obvious result!". 3. Promptly erases said scribblings and leaves you completely lost. 4. Repeat until end of lecture.
Not as hard as everyone says, IMO.  Truly a great guy, one of the smartest men I have ever met.
prof really cared about his teaching. the most helpful course in prepping for graduate work
Very interesting class, very energetic professor.  Not a hard professor if you put in the effort.
gives lots of help & nice fellow. homework helps out for exams very much. overall great guy and intelligent
fair- if you do practice exams/homework, class is easy- fun class
smart man
He doesn't know how to teach, and he is always mumbling in class.
Makes class tough, but learned a lot of material and helps you out quite a bit

This course was an easy and interesting course to take for my international perspectives credit. She was very sweet and helpful with questions and assignments were easy. I would recommend this course if you want something easy with small assignments each week.

Took this class as an elective credit and would highly recommend to anyone who is interested in this sort of content. TopHat is taken for attendance, but the lectures are full and make it worth coming. The tests can be difficult, but she allows written notes, and all the content is covered in class and posted on TopHat.
Dr. Wilson is an amazing professor and is easily so far one of the best professors I've had. She engages with the class and is easily accessible in her office hours and even outside of them.

This class was super interesting and really enjoyable thanks to the professor. I appreciate all the material I learned. This class is online, so there are discussion posts, online lectures, readings, quizzes, and simple assignments. I recommend her class!
Class was pretty easy for a gen dd. Lots of lectures and relatively few assignments. Top hat required and counts towards grade
Super chill and gave us a lot of leeway when it came to what we wanted our assignments and final projects to be about.

I could have gotten an A- in the class but I messed up and didn't respond to two people in discussion posts. The tests are hard. Sometimes you can find answers in her slide shows but other than that good luck. The homework is easy it just takes a little time. She makes the content interesting and is very nice. I missed a test and she checked on me

Easily the best professor I've had. She genuinely cares about the success of her students and has been very accommodating with me when I developed health issues mid-way through the semester. Such a kind person and very understanding!
With all of the challenges of online school, she is gracious to tech issues and such!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had at Iowa State. She makes everything short and to the point and the test questions come from her lectures. She also adds to the learning by using a lot of current events and media assignments which help a ton. Wish she was my prof for every class.

I enjoyed taking Professor Wilsons class. She is a very energetic, fun person, and knowledgeable with her course content. In her tests, I appreciate how she doesnt try to trick you with the questions. If you go to class and know the content, youll do great.               Learned alot from 205.

Wilson is a really good professor and knows what she is talking about. Her lectures can be pretty heavy though which makes it hard. You can't miss class either or your grade will definitely drop. She does want the best for every student.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Courtney is a great lecturer that really knows her stuff. She is passionate and energetic. Lots of in class assignments for attendance points, so it's important to get to class. There are weekly learnsmarts with the ebook... just get them all done at the beginning of the semester when you don't have any HW/tests. Testing center exams. Pay attention
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was really easy because she was always good about making her lectures interesting and cared about her students. She does really good reviews before exams and always gives you the study guide at beginning of the unit
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Super nice and understanding person. Teaches well in lecture too!

Dr. Wilson is by far the best professor I've had at Iowa State. She made lectures interesting and I found myself really engaging with the material with the in-class activities, which made it a lot easier to learn and understand. Her expectations are made very clear and she gives great feedback on written assignments/worksheets!
She's the best teacher I have ever had at ISU and I am a senior. She is funny, dorky, and super nice. Definitely take her class!!

The textbook is automatically billed to you for this course, and definitely required. Its an online textbook with reading questions for points. I just went through and answered the questions, which got me by, but it definitely would have helped to read. Lectures can get a bit long, but lots of points come from in class activities.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. VanVeller is very excited to teach all of her classes and provides great opportunities for guests to present for the class. The readings are very necessary (mostly dependent on your knowledge of the current religion, being agnostic, I had much reading to do). The topics are quite engaging and interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Good dude. Puts ducktales on before class so people get there early. Attendance not mandatory as he says if ur gonna talk during class you can go outside.  My only issue is that he explains some stuff in too much debt that wont be on the 12 question exam. Thats what got be a B. Exam 1 is easy, 2 is alright, and 3 hard. Final is pretty solid.

He's an excellent professor! Before the lecture starts, he'll put on Duck Tales. During his lecture, he makes sure the room is dead silent before teaching. He makes homework optional, which isn't that good, as you don't get practice. He also only does 12 questions on the midterms. A couple of times, he let people do the experiments in class.

Professor Venditti is amazing. He always plays Duck Tales before lectures and he explains all the chemistry concepts in a way that even a 5 year old could understand. He's always available after lecture to answer any of your questions. He also cracks jokes which make the lecture fun.

He's a pretty good professor, but his canvas page this semester was not organized. I did very poorly on my first exam (entirely my fault, not his) and my grade stayed low until the end of the semester. I ended with a B+ but my grade didn't change until earlier today, after he submitted the final exam. He's a decent professor nonetheless.

Nice dude, my only real issue is that he explains wayyyy too much on some topics and notes that are unnecessary. After exam 2 is when you really learn stuff you haven't learned in hs.
He gets the class involved really well with top hats while attendance is still not mandatory.
Also: If your final exam score is higher the lowest regular is dropped
Very good professor

Great professor for thermo. Homework is very challenging, but tests are much easier. You can use any notes you take or print out during exams, making it very easy to do well. He has amazing lecture slides that contain any formula you may ever need. I would suggest printing out the lecture slides for exams; it helps out a ton. Overall amazing.

I liked his sense of humor and his passion for chemistry overall. Homework was optional, but I would recommend doing at least some of it because the class gets a little difficult after the second exam.

I thought he was a good professor. I went to almost all the chemistry lectures and did the TopHats. I enjoyed watching Duck Tales before class started, it was a fun way to boost energy. To be honest, I didn't really listen to the lectures because I did better in that class when I watched YouTube videos. Nice professor though.

Amazing professor, we started each day watching ducktails. He makes lectures fun and easy to understand. He is always open to questions and does a great job explaining. There are easy in-class extra credit points.

Really funny professor with a great personality. Told many jokes, played duck tales before class started, and was very transparent with what material was on the exams and what we needed to memorize. Definitely recommend going to the SI's after exam two; for me, that's when the review of high school chem stopped.
Good lecturer who has a funny personality. Makes lectures a little less dull. Sped through information second half of semester. Attend SI's to help

The lectures almost always contained content way out of the criteria. it's evident he wishes he was teaching a higher level class. The lectures were ineffective for me, and the best way to learn was during recitation, or reviewing the practice exams. NOTE: If your final exam score is better, your lowest exam is dropped and replaced with it.
Vendetti is both entertaining in a way that makes content engaging and also is good at explaining/teaching the topics despite the huge size of his lectures.

Great guy and the class isn't very hard (especially if you took chemistry in high school). Tests are pretty easy and discussion sections are very helpful. The SI exam review sessions are really helpful.
Amazing teacher always made lectures fun. Exams were not to bad as long as you study
Honestly just a great professor

Hands down one of the best CHEM 167 professors out there. He knows when the material is too much for the students to handle and usually ends the class early. He has a thick accent making it harder for students to understand but overall does a great job. I highly recommend going to lectures. 2 weeks of this class  1 year of high school chemistry
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Venditti is a nice guy. He's pretty funny in class and seems to be pretty genuine. However as a teacher he doesn't do his job. I felt as though every lecture was extremely pointless because of the language barrier and made going very difficult. His grader is so harsh it's unreal, homework average was low final was unbelievably hard, no curve at all
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He really made Chem 167 more enjoyable. The class is very dry, but he made going more fun!

I was good at chem in HS so this class was very easy, but I know it wasn't for many others. You don't neeeeeed to read the book (I never did) but if you struggle with chem you'll probably need it. You do need the OWL code for homework. Killer italian accent. If you struggle with chem, get the book. Either way, you should be fine.

Attending Dr. Venditt's lectures is really quite entertaining. He never made it boring, or at least he tried not to. The experiments he did were fun to watch. He never takes himself too seriously if an experiment fails or he works out a problem incorrectly. We had a couple of substitute lecturers over the semester and I prefer Venditti over them.

Super easy. He's a funny guy, but once I found a plug for the tophat answers I stopped going. His lectures consist of him reading off of the slides and doing little demos which are pretty cool. All in all great guy but not the best teacher.

Venditti is the coolest professor I have by far. I absolutely hate chemistry but it is my favorite class because he is so funny. The homework is easy because its online and if you get it wrong you can redo the problem. The tests are hard. Quizzes in recitation are kind of hard. I recommend going to lecture for the in-class quizzes.

Vincenzo was a great teacher. His tests were a little too easy but hes such a great guy and his lectures were very easy to understand. I dont know what it is about this guy, but he made everything feel so much easier. Felt bad because only like 5 people would go to class and Id go toavout half of them but I still put in time outside of class.

Go to the lecture for Top Hat points. Weekly Quizzes and Homework due in the recitation, gets challenging later in the semester. The class was helpful to attend as he explains things pretty decently and is entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Had to take Chem 167 for engineering and had Venditti for his first semester. Tests were tough, but the final saves you. Lectures are pretty much pointless, if you read the book you'll understand more, the only reason to attend lecture is for entertainment in my opinion. Overall fun class.
The tests get progressively more difficult, but the final is alright. I got an 88% on it. Go to lecture or you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He made the lectures entertaining and made the material easy to understand, whether it was re-explaining a concept or walking us through a few examples. Relatable guy, very understanding. If a top hat quiz question was too difficult, he'd give everyone the point.
Slightly hard to understand at times. Go to class for Top Hat quizzes.
