reviews.comment: Although I personally hated Chem, Venditti made the class fun to go to. The lectures have quizzes that you have to take during them, but he often will give everyone credit just for attending class. The recitation quizzes were sometimes difficult, but is mainly things from the homework.
The lecture slides were also difficult as they were handwritten in cursive and not always clearly readable or fully in English.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great professor with a sense of humor, yet able to explain anything well!
Highly recommend Mr. Cox, he was a great professor! Classwork wasn't very demanding; he gave great feedback and just strived to help his students understand basic stats.

While intimidating this is the best professor I have had so far. As someone who is horrible at math I have never be able to actually learn and understand math until this professor. 1000% would recommend.
He has a tude most of the time and is very sarcastic but otherwise a very good teach he will explain things until you actually understand.

Dr. Cox is a very good statistics professor; he perfectly explains the curriculum. The most challenging part of this class is the homework. You'll need to pay close attention in lectures to complete the homework. There is one quiz per week over the lectures. The exams are very straightforward as well. The practice exams are also a great help.

Dr. Cox is awesome. He's a little intimidating at first but he's very funny during labs. He seems to genuinely care about his students and will meet with you one on one if you need extra help. Overall wish I had tried a little harder as it's not a super tough class but I didn't feel the need to actually read the textbook or do the hw.

I did not show up to class but watched the online lectures posted. Labs were very helpful, and I would stay in the lab option and not opt out. Cox is very helpful and grades very leniently on labs and homework. Also, fill out the end-of-semester survey to get extra credit for the lowest exam score.

Dr. Cox was incredibly funny during both lecture and lab, and he was always willing to help with any questions I had during the class. He made all concepts in this class quickly clear but also circled back for retention. Be aware that asking questions that prove that you weren't paying attention in class will be met with a healthy dose of sarcasm!

Wigton is an amazing professor. I took this course online, and it was about 2-3 papers each week with a quiz. There was also a (maybe) 10 min lecture each module. Personally, I'd take that over a class 3 days a week with a lecture. He was always available to help and give feedback. The content was also very conducive to future classes. 12/10.

Very fun online class, interesting assignments to do and fun quiz questions for extra credit occasionally. Communicates well and sends out emails and video lectures to help grasp topics. A lot of papers and analyzing, but they were fun projects to do and he had helpful feedback!
I took an online class so I didn't really know the professor but the class was easy and fun! I loved the final project and I would recommend this class to anyone!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Overall a good professor! Really enjoyed his class. He is flexible and gives good feedback on what to expect. The readings were okay, and the quizzes weren't too bad, just make sure you read the chapters. Would take again!
I was in Wigton's social media strategy class and he provided a ton of great material and fun projects. Assignments were manageable and always had clear guidelines and directions.

Prof Wigton is an inspiring and hilarious teacher. He cares about all students and is very knowledgeable on the subject. I would be thrilled to be in his class again. He is fair with grades, but you have to put the work in.

Professor Wigton is a great teacher and makes it easy to participate and learn during his class. He knows a lot and gives a lot of good tips and tricks to make ads more creative. However, hes not great at responding to emails and isnt really accessible outside of class even though he says he is. He also doesnt explain directions very well.

Wigton is a really good professor. I had him for 301 too, and he was a really good prof for that, so I was excited to have him again. He genuinely cares about his students, and is understanding with deadlines as long as you are actually trying in class. He also gives lots of great feedback and is a fairly easy grader.
Wigton was phenomenal. He's a funny guy, and class is always conversational. Plus, I learned so much and ended the class with a portfolio-ready example of a real world campaign. 10/10 recommend

In his online 301 class, he basically takes the syllabus and everything from normal classes, and makes it an online class. In a normal class, all these big assignments would be groups projects, but online there all up to just you, so the workload is crazy. Make sure your on top of things, because you basically make your own due dates every 2 weeks.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Wigton is the BEST professor at Greenlee. Real life experiences lead to great teaching! He is so personable and easy to talk to about anything. Easy grader as long as you know what you're doing and prepared to answer any question he has. He is seriously the best!

He's awesome. He's funny and down to earth. Helps. He is also personable. 335 textbook is kind of hard. You actually use it and he doesn't teach the text book until after you do the work however there is so many point opportunities that you'll be fine if you do bad on quizes. I am definitely taking him again for class

The new social media class is not as helpful as I would have liked, as I would want to focus more on strategy. Becoming Hootsuite certified is a great part of the class, but the overall material covered seems to be repetitive at times. Professor Wigton does a great job of making class fun and engaging.
Nice guy and has humor. If you do the work on time and follow the directions, you'll do just fine. Study for quizzes and make sure to do the readings, some questions do come from the readings.

Wigton teaches you everything clearly and will make you a better writer. He is clear with what he wants and makes the class fun. There is not going to be an easy JLMC 201 so take it with Wigton because he makes the class worth going. You will learn to be a better writer and if you work hard you can make the A. Do whatever you can to take his class.
Great teacher. Really engages with students. We had a 'client' who we did reasearch for the entire semester.  It was mostly group work.
Great teacher take him if you can, class is entirely group work.

I felt like I learned basically nothing. Half the class skipped each day, so that should tell you something. Boring lectures, terrible online quizzes, and a lousy project at the end. Seemed like a nice guy though.

Wigton is a great guy. His class was fairly easy; we worked on a huge project all semester and had smaller projects scattered throughout but you never felt unsure of what was going on or how much you needed to get done. He was always crystal clear, very kind, super helpful, and interested in helping me beyond the classroom. I recommend him!
CS 513 was a course which provided hands on experience about program analysis, debugging and use of AI tools. Professor Le was helpful and caring.
Good course to learn program analysis.

Overall the class wasn't hard, assignments were ok and sometimes fun if you're into that stuff. However, exams were 50% weight and only 2 were given. The questions required detailed answers but the time was extremely limited so you had to immediately have a good answer or just throw something out and move on. That alone ruined the whole experience.

She designed the course in a way to cover all the important topics in program analysis. The assignments, though tough, will help you to learn a lot about the relevant topics. She is very understanding, caring, and will appreciate if you explain to her the challenges you faced for your late submission.
Didn't like the class but I liked her as a professor. Doesn't have much of an accent.

Guys run. He has no clue how to work tests. He says you do not have to come to class, but later says that your attendance matters and will drop your grade. He doesn't understand English very well and is insanely quiet. He will give you 2 days to complete the homework with 73 questions and the 23 question quiz. Not good.
quite literally the worst professor or teacher I have had in my entire life
The average exam score is a 45%, and he doesn't care.

He really struggles to use technology. He also skips over chapters, then tests on them. The tests are nothing like any of the review material provided or the homework. This was the most frustrating econ class I've taken. Lectures were very hard to follow; the use of classroom technology often slowed things down rather than helped. There's homework just about every day and difficult exams. The homework is pretty easy and the majority of your grade. However, just completing the homework will not help for passing the exams. If you do all the homework and fail all the exams, you will pass with a grade close to a C or B.

Foreign language is required for some and this Spanish is an accelerated online course so you don't have to take two semesters worth of Spanish. There is a lot of homework which is doable, it is just time consuming. It is not going to be the easiest because you are learning a different language online but it is doable. You only need a D- to pass.

Very confusing professor and course outline. Unfortunately she is only Spanish teacher available for this course. Iowa State needs to consider getting her removed or changing outline of entire course and test questions

This semester I had the unfortunate experience of taking this course with Professor Wilhelm. She does not foster an appropriate learning environment for this course. I knew going in that this class was going to be fast-paced. I have taken fast-paced courses like this one and had no problems.

SPAN 97 is a Spanish review semester that's pass/fail for zero credits (hence why I have a D, didn't study for the final and didn't do the last project because it wouldn't matter). This is the worst college Spanish teacher I have ever had. She doesn't speak proper Spanish and makes errors on the exams, which is confusing. She can't spell words right or pronounce right. She also doesn't get back to you on emails and is rude when you try to ask for clarification.

I come from a Spanish speaking background. Her pronunciation is horrible. She speaks improper Spanish. She switches from Argentinian Spanish to Peru Spanish. She is very unorganized. Julie is a good prof, during class she'll always have you discuss in small groups which is fine. She's just a really tough grader, it's hard to get a 100% on projects. Not an easy class, but one that isn't hard to pass. Graded on six exams, projects, homework, and participation. Pop quizzes are given out at least once a week as well. Go to class! She is such a great professor, and the examples she gives during class and the exercises we did help a boatload.

reviews.comment: I didn't really like what we learned because the textbook was a pain but Julie is chill and tells you what's on the tests. She is also not a super harsh grader, and wants everyone to understand what's going on. I would definitely take her again.

she does not explain things or teach things at all, she expects you to know everything about the Spanish language ever, very hard grader, and I wish I would've taken a more educational class. really don't know how she's a prof.

I believe she's normally a pretty great person but this class was an exception. As a new class she never had any idea about what was going on or how to teach us best. reviews.comment: She is the cutest woman and she cares about you a lot and she's super chill! Love her!!

The way this class was structured- now I indirectly loathe the language. Going to class does not benefit any student: she addresses you as "chicos": so to her, you are children... easy to pass. pay attention early on

Professor Wilhelm is great! I had her as my first college professor and I absolutely loved her. She is easy to work with and clearly explains what will be on the exams. Her classes are interactive/filled with activities. You have a lot of partner work and online homework!
great teacher

Julie is an awesome professor for this class. Very casual environment while still helping you succeed in the class as long as you do the small amount of work. It's a great refresher class if you haven't had Spanish since high school and Julie helps you learn it enough in class where it won't take up very much of your study time.
She's great! Very supportive and helpful, really makes sure you understand the material! Good for you if you want to pursue a minor or just brush up on your Spanish
She doesn't usually teach 200 level classes, but she is so awesome, I'm sure, for whatever class you're taking.  Not intimidating at all to ask questions and seek help.

The class wasn't too bad, if you put the work in it's easy. Most people in my class did not put much time in per week, and blamed the teacher when they didn't understand. The textbook was bad, it was written by a department head and contained many errors.

Julie is a sub par teacher. She knows her stuff very well but is somewhat rude to students and seems stuck up. She has a cell phone policy yet she uses her cell phone in class. I personally did not have an issue with her. Class is cake.
Great teacher! She's the easiest Spanish teacher to listen to. Very helpful and understanding. Attendance is mandatory. Do the homework and readings and you'll be fine.

Hated this class and especially hated her! Impossible to work with! After emailing her several times about assignments, questions, problems etc she never replied! When I asked her why i hadnt heard from her she said she had over 100 students and how did I expect her to answer my emails?! Complete B*TCH!!

Decent overall. Like all language classes, there is a ton of boring busy work.  High school 2.0.  She continually berates the class for being lazy, but mostly I agreed with her. Tons of online assignments which I found annoying and difficult to navigate.  Serious MILF, which makes attendance a bit easier.

She is up front in her class, she lets you know what you need to do.  Her lecture sucks though, she goes so fast you cant copy notes and she doesn't teach, she sits at her computer while she makes you work in groups.  There is a lot of homework, but its easy.
Very high quality teacher all the way around
class was a bit of work, but julie was a great prof.
Very good teacher-Awesome at what she does. Book is expensive: Look out. Demands a lot, calls on you openly in class. It's tough if you don't LOVE spanish.

Amazing teacher. She takes time to actually explain the topic. She also gives you tips on what to avoid doing and what problems a lot of people have, which is actually really helpful. She also gives you an awesome idea of what to study for quizes and tests. Show up and do assignments and it's an easy A/B if you just don't try that hard :)

She is awesome! This class is somewhat a lot of work, but it is pass/fail, so an 68% and up is a pass. She lets us know exactly what to study for the quizzes and tests, which helps so much. I really like her, she has a great attitude and is always willing to help.

Her class is easy but there's alot of homework and projects due for the course.Her teaching style is decent and she focuses alot on group activities.She'll work you hard but her grading won't always reflect that due to some trivial things she'll take points off such as tardies.I would take more classes in the future but not with her.

This professor is AMAZING is the reason why i love espanol so much! She will work you hard, but in the end you will know a lot. She will see the work in the end and later give you the right grade. I love this professor, I wish I could take every Spanish class with her. She truly cares about teaching. Good luck!
She speaks in Spanish so much that people like me who haven't had spanish since the stone ages of high school will not understand her at all.  She assigns a ton of homework.
Large language barrier. As of spring 2026, the exams are no longer open note.

Funny person and fun lectures. 

70% of your grade is based on exams. This would be ok, but the grading scale in canvas is completely wrong for the whole semester. The syllabus is worded in such a way that you can be led to believe that homework is worth 15 points each but is actually only 15% of the overall grade.

Calc your grade yourself plz

Nice person, funny lectures. Not super helpful lectures though. Tends to skip around a lot. If you don't have a solid foundation, it is tough. Open note quizzes and tests with 7-day notice (not in syllabus). His TAs are pretty helpful. Grades kind of tough. 70% is exams. All in class. Expect to do a lot of learning on your own. A lot of homework.

Dr. Wang is a great professor. His classes are enjoyable, he's very helpful when you have questions, and he leaves out some of the less important concepts which makes the semester more manageable. Plus, no imperial units. More homework than some of the other classes, but manageable especially if you go to his or a TA's office hours for help.

This is the worst teacher ever. He spends all of class talking about his random views, not thermo. He shames students who walk in late or don't come to class. His lecture is entirely different from other professors, so you can't get help from others. You don't have enough time to finish the tests/quizzes, and the lectures are useless.

Dr. Wang was one of my favorite professors. He is funny, and he taught "philosophy". His thermo I class is open book, open notes for exams which made it easier. However you still have to understand the content to get through the class.
OPEN NOTE EXAMS. His lectures are ok, but he can ramble a bit. He does generally have good examples though. I did well on exams even if I never fully understood applications of the material.

I like Dr. Wang as a person, but I found him to be an ineffective teacher. His lectures felt like rambles, and following what he does in class is rather tricky. I am glad the exams are open note, but even then sometimes I feel lost with the questions. I would often leave lecture more confused than when I went in.
Wang is a solid professor overall. His exams and quizzes can be hard, but reasonable. He will post his lecture notes online including example problems; use his notes when taking them exams!
Nice and funny Professor. Open note tests and quizzes. It helps you learn the content for future classes. Grades based on hw and tests only.

Very nice person, helpful, and don't be afraid to ask questions. Homework every week and is due before class, quizzes are given every once and a while. He grades kinda hard on the quizzes cause they are only worth 3 points. But they are open note and book. The tests are just open note.

His accent can be a little thick at times, but he makes solid effort to be understood by students.  Cracks jokes and shares philosophy to keep his lectures interesting and engaging.  Grading was fairly lenient and quizzes and exams were open note.
Great Instructor! exams are heavy but are open notes. If you show up and take notes you will pass.

He was really easy as long as you could read the tables in the textbook. Homework and test were easy. Had a heavy accent so hard to understand him sometimes. He is also half deaf so if you have a question you have to scream it pretty much. Nice professor overall and easy class.

reviews.comment: Yes he has an accent and while sometimes you might not understand a word you can just raise your hand and ask. If you do your homework and pay attention to his examples in class you will be able to do well on the tests and quizzes. He is always more than happy to answer questions, and creates a relaxed environment.

Dr. Wang is a very nice guy and is pretty funny. In lecture he will explain the concepts and do an example or two. Overall a good guy, but not for everyone.
Avoid this guy at all costs. Terrible at teaching concepts and has very thick accent. Your open notes are your only help come exam time.

The average in another professor's class for the first exam was 77%. He doesn't grade homework which is nice, but his examples in class are often difficult to follow and he gives you no extra prep materials for exams.

Dont get me wrong, this professor is hilarious. BUT if you dont learn the table you are absolutley going to have a hard time. While his accent makes it difficult to understand him at times, he makes it clear what will be on the tests. There is homework that is graded on completion and as long as you know the general procedure to complete a problem on the test, he will give more than a fair share of points/credit for the problem. Overall, a pretty easy class!

He was very difficult to understand. The lectures seemed to jump around a lot and lacked any significant flow. The examples done during lecture were not easy to follow and were not all that helpful. This being said, the exams turned out to be quite easy because they are open notes. If you can understand the homework, the exams should be fairly easy

One of the best professors I've had. Lectures are useful and surprisingly engaging. He's a funny guy and really wants to make sure all of the students are understanding the concepts in class. His accent is a little thick but he'll happily clarify anything if you ask.

Dr. Wang was a very good Thermo II professor. The homework is graded on completion and isn't too difficult. Test can be tough or pretty straightforward. His analogies of thermodynamics to real life example are absolutely hilarious and motivated me to come to class the hear them. His accent can make things difficult to understand sometimes.

Super nice guy and is pretty funny.  Homework isn't too hard and it is graded on completion.  Knows his students and will joke with them.  Learned a lot in his class.  Tests weren't too hard.  If you did and understood the homework they were easy.

If you show up to class and put any amount of effort in, it is pretty easy to get an A and come away from the class having learned something. All his tests are open-note, and all of his exam questions are the same as sample questions done in class, just with different numbers or a slight twist.

Uggggghh. I had Hagge for Thermo I and learned way more than I anticipated, loved the class, and got an A. Wang just goes through every single page of the book, gives you 6+ hours of homework a week, and is harsh at grading. Not only was it hard to keep up and retain everything, but his brutal tests were hardly curved. Avoid him like the plague.
Really nice guy, wants to see his students do well.  Gives extra credit for showing up in class sometimes.  Very hard to understand, no assignments due, difficult tests.
Though his classes are not easy, they are designed to challenge us.  What ever time the student is willing to put, Wang will match it to see a student succeed.
Can tell hes been around the bioinformatics scene for years, motivates theory very well.

The first half of the course is taught by Dr.Chen, and I learned a lot. We use Galaxy to learn bioinformatics, and she gives optional tutorials to learn more.

However, the 2nd half of class I didn't learn anything. Everything Dr. Gu taught I already knew from AP bio, bio 211 and 212, and evolution. We did not do any actual bioinformatics.

He uses no technology for a class that is supposed to intro a very technology-heavy degree, and the effort he puts in is laughable.  Additionally, he does make some ableist comments, which is always fun to deal with as someone who is disabled. Class is technically an easy A, but is frustratingly pointless if you need it for a major.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hes the GOAT what else to say. Hes a very humane teacher and cares about finding a way for his students to succeed. yea he doesn't use power points and he really doesn't need to. His philosophy is to make sure that you understand the fundamentals and he doesn't like to trick students with questions. overall very nice person and a good teacher

His PowerPoints are a fever dream. The fonts and colors give me a headache. I got more out of that class when I was sick and stayed home than when I actually attended class. His accent was so thick I couldn't understand him. He didn't want to be there and neither did his students. He took forever to submit final grades as well.

He only lectures at the bored and the homework is not very similar to the exams. Make sure to abuse the mock exams he gives, as those help the most. One of out midterms had an average of 33/90 with the highest score being a 45/90. The class is curved very heavily at the end of the semester.

Dr. Song was a very good professor. I was weary of this class seeing his rating but as long as you do all the homework, go to office hours, and write down what he writes on the board you'll be okay. This semester had a 20% curve, and I did 2.5% worth of homework and got a -B. ABUSE THE CHEAT SHEET AND TALK TO HIM ABOUT POST-EXAM FOR POINTS!

He's the worst professor I've ever had. He doesn't use canvas at all and doesn't give enough materials to study for the exam. Also, all of the lectures are on the whiteboard with bad handwriting, so it's hard to take notes. His exam is extremely hard to prepare for since it's NOTHING similar to HW or in-class problems. Please avoid him if possible.

I honestly enjoyed Song this past fall semester. If you show up to class and actually try you will be fine. HW and exams are tough but not impossible. Class was curved at the end but I wouldn't bank on one. USE the office hours that Song and his TA have available. If you skip out on these office hours you will not do good in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He does not like or understand technology. He has bad handwriting but insists on not using slides. No one knew their real grade until after the semester because he didn't make the canvas grades weighted the same as they are in the syllabus, and everything had to be submitted in person. Try to avoid having him; otherwise, find a group to work with.

He was assigned to this class at the last minute, and it shows. He is not good at simplifying the content for beginners; he taught this introductory class like a review. Calc 3, Diff Eq, and Linear Algebra are not prerequisites for the class, yet he seemed exasperated when explaining what a partial derivative was or how to square a sum.

Dr. Song is the worst professor I have ever had at Iowa State.  The average on homework is less than 50%, and the exams are even worse.  He writes way too small on the board, and his handwriting is bad too.  He skips steps while showing examples on the board and then expects us to know these steps on the exam. AVOID AT ALL COST.

This professor is all about exams and his lectures are copied and pasted from the textbook with very bad explanations. He does not go over examples. He allows the student to make their own cheat sheet but it barely helps. Homework isn't gone over and sometimes is given back to the students after taking the exam. Also random attendance checks.

This is one of the worst professors I've ever had. You attend class every other day for a full hour of him talking to the board and writing stuff down, without any room for questions or checking in on how everyone's doing. His TA's do the grading, and there is no official rubric, so the class averages between the two sections had a 40% difference.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His philosophy is that you shouldn't be given many problems so that you don't memorize them. In theory makes sense. What it equates to is having no clue how to apply the material. Worst professor I've ever had. Thermo is hard. he made it impossible. He basically teaches from the textbook so make sure you read it.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: In all of my years here at Iowa State, I have never come across a professor as difficult as this one. The exams have averages of around 30%, and no one seems to have any idea what is going in the class ever. A C- is a 50%, and there is still immense difficulty in reaching that percentage. Whatever you do, if you can, avoid taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is a hard class by itself, but this professor made it so much more difficult. His lectures are incredibly confusing but somehow still mind-numbingly boring. He goes over material quickly and in a very math-heavy manner. He gives very few practice problems. Very difficult grading and test averages are always low. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR

If I was on my death bed, my last words would be do NOT take Dr. Song. He took a generally simple class, thermo, and made it absolutely impossible. His lectures were very confusing, and his tests were extremely difficult. His grader does not know what partial credit is, so exam averages would be in the 20's- 30's. Seriously do not take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Some of the reviews here complain about his accent but its not too hard to understand, the problem with his class is he does not do any examples, so you learn hard concepts and then are expected to know how to apply them. Other professors average on their exams is usually around a B, ours was consistently at or below 50% with a VERY small curve.

shockingly unstructured lectures that over emphasize derivations while he doesnt go over how to apply the equations. which means the homework and exams are absolutely brutal. Also there is no curve no matter how bad the average is, even with an gpa wrecking class average of a C-.

Most of the bad reviews he gets are because the classes he teaches are super hard, but he's a pretty good professor. His accent isn't bad and his lectures cover everything on the exams thoroughly. The class itself sucks though, and while I think Petrich is better he is still a very solid professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Homework is ridiculous. The hardest professor to understand ON CAMPUS
Literally the worst. Homework was ridiculous, exams more so

He explains all concepts clearly and in a manner that is easily understood. He is very helpful during office hours. Homework and exams are somewhat difficult but straightforward is you listen during lectures and study the material.
He is the worst professor I have had at Iowa State University.
This professor sucks.
He tries but doesn't teach well. Also he is not lenient in terms of grading.

Undoubtedly the best professor I could have had for a theoretical CS course. The material is challenging by nature, but Professor Huang consistently makes it approachable for students. He is very supportive outside of class and takes the time to help students understand the material. Also provides extensive exam reviews, which are of great help.

Homeworks were based on lectures. He provided extensions for difficult homework. Exams were not very tough and were based on lecture notes and homework. The lectures were clear, and he tried his best to answer students' questions.

Already a hard class, but can be interesting. Except his Lectures are literally him reading the slides verbatim. I relied solely on the SI and the TAs to learn the material, gives projects that are more to do with his research than anything and it is about stuff we have not gone over in class. Had to also start attending other professor's lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Huang is a brilliant researcher and a caring teacher.  That said, COMS311 is definitely not an easy course!

Professor Huang is the single worst professor I've had at any level in my academic career. His lectures consist of him wall-of-text slides (which he posts anyways) with his back turned to you in the most monotone voice ever. When you ask a question, his inadequate level of English makes him struggle to give a sensible answer. Terrible.

At no point did he have any idea how lost and confused the entire class was until the entire class was rocking F's and the Computer Science department held an intervention regarding how to get our class back on track out of fear that an entire semester's worth of CompSci students would fail a core class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures were heavy, but professor Huang is really caring about his students. If you have a specific question he can answer you with clarity. Moreover, Huang went to great lengths to make accommodations for me when I was out of town for a funeral. Lovely professor, difficult coursework.

You simply cannot understand anything he says during lecture. He is hard to communicate with via email, or more so face-to-face. His lectures started with over 100 students and ended with less than 5. The other professor's lecture became so crowded, students were standing all around the aisles.
The class is very poorly taught and unnecessarily strict.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nearly impossible to learn anything from his lectures. Hard to understand, poorly organized slides, and talked more about his research than the actual class content.
If you take 311 with him do yourself a favor and attend another section. ANY other section. He's impossible to understand and only talks about his research.

Easily the worst professor I've ever had. Despite being in Iowa for 15+ years, he has a horrible accent and doesn't speak English very well. I bothered to go to class near the end of the semester and around 5% of the class was there. The class wasn't very hard - not much new material and a project every 3 weeks. Bad with questions as well
He knows what he is talking about, and the notes are good... but he is very hard to understand. The class is not all that hard, just look at example code - the assignments are very close to that.

The class overall wasn't hard. What made it hard for me was the fact that I never showed up. Definitely added a lot of time to do my homework since i didn't know what I was doing. Tests were easy. Final was semi difficult. Teacher is a nice guy but hard to understand and boring to go to class. I learned more by myself.

He has a very thick accent which makes understanding him nearly impossible. He also reads almost directly from his lecture notes/code. The lectures are not worth attending as you won't get anything that you wouldn't learn from reading his notes. However, the recitations are usually pretty good.

Professor Huang is a good professor but not many people who started out attending this class at the beginning of the semester are still attending halfway through the semester because of his thick accent. Many of the things taught in lecture are reviewed by the TAs in your weekly recitation period and all the lecture notes and code are online.

Lectures were hard to pay attention because of his this accent. The homework, although very difficult, really helped me learn the material. The tests were a lot more difficult than expected.  The class overall wasn't terrible, but if you have the option to take it with a different professor I would

The good: This professor is a really nice guy and if you have questions he is available and willing to help out. He gives pseudocode  The Bad: He is super difficult to understand, his lectures are pointless and a waste of time,  his assignments are terribly confusing, pseudocode is hard to decipher.  This is his first time teaching this class

Amazing, just amazing. COM S 229 in his hand is just much easier, but you still need to work hard. Pseudo-codes and templates will be given for projects; practice exams will be given a week in advance. The similarity between practice exam and actual exam is at least 80%. If you have questions, forget about useless TAs and just go for him.
Greatest professor in the world!

Absolutely boring and confusing lectures. His oral skill is the worst I've ever seen in this university for 3 years. Somehow he just rushes his lecture notes in a very slow way and doesn't really explain the meaning of his code or the purpose why he write in this way. You HAVE TO learn yourself, spend at least 10 hours a week to read books.

Each module takes so much time it's insane. Nothing is original work it's mainly mcgraw which means homework and exams focus on small details you need to remember from the textbook. Just very draining as each hw contains minimum 70 concepts and takes 1-3 hours. Just makes me feel numb after
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class itself is terrible. I had more homework than in any of my other classes. Each assignment takes over 2 hours to complete, it's ridiculous. The discussion posts also take a long time to complete, having to write over 500 words with multiple sources, but they are only worth 10 points. I also tried to email him once and never got an answer.

Professor Warren is an amazing professor! We used McGraw Hill, and the homework did take a while, but he is really nice and fun. The discussion posts can be a lot, but there is extra credit opportunities with Sona credits. If you put in the work and effort, you will get an A or B. I highly recommend a class with him!

I wish Mr. Phillips would upload powerpoints instead of 50 minute video lectures. That's about all I have to say about him. This course is very easy, but it's a lot of work. Long discussion posts, 6 exams, and 80 concept homeworks (multiple questions per concept). If you have a lot of credits like me, wouldn't recommend Psych 2300.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The amount of work I had to do was stupid. At least 1 homework assignment a week as well as discussion posts, exams, and required research. This class requiring at minimum 5 hours of participation in research studies when I'm not going into a research field is just stupid. 0/10 don't do this to yourself if its not required for your major.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: dr. phillips is a great professor! he is very passionate about the material. the only complaint i have for the class is that the tests and homework are completely run through mcgraw hill, making going to lecture almost useless. for example, one of the final class periods was spent discussing child abuse and nothing about that topic was on the exam!

The only thing that I can complain about with this professor is that you can only talk to him before or after class and I had issues with the admin email provided but once I explained this to him he was amazing and accommodated me immediately. The lectures are fun and engaging while also elaborating on what the textbook says.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice professor and taught material well! I enjoyed attending his lectures and he often made them interesting. Lecture quizzes if you attend and lecture slides are posted on canvas! No complaints here.

Warren is a nice professor who is definitely passionate about psychology. His class is always a lecture and they tend to be a little bit dry as he reads off the slides posted on canvas. Be aware that attendance isn't mandatory but there is lecture quizzes frequently. He is willing to answer questions and communicate!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Phillips keeps the class engaging despite the dry textbook content. The homework is extensive but manageable. Attendance is mandatory, but the recorded lectures are helpful. I found Unstuckstudy great for exam prep alongside the class materials.

His lectures can get boring because he will go on long tangents about certain topics. The homework assignments are long and require lots of reading but aren't necessarily hard. He's a genuine guy and likes to get participation from the class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Warren is a funny, caring professor. All of the 6 exams are online (not in class), and are very easy. There are 10 research credits, but also plenty of extra credit. There's a lot of homework, but they are not hard (McGraw Hill). If you pay attention in class (and complete the lecture quizzes that you get the passwords to in class), you'll be good!

So much McGraw Hill Smart Book homework but it is kind of helpful. There are lecture quizzes and he gives out the password for them in class but they're only usually worth 2 points. Lectures are recorded and posted on canvas, but you can't get the lecture quiz password from the recorded lectures.
I loved this class. It was very interesting, and he always made the lectures fun! The homework took a little bit of time, but they were easy and helpful to review for the tests!

A very knowledgeable and respectful kind of guy. Was very understanding if things came up. Every piece of work was done online and is very manageable, it just takes a decent bit of time to do. Tests were also online. As long as you take notes, life will be just fine in this course
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Warren responded to emails well and showed he cared for his students. He assigns smartbooks for homework, and his tests are also online. He understood when my first exam wasn't working and gave me an extension. There are research credits required, and only half can be earned online. Overall, he was a great professor and kept it interesting.

He is very knowledgeable about what he is talking about and applies case studies as well. Adds a few jokes in there as well. It's definitely a very interesting class and important if you want to work with kids in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The homework questions are connected to a free online textbook. It is graded on completion. The exams are online and due the same Friday as the homework. It uses the honor system and you have 24 hours to start after it opens, and 1 hour to complete after your start. SONA tests are required as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Warren is probably one of my best professors since being at Iowa State. I took psych230 online; it was the easiest psych class I've ever taken. I don't like psych, so his layout and class are very convenient. He was super nice and understanding when I had issues taking an exam, and with a quick email, he showed his understanding of my situation.
Tons of reading that you must do if you want to do well on the tests. Giant lecture hall, hard to stay awake. He just talks the entire time.

Prof Phillips' lectures aren't mandatory (you can pass without going), but they were usually pretty interesting and I liked going to them. 6 modules (2-4 homeworks and 1 exam each, both online) with the opportunity for extra credit. It's definitely possible to get an A with a little bit of effort. Overall great professor and interesting class.

Stopped attending lecture after second week because test questions are only drawn from the textbook. In my opinion, his lectures do not add anything meaningful and as this was my first psych class I am very disappointed. The test questions can be tricky but as long as you read the textbook you'll be fine. I would take online if you could.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very helpful and gives out extra credit

I had the class online so I don't know how the actual teacher was. Lots of the test questions are from the book, but you have no idea what the questions will be so it's pointless to read the book. You have to buy the book because there is homework in it. There is easy extra credit available that raised my grade from an A- to an A.

This class is super easy. Phillips does a great job of explaining everything, but in all honesty, with tests being online you don't need a whole lot of effort for this class. The tests are on the same textbook site as the homework, so you can definitely just not go to class and read the chapters at home. Homework can be a little long, but not hard.

This class was really difficult for me because I would read the material, I would do all of the homework, and I would watch the lectures as well, but I could never get a good score on the tests. I tried studying as much as I could, but it became really difficult and extremely stressful for me, especially in the last weeks of the semester.

Made an effort to get to know his students and challenge their ideas and understanding during office hours. Class is VERY tough, lots of reading and requires discipline. The exams themselves are alright, but if you don't put in the work and time, you won't do well.
Yes, I have a C, but that's simply because I'm not smart. However, this teacher is great! The online lectures were a lifesaver in terms of learning how much material is in this class.

Class isn't too bad, Homework is 100 questions that take a long time to complete. But the homework does help prepare you for the exam. Could definitely have shorter tests and homework assignments and still be beneficial.

This class is INSANE in the amount of reading material you have to do. You have quizzes over the each chapter that are over 100 questions.. but you do get 100% for completing it even if you do bad so thats nice. Still annoying though. Exams every two weeks, theyre proctored. That sucks. This class is just so hard for no reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super nice, makes the topics interesting. As long as you do the reading and show up to lectures you should be able to get an A.

There was a lot of content to work with. There were lectures and required textbook homework but I only focused on the book and I did okay. Tests were long and pretty difficult and make you think. Make sure to take notes and actually read the chapters because it will help you in long run! Professor always available for help!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's a genuinely good guy with the intention of having you understand the material. The online textbook and the associated homework helps A LOT for studying for tests, so take notes when taking the homework quizzes. He's really passionate about the material and gives meaningful lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really great teacher, knows his stuff, does his best to make lectures interesting, answers any question you have. Definitely one of the better professors Ive had here.

Lectures can be kind of boring, but Phillips clearly knows his stuff. Sometimes the information presented in class doesn't match what the book says which makes studying for tests harder. DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. The extra credit moved my grade up over 10% at the end of the year and made the last exam much less stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a good guy and explains material very well. The readings are long and slides are vague so sometimes it is hard to find what you need to know for the exam, but it was a good class and he is a good professor. SONA extra credit is also super nice. Easy to pass if you do the homework and the extra credit

Professor Phillips is a really great professor and he really knows what he's talking about! The classes aren't mandatory and he puts all the lectures on canvas, but the classes are really helpful to get extra information and explanations as the slides can be a little vague. Its not hard to pass this class if you do all the homework and pass exams.

Professor Phillips is at MOST an average teacher and person. I don't recommend taking this class with him. If you sign up for this class you will regret it the whole semester and the rest of you're life.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class is pretty an easy A if you do the extra credit and at least pass the three exams. If you do all the extra credit and the homework (which is graded as a completion grade), then you'll easily pass this class. Lectures are pretty interesting but is not required to attend.

He's a really nice guy with great life examples, and the lectures are pretty interesting. They're not as organized as I like, and the book readings are so long and I sometimes don't even know what the most important material is, but the homework is pretty much just do it and you'll get a good grade on it.
Great Professor and is very clear on material. I suggest this class for everyone. Fun class!

Easy way to succeed in this class if you put in the effort, of you get 30/70 on all 3 exams youll still pass the class if you do all the extra credit from sona. Lectures are worth your time and interesting, however theyre all on canvas, the homework is done through project connect (the textbook) so make sure you buy it!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Tech didnt work one day, he totally nailed the lecture without it! He knows his stuff.

Warren made developmental psych easy and entertaining to learn. Attending lecture is not mandatory, but you gain extra insight as well as real life examples of a topic if you attend. There is extra credit as well as online homework using an online textbook that helps you study! HW is worth the time. Would 10/10 take this course again.

This class is pretty easy. Just do the homework assignments and study guide and you will be fine on tests. Phillips is a nice guy with easy to follow lectures, but you don't necessarily need to actually go to class and you will be fine.

Amazing professor, easily my favorite of my first semester! Very respectful of students and happy to answer questions.  Explains things very clearly during lecture with real-life examples. Only three exams that werent incredibly difficult, although you will want to study the reading material from homework assignments as well as lecture notes.

He made his lectures really interesting. He uses tophat to ask questions, but he doesn't use it for every single class so whether or not your attendance is recorded just depends. The homework was pretty easy, but you do have to do a fair amount of reading.

I had developmental psychology with Warren. I can definitely say that this class was tough and required a lot of work, but you learn a lot. Warren is a great professor who you can tell genuinely cares about his students and even more about teaching psychology. If you study from the slideshows and do the reading, you should be fine. Warren is great!

Good professor but reads from slides so it's quite hard to dedicate your attention to especially since it's a 9 am. Tests are very easy if you read the textbook, homework is textbook based questions that reappear on the tests--offers ALOT of extra credit, attendance is graded to 25 points so you don't always have to show up to pass.
If you do homework (super easy), complete all extra credit, and maintain a D average on exams, you will do great.

Fine lecturer, not boring, even for 8am. Answers any questions without being condescending. All material is posted online, so class isn't mandatory. I would suggest reading the textbook, but not taking notes on it. The textbook is required to do homework worth 1/3 of the points of your grade. Psychology trials required & offered for extra credit.

Phillips is a great professor and he really knows what he's talking about. He cares about his students and is almost always available to email or meet with. You have to do research studies and there's a homework assignment once a week, but all deadlines are pretty loose. Read the book and pay attention in lecture or tests will be difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: So there is a VERY LARGE amount of extra credit that you can do, and if you do all of it, you just need to maintain a D average on the exams and finish all of your homework to get an A. Lectures are boring and he gives you no kind of study guide or list of concepts for exams.

He has a very soothing voice for a morning class and can easily get distracted but he's EXCELLENT to work with. Fixed my wrongly graded homework 3 times. Gives lots of extra credit opportunities. Easy to do homework during class

I wish his lectures weren't at 8 am and that his voice wasn't so monotone. I went to the first 2 weeks of class only to fall asleep in each one and to look around and see that many other students had also fallen asleep. You need the access code because there is weekly online homework and it is super benefical to read the chapters before the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Phillips is a great lecturer and is passionate about his area. You don't really need to go to his lectures since they are all on his blackboard but it helps to go. His tests are kind of hard since they are so broad and the study guide isn't much help, I always got around 42-46/70 on all three exams but I still ended with a decent grade.

I loved having Dr. Phillips! Lectures were great and the people that didn't do well on the tests obviously didn't study that hard because he pulls his test questions directly from the practice exams he posts. Do the extra credit, fill out the study guides, and this class will be easy! I only needed a 40% on the final to get an A because of the EC!

I took this class online and it was one of the easiest classes that I have taken. You are graded based on homework for each chapter (completion grade), 6 discussion posts (completion grade), 6 exams (which are taken at home), and research credit. You can receive extra credit by doing more than the required amount of research credit.

In my opinion, this professor does not cover a lot of the material that he will put on the test. He does not give you a good idea of what will be on the tests (textbook/lecture wise). He drags on about certain topics that are rarely emphasized on the exams, so much so that he skips a lot of important material. The study guides are semi-useful.
Did not attend lecture, simply looked at study guides before exams and did well. No homework, just research credit that allows for lots of extra credit. Easy class.

Lectures are a waste of time, the sooner you realize that, the better. The test questions are all from the book (which I would highly recommend you read). On the exams I got an A-, B, and B- and ended up only missing a couple of points in the class thanks to the extra credit. Do all 20 credits research credits, it relives so much stress.

If you ever have to take a Psychology class I would really recommend Warren. His class was very easy but I also learned a lot from it. All of his lectures are online and you do have to study for his tests but they're fairly easy. Be sure to do the extra credit, I ended up with an A in his class thanks to the EC.

I loved Dr. Phillips. His lectures made waking up for my 8 AM class so easy. However if you don't want to go the recorded lectures are online. If you pay attention and read the book/do the assignments before the exam you'll do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Phillips is clearly knowledgeable in the course material and his lectures are really interesting. Extra credit is a must in this class, assignments are really easy. I never used the physical copy of the textbook, but the online code is necessary. All lectures are online too so it's nice if you miss class

DO THE EXTRA CREDIT I DON'T CARE HOW MUCH YOU DON'T WANT TO BUT IT MADE MY B AN A. I never attended the lectures, but I put a lot of effort into the (online) homework. Didn't use the textbook until the week before the final and it definitely came in handy - I wish I would have used it all semester.

He really knows and is passionate about the topics that he is teaching and if you take the time to study you will do fine. The research credits are easy to attain and aside from that you only have a few online assignments to prepare you for the exams. Excellent teacher
Just do the extra credit, and take the practice exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I went to one lecture. He told the class that all his lectures are recorded online and attendance is not needed. Everything you could possibly need is online. You physically cannot  get anything other than 100 percent  on your homework. Everything is due at the end of the semester RECOMMENDED due dates are provided

Dr. Phillips is a great lecturer, just a little boring at times. He explains everything well in class if you can stay awake. The readings and homework are long, and at times seem unimportant, but make sure you know the material covered. Definitely TAKE THE TIME TO DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. It will save you. The tests are hard - especially the final.

I'm a psych major so I really enjoyed this class. But Phillips is a really good professor. His class is easy as long as you do the readings and the homework -- he gives you till the end of the semester to get all of the homework assignments done. Easy A
I thought he was a pretty good professor, my only problem was how soft he spoke and almost made me fall asleep each time I went to lecture, the class itself isn't hard at all.
Class was easy. Only went to the first lecture, and did the homework. Got an A in the class. Easiest class ever.

Dr. Phillips is a great professor. He has clear lectures and is easy to understand. If you like psychology this is an interesting class to take and an easy A. If you do the extra credit, you are guaranteed an A essentially. He posts the slides online with himself speaking over it so you get the full lecture aspect if you're sick. Easy assignments
Best lecturer ever, I love your teaching style, very detailed and well-organized XD

Overall, I really enjoyed this class. It is obvious that professor Warren really cares about what he is teaching. The exams are not that difficult, and there is a lot of extra credit given. This has been my favorite class this semester. This class is required for all education majors, however, if you love Psychology,  I would recommend this course!

-Long homework assignments, one a week -Outside SONA research credits mandatory, extra credit if you do extra This class was interesting. He is a good teacher who really knows what he is talking about. He likes to involve the class in lectures. Not a terrible class at all. Attendance is helpful, he has a little info that arent in the books.

Easily my favorite class of the semester and it has everything to do with Dr. Phillips. He really cares about the material and its super obvious that he loves to teach it. The class is easy and fun even if you aren't interested in Psychology. He's one of the professors I know I will miss after the semester ends
Interesting class

I finally gave up on going to class & started watching the lectures online because he moves so slowly through the material you'll be lulled to sleep. If you're new and not the quickest learner it'll be perfect for you, but otherwise it'll be how much are you willing to sit through to get an A. Lots of LearnSmart homework, & research participation.
Speaks very clearly and is easy to understand and learn from. Best teacher I've had here so far.

No need to go to lecture much. Get the "research credits" out of the way. They are easy, you just have to show up to them. Can get SERIOUS EC from this! HW is really, really easy. Do the HW, research credits, all EC (all SUPER easy), and can basically flunk the exams and ace the class. Take this for an easy A.

Class if you need an easy A. Attendance is not mandatory, and you can get by with reading the textbook a couple of days before the test. A lot of extra credit is given through studys, and everything is extremely laid back. Barely worried about this class during the semester.

Great professor!  Dr. Phillips made the class very fun and his lectures were always interactive. He does post the lectures and PowerPoints on Blackboard, but you get a lot more out of being in class. Make sure you read the book because there's a lot of material from there on the tests. Time consuming work, but very easy! Would take this class again

A really nice and soft-spoken guy. The homework is extremely easy but extremely time consuming. It is through an online program that does not let you pass until you have mastered the material but it never deducts points. It's an overall super cool class but dear goodness, THE TESTS ARE HARD! 70 questions of pure memorization!
Super nice guy! If you go to the class and pay attention in lecture, you'll be just fine.

Warren was a friendly professor, he covered the material in depth. Sometimes he spent so much time on a chapter though that we didn't get to the other chapters but were still tested on them. Sometimes that made it difficult to study. Learnsmartsresearch studies were the homework, and he offered a lot of extra credit for extra research studies.

Chapter assignments due before every exam. Very time consuming to finish. Only 3 unit exams, final exam is not cumulative. I went to class maybe 10 times and got a B+ in the class with all C's on my exams. Pretty easy.

I went to class maybe 10 times the whole semester. No final exam, just 3 unit exams. There are multiple online assignments due each night of the corresponding exam. Very easy, but time consuming assignments. Required to do 10 research credits, allowed another 10 as EC that will raise your grade ALOT. I got a B, C, and D on exams & an A in the class

Fairly interesting class but there is a lot of material. Expect to spend time memorizing what happens during specific ages of development. Easy extra credit that can bump your grade up  a lot. Dr. Phillips is very helpful and willing to answer any questions. Exams are average: not too hard, but not super easy either.

This class is simple, just go to class or read the book on your own. Most of what he says in lectures is what is on the test. There are online simulations-LearnSmarts-that help you A LOT and they are homework. They drill the vocabconcepts and it really helped me get a good grade in the class. I put in minimal effort and passed easily. Pretty good

Dr. Phillips is hands down a great guy! Since his voice tends to be monotone and soothing, I do have the urge to fall asleep in lecture to be honest. However, he tends to keep his lectures interesting by telling a lot of stories and explaining concepts well. In order to do decent on exams, reading the textbook is a MUST. You actually have to try.

He's a great instructor! Incredibly helpful and enthusiastic about the subject. You can clearly tell he loves his job. The mandatory readings are a pain, but honestly, if you keep up with them, you are going to destroy the exams. Lectures aren't mandatory, but I recommend going. Love the class!

Class was very easy. It consisted of 3, 70-point non-cumulative multiple choice exams, online homework assignments, and required research participation credits. Ample extra credit was offered. If you're looking for an easy A, this is your class.

Dr Phillips has fairly interesting lectures. He's an extremely nice, helpful, and understanding professor. Extra credit offered. The homework assignments, in my opinion, are ridiculous. But at the very least you do need the code in order to complete online hmwk assignments. Night exams kinda suck, but they're good about working w/ your schedule.

He is very nice, very willing to answer questions, and overall a great professor. He posts all of his lectures online so you don't have to go to class, but I recommend going because he is extremely nice and easy to talk to. No complaints and I highly recommend this class for an easy A

This professor is very good and keeps things interesting. However, to be honest, I only attended 3 lectures all semester and got an A. He posts all the lectures online so if you look at those by yourself (what I did) you really don't need to go to class BUT he is a good professor so you should! EASY A and interesting so take his class!

Phillips' lectures were so interesting! He pauses often to interact with the students and answer questions. His passion and care really shows through in the way he teaches. I truly respect him and his class is full of life lessons.
Fantastic teacher! Really cares about his students and offers lots of extra credit points. Lectures are interesting too.

Prof. Phillips is a great professor and obviously passionate about the subject. He uses a lot of great examples in his lectures and makes the class interesting. If you read the lecture notes and study the vocab terms in the book, you'll do fine.
He's awesome and does a great job giving  easy to relate to examples. Exams are often harder than they may seem like they may be.

Dr. Phillips is awesome! I loved going to his classes, because he just makes it so interesting. He's very passionate about psychology and it really helps to see that in a professor. His tests are kind of difficult, requires reading the book to do well! He offers a lot of extra credit though so it's not too difficult to make up points. LOVED HIM!
Best professor I have had! He really enjoys teaching and is passionate about the topic. Make sure to read the book, a lot of the material is on the exams.

Warning - you WILL need the book. He doesn't discuss the content but it is 40% of the test. Otherwise, his lectures are crystal clear and you barely have questions about what he said. Very friendly and loves his subject!

Prof. Phillips is a great teacher, makes the class really interesting. His class is SUPER easy as well. I skipped class all the time, did okay on the tests, but with the copious extra credit he allows, still got an A- in the class.
Wasn't a bad class the only reason I didn't attend was cause it was at 8 am.  If you read the book you will be fine on the tests.

He is a fantastic teacher and he tells you everything you need to know & do to pass the class. Tests are MURDEROUS if you don't study vocab. & all the major theories he gives. Do not make that mistake. Overall, really good teacher considering Developmental psych is my least favorite psych class. Also, he's pretty cute ;)
Really good lecturer and professor! Class was interesting, he's good at explaining concepts and he keeps it interesting with stories! Loved the class!

He is an amazing guy and loves psychology, yes he talks a bit too much about his song who is now in Highschool and he seems a little odd but he really cares if you do good. Read the book, take your time on the tests and make sure you study from both the powerpoints and book.

He is great at explaining things and making them interesting. The class is curves as well as offers lots of extra credit. No attendance but he lectures are entertaining and engaging. One of my favorite professors.

Great lecturer, I always enjoyed listening to his lectures. He has a lot of stories which help make the lectures more engaging. The class is a bit tough when it comes to exams, but if you read the book and study you'll be solid. Warren knows his stuff and is always willing to answer questions.

A great teacher and lecturer!  He knows many students take this to fill gen. eds. (like me): notes are lectured clearly and slowly.  Sometimes it's frustrating when people ask moronic questions, but he'll patiently answer people and doesn't patronize anyone.  Uses real-live stories, is funny, and knows his stuff.  Always enjoyed class.  Book needed
Well-spoken professor with high level of knowledge regarding psychology

Hated lecture, it was boring. All you really need to do is read the book and the tests are really easy. He gives random quizzes in class so you have to go. The research points are really easy to get!!

his lectures are extremely boring. Do all the research extra credit studies, helps raise your grade by 2/3 at the end. Last test is the easiest. Notes are online, read the book over sections in the lecture. Try to hang in there, I had a C leading into the final and got an A! Good luck!
I think the lectures are boring and that they way he words his test and quiz questions are so off the wall and hard to understand.

great guy! loves what he teaches and tells tons of real life stories that are really easy to relate to and brings concepts to life. follow along in your book. pop quizzes so go to class. pretty interesting class over all!

Phillips was very down to earth and his lectures were fun and relaxed.  He certainly enjoys what he does and incorporates a lot of real life stories which makes the material easier to relate to. A lot of test material is pulled from the book.  I would love to have Phillips again as a teacher!

He is one of my favorite professors! His lectures were never boring, and he can relate what he's talking about to his life and his kids, which helps me learn. It's really easy to get an A, especially if you do the extra credit. I would definately recommend him to anyone taking a psych class!

I feel like the most obvious person here:  There is  a website on the back of the book where at least 10 questions per test come from.  He takes them word for word of the tutorial quizzes on that website.

I really liked Warren Phillips teaching style. He was always really interesting and told the cutest stories about his kids. Its important you go to class since you never know when there will be a quiz. Also, I would highly recommend buying the study guide book, it makes the test a lot easier when you  have that to fill out.

Warren is a really nice guy, and though his lectures are nothing to write home about, they don't fall prey to many of the typical complaints.  He's not boring, overly opinionated, doesn't get on the soapbox often.

Do the extra credit and it is easy to get an A.  Most important thing to do is to read the book for vocabulary and learn the vocabulary and the theorists' names.  DO THE STUDY GUIDES for the tests...only thing I didnt like is that he had pop quizzes but they weren't hard as long as you were caught up on the reading.
Ok teacher.  Class is entertaining and fun.  You need to go to class and study the book to do well on exams.  With the extra credit provided an A isn't too hard.

He's a good teacher and loves being there. Sometimes boring, but has good stories! I would recommend going to class. Some of the stuff on the test comes from lecture and isn't covered in the book. Read the book too!! Do the study guides, a lot of the questions are on the test!
Wonderful teacher with tons of anecdotes.  Had a great time, just make sure to go to class.

He was nice and had neat stories, but you really have to study the book to do well. There is a LOT of stuff on the tests not covered in class. Also, do the readings, they are hard to understand sometimes, but they show up on the tests. If you do all the extra credit though, an A shouldn't be that hard.

The class itself was interesting and he taught it well, but when it came to tests a lot of the stuff was not ever covered.  If you want an A on the test or in the course you really have to study that book. The Research Extra Credit helped a ton!! He also has pop-quizzes so you kind of have to go to class.
I found his class interesting and liked the stories. Learned lots that can all be used in life. Make sure to do the extra credit it will really help your grade.
He pretty much covered the material needed but sometimes class got a little long and boring but overall I found the class effective

This class is GREAT!  Seats in Curtiss Auditorium fill up fast!  Sure, he talked A LOT about his kid, but given that its a developmental psych course, the stories were HIGHLY relevant most of the time.
Is good lecturer, but has poor reading selections.
Challenging and boring. The tests suck, but if you study for them you should be fine. It has a nice curve at the end!
BORING!!!  If you are not too found of children, don't take the class- you will probably go insane like I did...
Easy class... tests are a little difficult but as long as you study the study guides he gives out you'll be fine.. and make sure to do all the research extra credit, it really helps.

Class was a little difficult, because of the test. I agree make sure you read all the packets and you go to class. His lectures are helpfull and if you pay attention and read the book you should do alright.
Good guy, very helpful if you need outside assisstance.  Tests are very hard read all of the extra course packet and at least the bold words from the regualr book (and do the extra credit)

He's a funny professor, especially when it comes to telling stories about little kids. His tests will kick your ass if you don't study. And definately max out the research credits because I knew someone who went from a C to a B+ using that.

Tests are very difficult. He gives pop quizzes, which sucks hard. Grading scale is fixed with 90% as an A. He is, however, a very good lecturer and very clearly presents the material. Lectures are slow paced and his delivery is somewhat rythmic, so take the class early in the day. He keeps the lecture room dark too. Good class if you're motivated.

Your grade is as good as you make it.  Get your Psych EC points done early to avoid the rush.  And do all of them!! That's what saved my grade.  I only bought the books for the rubric, but never used either one, so not nessecery.  I went to a few of the lectures, and tried to guess when his quizzes were.  Not too hard. good luck.

Dr. Phillips is a great professor for this class.  Granted, the tests are pretty difficult, and there is a LOT of reading to do, but lecture is fun and helpful and worth going to.  Do the extra credit research!

Hard tests, better study.  Going to class seems pointless, but it is worth it.  If you don't go, make sure to get the notes off WebCT, you will need to know them.  Do the extra credit research, it's easy and can boost your grade.

Thought it was a very good class! Great teacher, easy to understand, shares good stories, teaches childbirth, i give credit to any man that can do that and not have a gross look on his face! If you read your book, go to class, and do your extra credit you'll do good!
The class is boring, really not worth going to, and the test cover soo much that they are insanly hard
I loved this class.  He makes it very enjoyable.  His stories are great, and illustrate a point.  Go to class and pay attention, do the readings, and you will do great.
Easy class...boring and learned more in my high school psych classes, but overall not bad.  He likes to tell lots of stories about crap...so bring a book to read.
No Comments
Great class and great teacher! I enjoyed every minute of it. Tests were fairly difficult, but with the study guide, not too bad. I think many people would benefit from taking developmental psych.
He straight up sexy. this guy is a good teacher.
A class for el ed or ece majors, others may not be as interested. I think he is an effective and fair teacher. His tests were fairly difficult. Hard to sit through the entire lecture at times.

the guy's voice is like nails on a chalboard for me.  he talks sooo slow and goes over everyhting a bazillion times.  I have a feeling its an easy class, though.  avoid taking this class if you dont have to.
I loved his class so much.  And who knew...a man could actually teach and childbirth and child rearing...I loved every minute of that class

Decent guy.  Very easy class, I never paid attention or studied and still got an easy A.  Do the extra credit, its well worth it so you don't have to worry about tests at all.  Don't bother buying the books, I never needed them for the class.  Just know the Powerpoint slides for tests.
sweet
This class was interesting but like all psych classes they really expect you to memorize a lot of stuff! Warren himself is a nice guy! I wouldn't call him hot though. He was very helpful.
He's a very interesting teacher, I am able to stay awake in his class!  Oh course, it doesn't hurt that he is great to look at:)

I did not read the book at all.  Alot of the test questions I don't think were ever taught in class or in the book.  Memorize the class notes and you'll get by.  This was one of my lowest grades in psych, percetagewise, but I still had an A even before the curve at the end, which is gigantic!!

Everyone has told me how bad he is, but I really enjoy his teaching (for the times I got to lecture!)  He does talk about his family a lot, but it really makes things clear...I remember all the stories about his son and how they related to the topic.
Very boring...watch out for the birt video if you have a really weak stomach. At least he's thorough, so that's a plus.
Very easy and very interesting.  The birth video was not so cool. Get ready to listen to stories about his family, but they relate to the topic.
Not a very interesting prof at all.  If you like taking notes for an hour, then take a class with him.  Not a bad guy just doesn't spark an interest in class at all.
his class was pretty easy, i never did extra credit and got an A

Easy class, must do all of the extra credit because tests are tough, the tests are curved though, Must study for the tests and he's a good teacher, gives out random quizzes, so you must attend class from time to time. Good class overall.
He relies on Power Point too much. Kinda boring. Moderate difficulty.
Really nice guy, material isn't too bad (a little dry at times), tests can be challenging (or very hard if you don't study).

Oh I could sleep in this class. His voice is so soothing and Curtiss is soo warm...But I dare not nod off and miss the lecture. Good professor, very clear despite the buttloads of information to take in.  Hard tests. Do your reading.
He was really fun to listen to, especially his personal stories about his son.  Very cute!
Very thorough but a little boring.  Powerpoint shows are all the same so it's really boring to take notes.  Tests of about medium difficulty, and good opportunities for extra credit.

This class was boring but he's a good teacher.  It's not his fault that the subject matter is borning...and not to mention that he's not bad to look at!!  Tests are hard and there's no way to really study but get all the extra credit you can.
