Actually the best professor I've ever had. Everyone likes him for a reason. His class is enjoyable, the tests are not hard as long as you have a general understanding of the material. Take ACCT 215 with Prof. Bootsma, seriously. Its a good time.

Mike was genuinely the best professor I have had at ISU. He was funny, kept lectures entertaining, and his exams matched the topics discussed in class. He is also very accessible and wants his students to do well.

Professor Bootsma was an absolute joy to have as an instructor. He was very funny, helpful, and made lectures very interesting because of hypothetical stories, and not taking himself too seriously. Also, you could tell he actually wanted students to learn. For my class, a lot of people scored badly on an exam and he allowed everyone to retake.
His recorded lectures were engaging and worth the listen. Great at communicating over email and through canvas. Truly cares about you as a student and individual. Learned a lot and would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took this online, and if I had to do it again I would probably do it in person. I struggled to actually retain stuff from the online lectures, so I would cram for the exams. The exams had a ton of material on them, so there's no winging these. You either know the material or you don't. Mike is a fun guy though and really cares about his students!

Professor Bootsma is great but the class is super boring. The lectures are long and that is the only thing class consists of. I don't blame Bootsma for the boringness though, I just think Business Law is not exciting and he does the best he can. Exams are straight forward and he gives tons of review opportunities and practice exams through canvas.

Bootsma was an amazing Professor who truly cared about his students. He was always accessible and encouraged his students to reach out for help or visit his office hours. He was very passionate about this course which was why it was a fun course to take. Exams are very tough but he provided more than enough resources to succeed. Highly recommend!
Really lives up to his high rating. He cares about students and that they are doing well in the class. He makes lectures fun. You want to take this class in person.

By far the best professor I have ever had. If I could take every class with him I would. His lectures are easy to listen to and he is a funny guy. The tests are more about little details so reading the book makes a pretty big difference but he will go over the big stuff in his lectures. 10/10 professor and will help you a tone out of class too.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You'll have to work in this class no matter what so he makes it more fun
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Bootsma is hands down the best professor that Ivy has. I recommend taking him no matter what. Exams can be difficult but with some solid hours of studying you'll be fine. For ACCT 215, I believe that the textbook is unnecessary unless you think you're going to struggle with the material. Also, taking good notes on top of his lecture slides is key.
Probably one of the best professors ive had. Hes very clear on what you need to do in order to get an A in the class. I would definitely recommend you take acct 215 with him!
Mike really cares about his students and takes the time to get to know them. A real gem of the ISU faculty. I would 100% recommend any of his courses.
Professor Bootsma is very entertaining and it makes a boring class more fun. Do the readings and take notes on the lectures and you'll be fine.

It's been a few years since I took ACCT 215 with Bootsma. Far and away the best professor I have ever had. He makes the class accessible, and does an incredible job of making boring subject matter interesting. If I could have Michael Bootsma teach every single class I would absolutely take it.

Bootsma is awesome! He truly cares about students' success in not just his class, but all of their classes and life. The exams online were open book, so there wasn't a need to watch the lecture videos, but the videos are entertaining so they're worth watching. Be sure to make a little study guide for the exams and get all of the quiz points.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He truly cares about his students success! The grading for this class is generous towards students. The book is extremely helpful and his lectures aren't to long and point out key material. Learned valuable information and he makes it easy to understand with many examples. Quizzes and exam stimulations help a lot while studying for exams!Great Guy!

Bootsma truly is a great guy who tries to lighten the mood of class every chance he gets. He is a great professor to teach this class and he knows his stuff (after all he did write it). He clearly explained the class and what you need to do to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Bootsma is so so kind and he goes above and beyond to help his students. It is obvious that he is so busy but he will make time for you. He also recognizes the struggles students face in everyday life. He also is a great lecturer and really explains things well. Go to class, it helps and even though it can be boring, he's really pleasant.

Bootsma is truly a gem. The info can be boring at times, but he makes it as entertaining and memorable as possible. I will be taking ACCT316 with him, because I have truly enjoyed his class. He also posts prerecorded lectures online, but listening to him in class is most definitely more enjoyable. He is very flexible to meet if you need help.

Bootsma is one of my favorite professors so far. He's really funny and enjoyable to listen to. He posts his lectures online so if you miss class, it's easy to catch up. The material is difficult, so it's required to study hard. He provides a lot of useful resources that makes this class easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bootsma is one of, if not, the best professor I have had at Iowa State. He makes his lectures super interesting. Up to 40 quiz points to earn for easy points in the class (offers well over 40, maxes out) and the tests aren't that bad. Basically, just go to class and do all of the practice exams. Also, book is nice, but you can live without it tbh.

You're graded on 40 quiz points - there's way more than 40 available points for the semester. The remaining 360 points are from 4 exams. So make sure you study for them. The content is pretty straight forward, it's basically a lot of memorizing. Bootsma is a super sociable person and really cares about his students. He had entertaining lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved having Mike as one of my professors. He truly cares about all of his students and does a great job at keeping you engaged throughout class. You'll still need to put the time in to get a good grade, but I'd highly recommend taking a class with Mike!
Very funny guy that really cares about his students and loves his job at Iowa State. He makes dry and difficult material fun and easy to learn. Would take any of his classes again!

Bootsma is a great professor. A very engaging lecturer and a lot of fun. He genuinely cares about his students and is very knowledgeable. Overall one of the best lecturers I have ever had. He makes Business Law a great class to take.

Bootsma is one of my favorite professor at ISU. Cares about his students a lot and puts in effort to help if you put in effort to help yourself. Took this as a summer class so it was difficult and fast paced.
Bootsma makes class enjoyable and its easy to get the 40 quiz points. The exams are the tough part and you really have to grind and study hard for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Lecture and readings are important in this class. He is very awesome to talk to before and after exams!

Boostma is awesome! Amazing professor who has hilarious lectures. Attendance isnt mandatory but often gives hints or exact exam questions that will be used on your next exam. Easy to access outside of class. If you work hard an A is achievable, I reccommend reading the book, it helps clarify many terms with real world examples

Hands down, Bootsma is the best professor I have ever had. He makes lectures interesting and truly cares about his students. He understands we have other committments, and is willing to work with students. He offers so many office hours. I would take this class again if I could!

Bootsma is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is honestly just an incredible person in general. Fair grading system with super clear grading criteria. He sets his students up for success. He randomly gives life advice during his class when it is appropriate and I can appreciate this! He has a ton of office hours and is willing to help.

Bootsma is the best professor I have ever had. Exams require a lot of memorization and there are 4 of them. His lectures are hilarious and he frequently makes himself available to help students out. Provides a lot of study materials that help for the exam. Also curves every exam which helps out a lot. Wish I could take this class again
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Bootsma is a great professor. Teaches material well. Expectations for tests are well laid out, and he gives you lots of problems similar to those on the exams. If you study the terms the tests will be very doable. Attendance can give you points but you can earn the points from online work, so attendance is not required.

Has a cap point system for quizzes. There are enough points even if you don't show up to class and take the online assessments. Really funny guy but compared to my other liberal arts classes this one is an easy grade. Read the book and slides. It is upsetting that he has a lot of grammar errors which really hurts his accountability.
He is really funny and the lectures are not boring. Study for the tests by doing the practice tests and then the test will be easy

Bootsma was the textbook definition of how college professors should be. His tests were hard and require a lot of studying, but he makes himself readily available when needed and posts all kinds of review content.

His lectures, if you take notes, are your primary study source, and he is brilliant at making class fun. Use your notes and review the book before tests and you could get an A. Genuinely cares about all of his students and advertises his office hours frequently.

Bootsma does a great job of preparing students for exams. His study guides and practice exams are very helpful. His lectures are easy to listen to and he does a great job of using examples to make concepts relatable. One of my favorite professors so far.
Need to study for the tests, but they are not that bad. Final is not cumulative. Great professor

Bootsma is my absolute favorite professor I've ever had. He's funny, makes things enjoyable to learn, genuinely cares about his students and explains tough concepts concisely. He lets you know that he's available and flexible if you need help outside of class. Genuinely a really great person and I'm lucky to have had him for a professor.

Class is way harder than it needs to be. The only reason people take this course is because it's required. Bootsma is a great guy and is super friendly, but having tests be worth 90% of the grade in a class like this is absolutely ridiculous. 70 definitions per chapter and you really need to know your stuff to do well. Good thing C's get degrees.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Bootsma makes his lectures interesting and engaging, but he is difficult to approach outside of class. The best way to have success in this course is to read the chapters, even though they are dry, and utilize all of the exam materials he provides. The exams make up 90% of the grade, so they are extremely important.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Very personable guy, if you're struggling he is easy to talk to. He makes his material and his examples very memorable.
Hands down my favorite teacher Ive had at Iowa State.

Bootsma makes a difficult and fairly dry course very engaging and interesting. He lectures with enthusiasm and demonstrates with examples. He is VERY caring and reaches out to students personally to help them with grades. Hands down the best professor I have had in the college of business. Don't need the textbook but could help, learn terminology.
Great professor. Going to class is very rewarding and you'll learn a lot from him. However, tests are difficult and you must put a lot of efforts to get an A.

Bootsma is a great professor, one of the best that I have had at Iowa State University, I think he is the only ACCT 215 Professor so you're stuck with him regardless. He makes his lectures really interesting and engaging for students and always gives good real world examples. The tests can be difficult but as long as you put in effort you'll be god
Average instructor. Nice guy, can be mean sometimes. Really loves to emphasize how everything is on the syllabus already. Curves exams usually in the 7-10 pt range.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Goes out of his way to help students do their best.

Bootsma is amazing! The content is very dry, but his lectures are worth going to. He explains it in a way that you will remember and he is hilarious! He gives extra credit, lots of points just for coming to class, and he really cares about his students. Start off the semester right by going to class and reading either the book or going over PPTs.

Acct. 215 with him can be very hard but you have to put in a lot of work and effort to get a good grade in the class. I recommend reading your book for each chapter and to go to class. The tests are overall pretty tough but he curves every one of them. I enjoyed the class but you have to put in the work to end up with a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Mike Bootsma is a great professor. He really cares about his students and provides a lot of resources to help them succeed. He also makes his lectures interesting with his sense of humor. Although, his exams are challenging ,but if you study the notes and go to class you'll do well. Overall, 10/10 would recommend him as a professor.

Mike is very nice guy. He teaches the class very well and clear. He is also accessible outside the class. The tests in his class were very difficult and tricky so you need to be careful on his tests specially the test3. You also need to read the textbooks. If you don't understand something it is better to go to his office hours.

Bootsma was an awesome lecturer. Class was really interesting and he gives great examples to help you learn. If you put the time into the class, read the textbook, and go to office hours you can easily get an A. There's quizzes spread throughout classes so attendance is pretty much mandatory.

The class is challenging but so worth taking if you have Bootsma as a professor. He is the most engaged, caring, and humorous professor I have had and hands down one of the best professors at Iowa State. He treats his 400 person lecture hall like a 20 person class in the fact that he really wants to get to know his students & help them succeed.
This has easily been my favorite class that I have taken at ISU. The professor knows what he's talking about and makes class interesting.

Bootsma was by far the best professor I've had here at Iowa State. I can't even summarize the many ways in which he is excellent, knowledgable, empathetic, and fair. His material is hard, but he provides every possible resource you could think of to help his students succeed.

Best professor I've ever had at Iowa State. Mike actually cares about his students and makes it known quite often. The material is pretty tough, but he applies it to real situations and adds a lot of humor to make it a lot better. He's a great guy and a great professor, and I wish I could have him for every class. Take a class with him!

Mr. Bootsma is a fantastic instructor. He really takes the time and effort to make sure you do as well as you can in his course. He extends office hours, always quick to respond to emails, offers extra credit, gives a clear outline of the course and sticks to it. He goes the extra mile if you do too. He also is pretty funny so his lectures are fun.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Acct 215 with Mike and really enjoyed his lectures. He's a funny guy and made them entertaining for a 9am class. The material isn't too difficult its just the fact that there's so much of it covered for each exam. But if you study and put the effort in, you will do just fine! Overall, great professor and put effort in and you'll do well.

Great teacher and he does care even with 400 students. However, that being said, he can't see how the class is doing. If you have trouble, go see him during office hours. A couple of the tests are rough and the scenarios are a bit confusing. But, if you go every day your quiz points are completed very early on and it takes the weight off.
Tough class and not the most exciting topic, but the professor is excellent.  Very inspirational, and it is clear he cares about the individuals in his class.  Worth taking for sure.
Turns a dull subject into something thats not as hard to listen to. Genuinely cares about his students and truly loves teaching. Super smart guy and one of my favorite professors at Iowa State
Mike is probably the best lecturer I've had, and I've been here for over 3 years. Exams will be tough if you don't study properly, but getting an A or B is easily doable with a little effort.

Memorization. So many terms and lecture is very boring. The only benefit to going may be to get some extra examples but he posts lectures on BB, so towards the end I started skipping and still got 87 on the final. As long as you fill out the study guide he provides, then you're golden. And be sure to know what happens in each case!

Professor Bootsma is a fantastic guy. His qualifications are impressive, and he genuinely cares about his students. You will find the lectures entertaining. If you want an A you will need to study for the exams days in advance. The tests are fair. This class is very valuable, I learned a lot, definitely made me smarter!
Mike makes it fun to go to class. That's about the only thing he does. Tests are hard and require lots of studying. I wouldnt't take this class unless absolutely necessary.

Mike is the man. Posts review videos online, gives the answers to the quizzes  in class, also gives out some test questions.  Funny guy that truly cares about his students and makes business law interesting.

Great teacher, however the class is challenging. Lots of material and memorizing terms will not get you far. Going in for office hours to talk to him or ask questions is highly recommended. He really wants students to succeed and gives out a lot of study material. Also try to go to class because he gives out EC/attendance points.
The best Prof I've ever had. The way he says  "statutes" always makes class worth going to. I would highly recommend this Prof. Study hard for the exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Bootsma really cares about his profession and it shows in his lectures. He is the best professor I have ever had. Very approachable and knowledgeable about the topics. Also a really funny guy.

Mike made pretty boring material seem interesting.  You can usually choose between reading the book and going to class and you'll pass as he wrote the textbook himself, so the lecture slides follow it to a T.  I read and went to class and got an A, but I'm sure you could pass with one or the other.  Really cares about his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Michael is hilarious and seems passionate about what he does. Easily a favorite professor of mine, but his tests are so hard!!!! You have to spend days studying or there's not way you'll get a passing grade on his exam. There is a slight curve though.

Bootsma is a really cool and fun professor. He definitely makes the material as fun, interesting, and relate-able as he can. There are occasional quizzes for credit but besides that there is no homework. The tests make up a large part of the grade but aren't too difficult if you read the textbook and go to lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Bootsma is amazing - he is comical, understands students, and doesn't make sitting thru class terrible. Nice guy, too.
Favorite professor I've had.

Mike is an amazing professor. He makes boring material seem very interesting, uses great examples, and engages the class. Some of the material is very confusing, but Mike is frequently in his office and will definitely explain it to you if you make the effort. Coming to class is critical because of pop quizzes and lectures.

Bootsma is one of the best professors at Iowa State willing to help and is willing to help. He is also quite hilarious. The tests are a bit difficult and that is because there is a lot of material to memorize. He sometimes gives out extra credit and curves all tests. Go to class! He gives answers and points.

The tests in this class were a little difficult but definitely not super hard. He tried hard to make the class interesting even though the material was a little dry at times. Really nice guy though really made sure you knew that if you wanted help or to come in to talk to him about grades he was willing to do so.

Professor Bootsma is the single best thing of Iowa State. I have taken many of  his classes and highly suggest them all. The material is sometimes hard but as long as you try he makes sure you are successful. He's hilarious and can make the driest content easy to understand. Every professor should strive to be at his level.

He does what he can to make business law fun. His lectures follow the slides and he makes sure to do a lot of examples to demonstrate the topics. He is always willing to help, and is very fair with tests. He gives quizzes in class every so often, and posts videos of past lectures for each chapter.

Single best teacher I've had at ISU, maybe ever.  Funny, helpful, an overall great guy.  Makes you interested in what you're learning, and is very enthusiastic about it.  Quite the character.  It's not an easy class, but it's not to hard, either. Go to class, take notes, study, and you'll be fine. Highly recommend everyone to take this course.

Bootsma is by far the best professor I have ever had. Expect to do work as it is not an easy A. However, Bootsma makes very dry material interesting and is always there for you if you need anything. Bootsma for Dean.

Bootsma is the best professor I have had at Iowa State. The class is very easy. Attendance isn't mandatory but going to lecture is very interesting and helps you out when it comes to the tests. There are 4 tests and some quiz points that are very easy to get 100% on because there is a max out. He will always find time for you if you need help.

Professor Bootsma is an amazing professor. He truly cares about the success of his students. After taking Business Law I, I chose to take Business Law II with Bootsma as an elective. While Business Law II is a more rigorous course, Professor Bootmsa still made the class engaging to ensure students learn and succeed.

There's a ton of content but Mike is a great guy and wants to help you learn it all. I was in an 8 a.m. section but I enjoyed the lectures because they were a good mix of informative and he has a good sense of humor about himself and life. Put in the work and you'll do fine.

He is a really funny guy, and really wants everybody to succeed. His lectures are kind of entertaining and he likes to give funny real life scenarios. Grading also is not that hard, and attendance is definitely optional after you get your quiz points.

Good professor. The tests aren't hard but require studying for. It's just a lot of information to know for such a short test, 35 multiple choice questions. Print out powerpoint lecture notes before lecture, I found this really helpful to take notes. Show up for lecture. He gives extra credit quizzes based on attendance sporadically.

BEST TEACHER I HAVE EVER HAD.  Never have I been able to focus for a whole lecture until I had Bootsma as my professor.  Not saying that business law is easy, but he makes it enjoyable.  Always there to help, doesn't want to see a kid fail or struggle.  Brings laughter to lecture which is very comforting.  Overall, make sure to read and go to class
FAVORITE PROFESSOR!!!

Bootsma rocks. He holds extra long office hours for questions or concerns and is more than willing to work with students when they don't understand things or need help. I barely used the textbook since I went to class. GO TO CLASS, he gives out random basically free 5 point quizzes when you NEED for your grade.

Bootsma was great! He made lectures fun because he was so funny and I felt like he could really relate to students. He understands that we have other commitments and is willing to help you by providing frequent office hours along with review sessions and videos for each test. I would definitely recommend him!
BOOTSMA IS THE HOMIE

Bootsma makes material super clear. I made flash cards from ppt slides and got an A on every single test. He gives 40 total participation points and I reached my 40 max by halfway through the semester. Gives a few test questions during class. I would highly, highly recommend him for an easy class that you actually learn a lot in. DON'T BUY TEXTBOOK

I really enjoyed this class last spring. He was such a funny professor, had easy to follow examples and shared his personal experiences.  He provided video lectures and review sessions which were very helpful. The class was a few exams and quizzes. If you attend class he'll give out hints and test questions. He's there to help you if you need it!

Mike was the man! Makes the class somewhat interesting and relates senarios to college pretty well. There for you for pretty much anything, school or personal life. Post videos online of reviews and class.
Great teacher
Mike was super helpful and he's really funny! As long as you pay attention in class you'll do great on the tests!

Bootsma is a great professor. Knows his stuff, interesting, and very helpful. Grade is based on 4 tests and some quizzes. He gives test questions and pop quizzes in class, so make sure you go! You could probably get by without the book! Overall great professor!

Go to class and you will pass the class. Give out 5 point in class pop quizzes throughout the semester. If you miss one, don't worry as you only need 40 points and he gives out a lot more than 40 points worth. No homework, all tests. Very friendly and overall a very nice guy.
Must go to class, but if you pay attention you will get an A. Grade is based on tests, all non-cumulative. Very friendly and cares about students!
Helpful lecturer, care about student, great and clear lecture, absolutely a good listener.

He is probably one of the best teachers I have ever had. He makes class fun, and you can tell that he really cares about his students. You do have to go to class most of the time to get the attendance points. He also makes it possible to receive extra credit. If you can get Mike as a professor, do it. He's great.

Great professor! Tests are not too difficult and there are no homework assignments. Attendance is not mandatory but he will give out quizzes every once in awhile and he usually gives out test questions as a way to encourage attendance. If you show up to class and pay attention you should have no problem passing this class.

Professor Bootsma is an outstanding professor who not only is passionate about Business Law, but he also takes an active interest in his students' success in and out of the classroom. Make sure you attend lectures as he helps you on attendance quizzes and tells you the answers to test questions. He is always willing to talk to you in office hours.

Conveys topics of class very well, if you make the effort he rewards you. Very willing to take the time to go over things and help you improve if you reach out to him. He gives in class quizzes for points every so often and then he gives you the answers to them so you always get the full points. Respects students a lot. He's also hilarious.
not a big law or accounting person but he made this class fun and understandable. Gives out a 5 point quiz once a week randomly which really help your grade.  Fun teacher!
Good teacher, very willing to help, enjoyed the class.

He is so great. He actually makes me interested in accounting at 8 a.m. He gives great real world examples so that we can apply the information and actually retain it for the tests. He wants you to come to his office hours to see him and ask him questions. He really cares about his students and their success.

Possibly the best class I've had at ISU. Bootsma cares a great deal about your success, not just in his class but as a student as well. Tests can be difficult, but if you go to his reviews you will do better.

He speaks very clearly and defines terms without doubt. He incorporates humor into his lectures, but can sometimes be boring (it's a business class). If you attend class regularly and read the book, you will be successful. He cares about student success and will keep trying until you understand the material.

He's awesome. By far my favorite professor. He makes sure that you know the material and really tries to get to know you in class and out of class. Tests can be difficult, but he is very fair and will give points back. Also textbook is required. You use it for homework and do examples out of it constantly.
favorite teacher at Iowa State. I recommend him to all of my friends. Class can be boring at times, but usually very interesting. Bootsma is really funny and really cares about his students.
Overall a good professor. Made sure students understood difficult material before moving forward. Tests were difficult but fair. Definitely better than the other 387 teachers.

Test teacher I've had at Iowa State. Very good teacher, makes sure the class understands the concept before moving on. Makes a genuine effort to learn everyone's name. Homework is online and tests are taken with several other classes. His sections consistently had the highest test averages.
Probably one of the best professors I have ever had. Really makes sure students know the material before moving on.  Very helpful. I would definitely recommend taking a class with him!
Great teacher, very helpful. He really cares about his students.
Tests are extremely difficult. Makes you feel dumb if you don't know what he's talking about. Group project is very confusing. Homework is easy, but doesn't thoroughly explain the chapters.

Bootsma is one of the best teachers at ISU! He genuinely cares about his students and is always willing to help. He also has a great personality and kept class interesting. I would definitely recommend taking any class with him!
In my opinion the best professor at Iowa State. Cares about the students and learning the material.
Class was well organize, fun, educational, helpful, useful

Bootsma tells stories most of the class time, but they help in remembering the terms and understanding the information. He has pop quizzes that are very easy and gives out test questions if you show up to class. He calls out people for talking during class even though the lecture is 300 people. He is good at having useful office hours

Bootsma is the best professor I have had in my career at Iowa State.  He is very knowledgeable and keeps the class awake with jokes and calling randomly on students.  He also makes an attempt to learn each students name, and truly cares about making sure his students learn the subject.  Take any class with him and you will not be disappointed.

Great professor. Don't necessarily need to read the book, unless you are reviewing for the test. If you have a question, go up to the front after class or to his office hours. He's not really as intimidating as he seems. However, don't email him with questions because he doesn't respond, cause he wants you to go to class. Speaking of which, make sure you go to class because he gives out quiz points, extra credit (especially the class before break), and test questions.
Great professor!
Great professor!  Tries to get to know everyones names and then he calls on you randomly. Funny guy and very understanding and helpful. Make sure you have the finance calculator as it helps a ton!

Great Professor! Funny and helpful. He tries to learn everybody's names the first week so once he knows your name he will call on you so you gotta pay attention! Fin 301 is pretty easy but he does a great job explaining it nonetheless. He also gives random test questions throughout lectures so go to every class to get them.
He is the best teacher I have had at Iowa State so far.  He is very easy and is always willing to help you.  You don't need to buy the textbook but you do need the spiral notebook.
Pretty easy, career fair was a requirement to go to, which was fine. I had it in person and it was once a week, tophat associated so it was required to be in class. Really funny and down to earth

High energy classroom, don't be afraid to speak up. Long wants you to succeed and learn. Tophat is used for attendance. Visiting the career fair is mandatory.There is a video presentation near the end. Overall, great class and laid down great pointers for having a successful career later on.

Brooke is so entertaining, funny, and made the class exciting and covered the material in ways that made it easy to remember. Don't miss class (you will lose points) and do put effort into the group project. There are opportunities for extra credit and I was able to get over 100% in the course. Brooke is the best!!!

Prof. Long is such a nice person who is dedicated to teaching students well. Her class is very easy to follow along in and you'll get an A as long as you try during the lectures. However, there is one group project you need to be aware of. Please reach out if you have any issues with your group members or it won't end well grade-wise.

This professor insulted my religion in class in a very rude way. When I brought it up to her, she responded in a very "I've been caught" attitude, and did not seem to take what I said to her (respectfully mind you) in a serious way. The rest of the semester it felt like she was rude and cold to me, and I did not appreciate that.
If you put in effort, she was very happy and excited to see you try. A lot of small group work in class that could be awkward depending on the group.
She was fantastic! If you attend class when there is an assignment and turn your work in on time you will receive a good grade.

She was great. She made the classes interesting and was very understanding of my health issues despite the fact I was unable to get official accommodations. Her class is faster-paced than some of the other classes, but you get more time on the multi-modal project, and the end of the semester becomes very low-key.

Amazing professor. I would recommend using the multimodal project to create something useful for yourself. Use the research paper to help guide your career or grad school goals
The required attendance is not particularly nice but is important for a good experience in class. Just complete assignments on time and put in a reasonable amount of effort.

Super kind and willing to work with you. Very clear on when things are due/what you need to do to get a good grade. Often ends class early or cancels so that you can come to her for help or extra questions. Makes writing really easy/understandable and also offers really good feedback. I don't care for English usually but I enjoy this class a lot!
She is really nice and gives good feedback. She makes writing papers less stressful and is an easy grader. Sometimes she cancels class and has an assignment to to on your own.

Overall, a super easy english class where all you need to do is meet the requirements for your four main assignments, and you'll easily pass with an A. She is so sweet and often makes class optional about once a week. Highly recommend.
Great Professor, the ungrading really helped me in this class.
The kindest professor I've had. Dr. B strongly emphasizes trying new writing styles and is super happy when she sees something new in your writing.

My absolute favorite professor at Iowa State, I would marry her on the spot if I could. Allows you to experiment with your writing and will not dock points over misunderstandings or small errors. As long as you attend class and put in effort you will have no issue getting an A. Would recommend everyone to take classes with her.

Amazing amazing amazing. She encourages experimentation within your essays, does not deduct points for small errors, and truly wants her students to succeed and pass with an A. You will do great if you reach her bare minimum requirements and put in genuine effort. The majority of assignments are graded on completion rather than content.
Dr. B is an amazing teacher. Very big on trying new things when it comes to papers and allows you to be creative. Would recommend
Very kind and fun. 10/10 would recommend.

Dr. Brellenthin is very nice. She is pretty lenient and an easy grader. There are a decent amount of papers, but she breaks them up into manageable pieces. She gives good feedback and wants her students to succeed. Some quizzes, some projects, a fair amount of papers, but there were no tests. Participate and try in this class and you'll do fine.

Attendance is mandatory, yet Brent was rarely ever in the classroom. We were expected to work over university breaks, but he never does any grading outside of class time. If you take this class, memorize the syllabus because he will never post about due dates and rarely reminds his students of them. This course was a waste of time and money.

Brent created a safe space for models and made sure they felt comfortable throughout the hours of posing. He also provided feedback to students to help them improve on their works which was visible as figure drawing progressed.

I really did not enjoy this class. I don't think Brent is a bad guy, but he is never in class. He is disengaged and only interacts with a few select "favorites." He lets other students- students who are NOT IN OUR CLASS- walk in to chat with him or his TA. He gives no feedback or demos during the process but is harsh after work is already turned in

Brent seems to be a bit disengaged from class. He usually shows up late and spends most of his time outside the room until the very end of class. Critiques are really the only time he seems truly interested in the work. Other than that, hes a nice guy and really knows his stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: As with all design classes at Iowa State, you have to show up because your sign-in tells you what your participation grade will be. Brent can be very hot-and-cold depending on the day or semester. Sometimes he'll cancel class and be totally cavalier about assignments, other times he's super strict on his "syllabus policies" and can be frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Brent is quiet and has a very odd sense of humor. His assignments are fair and gives fairly helpful comments. His grading is fair, make sure your attendance is good and you spend outside of class time on drawing assignments, you will get a lot out of his course.

Brent chooses his words and teaching style very carefully based on the student he is instructing. He pushes the students who need extra encouragement, and gives students wake-up calls when they aren't improving enough. He's not for the weak willed, but he will tell you what you need to hear, when you need to hear it.

I changed my entire career because of this instructor. I wanted to be an illustrator, however, I refused to take any more classes with this teacher. He gave little input during class, and gave ridiculous harsh critique after weeks of zero direction. Unreasonably harsh, but hey, thanks for getting me into my current career.
Brent's classes are very tough; he is very particular about what he wants. However, he is a good teacher, I learned a lot from him. He appreciates hard work from students, and he's a good guy.

Brent knows how to push students to their limit, and I respect that. My skills developed immensely in both the classes I have taken from him. He can be harsh, but brutal honestly in the art world is hard to find. Hard work will get you through his classes.
No Comments

This class barely covered actual food law, even though it is required for my major. We spent too much time on random topics like cannibalism, dinosaurs, and woolly mammoths. Assignments felt like busywork and were mostly graded for completion. Overall, the class felt pointless. I also agree that the constant ums and uhs were distracting.

Had to take this class as it's required by my major. All the assignments are busywork and don't support learning. Class time is spent on irrelevant topics (not related to food law) like woolly mammoths and zombies. The professor will say "um" 5 times per sentence.

Taking a sped up summer online class, the class is due in 22 days and he still has not posted 3 of our assignments that we need to do. Want to email him? good luck getting a response. Last exam we were unable to take it until after the supposed due date, luckily he extended the date, but careless and doesn't show interest in the class
He says um and uh every 5 or so words during lectures. Other than that there is nothing especially good or bad about his teaching
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very nice professor! He is understanding and flexible. His practice exams are helpful.
Plays rock music before class, really pumped me up. Top hat attendance and questions in class.

I took this course because of all the positive reviews. If you are a visual learner, this may not be your professor. It was a lot of spoken lectures with few slides, examples, or walkthroughs. He is very caring and accessible outside of class. It just wasn't my ideal learning style, and it made the course more difficult than it needed to be.
Uses tophat in the lectures. Class isn't difficult if you pay attention and go to the lectures. Uses McGraw-Hill for readings and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I can't say enough about Bruce being a great guy. So clear on feedback and everything. Would take any class with him.
A great professor, it is very easy to be focused on his lectures and he makes sure you understand everything.
Great Teacher
He is extremely knowledgeable about everything finance related. He makes everything easy to understand.

He is such an amazing professor, I would take him for any class! He makes lectures fun and interactive so we are actually learning during them. He is easy to reach outside of class, and makes it clear how you should prepare for tests. Not too much homework or studying if you pay attention in class.

Probably the best professor in the college of business. Course wasn't difficult and kind of boring but Bruce made class fun to go in every day and would walk around the whole lecture hall asking if people had any questions. I think anybody with the opportunity of taking his class will enjoy him and the course greatly.
Kraft is a great professor, and I definitely recommend him for Fin301.
Bruce Kraft was a great teacher and it is needed to attend class and to put in proper work and learning when doing your homework. If you do this and go to class, you will get an A
One of the best professors I have ever had. Great lectures and responds to emails very quickly. Even on the weekends! I will be taking more classes with Bruce.
Great teacher! Attendance is not mandatory but for success, you need to go to class. Be sure to study the slides and do Practice Exams and you will excel

Bruce was an amazing professor who was super accessible after class and with office hours. In class TopHat makes up a 15% of your grade so go to lectures. His lectures are super informative with a lot of examples to make sure you understand concepts. Assignments include weekly HW and mcgraw hill modules and 3 exams. Highly recommend!

Bruce is a great professor! Finance is hard but he keeps lectures very engaging and informative! Tophat is worth participation points and homework also matters for your final grade! All exams require a lot of studying to do good.
Great professor! Has top tier experience and knows how to lecture. Could not recommend more. Attendance points for tophat

Bruce is a great professor. Somebody who cares about his students and is super knowledgeable about finance. He does a great job of teaching his students about the concepts in class. He is also a super funny guy and does a great job of keeping lectures interesting. I would absolutely take him again.
All around an amazing professor. Actually cared for his students and wanted them to succeed.

Finance is a tough class, but Bruce makes it very enjoyable! If you attend the lectures, pay attention, and do the homework, you will be just fine. The practice exams are extremely helpful, and you are given a formula sheet for every exam. Final exam is not cumulative. There are also extra credit opportunities throughout the semester.

Bruce is a great professor. He is very understanding and easy to work with outside of class. His class is structured well and he is always trying to ensure everyone has an understanding of the material. Exams aren't difficult if you are prepared.

Dr. Kraft is an excellent professor who makes the subject clear and straight-forward. He makes an effort to get to know students as well as help them out. As long as you attend lectures and do the homework, you will have no problem in this class.

Although I didn't enjoy finance, I enjoyed having Bruce as my professor. He is very good at explaining lectures and makes sure you understand. If you have any questions, he is happy to help you out. There are two exams and a final. You can retake one of the first two, but you can't choose after you've taken both. You choose wisely.

Kraft is a very caring professor and wants his students to do well. Tophat questions during lectures to make sure you know what you are doing, always explains and goes through questions. Lets you retake 1 exam, but it is averaged from 1st and 2nd attempt. Final exam is not cumulative. 2 attempts on homework. He randomly calls on students in class!

Dr. Kraft stands out as the most exceptional professor I've encountered during my time at Iowa State. While finance can often prove challenging, he has a remarkable talent for simplifying complex concepts. No surprises on exams, as you will be practicing all of the content in class and on practice tests. An amazing person and professor.
He is great!

Kraft is an outstanding professor and I would recommend taking FIN 301 with him. 2 homework assignments per week which are very doable and he prepares you very well for exams to the point where they feel easy and overall a really great guy.
He is one of the best professors I have ever had. He makes class exciting and genuinely cares about your education. Take Finance 301 with Professor Kraft

The weekly learn-smarts and quizzes were very manageable. Attendance is mandatory as he does TopHat questions in class. The exams were not bad as formulas are given to you. If you need to be absent, email him and he will still give you an opportunity to complete the TopHat questions. He responds to emails fast and truly cares about his students.

Class participation via top hat is free points as long as you show up. Homework assignment are free 100% and you get two attempts for every quiz. The tests shaped like the practice's test so if you can understand that you're good. Also you get a chance to retake one of the first two exams if you do poorly on them. Take his class, its a very easy A.

I would 100% recommend taking FIN 301 with him. He is a super nice guy and takes everything slowly, sometimes a little too slow, though. The tests are suuuper easy because he gives you all of the formulas and does an exam review the day before to answer any questions the class has. He will randomly call on people to answer his top-hat questions.

There are top hat quizzes every lecture but they are just graded as participation. Do not be afraid to ask questions. Bruce is great at explaining things and will never make you feel stupid if you do not understand something. The practice exams are very similar to the exams and are even counted as extra credit. Really easy class.

Professor Kraft is a great professor! His lectures follow the material in the textbook well and, while it can be challenging, he does many examples in class and gives practice exams before tests. He really cares about his students, and (in my experience) he doesn't make you feel awkward if you answer incorrectly. Overall great professor!

Extremely easy course with caring professor. TopHat questions every lecture graded, but graded for participation. Do the practice exams which are extremely similar to exams and you will be fine. Wish he disciplined the loud class more as it was often frustrating to focus when people talked all hour.

Incredible professor. Very organized, precise, and friendly. 3 exams in the course that closely mirror practice exams. Homework is graded for completion. Quizzes often have the answers provided in the hint section. Top Hat is utilized during lectures but the questions are graded for completion, not accuracy. Easy A with not much work.
Very helpful. One of if not the best professors I have had at Iowa State. 100% take fin301 with him.

Prof Kraft is a very cool guy. He makes coming to class a joy for students who are having a hard time. He starts each class with music, which is fun. Homework and exams are pretty easy, if you put in some extra study hours you'll get an easy A. Highly recommend this professor
Professor Kraft was awesome. Class was super chill and the way he taught was exactly the way it would be on the exams. Would always review the material before the exams.
Bruce Kraft is probably in the top 5 professors I've had at ISU. He conveys the concepts in a way that is easy to understand, and he is just a great guy. Definitely recommend taking FIN301 with him.

Bruce was awesome. Best professor I've had at ISU. He responds to emails within the day, is super helpful for after-class questions. Tophat questions in class that really help you understand. He is very knowledgeable and the tests are just like practice exams. It's challenging content but he is an excellent teacher. Go to class and you'll be fine.

I liked him. I found the class a little difficult, but if you go to class you'll do fine. Exams are worth 50% of your grade, so make sure you study and do well on those. Class is also engaging, a mix of lecture and tophat questions.
This class was fairly easy; I assume it was because of the teacher.  If you show up to class you can expect to learn a lot and come out with a good grade

Professor Kraft is amazing. He knows a ton about Finance and has experience to back it up. His classes are fun with a mix of lecture notes and tophat questions that are straight forward if you're in class. He gets to know names and cares about how you are feeling and will move exam dates around to make it when the most students are free.

Prof Kraft is a great teacher in all of his classes. I would recommend attending class as there are Tophat questions for attendance but it also makes the material easier to understand. He really tries to engage with students that show up frequently and is truly trying to help people learn.
One of the best professors I have ever had! Great at explaining the topics and more than willing to answer questions! I would 100% take a class with him again!!

Bruce is one of my favorite teachers in the college of business. He's willing to work with you if issues come up as long as you participate and communicate. The homework does require some reading, but as long as you take notes, you will be fine. Lectures aren't necessary but help a lot if you're confused on a topic.
I loved having Bruce Kraft as a professor. He's super good at teaching the material and really understands his students.
Best professor I have ever had at ISU! Gives you all the tools to be successful. The practice exams are very similar to the real exams and help you a lot. Would definitely take more courses with him!

I loved my class with Prof. Kraft, he was so helpful when my team was struggling with CAPSIM and met with us after hours to get us back on track. He gives out a lot of homework but as long as you take notes, you will be just fine. He's always willing to work with you if you give your best attempt on homework/exams and go to class.
Bruce is an amazing professor. He made the finance concepts easy to learn and understand in his lectures. As long as you put in the work for the course, you will have a guaranteed A or B.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: He is an extremely great professor. Super nice and cares about his students. Loved taking this class

Bruce is a great professor with lots of real world experience which shows in this class. The content can get boring for some especially if you have class for 1.5 hours on Tuesday or Thursday. He gives decent lectures and I felt like he covered the course content well.

Hes very helpful and gives some extra credit. does top hat so class is mandatory. i didn't like the way he used the calculator to calculate the problems. pretty disappointed . So if you don't like the BA calculator get use to the functions or self teach yourself math calculations. exams will be hard if you don't know how to calculate.

He's THE BEST professor at ISU hands down. Genuinely cares about his students and their success. He also has lots of guest speakers for a short time at the beginning of class to discuss opportunities for students. Attendance isn't mandatory but HIGHLY encouraged. You won't want to miss the notes and topics he discusses in person- study notes!!!

This is my second time having professor kraft(i had him for busad 250) and he is easily the best professor i've had at isu. He genuinely cares for his students and will go out of his way to check up on them both inside and outside of class. He always does his best to make sure students understand the material. I seriously can't recommend him enough

A great class and professor. The class homework and tests are pretty easy as long as you look through the notes or pay attention during class. A lot of the information is common sense. The group project takes a lot of work and time, but once you get the hang of it it is not so bad. He is a fair grader and is available to help students

He is a very fun and lovable guy. He is well qualified for the job and demonstrates that well. Class is pretty easy, doesnt take too much of your time. Group project is a big part of class but its easy.
He does a great job explaining things, CAPSIM was difficult for my group but overall it was a good class

Amazing professor. He makes the topics interesting and relatable as well as makes sure everyone understands before moving on. He is easily approachable and comes from many years in the finance industry so is very knowledgeable. Also had him for Bus Ad 250 and would take his classes again in a heartbeat.

Bruce is one of the best professors I have ever had. Although sometimes it has been hard to get myself to go to class, he always makes the lectures somewhat interesting and you can tell he really cares about what he's teaching. I would 100% recommend taking this class with him!
Great professor

The professor is very clear about the requirements for the class and the work that needs to be done, and he is always willing to help you out! His lectures can be a little boring at times, but overall he is an awesome professor.

Bruce really knows his stuff. Its nice to get advice from someone who was in business for so long. However, his voice can be hard to listen to while lecturing and I fell asleep frequently. Enjoyed the group project.

Professor Kraft is a great professor. He is very smart and conveys information easily to the class. There is a lot of homework to keep track of, but it is all fairly easy. Show up to class and participate and you should be fine. Overall he's a great professor to have.

Bruce is a very caring. He makes an effort to know all of his students names. The workload in this class can be a lot. There's 3 assignments for every chapter, excel projects, and a team business simulation that takes all semester. However, the exams are not difficult at all and his lectures provide easy in class top hat points for attendance.
Lots of online homework, but gives attendance points at lectures. Cares about his students, but lectures can be dry. If you pay attention youll do well on exams.

The class is very easy to pass. It's mostly a group business simulation project but he does lecture. Attendance and participation points are taken during class but you don't have to take any notes. Weekly homework and quizzes but they are super easy.
Super nice guy that's more than happy to help you with anything! He did a great job of letting us know what was going on in class and made a great effort to get to know the students in my section.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Bruce is a fantastic instructor. The class is fairly easy and centers mainly around Capsim and a few exams as well. What I really liked about taking his class is the fact that he has experience working high level jobs in business so he has first hand experience and seems to really have a passion for the business world.

Bruce is a really good lecturer. Hes clear and concise, and makes the class fun. Class is never dry and I have fun learning a pretty boring subject. Hell help you with capsim if you ask, and seems like he geniuinely wants you to succeed in his class. If you get him 100% stay in his class. You have to study some for the exams but its not tough.

You can tell Lee has been teaching agronomy for a very long time, but he is still very passionate about it. This class is very easy, as long as you attend lectures. He does not have slides bc almost everything is written on a chalkboard. Plus, he randomly takes attendance points. His love of agronomy really makes you excited about the topic too.

Dr is such an amazing professor. He is always available outside of class and is more than happy to help you. He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Iowa state is so blessed to have him as a professor.

Professor Burras is AWESOME! His lectures are incredibly interesting (for not being an Agronomy major) and I have learned SO much from his class. The best professor I have ever had at Iowa State. Highly recommend him and his class. He's super knowledgable, funny, and understanding. Only 2 exams and a final (if you need to take it). Amazing!

Lee is such an amazing professor to have. He makes lots of jokes with the class and truly cares about his field of profession. There are only a few assignments in the class so don't forget to do them! The only semi-difficult thing to do is the Land Use Report at the end of the semester because there isn't an outline to follow, but it isn't too bad.

Burras is hands down one of the best professors I have had the pleasure of interacting with. His lectures are interesting, engaging, and thought-provoking. He communicates clearly and is attentive to every question, concern, or discussion a student has. Professors like Burras are one of the reasons why I am proud to call myself a cyclone.

Great guy, teaches real skills, and in a way that is easy to learn. By far the best teacher I have ever had. Simple and effective teaching style. Class is interesting and captivating, and he is great at conveying knowlege to his audience.
Lee is a beast, if you have the opportunity to take this class or any class with him I would highly recommend taking it.
Take every class you can from Burras. He's a great guy and will give you good advice for your career.

Lee is awesome. He is a great professor and really cares for his students. He prioritizes students' understanding rather than throwing exams at them to make their life hard. I would highly recommend taking any course with him.

Burras is one of my favorite professors to date. He is extremely helpful and puts more emphasis on the basics and real-life application of the things we learned in class. He knows when the class doesn't understand something and is extremely understanding of who he is teaching. I have thus far taken 3 classes with him and highly recommend him.
Makes learning about soils a lot more interesting!

Dr. Burras is fantastic. Very intelligent, and fun to listen to. His lectures are engaging and entertaining, and if you put in a minor amount of effort, you will easily pass the class. Criteria is very clear and he is available for help outside the class.

He was easily my favorite professor in agronomy! Tests are not difficult and gives you all information needed to be succesful on them. He lectures 100% of the time but they're enjoyable and he is funny. Does everything to make sure we can do well. Show up to class and you will do great.
Very good professor, knows his material and uses real life examples. He will cancel class just because he feels like it. Highly recommend.

One of the best professors I've had here! He cares so much about the information he's sharing and is so dedicated to making it interesting and understandable for us. His lectures were always fun and I found myself never wanting to miss his classes.

One of the only profs who treats students with respect and has made COVID adjustments that are helpful. Always accepts late work and will give extension. Lectures were entertaining and relevant to the real world.

My favorite professor ever! his class is never boring, he knows his stuff, and he's considerate towards his students. If steve martin was an agronomist this would be him. I can't tell you enough how much I love being around this guy.
This guy is great. Honest and funny. He gives valuable real-life advice/information along with class material. Knows his stuff. If you have a chance, take his class.

I love Dr. Burras and will take more classes with him in the future. He cares about all of his students and genuinely wants you to succeed in his classes. Willing to answer questions and willing to discuss grading on assignments and exams. A great professor overall.
Very Good

Lee was one of the greatest professors I've ever had. His lectures were always interesting and he was one of the most kind, caring, and optimistic people I've ever met. He genuinely cared about all of his students and he made sure we always knew that he had hope for us and that we were going to save the world. It was an easy A, but I learned a lot.
Lecture quiz everyday after every lecture. No extra credit and one make up exam.
Lectures are engaging and she explains topics well. She like to blow things up as well in lectures for demonstrations.

literally the kindest, most helpful professor ive had so far.  she is always willing to help you after class and during office hours, and actually spends time making sure you understand the concepts. TA is really good too. GOAT professor

She is a great professor
moves very fast and doesnt explain well
She is great and really takes time to get to know each student. Her lectures are amazing.
Great professor, moves at the perfect pace. 100% recommend taking CHEM163 with Burke

Kathy is AWESOME! She makes lectures entertaining and it's clear she wants all of her students to succeed. Attendance is recorded. The tests aren't overwhelming, and she gives a lot of opportunity for some extra bonus point. Kathy is an amazing professor. I wish I could have her again! Super sweet and extremely understanding. She is willing to do whatever it takes to help you succeed. I would highly recommend her to anyone!

Dr. Burke has been my most helpful professor since I have attended Iowa State. I would seriously recommend her as a professor if you have a choice!
If you don't want to wake up early and go to the lectures they are all recorded and you can watch them whenever you want. She moves slowly through difficult topics and is a great chem teacher.

Absolutely lovely woman, she goes over topics multiple times and does her best to ensure that students are understanding the material. She records the lectures and posts them after each class. She is super caring and willing to accommodate to student's needs. If you're worried about taking chemistry, you have nothing to worry about if you have her!

Professor Burke was a great lecturer for Chem 163. She goes over things multiple times and is very passionate about students doing well. There are also a lot of opportunities for help if needed. This class was a lot easier since she was lecturing it.

One of the most caring professor at Iowa state. I usually dont write reviews for professors but Kathy deserves the love. She puts in a lot of effort to help students, and if ur struggling with anything just email her and she will 100000% help u. Her lectures are very understanding. She knows what she is teaching. She is the best.

Dr. Burke is the best professor I will probably ever have. She makes sure to go super slow so that everyone can understand the material thoroughly. She is very sweet and you can tell her entire goal is to help students. One of the most helpful professors ever. I feel prepared to take Chem 177 now after this class.
An amazing lady, very personable and cares deeply about all her students. She makes me want to take Chem.
Shes awesome and personable!! Also, she explains things well and has really fun experiments
Amazing teacher.

reviews.comment: I took her class last semester when Covid hit. She was on zoom with me constantly helping me understand things. And always so encouraging. Seriously awesome lady who just loves chemistry

reviews.comment: Kathy made the class fun and easy. If you pay attention and do your work you are bound to succeed in her class. She is friendly and willing to work with you.
