reviews.comment: Kathy is the best professor I've had at Iowa State! She is willing to give extra help outside of class, and wants all of her students to understand and be successful in the class.

She is an amazing professor that genuinely cares that you understand and wants you to pass. I wish she would teach harder classes because she would make everything seem so easy. 10/10 don't be nervous to take her class. She is amazing.
Kathy is great. Really makes sure we're prepared for lab and recitation. Lecture goes at a good pace, and there's always a fun demonstration at the end of lecture.

Although she likes things her way or the high way, she's very specific of how she likes things done. She's nice to approach and will answer your questions. Attendance points for lecture everyday, quiz every Thursday. Not a bad chemistry course, would take again. Very clear expectations for quiz's and exams too.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Such an amazing teacher. Why cant every teacher be as clear and helpful as her??

Kathy is a very sweet, caring teacher. She goes slowly through material to ensure everyone understands. She does lots of examples and demonstrations to keep things interesting and explains things in the easiest way possible. By far the BEST teacher I've ever had!!!

Prof Burke was 100% my favorite professor I've had at ISU. I dropped Chem 177 and fell back to 163 this semester and was very nervous to retake chemistry. Professor Burke made it so easy to understand and she genuinely cares about all of her students. She is the nicest professor and such a good person. If you have to take chemistry take it with her
Kathy is hands down my favorite professor I've had. She's a grandmotherly type and is outstandingly caring and passionate about helping students to succeed.

Kathy is such an amazing professor! I didn't take chemistry in high school, and I was scared having to take it in a half semester, thinking I wouldn't take anything in at all. But she's AMAZING at teaching, she goes at the student's pace, willing to do multiple examples so that everyone understands. I hope to get her in Chem163 next semester.

Professor Burke is an amazing professor. She is not only brilliant, but also cares about studens as real people with real lives. When my finger got infected, she got very worried, put bandage on it, and told me to go to the health center right after class. I said "oh it's fine" and she said that if a science prof is worried, you need to see a doc!"
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I was terrified to take a science class at Iowa State, but Dr. Burke spent the time to thoroughly explain difficult concepts. If you want to succeed in this course, attend lectures frequently, do all the homework and actively participate in recitation. She's really kind and energetic.

It was obvious Kathy is passionate about chemistry and her students succeeding.  She records the lectures and review sessions that way you can go back and review for exams. I found the notes she posts on Blackboard helpful to follow along in the lectures. The review sessions SHE does before exams are extremely helpful and an easy way to review.

My class with Kathy was the second time i was taking chemistry and i could not have asked for a better professor to retake the course. She was an incredible teacher and went so into detail with course work and make a difficult class very easy. She taught all of the short cuts and made sure everyone knew how to do everything.

I had been out of school for five years when I took Chem 50. I had also failed my high school chemistry class. Dr. Burke was absolutely excellent. After the class I finally understood how basic chemistry worked and prepared me well for my current chemistry class.

Kathy Burke is the best professor I have ever had. She knows her stuff and really wants the students to learn and not just pass. Some professors seem like they hide info so you figure it out for yourself, but she's so clear with her lectures and tells you exactly what you need to know. She also does a review before each exam personally, not a TA.

Dr. Burke is such an amazing person and professor. Even though there were over 200 people in the class, she made time to sit down with just me many times to go over material. If you put forth the effort, she would love to help you and get to know you. We still talk whenever we see each other. She is very hardworking and kind!
Thank you for such a great semester. By the way if you read this I am also sad of not having you as my prof anymore but i hope I get into a future lecture of yours.

I think words cannot give her what she deserves for rating. She is simply Great teacher. She cares about her students and at the end of semester she wishes to tach them again. She is one of the most rare teachers. I am absoluteness confident that anyone who get into her class should understand everything. I simply admire her efforts the most.

She is great. The lectures are easy to understand and at the end of the lecture their is a presentation that goes along with whatever topic for that day. The quizzes are mostly memorizing and math that mostly comes from the book. You can get the lecture notes online if you miss a class. Great professor!!!!
I had her for my chemistry 50 class and she was very good. She is great and explaining to everyone and making sure everyone understands. She also makes the class very interesting and interactive.

Love her!! She is the nicest professor and is soooo clear in her lectures. If you haven't taken chem in a while then she is the teacher for you!! Just pay attention and take notes. Its easy to follow along you just have to pay attention. She always gave cool experiment demos at the end of class too.

Her lectures are very interesting. I felt like I got something out of every class. At the end of every lecture she does some sort of experiment. Usually they are entertaining. She makes the class fun and easy. She gives out extra credit on every test and quiz and on homework and participation. She is really nice.

There's literally not enough I can say about this woman. I used to HATE chemistry with a passion but she manages to speak at a GREAT learning level, she's so helpful and would catch me in the hall after a test every now and then and have a genuine talk with me. She's a funny lady and she's an amazing teacher and I can tell she truly cares for us.
She's an amazing professor. Always willing to stay after and help, or set up a time to make things more clear. Will go over information until you understand it. She also is a very caring person!
She is a amazing teacher as long as you go to class.
Kathy is a great teacher, going into a chemistry class scary but with her help you will pass and learn a ton of practical things about science and chemistry. GREAT TEACHER

Kathy Burke is a wonderful professor! Absolutely great to work with and made a hard Chemistry class enjoyable. She breaks hard concepts down into pieces and helps you slowly learn it piece by piece! Such a caring person about her students and Chemistry. She has a demonstration every day to show. Very kind and willing to help! GREAT professor!

So interactive, loves her job, very easy to contact, explains hard concepts in easy ways, lab sucks, but her lectures show exactly what is on the test. Provides concrete examples and relates to real life. Homework for recitation each week (30 minutes or so), quiz once per week, tests every 3 to 4 weeks (she prepares you well), do reviews on bb

She is one of the best professors I have had at ISU. She definitely makes Chemistry interesting.  Dr. Burke knows her stuff and is very passionate about what she teaches. If you can have her as your professor I would take that opportunity without hesitating.

Kathy has been one of the few professors at ISU that remembered everything about me outside of class and that I continue to talk to. She is extremely nice and will take all the time you need to help you. She doesn't pressure you, and has a great way of explaining things. Best professor I've ever had, hands down.

Mrs. Burke is one of the nicest professors  I have ever had. I took chemistry from her over the summer. She prepared a demonstration everyday and made the class very interesting. She went out of her way multiple times to hold review sessions. I enjoyed her class very much! ISU is lucky to have her.

Honestly the best chemistry teacher I have ever had. I struggled so much with it before and she took each concept and broke it down so that it was extremely easy to understand. Always made chem interesting and was always willing to help you out if you didn't understand something. If you do your homework and pay attention, this class is an easy A.

Dr. Burke is amazing. I have never had a positive chemistry experience in my life until taking her class. She makes everything easy to understand and genuinely wants you to succeed. She tailors her classes around what students are having trouble with via feedback from TAs and actually goes over multiple problems in class. Easy exams. LOVE HER!!

She is the cutest old woman. She genuinely wants you to learn and has lots of really helpful hints. But only take this class if you really don't understand chemistry because otherwise it'll seem like a waste of your time.
She is AWESOME!!! Fav Science class yet.
Awesome professor, kept lectures enjoyable and was very eager to connect with students.

Kathy is without a doubt an amazing teacher. She wants you to do well. She makes sure you understand what she is saying. You mixes fun with chemistry which is a plus. If you have the chance to take chemistry with her, DO IT! Great professor.

She's one of the best professors ever. I started going to Dr. Burke's lecture & I understood so much more of her lectures & the way she worded it so we could understand it. She does a lot of examples and makes sure we understand it. Most of the time her lectures would completely filled. So make sure you sign up for her lectures if you get to.
Clear and helpful

I hate Chemistry but the professor made it extremely easy and understandable. My highest grade was in this class and I had no chem background. She takes time to explain complicated subjects and makes them easy. Learned a lot and actually enjoyed it a little. Fun demonstrations, manageable homework, tests are easy if you study.
good prof.

Katy Burke is one of the best and most amazing professors Iowa State University has to offer!!! She makes sure everyone is understand the information she's teaching if you ever have any questions she's always willing to meet and help you! She teaches in a way that doesn't make you feel dumb but more or less she teaches in laymen terms! Meet her!!!!
Kathy is awesome. She spoon feeds all the info you need to be successful in chem160 and 170. As for help or look a little confused and she is all about making sure you understand.
Awesome teacher. I used to not like chemistry at all, but she has made class very interesting!

I love this teacher, Kathy is very nice and truly cares, more than willing to go over things you don't understand and meet with you for extra help if needed.  Before taking her class I hadn't had HS Chem and was struggling I have learned so much from her! She makes the information easy to understand and relate to.
the best profeesor i've ever had the privelege to be taught by.  fantastic job of teaching at class's learning pace. willing to help out everyone.  take any available class from her.

Kathy Burke truly cares about her students educational growth. She is very patient with students and has a very effective teaching method. She is very enthusiastic and keeps class interesting. Take her chem 50 class if you are struggling with chemistry, it really helps.
Kathy is probably one of the best teachers i have ever had. she keeps thins interesting and wants you to do a good job in her classes.
She is a really nice teacher. She is  a good teacher and she wants everyone to do well. She will make study sessions for you and give you notes. She balances fun and work very well.

Annemarie Butler is an incredibly funny and engaging instructor. Attendance isn't required, save for select days that are reserved for graded class discussion days. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, always understanding and leads interesting discussions. Attendence is only "mandatory" 1 day each week for an in class discussion for free points. Besides that, the only other assignments are take-home exams and a final paper. Easy A, would take again.
My favorite professor I've ever had. A true intellectual and a lovely person as well.

Prof Butler made this class easier to get through. I hate philosophy, but taking it with her, she made it simpler. However, she is very monotone, and this class is just boring in general with the content. She is one of the better philosophy profs you can get. You would have a discussion question to turn in at the end of class, worth points.
Well prepared for class. All of the material on tests is presented in lectures. She is very good at explaining difficult concepts and answering questions.

Lectures are optional but insightful, interesting and help with exams. She does have a lot of readings, but you don't really have to do any of them. Only 3 exams and 2 papers make up the entire grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Butler is very helpful and courteous to students. Two exams have opportunities for extra credit, and she was very flexible with paper deadlines. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I suggest going to as many classes as you can.

Provides plenty of opportunity to improve your grade if you aren't happy with it. Flexible. Doesn't require attendance. Doesn't believe in invasive academic software. Just is happy to teach and very conversational when doing so.

I couldn't of asked for a better PHIL 343 professor. Highly recommend.

Butler is REALLY understanding that students have other demands outside of her class, and does a great job of making sure students understand the material without giving them busywork. My only reason for not giving her 5/5 is that I expected there to be a lot more discussion for a philosophy class, but it was mainly just listening to her lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Knowledgeable about the subject. Unfortunately, very boring lecturer. Very monotone and hard to follow because of this. There is lots of extra credit, but make sure you look into what the class covers to see if you would be interested in it. Unless you are trying to teach philosophy or be a philosopher, it is completely irrelevant to everyday life.

Professor Butler is one of the kindest professors I have met at Iowa State University. She is extremely accommodating for any problems that you may have with course material or subjects related to course material. Make sure you go to class as you will get lost if you don't. Makes philosophy 201 worth going to!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Go to class or don't pass, follow the lecture best you can. The more you write down for notes the better. All notes are usable on quizzes and tests. Annemarie was very understanding with late homework. The books for the class are actually interesting and help you understand her lecture. She brought a sense of humor, and really cared for her craft.

Philosophy is a hard subject. Prof. Butler is pretty gracious with grades, but you really need to attend class in order to do well. Daily quizzes aren't horrible and the tests are similar to the quizzes. No attendance required, but make sure you go or you won't understand the material. Plus she only counts 25 quizzes so every quiz after that is pts

Graded on 4 exams & easy quizzes. No final when I took it, but she mentioned there have been final projects in previous semesters. All necessary info was in the lectures & all hw is extra credit. Very interesting, an easy A, & Dr. Butler is super nice. A perfect class for non-math people needing math credits (no numbers involved, just logic!).

Lectures are everything. You don't have to attend class, but you'll be lost in the next lecture. You also don't have to buy the books, she will summarize them for you. Try to stay engaged in what she says and you'll be fine for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Excellent professor and the easiest class I've taken. Just show up, listen, and take notes -- there are no papers to write, and the reading I didn't think was necessary. Easy daily quizzes that she basically gives the answers to in a review before hand. Three tests, not cumulative, over parts of three main books and concepts. Easy gen ed.

All the homework is extra credit. The concepts are difficult but if you do the homework (4-6 hours/week) then the tests will be a breeze and you'll have a huge buffer of extra credit. Annemarie clearly outlines what she wants you to know and goes over everything in class before each quiz (daily). Highly recommend, she's amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Phil 207 is one of those classes where if you show up and complete and understand the homework, then you should definitely get an A. All of the homework is extra credit; the daily quizzes are pretty easy. If you do well on the quizzes, then you should do well on the exams. Instead of a final, there is a project. Dr. Butler is a great professor.

I really liked her! No curveballs and you can get an A even if philosophy isnt your thing. In class quizzes but she lets you make them up, so up to you if you go. She reviews whats on the quizzes right before though which is really nice. Gives a study guide to follow for exam prep. I went to class most of the time, didnt study a ton,and got an A

Annemarie is actually a decent instructor for Phil 201. I would highly recommend taking this course. She also has 5 point daily quizzes, but she tells you what to expect. Before a quiz, she reviews what you did the day before which is basically what is on the quiz. Don't really have to study, just pay attention.

Annemarie is amazing! Even though there is a 5 point quiz every day, if you do your homework and understand the material fairly well, you'll do a good job on the quizzes and tests. Homework is extra credit and there's always extra credit on the tests. She is hilarious and gives a lot of feedback. Overall, highly recommend 207 with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I love Annemarie. She's incredibly understanding and will work with you in order to make sure you do the best you can. She truly cares about her students, both as people and pupils.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Super nice professor, and very attentive to make sure all students get what they need. The class gets progressively more difficult so try to get all the extra-credit you can!

The structure of this class is excellent. Daily quizzes counted as attendance, and all homework was extra credit. One group project and a handful of tests. Everything graded tough but very fair. Doesn't take much effort except paying attention in class. She explains content very well and has a thorough understanding of the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Love Annemarie! The class overall is pretty difficult for me personally, especially since there are 4 question quizzes everyday that are true/false that are somewhat tricky. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: She's a great professor. If you don't understand something you can just ask her about it and she will explain it to you. Attendance isn't mandtory but you need to go to class or you will know nothing. She usually does 4 point tests, but she goes over the material before the test.

reviews.comment: Overall the entire grading system is tests and quizzes. There is only three tests and each quiz is four points. If you do bad, those will knock you down quickly.
She is an exceptional teacher with clear and distinct definitions and explanations. She is quite approachable, and easy to ask questions. Every concept will be understood if you put in the effort.
Read, do the assignments, and you'll pass. Not an easy show up and pass type of class. She's a tough but fair grader. Put some effort in and you'll get a fair grade.
She is a good professor. This is a tough course, you have to spend a lot of time

She was very interested in her subject, and it showed in the class. She was very willing to help anyone who needed extra explaining during and outside of class. Really enjoyed class time. Can mumble sometimes, but she warned us herself of that, and was willing to make adjustments so that she was clear.

Very knowledgeable on the subject, and great at providing examples to explain difficult material.  Weekly writing assignments are tough if you work over the weekends, but she asks specific questions that allow you to write a lot about them. Very funny (if you get her jokes) and likes to get into character. Provides great feedback on papers!

Dr. Butler obviously loves the material, and she is very good at explaining everything. She is very approachable and really wants to see everyone succeed. She tries to be fun, and she has a great personality.

Dr. Butler is a wonderful professor. She's clear, concise, and adds a nice touch of humor to what could be a very boring class with any other instructor. She goes at a nice enough pace for the slow learners, but speeds through enough for those that catch on quickly. And she's sooo cute and charming! Her look is part librarian part Disney princess.

The material in this course is difficult to understand, however she is very willing to help and homework is all extra credit, but you'll need to do it all. Tests are same as quizzes so make sure you do all of those

Prof. Butler was extremely helpful all semester. She takes her own views out of the picture and makes sure to give students an opportunity for opinion and discussion. Interesting class and an easy A. If you come to class there isn't really too much need to buy the books, either.
Really boring.  I didn't know what was going on all semester, but it must not be that hard because some how I pulled off an A.
Loved her as a person she's hilarious and as long as you pay some attention you should do well. Quizzes are easy.

Loved her as a teacher. I had taken PHIL 230 from her husband and did well so naturally I thought she'd be great. Need to pay attention and take notes, has daily quizzes (4?s T/F). Allows make-ups before tests. Go to her office hours if confused!! She goes through everything with you if needed. I never used the book, but sm say it helped them.

You take a quiz 10 minutes into class almost every day. The first 9 minutes of class she tells you the answers to the quiz you are about to take. Tests are a bit difficult, but only because you never pay attention after the first 9 minutes of class. Good easy class to take.

It can be very hard to understand the point she is making sometimes because she doesn't dumb it down at all. She uses very philosophical terms, even one's we're not required to know. She is very willing to help you out during office hours, but can still be quite confusing. You don't need to read the books because it's all described in the notes.

Annemarie is one of the best teachers I've had. She is intelligent and funny and very willing to give extra help. Her class is very structured and if you work hard and do all the homework, you will do well. She prepares us well for her predictable, if difficult, tests.

by far the most confusing class I have ever taken.  Started easy but by the last two exams I couldn't understand a single thing she was talking about. A waste of time and effort.  I def think I picked the wrong professor.

Ridiculously easy class. The first half of each lecture is a review of the previous lecture.  In-class quizzes are always about the material just discussed and you can make up all quizzes missed.  Just show up to class (or every other class) and you can easily get a good grade.  Not terribly interesting class.
Super cool. I 'd say brilliant.

Good professor, can sometimes appear boring but can spark your interests at key points. Grades hard on papers and exams and quizzes can sometimes be worded in a way you don't understand but if you look at the study guides and quizzes she gives you then you should do fine.

She can be difficult to understand at times, daily assgns aren't bad, tests are very particular - know vocab and know objections well. Pay attention and do h/w and you'll do fine. She's also an Eng teacher when grading papers - write well.
Saved my life
The goat  .
GOAT PROFESSOR. GOATED VIDEOS. Single-handedly taught me all of calculus
good sfdfsf

Technically didn't have him, but his online lectures were how I passed the class. Make sure to watch them all and the test prep ones. The class isn't easy, but you already know that if you're taking it.

Took Math 1500, truly one of the best overall professors on campus. Great at explaining things and is extremely supporting of his students, the only things to critique him on is he loves class participation and will pause looking at the class for 10-20 seconds waiting for someone to say something, other that that 10/10 professor.
the goat, wants the best for his students, lots of effort to help his students
WHAT A PROF! amazing lectures, also he solves so many questions for you to make sure you MASTER the content. a rare gem. huge respect
Best Math professor ever. 10/10 He puts in so much effort and I love the you-tube videos he uploads each week.
The professor clearly states his ideas as well as the required knowledge for the course. He is concise and stays on topic whole being aware of other methods.
Professor Butler was outstanding, very obvious that he cares for Iowa State students. Modest and smart.
Butler is a God here. Phenomenal man that loves his students more than any professor I've ever met. Even if you cannot get him for your lecture, you can watch his YouTube videos and do just as well.
Don't even have to explain its Steve Butler
goat math professor. simply the best. every lecture you learn something new, not just math.

Fantastic professor, gives thorough explanations with good visualizations. Also all around a great guy, stands outside the library with a good-luck sign before exams. Inspirational and super caring guy. Generally focuses on practical understanding/practice in class.
Good Teacher
Steve Butler is the reason I am doing good in calc. He has this amazing way of teaching and making you learn. One of the best professors in the country. He is Steve.
Butler's videos are getting me through Calc 4. He is calm and thorough and his examples are easy to follow.

By far the best calculus professor at ISU. Knows how to lighten the mood of his lectures while also explaining everything very well. Does lots of in-class examples to get you used to problems you will see on quizzes and tests. Also posts all of his lectures on YouTube @Beard Meets Calculus, which is great for review.
The actual goat of all Calculus

Nothing I can say hasn't already been said. Hilarious guy, constantly motivating students, and the endless amount of online resources to help in a pinch. If you go into a Calc exam feeling unprepared, you didn't try hard enough, because of the giant excess of material that is available to you.

Professor Butler is the best math teacher I've ever had. He's very funny and practically the Bob Ross of Calc. He teaches in a way designed for both audio and visual learners, as he has paper handouts for every lecture and solid videos for outside learning. I rearranged my schedule for next semester so I could have him as my math professor again.
Easily one of the best professors I have ever had. He was very easy to understand. There's nothing else to say other than I was blessed to have him conduct my calc three lectures.

Steve Butler is an amazing professor! His Calc 1 class was very well taught. He keeps his office hours accessible and every lecture is recorded and posted online within the same day. Steve provides resources to help studying and makes every single lecture engaging and fun. Would definitely recommend if you can take his course!
Math 2650 will be hard no matter which lecturer you take it with but Butler is an amazing professor who delivers the Calc III content extremely well!

He is an amazing professor and truly cares about his students. Not only does he have hours worth of videos worth watching but his lectures are great and he keeps them entertaining. I found the printouts he gives each lecture to be very helpful. The class its self is definitely hard but he does help make it easier for us.

Butler is the man. Stopped going to his lectures halfway through but watched his youtube videos and they helped tremendously. Would still suggest going in person to get a better understanding and a more quality learning experience.
Great YouTube videos
hes great, the class is hard itself
Amazing guy!

Professor Butler's lectures on YouTube and his website are super helpful, but his grading can be tough. Using unstuck study, ChatGPT, and attending study sessions helped me stay on top of the material. Overall, an engaging class with lots of resources.
Savior of all Calculus Students.
Steve is very passionate about math and spreading knowledge of calculus, and that passion allows him to be an amazing professor.
Butler is the goat

Steve Butler is a literal God. I had him for MATH 267 but I used his lectures for Calc 3 and they saved my life. He is one of the best professors I have ever had and I would recommend him to anyone. He is amazing and a math genius!

The GOAT. I've watched his videos from calc 1 to diff eq, and I could not have done it without them. His lecture videos are much more effective if you follow them up with the practice problem videos, but either way best math teacher I've ever had.

I skipped my actual Diff Eq lecture every day and watched the Butler videos instead. Butler explains concepts very simply and keeps his lectures engaging and fun. Because he's the course coordinator for a lot of the math classes, he structures the lecture videos to teach all the content you need for the exams and homework with no fluff. ISU legend!
This man is the GOAT of Iowa State. Only reason I passed my classes was his videos.
LeButler
I would not have passed Calc 2 if it was not for Prof Butler
Steve Butler is phenomenal, thats all that really needs to be said.
GOATED lecturer, but you do not want to take a test that he wrote.

This man has helped me get through the toughest of math problems, and he has helped me improve on how to solve calc 3 problems with step-by-step instructions. Honestly, I love this man. Thank you, Butler.

Before I start let's establish one thing, This man is the GOAT. He makes math better by adding jokes and always having a positive mindset. Literally, I had a different math teacher and all I did is watch his videos. Now, this does not mean calc 2 is an easy A. You are way off if you think that.
Everybody raves about Butler... but there's a reason for it. He is by far the best professor at Iowa State University.
Best professor ever

Professor Butler is the backbone of the Calculus department at ISU. His online lectures and practice make it possible to learn the material through the math track, and he provides ample resources on top of that. Using SI and Help Hours according to your personal understanding adds a lot to the class as well.
Steve Butler is the best math professor I have ever had.

This man is the holy grace of the Iowa State University math department and is probably one of the top 10 math professors in the nation in my opinion. People come to his diff equ lectures who aren't even in diff equ just to hear his jokes. Awesome man.
He has lots of videos on youtube and his website but you either understand his way or you don't. And for those students who don't understand his way it reflects in his grading.
He makes math funny, which makes Differential Equations a lot more bearable to learn.
Steve Butler is literally the goat
An extremely engaging professor who manages to use humor to teach effectively, and clearly cares about his students and his teaching.
Awesome teacher! He's what made calc 1 and 2 good!

Steve Butler is the best professor I've had. Makes lectures interesting, thoroughly explains every problem, and perfectly prepares students for his exams. Encourages students to make use of outside-of-class resources (which he offers plenty of), and also gives students general college/life advice since many of his students are younger. Amazing prof

Steve is one of the most well-known professors at Iowa State. He's super funny and genuinely loves math. His lectures are leisurely, and he has mastered the ability to teach students. The classes he teaches are very difficult, yet he manages to help most students succeed.
Steve is an awesome professor but Diff Eq was not an easy class in my opinion.
Great professor, actually make math not terrible.

Steve Butler's lectures were my favorite math lectures to go to. He can explain hard concepts in simple terms, certainly far better than any textbook I've read. The homework can be quite challenging at times, but all of the tests and quizzes felt reasonable and fair. Great class, would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lectures are very helpful with both clear explanations of topics and worked-through examples. Professor Butler loves math almost as much as he cares for his students and always brings energy and enthusiasm to lectures. Posts lecture videos and notes online for easy access and review. One of the only lectures I honestly look forward to each week.
He made me genuinely enjoy Calculus! His lectures are not only fun and engaging, but easy to understand.

Butler is a great professor who wants the best for you. His lectures are pretty straightforward and easy to understand. When I took the class, there was always one question on the weekly quiz that he had taught us how to solve beforehand. Just be sure to know your basic concepts like trigonometry and differentiation/integration.

This teacher is very over hyped and so is the whole math department. Lectures don't teach you anything he just does examples. If you want to pass this class you might as well not show up to lectures and learn on your own
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Wow. one of the best math classes that I've taken in a while. His lectures are AMAZING I would recommend anyone who is struggling with math to look at them.

Dr. Butler is an absolutely amazing professor. He makes any level of calculus easy to understand and follow through his videos. His transition to online courses was very good for students to adjust to as well. His videos are so in depth and helpful for homework and exams. If you can ever take a class with him, absolutely do.

He is the best. Theres not much else to say. Butler does an amazing job explaining things and he makes Calculus easy to understand, always explaining why and how things work and not just the formulas.

Steve has quite a reputation at Iowa State. His videos are very helpful and can help simplify complex topics. Other than his great teaching skills, he also has an amazing personality. Definitely a professor that you want to have!

An amazing professor that genuinely seems to enjoy what he's doing. Lectures can be lengthy but are extremely helpful. He is engaging, does lots of practice problems, and sometimes dresses up in videos! Grading and quiz/test schedules are all straightforward. The class isn't easy, but put the work in and you'll pass. (he's also active on reddit!)

I had another instructor for this class, but Butler's online videos were the only reason I passed. Cares greatly for students and makes learning fun with his excitement and his cringe jokes. The class is difficult but he is always willing to help students who reach out, and anyone should be able to pass if they take full advantage of all resources.
Butler is the GOAT of course. Be prepared for this class, he will make you work for the grade but it is passable.
Great teacher
Gave really good online lectures to explain everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Truly one of the greatest professors at Iowa State. Is great at explaining complex calculus topics and has videos you can watch if you decide not to attend the lectures. Very funny and seems like he actually enjoys teaching.
Excellent professor

By far one of the best professors I've had. The concepts are tough, but Butler teaches them well. He truly has your best interests at heart and is more than willing to help you, if you ask. Lectures are enjoyable, and available online. His exams are difficult, but if you study and practice you'll do well. Definitely go to his exam reviews!

The absolute greatest professor of all time. It is obvious he cares so much about his students and wants them to succeed. He makes lectures interesting with his humor, analogies, stories, and examples. Tests are challenging, and he knows that, but if put in the work, you will get a good grade. Go to help hours for the weekly quizzes.

The exams are hard, but he knows they are hard and they are well written. His lectures are amazing, and he records them and uploads them to youtube so you can rewatch them at any time. The quizzes are also extremly hard but he gives you a bank of questions that the quiz might have. I recommend getting in a group to work them out in advance.

Butler is an amazing professor who can help almost anyone learn calculus. He is extremely down to earth and one of the nicest professors I have ever had. His knowledge and love for the subject shines through when he teaches and I probably wouldn't have been able to pass without his help.
The man himself, Steve, inspired me to love mathematics. Also conveniently active on reddit!
Great professor, really one of the best I have had in my lifetime.

This man is a true lecture genius. He makes math interesting and ... fun? Never thought I'd say that but I think it's actually true. He knows everything he talks about like the back of his hand and knows exactly how to explain things to make them easy to understand.
You will not regret riding the B U T L E R W A V E

Butler was a great professor. I'm writing this as a warning to future students: study outside of class. If you don't get a problem, work until you know it. I didn't, and this class kicked my booty. Butler was an amazing professor, I just didn't take time outside the class to learn his material.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Solid mathematics professor

Butler is amazing. He makes the lectures extremely enjoyable. I really enjoyed having him to start my day. There does seem to be quite a bit of homework on MyMathLab, but I don't mind the extra practice.
An absolute god at calculus and down right the best professor I have ever had. Explains everything well and throughly and make the class interesting.
STEVE IS THE MATH GOD. BOW DOWN TO HIM

Literally the hardest class I have ever taken. That being said, I still think he is one of the best professors I have ever gotten a chance to have. The tests are extremely difficult and there's homework three times a week (which isn't that bad).

Steve Butler is a gift from heaven. This is my first semester having the opportunity to attend his lectures for Calculus. He generally cares about students. Although exams are tough sometimes, studying past exams and quizzes, will help you succeed. Go to office hours if all else fails!

Rather than go to my assigned professor's lectures I stayed home and watched Steve's recorded lectures. After taking the calc series at ISU I cannot recommend enough that you look elsewhere. I reached the end of the gauntlet thanks to the curve and doing well on homework. According to exam histograms, you might not. Here be dragons. Heed my warning

I had a different professor but just ended up going to Butler because I found myself watching his lectures online anyway. Steve is a great professor and if you put in the work, you can get a 60/60 on the exams. The exams are hard but Steve hold weekend review sessions to help students and gives us access to past exams. Great guy and great class.

Professor Butler makes math very interesting. His explanations are always above and beyond. He thinks of creative ways to help students visualize what is happening/going on. He is always open to help and even if he doesn't have office hours you most likely can go in and ask him about a problem or two, or concepts :)

Cant really avoid him since he coordinates all the Calc classes. Makes tests way harder than needed. And really the class is set up so that even if you dont understand anything you can still pass the class, as long as you do better than the bottom 25% of students. Cant really say I understand the setup, but a way funny guy who loves math.
Best calc professor you'll get at ISU. He goes at a good pace and explains things very well. He's also kind of funny and is considered a legend.

Never have felt worse about myself in my entire life. I maybe cried over this 10+ times. Confidence level was destroyed which is the ultimate goal of this class. Be prepared to be more stressed in your entire life. No class should ever be this difficult. Even my tutors were confused and said their years at calc before these exams were way easier.

Prof. Butler doesn't write every problem on the calc exams, take that from me who's done research with him. And no matter which teacher you have, you'll have the same exam as everyone else. Lectures are amazing, and he makes calculus so easy to understand. He's entertaining and makes me excited about my math major. He is THE BEST calc teacher ever.

Great lecturer--he makes the concepts easier to understand, does lots of good examples to solidify the concepts, and adds lots of jokes to keep listeners engaged. Exams can be difficult, but there is a curve.
Wonderful professor who cares about his students and their mathematical skills. Gives hard tests but they are curved to make up for it. Overall wonderful experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Steve is one of the better lecturers for Calculus, he posts his lectures on YouTube and makes the material understandable. He writes difficult questions into the exams that make you think, however they are not unfair since they are over material that he covers in class. With the curve, his class is very do-able.
Great Teacher, makes hard test

Steve Butler was the best professor I've ever had. He is always in a positive, cheerful mood. It's clear that he has an extreme passion for math and he loves teaching students. He keeps students engaged and makes the class even more enjoyable by adding jokes into lectures. Yes, the exams are challenging (&curved), but he does this because he cares.

Everyone is so amazed by Steve Butler, and yes his lectures are better than some and he is funny, but he makes the exams so much harder than they need to be and filled with tricky questions and I think a lot of people forget that. He is the reason why so many grades suffer in calc.

Steve Butler is the best math professor I've had. He's caring, funny, and makes math interesting. I'm someone who really hates math, but when I started attending Steve's lectures the passion he has really rubs off and makes you want to do better.
Lectures are terrible. His tests do not reflect the material and are written for students to fail.
If you have the opportunity to take a class with Prof Butler do it, you wont regret it! ARCTAN is a beautiful function
He really tests your knowledge and understanding, but is so accessible and his exam preparations are top notch. He give you everything you need to be successful, its up to you to utilize it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Steve Butler is a little goony, but he is one of the best professors I have ever had. I was really struggling with the professor I enrolled in. Then I started going to Butler's lectures and everything started making sense. Highly suggest taking his class.

Steve Butler is a great math instructor who genuinely cares about his students. His lectures set a standard of quality that's hard to top. His class is not easy, but very rewarding. Don't expect him to change your grade, his material is purposefully difficult to judge your overall knowledge. He is very approachable and witty.

Butler is the best professor I have had at ISU, period (took 165, 166, 265 with him). If you have a chance to take a class with him, do it! Lectures are incredible. Weekly quizzes will seem daunting at first, but are very good at preparing you for exams. Go to office hours if you need help. Very accessible. Genuinely wants his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The Philosopher Steven Butler is one of the greatest math thinkers of our time. This titan of mathematics is a champion of wit and humor. If you don't laugh or at least grin at his jokes, you do not have a soul. His beard is proof of his wisdom, and his exams ensure you of his majestic proficiency in mathematics. Know ARCTAN and the number 137.

Beautiful man, beautiful beard. His math sermons are unparalleled, and brings enlightenment to the masses. His lectures are online too for unlimited access. Beware his tricks and KNOW ARCTAN AND THE NUMBER 137, the mark of the Butler, and you shall pass.
very attractive

Butler is the best math professor I have had. He explains concepts very well, and you can tell he puts work into his lectures to help students understand. Going into his office hours was always beneficial and helped with the quizzes. He cares about his students, Math, and helping his student understand math. Truly one of a kind.

reviews.comment: The class is very difficult but Butler made the class tolerable. I attended his lecture because he was a million times better than the professor I was scheduled to have.
Steve Butler made A very hard class bearable. If you have a chance to take a class with Butler then you NEED TO TAKE IT WITH HIM!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: What isn't there to say about this phenomenal man? One of the best professors in the entire university. He is brilliant, hilarious, and caring. ISU is truly lucky to have him. I cannot stress this enough--go to his office hours!

Hands down one of the best professors at ISU. Very funny and very knowledgeable. As usual his exams are very difficult but attend his office hours and you will do well. Cherish your time with Dr. Butler. He is a true gem. I had him for Calc 1 in Fall 2016, for Calc II in Spring 2017, and now for Calc III in Fall 2017. I truly love this guy.
PHENOMENAL teacher. Explains concepts clearly. Makes you work for your grade. Funny lectures. My favorite teacher at ISU

Butler teaches Calculus in an amazing way that is easy for those who struggle to understand. He has office hours every week where he goes over the answers to his quiz questions. His tests are tough, but the whole class is curved so if you get a 60 or 70 on a test youre doing well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: 350 characters isnt enough for this glorious man. Perhaps the best Calc professor Ive had, 2nd to Dr. Lee. His lectures are captivating as well as informative, while writing fair tests that challenge you. He has a YouTube channel that is a huge help and gives quiz questions ahead of time which train you to understand the material. 10/10 Amazing.

Steve Butler is one of the most engaging professors I've had the pleasure of taking a class with at ISU. The difficult material is clearly explained and understandable. You can tell Butler puts a lot of effort into his lectures. The tests are some of the hardest Ive taken at ISU however. Make sure to really study the quiz problems and practice.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Butler is by no means easy. He teaches tough subjects, and he is very thorough in how he tests. Be prepared for very low test scores and to put alot of work in. He recently started putting his lectures on youtube which is very helpful especially since his notes are prewritten and it is easy to miss things in class.
Steve requires you to understand the concepts instead of just plugging numbers in
Best teacher ever
Give Steve the chili pepper
Posts lectures online so even if you don't have his lecture you can still watch it via youtube.

Butler is an amazing teacher. He posts all of his lectures online, which are extremely easy to learn from. His exams are really hard, but the average is always low. I got a D+ my first time taking Calc 3 (with a different professor) and really never understood anything. With Butler I actually understood what I was learning. Best math guy at ISU.

His test are difficult, but your grade is based off the standard deviation to the mean so failing the class is pretty difficult. He cares about his students and is very helpful during his office hours. He really gets you to understand the material. Best math professor at Iowa State.
Helpful. Really cares about his students.

Butler's lectures are funny and interesting, and he is good at explaining the material in a way that doesn't leave you panic-stricken. His tests are very hard (scores average just a little above 50%), but they are curved. Butler provides practice tests in class, which really helped me prepare for his tests.

This was by far my favorite prof and class so far. He is GREAT outside of class helping with hw or preparing for the weekly quizzes. He kept the lectures interesting and he was great at drawing the 3D components which was super helpful for me. Told lots of jokes too. Definitely expects an effort from his students but he is there to help you.

reviews.comment: Very great professor. I, unfortunately, wasn't putting in the work I should have been so I had to drop the class, but I can see if you want to learn the material, he wants you to learn it just as bad. Great professor with a friendly, inviting environment. Also, his office hours are incredible, really dedicated professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Butler is a great professor, but don't be afraid of your grade. Butler gives EXTREMELY hard tests (Where 50% is average) but curves the entire class. Once you learn this, then you don't need to be afraid as long as you are putting in the work to succeed. Also, one test gets dropped which helps a lot. You want to understand the material, take Butler

Dr. Butler has really great lectures that he posts online. Overall a good teacher. Very frustrating at times because his tests are very hard. If you prepare well and go to class the tests are manageable. Class is curved a decent amount but prepare well for tests.
Top notch professor. Very good lectures. He cares about the well being of the student and how they do. Very nice man.

Easily one of the nicest professors I've met. His tests are difficult but the average is typically around 50-60% stay above that and the curve will work out in your favor.   I did not open the book the entire semester. Take detailed notes and you will be fine. Always go to his office hours for the quiz reviews as these problems will come up again.

reviews.comment: Good professor. Engaging. Really loves writing hard tests. He has this force you to learn by making the class average a 55% and scaring you kind of idea.  It works. I don't think I would take another class with him though because the work to knowledge of calculus ratio seems really high with 7 tests and 13 quizzes overall in a semester.

reviews.comment: Keeps you engaged in lectures, makes them entertaining. Makes you want to learn more, however, his way of thinking through problems isn't exactly clear. Repitition of concepts and examples is key.

I have had Dr. Butler for Calc I and II. I absolutely love his teaching style. Lectures are very straight forward and easy to follow. His tests are no joke though. Prepare to prepare, my friend. Your grade might seem bad at first, but he has a unique curving system that helps a lot. Super nice guy and always willing to help. Definitely recommend!
Tests are difficult but pay attention to the average not the letter grade. Good teacher, kind of goofy but in a good way.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Butler is an astounding professor and one that you can very easily get along with. He is an EXTREMELY difficult  test writer, but it is for your benefit! He provides a crazy amount of office hours and private time that you can meet with him and he explains things so clearly. He and Arctan are a great couple. I really recommend Butler. 10/10
Great funny and engaging teacher

Incredibly hard class, especially for Calc 1. I did however get a ton out of the class and am currently taking Calc 2 with him this semester. His tests (all 4 or 5 of them excluding the midterm and final) were all very hard but god bless that curve. It's hard to know how you're doing in the class because he doesn't give letter grades until the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Tests are ridiculously hard, but he bumps up all the scores at the end

I loved this class! Professor Butler challenges his students, but you will get so much out of the class. Be prepared to take weekly quizzes, and 4 in class tests that will scare you! Go to office hours and do practice tests and you'll do great! There is a curve. He is a wonder guy and he is super funny! You'll be glad you had him as an educator:)

reviews.comment: You wont know if you passed until you get your final grade, but you can rest easy knowing that you are still better than everyone else who doesn't have Prof Butler. He has a sweet YouTube channel as well so check it out!
Butler was a great professor. Very difficult tests however. Attend office hour for quiz help. (it'll save your grade.)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Butler is hilarious! He writes really hard tests, but gives plenty of resources to prepare. If you prepare well for tests, your test score might still be low, but your end grade will be fine.
Great guy to have a difficult class with.

Fantastic Prof! Hard tests, but there's a wicked curve. Take the time to go to office hours. You won't use your book. You will laugh at his 'jokes.' Weekly quizzes are difficult, but he goes over everything thoroughly (again, go to office hours).

Great professor! Hard tests but makes up for it with very generous curves. I never looked at the book so you might want to hold off on buying it. He puts all his lectures online so you can go back and look at them. Very accessible for office hours and very helpful when studying for quizes.

I took Calculus I with Steve Butler. He is very knowledgeable and knows exactly what he's talking about. He's a bit of an odd character but it's sometimes entertaining. We had weekly quizzes with the problems, hints, and answers given to us in advance. If you don't know how to do the quiz problems, I strongly recommend going into his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Steve is... just not great. He can be funny, but tries a little hard sometimes and it gets lame.  His teaching is strange.
Eh. Did not enjoy the class

Dr. Butler is funny and explains concepts very well. However, his tests and quizzes are extremely difficult. His Calc 1 class consists of weekly homework, weekly quizzes, and 4 in-class tests, in addition to a departmental midterm.

Dr. Butler is great. By far one of the best professors I have ever had. He is very funny which makes lectures interesting. Not a whole lot of homework. The only downside is that the tests are extremely hard, but the class has a fairly generous curve. Dr. Butler cares about his students.

Overall, Butler just sucks.  He's hard, not clear at all with what he expects from you and what percent you need to get to get a certain grade. Overall, he just sucks. Stay clear. He also didn't care about how much you knew. He only cared if you represented it how he wanted it written. I received As in both Calc 1 and Calc 2.

Steve Butler is one of the best professors I have ever had.  If any engineer is reading this take his course before or during physics because you will ace physics. Funny, respectful and the best lecture notes I've ever seen.  I give my friends in UOI, NIU, and UCLA his lecture notes; that's how good he is.  TAKE PRACTICE EXAMS AND YOU'LL DO WELL!!!

tl;dr, great professor, will break your spirit with his tests, and lectures are great. I was a young lad, and thought to myself, "why this Butler fellow seems like a swell gentleman.". For in fact, Butler will be one of the best teachers that you learn from. But be warned, this class is not for those of weak constitution, the tests..; JUST DO IT!

Butler gives great lectures with very detailed notes. He is also really funny, so that makes the lectures more enjoyable. However, the average on all of the tests are around 50-60%, but it's hard to be mad at him with how nice of a guy he is. Hard tests, but they do get curved. Weekly quizzes with 2 random questions from 10  given in advance.
Butler is a fantastic teacher, he's hilarious and actually makes class enjoyable. Tests are difficult but are curved at the end of the semester.
The best professor I've had at Iowa State. Highly recommend him for those that struggle. He makes the lectures easy to understand and fun with his jokes.

I just hope that next semester I have a class that I'm half a excited to show up for. Butler was tough but fair, and extremely helpful in how simply great of a teacher he was. Also, shoutout to his SI leaders.
Great Teacher overall. I learned a lot about psychology and criminal justices from taking Math 265. Would take the class again in 3 dimensions!
Excellent teacher; Butler made a difficult class fun and easy to understand.
Dr. Butler is by far the best teacher I've ever had in college. If you work hard, you'll get the grade. Get ready for his sweetness.
Genuinely funny and teaches very clearly. I now enjoy math.

Dr. Butler is funny, engaging, and truly cares about how well his students are learning. His lectures are very well planned and he is more than happy to stop for questions. Dr. Butler clearly is interested in providing the best education i n mathematics that he possibly can and his passion for the subject shines through this trait.
he's hilarious if you undrestand underlining math suttleties
hilarious!

Prof Butler definitely raised my interest and enthusiasm levels in combinatorics and math. He covers the material at an even pace at an appropriate level, is responsive to student questions, and has fun stories and math problems to share.

Very funny, easygoing, and an enormously good teacher.  The tests are difficult but the grading policy is very lenient.  He's a funny guy and makes me like learning as much as he clearly likes teaching.  Can confirm that his beard is wicked.

This guy was hilarious. He really made calc 3 easy to understand and pain free. He's a silly guy, but that makes his class that much more enjoyable. A lot of math profs understand the material, but have no idea how to teach. He knows the stuff and how to teach it. Plus he's got a wicked beard.

Super helpful and genuinely caring! He is funny, and prepares you well. Our class was  much more prepared for final than any other section! I have had good math instructors before, but he is the best!

Dr. Butler is, in my opinion, one of the best math teachers at Iowa State! You can really tell that he loves math and wants everyone to love it as well. I would recommend taking any of his classes, but be prepared for amusing stories and anecdotes!
What everyone else said that was positive

If you have Butler, be prepared for some hard tests!  In the end he curves everything and you will be prepared for the final if you go to class.  He is one of the best teachers I've had at Iowa State.  Very clear lectures and throws in some humor.  A class where you need to go to class but you actually learn something.
One of the best math teachers I've had

Prof. Butler is a very knowledgeable teacher who cares about his students.  He orients the homework around his exams, so you've seen it all by the time the tests come around. Also includes alot of Math humor in his class, he's a funny guy anyway...
Easy class, lecture is only for the first 8 weeks. Bundy is a very clear and fun speaker and there is lots of extra credit. Attendance is very mandatory with location checked daily through top-hat.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: It is difficult content, but she does well at teaching it. Pay attention and ask questions in labs, math is worth 50% of the exam, there's math on the quizzes, and the labs are a good portion of your grade as well. Lectures are a little boring, but she is passionate and extremely willing to answer questions.
Attendance wasn't necessarily taken, but tophat questions were asked and apparently she is able to track to see if you were actually in the room.

Do not fall behind in this class. Do not skip a lecture. Bundy herself is fine; she just mostly teaches by explaining her slides, which is fine, but I am a visual learner, and concepts are very hard to grasp in this class. If you have not taken stats, do not take this class yet. I barely scraped by with a B- and I have taken stats.

Dr. Bundy is a great professor! She can be very tough when it comes to questions on exams, but paying attention in class will be the best help for that. The lab times are very helpful when applying the content, so pay attention and actually try so you can practice for the exams.
Really easy class, just kind of boring after career fair prep

Attendance is important (over 50% of your grade)!! Lectures themselves were as entertaining as an orientation class gets, but Dr. Bundy is a very sweet and passionate woman. She seems like she is on the go all the time, yet she always makes time to help students when needed.

This has been one of my favorite college courses. Going to lecture is a must because TopHat is worth a good chunk of your grade and she gives great exam tips during lecture. It would be easy for her to make this a hard class because of the content, but she gives plenty of chances to practice the knowledge through quizzes and labs.

Dr. Bundy is amazing! She really cares about the students she has in class. I had an issue with my advisor, and she gladly helped me get through the problem. Attendance is mandatory because of tophat and 56% of your grade is attendance, and go to your peer mentor group for attendance. Make sure to turn assignments in on time and you'll pass easily.

This class covers a LOT of material. Small quiz every week. Lab with a lab report every week but you can do it all during lab and get your answers checked, take advantage of that and ask questions! Three exams, not cumulative but they build on each other. Bundy is great, always willing to help you out and work with you. TopHat every day.

She is a great professor! I have had her for about three months, and she is very caring. She responds to emails very quickly and from what I can tell, she loves to get to know her students. She wants her students to succeed! If you are scared to talk to her, don't be!

Bundy is okay. She's very no-BS and shows no mercy if you need to miss a class. Only got less than an A because I didn't turn in a bigger assignment in time. She's pretty helpful if you need anything or any advice. The class is boring but that's to be expected, just make sure you go to class and your peer mentor group for attendance points.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bundy is amazing. ANS 110 is not the most fun of classes, but there is a lot you can learn. Tophat attendance is taken so show up!

Would definitely take another course taught by her!

Great teacher! Will answer questions outside of classroom and gives lots of encouragement. Show up and pass is a huge plus!

reviews.comment: Amazing, caring prof. Very good speaker. If you ever have issues with the class she is very nice to talk to. Show up to the peer mentor meetings.

This Lab animal course started as a test course, but has now been accepted into the curriculum. Dr. Bundy teaches this course with 2 other professors, but I found her lectures to be the most detailed/specific/educational. She does a great job explaining and adds personal stories to keep you focused. Wonderful labs and lots of hands on.

She seems like a caring prof who knows her stuff. The lectures are a bit boring but are relevant. She's accessible outside of class for questions and she answers them really well. Don't skip peer mentor meetings.
Bundy is okay, this class is super boring and she has to cover topics that suck just because its in the curriculum.
Dr. Bundy is by far the purest examples of a kind, respectful professor that would go out of her way to help. Would recommend her for any sort of consultation and classes.

This class is an experimental course, and this is only the 2nd time that is has been offered. I have just completed the course and it is one of the easiest classes ever. It is taught by Dr. Bundy, as well as 2 other professors. This class is very interesting and I learned a lot. The labs are very cool and interactive. I would definitely recommend!
Class is super easy, as long as you show up. She can sound a little harsher but once you talk to her one on one you'll see how nice and caring she really is, just don't piss her off though.

reviews.comment: I'm taking the 352 online summer class so this class moves faster but I feel like she's explaining everything very well that I don't feel overwhelmed by the pace.

reviews.comment: Not a very nice person but is very easy on the eyes..... very good looking
She's very helpful, pretty, and caring! She knows lots of good connections and can steer you if you are looking for something such as an internship or job opportunity.

She did a very good job about trying to make the class as interesting as possible. It was just an orientation course so not a lot of information about animals. You could tell she really cared. You get plenty of time to do assignments but make sure you turn them in on time.

reviews.comment: She is a great professor I would highly suggest her for any class she teaches. Very approachable for any questions you may have or even help with life.
Great teacher who is very approachable and explains things in class.

Absolutely incredible professor. She gives such good feedback on all works and essays, and very generously listens to her students. I am eager to take another class with Professor Burke in the future.

She is amazing, one of the best professors I've had at Iowa State so far. Graded on very few things, so make sure the midterm and final is well studied for. Basically we would have a reading, then discuss it in class for about every class. Heavy readings but as long as you understand the general premise it will work out fine.
