reviews.comment: If you are taking this class because you think it'll be easy, think again. It is extremely difficult and Cervato is a terrible professor. She makes the class way harder than it needs to be. There is a curve, but even with it, you'll have a hard time. Honestly, just do the best that you can and get out of there with a proud C.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very online orientated. Class isn't a lecture but instead a Q&A online for points. Homework is also online with videos and questions. I was able to look past the weird set up, because I find the content very interesting. Do not take for an easy A if it is not something you're interested in.  She is hard for some people to understand due to a stroke
Expect no teaching and be graded on material not explained.  She is very hard to understand due to a stroke.  Very difficult class. Drop the class if you can.
Hard to understand due to a stroke she had a couple years ago.  There is a lot of homework to do before every class meeting, and during every class she gives around 20 points (give or take a few).
She gives you a pre-test in class before the tests, but surprise there is only 1-2 questions that even relate to the pre-test.  Incredibly boring.  Covers multiple chapters per week.

Very little homework. This was an easy class for me, but I know some people thought the tests were hard. She goes through the material quickly, and you need to attend the lectures. If you like geology and take notes in class, you'll do great. Review days before tests are helpful for knowing what will be covered. Some questions are common sense!

Cervato is very, very hard to understand when she speaks. Most of it's not her fault, she had a stroke and has an accent, but talks very quickly and not very thoroughly during her slides so you go to write and look to see she's ahead. She did not go as in depth in topics even though she expects you to know the information in depth on the tests.
An easy class but she flies through lectures.  She loves Geology but she can be rude. Tests aren't hard but usually contain a couple questions that we never discussed.

Loves her subject, teaches it quite well (but also quickly, so be prepared to take a lot of notes). Material on the tests is usually all in the in-class powerpoints, which are posted online. Had to do a little bit of reading from the text. Has an agenda on global warming, and pretends to present it fairly, so be prepared. Overall, though, good.

I thought this class would be pretty easy, but she likes to fly through lectures making it impossible to take decent notes. Also, some things on the test were never discussed in lecture making them pretty difficult. She seemed nice, but this was definitely my least favorite class
She was very nice but not can be very hard to confront after class since she leaves so fast. Class was mostly graded on homework and in class quizzes so the final grades balance the hard tests.
impossible to reach in person. not very lenient

A somewhat challenging class. Curve really helps for how hard the tests are. Frustrating professor to try and talk to one on one about grading, or moving the final due to having another exam at the same time. Wouldnt recommend taking. Trys to influence student beliefs by pulling absurd statistics to support what she thinks.
She is so nice, but there is way too much material. It's a fasted paced class, and tests are very hard!
Thought it would be easy, but she goes very quick through power points. She also covers a lot of material, so tests are difficult. Make sure you do in class activities.
Came into this class thinking it was easy, but there is way too much material and she flies through it. Half of the material on the exams are taken from little things in the notes.

Classes are extremely boring, hard to pay attention, and it is difficult to comprehend all the information on her powerpoints. Tests are hard to study for due to the fact that there is so much information and most of it isn't on the test. Horrible teacher. Makes the class harder than it should be.

Should be an easy class, she just tries to make geology hard. Teacher is terrible, anyone could teach what she does. Ended up with an A- because of a mistake she made on my final grade. Wouldn't even hear me out and make the correction or email me back. Very unprofessional. Treats students like they're in 3rd grade.

She's a nice professor and if you attend class in order to not miss the suprise quizzes and in-class assignments, you will end up with a decent grade b/c of extra credit and her easy grading scale.  Take the class.
As long as you pay attention and study a little, its an easy class. She also offers a lot of extra credit opportunities. Her accent can be a little strange but nothing too challenging to understand.

Classes are pretty boring and it is difficult to comprehend all the information presented in a single class period. She puts all notes and ppts online before class; print and bring along. She treats the class like 1st graders, but then the tests are not so easy... 1st is simple, then they get progressively harder. Don't buy the textbook.
She is terrible. I took this class to get an easy A and ended up with a D+. It is a pointless class with her. Do not take any class with her.
Ms. Cervato was extremely hard to understand and the tests were incredibly challenging even for those that studied.

I though this class would be a good elective but it turned out not to be. It was not a enjoyable class to go to. Her infomation was hard to understand and she made her tests way to hard as well. I would not recommend to take this class with this professor. Keep on looking you will find a better prof.

I liked this class, and the professor. She made the material enjoyable. She posts lecture notes online. Don't skip class often, she give around 10 unannounced quizzes in the semester. The class has an AMAZING curve. Make sure you do the forecasts and the assignments, it hurts if you don't. The forecasts are easy points.

The material is easy and she provides many opportunities for points, but she is a rude person and her accent is hard to understand. She puts too many of her own opinions into the lectures and argues it as fact. She doesn't make learning about Earth as interesting as other teachers have.

I found the Professor very helpful when asked a question and additional Q & A on line. We did not use the book however it was helpful for deeper study of geology. Many find the subject boring, but after this class I love it!  For an older lady she looks great.
She's practically handing out A's in this class.

The teacher is nice and willing to help. The class is fairly difficult (b/c it's boring), even if you do go to class. I did poorly on the exams, however, there are in-class quizes and assignments. So go to class, and you'll be fine. You don't need the textbook.
Really easy class if you go over your notes, but difficult to pay attention because the material is kind of boring.

I heard the class was easy, and by no means was it. I attended class and still did very poorly on all the tests. I got D's on all of them.. however i ended up with a B- in the class?!? i would suggst a different course if you want an easy science class to fulfill requirements!

She is a nice teacher. Sometimes she puts up a lot of useless notes in class, so when it comes to studying it's a bit overwhelming. Otherwise, it is an easy class especially since extra credit and easy in-class assignments are given.
Highly recommended.  Great teacher.  Gives you everything you need to get an A.  Very Helpful!
Extremely helpful and fun

Geology of the Earth is definately a freshman course.  She spent class time discussing how to use Web CT!!!!  I took this course as a easy science w/o a lab and it was just that.  She style of teaching is geared heavily towards freshman, which means that a lot of times class is just ridiculous.  It is an easy course but completely babyfied.
Easy class.
Class is pretty easy.

if you go to class, d oyour work, don't worry about the tests much. did jeopordy and helped a lot. book wasn't very helpful ... class is where you fill in blnks she leaves in notes. everything you can make up except a few assignments.
She loves Geology and tries to make it relevant for the rest of us.  The class was okay, but there was definitely a lot of busy work that was not worth many points.  Tests are not too bad.

Only take a class from her if you have a high tolerance for BS and busywork.  It made me mad that she was still accepting late assignments several days or weeks after they were due.  If you aren't responsible enough to turn your work in on time, you don't deserve to pass.
just do what u have to do and go to class and u will get an A

Easiest class ever.  She highlights test material on her Powerpoints and accepts late homework with no penalty.  Class activities are usually pretty fun, lecture is usually interesting.  Tests are easy.

I think she is one of the best profs I have had! She does a wonderful job explaining things, make things very clear, and her activities in class are good. Excellent, and the people that don't like her are just stupid. It is geology 100 it really isn't that hard unless you really don't try! So go to class, don't be stupid & **** about something eas

She does so many stupid, pointless activities in class that it makes my head hurt.  Powerpoint lectures are full of crap that doesn't relate to the test.  Wastes time in class that could otherwise be spent doing something productive.
Excellent prof.  Love the accent!

Cinzia means well, but her powerpoints are extremely detailed and hard to follow.  She could make the class easier, but also a lot harder.  She's got some humor and an interesting accent.  She's gone a lot and so Flory takes over and that guy rocks.  I wouldn't recommend the class...take Astro/Geo!
I like her accent

Students complain that this class is hard and she teaches it like an upper level course-HELLO we're in college-it's not easy high school crap.  I got an EASY A in this class, and I loved it. It's easy if you review the chapters before the test.
Class is very boring.  Powerpoint presentations are repetitive.  Doesn't teach students how to do anything.  Is always gone for weeks during the semester.

Makes an entry-level class into a graduate-level type class.teaches students like they're experts already. makes daily forecasts a requirement...but doesn't explain how to do them very well.  tests are very difficult.  online assignments are also hard.
bad teacher, class not too bad but the assignments are worst i've ever done, tries to teach writing in a class of 300+ students, dosen't work
what should be an easy class was extremely hard - read from powerpoints everyday which is pointless and had forecasts which became a waste of time

Unwilling to help and work with students.  Annoying daily forcasts with confusing instructions.  Also a lot of stupid time consuming assignments that dont really teach you anything about what you are studying

This class was really boring and the tests were very hard. BUT.... the little forecasts that she has you do make all the difference in the grade. Make sure you do the forecasts every day so you can get a better grade. I got a 73% and I got an A.
Everyday in a really annoying voice:  Please turn off your cell phones.  Makes material much harder than it actually is. Take it from Taylor in the fall!!! Much easier!
No Comments
No Comments
Best professor I have ever seen.

Without a doubt the best professor on God's green earth. More classes should be taught like this. Koray is an engineering instructor that needs to be seen to believed; I am hard at words to describe my experience.

Koray is tough, but he works hard to inspire and motivate his students. Tries (and usually succeeds) to make lectures fun and interesting, and is available to help if you ask. Tests are difficult, but he's an incredibly easy grader. Homework is near impossible at times, and usually took me 6-8 hours per assignment. Overall, a great professor!
Raised my expectations for all other professors.

Professor Koray Celik is undoubtedly the best professor I have ever had.  He spends hours working on every lecture and clearly cares about his students.  At one point this semester, Koray drove to campus at 2:00am to help a student with a lab assignment.  He makes dull topics interesting and even inspiring.  Take every class you can with this guy.
he is amazing

Koray can get a little of topic from time to time, but nobody is more passionate about the subject. He puts in tons of time to make the class interesting and easier to understand. He is also pretty flexible with assignment deadlines, which is great for busy college students. I would definitely take another one of his classes in the future.

By far the best professor I have had here at ISU. At first I was intimidated by his teaching style, but after sticking to it I learned that all he really cares about is the future of his students. He molds the homework and tests to the students, he is always there when you need him, and most of all is very inspirational.

You want this professor. The class won't be easy, but it is rewarding. Koray has no problem responding to questions in class, office hours, or at 1 AM on the discussion boards or via email. His lectures have the highest attendance of any class I've ever taken, and for good reason. This is a professor you want, every time.

He does a great job of making material engaging. His outrageous projects, while not always politically correct, are fun and help teach the material. Just learn to take a joke people. Works very hard to help students and clearly puts in the extra effort. His innovative methods are a godsend in learning what is a tough topic.
The guy is crazy and awesome at the same time, in a good way. You will fondly remember this class for its uniqueness.

The best professor I have had yet. He is extremely eccentric but that made me want to attend class even more. You never know what he is going to do.  He makes sure that the majority of the class is on board with what he is talking about before he moves on. The only reason you shouldn't pass his class is if you don't let him know you're confused.
One of the most interesting and thoughtful courses I have taken. He makes you work hard, but it's worth it. I have learned a lot from him and he helped teach me more than any other class I've taken.

Koray cares about educating and preparing students for their future more than any other professor I've had at ISU. He puts a monumental effort into preparation of lectures and other class activities and truly wants to see students succeed. He goes the extra mile for students and his lectures are entertaining and easy to sit through.

Very entertaining lectures. He puts a lot of effort into them, so appreciate the details! Draws from his own experience, explains things in a less "technical" way sometimes, which gives you a different way of thinking. Loves analogies, hopefully you do too! Has an interesting way of seeing things and an unconventional, but engaging, teaching style.
While unconventional at times. He always had the students in mind. Twisting the syllabus around to fit the class as best as possible.

Koray has a unique teaching style where he really focuses on class participation and teaches more than just the minimum class requirements. He keeps his lectures very fun and entertaining. Uploads constantly to BB. He spends A TON of time outside of class to prepare amazing lectures. First CprE class that I look forward to attending!
Talks about himself and what he's done for 85% of class.  Assigns 3-4 times the amount of homework you should have.

Koray was an awesome senior design professor! He prides himself in helping his students succeed. Be prepared to be amazed by his current research experiments and his crazy life stories. Koray is the kind of professor who you WANT to work hard and deliver results. I hear his Cpr E 185 classes are suburb; I wish I could go back and take it with him.

Koray was my senior design advisor. He is very dedicated to his students. He has great work ethic and he knows how to motivate his students. I wish I would've taken more classes with him. He expects quality work; he makes sure you succeed but does not your hands. Definitely one of the best professors of the bests.

Koray was my group's adviser for Senior Design. He was a phenomenal adviser. We were given a difficult project, but with Koray's great help and expertise on seemingly everything, we were able to successfully complete our project! I am sure that our project would not have been completed without Koray as our adviser.

Very knowledgeable and passionate. Always helpful and encouraging, pushes you to go above and beyond. Full of crazy, fascinating stories about engineering. Excellent teacher, would recommend to anyone.
He pushed us hard, but that helped a lot to accomplish our goals. A great teacher.
He is a cool guy. Loves what he is doing and very helpful ! I had a great time in my senior design with him.
Very intelligent and passionate about his job. Very helpful, pushes his students to work hard.
One of the best profs I've ever had! He is very passionate about what he teaches and is willing to help those who don't understand things right away. He makes in hard in a good way.
Prof. Celik is an awesome professor to have--his teaching style is significantly different  than the typical professor, and he's super passionate about the subject he teaches!

This was probably the most difficult course I have ever taken (harder than 311 for me, personally). Soma did a good job at making the material seem approachable, but did struggle at times to understand why student's found the material to be difficult (she has been teaching this class for many years now). I enjoyed her office hours as well.
No use going to the class, she just reads point to point from her slides

One of my favorite professors! She gives you so much extra credit in exams and homework. She explains things well, and her teaching really brings out the charm of these abstract math concepts. Very accessible outside of class, wants you to succeed. I love the in-class activities, which encourage active learning. TAs are very helpful too.

Dr. Soma was a very good professor. She clearly cares about the success of her students. One thing I would say that MAJORLY helped me in this class was the practice exams. Make sure you do them before taking the exam! She typically gives a chance for 20 extra credit points each exam, but don't take this lightly. Tough class, but a good professor.

Super fast lecturer. She wanted students to read the notes before class, then she would fly straight through them. She tried her best to explain things and she typically had decent analogies. But sometimes no one would understand. Be prepared for a lot of content.
Hard class but good professor. She explains topics clearly in lecture using multiple analogies to help you learn. The course is hard but as a teacher she does well and teaching.
Soma is a great professor. If you are confused and go to her office hours she will work with you until you get it. If you study the exams are not hard. Homework is pretty difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Chaudhuri is a pretty good professor, but keep in mind this course, in general, can be difficult. This course starts with a pretty big curve, but it won't curve later, so be ready for that as well. Make sure you attend lectures (you have to anyway), do your homework, and use the practice exams. She clearly cares about her students' success as well.

Defiantly a difficult class to take and requires a lot of mental effort to understand the content. The material is very abstract and is way different from calculus. The lecture notes are organized but require long reading. The class is very test-heavy so make sure to attend reviews and ask questions. It is clear she wants everyone to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Chaudhuri is brilliant, she's literally an MIT graduate. She sometimes glosses over things that she may understand but the students do not, but I think she's a good lecturer overall. Most of the homework problems are taken directly from the notes, it's not as bad as people say. Also every week or so there is a pop quiz you complete with a partner
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Soma is a nice person however, prepare to be confused, run into pitfalls and get angry or cry. Discrete math is a snoozefest, all of the exam(80% of your grade), have 20% extra credit so it's possible to excel greatly in the course. Good luck getting TA help they can be just as lost. But hey at least you have 311 to look forward to next semester :)
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: AVOID THIS CLASS AT ALL COSTS - Professor doesn't help. All of the topics are incredibly boring and the slides are just read word for word. No point in going to the lectures because you will not learn anything but you have to because there are group assignments sometimes. Homework is very difficult and graded extremely harsh.

Dr. Chaudhuri does a great job being articulate in lectures. Answers complex questions on-the-spot and makes sure that everything she says is clear and accurate. This was my introduction to discrete-math-like courses and she did a very good job preparing me for later courses. She's very knowledgeable, and I'd highly recommend taking 230 with her.
What can I say? Prof. Chaudhuri's course is the root canal of comp. sci. courses. She just reads her slides which are usually just copied from other profs.
If you are going to take COMS230, please, and I mean please, take it with Christopher Quinn.
Lectures were fine but very boring. TA's were no help... they didn't know what they were doing either. She gives curves on tests which helps a lot and seems to care about her students.

Professor Chaudhuri is not a bad professor, but her lectures can get a little confusing sometimes. Her online notes are best, they're very clear in explaining the topics. In lecture she tends to talk in circles and it's easy to lose her. She seems strict on grading but she's nicer when it comes to exams because she recognizes they're hard.

230 is very unforgiving in the sense that if you don't understand the material intuitively, you may never. For her part, Dr. Chaudhuri goes out of her way to give you extra credit and opportunities (like office hours) for supplemental practice. You must do well on the homework, because it is often exactly what's on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 230 is hard, the content is different from anything learned up to this point. 80% of your grade is exams. Weekly HW is time consuming, but if you make a solid attempt, exam questions are typically very similar. This class is tough, but Chaudhuri is a very fair professor. She does not make the class harder than it should be and always offers help.

She is very nice, but she is not really good at explaining things and even overcomplicated the content. The lecture is heavy, and she is always in a rush trying to finish the material so it is hard to follow up on what she is saying sometimes. I am not saying her lecture is bad, just her teaching style doesn't match my learning style.
Homeworks and exams are very hard and graded very strictly if you deviate from the class notes. I don't think the grade I got was really fair

The class material isn't bad and I actually enjoyed it. She teaches well and the material relates to the homework. The problem is the exams. They are so much more complicated than any of the homework assignments and anything we learn in class. In total, exams are worth around 80% with the only other grade being the weekly homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If possible, avoid this professor at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Love her. One of the best professors I have taken, very caring, very down to earth. She is a good lecturer and even though there are a lot of homework she gives, she makes sure all of them are already included in the lecture notes. She is also very lenient to exam scores and extra credit. Study hard, do all the homework and you will pass.

I want to say something for Prof. Yeah, midterm and final exams are tough. But in that way, her students can learn more from the HW and Lecture because you have to learn deeper. Just believe yourself and focus on learning, you can get an A. By the way, you don't have to attend the course because she provides Course Videos and clear Notes.
Pretty bad. The Homeworks were really time-consuming, but what was worse was they never gave us any of the solutions. The exams were graded really harshly and took too long to complete.

Dr. Chaudhuri is kind and wants her students to pass. Met with her multiple times outside of class to review HW problems. HW is brutal; I would spend all Saturday and more working on the HW, but always did very well. HW problems are usually based on textbook problems. So much extra credit... Ended the course with a 110%. She is a good lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took the class years ago. Halfway through the semester it was announced that any student that had been caught using Course Hero to upload solutions to the homework had been reported to the university for cheating, and I believe over half the class failed at that point. Threatened to track your IP. I only passed because I had a tutor. Beware.
Worst professor ever.

She is not great at explaining material but will make an honest effort to try and answer questions and go more in depth. In my opinion the TA's are the best resource and you should rely on their office hours alot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The homework was always more complicated than the examples given, very time-consuming. Lectures were handwritten on the board, with no electronic copies or slides. Very fast-paced, instructor constantly watching time, would work problems wrong then stop to see if class noticed, often did not show the correct solution.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The homework was difficult and time consuming. The solutions and feedback was never given, even though you need to correct mistakes before exams. She is so paranoid about cheating it holds people back from improving in the course. The in class assignments are said to not be quizzes, yet you get 15 min and 2 ta for 50+ students.

The worst class I've ever had. She never gives answers to the homework and exams. She said that answers for homework can be found at CourseHero. If you are a person that learns from homework, it is the best that not to take this course with her. If you screw up an exam 25% each, you're doomed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She can be difficult to understand at times and doesn't give many examples but she is very caring about her students and seems to care about the grades of everyone in the class. I would recommend reading the sections before class to better understand it. Know going in that this class will be hard and very proof heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took this class twice, and she was by far the better teacher. Knowledgeable, goes at a reasonable pace, answers questions when they arise, and encourages visits to office hours. Just be warned - this isn't a class you can skip lectures routinely and expect to pass. Go to lecture, pay attention, and use office hours and you'll make it through.
Homework's are difficult and time consuming. All of the materials are covered thoroughly in class. Homework applies directly to the exams, understanding them will make the exams much easier.

The homework is very difficult to do. I found it hard to take the examples in class and apply them to the homework. She releases practice exams which is nice but will refuse to give out the answers out of fear they will end on Course Hero. The exams are pretty much your entire grade so if you have a bad day, good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The lectures are amazing and very helpful. She goes at a perfect speed so that you can follow along and take notes. She is super smart and got her graduate degree from MIT! Really kind and caring too for each student.

Soma is a great and fair teacher. Taking notes are mandatory to succeed. The textbook is used for weekly assignments. Read test questions carefully and check your work. Accuracy  Speed. Mistakes on assignments and tests will be costly. Go to Ghazaleh's office hours if she is a TA. She will thoroughly explain how to answer homework questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Horrible lecturer. Exams are 120 points out of 100 because she knows everyone will do poorly.

Did a very good job teaching the material, I really learned a lot. Occasionally, she would get off topic for a few minutes or get hung up on little details  about things when a comment is made. Homework was very helpful in learning the material and preparing for the tests. If you skip class it can be hard to catch back up.

The class is kind of hard to follow. Be sure to take notes, review them, and do the homework. If you are not a theory person, this class can be challenging. However, her tests are extremely fair! She is somewhat helpful in office hours, I recommend going to a TA instead. Recitation can also be helpful, but not necessary.

Chaudhuri is a very caring professor. She always tries to help the students as much as she can. The unfortunate thing is that she prefers to approach the material from her most comfortable perspective, which is a mathematical one. It can be a bit hard to follow along the proofs but you'll learn a lot. Be sure to spend time on the homework
Not my favorite material but  I felt like I learned enough of it. Plenty of extra credit too.

Entire class was lecture - no hands-on. HW given every week but no review of material until test time (outside of class), so if you don't understand the material, it's tough keeping up at times.  Doesn't communicate through WebCT like most other classes I've taken but does have e-mail listed on syllabus.
No Comments
Not a bad prof. Explained things fairly well. Exams had 120 possible points, graded out of 100. Homeworks had similar point structure (allows for extra credit).

Absolutely amazing woman who deserves so much credit! Super easy class that doesn't take up a whole lot of your time. Plus, you're done a month before classes end! Chris is so helpful and kind, and is a wonderful student advocate! Take every class you can with her!
This class can/will be confusing for some inane reason. However, Chris does a good job of making sense of it all and will help you with literally anything you need.
This class is a whirlwind but you learn a lot. Sometimes there are more questions than she can answer at one time, so be prepared to be patient on tax nights.

The material can be hard but is easier than 284 in my opinion. She does a good job of teaching material during lectures and is very helpful when you need it. There are excel projects which can be very hard and frustrating. Also a group assignment in class for each chapter that counts towards your grade

All time favorite professor, she actually cares about her students and the grades they receive in her class. I would love to have her again and will definitely keep contact with her after this course.

Professor Moon is so kind & really wants her students to succeed. Some concepts can be tricky, but the class was organized really well. We got to use handwritten notes for the exams and she even let us do corrections to earn exam points back. She is always willing to answer questions!

I loved Chris, she is a very hardworking professor and is knowledgeable on taxes. She was able to answer any and all questions I had, and even during the sessions with clients she would make sure she was available for on-the-fly questions. She also is very understanding if things pop up and will help you reschedule your times if needed.

I don't really understand the hate on this professor. Moon was a very nice professor and would do lots of examples in class, and would elaborate if you asked. My only worry was that the lectures felt rushed at times, and were not fully elaborated on in the moment.

I had her for ACCT 285 and did really well because I'm good at math, not because of her teaching. She doesn't respond to emails and often talks to you like you're dumb. She does cancel class a lot, but doesn't seem to know what's going on in regards to course material (said our exams were 96 pts the entire sem but they're actually out of 100)

Chris is a great professor who really cares about her students. Her lectures are usually pretty short and she provides workout problems/solutions for each chapter. Exams can be difficult, but there are plenty of given points throughout the course to boost your grade. She truly wants you to learn the content, so go to class and ask questions!

Chris is a very kind person, but she is not cut out to be a professor. Her lectures come from slides pulled directly from the textbook with little elaboration. The exams test on things that you have to research yourself outside of class. I have learned almost nothing in this course and feel like it's because of the professor more than the content.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a good educator. Gives out practice problems, grades for completion, posts solutions, but never works them out in class. Tests are also heavy on these kinds of work-out problems. Tests are heavy. Tests are also inconsistent: one will be open book/notes, next is strictly hand written notes and there is a lot of material (~70 slides per chapter).
I have no clue.

Dr. Cindy Yu is the best. She is a super understanding and considerate instructor with quick responses to questions. We used R to complete labs, and we had one homework assignment per week. One midterm and a final with great review. Sometimes slides and # of equations would get confusing, but its minor. Totally would recommend this professor.

Professor Yu is the best stats professor I have ever had. She is attentive, helpful, and cares about her students. She goes over many practice problems in class to prepare for the homework and is very accessible outside of class. If you get an answer wrong and explain why you think it was correct, she is very likely to give points back.

Cindy was my favorite professor this semester. Provided students with many working sheets/practice problems which made hw & tests a piece of cake. Slight accent so sit in the front. Easy to contact through email or office hours. She made stats fun & easy. Practice her sheets/hw and you will ace the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cindy is amazing, she explains material thoroughly and makes her own practice sheets and exam reviews that are so helpful.  The homework takes some time but she will answer questions after class.

Super helpful,  approachable, knows what she's talking about. You have to study for  exams and gives a tough-to-get but generous extra credit opportunity. Wonderful professor, fun sense of humor to counteract long lectures. STAT101 is helpful to have under your belt but she goes back to basics frequently to review.
One of my favourite teacher~~
EASY, HELPFUL!

Talks WAY too fast in lecture.  Each lecture is a race to finish as many PowerPoint slides as possible.  Difficult to keep up.  She is very helpful if you go to her office hours with a question.  Directions for homeworks are vague a lot of the time.  Her English is fine, just talks too fast!!!

Class was amazingly easy, but very boring.  You most likely won't learn anything.  She spends amazing amounts of time talking about things that could be fit into about 10 minutes.  However, decent amount of easy points.  Can't speak very well either.
She is fantastic and I love her

Overall this course was really fun. You learn alot about plants and you do not have to worry about getting a bad grade as long as you show up and do the homework (there is a lot of tophat). I don't know if I would say Dr. Haynes is a motherly figure as some did below (as she can come off quite stern) but she is not bad.

I'm in a few of Dr. Haynes classes, I can't wait to take more. she has a great way of engaging you during lectures and helps you understand the material. If you are taking 221 with her, my biggest advice is to read your textbook, It helps a lot; it gives you the exact answers that she is looking for. This varies depending on the class.

She's very chill and wants the class to be fun. She makes jokes and is very informative when answering questions. She also asks during class if the pace she is going is good to make sure people understand. A big part of your grade is attendance so make sure and go. She isn't the fastest when responding to emails but gets to it eventually.

Dr. Haynes is a great instructor! She is understanding, helpful, and overall wants you to succeed. It will be intimidating at first with all of the course work, but it's totally worth it. Great professor!
Haynes is a lovely professor. This class isnt too difficult. Show up to labs and turn in your work, youll pass. Haynes is a wonderful lady and understands that youre a normal human arent perfect.

Hort 424 was an online class. She did not have clear grading rubrics and would not answer emails when I had questions. This made it very hard to understand what was going on in the class. I learned a lot in the recorded lectures, but do not expect to get in contact with her through email.

Passionate professor and her lectures were full of great information. I have an interest in vegetable gardening and I needed a Life Science class, so that's why I took this class. There is little to no outside reading/work besides the occasional HW and reviewing for exams. Mostly about showing up, taking notes, and getting Top Hat points.

Dr. Haynes takes great pride in her teaching, and it shows. She uses well-written lecture slides complemented with in-class visual aids and demonstrations as well as field trips throughout the semester to keep things interesting. Excellent course if you're interested in getting an overview of home horticulture.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cindy was a great teacher. She is incredibly knowledgeable as well. She did have us do a lot of group discussions but they were very helpful. Definitely recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Clearly loves to teach and talk about hort. Points every class for TH so don't miss. HW is laughable easy, which caused me to forget about some, but she forgave ALL of it and let me turn in late. Tests and subject is confusing for non-plant majors, lots of getting used to vocab. 4 Tests for 50 points, difficult but not impossible if you study.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I took this class Spring 2016. Dr. Haynes is a very fun and friendly professor. She loves what she does and is very excited about horticulture. She even took our class on walks to see the plants we have on campus. As long as you come to class, participate and listen to the lectures, you will be just fine.

Great professor for 121. Easy grader, easy and fun homework, easy exams. You always get 100% on clickers no matter what and she gives you the previous year's exams to study from that are literally the same thing as the current exams. Homework includes eating apples and going to Reiman gardens. Easiest class I've taken in a while, got over 100%.

Home Horticulture was easy and interesting. Sometimes she made people awkwardly talk among themselves which was always weird. But the tests are the same every year and it's easy to find the old questions on the internet. Clickers and tests are nearly all the points.

Cindy Haynes has to be one of the best professors at Iowa State University. She is passionate about what she teaches, active in her teaching, extremly knowledgable, and quick to answer questions. She is my favortie professor and does an awesome job at teaching!

If you want to learn about plants...take anything she teaches!  Plants are her passion and she will grace you with a whole new appreciation of just how beauitul and exciting the world of horticulture can be!  She can even make a Hedera Helix (English Ivy) a star!

Cindy plays favorites, if you're a suck-up and play her games you will do fine. Not a very professional teacher, we had magazine day once! Horticulture department would be better off with a different teacher.
Tests are easy and she will do online reviews before tests if the class wants her to.
Hard to memorize all the plants, but a good teacher and very helpful. Super nice and friendly!
Great teacher for those who WANT to be taught.  Don't waste your time if you're not interested in learning something.
Badass teacher. Hardest class I took, but she's good
No Comments
No Comments

Great lectures for first two-thirds of class. Last third (Turing Machines) gets complicated and vague. Class is similar to 230 & 311, but with less math and more relaxed grading. If you apply yourself on homework, exams will be a breeze (open note). He was super helpful in office hours. Great professor and clearly knows his stuff.

He teaches the course material very well up until you reach the last 4 weeks with Turing Machines where everything gets confusing fast. Speaks clearly but can have slightly sloppy handwriting. There is extra credit and Exams are very understandable and doable if you understand the Homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The grading criteria was clear and fair, and he was helpful in office hours. The grades are based on the homework and exams, 40% Homework, 60% Exams. The Homework assignments were not super easy but not very hard either, the exams are very similar to the homework. Textbook is not mandatory but I think reading it is required for getting a good grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The lecture can be a bit dry, but overall the professor is good at teaching. I was he spent more time on examples. There are few extra credit opportunities but they have nothing to do with the class. Exams are 2 or 3 easy questions with 1 tricky one. Homeworks are very hard(sometimes the average is an F). This class is slightly easier than 230/311.

While Dr. Ciardo is a brilliant man, he is a sloppy professor. His lectures are boring and difficult to follow derived directly from his course notes. His lectures provide no new insight, nor does he give examples. Paired with excessive weekly assignments, this course may easily become your life.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Homework is very difficult, I do not have a problem with this, however, the professor may or may not help with the homework. Partial credit is non-existent. Writes small on the whiteboard, and refuses to write bigger when asked. Desires only to rush through the material, difficult to get him to do necessary examples. Not fun.
Great class! Learned a lot!

Cindy is really sweet, and you shouldn't ever be scared if you don't have something done. But we were always behind the other classes and she was too easy on us. Other classes had much more impressive work because other teachers pushed their students.
She has no reasoning for why she doesn't like something and does not give clear instructions or feedback. You might as well just do what you like because she's impossible to please. Worst professor
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Are you ready to spend 50% of studio listening to her ramble? Great! Are you ready to get a C on your color wheel because you couldn't erase the pencil marks all the way? Great! I took this class as an easy A but it turns out it's my hardest and most stressful class. She misses class constantly and gives horrible feedback. The homework is so hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She rarely comes to class, but you are required to come to class anyway. You will have a few other lecturers, but they will have nothing to do with the class. Most homework is busy work. Didnt learn almost anything about actual color theory. I received As on all homework save for one exercise. Didnt miss more than the allowed absences. Got a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: She misses at least a dozen a little more then half way through the semester. shes really critical when it comes to your work but doesn't give a reason why you get the grade. she is long winded and is able to drag a small amount of learning into a full semester. I would have learned everything in a couple of weeks.
Cindy is a very perceptive and interested professor.  If you exhibit enthusiasm and dedication, she will reciprocate.  If you check out, she probably will too.
She is annoying, and not friendly

Nice teacher but class was not engaging. Lots of busywork-like mini projects. Didn't learn anything I didn't already know. Easy but she gets mad if you don't come to class and will take off a lot of points.
cute

She is a terrible teacher. She picked out all of our compistions, drew on our paper, and then took points off for it. The first drawing I did in her class, I got an "A" [no guidience from her] By the end with her help, my drawings were recieving "C"'s. I have 5 years of drawing under my belt, so I'm not hopeless. But if you're a newbie, stay away!
Class was useless.  Teacher didn't seem to know what she was talking about at times.  Required approximately 60 students to share two books since the book is out of print now.
Fairly good teacher but extremely long winded.  She is amazing at cramming half an hour of material into a full two hour class
Sweetest most caring woman in the world.  She was a great teacher and a delight to be around.  I would love to take her again for any other class...she is a wonderful teacher!
You'll pretty much never make her happy.

Show up to class and you will do just fine. He covers almost everything in his lectures and everything else comes from a couple short assignments each week. It really isn't as bad as other students make it out to be. I had a busy schedule and this barely added to my workload. Dr. Chase is super understanding and caring, and he welcomes questions.
A ton of outside of class readings, and videos.
He lectures you the whole class (so boring) expects you to read and watch videos for 20+ hours and then gives you an exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: RELIG210 has a heavy workload with lots of readings and quizzes. However, using tools like Quizlet and unstuck ai can make studying much easier. Overall, an okay elective if you're willing to put in the work.

Professor Chase is very understanding and clearly cares for his students. He has given me grace for multiple assignments when I didn't always need or deserve it. He was very understand when I was sick with covid and gave me extra time to work on assignments. The classroom environment was very welcoming and made discussions fun. Highly recommend.

I liked the content of RELIG 210 but would steer away from Professor Chase. Tests include very random questions about specific topics that we either breezed over in class or didn't talk about at all. Study guide given is broad and unhelpful which makes studying for tests difficult. It's definitely not the best elective credit option.

The classes content needs to be tore down and rebuilt. One religion a week and exams focus on architecture, readings, and music. If your looking for a class that talks about politics of religion, scientology, great awakening, and interactions between cultures, drop him and add the other 210 professor. They are entirely different classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he does not care about people
If you have him change or drop right away

Took RELIG 210 as an elective as I enjoyed RELIG 205 with a different professor. This professor required a lot of readings and videos you are assigned to watch weekly in order to complete the assignments, especially for a 200 level course. The number of readings and videos makes the workload seem very unapproachable and gives you burnout quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Easy professor as long as you pay attention and class and have half a brain.

Took this as an easy 3 credits, was way more work than I wanted. Passback is annoying, a lot of quizzes that you can retake as much as you want. Quizlet will be your best friend, don't miss too many assignments like me, regardless of how much of a chore they are.

He is a very good professor, in my opinion. There are many quizzes, but you can take them as many times as you want for an A. A lot of the exam questions are from the quizzes and lecture concepts, so take pictures of the quiz answers to study with. There are readings, but he only has you read sections of the book in class and then have a discussion

This class was honestly so unnecessarily hard.  There is A LOT of reading and quizzes.  The questions on the quizzes and tests are all over the place and pretty irrelevant.  It is impossible to study for the tests because the "study guides" he gives are ALL of the topics covered in that unit written in a list.

I took RELIG210 online, and the curriculum was very good. You can tell that Dr. Chase wants you to really learn the material and he uses diverse, interesting ways to learn it. He had 4 textbooks required for the class, which I thought was a bit much. (The Cataan one isn't really needed, I would definitely get the others though)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: A lot of stuff taught in the lecture was on the exams so it's pretty important to go. Whenever someone would ask a question he wouldn't directly answer the question and would give a lengthy pointless explanation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Chase himself is extremely passionate about what he teaches and it can be felt in every lecture, this is in my opinion the most important factor in learning the material and he aced it. The secondary days where we discussed questions he posed to us led us to asking interesting questions and naturally digesting the material. 10/10

Professor Chase provided a very welcoming environment in the classroom. He went above and beyond to answer questions, and I felt the assignments that were given were actually beneficial to my participation in the class. He answers questions thoroughly, and provides many opportunities for class discussion and engagement.
Dude was so unorganized, it hurt.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Chase is a very knowledgable guy, but the class was unnecessarily hard. There is a TON of reading, and the quizzes are often very difficult. Tests I found easier. Studying is very hard because lectures tend to be all over the place and the slides do not help. A lot of time spent outside of class, difficult to grasp, would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chase is a bit of a mess but he's a nice and knowledgeable guy. Very passionate about the class. I had trouble grasping some of the ideas and his PowerPoints are not helpful to look back on. There are quite a few books he asks you to buy, but I would just get the main one if I were you. He's a pretty easy grader and an understanding person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor was one of the worst I've taken at Iowa State. This guy changed the due date of the final on finals week messing up my schedule and making it even harder to study for. He puts quizzes and tests due on the same day thinking we don't have other stuff to do. Would not recommend 0/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took RELIG 210 from Chase. The class is very easy (if anyone says it's hard, they have poor study skills). Chase as a professor is knowledgable but unorganized and he appears to be lazy. He is continually late to create quizzes and exams that he says will be ready to take by a certain date and makes generic excuses to cover himself.

This class with this professor is the WORST class I have taken at ISU and I'm a senior. This professor is SUPER unorganized and assigns every assignment week-by-week, including tests and papers. So we only have a weeks heads-up when we have a test or a paper. He cares more about his title than the success of his students. Do not take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't take this class. Most disorganized religious studies professor at ISU. Will never take his classes again. He knows his stuff but over-explains everything. Prioritizes being a puppet for the university over his students. He'd rather look good to higher ups than organize a good class. Constantly changes due dates. DO NOT TAKE
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great lectures. There is quite a bit of reading involved. While it is a lot, it is best to read the source material for the religions and topics talked about so you aren't lost. Plus, he talks about the readings in class. He's also very good at answering questions. The film assignments are a bit dry but the questions are to the point.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Chase is extremely accepting of everyone and is very caring about how we do in his class. We had to do about 1.5 hours of reading for each week as well as occasional video assignments (which were easy and great grade boosters). Overall, a very knowledgeable and kind professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The material itself shouldn't be as hard as he makes it. We had 4-5 assigned readings every week, and his exams were entirely concept based. Reading quizzes and film assignments took up quite a bit of time outside of class, all online quizzes and exams. Studying for this class was more difficult than it should have been for a 200 level course
You will have to read A LOT for this class. Way to much to read. He's a really nice guy, he just expects a lot of work out of you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a caring guy and an expert in his field of study. But he gives you a crazy amount to read every week and will be quizzed on the reading every couple of weeks and will be on exams. On the weeks you don't have an exam or reading quiz you will be given film analysis assignments. Overall I would not take this course again because of the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really knew his stuff and taught pretty well. The only official homework was 30-minute videos we had to watch and answer questions on. There were multiple reading assignments a week, usually about 30 pages worth.

This class for an elective was extremely difficult for the credit. There was ALOT of reading for this class and alot of the times his lectures really weren't relevant or important. His slides were really hard to follow and he has 4 random pop quizzes that are very hard fill in the blanks. I wouldn't recommend taking this if you have the choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable guy. Not an easy elective that I was hoping for. The material itself is not difficult to comprehend, but he makes you work really hard for a good grade. I personally did not like that there were so few points in the gradebook and everything was weighted the same.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Cares about students and subject, but when you're a FIN major looking for an easy A, he really makes you work too hard for an elective. It was very annoying when studying hard for something that I care about to then have to work even harder in this class so it wouldn't tank my GPA. There's no "free points". Every little thing is difficult. Dropped

Dr. Chase loves what he does and is very knowledgeable and wants to expand his knowledge to his students. Often times though, he doesnt realize that a majority of his students know 0 background about different religions and so on. He explains big concepts but doesnt really explain them to where you can understand and learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Chase is interesting and knowledgeable, but does not prepare you for tests whatsoever and makes finding the required readings a game of hide and seek. His tests dont reflect the points he emphasized in class and often are over seemingly unimportant things.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I do well in all my classes.. this one however is a different story. I would suggest taking the class with another prof. because it is a great class, just not with him. Interesting lectures and material, but non of it shows up on the tests. Quizzes are easy, but the tests have nothing to do with the material covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Teacher was very clear whenever I had questions. The lectures were very interesting and the grade is based off of four tests. But honestly the tests weren't that hard. You can look up on quizlet all of the terms you need to know for the tests. They give you 50 minutes for the tests but they only took me 15 minutes. Study and you'll get a good grade
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Extremely rude professor and not understanding. I heard he was respected and could be possibly a good professor to take. I was wrong, I regret signing up for his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: While the online class wasn't awful, I didn't feel that I retained any information. Since the course is graded based solely off of four tests, there are no opportunities for extra points to help level your grade out if you screw up on one exam. To put things in perspective, I missed 6 questions in the entire class and that put me at a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Chase is very knowledgable and makes lectures interesting. However, if you don't attend lectures you will not get the grade you want. He gives out pop quizzes, but will also give you hints for questions on them and exams if you are in lecture. Overall, if you attend class and do the homework/assignments on time-this class can be super fun/easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Can be energetic in class and will yell occasionally to get an extra point across. 3 pop/he warns you quizzes in class. Reading quizzes and Exams are in the testing center but he usually plans them to be with in the same few days so you've got two tests to take really. A few film assignments that are not hard to do.

Chase knows his stuff and lectures were always interesting but the tests didn't match what we covered in lecture. Mid semester I lost being able to follow what he was talking about and our online reading quizzes seemed hugely irrelevant. Relig205 is an interesting class but I would suggest a different professor.

Dr. Chase is very respected by myself, but Rel 205 was quite challenging, despite having a tutor. We would go over information in lecture yet the information was very inconsistent with the tests. It's a very interesting class, but I would try to find a different professor if you want to take Rel 205

Chase is knowledgable, but he's not the best at teaching. He doesn't explain concepts very well and he's very unorganized when it comes to grading and posting homework. The tests were difficult to study for. I went to almost every class, took very detailed notes and studied for the tests, but I was always lost.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: DO NOT buy the "atlas of world religion", we NEVER used this. The main textbook is very necessary, however. I though he was a very good teacher, lecture heavy, vast understanding of the material, he knows literally any question you ask him. Class is very structured, but he will push things back and change dates if he needs to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There's only 3 tests given during the semester and they are all ridiculously hard. I studied as well as I could have, but there were just too many terms and notes covered to memorize everything. I only had to take this course to meet a university requirement, and for it to be this difficult when it didn't matter for my major, it was frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Chase is super intelligent and a great lecturer. What he won't tell you is that succeeding in his class often depends on rote memorization. You need to know terms and definitions, and you need to understand the fundamental concepts of every religion. Go to class and do your readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Grading criteria was clear. Don't miss the lectures,  participate and pay attention in class you'll probably come out with at least an "A". The tests weren't too hard as long as you study the slides and information on Bb. A frustrating part was the worksheets that are given during class, FIND a group and work together, my group had 7 people in it.

I was scared to take this course because everyone told me how hard it was. If you do the readings  you'll be fine. He's a very good teacher and will answer any questions you have. He tries to teach in many styles so all people who learn differently can understand.

Instead of providing a textbook that explains what he teaches, he assigns an atlas, which is very confusing to follow, and a scripture book, which when read feels like a foreign language. Class is unnecessarily hard and the teacher cares but he picks on certain students and the material is extremely tough to understand. Don't take with this prof

His presentations are awful to look at. I don't think I learned all the much about religion, more about the language than anything else. He also picks on the students who sit in the front. I learned more from looking up the religions studied on google than his class.

I found this class to be incredibly challenging and frustrating. Although Dr. Chase is very intelligent and cares about his students, there are only 6 quizzes/tests and they are very difficult. I attended class, read, and reviewed lectures and still struggled because much of the material on tests is confusing/not covered.

I hope you enjoy learning foreign languages because you pretty much have to learn one to pass this class. Do not take this class especially if you want to focus on your major.  Lots of unnecessary work here.

Dont take his class. On top of teaching various religious practices, this guy makes you learn all kinds of foreign words. When we studied sikhism and buddhism, he made us learn over 90 indian terms in about 3 weeks.  Sad part is most of these terms have an exact english equivalent.  He makes things a ton harder than they have to be.

Took notes in class and studied Professor Chase's lecture powerpoints for hours, and yet there is still a ton of information I'd never seen before on the test.  He cares about his students, and loves questions but good luck on tests, they're impossible.

Dr. Chase is very friendly and unbiased towards any religion. He seemed somewhat unorganized, and his powerpoint only included bullet points rather than explanations, and uses confusing words. There's a 7-10 paper about family history that sounds awful, but was actually interesting. Tests and quizzes are fine if you pay attention and skim the book.

I really enjoyed the class, but still fear failing because there are only a total of 6 grades: 3 quizzes and 3 exams. More opportunity for grades would have been great. There is an extra credit option but it involves watching a movie from the library (that only owns ONE COPY) and long story short... someone's not sharing. *eyeroll
Really loves what he does. I like how he doesn't spend more time on one religion than another. He really cares about teaching the students and uses voice inflection perfectly while lecturing.

The only way to get an ideal grade on his exams is if you're apart of the actual religion. Readings and going to class helps a lot, but most of his questions are super in depth and not found in the readings or class notes. I found myself spending most of my time studying for this class rather than the classes that pertained to my major. Good luck.
Thought it would be a fun class, because it was a topic I was interested in. No homework, only 3 quizzes and 3 tests.
Do readings and go to class!!!

Fantastic professor! He is very in depth with the material, but takes plenty of time to explain it all.  He adds a lot during lecture that aren't on the slides, so you need to be there to get the full picture.

Dr. Chase is friendly and great at teaching material and answering questions, but attendance and reading outside of lectures is a must if you want to come out of the class with a good grade. The final grade is based solely on 3 quizzes and 3 exams. Not an easy course, but very insightful and worth taking.
Tests are easy if you go to lectures. Watch a lot of films in class so that gets boring. Whole grade is 3 tests and 3 quizzes but they're very broad. Not biased towards any religion.

This class consists of three exams and three quizzes. If you mess up on one exam (like I did) you get screwed for the points and a total grade since there is not a lot of points. You will use your textbook and exams have questions on the readings.

If you are an engineer, I do not recommend that you take this class with Chase. I found myself spending all my time on classes related to my major rather than on a religion class. The class is out of 360 points based on three quizzes (60)+ 3 exams (300). If you mess up on one, getting an A in the class is very hard.

Your total grade is 3 quizzes and 3 exams. No study guide. No direct answers to your questions. A ton of information to study. I have As in all my classes besides this one. It's a D with only 1 quiz and 1 exam left. RIP my GPA.

Great professor- the concepts he teaches are pretty foreign to most people but he does a really good job at explaining them. This isn't a class you can skip! Each lecture is pretty dense but he emphasizes on the stuff he'll put on the exam. He's helpful when you have questions and he wants his students to do well as long as they put the effort in.

Interesting prof. Clear and engaging speaker.  Very helpful out of class.  Essays not too difficult. BUT if you are taking this class thinking it will be like sunday school, or to reassure you your own religion is the right one, you are going to be disappointed.

I wasn't looking forward to this as I took it to fill a mandatory requirement.  But Dr. Chase is a great lecturer and actually makes religion interesting.  He's more accessible during office hours than most profs and will work w/you outside of class too. Really a great experience with him.

This class was difficult because I did not put much effort into it. There is no homework, but there are quizzes in class. If you do not listen intently and review the notes THIS CAN BE VERY DIFFICULT. I did not buy the book or go in for help, because I just took this to fulfill a requirement.

Professor Chase is a very nice man, he does use a lot of complex words in his lectures but he is generally easy to understand. There are 3 Tests and Quizzes which are non-cumulative, and tests are multiple choice while quizzes are fill in the blank.  Fun class if interested
Very hard class for being an intro and very few options to get points. I would recommend finding a different professor. Not very easy to work with.

Took both intro religion courses with Dr. Chase. Sure there's a lot of difficult terminology but if you pay attention he'll give you extra tid-bits of information to help it sink in. Tests are easy and multiple choice (often 2 of the choices aren't even from the religion in question so if you actually read and study it's pretty easy) Overall great!

Quizzes and tests in this class are extremely hard, even with studying. If you don't have any prior knowledge of world religions, I recommend taking this class with another professor. Chase is very challenging for an entry level course.
Very nice man however a terrible teacher! Very hard course for being an intro
Prof. Chase is very knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. Study what he gives you in lectures and simply read the assigned readings and you'll do fine.

Great professor. Read the book, pay attention in class, ask questions when you dont understand, get a relatively easy A. Dr. Chase is extremely understanding and intelligent, but strict when he needs to be.

Prof. Chase was an amazing professor! He was super nice and really knows what he's talking about. He took the time to answer any questions and he was always willing to meet with anyone for questions after. We watched a lot of documentaries, which was nice. Although he says to read the texts, almost everything is covered in class. Easy tests.

He may not be the most interesting person or professor, but he definitely DOES know what he is talking about. I took an Intro to World Religions class with him that either put me to sleep, or made me extremely interested in the topic at hand. Didn't really use the text at all, just show up to lecture and the class will be extremely easy for you.

Was a very intense class considering the fact that it was supposed to be an intro class. Had a tough time on his test and quiz and I even study.I have heard they are better professor who teach this course
I thought this would be a very interesting class, but I found myself falling asleep each day. Very difficult and don't expect an A without a lot of work.

WONDERFUL professor. He is easy to understand, CHALLENGES you to actually learn, and is willing to go out of his way to help you understand. He doesn't try to baby you with easy tests, but these aren't easy concepts to understand. If you pay attention, study, and ask for help when you need it, you'll get the grade deserved, and learn a lot too.
Very helpful teacher. Cares about students and likes to interact with them. African American studies is a pretty easy class. 4 tests and an analysis over a reading due each week

I thought the class was pretty easy. I started reading the book at the beginning but then realized that 95 percent of the information on the test deals with lecture information so I simply started scanning the book.

worst class ever. It is supposed to be an introductory religion class but material is very advanced. Attended every class and sat in first row and still did very poorly in the class. Quiz's and test's are fill in the blank and need to be spelled correctly or no credit. Most of the answers are words from different languages.

If you're hoping to get an Easy "A" don't take this class.  It's pretty tough to get a good grade.  With this said I rarely looked at the book.. not sure if that would have helped.  The format of the class was sooooo boring.  He even said during the first class that it was going to be a dread.

Pleas save yourself now and switch to Northway! I did not take this advice and received my first c in my life!! He kind of tried to help when I went in for extra help...but still gave me 1 out of a lousy 2 points extra credit assignment. Boo---- Just do the smart thing and switch- although some of my friends did decent- i hated it

Want a good grade? DON'T take Relig 205 with Chase. It's delusion if Chase thinks the hardness level of this low-200 level class is appropriate. It's not. It's obscure, foreign, impenetrable material, it covers a vast amount, and the multiple choice and true/false tests don't make it any easier. He offers almost no Xcredit to make up for it. AVOID.

This class is SUPER hard. I failed every quiz except the one on Christianity. There is no extra credit and the class is sooo boring. There is no point in going to class because the slides are online, but the slides are so complicated anyways. Take it from a different professor!

I signed up because I needed a fluff easy A; but it was way harder than I expected it to be. Lots of detailed, specific material covered pretty quickly. Break out your flashcards: the obscure vocab is an a*kicker. The quizzes are easy to fail; be ready with studying. If you're interested in the subject, go for it, but be prepped to work hard.

he knows his stuff...almost too well, this class is HARD...if you're interested in this subject maybe just go sit in on plan on taking it pass fail unless you really wanna spend a LOT of time on this class

Definitely one of the harder classes. He expects you to know way too much. Tests can be EXTREMELY confusing since they're either over 2 completely different religions or 2 religions that are very alike (both ways are easily confusing) Also, his lecture slides are just all over the place and hard to read. He definitely knows his stuff though!

This class has so much reading. He gives you too much information that is not on the test. The lectures are rather boring as well. Most people dropped this class. I think he made a huge curve on this class because so many people would have failed. This class was such a snooze.

Professor Chase does a good job with this class.  He knows what he is talking about and tells you during the lecture what will be on the test.  As for the test being hard, that's a joke.  It's 25 multiple choice and 25 true/false, these tests are about as easy as they come at any university.
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS FROM PROFESSOR CHASE. very interesting topic, but very hard tests!! I would recommend taking it with a different teacher.

NOT an easy class, especially compared to a friend with a different professor. I struggled to pull off a B-, several people I know ended up lower. However, if World Religions are of interest to you he really knows his stuff and you could learn a lot.
Really hard

This guy is the worst i've had in 4 years..he uses terms and expects everyone to know them right away. if you like sitting through terribly boring lectures, taking quizes and tests that are very detail oriented than this is your class...not an easy  A or even C for that matter since half of our huge lecture was failing the class

Christopher Chase is a definately a good teacher. His lectures are interesting but very complex. You really need to keep up with the book if you really want the most out of his lectures. The test are not hard just make sure to study and you will be fine.
He tries to act like he knows more than he does. The test cover a lot of information.

Personally, I would not recommend this professor. The class is very challenging, and the lectures are not always clear or transparent. Exams and homework are quite difficult, and expectations can feel unclear at times. The professor also comes across as strict and not very flexible. Overall, it may be hard to earn an A in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very tough grader! Avoid at any cost. Exams and HWS are very tough. You have to read a lot to pass this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Toyin Clottley is an interesting person. He'll help you, but he can come off as very condescending and cocky. His material can feel rushed and not clear.  But if you ask for help, he'll make it clear. 

 I wouldn't retake him. By the way, I took DSB6200 or GSC7010 at Wayne State.

Avoid this professor at all cost! Took this class in Fall 2020. The quizzes are hard, the tests are extremely hard. This class will literally give you anxiety attacks. To top it off the professor doesnt care about you.

I really liked Professor Clottey. He's really easy to talk to and makes real efforts to help you when you have questions. We work through examples in class, which makes the material easier to understand. I give him a 4/5 instead of 5/5 because he rushes through the background info during lecture, and then a lot of the test questions are on those

The material covered in this course is very technical, so that makes the course tougher IMO. Dr. Clottey taught the course in three weekly 1-hr classes. At times it seemed rushed and a lot of information was presented, but if you take the time to go over the materials outside of class, you'll do just fine. The group projects were... Meh.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Clottey is a phenomenal instructor. He makes you work for your grade, but he wants to see you succeed. Would recommend you take 453 with him.

Dr. Clottey has a lot of energy which can be distracting at times. Many times his answers aren't clear when students ask questions. The group projects take a lot of time, but you learn a lot from them if you put the time into them. Tests are extremely hard (average in the 60-65 percentile). Grades curved at the end.
