Tests were really rough. Group projects were very tough. The whole class in tough in general. The material is super interesting, just the way he lectures, I would say try to take it with someone else. Good luck if you take it with him.

He knows the content extremely well is really likes teaching it. The class is extremely difficult to try to breeze through but if you put time into it, do the assignments, and go to class, it's not that bad.

He teaches topics quickly but thoroughly. He's super energetic and animated with his hands but it honestly helped keep my attention. He has a strong background in the material he teaches and it really shows in his lectures. Definitely one of my favorites in supply chain.

Very nice guy, but very hard class. You think you understand the material in class, especially with the in-class assignments, but when you get to the tests, it's a whole different story. The tests are very difficult. I would recommend taking this class with a different professor if you want a good grade.

He gives a lot of in-class assignments, but he will give you as much help as you ask for. He is super nice, and very eager to help students.  The tests are hard, but the material is complicated. I would highly recommend him. Also he generally lets you out of class early, when done with in-class. It is so awesome.
I learned a ton in this class.

Nice professor but strict as well. 5 simple homeworks are provided. 5 quizes---not hard, but need to review the slides and focus on very details. It's one of the most interesting classes in fisher, but it's not easy to get an A(A- is possible)

He is strict, inflexible and not confident in his teaching style. It's a hard and terrible subject to begin with, but he rarely has any say in the department so he doesn't have a hand in the exams, plus his strange accent and exaggerated hand gestures are most distracting to learning. He was a nice guy, but an incompetent teacher.

Clottey is very helpful, caring and explains the material rather well. I found the class difficult, not because of him but because of the material itself (it had been a year since my last Stats class!). Good professor, I would recommend him to anyone.

I thought the class was fairly difficult, but it's not his fault, it's the content. He genuinely cares about teaching and I highly advise going to his office hours. I highly recommend taking a class with him - he's a great educator.
She was very engaging, and the labs were so much fun, I would definitely take it again!
Claudia is very interesting and knowledgeable about microbiology.

Class was for Micro 3020L. She's amazing and so fun! Great teacher. Weekly quizzes in lab that are timed but look at the slides night before and take notes and you'll do good. Covered a wide variety of topics, and made wine in class. Class is required for Micro majors so let them register first otherwise I would definitely take this as an elective!

MICRO 3020L: Claudia was awesome! She made the lab so much fun, and I looked forward to going to every lab. The experiments in the lab are fun, and she always relates them to real life. I would highly recommend this lab for anyone interested in microbiology, immunology, or just for fun!
Low stress and fun class. All work is organized and the course manual is set up nicely.

Claudia was great to work with. She has a sense of humor and tries to make microbiology fun to learn for everyone. She does a decent job helping out with the labs and you don't get points taken off if the lab does not come out as expected for you. Overall, I would take a class again with this professor in a heartbeat.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Claudia is amazing! She's really funny, and does a great job at explaining what you'll be doing during lab. She'll make jokes, and tries to keep everything interesting and fun. She also relates things back to the real world, so that you can see that what you're doing in lab is actually done in practice by doctors and microbiologists.
Very open and a great contact if you ever need help
Quizzes over ever chapter in the book. If you read it their easy. He curved my class midterm, and gave us a day off for mental health. He extended several deadlines because of the class stress level.
He is super fair! He curved the midterm for my class and gave us a day off to take care of our mental health!

I really enjoyed class with Brandon! He doesn't act as if he's superior to you. He also talks about his life a lot, which I enjoy, I like to personally know my professors. There are three quizzes based on readings, two 4-6 page papers and a partner project. You'll need the books for class discussion and the quizzes. Class was very chill and relaxed
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Brandon was dope

Awesome professor. Class was so easy and fun, besides the multiple ratings and papers we had to do about 1 time every two weeks. The class is an easy A. Brandon was super cool and the class was practically just an open discussion over current events and historical events. Loved CI 204! If you don't show up, but you do the assignments you will pass
I personally thought he lectured too slow. However, he was funny and explained things very well, and answered all questions respectfully.
Was easy to understand and was funny.
great professor

Claus definitely overcomplicated this class compared to other professors. His examples made no sense in class, and he never fully explained his steps. The only saving grace is that he uses Butler's notes and has to rely on those. If you can take Calc III with Butler or Barloon, please do it.
Professor Kadelka was so funny, and it made lecture fun. Would definitely take a class with him again.
I liked Kadelka, his lectures were funny and engaging. He also used the Steve Butler notes which I appreciated because I could print them out and have less to copy down. Solid professor

His lectures are to the point and clear. He's also a funny guy, so it was worth attending. Calc 3 requires quite a bit of work so stay on top of your HW, attend help/office hours, and practice a lot, and you'll definitely do well.
Professor Kadelka is great and while lecture is optional, I find his lectures worth attending.
Overall very good professor, made a difficult class much easier

Dr. Kadelka has given me an amazing Calc 3 experience. I felt very comfortable taking this class straight after AP Calc BC. He is very good at explaining concepts and, most of the time, paves a clear pathway to getting on the right track to be successful. He definitely made Calc 3 my favorite class at ISU I've taken so far.

Great professor, would highly recommend going to lectures since he does a great job explaining the concepts. Overall, the math classes at Iowa State are made to be way more difficult than they need to be, but Professor Kadelka made it bearable and fun. If you can survive calc 2, then you should be able to do great in his class.

Dr. Kadelka was the best professor/teacher I have ever had. He is incredibly smart and can hold real discussions with his students to clear up misunderstandings. He learned names and used them often. He was not soft. We were something like 15-20% above average in grades. Incredibly smart, interesting lectures, very helpful. Dr. Kadelka was great.

Fantastic professor. Only reason I attended most of my lectures for Calc 3 in person. Very easy to understand and always went through problems and examples in a clear way. Most of the difficulty in the course came from it being Calc 3 and not him being a difficult professor. Always had a positive attitude and cracked jokes every once in a while.

Prof. Kadelka did a really good job of teaching Linear Algebra. Although I personally wasn't a huge fan of the guided notes we got, I found his lectures to be beneficial and he taught the material very thoroughly. He did a good job keeping the class engaged and cared a lot about his students.

Kadelka taught MATH207 for the first time when I took it and he was great. He explains everything nicely, and really tries his best to answer questions and get students to do exercises during class time. He is kind and willing to help during his office hours too. Just show up and pay attention. Linear algebra isn't as hard as the Calc courses.

Professor Kadelka went out of his way to make sure that the students felt that they were cared for and knew everyone's name (in a classroom). He is really good at lecturing and overall made my experience with Calc 3 very easy and enjoyable. I would definitely take him again or want to be part of his research in the future.
Loved having Dr Coffman again. He is knowledgeable and personable.
Has a clear passion for guiding learning and ensures students are heard. Knowledgeable and personable.
I took 1140 DO NOT TAKE THE CLASS COMPLETE WASTE OF TIME

423 was a fairly easy class if you attended lecture. His lectures are great and he cares so much about his students and therefore is super approachable and easy to access out of class. He really wants students to succeed. ONLY downside was he took a very long time to grade, but his exams and essays were not difficult so that wasn't much of an issue

dont usually care to do this, hes nice BUT had to say DO NOT take this class w him. We had to read research articles & do discussions or write papers in the weeks we had exams. exams are very hard short answer qs in class & only get 50 mins. no way to take notes &he assumes every1 knows what hes trying to explain. had to teach myself & did horrible
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Coffman was great at clearly explaining topics we were discussing. I was never lost when he was teaching our class. He likes to have small group discussions during class, which I think are helpful in talking through ideas.

He was a good professor, who just needed help with focus. The class was relatively easy, and I did well. His lectures can be tough to follow, but just go over the online quizzes before the exams and you will be fine. There is a lot of extra credit at the end of the semester.

Dr. Coffman can sometimes be a little scatter brain, but in my opinion that the lectures more engaging. He is very clear on grading and gives a lot of extra credit at the end of the semester. As long as you pay attention you will receive the grade you want
He is a really sweet guy who cares about his students. The class can be hard but he gives a lot of extra credit at the end.

Professor Coffman has 50% of the class for tests and 50% of the class for homework and TopHat. I would take advantage of going to every class and getting all the participation points as they are a life saver. You get 2 attempts at every exam, including the final. For tests, read the book and go to SI sessions, and you'll do well. He gives lots ofEC
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Personally, this was my hardest class due to Dr. Coffman's way of explaining information. He is such an intelligent man that it is sometimes too hard for him to break it down for a way that students understand his work. Make sure you do all the Mastering Biology and Top Hat questions as they boost your grade a lot!! Study hard for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I did NOT like having Coffman as a professor! His slides were unorganized and hard to take notes off of. I also did not like having to do group in-class worksheets because it was a waste of time to me. However, I did like that the tests had 2 attempts and one test was dropped at the end. That's the only reason I had a decent grade in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Coffman really wants his students to succeed. You get 2 attempts on all of the exams, including the final, and you can use your final as a drop test. He believes a lot in participation and extra credit to take pressure off exams. He is not the best teacher or exam writer, but gives ample extra credit and opportunity for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bio212 with Coffman was extremely difficult. I studied hours every week, never skipped a class, and still failed every exam. The exam questions were way more in depth than anything covered in class. Yes, you get two chances on exams, but it really did not help much. His lectures were very hard to follow because he is so smart and moved very fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class was co-taught and the exams he wrote were 10 times harder than the other professor's. His lectures do not help you learn whatsoever but you need to go to class because the class is 50% participation. You get to take each exam twice (including the final) and one exam is dropped (yes, including the final). Read the book & you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is such a smart professor, but he has a hard time taking what he knows and putting it on a level that undergrads can understand. He give to chances to take his test, which is really nice, but make sure you do his study guides and read the book!! His lecture slides are unorganized and so is he.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor I've had to date. Doesn't care about students, lectures at his own pace and doesn't care if you follow or not. You basically have to teach yourself the materials.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this class Spring 2016. Dr. Coffman is very friendly and wants his students to learn. He tries to come up with understandable examples for students. He knows that students are often worried about grades in this class, so one exam was dropped and extra opportunities for points were available. Be sure to read, participate and study.

Nice guy he's just really focused on group learning... I had this class in Troxel, a lecture hall, and we had assigned seats for the entire semester. We worked with the same groups every day to do worksheets and such that were turned in for credit. He's also super into clickers and that's what gets you attendance points. There was like 5 pts a day.

He gives two attempts on all tests over same questions. This makes his tests much easier. He encourages students to think about questions in his lecture and he may not tell you the correct answer directly. I will suggest you read the book at least once before taking the test. He gives so many extra credit at the end of the semester.

212 with Dr. Coffman is not too bad. He drops your lowest test score (final if applicable).   Attending class is a must since there are many clicker points and in class worksheets  Can be challenging to follow, but reading the textbook before lecture helps  Various extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Coffman was the best choice for this course. He gives so many resources to prepare student for exams. Weekly Quizzes are extremely similar to exams, and homework assignments are easy participation points, as well as the clicker points. He gives out lots of extra credit. He truly wants his students to succeed.

He lets you take exams twice, including the final. Gives tons of extra credit. Homework questions can be found online. Weekly quizzes are the exact same as what will be asked on the test. Not a very good lecturer but I honestly didn't need the lectures to pass the class. Only went for clicker points. Never read the book.

Coffman is the guy to take Biology 212 with if you want to learn the material well for  PreMed or anything.  He is like your old High school teacher that made you passionate about the class they taught. Sign up for his section and you will be glad you did.  Always go to class, there are worksheets and clickers every day. He gave TONS of EC points.

Coffman moved very fast in his lectures, and the information jumped all over the place making it very difficult to follow along in class. It helps to read the book, but the reading assignments are super long and time consuming. Exams were fairly simple and straight forward, with two attempts allowed.

Worst professor I've ever had. His lectures make no sense and rarely cover what is on the exam. His teaching style is extremely hard to follow and his exams will literally bring you to tears. SI is a must if you want to pass this class. The fact that he is considered qualified to teach has caused me to lose faith in humanity.

This class in general is hard, but having this professor will make it ten times worse. The powerpoints that he gives in class are scatter-brained, and he doesn't have a clear train of thought. He's a nice guy, but not the best professor. You better go to class AND get a tutor if you want a C.

The lectures are long and confusing most of the time. If you don't attend class, you most likely won't do well. The tests are hard and I would highly recommend a tutor. He is a nice and will help you a lot if you meet one on one but it is really hard to set up a time to meet.

At the beginning of the semester I thought he was absolutely ridiculous. However, a few weeks in, I got used to his strange methods and the class ended up being a breeze! He is really nice and appreciates any and all questions. He admits when he's wrong or doesn't know the answer. Gives a TON of extra credit opps. He is WAY BETTER than Dr. Peterson

If you have him in this class, GET A TUTOR! That was the only reason I got anything out of his class. He goes ridiculously fast through the slides so taking notes is almost impossible. Tons of clicker questions so attending class is mandatory if you want to pass.

The "think-pair-share" method takes up a LOT of time for discussion, so I felt like I didn't get much out of the lectures. He always seemed smug for some reason, which isn't an ideal quality in a professor. I started bringing my textbook to class so I could follow along, and that helped my comprehension a lot.

His teaching style is extremely interactive.  You need to understand the material before coming to class or you will feel lost the entire time.  He focuses on applying concepts, not memorizing facts.  It took a while to get used to, but I honesty think he is one of the best teachers I have ever had.  He really cares about his students.

The test questions are straight from the learning objectives most of which are covered in class.  I don't like group-based learning but it seems to be an emphasis for all sections of Bio212 even the online section.  Some of the rules in lecture made me feel I was in grade school (assigned seats, requiring different handwriting on group worksheets).

The lecture is not like other science classes I have taken.  Dr. Coffman is definitely not your average professor, he is very into class and group involvement which I believe IS helpful in learning concepts.  Do the pre-class reading, IT WILL HELP!  I enjoy that he uses a lot of demonstrations for topics and rewards participation with candy!
Worst professor I've ever had. Changes the syllabus every other day, ridiculous amounts of reading, textbook doesn't seem to match the powerpoints.

AWFUL PROFESSOR! Took his class for a total of two days and switched to another section. He doesn't teach, he expects the students to teach one another. He will randomly select a name from the class list and make you respond if selected. He makes you read hundreds of pages in the book then expects you to teach yourself the material.
Nice enough guy, awful teacher.
WORST TEACHER EVER.  Often answered questions with "I don't know." Class never focused on what was on the test. Prefers to ask questions of us without ever lecturing.
he gives lots of extra credit. I got Cs on all of the test and still got an A.

Dr. Coffman was the worst teacher I have ever had. NOTHING was taught in class by him because half of the time he didn't seem to know the material. The averages for exam scores were around 50%. I ended up with an A but I still felt the need to warn everyone. TRY TO GET OUT OF HIS CLASS!

Awful professor! If you have him switch as soon as possible. He is completely useless when you ask questions. His tests have nothing to do with his lectures. After taking this class I still have little to no idea what it was about.
WORST CLASS I EVER TOOK! He's amazing unhelpful. Gets way off topic, and is extremely defensive. If he is your professor, GET OUT. DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS.
The hardest class ever. Tests had nothing to do with the lecture.

If at all possible, get out. There is no hope. Lecture material is irrelevant to exams and the questions are agonizingly precise for the style he chooses to lecture with. No amount of studying will help.
Dr. Campbell is my favorite professor from the semester. Low-stress, not mandatory attendence, LOTS of extracredit. GREAT GUY 10000/10

He is such a chill guy. He wants everyone to succeed. Quizzes are unlimited until you reach a certain amount of points, and exams are take-home, online, open-note, open for 3 days. Drops one exam. If you come to class on a regular basis, maybe he'll give extra credit points. He loves his job and his students.

Dr. Campbell has such positive vibes. The class itself is an easy A as the exams are take-home, and often straight from the slides. He will always be there to help. The content is actually quite dense, but he does a great job of breaking things down. One of the kindest and most down to earth professors, I have ever had. Take this class!

Really nice guy,  the very first day he spent the entire class helping students find a lab of interest to apply for. He is very personable and and loves to chat and be chummy with his students. He is great at grading things on time, but there are a few assignments; so make sure to do your best work on them. He loves to give extra credit.

Wow. Best professor I've ever had in my entire college and high school career. 10/10 would take any of his classes again and will be taking any other classes that he offers. Couldn't ask for a better instructor. Also very funny and charismatic dude who makes lectures very interesting which makes me actually want to show up to class.

Clyde is by far the best professor I have ever had and I'm a senior. He cares so much about students succeeding in his classes, he doesn't worry about your grades he only cares that you actually understand the material and he is more than willing to help you do well in his courses. Wish every professor I've had was like him. 100/10 professor

I took Dr.Campbell's developmental biology course. The lectures were clear and very relevant to the exams. The group activities were helpful. Even while expecting a new baby during the pandemic, he was very together in his lectures. 
A very hard working teacher. 
Also, his wife does some really awesome research.
Dr Campbell is the best professor I ever had. There are no words to describe how awesome he is. He will probably get a Nobel prize one day so take his class!!!!!!!!!!!

I had professor Campbell for Bio 423 (Dev biology) it's a two professor class. He is the second professor. He is one of the most caring professors I've ever had being a stem major. He's always willing to talk about anything. He breaks that "hey I'm a professor and I'm better than you" view. The class isn't easy but he makes it digestible.

LOVE HIM. He really pours into his students and takes the time to make sure everyone understands the content. He will throw away all his plans to stay back after a lecture to explain something further. lectures are fun. Exams are easy if you pay attention in class. hw super helpful, gives good feedback and wont penalize you on hw for wrong answers

Dr. Clyde is the most caring professor I've ever had! He responds super quickly to emails and is always willing to answer your questions. He works very very hard to get your grades back to you ASAP with helpful (and sometimes funny) feedback and to make this class not only enjoyable but pertinent to your life as well.
Can't pass if you don't go to class; a lot of reading is assigned, but your grade is based exclusively on class participation and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I wouldn't take Wolf again; I can tell he cares about the subject but I hated that minimal things were graded, the only things in the grade book are the Midterm, Final, and attendance Top Hat quizzes. He takes attendance through Top Hat in the first 5 minutes of class, and after 5 minutes he locks it.

He's a very nice guy but oh my goodness is there a lot to memorize. There were only 2 major exams and the rest of the semester was attendance-based quizzes in TopHat. If you have Professor Wolf make a quizlet of every single term he gives you, and read every, and I mean EVERY, "optional" reading assigned.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was very challenging, but in the best way; I thoroughly enjoyed this class! We read about a wide range of topics, which were flexible depending on what direction class discussions went. Assignment feedback was very clear and fair, and Dr. Wolf definitely cares about helping students do well in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: There were only three assignments (10 points each), two exams, and one final. Attendance was mandatory and he did not update it often. If you fail one exam then it will completely screw you over for the rest of the semester. I found myself dreading this class every time I had a lecture. He seems nice as a person, but awful as a professor.

Very messy course. The syllabus was completely disregarded. Tests were easily graduate level. Class average was about 25%. The students grades drastically suffered because of this confusion/diffuculty. He tried to fix the chaos by saying he would "even it out in the end". This decreased grading transparency. Nice guy, but would not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: would put things on tests we never even learned. would go on tangents on one slide and never talked about anything else. Had no idea how to work top hat and would put our tests on that. made no sense when talking about things and was overall a horrible lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pr. Wolf is an amazing professor! I recommend taking a class with him ONLY if you are truly interested in the class topic. He assigns heavy readings every class, which is difficult, but he always gives reading outlines which are extremely helpful. Lectures amazing & mostly needed to pass. Work for your grade, and you'l come out with at least a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Wolf is so enthusiastic about teaching and very smart. He is the best lecturer I have ever had!

Dr. Wolf is AMAZING.  He cares, he'll go the extra mile or how ever far it takes to assist and facilitate your learning, and his knowledge about the subject matter is inspirational.  I would recommend a ANY CLASS he is connected to.  Many of the readings are not easy but he'll assist you all along the way.

Prof. Wolf is really interested in helping his students succeed. He went above and beyond to give us opportunities to do well, including giving us a "Redemption" Midterm after a ton of people failed the first one. He also was very open-minded to others' opinions and respectful. I would definitely take more of his classes.

He is so knowledgeable about everything he talks about. He gives you all the questions that will be on the test ahead of time so you can study exactly what will be tested, and then you pick four questions to actually answer on test day. He expects you to do the readings and be prepared for class, but that's easy. He is very willing to help you too.

Engaging and extremely passionate about what he is teaching. A medium amount of reading is required but they are discussed thoroughly in class. His assignments are easy and definitely make you more knowledgeable about the subject. I highly recommend taking a course with him.

One of the most engaging professors i've ecountered yet. Always keeps you thinking and is able to point you in the right direction when you are lost. He has so much to say, I loved every minute of it.
Prof. Wolf totally rocks!  His class takes a medium amount of reading, has 3 tests total, and 2 12-15 page papers.  I enjoy going every time!

You know you have failed as a professor if your final exam average is a 59%. I defintley learned alot of useful things from this class, but the scope of this class is so large that it hinders the ability to remember alot of those useful things. Lectures are boring and many of the images she shows are blurry and hard to make out.

She's extremely knowledgeable on the topic, which ends up hurting the course. It feels like Dr. Clarke wants to fit her decades of knowledge into 16 weeks of a course which simply isn't possible. It's a very difficult class simply because the scope of the information you're required to know is far too vast. Also there's 5 tests in the last 30 days.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: For Plant Systematics 366 the lectures are horribly boring. They don't talk hardly about any test materials or what we'll be going over for the practical. When there is practical, no study guide is provided and you'll have to go through the presentations that were never gone through in the first place.

I have mixed feelings on her. She's very knowledgeable on course material and clearly a kind person who cares, but she can make things more difficult than need be and isn't very accommodating. Her lectures aren't particularly engaging. I would take her again, but not as a first choice.

I really enjoyed Dr. Clarke's class; there is a lot of memorization but you are given old quizzes and tests to  study with. She also touches on points in lecture that will be on the test. She is overall very helpful if you go to her with something you are confused about. I learned a great deal in this class and feel like I actually retained it.
Better do your own studying outside of text materials and course notes, it's not easy.

She is a really dry lecturer...but is willing to help.  The material is pretty boring.  Lab is always done early, but stay as long as you can to learn the specimens. Use her practice tests online, they help for her wicked lecture tests.  Pop quizzes come up, so be ready.  A challenging class but you can get an A with hard work.

Initially did not like the class do to the format for grading on exams, but once you understand how he grades and sets up exams the class is very easy. Literally just write word for word what he has for notes. However, DON'T MISS A CLASS or have someone to get all the notes from it is the only way you will get those notes. Overall, nice guy.
Attend class and you wil do well

Professor Thomas does a clear job for MGMT 372 to provide great lectures, thorough exams, and proper assignments that align with the coursework. Participation will matter if you want to do well on the exams. There are two papers throughout the course that are not hard, but you need to be active about seeking feedback. Overall, a great professor!
Chill dude
Bet professor by far at Iowa State. Everything is straight forward but challenging. Professor T actually cares about his students learning.
Amazing Professor! He is probably the best teacher I have had at Iowa State by far.

Professor T's class was very straightforward and not too hard (if you put in just a little effort). He gave clear, helpful feedback and really cared about students. Lectures were important to attend, but he made them interesting, and taking notes was very easy. Tests were open book/open note, and he provided some practice problems. Great professor!

Professor T is one of the best professors I have had at Iowa State. He is extremely personable and makes an effort to learn the names of every one of his students. His lectures are incredibly engaging and are a nice change of pace compared to other classes. The class structure is set up for actual learning rather than memorization. Great professor.

Professor T is a great professor that gave the notes to the students and often is very patient with waiting for students to finish notes on a good pace. Often times, Professor T would engage with the class and remembers everyone's names which makes it extremely engaging when he is able to ask us questions.

Professor T is easily the most caring professor I have ever had at Iowa State. His class is challenging but if you pay attention and ask for help when you need it, you will succeed. He gives real world examples and demonstrations to help make learning easy and fun.

One of my favorite professors so far, Prof T really cares about students and even memorizes everyone's names in each of his classes. Exams can be tough but they are open note so if you show up to class and take good notes they should be easier. One long paper due at the end of the class but there are many opportunities for getting input from Prof T

Professor Thomas is a great teacher. He cares that students learn the material. MGMT is of no interest to me, but he made it interesting. The class isn't necessarily easy, but he makes it incredibly fair. If you follow his structure for the class you will have no problems with it. If he's an option, definitely take your class with Professor Thomas!

Clay cares about every one of his students, remembering all of their names by the end of the second week. In lectures, he brings real examples and is fun to work with. He wants everyone to do well and offers extra credit often. If you have to take management, take it with Clay, he's the GOAT.
Great and engaging professor who alters his teaching and class around what students want/need to succeed. He's always looking for ways to help students. I wish he could teach all of my classes.

You can tell that Professor T really cares for his students, but sometimes he does it in ways that are unprofessional and uncalled for. Overall, the class isn't super difficult, the exams are harder because he creates them himself, but if you pay attention in his class you should be fine.
Professor T gives good lectures and his exams match up with the content discussed in class. Homework is pretty simple. He cares about his students' success and is accessible.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Thomas is a great guy that cares about his students. Attendance is taken by going to class. Exams can be tricky as he writes them all himself so the wording on some can be bad. There are 2 large papers that are graded generously it is just exams that can be hard and confusing.

He is an amazing professor! I felt like I learned so much from this class, and he is the best professor I've had. The class uses an online textbook. The class does require effort, but if you pay attention and complete homework then it will pay off!

I really liked Professor T. His lectures were engaging, and he liked to get everyone involved. I actually felt like I learned valuable things in his class. He cares about all of his students and learns everyone's names. The exams were open note and were easy if you went to class and paid attention. I would definitely take him again!!

Professor. T is an amazing professor who is always caring and willing to listen. His tests can be difficult as he tends toward application rather than regurgitation but takes feedback and provides clarification for the next exam. If you are a student who finds themselves zoning out in a class then this is the professor for you. 100% recommend!

She isn't a bad professor by any means, but the class you are required to take with her your first year is quite boring. Her responses to questions can come off as "snarky" and/or unhelpful and her grading system, while very detailed and thought-out, can get confusing at times. (This is a review for DSNS 1100 and DSNS 1110, very similar classes)

The teacher normally just had other teachers teach the class. Participation matters, which I did not understand till the very end, when someone better explained how it worked. Plenty of extra credit. Be careful how you write, because some writing styles were flagged as AI.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is fine and easy. She's a bit rude, but an acceptable professor i suppose. Great academic advisor though

Honestly loved this professor. I just think the class she teaches and first year students are forced to take is just boring and useless. Lots of guest lectures and a grading system that can get confusing especially to college freshman.

Class is very easy. Its just participation based but shes very strict about it. Not much wiggle room for missing a weekly lecture. Drops your grade by a lot. Make sure to attend every single one of them. Can be very rude over emails for no reason.
The layout of the class is kind of weird. Don't underestimate the weight of your attendance grades, and don't put off the "optional" assignments.
Whole job is to help freshman settle in yet gave vague instructions and left little to none communication with grades and assignments. Very lazy when I came to grading

This class was such a slog. Mindy barely taught any of it, most of it was guest lectures. But, Mindy had control of grading and assignments and this was the most bogus system ever. There was EXTRA CREDIT and OPTIONAL assignments that were NOT optional if you want to even get a B. She should just have them be assignments.

She can be helpful, but she is very straightforward. She's like laidback but strict at the same time. I needed extra points to get to an A, and she said she couldn't do that but then the last day of class we had a tophat question for extra points. You must show up, she will call you out if you try and leave class. It is a points-based class!

Outside of the design major lectures, class was very boring. Outside of class participation points are needed to pass with anything higher than like a C. Was not the most professional at times through out the year. Class attendance wasn't mandatory, but that was a lie. Go to class or get a bad grade.

This class was required but the lectures were very boring. The participation points assignments that you had to do for your grade weren't interesting or helpful at all. We learned about all of the design majors in this class but that was the only productive thing all semester. Easy to control what grade you get. Attendance counts as points.
Lectures were early and boring, making it hard to stay awake. Gave good info but sometimes over-explained. Practice exams were required and graded, but exams were almost identical to practice.

Overall, this professor was not the best. I feel like she teaches the class in lectures like everyone in them took trigonometry in High School. Homework wasn't fully taught in lecture either. I once asked a question and she acted like it was obvious; never asked another question again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think she was pretty good. The lectures can be boring plus they're early. The only thing that really matters is the recitations and she was always helpful and made sure you understood what was going on. Very nice & clear when you ask questions or for help on problems. Also most of the practice exams were almost identical to the actual exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Taught content during lecture, but didn't give much quality during class, and the recitation put packets in front of us and wasn't much of a help since the stuff on the packet wasn't fully taught in lecture.

DONT EVER TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. SHE PICKS AND CHOOSES GRADES FOR PEOPLE. IF THIS IS DYCHES I MEAN. SHE OVER COMPLICATED EVERY SINGLE ASSIGNMENT AND WONT CREATE AN ASSIGNMENT TO TURN IN ON CANVAS UNTIL AFTER YOU DID IT IN CLASS. NEVER EVER EVER TAKE HER. GENUINELY MADE ME CONSIDER DROPPING EDUCATION.

Very unclear with instructions. Grading was inconsistent. Use of group activities were pointless. Course outline wasnt used. Dont understand why she even made a syllabus because she didnt follow it from day 1

She is super unorganized, but the class is super easy. Do not buy the book for this class because you won't need it. Tests are pretty easy. Everything she says will be unclear and confusing but you will be fine in the end. She is a very easy grader and gives a ton of extra credit.

It was her first semester teaching and she had no clue what she was doing but at least she tried. She was very nice and accommodating when you talked to her in person. I alway left her office with at least two more points than I went in with so go talk to her about every question you have.

The week before finals and we still do not have grades in the grade book, she doesn't believe in blackboard, and we submit assignments that she sometimes grades. Her grading is a bunch of symbols and never gives us a score. Most of her instructions are confusing and they change often. The responses are easy to do, I just haven't learned anything.

Cristina overall just made CE 3060 such a confusing class. The tests never had a clear study guide, and many questions were changed mid-test. Projects were a nightmare, also because they were semester-long projects.

Overall good experience, CE306 it is a very informing class if you are new to construction, if not then the class is boring and is pretty far from the reality of it. You do learn a lot in the labs and those are honestly more informing than the lecture. If you participate a lot in class and ask questions she will love you and give lots of EC.

She was alright. The lectures were an absolute snoozefest and you had to go since attendance was required. There were group projects and presentations throughout the year in both lecture and lab. She has an accent that is easy to understand, but sometimes a few words may get lost. Overall she was not bad but nothing special.
The class is a joke. All busy work. The lab is a joke. She's just doesn't understand reality in my opinion.
Mid

Most important thing about this class is that you'll be working in groups the whole semester. Cristina's lectures are okay, but always packed with information. Homework/lab is weekly and isn't too difficult, especially if you get help. Take any extra credit chances you get. Final is okay if you study. Pick good group mates, that almost failed me.

Not easy/fun Lectures contain little information, class time is wasted on useless lecture assignments, many involve searching massive documents for meaningless information, Time wasting. There is a boatload of work, the assignments are way over the top, there is no need for the assignments to contain SO much work. The class is pure tedious fluff.

This class was pretty helpful, and Im glad I took it. She has you do projects with software used in industry. If you do the work, you will do well. My only complaint is sometimes her directions and expectations were ambiguous, and shes not always the best at responding to emails. Also, you only meet in class a few times and the rest is online
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He definitely knew what he was talking about. It was a hard attendance policy because you got graded on Top Hat/Attendance and without many other assignments, missing one class could really effect your grade. You definitely need a friend in the class to get the notes from because if you miss that is the only way to get them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Corrigan was a great guy! He had super interesting lectures that were very engaging. Not much is in the gradebook. Missing daily points drops your grade quick. The exam part in canvas is difficult, since it is timed and you cannot go back, but the essay portion is easier, he provides the questions beforehand.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, no issues, no textbook, videos to watch weekly. Packback is due every Thursday, quiz on Sundays. 2 essays on Packback about previous discussions. Online midterm and Final on Canvas. The course schedule never changed throughout, so it was pretty straightforward. Would take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't have a family member pass while taking the class, he will take it out on you and punish you on later assignments.
Easy class. Attendance is mandatory but you don't have to get those points to pass. I had like 15/30 attendance points and ended with a B-
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It was a good thought-provoking online class. The lectures that Professor Corrigan made each week were easy to follow, and the notes were straightforward off of the videos. There was a discussion board each week with a quiz that was easy as long as you did the notes. Would definitely recommend.

You need to ignore the old bad reviews. This class is very easy as long as you take the notes during lectures, which should be easy since it is engaging and interesting. He is not condescending at all those people are just fragile. The only valid complaint is you cannot recover attendance points but I haven't missed a class. You don't need to study

Prof Corrigan is a solid lecturer and a really nice guy but you have to show up in order to collect attendance points, do the in-class quizzes, and fill out "study sheets" which is basically just copying down bullet points on a slideshow. The filled out sheets are not accessible on Canvas! With Corriga Phil 2300 is an easy class if you show up.
Engaging Professor who made philosophy very enjoyable/stimulating and involved the class in a fun way. Only two extremely easy tests and not much homework.

Daniel is a good guy and a good professor, he is clearly very passionate about what he is teaching. Overall if you attend class you will be fine. He offered extra credit in my section and provided all of the information needed to do well in the class. I really didn't even need to study and I am by no means a great student.

He is not at all forgiving if you miss a class due to a very valid reason even if it does drop your grade a whole letter grade.  he does tell you what sets of notes to study so that's good. you have to go to class. he takes attendance on top hat (location must be on) and there are a few lecture questions per class.

This was by far one of my favorite classes I ever took. Although he's a tough grader & there's a lot of reading, it's manageable & honestly enjoyable if you're into philosophy. Do your work, come to class, pay attention, and learn how to take fast notes. The material is interesting & makes you think. He's a great professor & cares for his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Corrigan was one of the best professors I have had so far. Not only does he care about his students, but he is very clear about his expectations and is extremely communicative. He is a great speaker which helped me stay interested in the topics. Very easy class as long as you show up (attendance taken) and take good notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I got one question wrong on homework and it dropped my grade by 10%. When I emailed him about it he basically said "you're lucky I don't drop your grade more." He is unbearable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's really good at explaining his lectures and engaging with students the problem is he does not post the notes which means you either go to class or you lose everything. He also has many slides for students to take notes and skips so fast not letting students finish taking notes.

I have never regretted taking a class with a professor more than this. PHIL 230 had very few assignments, making the tests extremely important (and hard). It's nearly impossible to get a decent grade. With this, he was very condescending when answering any type of question, and blamed the very low exam averages on a lack of effort from students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor has been quite challenging, making it a unique learning experience. Although the course content and workload are manageable, the professor is notably rigorous in their grading and tends to maintain high standards without much flexibility.

Unlocked "Exam 2" at the beginning of finals week. At 8am today unlocks a "final "exam" that had to be completed by 10pm. Anyone not checking their blackboard today will automatically lose 18% of all possible points for the semester. This was very deceptive and misleading.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very little homework, and very little time required each week.  However, A LOT of emphasis on tests, that are graded very tough.  Part multiple choice, part essay.  First time in my college career not receiving an A.  Will not take again.

Loved his into to philosophy class at DMACC. Going to take his Ethics class next semester. He takes time to create lecture notes for students and details lengthy responses to help them understand what they missed. Super positive attitude and great at seeing both sides of an argument. The material is tough, but he will reward logical thinking.

One of my favorite teachers at Iowa State. Have to study a lot for the tests and attend every class to keep up. There are also some pop quizes. Make sure to memorize all points that each philospher made. Really enjoyed the lecture/discussion format.
good at explaining how the philosopher would argue against an arguement

Good professor but tests aren't fun.  I enjoyed our discussions/'lecture'.  5 mult. choice, 20 T/F, then 2 essays for the tests.  The essays were no fun.  You basically have to remember all your notes for the arguments, objections, and responses. Don't be afraid to ask questions!  Love the teacher, hated the tests!

Mr. Corrigan is an excellent professor! I looked forward to the class because I felt that I learned something new each time. He expects a lot from his students- but he's extremely clear and helpful at explainging difficult material. He's also willing to meet with students anytime to offer help.

He teaches the lessons boom boom boom not to much review so you have to remember everything from the last class or else your in the dark his tests are split between multiple choice and essay. after the first test you get a better hang of what to expect. all in all good teacher tough material.
Grades very, very strictly. Material covered boring, and Corrigan does not do a good job of relating it to real life/historical thought. Memorization heavy, one of my least pleasant classes.

Class is not mandatory, but very highly recomended. He had a few pop quizes after the readings, so watch out for those. You have to get the hang of his tests and you should be able to do fine. Very helpful and easy to approach.

Philosophy is tough for me, but after the first test, I got the swing of things. Exam format is mult. choice and written. The written part is pretty tough, and he has to dig for tiny details. Studying arguments and positions is crucial.
He tried to facilitate discussion in class depite a lack of interest for it my many students. Very clear and communicative.
Great professor! Must pay attention in class because he randomly calls on people. Very enjoyable class to take.
Amazing guy that is very open to our everyday life styles. He understands our schedules and knows we are all human. Jim is a great guy that keeps class fun!

Jim Croxdale is an incredibly engaging, relatable, and funny instructor. He draws upon on a lot of anecdotal experiences that he has had over the course of his life and ties them into course material. Additionally, Dr. Croxdale will also use group assignments in class to demonstrate concepts covered in the lectures. I highly recommend him!

Jim's classes are very interactive, so you can't sit back and breeze through them. He cares a ton about his students and believes in them, and his stories are hilarious. I truly learned something from this class and stayed engaged easily. If you put the work in, it's easy to get a good grade!

Jim is an amazing guy who cares greatly about what he does. He's hilarious and always works funny stories into his lectures, which he puts together in a meaningful way, and presents without just reading off a slide. Not necessarily an "easy A" course, but he makes it fun enough that you'll want to put effort in.

This class was a great learning opportunity and clear guidelines were set and followed. Croxdale was kind, personable, and extremely quick to respond to any questions or issues. He has a good sense of humor and is very involved on campus. Hands down the best professor I've had at ISU.
Jim is awesome! He has great experience as a former business professional and provides valuable insights for his students. Take a class with this guy if you can.
Good lectures, exams are in class, lots of guest speakers, and a weekly team exercise.

He actually teaches, rather than just delivering lectures. Group assignments once a week, very easy points. 4 exams, 2 online and 2 in person. I found them to be very simple. Guest speakers come once a month, essay required (350 words). Uses real-life scenarios, which makes this class very applicable. He truly cares.

One of the best professors at Iowa State, and it's not close. Show up on the days you are told to show, and you will do great in this class. He truly cares for his students and is willing to meet at any time to give advice. Anyone who gives him a bad rating doesn't show up to class.
BEST PROFESSOR IVE HAD. So cool and kind, down to earth approach to teaching. There were guest speakers and team exer

Jim is a very chill professor. Be prepared to be called on in class often, typically just asking your thoughts on scenarios. Grading is made up of 3 longer papers (3 pages), 6 shorter papers (1 page), 4 online exams, and 8 team exercises (participation). Jim teaches the class in an interesting way and uses real-life examples from his own life.

Jim was one of the most personable professors I have had at Iowa State and always had something funny to say. He can carry on a conversation with any of his students in a great way. The class itself was fairly easy and included a couple papers, guest speakers, team activities, and online tests.

I can't begin to say enough good things about Jim. I would take every class with him if I had the option to. He is so real, caring, funny, and all-around a great guy. He truly prepares us for the real world and cares so much about his career and his students. Absolutely take a management class with Jim if you have the opportunity.
I really enjoyed Professor Croxdale. Always had very interesting lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: very entertaining and enthusiastic

Jim writes terrible tests. Of the tests, half were all "A". The other two were not. Questions were subjective. Another issue with Jim is grading papers. He is a subjective grader and has no clear instructions when assigning the essays. He doesn't clarify why points are taken away and when asked he doesn't have rationale for the point reduction.

Awesome! He is so entertaining and cares a lot. He talks to you individualy and gets to know you. I thought the actual class was pretty boring but he makes it fun. Does real world scenario discussions that liven it up. Super chill.

Took this class in-person and was a very straightforward class with not too much outside of class. Some classes are required but lecture days are not required which were not very helpful to begin with. Best use of time would be to read and study the textbook because a large majority of the exam questions are based on information from the textbook.

Jim is a great professor! He has so much experience in the management field and business in general.  He truly cares about all his students and makes an effort to get to know them on a personal level.  The in-person half of the exams are somewhat difficult, but passable.  If you have the chance to take a class with Jim, I would highly recommend it!

Overall, not a bad class. The lectures weren't mandatory but I often went because they were interesting. Jim has a lot of good stories. My only complaint would be the exams. There was no material to prepare you. Not even the chapter objectives. If I were to take the class again, I would probably try a different prof for that reason.

Jim was one of my favorite professors at ISU. He is a good an authentic guy that really genuinely cares about his students. My only complaint are that the in person exams feel impossible to study for. Make sure you really pay attention to the youtube videos he posts. Not a guy you can stay mad at even if you flunk the exams. Great environment.

Pretty easy class. The tests are divided up into two parts, a take home part and an in class part. The take home part is very nice as you can use notes or the textbook, making tests for his class not stressful at all. He has experience from the business world which he applies to the class. I would suggest taking his class for MGMT 371 or 372.

I really enjoyed this professor! He did a very good job sharing all needed resources to do well in the class as well as providing weekly reminders with the assignments that are due! This class is based off of four exams, two short papers, and a few feedback papers(two paragraphs) from quest lectures you watch.
Professor Croxdale is the GOAT. His videos are awesome and he's comedy. He is also very helpful and responds to questions in a matter of minutes.

Equivalent to the high school history teacher everybody liked status. Lectures arent mandatory but honestly I showed up sometimes cause guy is comedy. Almost all the material is on quizlet and textbook. Class consists of 4 exams and 2 papers. Not much to grade on but definitely your class with the least amount of work for the semester.
He is awesome, if youre condering taking his class, do it. He is chill asf and is always willing to help. Lectures are not required and only 4 exams and 2 assignments, one of them a group project.
Easy class the lectures are always fun. We had no final just exams and 2 projects

took this over the summer, the grading was 4 exams and 1 project and no peer reviews. You are required to go to guest speakers, but never had one when i did attend otherwise class is not mandatory to attend. plan to do your group project early because I had this one girl and she took 5 days to do the project so plan ahead the project was easy too.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: If you're looking for a class that you don't have to do much outside of class, this is it. I enjoyed every class with professor Croxdale, and thought that he was easy to listen to. Although VERY old school (brings in newspaper clippings all the time), he was always very passionate about everything he said.

Loved this Professor! He was fun and relatable and only taught material that would be useful. 4 exams (he underlines all the topics on his presentations so you know exactly what will be on the exam) and 2 group papers. Super easy!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was a fun class, especially because you experiment with technology in lab. In each lecture, there are multiple mini quizzes, and you have to be in class to take them, but they are very simple. The class sometimes feels like there is more work than necessary, but it isn't difficult, just annoying. Dr. Crawford is kind and kind to students.

Dr. Crawford gives you clear grading rubrics, which is really nice, since you have a small project/lab every week. There are in-class quizzes every week, but if you attend the lecture, you will do just fine. She gives excellent feedback, but the class is just boring and long.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is good. I would take her again. I actually had issues with my lab teacher not her. However, I wish she would do better for advocating for her students.

Professor Crawford was fine, but the lab grading is ridiculous. Not because they are picky, I'm fine with that. It's because they won't tell us what they specifically want and will deduct points when we can't read minds. If everyone is not doing what y'all wanted us to, maybe instruction is the problem.

Dr. Crawford is an expert and I enjoyed her class. My only gripe is that grading was slow and often we did not receive grades until a month later. Attendance is mandatory since there are little quizzes everyday.

Dr. Crawford comes off as very intimidating at first but she is absolutely awesome and cares so much about her students, she makes sure to address us all by name and makes us feel welcome and important. She is obviously an expert and knows what she is talking about, just show up and you will do fine, offers extra credit throughout the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While she seems scary at first, she is a sweet little woman who really cares about the future teachers of the world. Teaching means so much to her, and she is so passionate. Her once- a-week lectures are very easy.

Never responded to my emails. I had to go to office hours multiple times to get one simple question answered about my grade. Finally got my answer in December after 5+ emails and 3+ office hour visits with the first email been sent in September. She expects professionalism from students but shows her extremely lacking ability to be professional.

Dr. Crawford gives us very important content. Nearly every assignment is given during class, so go. She says a lot during lectures and quizzes, so take some notes. Save all the resources she gives us so you can use them in the future. Attending labs is important. If you miss points on assignments or labs, do the extra credit!

This class was fairly easy. You have to attend lectures because she has small "quizzes" after the lecture, but they're easy. You have to attend labs as well. Most assignments are finished in the lab. There are only a few assignments that you have to work on outside of class. She gives so many easy extra credit opportunities.
Grades so particularly it will make you wanna rip your hair out!! You have to read their (Dr and TA's) minds at times. Honestly feels like they don't want you to get an A.

You don't need the textbook (says you do, you don't - not even for the lesson plan) - don't buy!!! She's long and boring but you just gotta go to class and get through it. Occasional online classes are nice. Labs are long and very particular grading.
Her lectures are not long but they feel like it. The class really isn't difficult if you have a good lab instructor. Really good class for learning tech minors but not always the most enjoyable.

If you miss class even if you have covid she will take away points from your quiz. If you might have to miss class be aware you will loose points. Theres a quiz in every class usually worth about 4-6 points. The labs are long the work is do-able but exhausting. Get ready to spend around two hours per week doing projects. The class is passable.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Denise really cares about her students as well as future students. I enjoyed her lectures but they were somewhat pointless. Attendance is mandatory for lectures. The labs would have been beneficial, except the TA that I had did not speak english and did not understand the material. She said "idk" to a lot of question. Denise herself was great!

I loved this class I think it was very beneficial. It was time consuming but well worth it and Dr. Crawford was a very nice lady and always helped me when needed! Only reason for 4 instead of 5 is because of the amount of work and time it did take.

Denise truly cares about her students, but what I admire most is she cares about our future students. She gives you many tools that you can use in your future classroom, and labs are really helpful in applying that knowledge. I got the book, but only used it once for a project at the end of the year. Just keep up with the work and you'll be fine.

This class was hard for the sake of being hard. Denise thinks she knows tech but doesn't. Attendance is required for a class that should be online or at least only labs. The idea that this class will teach anything relevant is laughable. This is a mandatory class for El-Ed at Iowa State Uni. Switch major or school so you don't have her.

You'll have weekly projects that'll take you about an hour, but they usually aren't very difficult. The bulk of your grade comes from your portfolio and lesson plan, so dedicate the majority of your effort to these assignments. Attending lecture is key. However, paying attention is not. Study for the final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Although this class has a heavy workload, IT IS WORTH IT. You do have to work for it, do not skip class, because her lectures are important, and READ THE BOOK. The book will be helpful for your essays and final exam. Denise is an awesome professor and really cares about this field of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DONT GET THE TEXTBOOK. You dont need it. Just go to each lecture and lab and keep up with homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Denise cares about her students, but can often times be hard to contact. Denise tries to relate to her students and make the class interesting. Make sure you don't miss labs, you will lose lots of points. My TA graded hard, but I had friends who's TA's graded super easy, it just depends on who you get.

She makes the TAs grade harsh or she'll dock everyone points. No one got 100% on the midterm and no one I talked to was very happy with their grade. She'll assign things at weird times so make sure you're paying attention. Be sure you have good wifi when you need to turn something in.
Course load is rough.. Sooo many project due at the same time. Get ready to be overwhelmed. 3 papers due over the course of the semester and a project due every week.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher. She really cares about her students. Some in class points and lectures are not posted on BB. READ THE REQUIRED MATERIALS AND TAKE NOTES IN CLASS then the midterm and final will not be too difficult. Lab assignments can be long but very helpful for a future elementary teacher. Dont procrastinate and attend class.

Random lecture assignments that you get points for being there. Get lecture notes from a friend or split days you are going to go. Lecture moved so slow and MANY days I wrote nothing in my journal/didn't learn anything. Instead of reviewing for our final we watched our peers videos and she gave them candy......

She is a really nice person and actually cares about her students. She somehow knew my name, although the lecture had at least 100 students. She responds to emails in a timely manner and is very helpful. The midterm and final are hard, but the projects will buffer your grade. The lectures seem a bit pointless, the labs are fun and you learn a lot.
She was actually really helpful. If you become a technology minor, she'll check in on you to see how it's going. She really seems to care.

Dr. Bonaccorsi is one of the best professor's at Iowa State. Her lectures are extremely easy to follow, and she is very engaged with everyone. It is also easy to schedule meetings with her outside of lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: homework takes forever and the exams are easy to loose pionts on
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I reccomend this profesor. She really is one of the best profesor here at Iowa State. She explaines me everything very clear and help me a lot.
One of the best profs at isu. Made chemistry fun and easy

Bonaccorsi was pretty good. She has a lot of information in her lectures that you end up never using. Everything seems super complicated and then you look through it and realize its simple. Her tests weren't easy but they weren't hard at all. Make sure you do the practice exams before the exams and you'll see a lot of similar questions.
As long as you do the practice exams before each exam you will be fine. Great professor and great class overall.
Very caring and easy going professor

Chemistry is a difficult subject, but she does her best to make lectures fun and worth listening in on. Often she will provide demos in class of the specific chemistry properties that she is teaching, that make the lectures even better. Her exams are well encompassing, though they are all very fair.

Does really well during lectures considering it's a very big lecture hall, stays similar to the lecture videos she posts so if you miss a lecture you aren't absolutely screwed. She also makes a good effort to walk through examples during lectures and gives plenty of time for peer discussion, so get to know the people you sit by.

She was very passionate and knowledgable. Her lectures were very enjoyable and she frequently did demonstrations and explained complex topics in easy-to-understand ways. Would highly recommend this course with her if you are genuinely interested in chemistry.
Doesn't explain the concepts properly in class.

IDK if it is because it is only and the prof dunno how to do it, but her lectures suck. She is basically reading out her PowerPoint. The PowerPoint isn't even good. However, she is a really nice person. I went to her office hours and she is really nice. She explains things during office hours better than in lecture videos.

This class is very boring and kind of difficult for someone not interested in research whatsoever. However, he wants you to succeed and is very accommodating. There are only three tests and three assignments so if you do bad on anything your kind of f'ed for the rest of the semester.

Prof Crede was smart and I really enjoyed his lectures. He did a lot of examples on the board, which came in handy for exams. Exams are open note and written essay questions, so as long as you had the right information, they were easy. There were only three assignments, and they were easy to do. He cares a lot about his students and their opinions!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One piece of advice, GO TO CLASS and TAKE NOTES.  This is not something you can skip, you will probs fail.  He goes over a TON of information during lecture.  I actually enjoyed what I learned (for a research class).  Crede wants you to succeed and is very understanding.  He tries to make it easy enough for you during exams and grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was so sweet and made sure his students were going to do good on the test. Crede's lectures were interesting (as much as they could be for a research class lol). I suffer from depression, and Crede was very understanding. YOU HAVE TO GO TO CLASS! Not going to class really f's it up because he will tell you exactly whats on the exam.

Dr. Crede's lectures can be kind of boring but this is a research methods class so that's to be expected. He is very approachable and accessible and is understanding when it comes to deadlines/extenuating circumstances. I would recommend taking this class with him if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very transparent and willing to work with you on assignments.

Dr. Crede is just an amazing professor and clearly cares about his students. I am glad to have him as a contact as he is definitely someone you want to know on campus. The class is easy enough if you just read the book, write the papers (you can send it to him before it's due as much as you want & he will give great feedback) and study for tests.

Possibly the worst and most pretentious teacher Ive ever had. Super boring class, and he made it unbearable. 100% fake accent. Material is straightforward, but the exams are complex and have many pages of short answer, so you better know your stuff. Id recommend just not taking a class with him, its horrible. Tried to rate 0/5, but I couldnt.

Lecture and reading based class. Chapter reviews are useful for studying. Participation helps a lot and the class environment was great. Learned a lot about the class topic. Extra credit is hard but can boost your grade, and the class is curved.

There is a long reading each week, and very few assignments. But the exams are on all the readings, and she expects you to remember small information from the readings. Does not give a guide to what's on the exam; part of it is multiple choice, and part is open-ended. Exams hurt your grades bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She has fun lectures, so it is not just her lecturing the whole time. Her tests can be hard if you haven't studied, but makes  good study guides to help. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and takes the highest grade as the 100% to help curve grades. knows a lot about topic and interesting class. Make sure you come to class or lose point
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The most helpful of the 3 psych 101 teachers. She is very nice and willing to help. Pretty easy to learn from, and goes through a lot of information during each class period. Go to class and read the book, it will really help. There is a lot of reading and the tests are hard. Do the extra credit, it will help your grade a lot.
She is a good teacher, respectful, and easy to learn from.

Dr. Cross is a nice lady. Her research is multicultural, so teaching this class was right up her alley. The tests were pretty difficult, and the final paper was super long, and presenting in front of the class for 8 minutes sucked, but I still learned quite a bit from the class. Final grade was based on a curve, thank God.

Read ALL assigned chapters in the book. Attend every class and moderately pay attention. With those two things, you'll do great. Dr. Cross is very sweet. She loves what she is teaching and she is very willing to help students who have questions or concerns.
She was very clear and nice. I felt that she really wanted us to learn. Test was moderately hard. Go to all the classes, listen, and DO your book notes and you'll get a solid B.
She was a very nice lady and her teaching were interesting. If you are taking this class I think you'll like her the best out of the other 2 teachers.
Her lectures are very interesting. Her note packet and study guide are helpful. She is a pretty easy teacher. DO NOT PLAY ON YOUR COMPUTER DURING CLASS and be very discreet with your cellphone.

She wasn't a bad professor, she wasn't an especially good one, she was just wasn't that memorable. And that's not entirely her fault: end of semester, spring, she has a low-key style, and most of the grades were already determined. Still, if you see her name listed for psychology go for it since she seemed like she'd be nice in advanced classes.

Cross is very nice and helpful when you have questions.  Out of all the Pysch. professors that teach 101 she was my favorite.  Her notes really prepare you for the test and she has a really really good study guide!
She is a very nice lady. I found her teaching style most effective. She is so sweet. She makes you WANT to attend class.
Make sure to pay attention, there are quizzes. Don't take if you plan on missing, you are only allowed to miss once.
Psychology of women was one of the most interesting classes i've had at ISU. The tests are harder but you can make up points with easy small assignments
easy course, shes very nice
I really enjoyed her. Great professor!

What an awesome teacher! I liked her teaching style the best out of all 3 professors for Psych 101. Her notes are easy to follow and prepare you well for her test. She is also a very nice person with a great attitude.

The class was not what I expected. The bulk of it was Salesforce training and going through different modules. Honestly, I didn't have any interactions with the professor during the course. We did the Salesforce modules each week, took a quiz on the lecture/Salesforce material, and that was pretty much the bulk of the class. Easy elective!!

Great person who loves marketing and wants to pass that on to his students. Course grade consisted of 5 open-note quizzes (lowest dropped), 3 research credits you have to get (5 total if you want extra credit), and 2 exams that you get to bring a note sheet in for. Class lectures were interesting and the slides/notes were easy to follow.
Connects well with students. Lectures were always entertaining. Class was graded primarily off quizzes and research credit which was online surveys. Always responded to emails quickly. Great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This sounds like the easiest Marketing 340 of them all. Lectures twice a week, open note quiz every other week, midterm and final exam. You also have to get 5 research credits. This class was very easy if you go. Mr C is hilarious and easy to reach if you have questions. If you're taking 340, take it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor. Rood is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is extremely understanding and will always help with any difficulties you face related to the course. I have taken four classes with him and I learned so much from each of them! I highly recommend him.
