You only get graded on 4 exams and an optional extra credit paper, but the class was so easy and the professor is amazing! You don't really need to go to class to pass, but the lectures were interesting and the professor is funny and does a great job at making the class enjoyable. We also never went to the full 80 minutes so that's a plus.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof Delisi does an amazing job at engaging during lecture and making you want to learn more. There are two required textbooks but you can get an A in the course without opening them at all. His tests are lecture heavy so while attendance is not mandatory I would highly recommend not missing many classes but if you do he provides his lecture notes.
great guy. makes class fun and material interesting. Knows what he is talking about and you honestly could not get someone better to teach this class

Absolute professional in his field, he personally goes to the field and researches the leading sociological issues. Listening to him lecture is more clear and understanding than a dedicated documentary on the subject.

Easy A. Absolutely no homework, and only 4 exams each worth 50 points. Attend lecture and you will get a good grade on all 4 exams. Plus on 2 random lecture days, he gave us extra credit for showing, each worth 10 points. For people that need a random elective and want a good grade, take this class!

Overall, the class is really easy to get an A in. Even if you don't show up to class, he posts all the notes online so as long as you look at them, you should pass all the tests. Also, he gives out a lot of extra credit randomly if you do show up to class. He's really nice and loves to teach!!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Matt is my favorite professor at Iowa State. Attendance is not mandatory but questions on exams are mostly from lectures. You watch a lot of films/movies during the course and Matt makes lectures fun to attend. Make sure you get him for class!!

I really enjoyed going to class and listening to Dr. DeLisi speak. He knows what he is talking about and is well prepared for each lecture. He is understanding and doesn't try to trick you on the test. If you study a little, you will pass. He is the reason I changed my major to criminal justice.

Professor Delisi has a straightforward teaching style. He was always willing to stop and answer questions in the middle of lecture. He wrote the text books, and the exams (there were 4, no final) are based off of lecture and some extra info in the books. There was also an extra credit paper available.
Great professor and a really interesting guy. His class is a lot of information but the tests are pretty easy and he offers lots of extra credit.
fun, interesting class that is pretty easy but you get a lot of information also. Delisi is a great professor and is a great guy, the ladies love him as well.
Four Exams, One extra credit opportunity. No homework. COME TO CLASS. Great professor, deserves respect!
One of the best professors on campus hands down.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy A. Only 4 exams, and he tells you exactly what to expect. The last test is not cumulative, also big change for extra credit! He is also sooo dreamy.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Loved his class
Professor DeLisi is an excellent teacher and makes every class worth taking.  He is the best professor I had in my four years of college.
He was clear about which materials would show up on the exam and what we should focus on.

This class was online so we had weekly assignments. The assignments are easy if you just read the assigned readings. If you make a quality post, which he gives you an example of in the syllabus, you will get 100%. You just have to try and you will get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The hype is true.  Class is lots of fun, interesting, and pretty easy.  DeLisi gives great lectures and has good rapport with students.  He is really cute and very confident which makes him even hotter.  You won't regret taking this class :)

great professor, interesting, and one of the most famous criminologists in the country, so cool he is at ISU.  has tons of contacts in the criminal justice system and is very helpful with setting you up with internships and jobs.  understands the point of college of practical information and preparing for career in the field.

Special topics class on homicide with great lectures and awesome films that highlight the lectures.  Lots of writing on annotated bibliography and final paper but he gives you lots of help and is understanding grader.  Attendance counts throughout semester too.  DeLisi is really,  handsome :) and dresses very professionally. I never missed class

Class has straightforward exams that DeLisi really prepares you for plus there is an extra credit paper that basically guarantees a B or higher. Gives incredible lectures but also involves the class in discussion, pretty funny too.  And it does not hurt that DeLisi is gorgeous!  SO Dreamy....
great professor, very accomplished but also down to earth and cares about teaching

He is by far one of the coolest professors at Iowa State. He is pretty straightforward with what is going to be on each test and they are fairly easy. I am not a CJ major but this class made me consider taking more on the subject!
took online. 15 papers on 15 chapters (one page each with link to articles). not sure he even read mine, got 100% on all of them and Im not a very good writer.
I love Dr. Delisi

One of the most interesting classes I've taken. Dr. Delisi is one of the most clear, straight forward professors I've had. He gives study guides for exams, but his lectures are 100% worth going to. So interesting, I love this class.

This class was an awesome first class to take here at ISU. Dr. Delisi was very informative and knew everything he needed to know about his job. Ask him any question, he can give you an answer. The content is very practical and interesting. If you're interested in this class at all, I would definitely recommend it!

He wrote our textbook, and I actually read the entire thing because I found it that interesting. Lectures on one day, watch a video the next. No tests given, just one 15+ page paper due at the end of the semester, and attendance points. Great lectures, lots of discussion. If you need a laid back and interesting class, this is it. Would take again.
He wrote the book that we were supposed to read, so if you attend and pay attention during lectures its not really necessary.

He is by far my favorite professor. He makes the class feel involved. I never even cracked open my textbook, but you have to go to class. He doesn't post the lectures, but will let you take the test late if you miss your alarm. LOVED this class!

I loved my criminal justice class! Even though it was an 8am, I enjoyed waking up for them because I loved sitting and listening to him talk. He told you what to study, and his tests were easy if you study. His tests don't try to trick you. I would love to take another class of his!
Loved him! His test are very easy just study the power points and skim through the book!

Though this class is SUPER easy, it was the only class all semester that I attended each and every one. Delisi makes the class interesting, and he truly wants you to know and understand the material. He is an AWESOME professor, and if you have the chance to take any of his classes, it should definitely be done. AMAZING!
Mr. delisi is awesome and professional. He is very good about answer questions almost instantly and will help with almost anything. Genuinely cares for his students
Gives interesting lectures, attendance isn't mandatory, he gives study guides for his tests... as long as you know the study guide and the chapter from the book you'll do well.

His class is very easy if your good at multiple choice tests. He has very thorough power points and gives you a list of 50-60 things you need to know for the mid-term and final and the tests are 50 questions.
Great teacher, he has to be one of the best in the nation

This was an incredibly easy class. Almost everything on the tests came directly from lecture, and a lot of it is common sense too. He is very helpful and is willing to answer any questions you may have, even during a test. There are even a few "gimme" questions on every exam! He kept it interesting, and I enjoyed showing up to class.
best teacher at ISU

Great! He was always willing to help and really knows what he's talking about. He made it fun to learn about something that I had no interest in before his class. Not to mention he doesn't have the facial hair thing going on any more so he's REALLY good looking now : )
DeLisi's lectures were on task and entertaining.Recitation with Molly Sween was great. Definitely reccomend!

My favorie teacher of the semester. Very interesting class and he makes it soo much fun. He writes all the material you use and is willing to work with you if you miss class. The recitation is very helpful too. He wants you to succeed.  If you have free time, I would recommend the class.  =)
Very good teacher.  It's nice that he writes most of the material we used in 240 and 241.  Very flexible if you missed something he is willing to still give you the notes.  Unlike some professors.
I really enjoyed the way the context of the text was approached in the lectures. Dr. Delisi made youth and crime interesting to want to study.
Took the class for fun and I am glad I did. It was an awesome class and I learned alot.
Awesome professor. test are easy and he gives a study guide which is all you need to get an A on the test. Didn't read the book often. Makes the subject interesting especially for an intro course!
By far best professor i've had at ISU so far.

as a criminal justice minor and coming from a whole family of corrections and public safety emplyees, I wasn't looking forward to an introductory course but DeLisi's class is insightful the the criminal justice system. He relates to you as a student and makes even the boring stuff fun to engage in. Highly recommend taking his classes!

Great professor.  He is one of the best lecturers I've ever taken a course with and would definetly recommend those taking a criminal justice class to take it with him.  He makes the the material easy, relevant, and understandable, especially if you're not traditionally a criminal justice major.
great, easy class as long as you show up and study.  since he wrote the textbook he just lectures straight from the book
he's a great teacher and lectures are always interesting and relates to current world, tests right out of notes for the most part and gives a study guide

This course is not only interesting, but the material relates to situations that any of us could encounter. Even if you are not interested in criminal justice, it is helpful to know your rights when it comes to the law. Matt is a great prof with a lot of ambition for the subject. Highly recommended!

Definitely an intro class. Very easy to ace tests. His lectures can get slightly boring from time to time but I wouldn't let this discourage you from taking his classes. I'm actually looking forward to the one I have coming up next semester.
Matt is a great person who will go out of his way for you.

There's a lot of hype surrounding his classes and to be honest I was kind of disappointed when I finally took his class.  I guess a test that's so easy you could take it with your eyes shut is great for freshman, but as a junior I was actually looking to really learn something.  He seems to be a really great guy though and VERY approachable!
He is awesome.
Very good teacher.  Very helpful and responds quickly to emails.  Really easy to get along with.

Great professor & interesting class. Simple straight-forward exams, but you do learn.  His enthusiam and interest in the subject is contageous. I would take every criminal justice class from him if he taught them.
All I have to say is Awsome Professor. If you have any intrest in CJ take a class with DeLisi. He knows his stuff. Great Class, Great Professor.
No Comments
like the class

Very Very helpful and fun to listen to.  teaches you alot.  i would take as many classes as you can with him.  if you like criminal justice try to go and talk to him, he knows ALOT and can help steer you
Great teacher, great class!  Take as many of his classes as possible... matt rocks!
I loved this class! It was so interesting and even though there is a recitation class and a paper due later in the semester, it was soooo easy and I recommend it to anyone!

EASY EASY EASY, and Matt is great! He is really funny, and some of his test questions reflect that.  I took both 240 and 241 this semester and will get an A in both. Recitation is fun as long as you make it fun. Matt is by far one of the best profs in the Sociology department. Go to lecture its fun!
He is just and awesome prof who really enjoys teaching
Makes class fun and interesting and has a good connection with students. Tests are straightforward and easy to study for. Funny guy, excellent teacher.
Great professor.  The tests are done well, he's knows his material, and he takes the time to give you attention.
Delisi is a great teacher.  He knows his material and does a good job of explaining the material to you.  As long as you go to class and take good notes...you will be fine in this class.
Dr.Delisi is AWESOME.  His lectures were always interesting and he is SO dreamy!!
This class was very interesting.  DeLisi was a great teacher and he gave very good info.  If you go to class and read you should do fine.  You really dont need to study for tests for very long.
Kept subject interesting, yet light and helpful. Had a lot of notes that were helpful on the tests.
Hes awesome and easy to listen to! The best professor I have had yet.
Great teacher, should get into FBI, I'd work for him, good guy
this guy knows his stuff and hes huckin filarious!

Lectures were very boring and did not explain well. I was better off teaching myself the material with the lecture slides. Attendance was not mandatory. But exams were fairly close to the practice exams and pretty easy.
He is a great professor. Very well grader and willing to help anyone learn and explain things further.
Really nice professor, lectures can go too fast and or be boring sometimes. Gives practice exams to help study as well as homework that is very manageable.

Honestly, he's a really easy teacher besides the fact that I showed up on day one, found out his lecture was the most boring thing ever, and never showed up again. He provides his notes after class, and his practice tests are basically almost the same as the tests and finals. I would def recommend him!

Professor Disch is a good guy but boring. Practice Exams are almost identical to the actual exam with 1 or 2 questions out of 20 different. I never showed up to the lectures after the second week and still got an A through studying the practice exams.

Prof. Disch was a nice guy, but not a great teacher. His lectures will put you to sleep and were not helpful. I did appreciate his grading style as it was clear and made the course easy. You're better off doing all the homework then watching the Steve Butler video before the exams.
Grading scale is good but professor is pretty awful and over complicated things. Practice exams are NOTHING like the exam and he changes questions.
Really boring lectures practice exams are identical to the actual exams. I never showed up to a lecture after the first week and still scored well on all the exams from studying the practice exam.
Dude is so boring. Just take Beard meets calc if you can, he's the better math 1500 prof.

His voice was so slow and boring that it made it difficult for me to want to attend class. Sometimes it was hard to read his lecture notes as he was teaching. He seems nice, but not interesting. I have an A, but is style of teaching was not for me, maybe try out a different prof. than Jordan.

I actually took his math145. Class was so early in the morning that if you went to class that day, his monotone delivery will put you to sleep. Also example problems given in class are way too easy than whats in hw. I recommend just reviewing posted slides and going to the study sessions hosted by the TA, no need for Jordan's lecture at all.

nice guy, and the course is overall average in difficulty. i never went to lecture, but i did go to his office hours once and personally found his explanations confusing and not very helpful. if you struggle with math, i recommend watching youtube videos and going to TA office hours instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Extremely simple problems in lectures, and complicated ones on quizzes and exams. You will fall asleep during class cause he sounds like he doesn't want to be there either. Handwriting is hieroglyphics. Khan Academy all the way.

He wants all his students to do well, and if you're struggling on HW, go to his office during office hours, and he will sit with you and review it. While the HW is optional, you should do it as the quiz questions are the same as the HW questions.
He's a nice guy who knows what he is talking about. Sometimes lectures will go to time but usually not.

He was an average professor for an average math class. Lectures would regularly go over the class time and would get us behind over and over, which was not great for preparing for the weekly recitation quizzes.
Wrong professor

Jordan is a great professor who really cares about his students succeeding. Although the lectures could be boring at times, they were beneficial to the weekly assignments and quizzes. He also provided practice exams almost identical to each unit exam. Would definitely recommend getting in his class if you get the opportunity.

Disch can teach and does so pretty effectively, but lacking emotion is what made lectures really dull. Of the lectures I did attend, the material was taught fairly well. The grading distribution was also fairly equitable with homeworks constituting most of your grade. The practice exams are also almost identical to the actual exams.

Jordan is a super nice professor and he really cares about your success in his class. His practice tests are almost identical to the real exam and not difficult if you pay attention and do the homework. He ended up rounding up my grade after just asking him if I could do anything to help improve my grade. He just let me redo a problem on the exam.
Goes over everything and usually ends up finishing coursework before exam deadlines.

The math was easy and don't worry, he ALWAYS lectures from start to finish. He wasn't a bad professor by any means and math isn't necessarily supposed to be interesting but boy was it hard to stay awake in this class. He never grades anything - its all left to the textbook system so sorry if you hate Pearson. The lectures moved quickly so keep up.

Dr. Disch is an okay lecturer. I felt like I could understand the concepts decently, however, he doesn't choose super challenging practice problems. So often I have to watch Butler's videos for the homework. But I haven't had much trouble on the exams, so yeah.  

One time he said sigma male.
He's a Dawg

Jordan Disch likes to go over theory in class, using very simple examples to teach how to do something. He reuses old professor's materials such as practice quizzes and videos. Good luck on the quizzes and tests as they are problems in completely different formats than what you practiced in class and on the homework.

He goes over the simplest practice problems in class and on the homework, and the only exposure to harder problems is on the test. You have to teach yourself everything using things like Khan. There is no point in attending class because you go over three simple problems for the whole hour. Hope you get a good TA that knows what's going on.

Pretty bad honestly. 151 is supposed to be a core course for business students so it really shouldn't be hard. And it's not.... when you can find other resources to teach it to you. Guy is scatter brained and it's pretty distracting. Teaches lectures with the simplest practice problems, and then throws ridiculously complex ones on tests.

Disch is a decent lecturer with good practice problems. His handwriting is not great and topic pacing was my biggest complaint. He speaks clearly but without expression. It was his first time teaching calculus at Iowa State which explains the pacing issues, but he progressed in his abilities throughout the semester.
just go to office hours bro

Dipa is a very passionate teacher! While lectures were often jam-packed with material, she made sure to include some fun facts about biochem along the way. Office hours are VERY helpful for homework, which makes up only 20% of your grade. She grades very strictly and will take off .1 point for a slightly lacking answer. Hard class, but manageable.

reviews.comment: Professor Dipali Sashital is who more professors, who care for their student's should strive to be like. I enjoyed this course and her passion for it as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love Dr. Sashital's lectures. She is clearly passionate about biochemistry. Homework can seem tough at first, but it is very simple once you understand what she is asking (same with exam short answers). Watch/attend lectures, go to office hours, and you will have no trouble. She will help you succeed! Wish she taught BBMB 4050; she is my favorite!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Don't listen to the 1 star ratings, Dr. Sashital is a fine professor. The exams and homework were difficult, but not impossible. Also, an 88% is an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Sachital is a knowledgable scientist; however, she does a horrendous job of teaching. reviews.comment: Dr. Sashital is one of the best professors I have ever had. The course content is not easy but she does a very good job of teaching it and is always available outside of class to answer questions.

reviews.comment: Dr. Sashital has a pretty standard lecture style. The class had 4 exams + a final. There was homework once a week. The homework is graded on accuracy and you only get one attempt. The exams had an long answer portion and a multiple choice portion. The saving grace of this course was the curve. Dr. Sashital was very generous with the curve.

Dr. Sashital's BBMB 404 class is a straightforward biochemistry course. She has homework every week, and an exam once every 3 to 4 weeks. I highly recommend going to office hours, her lectures make the topics seem confusing, but she helps to explain them in detail during office hours. Overall, her class was difficult, but I learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's the best professor you can get when entering the biochem series at ISU. She gives amazing lectures and is able to make complicated subjects easy to understand. reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are long and unhelpful. I spent hours and hours in the textbook, on khan academy and still came out confused. She overcomplicates every concept, and grades her own written short answer questions very hard. Do not take this and expect her to care about helping you understand biochemistry. Take with any other teacher you can!!!!!!!

This class is ridiculous. I do not know how other people do it, all of her test questions and homework questions are highly application and you have to basically be a biomedical professional to understand. Her lectures are full of tangents and she almost never gives any actually useful content. She has no understanding of the best way to teach this

The class is definitely tough, but she does a great job at explaining and is always willing to answer any question or set up a zoom meeting if you'd prefer to talk rather than email. She formatted the class perfectly to accommodate for online delivery. Expect exam scores to average between 60-70% but she curves the final grade to a B.

I was warned about this class in advance, but Dr S has been amazing. The class is all online, which isn't my preferred format, and she still kept the lectures engaging. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There is NO way you can score full marks for your homework. It is a very very VERY difficult class. Her exams are super difficult and it felt like she didn't really teach us much about what might be coming out for the exams. I found it really hard to understand the class.

This class was extremely hard but she was amazing. Her lectures were so clear and genuinely easy to listen to. She communicated frequently with students and was always ready to answer questions. I cannot imagine how hard managing with 404 must have been, most of my professors gave up trying to manage much smaller classes. I am very impressed.

She is really nice and helpful at times when you need her. However, her study guide is so messy and not straight forward that it can take me a long time to watch each lecture video. She asked to recall materials from previous chapters, but sometimes it is just not possible especially if it too far back.

Her homework is exams are impossible to do. I never once scored for anything. everything taught in the lectures are far from what is covered in the exams. It was EXTREMELY HARD, and this is coming from a student who scored an A for OCHEM 1&2.

One of my favorite professors so far at Iowa State. Biochemistry is a very hard subject and for a while I thought I might fail the class. Also very clear about what will be on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I seriously don't understand a lot of these reviews. She is not nearly as bad as any of them say. I thought the lectures made sense, I understood the material, and she stays after class to help tables work through problems. I even was 15 minutes late to an exam once and she gave me an extra 15 minutes at the end to make up for the time I missed.

Brenda is literally so amazing! She always wants whats best for her students and does so many hands on activities and peer collaboration to ensure the best learning. She is super approachable and kind. She is insanely organized and communicates clearly, you will never not know what's going on:)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is definitely a lot. There is a ton of homework which isn't too bad but it does get tedious for sure. You can tell she cares deep down about her students but sometimes she can be very passive aggressive. I also feel that multiple times she does not really know what she is talking about or has a hard time explaining it.

I genuinely don't think I've disliked a professor more in my life. The class itself is hard enough but her teaching made it even more miserable. I had to go to another professor's office hours almost every week to learn the content properly. She is condescending and rude when you don't understand something. Prepare to teach yourself everything.

This class content is not hard as it is elementary math but the grading is RIDICULOUS, Brenda counts anything and everything wrong even if the final answer is correct. She also comes to class unprepared and typically seems confused while trying to teach. It is hard to learn when the teacher is standing at the front also getting the wrong answer.
She is not helpful, nor is she nice to those who need accommodations/those who work during the semester!
She will never, ever help you. Good Luck!

Brenda is a very good teacher. She can always help you one-on-one, but not enough people take advantage of this. The class is very intimate, and you'll work in groups often. She cares for her students and wants everyone to understand the content. To pass the class, attendance and effort matter. Do the homework and ask for help!

Math 196 was a little bit challenging. I had Sylvia for 195 and it was a big difference, however, Brenda was helpful and showed many different ways to do the work. When your table group was to put homework on the board, You didn't necessarily have to put it up for credit like in 195. I cannot stress enough, Ask for help if you are stuck.

This class will be easier if you take advantage of class time and ask Brenda many questions. She's a big fan of "discovery learning" which can be confusing but if you ask her for clarification she will provide help.

Brenda Diesslin is honestly one of the worst professors I've ever had. Extremely passive aggressive and for a majority of the classes, had no clue what she was talking about. If you take this class with her, be prepared to teach yourself all of the content, and expect little to no help from her.
Awful !

If I could rate Brenda a zero, I would. She is incredibly difficult to work with and learn from because she is so insanely specific in what she wants and expects us to read her mind. Brenda is very specific when she grades and expects you to be able to read her mind on what she wants. She grades her quizzes out of 15, while the other professors grade out of 8. Dr. Dispirito is an intelligent man who only cares about himself. He does not put an effort into understanding the student's needs. He is unapproachable and short-tempered.

Dr. Dispirito is absolutely amazing as he wants you to understand laboratory procedures and not just go through the motions. reviews.comment: He's a super nice guy! Very caring and very knowledgeable.

Lectures are pointless. I have never seen a professor talk for over an hour and only 2% of it was relevant to the course. Do yourself a favor and take it with Dr. Phillip Jones if you actually want to learn and not completely depend on the TA's.

Dr. Rover tells you at the beginning of the class that you do not have to attend. And that is true, it is set up so that most of the class is done outside of the lecture time. However, if you attend class, you may get extra credit, you will learn more about the subsystems in the class, and overall the class will be easier for you.

Easiest yet most time consuming class I took. No attendance, 2 compulsory online open-notes exams and 1 optional final exam. Challenging labs, especially Lab 3 , Lab7. Final project will definitely take most of your time, so think of it ahead of time.

I'm very appreciative of how Dr. Rover runs 288. There's a deliberate focus on learning hands-on in the labs rather than just lectures. The labs are built such that you implement different components one at a time, all building off of one another until you eventually use your own code for a fun final project. Learned a lot of valuable stuff.
Horrible lectures, honestly it is not worth going to lecture. It feels like she just says the whole lecture's content in a single breath.
Cons: useless lectures

You'll pretty much learn everything you need in the labs but they can take a long time and would be easier if you go to lecture. That being said, the class wasn't too bad and the final project/lab was kinda fun despite being VERY time consuming.

Dr. Rover is very caring and responsive to student questions, sometimes lectures are confusing but the professor and TAs are very helpful and labs are interesting. She was very understanding and accommodating during the switch to online classes as well.

Horrible lectures, just a bunch of nonsense mixed with random stuff. She goes over a couple different slides during lecture that are just a waste of time. You are better not going to class and using this time to study by yourself. The labs are quite nice, the problem is that you need to wait for more than 15 minutes to get the help of the TAs.

Diane is not a very great lecturer, however don't fear taking the class from her. Lectures are dry and a lot of wasted time, but all the material you need to know is covered in labs. Make sure you know how the labs work and how to use the datasheet and you're good.

reviews.comment: Dr. Rover is a fantastic professor that cares about her students. The class is difficult and the labs are a lot of work, but she offers a lot of extra credit to help boost your grade when you need it. Her accessibility outside of class is amazing, she had multiple hours across multiple days, which I appreciated.

An alright lecturer overall. Her lectures were generally dull, and I ended up skipping most and just reviewing with the slides. I felt bad for her as she was constrained into a weird teaching style because of an educational grant for the department. The TA's in this class are your friends, ask them to clarify!

This is a very difficult course, but Dr Rover taught it well. She put a lot of burden on the students to learn the material by themselves, but I think it was a good thing. I couldnt just go to class and memeorize the information. I had to learn how to use a technical manual and that knowledge is much more portable than knowing one microprocessor.

She may not have the best lectures , but she is a down to earth professor!!! Lectures may not be useful, but I highly recommend going to office hours. The class is challenging, but she challenges students to prepare for the real world and figure out problems themselves.

This teacher should seriously consider quitting. She didn't teach anything helpful in the entire course, I'm not even sure if she understood anything to start with. She can't answer questions, a tough grader, and very unorganized and unstructured. If you want to learn, don't take this course with her.

Unorganized, bad lecture notes, unclear expectations, overall terrible teacher; This is what you have to look forward to with this professor. She was really bad, the only thing that was pretty good in this course was the TA's, without them I would have failed.

This was the worst professor I have ever had. She seemed to know absolutely nothing about the course and going to class wasn't really worth it. I knew about as much after class as before. Poor lectures that did not actually teach anything helpful to the subject. All classmates struggled through tests, quizzes, homework, and labs because students did not understand what was going on.

Very good instructor, very supportive.  She will teach one of the System Level Design Languages SLDL (SystemC, SpecC ..etc).  Dr. Rover takes quite a while to grade homework and the quiz, but she knows what she is doing and you will get your grades back with a great/detailed feedback.

should stick with administration or look for a career in the military

Kind of a hard grader, busywork, and just springs up huge projects three days before the due date.. take a different English 250 with another professor. Trust me; it'll save you time.

This professor gives a lot of busy homework. It's hard to fail her class, but it is also hard to get an A in her class. She grades in the middle. Overall she is an okay professor, but this probably isn't a course she should be taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: By far one of the best English teaches I've ever had. She is really nice and you can tell she enjoys her job. There aren't really a lot of papers due but when they are, they're big and worth a lot but she prepares you for them. But be prepared to practice communication. For 10 weeks, every Friday, you have to sum up a small article to the class.

It's a lot of work but a lot of practice, and this is what you need to be a writer. She's a genuinely nice person and will do her best to help you out once she gets to know you. Assignments are a little unclear. Do the reading and your duty to your classmates and you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Most assignments are kinda like busy work. The way she grades isn't very clear, but it's not tough either. Make sure to participate in class discussion at least once a day, the participation grade was the hardest for me. Its not an easy A, but its nearly impossible to fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Brenna is a solid choice for a teacher. Not amazing for sure, but for ENG250 she is definitely good enough. She's one of those teachers that practically never gives below a C+ or B- but will rarely give above 95% on assignments as well. If you take this class with her and put in minimal effort you will pass. She is receptive to questions as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She's really only good if you have the same personality type. You are expected to speak often in class or be ready to lose a bunch of points. She's also not very specific about what she wants.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is a nice person but, her expectations are unclear and she sometimes seem unapproachable. Ask question it will help you.  Give a ton of busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She is not clear with her expectations and throws in surprise assignments that you won't know about unless you dig through Blackboard. On the plus side, she doesn't use moodle.

Heavy reading (4 text stories +8 peer stories, weekly). Heavy writing (Weekly response to text readings+ critiques for EACH peer story+writing your own stories). She has no clear grading criteria. After first few weeks, she doesn't teach anything, just does class critiques. Tedious class, which sucks because of the mandatory attendance policy.

Lacks Integrity: She told the employment office & the ROTC office the minimum grade I would receive was an A. I got a C+. I'm not mad about the grade; I'm mad that she lied, giving me false hope. Lacks Authority. Does not have clear grading criteria. Heavy Reading &Writing, like she thinks it is the only class you are taking. Do Not Recommend.
Awful teacher. Not helpful and confusing. Is friendly, but I would rather talk to a brick (although the experience would probably be similar).
Professor Dixon is funny, open and brilliant. Plus, she's hot. On the whole, I'd take more classes from her if I needed the credits.

She is super nice and helpful. She is a hard grader but she is fair. Her exceptions are not super clear but if you go and ask her after class what you are confused about she will explain it much more clearly.

Awful. She smiles a lot but is a god awful teacher. Unclear, inconsistent, and lectures are a meandering mess of half ideas and non sequitur.If at all possible do not, do not, DO NOT take this class with her.
Awful. Ditzy Dixon. I would rather floss with barb wire than go to this class and hear her babble.

I don't know what other people are talking about but she was a great teacher. She was really open and easy to talk too. If you needed to discuss your stories she was always available at her office. Maybe because this was a creative writing class. My only gripe was their was a ton of reading in the class. From the text book, and other students work

This is the best English teacher I have ever had.  I understand the bad reviews, because everyone who came expecting an easy class hated her.  If you want to be challenged, this is the best possible fiction class and I've kept in touch with her since the class ended.

She was confusing, unclear with her expectations, and harsh when grading papers. She didn't answer question clearly, if not defer them, and was confusing when assigning papers. She didn't post any grades until after the end of the semester. Avoiding her if possible will make your life a lot easier!

She is confusing, unclear with her expectations and harsh when grading papers. She wasn't very clear about answering questions. For a while she had a paper due every week for 6 weeks. Used the textbooks very little, one of which not at all. She didn't post any grades until after the semester ended. Avoid her if you can. Ur life will be a lot easier

If you get her RUN! it's not worth it. Take it later if you have to. She is very confusing and is never clear about what she wants on assignments. If you go to her office hrs about your grade or with questions about a paper it's like talking to a smiling brick wall. Again I can't stress this enough if you get her RUN! she's that bad.

She is probably the worst English teacher I have ever had at Iowa State. I have no idea how she grades the story, but she was never clear of her expectations. Sometimes she'd keep our old work for long ago and return it to us graded by the new criteria she makes. After taking her class, I couldn't write for a long time. Stay away from her 304!!

She is a nice teacher but her directions for assignments/essays are not clear and are confusing. I would email her asking for help, but I would be even more confused afterwards. The community action project at the end is probably the most straight forward. Readings and discussions every class. Took it Spring 2012, 8am, so that could be why haha

She's a very nice person, bu not the best teacher. She did not give clear directions on our assignments and was not very helpful when I asked for help. I asked for her feedback for one of our papers and did it all over based on what she said and still didn't get a good grade. It's nearly impossible to get an A in her class.
Some of what she teaches proves useful for the future, but a lot of times, she has unreasonable grading and does not provide that much help even during office hours.

This class did not need to be 2 hours.  A lot of the content was repetitive and made the lectures tiresome.  She truly cares about her students but has a lot of high expectations when grading that aren't included in a rubric.  Overall, there is a lot to learn from in this class but only 1 topic was focused on the whole semester.

I'm not sure. Very sweet, but I was extremely bored in class. We would always repeat things and I just don't think 2 hours of lecture is necessary. I know she cares about teaching us, but I feel she needs to change a few things to help people become more intrigued and interested to go to class. I feel that some assignments were not necessary.

Pointless tasks took up the majority of this course. I could've learned just as much, if not more, if this class was 50 minutes instead of two hours. Repetitive and common sense assignments. Her voice started becoming irritating after listening to it for hours on end each week. Easy grader but it's torture to just waste time in her class.

She is very helpful and works with you when you need help or are struggling. She does have a lot of assignments, and many of the readings are repetitive. I think overall she is a good professor, and she cares about her students and is passionate about mathematics. If you try hard and put forth the effort, you should have no issues in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Such an amazing professor. She was clear about expectations and made everyone feel welcome. She was so helpful with everything and made it easy to learn.

Be prepared to read 2-4 ch a night and 1/2 page reflection for each. There are so many reflections in this class, you could build a wall with them. If she says you have to print something 98% chance you don't and can use your computer to look at it in class. Worst class in Block 1 by far
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: There are quizzes every week. She tells you what to study, but it is not clear. We did a couple of evaluations for things to improve on. (WHERE DID THOSE GO?!)  Around 2-3 projects, the main one is LONG. Some of the content on the final is not what we studied. Overall, the moral is if she taught it well, the course would have been interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lecture content had little to do with community nutrition; instead, sociological and political concepts. Lectures were long and incoherent, and her quizzes contained material that was unrelated to what was discussed in class. Feedback on group projects had personal bias, and grading rubrics were not clear.

Her lectures and quizzes are unclear, jumbled, and lack coherence. Her lectures consist mainly of opinionated statements and lengthy stories that have little to do with the course content or what will be covered on the quizzes. Quizzes had unfinished questions and were unclear; she also graded based on opinion rather than the rubric.

Confusing class, cryptic test questions. Pay attention to everything she says and the specific wording of it in class because it could be on quizzes even if it's not written anywhere. Dr. Winham is passionate about the content but very opinionated and lectures are hard to sit through and follow. Syllabus and assignment schedule inaccurate.

The course has great material that is very important to know.That being said you will learn none of it because Dr.Winham spends her time lecturing on unrelated opinions and emphasis on race and political opinions where it in not needed. She grades strictly on grammer and gives nor feed back on content, the quizes include material not learned

She announces things last minute. Sends TONS of emails, most of them irrelevant. Rambles through irrelevant stuff then grades harshly on assignments. Group projects are unrealistic due to how much time she gives you. Attendance was not required but she takes attendance anyways. Poor explanations of expectations for assignments and due dates.

Dr. Winham has very particular rules when it comes to her grading and it is not consistent from person to person. The TA and her were never on the same page, which was frustrating. Class points for just going to class, sometimes it was extra credit. Only quizzes and a final, only large projects (3) with two of them being in small groups.

On many occasions, he does not know how to solve the problem. Frequently gets problems wrong in class. I stopped going to lectures after week 2, and I have an A. He often grades quizzes incorrectly and does not regrade. On one occasion, I had the correct work and answer, had it verified by multiple people, and he still marked it wrong.

Had professor D'Alessandro for calc 1 after I took calc one in high school. I thought he did a good job explaining 90% of the topics very clearly and simply, a few times he could have done a better job. He checks in multiple times during examples to ask for question and really cares that people understand his lessons. Writes out examples in lecture

I had him for Calc 1, 1650, and it took a little getting used to the accent and the handwriting. The lectures were okay, but he didn't always answer questions well. He also has an odd way of doing problems sometimes that just seem more complicated than what I do.

He overcomplicates everything. You can find videos online that explain the content way better. Lectures are dull, but I suppose it's difficult to make differential equations interesting. The tests were pretty easy.

I loved his lectures and his passion for the subject was very evident. He does upload lecture notes before hand which are very thorough, but I recommend going for the lectures. He is very approachable by email, and his exam review sessions really help you with the exam. People seem to find his accent heavy, but I did not have a problem.

He posts all his levture notes to Canvas ahead of time. No real need to go to lecture. Study the material, watch YouTube videos, go to recitiation. The grade is based on online HW assignments and 4 exams (including Final).The lecture before an exam, he gives a 'practice' exam that you can hand in to be graded if you don't want to take the real exam

Dry lectures, does a poor job of going over material. Tests are wildly inconsistent and seem too difficult for what are very simple concepts. He seems like a good guy but for what we pay to go here I expect a little bit better of a lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's a decent lecturer, but he moves fast and has a bit of an accent.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you suck at algebra, do not take it with him because the algebra in his class is hard. But if you're half decent then his class will be a cakewalk. No quizzes and 2 tries on each test, and if you can decipher his handwriting and ignore the proof his notes are like basically worth your weight in gold.

HOLY COW I was terrified to take this class because of his 3.7 rating and because I thought that a 3.7 was a bit low but I did not want to take a chance with the only other professor teaching the class because their rating was lower. I am so beyond glad that I took this class with D'alessandro great guy great class. Deserves probably more of a 4.5
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This professor was a very clear lecturer. His italian accent might have been difficult to understand at times, but that never hindered my understanding of key concepts in this class. He gives wonderful practice exams and gives two attempts at each exam.
Take him. You won't regret it.

His handwriting is pretty awful, and it takes some time to get used to his voice, But if you spend enough time outside class to take good notes on his slides and understand each lecture, it's passable. Extremely heavily exam weighted. Lectures are very theory heavy, but usually the examples clear up most of the confusion. Studying alot is necessary

D'Alessandro is a little hard to understand and it is hard to read his writing, but he gives straight-forward notes. For every test there is a practice test and a final test. He posts the test keys the night of every test. Also he has tons of practice tests with keys. The real test is pretty much exactly like the practice tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: At first, I was not impressed with D'Alessandro.  He has a very unique accent and his handwriting is not the best.  However, later on, I really came to appreciate him.  He gives many examples and his lectures are really helpful.  He gives you two chances for each test (excluding final) and if you study the practice tests, you can do really well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Alessandro is a really great professor. If you attend and listen to his lectures, you will get an easy A. He gives two chances at each test (except final) and really useful practice papers. Use them. His lectures right before the tell you what you need to study for. And there's not much homework.
3 tests, online homework and one final exam. You have 2 tries on the tests. Very clear explanation and gives a lot of example. Study the practice exams and you will get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is AMAZING AND SO AWESOME. Definitely take him. If you're in diff. eq. YOU WANT THIS PROF. Course is super easy with him and he gives lots of resources. Don't need to put too much time into the course either. TWO TRIES ON EXAMS. Straightforward. Really cool guy! :) His accent is weird at first and he has funny handwriting.

2 attempts for each test which he gives you the exact format of before hand. There are only 3 tests and 1 final and online homework. His recitations were only for review (no quizzes) and all his lecture notes are posted online. That said, attend class since his handwriting is sloppy, but if you study for the tests, you'll get an A.

Diffeq is a tough class. D'Alessandro does everything he can to help you succeed, including giving you the exact format of the test and essentially allowing 2 tries for every test. His accent is thick and handwriting isn't the best, but he makes the concepts clear enough. Would recommend for 267

Literally the worst handwriting I've ever seen. He has a strong Italian accent too, which makes it even harder to understand the lectures. Doesn't assign homework, so grades are dependent on quizzes and tests. Khan Academy is your best friend. However, he does tell you exactly what's on each test, so the class isn't completely impossible.

He was my first math professor at Iowa State. In the past, I've never had any trouble with calculus in general. This class I had a great amount of trouble. This class is supposed to be easy, but it's a bunch of memorization. He's also a bad lecturer with terrible handwriting. My TA was also terrible.

He is a great math teacher. I had him for a smaller class of about 30 and he was really good with people interrupting and asking questions. Moves fast but leave a lot of time for review. I had a lot of fun in the class and it wasn't too difficult thought I did have to work at it a little.
Great Professor made my time in Calc II enjoyable. He makes jokes. Goes through the material a little fast, does make more time for review though.

Ignore any negative reviews. He's definitely the best teacher in the math department I've had. Yes, he has an accent but you can still clearly understand him. He's very fair in grading and teaches you step by step how to solve the problems. Also tells you exactly what to know for tests. Try to take his section if you can.
His lectures are hard to follow and his handwriting is awful but he tells you what is going to be on the test.  Homework and tests are graded really fairly!
hardest class of my life. avoid this guy if you can. his speech is incomprehensible, he doesn't like students asking him questions. although he curves pretty well at the end.

Just okay. you will understand his accent at last. I had him as Linear Algebra.. he's kind of you come for office hour/ or ask him because.. not many student asked him question.. If you are talkative person, he would love to teach class that has you.
Very good prof.  Hand writing is sometimes hard to read but will gladly clarify if you ask.  Would recomend to anyone considering taking DFQ.  (P.S. DO NOT TAKE SMILEY, YOU WILL FAIL!)
Really smart.  Accent is easy to understand, and sometimes humorous.  Attendance not required; if you get the online hw, you'll do fine on the tests.
Has thick italian accent, and failed half my class including myself.

A bit hard to understand occasionally. HE DIDN'T HARDLY CURVE. He failed 50% of the class. Don't take this professor unless you already know a great deal about calculus. I had a BIG STRUGGLE! (accidentally writes in Italian occasionally).

Definately the best math teacher I ever had.  Made sure to teach every concept and showed examples on absolutely everything.  Said everything that was going to be on every test, even the final, and was very helpful in explaining concepts.  I would definately try to get him as a professor for Calc III.

don't like to go to class/dont want to learn anything? this guy is for you.reads straight out of book. doesn't answer any questions straight. hard to understand sometimes. hates when students ask him questions during office hours. grades tests based on if he likes you - takes points off randomly. final had no calculations just formal deffinitions

Jing Dong was a great professor for CE 355. Tests and homework were not too hard, and you were provided a formula sheet for the exams, which is nice. At the end of lecture she would have students fill out a survey asking what was most confusing in the lecture, and then she would go over some of those points at the beginning of next class period.
Perfect. The coursework is easy to follow and the amount of homework is reasonable.

NOT AS HARD AS PEOPLE THINK!!! The tests are a bit challenging but if the readings are done then it's not too bad. Attendance is so important to being informed and learning. If you're looking for a class that's easy to pass with the least effort then Animal Ecology: 321 is for you.
Does not explain clearly. Does easy example problems with hard exams.
She's a horrible lecturer. The class has super interesting topics but she structures the class so poorly.

Actually the worst class I have ever taken, worse that Physics 222. The structure of the class is horrible, you cant understand her accent, and she is virtually useless when explaining topics. Too much work for such simple topics. The exams are too hard for this level, overall a horrible class and prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He is the best lecturer I have had in my 4 years. Great guy, very kind. Exams require studying, but the material shouldn't be difficult to grasp. Cumulative final but its not hard. Some textbook questions. Pay attention and participate in class, and you will do well. If I studied more or went to office hrs I'd have an easy A. Best Prof I ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the most boring and useless psych class I have taken. I have learned nothing worthy of application. Lectures are long, done on plain white slideshows, and he talks the entire class period without any engagement. The entire grade for the class is based off of four exams with the final being both cumulative and worth 30%. I do NOT recommend.
Grades are only from exams. I take chemistry and physic classes and got an A and I have a C in his class. So I would not take.

Good teacher, hard classes. He makes the material much more accessible and easy to understand for students. The lectures are incredibly long which is tiring. The final is cumulative which SUCKS. You really have to go to class because the slides he puts on canvas don't include the examples which is 75% of the exams.

Dr. Smith is a very approachable and funny guy! His lectures are relatable and pretty comprehensive. Most of the test questions are taken from lecture but does have a handful of questions from the book. You will have to read the book to pass this class. Not to much things to grade and all quizzes and exams are multiple choice. Cumulative final!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I would highly recommend taking any of Professor Drury's online courses. Every week, there is a 2-page reflection on that week's reading; those are the only assignments. He is a more than fair grader, and if you put in effort each week on the assignment, you can expect to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is very straightforward. Each assignment is a two-page paper responding to the prompt questions based on a chapter from the textbook, which you'll need to purchase since citations are required. As long as you keep up with the assignments and put in some effort, earning an A in this course is very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Drury is a great professor. This class consisted of weekly papers based on chapters in the textbook. As long as you completed the papers, and it was evident that you tried, he almost always gives 100%. Overall, this class was super easy and Dr. Drury was very on top of grading assignments and answering emails quickly!

There is a lot of read so be on top of it. There are only 2 paper assignments each week with one final project. Final project includes an interview with a focus topic. Learned a lot from the readings and if you plan ahead it's a simple course. Highly recommend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a great professor! Responded when he received assignment which was nice knowing he saw it. The schedule was nice and consistent and you knew what was expected each week so there were no surprises. Would for sure take again

This course was amazing. You only have to write 2 papers each week. No final exam or quizzes. The textbook is very formative. However it can get lengthy to read at times. Overall, I highly recommend this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Respected

reviews.comment: One one page assignment due per week on Sunday and an 8-10 page final paper at the end. Other than that there is no other work. Easy grader.

There is one weekly two page assignment that is related to the reading. There is no other assignments, however you must use the book in your writing to show that you have read it. There is no final or quizzes. Overall, I would recommend him as a professor.
So good! Basically a paper a week, one page. You read from the textbook and write a paper answering prompts I got 25/25 on all. When I emailed with questions he was always nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Really great professor, for CJ 242 you write 1 page a week and then a longer paper at the end of the semester. Easy class and easy A. Professor grades things quickly and is nice.

This class was really relaxed and straightforward, all you have to do is turn in a one page summary of a couple questions he gives you about the chapter reading for that week by Sunday at midnight. Then, there is a paper at the end. He pretty much always hands out a 100% for the weekly pages as long as you do it.0048-0267018
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This professor is awesome. He keeps such a steady schedule for what we do each and every week, so it's not constantly changing or hard to grasp. The powepoints are straight to the point and informative. He's also a very relaxed grader when it comes to the weekly assignments!

Super easy class. Takes attendance so show up if you want to get a good grade. Each test has 5 long answer questions but he gives you all the questions before hand. Dont have to read the textbook if you show up and pay attention. Three hour classes are never fun but he almost always dismisses early.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly, I don't write reviews but his class was so good I just had to. If you're indecisive if you want to take his class or not ... JUST TAKE IT. Easy A, he gives you word for word what the questions are going to be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took this class online and it was very easy as long as you stay on schedule. With it being online, everything is due at the end of the semester, so if you're a procrastinator, stick with the schedule. It would be hard to do it all at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Showing up to class is important to pass. He takes attendance grades and it can help raise your grade at the end of the semester. The way he teaches and what to expect is clearly outlined in the syllabus. If you show up to class, you will know what to expect on the tests. I didn't get an A but I would have if I showed up to more classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class was super interesting. Im a CJ major so I found this class super relevant to be and the information was so cool. There's 3 exams and 1 research paper. He's a very easy grader on the paper and as long as you do your work, you'll do fine.

Alan Drury is a great professor, one of the best. He is very clear on what will be on tests, and will answer any questions you have. He gives great real-world examples that make class interesting and fun.  He does the best he can to make a 3 hour class bearable!

He does usually assign one paper for the semester, he is very liberal when grading them. His 352 class has multiple choice quizzes, he tells you exactly what you need to know. His 484  class is a little harder. Mandatory attendance but if you are thinking of going into Corrections this is a VERY good class to take. Tests are 5 essay questions.

He's a caring and helpful guy, so I'd feel bad when people were uninterested in his lectures. Grade is based entirely off of 2 big projects, so don't slack off or procrastinate. Wei clearly loves his job, and is willing to help you outside of class or during work time if you just ask. Be prepared and choose a good group.

I really liked Dr.Zhang. He cares a lot about his students and wants to learn everyone's names.The class itself is very project heavy, but it was helpful to learn some real-life skills. No exams or homework, but you will need to invest time in the projects to do well in the class.
Wei is a great professor! He care about all of his students and is more than willing to meet outside of class. MKT 367x is all group projects so pick a good group!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: He really cares about his students and gives great feedback. He'll will make you work for your grade but pretty simple work.
Fantastic class, very inspirational and informational. Interactive professor and genuinely respects the students.
really cares about his students

The thing that really bugged me was 18 percent of the grade was participation & attendance and I got 9/9 for attendance but got 0/9 for participation just because I didn't raise my hand enough times during lecture. JOKE! Also acts like the two exams (mid-term & final) are not anything to stress about, but yet very difficult exams! Very unorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Mr. Zhang's classes are very difficult, but if you want to do good and find amazing real world experience through a class with just 2 case studies, MKT 368 is for you. He will do anything to make sure a student will succeed and will answer emails at 1AM in the morning or going to his office hours. He cares so much, he values all his students. 10/10

He's a great guy but no organization. he told us the first day not to worry about taking notes and participate in class, yet the exams are very difficult. Our midterm exam was uploaded the night before the final exam, before then, there  were 0 grades entered in. It was stressful not knowing where you stand grade wise. Save the headache, stay away.

Dr. Zhang really cares about his students. He wants them to receive real world knowledge instead of just teaching to a test. You learn very practical marketing skills while also learning how to think and approach tough questions and situations. He appreciates hard work and effort, and those are rewarded. Will have to work hard, but it is worth it.

If you do not want to work hard, this is definitely not the class for you. Our team was great! All of us want to get A. I have never worked this hard in my life. Professor Zhang was extremely helpful. He always met with us to give detailed feedback. The final presentation was a fascinating experience.

Dr. Zhang's marketing 340 section is different than any other beginner marketing course because you are given a real life marketing project that takes place throughout the semester. I learned more in this class than any other business class I have taken because I had to brainstorm about an actual marketing campaign. HIGHLY RECOMMEND DR. ZHANG

Loved com s 252 at first, then it felt like the lectures got a bit longer and drier (that probably was just me). My only complaint about the class are the exams. They are so short and account for so much of your grade. Also, some of the questions felt really obscurely specific.

The course is structured in a way that makes it difficult for beginners to  learn Linux. For the homework assignments, the guidelines are very unclear and will often confuse you rather than help you understand what the assignment is about. Only good part is that is readily available to answer questions in Piazza
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class was very informative, and covered a lot of topics. Homeworks were straightforward and had piazza help options (Professor was really good about answering questions often). Tests were difficult, had irrelevant history questions and long imbedded single line command questions that were hard to answer. Got two front and back cheat sheets.
Unless you're already a whiz with Linux, I strongly caution against taking 252 with Miner. The exams will kill you.

Professor Miner is the ideal professor. He has useful and meaningful slides and lectures. The homework directly relates to the material and the material and assignments are beneficial to outside classes! The tests were meh. Miner shines through his presence on Piazza - questions would only go minutes before being answered by him!
Really solid professor. An angel compared to any of the other professors I had this semester. Helped a ton on Piazza and was super helpful in the scheduled lecture times.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lectures are just reading from the slides with commentary sprinkled in. Use piazza! He is very active and helpful on there. First half of the class should be a requirement for all CprE/SE/CS majors imo. Incredibly useful skills to have. Second half focusses on network related stuff, and I wasn't a big fan. Still a great course though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are fine. Office hours were terrible! One hour a week and no TA's! Seemed to not understand questions you ask or would not to answer to avoid "giving the answer away". Homework assignments every week, two mini-projects per quarter. 4 part semester project given a piece at a time, made it difficult to reuse previous code
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was not particularly challenging, but despite that I managed to get a lot out of it. I think the first half of the course is useful for any person really to know no matter what field they are in, not just computer science students. Then the class kicks into gear and things like networking are explained from their roots which was awesome
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures have very little bearing on grade; if you reference his class notes while doing homework, you will pass. Grading is reasonable. Tests are middling difficult and rely on lecture material. Does not seem to enjoy teaching. Talks down to students, and often dismisses questions without providing a clear answer.
Miner is good in this class, but it all seemed a little chaotic. Grading took weeks to get done and was often done incorrectly. The class is very hard but miner's lectures make it a lot easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Miner is very honest and clear with his expectations and criteria. No assignment was unclear in their instructions and his Piazza activity is exceptional. He gives full fledged responses to everything he can and in a timely manner too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I took this class online while abroad and Dr. Miner was awesome about getting back to me, trouble shooting, and exam accommodations.  Overall class was just the right level of challenging; however, I have worked with command line prior to this class for over a year now almost every week.  If you haven't worked in Linux or Unix it might be harder.

Prof. Miner has many lectures on the topics we cover available on BB. The lectures are good to read and you probably need to go over them to pass, but the videos he uploads of his 'lecturing' are vastly just reading the slide. Don't bother listening to the video unless you're lost. There's weekly homework and three exams.

Homework assignments are practical, online lectures are easy to follow along with, and he is always available on piazza or in office hours. The class covers a wide range of linux based things so you will definitely have highs and lows, but there is extra credit at the end of the class that you should take advantage of. Tests average in the 70s.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is a great professor, very helpful, and he saved my life in this hard course.

Professor Miner is absolutely one of the best professors in the Computer Science department, hands down. Personable, reasonable, and very willing to work with students on any problem they have, at any time he is in his office. If you have a chance to take his class, do not pass it up.

The class is very, very difficult, however he does a great job fitting in the material and explaining it as well as he can. It is a great class where you learn a lot and he is a great teacher (go in for help HE HELPS A LOT) but the class is EXTREMELY hard
Extremely hard class, but very good professor. Very personable, he realizes he teaches an incredibly difficult class and wants to help, if approached outside of class.
Spend too much time on Programming language C, and C++. Get ready to Programming. Classes are easy, exams are hard though.

I took the lecture portion of this class online and the videos were informative and translated great to the lab portion of the class. Grading was straightforward and the lab instructor and professor were good at communication.

the class was interesting and the workload was never to much. the main issue is the timing of the exams. with the class being at 7:45 am on Mondays the first exam was after the super bowl and the second was right after spring break. It was incredibly hard to study and attend those classes.

The content was pretty straight forward, easy to comprehend and digest. With the study guides and sometimes the powerpoints, exams are never too daunting. With a few easy quizzes and assignments, this class is pretty average in terms of workload. Drenth is a pretty good professor!

She does not give clear feedback as to why your assignments were graded the way they were. Most of the test materials are not emphasized as important in lecture. Also studying for the class is very hard as she flies through the lecture slides and does not post them online.

Great teacher. She really cared about me and my questions. Lots of lecturing but she provided decent study guides. 4 exams in the semester and a couple various quizzes. She offered various types of extra credit, use. Only big thing was the health promotion project which I actually enjoyed. Good class, good teacher. I would definitely recommend.

This professor is great, and the online course is very easy. All you have to do is the homework, definitely watch the lecture videos, as the exam is taken only from lectures. You get 2 note sheets for exams, front and back, so if you put in the work to watch the lecture, you should get an easy A.

I took PSYCH 1010 online with Dr. Gentile and really like him as a professor, but not how the class is structured. In order to do all the work, including extra credit, I probably spent around 6-9 hours a week on this class. All exams are only on the lectures despite there being hours upon hours of other work. Do not take this class if you're busy.

This class was interesting. However, there is a lot of assignments throughout the week that can get overwhelming if you are not on top of it. The tests are open-note which is nice but you still need to study.  The instructor is caring and gives lots of information in the lectures. There are no papers which is nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The textbooks for this class are very outdated. You read a chapter then have to take a quiz on it. Papers are written for every unit, too. The grading is way too tough and near the end of the class, we were told we weren't allowed to resubmit. Got zeros simply because I used the wrong font.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is by far the worst online class I've ever taken. Gentile has an all or nothing grading system when it comes to grading papers, which can easily screw you over. Lectures are EXTREMELY outdated and so is HIS textbook that he makes you buy. I actually liked him in 101, but this class is horrendous.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Gentile is the best Psych 101 professor out of the three. He makes his lectures very interesting. I learned the most in his class and did not once fell asleep. His teaching technique really works and it's just the best. 10/10 would recommend and take again.

My absolute favorite professor my first semester. Made the lectures cater to each person's learning style (videos, lecturing, and group discussions), which made the class more interesting. Was a funny guy and made you think about the material you were learning.
Gentile is overall a great professor. He goes into good detail in his lectures, but sometimes he speeds through it fast. You can also tell that he cares about the material he teaches.
Boring lectures. Weird humor.

His lectures were interesting and entertaining, but his notes were extremely confusing and difficult. Attendance is a must, he tests off of things that he discussed in class, but didn't include in the notes so if you miss a class, you will lose points on the exam.

He makes his lectures very interesting, and he tries to help every student learn the material. You need to attend class if you want to do well on the exams because the exams are based off of lectures.

Douglas Gentile is an amazing lecturer. He is very engaged in his teaching. He caters to everyone's learning styles and gives clear examples. He is hilarious and does very strange things to get your attention. One of the best professors you'll ever have. Even though it's not mandatory, go to class since his test is almost all based on lecture.

He was a great professor who always found ways to keep us interested in his lectures. He shows a lot of videos and gives good examples. He grades the easiest out of all the Psych 101 professors at ISU and his final was easy, as long as you actually go to class that is
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Gentile is very strange, but he made the lectures interesting. He also always plays movie clips before class, which was nice. I really enjoyed Pysch 101 as a class.
