If you don't know how to use a calculator, good luck. He doesn't teach anything, he just says 'Oh here's how to input it, moving on'. Horrible instructor and just so bad at actually getting you to learn things.

The lectures are extremely important in passing the class. Always asks question he will always help. Get the financial calculator it helps a lot. He really cares about students grade and understanding of material. Put in the effort youll do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He made it very clear on the first day of class that the class was going to be very hard for a lot of people, but he does his best to make his students succeed in the class. I've seen him reach out to students that were obviously struggling to make sure that they absolutely know the material before they leave. You can tell he loves what he does.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Shen's class was very boring and hard to want to pay attention in. Attendance is not mandatory although there are pop quizzes every so often. Textbook is not necessary. This class will take some effort. You get three attempts at the homework, but the exams are quite difficult.

Professor Shen actually cares about you. Go to class, the lectures are really helpful and he wants to really help so ask questions. There is homework each week that you get a couple attempts on. It can be hard sometimes but if you ask him questions over email or in person he's really helpful. He wants you to understand. Tests are similar.
Shen's lecture are pretty boring but the tests are really easy. You get 3 tries on the homeworks, so it is an easy A

Straightforward class. 10 HW total, due Sundays. If you know the HW's, you can easily do well on the tests, although each test is 20 MC so there isn't room for small errors. 3 tests; 1 cumulative final of 32 MC. I struggled to pay attention in lecture, but you can easily learn yourself by doing the homeworks and seeing the formulas.

He goes really fast over lectures in class. He describes things in ways that are more difficult than they need to be. The nice thing is, if you do poorly on an exam you can go to a conference and possibly get some points back.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You get 3 attempts for the HW assignments- so work on them with a friend. It is important to understand the HW, because the tests are the exact same. Junyan offers review sessions before each test which are very helpful! Do not buy the book & make sure to go to class. Lecture can sometimes be boring, but the material is hard to teach to yourself.

Junyan is a great teacher- you definitely need to go to lecture b/c his PPTs are a little confusing. DO NOT buy the book- I opened it once and unnecessary. Go to his office after tests and he will give back points. He likes learning student's names and will help you! I got extra points + a curve b/c he knew my name and I went to class before break.

The three exams and the final were worth 80% of the the grade, so if you're not good at tests this is not the guy for you. HW you get 3 tries on, so that is nice. Not the strongest English, but understandable and definitely knowledgable. Gave me extra credit points for talking about each test afterwards. No Curve

Junyan was actually an amazing professor for FIN 301. He genuinely wanted me to learn and succeed in the class. If you go to his review sessions before each exam, he gives you extra credit on the exam and the review sessions are very helpful. He clearly states what will be on the exams and gives you plenty of resources to study. He cares about you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Junyan Shen is underrated. The class is easy enough, there is extra credit, the homework is not excessive & you get 3 attempts, the tests are short & similar to the homework. The lectures are bearable, unlike my MGMT370 class I actually learned a lot. I encourage you to participate in class.

Do not take this class with him.  It was his first semester teaching and it was obvious.  Lectures were boring and he would fly through examples without making sure anyone understood.  Exams were incredibly hard and not curved.
It was his first semester teaching, and he made it obvious. Lectures were confusing and hard to understand. This makes it tough to do on top of an already tough class. Avoid him.

Tougher than your normal professor - reviews leave out that while  exams are worth 90%,  the entire class is curved to a B-.  Put in the work by reviewing what he tell you to look at and redoing the homeworks and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: It's his first semester teaching , and he doesn't know anything at all. 90% Exams and 10% homework. The homeworks are very long and don't help boost your grade at all. No in class practice problems. Just keeps on talking during the lecture and nobody understands anything. Try to avoid him!!
She reads off from slides and its very hard to take notes. There should be another professor for cybersecurity courses who is more qualified.

Lots of people don't like the policy with no partial credit for lab questions. I found no issues as the directions are clear anyways. Exams were not bad and she only put on the exams what she taught us. Great professor if you put effort in!
Very poor course coordination. Incredibly sloppy writing in both lab manuals and lecture slides. Awful at taking constructive criticism.

Took a ton of her classes, including 331 and 436x all of which were enjoyable, lots of hands on lab work to familiarize yourself with the concepts, and always very transparent about what you are going to be tested on/should know for your exams.
Had her for 230 and 231. Her lectures were good but 90% of the class is the labs. As long as you go to her review lectures, you'll do fine on the tests.

Her lectures are not much better than reading directly off of her slides and makes it difficult to take notes in her own course. If your curious as to how qualified she is look up what her publications are and you'll see that she has not done anything of her own. Despite being a poor teacher some how has the audacity to be a terrible person

I had Julie for 230, 231, and 331. My overall experience with her was great, she knows her stuff and has pretty interesting lectures. The three classes I had with her are the major 3 that set me up to succeed in the cybersecurity field. My only issue with her was her 230 final. Memorization of trivial things mattered more than understanding topics.

Many people do not like Dr. Rursch's grading policies and such, but personally I think they are pretty straightforward. At first the classes can seem daunting, but over time I have grown to enjoy the class format and understand how she grades. I have had her as my cyber professor for the past 3 semesters and will next semester. Great professor.

I have had Dr. Rursch for two semester in a row and she has hands down been the best professor I have had at Iowa State. If you go to lectures, ask questions, and make an effort to learn more about the course content you should have a great time with Dr. Rursch.

If you don't care about the class, you will struggle. Julie has some policies that aren't perfect, but not unreasonable. If you want to learn the topic, and show that in class, she is wonderful and always willing to help. She is also, incredibly consistent in difficulty I was never surprised by any material on exams across 4 classes taken with her.

If you need to take CPRE classes I would seriously wait for any other professor they are all so much more engaging and respectful to their students, Julie is one of the only professors in the CPRE department which is so unliked
If you need to take cybersecurity engineering classes I would wait for another professor, none of her lectures were engaging and she does not care about her students
Just reads the slides, class is boring, attendance mandatory

Julie is super sick. While she does have some old school policies around attendance and slides she has worked hard to create a strong class framework for Cyber E students at Iowa State. I've found if you make sure to communicate then she is understanding with attendance.

exams have questions such as: how did we refer to this specific thing in class it doesn't test your knowledge it tests how well you memorize her lectures. some of her labs have the wrong instructions which make it impossible to do the lab correctly, when she is told about this she will fix it in slack but doesn't make an announcement to the class.

- goes through slides quickly
- poor exam prep
- covers topic vaguely

Good Lord. This woman is the bane of my existence. Cybersecurity was ridiculous - she moves too fast and her answers to questions are not helpful at all. Great professor you can tell she cares about the subject and the students, although she seems to have some kind of vendetta towards students who don't come class, and ends up taking it out on the whole class. One of the best professors I've had at ISU. If you put in the work, you'll do fine. Labs are fun, lectures are helpful.

reviews.comment: CPRE 230 is the most boring class I've taken at Iowa State. Too bad the labs are useless too. Rursch cares about how the class is taught, but doesn't do it well. Dropping the cybersecurity minor after this if its this boring.
Great course and great teacher. I learned a lot and she explains the topic very well.
She does a good job at trying to connect to her students and making her lectures fun/relatable. Labs were really fun to do and not too difficult.

Lectures were boring. She reads from slides. Not a very good lecturer. Lectures aren't mandatory, but the labs are. One lab and reading due per week. PAY ATTENTION TO THE SYLLABUS. If you've never programmed or have little experience, expect to put in more time than you think you need.

definitely would recommend dr. rursch. she is great- she really tries her best to connect with her students and cares about them. lectures can get a little slow but overall a great class and a great teacher

best teacher i have had at ISU so far.  her lectures were actually interesting and i went to pretty much all of them (at 8 am while there were no clicker points) so you could say she's a pretty dang good teacher and actually interesting for me to get out of bed and go each time.

take good notes, get overwhelming

Dr. Sterle is very passionate about what she teaches, if you go to class and listen, you will learn something. As someone who grew up on a farm background even I was learning stuff each lecture. high recommend!!

Tough, but I LOVED this class!

Dr. Sterle is one of the greats at ISU. She is a tough professor, but it is because she loves what she teaches. Sets clear expectations of the class, amazing person!
Never know what your grade is half the time, very slow at giving things back to you. Don't ask her for help, she'll just be rude to you

ANS114 with Sterle was definitely my favorite class. She does such a great job of explaining all the concepts and really makes the 8AM lecture worth going to. I would definitely recommend taking this class with her. Her final is not required if you have less than 2 absences. Her exams are lengthy, but if you attended lectures, they are easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher, great opinions on topic, and I really learned a lot from her. You treat her with respect and she will do the same for you and bend over backwards in order to help you if she can.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Sterle is a great animal science professor! Her lectures are entertaining and are essential to go to if you want a good grade in the class.  The questions on the tests come right from her lectures and the weekend quizzes she assigns.  Dr. Sterle is easy to contact and is very good at communicating what will be on tests at the end of sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shes amazing! and is truly passionate about what she does. 114 is extremely easy if you have a background in livestock.

Dr. Sterle was a great teacher who presented the material in an easy-to-understand format. Weekend quizzes over the material taught in class each week and Top Hat quizzes before each class. If you miss two or fewer class you are exempt from the final. Only frustrating thing was that she doesn't always respond to your emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her tests were sort of difficult. I wasn't too big of a fan of the timing. The exams started at 7:15 in the morning. Make sure you read the online textbook!!! A lot of the questions on tests are off lectures but many many many are from the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great Professor. Could work on being more respectful of different perspectives but overall, I learned a lot with her lectures.

Dr. Sterle is one of the best professors I've ever had. Her lectures make getting to class at 8 am worth it. She's really good at explaining the material and making it interesting. It is extremely important to take good notes and go to class. Exams require studying, but are not awful and the final is optional if you only miss a couple classes.
She was great. Yes, she expects you to be very responsible, but it's well worth it. Amazing professor, really great class for freshmen.

This class is very basic and right to the point. Exams are easy if you study correctly. Clicker questions everyday worth up to 8 points so it adds up quickly if you miss. If you're there everyday you will most likely pass because of participation. You get 2 points for correct ? and 1 point for just clicking if wrong. Also I never touched my book.
She is a great teacher! Keeps you interested at 8 am.

She made having an 8 A.M. enjoyable. She's enthusiastic and incorporates current events related to the material. Attending class is almost a must. There are clicker points before every lecture, and the notes are needed to complete the weekly quiz. Rewards good attendance by exempting from the final. I would highly recommend this class!
Makes the class enjoyable, go to class and the class is easy.
Very nice professor and clearly passionate about the subject matter. Unfortunately, I feel like it is less of a class and more of a recruitment against animal rights activists.

Great teacher, enthusiastic about class and subjects, wants students to learn. Wish I would have attended class more because that's where most of your points come from. Exams are easy, it's a shame that she doesn't have more knowledge of subject areas (excluding repro) and doesn't seem to want to help students with grade correction issues

Don't really need the textbook for 114.  She made 114 and 211 really easy cause of the familiarity from orientation.  Great personality!!  Always willing to help.  Definitely wanna take her 207 class!
Great teacher, it makes waking up at 8 AM reasonable. Tests are easy and class is fun.
Great teacher
LOVED this class. it is at 8am and she said it always will be, BUT if you miss less than 2 classes, you dont have to take the final! clicker quizzes almost every day - points add up!

The only book for the class is an online book that is "recommended but not necessary". If you want to do well on the quizzes and the tests I would buy the book. Dr. Sterle makes sure that the students understand what she is talking about before moving on. If you go to class the final is optional and you will  get a good grade.

Class was at 8 AM, but was worth  it.  She makes notes available before class with missing words, so you can just fill them in during class.  Exams easy if you study.  Optional final, if you have two or less absences!!! Very caring and helpful as a professor. Get the Webcom program, but don't buy the book.  Never opened it all semester.
Favorite teacher I have had at Iowa State so far! She does a really good job explaining things and actually cares that you understand it. I'm glad I have her next year for AnS 211.

Dr. Sterle is a lovely person, however some of the "facts" she presents are glaringly incorrect and it is clear that she does not have extensive experience with some of the species she is attempting to teach about. Not bad, but not good either. Seems unwilling to help students in situations such as an incorrect grade entered online.
She is a great professor. This was my only 8 a.m. class this semester and I still attended class every single day. Go to class and take notes and you will do good on exams.

Her lectures were really interesting and she was fun to listen to. Tests are pretty easy if you study the notes. Textbook is helpful for learning breeds but I didn't have one and passed. Pretty good at making complicated subjects understandable. Very fun professor!
She was very helpful and understanding of everything!! She kept class interesting and interactive even though there were many students.

I loved this class!  It's very similar to 101 but goes a little more in depth on everything.  Professor Sterle is very passionate about the agriculture industry and she always brings up current, relevant topics.  Great class!

Dr. Sterle is by far my favorite professor!  She responds quickly to her e-mails and is very approachable!  Her tests come straight from her notes and are very clearly stated.  She tells you basically whats going to be on the test.  The online textbook is very helpful in studying!  I love her!!!!
Take other English options if possible...

This professor seems to have a PhD in passive aggression. Grading is completely arbitrary as she rarely follows the rubric, and she treats student questions like a personal offense. She clearly plays favorites, so unless you're one of the chosen few, prepare to be ignored. Avoid this class if you can.

Julie wasn't my favorite professor, she had clear favorites in class and always seemed passive-aggressive if you messed up. Instructions were always unclear, and she made it your problem to figure it out. She loves to call on people to catch them not paying attention which low-key sucks. She's not a tough grader thankfully.

class was actually ENGL314. Julie was great, made a class that would usually be very tedious fun and entertaining. I looked forward to these lectures. Projects are a lot of work, but she is very reasonable on grading. If you attend class, it would be unlikely to get worse than a B

Professor Seier is a great source when it comes to professional writing. She can get disorganized but has the best intentions with her students. There is a good amount of work to do outside of class as a few projects require major brainpower. She can grade harsh at times as she is particular on certain things.  I enjoyed the class though!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Julie is a tough grader, and was slightly disorganized when first walking into class, but as soon as she was settled, we were able to get a lot done. I thought this class was very fun and she made class very interactive, don't forget to participate, it will help your grade! She cares about her students a lot and provided good feedback. Great prof!

Julie is a great teacher. She can really get into student's heads and help them understand concepts. As a person, she is a little all over the place and disorganized. However, once she gets herself settled in the classroom she can get things done. She cares about her students and is reasonable when grading.

Professor Courtwright is very firm with doing things the way SHE wants them to be done which is frustrating as a student. She doesn't let you take notes on your laptop, wants printed essays, and gives participation assignments every lecture. Her lecture slides are also pointless, she constantly goes off of them. Don't take if your a visual learner!

Dr. Courtwright made this online class very enjoyable. The final was an essay on two western films which was a nice change of pace. Courtwright seemed very eager to help if needed and gave clear, constructive criticism to help better your writing. I would highly recommend taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Provides a lot of content each week ( multiple hour long lectures, readings, podcasts, and other primary sources to read) and with all of that information picks the smallest pieces of information that were barely mentioned to add as quiz questions.
Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Instead of actually making the class entertaining and engaging, she just requires you to do writing prompts and speak in class, or your grade will drop. Courtwright is bland and knows she is, which is why she does this to make sure people listen to her lecture. Quizzes can be too specific and include things you'll probably miss from the lectures.

Like others have said, extremely long and boring lectures.  In regard to 465, get ready to learn very little about the American West; the class focuses on a book that she herself has said is not very beneficial in regard to learning about the West and horses.  She has the tendency to ramble on, and her slides are black and white most of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: HIS 364-Although she seems like a nice enough professor, she is quite boring overall. She is a unnecessarily, unforgiving grader, as for the class itself, I would highly recommend NOT taking The Wild West class. Topics more inclusive of philosophical topics,and IDEAS of the West. Not so much the history. May seem like an easy filler class, its not
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Was a fun class when it came to material but she is very picky with her grading. She would dock you for small things and was not very good on getting back to you over email if there were questions. Material again was easy but she had alot of reading assignments (more than you'd think).

Professor Courtwright is a very average professor. She has a very bland lecture style without much outside of lectures that she talks about. There was a lot of readings that you have to do for this class. The quizzes are sometimes very specific and can be difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
(Actually for HIST 364) -

Professor was helpful when need be but TA did most of the grading (subjective).  Enjoyed learning about the myth of the Wild West and gained cool info.  Unfortunately, there was SO much reading and you had to do it to answer questions for papers and quizzes.  No exams.  Homework done on a two week basis (very chill).
Courtwright has the most boring lectures I've ever been to. She drones on, reading off of slides, and she and her TA grade VERY subjectively. Be ready to hear about horses for 3 or 4 lectures in 221.

Lectures are all over the place, rambles constantly. No visuals during lecture for note taking just a photo and maybe a point while you have to really take in everything she is saying or you won't pass. Exams are VERY DETAILED. You must keep up with all of the reading in order to pass. I'm a visual learner I did very poorly in this environment.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Lectures are extremely boring. Your TA is your best bet to talk to for grades, session is repetitive and also boring. Gives pop quizzes and points for attendance. Plus side is gives study guide for all exams and non cumulative final. I suggest quizlet for studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was by far the worst class I have ever taken at Iowa State. If you're not a history major DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Lots of reading every week over very boring topics, random quiz's and the lectures were very boring. The only good part was no exams, but there were papers. If you're taking this as an elective, I highly suggest against it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She gives out mini-assessments every class even though she said they would be random, so if you aren't in class you will most likely fail. Be ready to read a lot and make sure to have a coffee before class so you don't fall asleep. Very boring lecturer and her TA is very boring as well (also seems judgmental). Do not take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Courtwright really knows what she is talking about. She is definetly passionate about the topics which helps make this class really fun. A few times extra credit was given just for showing up to lecture which was nice. She also uses take home essays for the midterm and final which while more work than an exam are much more enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I like Courtwright she defiantly knows her stuff but your grade is up to your TA. They do all the grading. The papers were alright and as long as you show up to recitation and participate you will be fine. I never attended lecture because it was kinda boring and wasn't really necessary.

In HIST 221 we used an the American Yawp textbook online and it was actually easy to read. Keep up with the textbook readings, show up to lecture and recitation, take notes, and you will be able to write the midterm and final easily (they were take home essays). Lectures can get a bit dry, but still make the effort to attend class. Easy class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Incredibly helpful and flexible with deadlines if you have an issue. There aren't really any tests, just quizzes, and if you go to class, read, and pay attention, you will be just fine. She is a super easy grader, and very very nice. 10/10 would recommend taking a class with her.
Worst and easiest class I've ever taken. Lectures are exceptionally boring and recitations aren't much better, depending on your TA. Easy tests and quizzes and attendance points.

The problem is some weeks you will have to read over 150 pages. Your weekly homework is online quizzes that off of text book readings. You only get one chance per question that are difficult and these quizzes are worth 22%. Tests are all free response if you are bad at writing do not take, not an easy elective takes all of your time up.
Good class to take with her. Pretty easy.
She is very difficult to get a hold of. She rarely checks her emails. She is boring as death in lecture, but she explains things very well. If you look at the study guide, you'll be fine.

Relatively easy class, the tests were relatively easy all based on the study guide.  The short essays could be tricky, I received a B+ I wouldn't say it was necessarily the easiest class but it was very interesting and I would suggest taking it.

She is very boring in lectures! Tests were alright, but I had Erik Stumpf as a TA and I do not recommend him. His grading does not match up with what he says. He told me for my first exam that I was "so close to acing it" and I got a D+...

Awesome class! Favorite teacher so far. She explains things completely and in a way you can understand. Just make sure you take notes in class. Very comfortable atmosphere, nice teacher, would definitely recommend this class!
She gave us the terms we should know for the exam. Overall this class was very easy but I did actually learn in this class. She is somewhat boring in lecture.
One of the easiers classes I've ever had. If you do the study guides you'll be fine. Recommended for an easy A
Good professor. Lectures are okay. Nothing hard at all. Goes over all powerpoints clearly. Tests are easy. I would recommend having her for this History class.

I took her ACCT 2850 online over winter break. It was challenging only because of the fast pace. Her lectures were clear and easy to follow, and homework took about 30 minutes. Tests were fair, and she was very kind and helpful when reviewing mistakes. I'd take her again, but winter break requires hours of focused work—fall or spring is better!

Kayla is one of the best professors I have had at ISU. She is very caring for all of her students and genuinely wants to see everyone succeed. I had her for ACCT 2850 and in the class we had 3 exams and a cumulative final. Exams were all easy because I felt prepared from in class activities. Take accounting with her, she is simply the best!!!!!

Professor Sander is really friendly and provides clear grading criteria for all assignments. Her lectures can get a little long, but she still does a great job of covering everything you'll need to know.
The class itself isn't too bad as long as you watch the lectures and do the practice. Professor Sander is very nice and helpful if you have any questions.

I think Kayla is a great person who cares about her students, but she teaches the material in such a simplistic way that the questions on the exams come out of left field. You have to watch videos for class, which is fine, but she talks WAY too much. A 25 minute video could really be shortened to 15 minutes. Also very unclear on project guidelines.

I think that Kayla is a wonderful person who cares a lot about auditing and accounting students. I think that one area Kayla could improve is how much she talks - she tries to fill in the dots for us too often rather than letting us think for ourselves. Other than that she is fair and honest and provides a great learning experience.

Kayla was helpful in the help labs. Do not wait until last minute to complete the online portion. It's not hard, but can be overwhelming to do it all in a short period of time. The project at the end is fairly easy. It's what you would expect out of a 1 cr. course.

Loved the online system used. Definitely don't waste last minute to do assignments. this class is just an overview of ACCT 284 and 285. very simple and you an easily get an A if you get everything done on time.
Do not take 497 with Kayla Sander. She has her favorites and is extremely unfair when it comes to grading. If she doesn't like you she will make sure you don't get an A. Horrible.
Pretty easy class but a lot of work for only one credit. Don't wait until the last minute to do the class because you probably won't get it done
Kayla was a great professor and I would recommend her for any accounting class! I can't wait to have her in the future for my accounting classes.

Kayla was one of my favorite teachers as an accounting major. She structures her class in a way that incorporates both class discussions and lectures to make class more enjoyable. She will help anyone who needs help outside of class. As previously mentioned, she is very attractive and her personality is awesome as well.
Said she hadn't taught 284 in awhile but did a good job. Very helpful and willing to help everyone to understand.

Awesome teacher and extremely hot. She is funny, indefatigable, and has an awesome personality. Do the HW and go to class, it's just that simple. Also, study for the test my doing old exams talk to her if you have any questions. Somewhat of an easy A.

AMAZINGLY helpful teacher. She not only teaches the material well, but she prepares you for the tests. The way she structures the class with homework, exams, team assignments, quizzes, and an Excel project gives you many ways to get your A as long as you work hard. She actually cares about her students, and it shows.
I think she needs a little more experience in teaching.
Good Teacher
Students know that she would delete negative posts on this website. Weird! Classes are boring, and she is all about her ego. While her 'looks' not even average.
Super attractive. Made going to class exciting. Really knows what she is talking about and is extremely helpful if you make the effort.
Extremely Attractive. Very helpful with any questions you have in or outside of class. If you make the effort she will notice.

Smokin hot.  She's a bit scatterbrained when she's trying to convey ideas.  She often stutters or changes what she's saying mid-sentence and then repeats herself.  I found her a bit difficult to follow.. she seemed nervous all the time.  But she's super nice and always willing to help you out.  You will learn a lot about her family as well.
Very easy class... gets the material across in an easy, understandable way.  very hot too!
Super HOT!!!Super easy class!!!Very nice and helpful teacher.
Extremely hot and helpful!! Could not wait to go to class!!
Supppppper HOTTTTT

Kayla is very nice and helpful.  She made things very clear and gave plenty of examples and exercises.  Go to class for easy points on the team exercises.  Not a tough class if you go to class daily, do the homework, and work through the problems.  She is very cute.  Having such a cute instructor is distracting for a guy.

She's really excellent!! At first I was doubt whether she would be good as she's so young. But it seems she's worth to be an instructor. Her teaching is very easy to understand and I don't have to stick to the text. Besides, she's very helpful and it is really easy to pass her course. I even got 2 points beyond the full mark!!!

Kayla is one of the sweetest people I have ever met! She really wants her students to do well. Just go to class and pay attention to what she highlights in class. She will go through examples step by step and so the homework is usually a breeze. The tests are challenging but she prepares you really well! She's gorgeous and dress really well too.
Talked to us like we were five years old. Comes off as a complete dumbass. Would be much better in a Kindergarden Classroom
Great teacher.  She seems to enjoy what she is doing and is extremely helpful.

She was great! Super friendly and very interesting! She gives you examples of stuff that could potentially be on the CPA exam. The quizzes were way tougher than she explained but still made exams and writing assignments consistent with what she taught! TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!!!! Super nice and wants you to learn!

I wish I got the other professor who did Auditing, Kayla lacks professionalism as a professor and most certainly lacks it to teach 497 which is a relative important class for Accounting majors. Below comment is absolute truth she is a very inconsistent grader and no matter how well you do in class you will get a lower grade. She is horrible!!!

Kayla is a great teacher, I went to class and followed along with the slides that she put on WebCT and got an A. Utilize the cheat sheets allowed on the exams, but don't depend on them and you'll be fine! She's awesome!!!
Grades very inconsistent. Uses information from when she was in school.
She was great! Easy to talk to, knows her material, and tries her hardest to make class interesting. Also she is very attractive, but still dresses and acts professionally
You can tell she used to be a sorority girl in the ways she talks. Otherwise, she explains the material fairly well and was very helpful on the group project. Total Babe!!!!!

Lectures really boring! She is very nice. Online homework somewhat tough (but can re-do multiple times to get higher grade). 8 pop quizzes but on syllabus. Tests were easy (you got to use sheet with formulas). Go to the SI exam reviews they are really helpful. Built in point cushions for HW, quizzes, team exercises, and exams. Kayla is really hot!!
Hard to pay attention in class, she just reads off the slides.  Doesn't involve the students much. on the other hand, she's smokin hot

Kayla is a great teacher I have ever met for accounting classes. I took acct 284 with her, and I am taking acct 285 this with her this semester. I really like her. You will be fine if you keep on track of her, attend the class, and take the quizzes. They key for success in this class is just pay attention, and you will be doing great. She is so hel
No Comments

Watching her videos was tedious. We were told they related well to her exams, but in reality, everything seemed so easy until you read her exam questions. MQCs are particularly difficult. She also laughed off letting students who hadn't taken the exam yet sit in on the post exam review, and lied about when items would be graded a number of times.

Kayla is great professor, she has great lectures and is super knowledgable within the area of ACCT. My only critique is the fact that the excel cases sometimes get challenging and do not really relate to the class at all.
One of my favorite professors at Iowa State. She is very friendly and understanding and is easy to understand. She is very easy to approach with questions as well.

Like other reviews, she did not respond to emails at all which is weird considering it is an online class with email being the only communication. Overall though, exams were definitely tough, but if you do the practice exams you will be fine.

Took ACCT285 online. She is nice and does a decent job of preparing us for the exams. However, I took this class online, and she has never responded to an email. Not once. I am truly baffled by how you can have a professional career without reading or responding to emails. I have emailed her on 3 separate occasions and haven't received a response.

My favorite professor at ISU! The class environment is fun, her lectures are engaging, and she tries to incorporate real-world uses of the content. She genuinely cares about every one of her students and is always encouraging us. If you pay attention, the exams are no big deal!
Honestly, this professor was amazing. Every concept was explained really well making it really easy to understand. I loved attending, studying and overall taking this course. 100% recommended.

She was great as an ACCT 285 instructor. I absolutely do not like accounting and she made it bearable. If someone was going to be taking ACCT 285, I would strongly recommend they take it with Kayla. She's great.

Multiple attempts to get into contact with the professor - had to go to the dean to get responses; Excel cases didn't match lecture concepts if you do not know how to use advanced functions before taking the class, such as goal seek I do not recommend taking this class unless you have a very strong grasp of Excel/the concept. Can't reach professor!

Great professor who actually makes her lectures worthwhile and engaging. Got D+ on the first two exams but after meeting her before the third exam and final exam I got a A- on both and finished overall with an A-. She is very helpful going over the practice exam which is very much like the actual exams. Her grading criteria is nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not the best, not the worst. She was a great responder in the beginning but got much worse as the semester went on, to the point she didn't at all. Go to the help room for the Excel cases and practice sets because the HW did NOT relate. Her practice exams were spot on with her real exams. Much more understandable than 284 and actually enjoyable.

Extremely smart professor but often rushes through lectures and hopes you can complete the remaining of the lecture notes outside of class. Provides binder of note packets that you can purchase for $9 and fill in throughout the semester which is nice. Exams are often difficult and the exam format makes it easy for your grade to suffer quickly.

Professor Sander was easily one of the best professors I've had at ISU. One negative thing is she talks a little more than needed sometimes but overall she is great! The online course was awesome although still had to go to the testing centers. If you just watch the lecture vids and put in your time you will do fine! Similar to Clem's acct 284!

Kayla rushes and skips example problems in the notes packets. She is very knowledgeable but what she teaches is not common sense like she thinks. Slides are not helpful and don't provide equations you have to know on tests. Would not recommend her as a teacher, but really a kind person to talk to.

Kayla is my favorite professor I've had at Iowa State. As long as you show up to class & do your work on time, you'll be totally fine. She's an engaging lecturer & cares so much about her students. It's so easy to get outside help in this class. Highly recommend!

Kayla is awesome. She gives great feedback on exams if you visit her during office hours. You can genuinely tell that she cares about her students. Hard class if you're not a numbers person, but her lectures make the content a little more understandable.

Kayla is an incredible instructor. She gives easy-to-understand lectures with great examples to help you understand difficult topics. She's also super friendly and willing to help whenever you need it. I hate acct but she's very enthusiastic about it which made it more interesting. Definitely take a class with her if you can; she's truly the best!

Kayla Sander is a great professor for auditing. I would recommend taking the class with her if you can. There are a couple of small papers, an analytical assignment, three exams and a few other assignments focused for each chapter on the important concepts and what would be on the exams. She makes the auditing concepts very clear which is great.

Kayla is by far my favorite accounting prof. She is lecture heavy, but she makes sure you understand her lectures when giving them. There were 4 exams total and homework due each week. She cares about how well you do in her class and will accommodate to your needs.

I really liked her, she is super high energy but accounting is not an exciting subject but Kayla does a pretty good job of keeping the class engaged throughout. Going to class is pretty important because the tests are pretty hard but she will tell you what is on them beforehand. She is REALLY good at answering questions, especially after tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Kayla is a great teacher. She is very understanding and tries to help you be as successful as possible. She wants you to know what you are doing and help you get a good grade. The lectures were very clear and the tests were all multiple choice with a bonus question and not too hard if you studied.

Requires a decent amount of memorization, but most of the concepts are pretty easy to understand. Exams were pretty easy. On one exam, the testing center did not allow me to use an on-screen calculator like it was supposed to and Kayla allowed me to retake the exam after I emailed her. Kayla really cares about her students and has good lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Kinda has the feel of a high school teacher but lectures are good and if you pay attention, complete hw and group assignments you should get a decent grade. Gives a little room for error if you miss a homework as well.

Kayla is amazing. The class is difficult but she makes it easy and fun. She is always available to talk about class as well as Iowa State sports. Her lectures always last the entire time but they are fill-in-the-blank notes and she gives great examples. Exams are hard but she provides a study guide and a practice exam that is almost identical.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Kayla is the best professor ever, she actually cares about her students and loves what she does which makes it interesting
Best ACCT 285 professor. Guided notes, you can ask questions in class. Professor Sander is very kind and great at teaching.
As a student, she wants you to succeed. Prof. Sander makes herself available and gives so many opportunities for to get help and do well in classes.

She was horrible at responding with no good lectures available. Basically, if you cant learn by yourself you are done for it. She took 5 days to respond to my email regarding the test which was two days at the time.

Ah, Professor Sander. <3 I love this woman and her class. she made learning this material so fun and accessible, despite the difficulty. Watching the lectures never felt like a chore with her. She's so thorough as a professor. Absolutely wonderful. Wish this class had been in person this semester so I could have been able to know her better.
Cares about her students and is very available to help. Explains the material very well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Kayla's online section of 285 was great! Easy to learn the material from the videos and clear test requirements. I would take another class with her!

Kayla is the sweetest person. She genuinely cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Everything is laid out clearly on the PowerPoint slides and she does a good job of explaining during lectures. Take 285 with Kayla if you can!
Very sweet, Tests are easy if you listen in class. Homework is super easy. One project that you do by yourself.

This is a very tough class but Kayla makes it alot easier. She is very understanding and helpful throughout this class and makes it fun. Have a weekly homework and 4 exams throughout the school year. Take this class with her!!

Probably the best business professor I've had at ISU. Accounting 285 is a really difficult class but she really knows what she is talking about and does a great job explaining it to us. This was my second time taking the class and I can't stress how different it is, she really is the best. Switch to her if you don't have her you won't regret it.
Kayla is very knowledgeable and helpful. Always available during office hours to assist students with anything. A lot of assignments and material is difficult, but she explains it well.
Great professor! Made learning the material very easy. She has an example for everything. She's also super nice and understanding.

She is incredibly excited to teach, and really cares about her students. She will do anything she can to help you understand the material, and always has a smile on her face. She knows what she is talking about, and her lectures are very straight forward. As long as you go to class, you'll be fine.
Amazing professor! Would absolutely recommend her to everyone!
Great professor who is more than willing to let you make up work if necessary. Very good listener and an even better person! Not the most engaging class, but not too bad and attendance is mandatory.

She is an amazing professor and person. Very caring. She cares a lot about her students mental health and will change assignments dates to help students. Have daily readings every week but the questions are very easy to answer. Daily discussion essays in class which makes attendance mandatory. Love her as a person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is very reading heavy, with two readings per week for a 3 day a week class, but are very easily digestible and the questions linked are easy to answer. She's a very sweet professor who cares a lot about her students and enjoys what she teaches. Participation is mandatory, as there are in class discussion papers at least twice a week.
great class discussions
Great professor to take Phil 230 with. No finals, but quizzes are a tad bit difficult. She is an extremely caring professor and will work with you for missed assignments/quizzes.

She is genuinely one of the most kind and understanding professors I have ever had. She is very accommodating and understands we have other classes and a life outside of school. Phil 330 is a very enjoyable, discussion-based class.

PHIL 230 has a decent amount of readings & discussions, but it's easily manageable. The slides are posted after every week. Padgett-Walsh is a great professor who tries to cover many ethic-related topics, so that people of all majors/fields can find interest in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: If you want to be engaged with the material or a professor with a semblance of structure, get someone else. She often forgets to bring the handouts and just reads word for word what she has on a presentation (which is available online so the only reason to come to class is for the random graded discussion questions). Should've been an online class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Padgett Walsh is probably the best professor I have ever had.  She is helpful, understanding, and extremely intelligent. She is very self-aware and understands that students have other classes and lives outside of her class. She is an amazing teacher and person I cannot credit her enough.

The classes are heavy on participation but it creates the most exciting and interactive classes I have ever taken. Philosophy can be really difficult to read and get into, but the professor makes sure that everything is relevant and will even bring up out of pocket topics because she understands what is relevant to us.

Dr. Padgett-Walsh is awesome. This class is very discussion heavy, so get ready to come prepared if you want the most out of the lecture. Fair amount of reading on Perusall, but it's very manageable. Every class you have to write a graded response on a particular question, so don't skip often. She's a very understanding and kind professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Padgett-Walsh is a fantastic philosophy teacher. She takes complex, nuanced ideas and makes them accessible to everyone. She gets students involved in lectures and considers everyone's ideas, challenges them when appropriate, and helps us think through challenging topics in a logical way.

I struggled a ton with Phil 201 and was worried about this course, but Dr. Padgett-Walsh is the best! She's great at explaining moral philosophy and connecting it to modern-day issues that we experience. She is the most caring professor I've ever had. I could just sit and listen to her all day; this class made me love philosophy! Take Phil with her

She's very understanding, no final, just 3 quizzes that are non-comprehensive with 20 questions each. A bit heavy on the reading, but that's to be expected. Writing the final paper was made easy and she's always there to help if need be. Seems like she cares more about the students learning than getting through the slides which I love.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Make sure to submit homework (it might seem like you don't, but do it), three quizzes from reading and past annotations, and one final last paper. Loved the class:) Also if you're a psych major it's more psych related than business.

This was one of the easiest classes I've taken. She was an easy grader in my opinion, and there wasn't a lot of course work. No final exam, there was a final paper instead. She canceled in person class 60% of the time which was nice in my opinion.

She was super political, constantly bringing things up that had nothing to do with the class, making me super uncomfy. She is super easy though, no exams and only worth 100 points total. I never really went to class and still recieved a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty easy class. Just make sure to submit everything each week and you'll get an A.

Great professor. Gives good feedback on assignments with plenty of opportunity for extra credit. I particularly like how she structures writing the final paper for the course (by section). My only complaint is that sometimes she just let the students take over the discussion and get off topic and would rarely tell them when they were wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Kate has been my absolute favorite professor so far. She made the class interesting and very easy. There is very little homework and you get cheat-sheets on the 3 exams. There is a large paper at the end, but she makes the criteria very clear gives you plenty of time to write it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Excellent professor -- IF you don't do well   THEN you deserved it
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Great teacher. She gives you all the resources to get an A in her class if you put in the work. Go to class, participation points are a major part of grade. Classes are interesting, and she is very interesting to listen to. No tests. 3 quizzes and 2 papers due all semester. Take this class with her if you get the opportunity.

She is absolutely wonderful. She really cares about her students and loves giving feedback on papers so you can get a good grade. The class itself is very interesting and she's a great mediator of discussion. You NEED to go to class or you will not do well, but it's always an interesting topic.

Easy and interesting. Don't get cocky and skip-the class is discussion based--points given in class-and only worth 100 points (every point lost is a percent off your grade) but there's lots of extra credit (take advantage of it every time). You don't have a final, instead you have over a month to write an 8 page paper, and there are a few quizzes.

Clear-cut class. The whole class is based off the readings. If the readings are tough,  she'll clear it up in the lectures. It's not necessary, but highly recommended that you show up to class because the lectures will be helpful for the quizzes and papers. I'd take another class with her.

Great professor. She is extremely helpful and willing to go over material/your paper if you want. Important to go to class because quizzes are from your notes. If you don't go to class read the assigned readings THROUGHLY. I would advise going, though, she will learn names and give you the points if you put in the time.
Reading material is long and tedious, but as long as you do the readings, this class is an easy A. Kate has three quiztests, no big test or cumulative final.

Excellent teacher. Good distribution of homeworks, tests, papers. Very considerate, though it seems to lead her to humor some bad and not-so-worthwhile opinions, which wastes class time. That's the only drawback. Wonderful teacher, 10/10, take every class you can with her.
Great professor, great class!

I came into this class not very excited about philosophy and now I find it very interesting. She has a way of taking the reading that don't seem very exciting and discussing it in a way that connects it to modern day issues. Some of the readings are hard to follow but after they are discussed in class it is easier to understand.

She is extremely nice and easy to get along with! She enjoys teaching & wants everyone to enjoy class. She does a great job at explaining the text. She has changed her teaching method and only gives three quizzes (dates are known ahead of time) throughout the semester & no final exam. There was also only one paper we had to write. Highly recommend!

As previously stated, quizzes come from the readings, and come when you least expect it, so stay on top of things. Read a really fun book for the course that I never would have otherwise. She has a nice, clear voice.
Very helpful. Just pay attention.  Quizzes come from your notes.  She'll help you if you ask. Easy to understand. Interesting too.

Lots of reading in the class and quizzes are taken on the readings in class. It is possible to BS the quizzes if you have common sense and listen in class. Only three papers and a final in the class, but very, very difficult to get an A, but easy to get a B- to a B. Too much work, I would take 230 with another teacher.

I loved Psych of Women with Dr. Scheel! She was such a caring and sweet professor, and I enjoyed learning from her. Attendance was mandatory, but I didn't mind because lectures were engaging. There is a paper, a poster project, a university lecture discussion, and a final exam, but those were the main assignments. Highly recommend Dr. Scheel!

Great Professor! If you can't make it to class, she has a 1-page essay that you can do however many times you want to get attendance points back. There are group projects but almost always gives full points.

Dr. Scheel is a nice professor. The course itself was okay. I have taken many courses like it so I didn't learn much. It was so hyped up that it wasn't nearly as good as people say. Her attendance policy was nice; if you skip class, you can do an easy assignment to make up the point. She didn't accept excused absences, which I thought was weird.

Super kind and thoughtful. The class was okay if you went to lectures and paid attention. She provides note outlines for you, which is nice as I struggle with note-taking. The material was interesting, and she gave you time to make friends so they could send you notes in case you missed a lecture. Ok professor overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was fine. Professor was moderately entertaining, it was just kind of a boring class. If you can get into the material, the tests are simple enough. Exams are online :)

Dr Scheel is a great professor and I have had her for multiple psych courses. The lectures for this particular class are important to attend. She will not post notes from lectures and lecture material is always on exams. She is great at teaching her students and loves what she does!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Scheel is one of my all-time favorite professors. She is so caring and nice she is probably of the nicest people you will meet. She is like that nice grandma that bakes cookies for you. I recommend taking a class with her because it isn't very challenging and she is very passionate about teaching. Can't go wrong with taking one of her classes!

She was a really good professor and cared a lot about the success of all of her students. The lectures are fill in the blank, so if you go to class to get the notes you'll do well on the exams. She told stories that pertained to the course material and made it interesting. She also showed funny videos that made the lectures engaging.
He sucks as a professor and beware most of the things he teaches are NOT on the exam use the Quizlet's online and the textbook practices to study for the class.
Just don't if others prof are available. Prof Roe is obviously problematic as many students have stated he will continue to be problematic in this course as he truthfully doesn't care to do better.

Lectures consist of so many tangents they become unuseful in regards to the exams, just read the textbook. He doesn't specify anything about extra credit and don't bother asking for anything, he's blunt in response and has 0 sympathy, take the other 211 prof her exams are way easier

Professor Roe is an okay professor. He reads off of the slides and every time I ask him about something specific relating to the class he tells me to check the syllabus. The exams do not line up with what he is teaching in class for the most part, so they were pretty difficult. No final exam. I still got an A but that was with SI help.

Reads off slides and info dumps, then will test you on a specific characteristic of a subphylum in a test that he read off one slide. Be prepared to study information that you could easily google search in the real world. Very uninterested in what he teaches and it reflects in how he lectures his classes.

I didn't take 211 with this professor. never had his slides prepared for a single lecture, so had to use a student's laptop. He made multiple sexist "jokes" in class, yelled and swore at students for a miscommunication, and overall sucked as a person. Easy grader tho because he doesn't give you any helpful feedback. hope he can retire soon and go

He seems uninterested in what he is teaching and his lectures are pretty much pointless. This ends up being a self guided class. Don't bother asking for help from him, you won't get it. We learn hundreds of things per module, spend hours memorizing everything, and then are tested on 25 questions.

Kevin was a great guy and I honestly enjoyed him as a professor. The only critique I have of him is that sometimes the quizzes don't always match what is done in the homework. In order to succeed very well in BIO211, I recommend going to SI sessions for sure.

Attendance is not required but personally I do it otherwise, I will be lost entirely. Reads off of slides but goes into some more detail IRL. I take the notes off of canvas, re-write them in my notebook and then follow along in class for a deeper understanding. He is pretty cool, though.
professor tends to just read off of slides, when you ask questions, he usually just says to look at the textbook, and doesn't answer the question.

If you have the option to take this class with another professor, I would. The material felt rushed and it seemed like we had a test every week. SI helped me a lot in this class. He reads directly from the slides and includes the smallest details in tests which makes them very hard to study for. In class points and MB saved my grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Really fun class, grade is entirely participation and weekly quizzes so it's an easy A if you stay on top of it. Lots of interesting material and Roe is a really cool dude, really laid back.

Doesn't take attendance but expects you to be in every class otherwise you can't get the notes. Everything is just read off of the slides. Felt a little disrespected during the class. Group project at the end comes fast but if you use quizzes every week it is pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I have this professor for Wildlife Genetics and he is awful. He reads right off the slides, he is unprofessional and rude, he treats students disrespectfully and he is not very good at answering questions.
Tests are very hard, mastering biology and the quizes seem to help boost your grade. Be prepared to study a lot for exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Extremely boring lectures. He goes really fast and doesn't describe concepts and terms very well. You must read the book or you won't learn very much.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He reads right off of the slides which tend to be packed with a lot of fine details.  There are a lot of tests which are difficult if you do not study. I would definitely recommend going to the SI exam reviews.
He is a good teacher that keeps class interesting, but there is a lot of work to do outside of class and many exams. Exams are difficult, but SI helped me a bunch.

Complete all Learnsmart assignments and quizes for easy points. Lowest test grade is dropped but tests can be fairly difficult and are very frequent. He is a nice guy who is willing to work with you outside of the classroom.

He has trouble managing Web CT. Tests are hard and include picky details that he may or may not have covered in class. He's unwillingly to let students know what their grade is in his class. He didn't curve grades, even though he indicated he might curve them. Worst instructor I've had so far.

A lot of the work has to be done outside of the class. He goes right off the slides. There are in class activities, and pop quizzes which help your grade a lot. The tests are poorly written, but not overly difficult.

This professor is decent but needs to do a better job at organizing the class. He doesn't write his tests until a few days before, so it is difficult to know what exactly they'll be like. Every exam seems to focus more on one particular area, and there's no way of knowing what that area will be. He also has trouble managing WebCT and Mastering Bio.

Dr. Keren is a solid professor. He structured this class well and had clear expectations of students. He also graded assignments quickly and gave good feedback. His main issue is lack of attention to detail when writing quiz and exam questions. They were littered with outright mistakes and typos that made them much more difficult than necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher, has lots of regards for students who work hard. He will ensure that all students get value out of his classes.
Easy easy class and teacher.  Only flaw is that expects group meeting from online class which doesn't make much sense. Don't bother buying book for this class either, never once used.
Not a good teacher.  Could not use blackboard and has a weak grasp on the class.

Statistics finally make sense. An interesting course, an enthusiastic instructor with a great sense of humor, and class activities that made me engaged throughout. Among other factors, his willingness to work with students was a driving force to respond to the variety of challenges introduce during the semester. Highly recommend!
Very intersting material. Sounds like it will be extremely useful later in my career.
His classes are very demanding. Lots of group meetings and lots of tough homework. But if you do the work your pretty much guranteed a good grade.
It is the most interesting course I attended. A fresh breeze in the program's current corriculum. professor Keren has a great attitude. Recommended!
An inspiring professor. Always open to students' input. I enjoyed class activities with him.
I have learned alot. Easy to approach instructor, enthusiastic, developed great class activities.
Great at outlining the course.  But I had a terrible time understanding him.
She engages in good lectures and grades off of written work.

DO NOT TAKE!

reviews.comment: I tried to communicate with her over email as she was both my professor and academic advisor. She got angry with me for sending her multiple emails about my grades.
Very knowledgeable and understanding professor. Just go to class, and you will be fine. It is mostly participation-based.
the mayor of karenville

She is awesome! Makes the class interesting and is an entertaining lecturer. Responds quickly to emails. If she is your advisor, use her. She's very helpful in guiding you and is very knowledgeable about the school and programs.

Kelly is an amazing professor! BUSAD 102 is a great introductory class to the Business College, where you learn a lot about your resources on campus. Make sure to complete the minor assignments on time, and you will be perfectly fine! Extra credit opportunities are available.

Professor Pistilli is kind. She will respond to emails and will make time to meet with students outside of class. I would possibly choose this professor again, but many activities were not useful and felt childish. Overall, having class with this professor is pretty easy as long as you keep up with the quizzes and the few larger assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lecture and exams contain incorrect information, and random changes to the course schedule are made with little to no advance notice. Very unorganized; I feel like I learned very little, especially for this being a 400-level class. Dr. Carlson is enthusiastic, but I don't think a 400-level class is the right fit for him to teach.
Good overall class and intro into the kinesiology department.

This class is supposed to be difficult but he made it very easy and interesting. The exams are pretty intense and somewhat difficult, intense studying is needed. He helps by giving study guides every so often, gives freebie homework and EC through evals and other misc. Would recommend taking him for this class.
The lecture for this course is fast paced and sometimes hard to follow. He is passionate about kinesiology which makes him fun to learn from.

Professor Shaw's attendance is somewhat unpredictable, but the lectures are worth attending when you do. He does not always do well with reading emails, and he relies heavily on his TAs; however, his grading is fair and quite forgiving. He does not assign a lot, but overall, his classes are great, and his sense of humor is hilarious.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: So good!!!!! Can't say enough great things about him. He's outgoing and bubbly, a terrific person.

I like the style of Shaw's class. There is also a lot of variety with projects, essays, lectures, and in-class discussions. Will say, if you don't like his humor you might not like the class as much but it was a great time for me!

Dr. Shaw is a great guy. Despite what others have said, in my class, he learned everyone's names. He gave out extra credit all the time, and made lectures fun and entertaining. One main issue, the exams aren't exactly the same as lectures, so make sure you read the textbooks and pay attention to details. Otherwise, super chill professor.

clearly guided towards poli sci students rather than religious students. hard to follow criteria. doesn't follow class schedule. doesn't care about learning names unless he has had you before. clear indication of his political opinions and religious affiliation. only covers material about own religious affiliation

- talks more about poli sci than religion
- half way through semester didn't know what the class was about
- clear favorites/ only calls on certain people 
- talks more about own religion than other religions

Dr. Shaw's lectures are very hard to follow, and it feels like the material is not applicable to what is put on exams Also, he tends to make a lot of innuendos regarding his own political beliefs. He is not super clear on deadlines and is also not very accessible. Given that this is a 100 level course, it should not be so hard to do well in.
I love taking classes with Prof. Shaw! He clearly explains everything you need to know in lectures. Highly recommend taking his classes
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Shaw's lectures were usually very difficult to follow, the instructions for assignments were nonexistent or made no sense, and he did not communicate well outside of class. I found him and his TA to be very inaccessible and spent much of the semester very frustrated and confused because of it. This was a very hard class to be successful in.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took him online, amazing teacher, had an A all year long, sadly final destroyed it. Make sure to watch all lectures and quizzes will be easy for you. Good at communicating back as well.

One of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are interesting and always feel necessary to go to, his projects/assignments are great learning tools and never feel like busy work, and he knows how to keep students engaged. He is helpful and pretty easy to reach, and funny and nice to have just a casual conversation with.

Dr. Shaw was confusing in his lectures, getting off topic frequently. He was hard to get ahold of outside of class. When it came to projects, he was not clear on instructions and did not post the assignments in a timely manner.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He was amazing, barely any work throughout the semester.

Dr. Shaw is a great guy who always has interesting stories to share. There are not very many assignments in this course. I only deducted one star, because I find his lectures at times to be a little too vague and the assignments can be unclear. But, he is very knowledgable and a fun professor to have.

Missing any assignments will ruin your grade because there are very few! Attendance is only tracked on days that a guest speaker is present, but attendance is important if you're not doing all of the readings. As an individual, Kelly is very accommodating and will help you do everything in his power to help you succeed in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was asynchronous with modules being due about every two weeks, but definitely not one you wanted to put off to the last minute. There was a lot of reading + lecture videos to watch. However, I found the content to be interesting. The assignments + exams were all approachable. Dr. Shaw was also responsive and helpful via email.

Dr. Shaw is a good professor and even better person. His Pols 101 class is interesting and he always has many interesting stories to tell. His lectures are alright sometimes they are too basic/not enough information but his power points are good and his textbook readings are easy if you look for key words. Hes very good at answering questions.

Took as an online class. little homework, easy to get behind though. Lots of lectures to watch, & they are long & can be very boring. but you can tell he cares about what he is teaching, and cares that you understand it. Do not need main text, but you do need book that he assigns to be read on your own, there is a test over it

Extremely unhappy with Professor Shaw. I communicated my situation to him multiple times, asking for ways I could improve my grade due to missed participation points as a result of being absent for military training and working on political campaigns. During a global pandemic, Professor Shaw heavily based the overall grade on participation.

reviews.comment: Solid professor

I am a 4.0 Student and the class with comparative politics should have been easy. He graded papers extemely rough and was not very clear with what he wanted in them. You had to read the book and understand the book. The first test everyone got around a D and the highest was a 83 percent. He did not curve it. The second test was a lot easier.

reviews.comment: Hes the worst LECTURER ever. He just very confortable taking about British government but thats it. He is very dated when it comes to politics. ALWAYS late to class and he just a terrible lecturer.

Dr. Shaw is really nice guy, but an okay teacher. He definitely knows what he's talking about when it comes British Government though and I would recommend taking this class if you're interested in it. He assigns readings due before each class- read them! He does a simulation of parliament in this class that I found to be very fun and interesting.

Professor Shaw does a really good job of getting his points across during lecture in a clear and concise way. He is a very nice guy and really easy to talk to. Honestly I've retained so much of what he's taught due to the fact he lectures really well. Definitely enjoyed the class.

Kelly is probably the worst professor I've ever had. He's a super nice guy, but has no idea how to teach students. This class was supposed to be an introductory course but he treated in like a grad student course. Did surprisingly well on the final but for 90% of the semester I thought I was gonna fail. Basically, avoid taking his classes. No curve

Dr. Shaw is one of the best professors I have had at ISU. I look forward to this class every MWF because the lectures are interesting and he is an enthusiastic professor. You will be expected to read and write papers for this course, but he gives you a good sense of what will be on the exam and good feedback on everything else.

Dr. Shaw's a really neat guy and is really easy to be comfortable with, he's just not the best teacher and makes the course harder than it should be. Lectures assume a lot of background knowledge and exams are difficult when considering the material. He gives out his cell number and you can text him to get ahold of him, which is really great.

I have taken a class with the professor before, an online summer course, I prefer the online class to this. He claims to care about students but does not make an effort to make the space an open one for learning to all.

he clearly shows what will be expected during his classes and as long as you follow those guidelines you will get a good grade, tests are made up of lectures and textbook main points

reviews.comment: Took his online American Public Policy class through the University of Iowa. His lectures aren't too long and the class isn't too tough. Good professor and very accessible. Some of the grading is a bit slow but that's understandable considering the size of his online class.

Really enjoyed Dr. Shaw and his knowledge of British politics. Class lectures and exercises really helped me understand the materials covered in class, but are no substitute for readings. A great professor who really cares about his students and teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Kelly is a great teacher to learn from. I had him for State and Local government and since he is also a mayor, he is more than qualified to teach the class. He applies things you learn about to his job as mayor. The real life examples are helpful in learning the material. This is not a show up and pass class, effort is needed to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loved this class. Taking another with him next semester.

I'm quiet in classes and this teacher has always made me feel heard and important. I've had him for multiple big classes (like 40+) and he somehow still remembers my name and the work I've submitted to him before. His tests are fair and the papers are always explained thoroughly. He also really knows his stuff, especially about politics in Europe.
Professor Shaw is a very good lecturer, and he is actually a town mayor so he knows what he is talking about in a very practical way in a state and local politics class. He's a nice guy.

Dr. Kelly Shaw is the man! Though his tests and quizzes can be challenging, he is there for you every step of the way. He is such a class-act professor that truly cares about his students learning! If you make use of his office hours and put in the extra effort, he will give you an increase in your final grade. Great guy!
Do the readings and study book for the A. Great professor.

Kelly is a great guy and professor. The class is an intro class to comparative politics, but it felt like a heavier workload than I was expecting. There is a lot of information you are liable to know, and the random in class meetings seemed excessive. Make sure you go to class and skim through the book often.

Dr. Shaw is really nice. I liked that he covered different material in class than the books did, it kept things from getting repetitive.
