reviews.comment: Levi is the best. He'll let you know what will be on the exam. You'll have to spend time for the course just because it's OChem 2. Stanley for sure makes it easier for me.

Levi is great. Obviously organic chem 2 is a difficult class and you'll have to work to get a good grade, but Levi tells you what will be on the tests and is a great lecturer. Sometimes when class attendance is low he'll take attendance for extra credit points on the last exam. If you have to take 332, take it with Stanley.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hes got amazing lectures. Make sure you print off his slides before each chapter starts and just pay attention to what he says and highlight important things. Go to SI and the practice sessions to help study for the exam. Just beware, you need to put in a lot of studying. You cant pull and all nighter and pull an A out of your ass for this class
The exams' questions are pretty straightforward and he curves a lot. Highly recommended.
Professor Stanley is an amazing teacher. Pay close attention to his lectures and take good notes, and you'll do great. His tests are straight forward. His grading is also very lenient
Attend lecture and do the practice tests! The final exam especially includes questions that are the exact same as some from practice tests.

O Chem 332 is a tough class but I wouldn't want to have taken it with anyone besides Stanley. He does a good job of presenting the material as well letting students what the test is likely to cover. He wants his students to pass, but be ready to spend 15+ hours studying before exams. Start studying a week before & put the rest of your life on hold

Organic chemistry can be a bit dry, but I was able to pay attention for a reasonable portion of time with Dr. Stanley. He does a good job of letting you know what you need to know for the tests. This class covers an enormous amount of material, and so is inherently difficult, but not impossible. Dr. Stanley explains things very well during lecture.
not good

He was a great professor. He was always available to answer questions and his power points were great study tools.  The class isn't as bad as everyone says it is but you have to study! My text was my bible for a semester. Do the problems in the back and you'll be fine. Skip lecture and you'll probably fail.

Leslie is very kind and engaging in class, the workload for IE2220 feels disproportionately high. There is a significant amount of reading and outside work required. The exams are surprisingly difficult and often include math concepts that weren't thoroughly covered during lectures, despite the course material itself being very interesting.
The class is treated like high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is kind, very outgoing and loves giving out prizes to her students. But don't be fooled by her bribes, she is not a good teacher. She is so strict with her grading. She also gives you loads of topics and only talks about them on surface level, but then on exam goes in DEPTH when we barley discussed it. Good lukc trying to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Grading is unreasonably tough for no apparent reason. Despite the content being extremely easy, her questions are all extremely subjective allowing her to squeeze every point she can off homework and exams, all while hiding behind an extremely long appeal process. I would genuinely rather take every calculus course again have her as a teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's awesome, has great amounts of industry experience and explains concepts very nicely. Fair warning, if taking IE1600 (IE148), be prepared to dedicate a lot of out-of-class time to the content. You work through learning excel and VBA for excel as well as general CS concepts. The homework is long, DO IT! I would have a high-B if I had.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She expects the most and pushes you beyond your limits. Very tiring and she is worst DO NOT TAKE HER.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Requires a lot of time outside of class.
Very time intensive ~6 to 8 hours a week outside of class, however Leslies teaches the concepts extremely well and is very accessible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Leslie is a great professor this class is a step into how to really manage your time here. There will be times you feel lost and overwhelmed but office hours are going to be your best friend. She truly wants you to succeed but you need to be willing to ask for help.

Class was fun until the projects come up which provide no directions on how to do them and often result in poor grades for the whole class. Expects too much out of new students in written assignment does not extend any assignments no matter the reason and mandates attendance. Team-based learning means you primarily teach yourself all the material.
Awesome professor, would highly recommend her.

She holds you to high expectations it can seem annoying like no phones and mandatory attendance but all she wants from you is 3 things. Effort, participation *she gives food sometimes* and honesty. 
She wants to see you learn and grow from mistakes and if you talk to her she will help you. She is my #1 person to go to for advice. 10/10 great mentor

Leslie treats her students like high schoolers, requiring attendance and routinely sending her TAs to reprimand anyone with their phones out. This wouldn't be as intolerable as it is, but her lectures are bone-dry. She also offers no extensions on any assignments for any reason. You couldn't pay me to take an additional class from Leslie Potter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Leslie makes attendance mandatory and doles out huge makeup assignments for each day of class missed- think a 5-page essay for every day. Being sick is NOT an exception, even with a diagnosis from a doctor. This makes her class hugely inaccessible and encourages students to come to class when sick, which can further spread illnesses.
She is a great person who really cares.

Leslie is a great professor but you should know to be successful in 222 you must attend class for the RATS. Additionally, thoroughly analyze the pre-readings for the exam. This is essential to doing well on all exams. There are two books you must read for the class, and I encourage you to actually read them as it will be about 25% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her homework can be long, but she grades fairly. She's very passionate about her job, and her class provides a lot of awesome information. It's a class worth trying in. Just practice the math outside of class and do the extra practice problems she posts for the exams.
Can be tough at times but does a great job teaching what matters for an IE
Show up and you will pass. Funny, engaging, and gives student's the opportunity to try new things, meet staff, etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 148 with Leslie was amazing and I learned so much! Be prepared to but in 8-10 hours a week if you want an A. There are many projects that will take much longer. If you do the homework by yourself and learn the material, you will easily get an A. DO NOT copy the code from classmates for assignments. This will set you up for failure!

Leslie is an amazing professor. She really goes the extra mile to make sure that you can do the very best you can to succeed in the class. She responds to emails very quick and is always willing to work with you when you have questions. She is a person with a lot of experience in the IE field so be sure to pick her brain. 10/10 :)

Leslie taught me super useful information and made it easy to do well on quizzes. She would answer any question we asked! Her office hours would also go long every week because kids had extra questions, and she never had an issue with it. She's charismatic and easy to understand, but the homework can be really challenging. Don't procrastinate!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It's obvious from the get-go, Leslie really cares about what she does. She's very charismatic and open to discussion with her students. That being said, content feels important and intuitive, but the class is taught so generally that you will probably be unsure of what you're going to be tested on since lecture feels like a conversation.

The lectures could be a well worded email. Easy class to understand But will not provide clear understanding of topics. Any slight deviation of her prescribed method will end in your demise. Painful class even the Ta's don't want to be there.

You either like Leslie or you don't.. Same with the course material. Class seems easy but the exams are more challenging than you will expect. Not hard to get a good grade in the class. Keeping my attention was the hard part.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Leslie is a very nice person, but does not seem to know how to teach. She appears to go into lectures without a plan and just sees how it goes. Multiple times this semester she put out assignments that had errors. She sent out SO MANY emails a day as well, it was just stressful. I like her as a person but don't want another class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Leslie is great because she was a former IE. I hate most professors because they teach stuff you will never use. Everything you learn in this class is applicable and thats great! Not a super hard class but lots of busy work, but I enjoyed it alot! Very well rounded class that teaches alot and Leslie is harsh and caring at the same time.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Leslie does not interact with her students like a professional. She threw bread at us the first day of class. She is extremely by the book and does not put common sense over her syllabus, and also convinced another professor to threaten my professional career for bringing up an issue she refused to work out with me after saying shed consider it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very compassionate person that cares about your success. Her enthusiasm is sometimes interpreted as "talking down", but she is not that kind of person. My only complaint is the amount of reading involved in her classes.
Best teacher I had in the IE department caring and passionate.

Leslie is super passionate about her students and teaching. It is super helpful that she has experience working in industry. This class is full of busy-work though. It is definitely a rewarding class, you just need to put the time in.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Leslie enjoys what she does and is very accessible outside of class, but she is the most nit picky person I have ever met. This course was a ridiculous amount of work and she grades everything to a very high standard with no clear grading criteria. She holds students to a standard that she can't hold herself which makes her difficult to work with.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She's probably one of the most caring professors. It is good, she's accessible between 6 AM and Midnight almost every day. She genuinely tries hard, but that can be excessive at times. Very optimistic. Coursework is easy, just time consuming. Tests aren't bad if you go to lecture. She does consider professionalism in your grade, so participate.
Great class, learned a lot. You have to work for your grade, it takes about 20 hours of week in homework or studying, but it's worth it.
Leslie is awesome! The end.

One of the nicest teachers I have ever had. She is extremely responsive and will drop anything to help you. The thing is if you don't come in with computer programming know-how and knowledge it will be very difficult. She even separates the class up by how much know-how you have when you first enter.

This is not an easy class but the teacher makes it as fun as it can be. She truly cares for the learning of her students and tries to modify her class according to previous years' feedback. If you need help she is there to the point that she gives you her cellphone number and encourages students to call her even on weekends!

Leslie is an outstanding professor; She's definitely focused on preparing her students for the real world. She genuinely wants feedback after each assignment and test to know how SHE is doing. She also gives students solid feedback. Great environment. Her experience in industry makes her an invaluable resource while and after taking IE 148.

Fast reply in email and kind of really helpful. BUT it has tons of homework, assignments, projects, lab reports, quizzes, and even final projects! Barely gives lecture in class instead of watching video independently. The materials shouldn't be as hard as what being taught!

IE148 is a time-consuming class, but Leslie tries to make it as do-able as possible.  Lots of outside class work (Video lectures outside of class, HW, etc.).  It's clear that Leslie cares for her students and wants everyone to succeed.  Leslie is always trying to improve the class so if something isn't working, she will do her best to change.

It was a really tough class but you learn so much. She is definitely a great instructor and you can get and high grade but will have to work hard for it. She is so willing to help and make the class better that is very inspirational.
Leslie is an amazing professor and I love this class and her!

You can turn things in late but every class has a new assignment due so I don't recommend it. Start off by making a group to split up the work on homework or labs since you can work together. Watch every video she makes and write notes for the weekly quizzes. Review the practice tests. It is not too hard to pass, time consuming and tough grading.
Leslie is a great person and a great teacher. Be sure to get to know her and talk to her outside of class. Homework takes hours! But call Leslie and Ben if you have questions.

One word to describe Leslie? Perky. She is awesome at helpoing is just you dont even take classes with her. Dont even bother going to class on thursday. She is a really nice lady who really wants you to succeed. Her questions are unclear and be ready to be super specific. Homework takes at least 15 hours a week. Be prepare for Ben's talking.
She's helpful in so many ways. She gives a hard assignment, taking more than 15 hours a week. you need to work hard just to pass this class

This class is horrible! Consume too much time for doing homework, toughest grader, too picky, expect too much, yet never teach anything in class period. Need at least 30 hours week to get a good grade in this class!
Avoid in any cost

Leslie is a very nice person and very reachable. She will go out of her way to answer questions if she has to. Sometimes the way she writes is not always clear which can be frustrating. This class is very time consuming and homework can be ridiculous at times. A very nice professor teaching a course that was poorly planned in my opinion.

Liu is a great professor and really has a great understanding of the content. Lectures are clear and easy to follow along with and the weekly homeworks help you fully understand the concepts. She's super helpful in office hours and the exams were open note (but also worth about 80% of your grade).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: very nice and understanding
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: great professer

Very good professor. She writes up all her notes on the board which is nice because we don't get overwhelmed with stats (wish she would use the elmo though). Homework problems are great at illustrating what you need to understand. Very willing to help and is very nice. I would highly recommend her as a professor.

Dr. P is an amazing professor! He clearly cares about every student and is very passionate about what he teaches. Dr. P is always open to questions and loves discussion during class. There are few points in the class so be sure to take every assignment seriously. Overall, I highly recommend Dr. P.

Dr. P was funny and genuinely cares about his students. However, he is VERY strict about class policies and is not lenient when it comes to deadlines and grading. Your overall grade is only based on weekly quizzes, a case study paper, and the final, so be sure to do well on the quizzes. He doesn't use the +/- scale either (only A, B, C, etc).
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: An amazing professor and an eye opening class to the reality of mental health! Dr. P has great lectures over the material, and loves to banter with students over various ideas to keep things real and light hearted. There are weekly quizzes in this class, one case paper and a final exam. Overall fairly easy!
He doesn't teach anything relative to the content. Yes he is funny, but does not teach. Don't recommend him. He also can't work technology very well.

I loved Dr. Prieto. He was so funny during lectures, and he would let us get out early when he could tell we really weren't feeling it that day. He plays videos to help break up the lecture, which were always interesting. The quizzes are all based on the lecture and book, so they weren't difficult. I highly recommend him, he makes the class fun!

super easy class, the professor really does care for his students and understands the stress most of his students are going through. really enjoyed this class with Prieto, highly recommend taking this course and it is very interesting. He shares more concepts with a true story which keeps you engaged during the lecture since it is online.

Dr. P is fantastic! Even though this is an online class, he makes an effort to get to know all of his students and says hi to every person as they join the WebEx. He cares a lot about his students and takes the time to make sure everything in the the lectures and videos is understood. I loved this class!

Honestly the best class and best professor I've had at ISU. Dr. P made me feel like I mattered to him as a student, and the love he showed us was unparalleled. Hilarious lectures and exciting, interesting material. I was always excited about this class. He did take away your extra credit points if you missed a quiz; I thought that was unfair.

Dr. P is one of the best professors I have ever had. He knows his stuff, and has a great teaching style. He also is one of the most caring professors I have ever had. He gets to know you personally and treats you as if you are a human, not just a student. I went to every single lecture because he kept the information interesting.

Dr. Prieto knows his stuff. But, more importantly, he seems to be a very caring and understanding person. The content is very interesting and the weekly quizzes and case report paper is not too demanding or difficult.
Good teacher. made class fun and I wanted to go every day

Dr. P is simply the best. Ive never had a 1.5 hr class go by so fast! He makes every day interesting & fun. Makes an effort to know everyones names. Super funny, intelligent, and kind. Cares for his vatos so deeply. Easily the best prof Ive had at ISU. Material is super interesting too. This man is incredible. We love you Prieto!

Dr. P made the 75 minute lecture fly by, and somehow got our entire class of 90 people to actively participate and discuss concepts. Of all my classes that got moved online Spring 2020, I'm most disappointed I didn't get to finish this one out in person. Gave us breaks during class and we rarely went the full 75 minutes.

I have ADHD and I've never had a T/R class where I wanted to stay in lecture longer or read the textbook until this class. Dr.P is a little off the wall, but makes complex content easy/interesting/relatable. He genuinely cares about his students; he learned almost the entire lecture hall's name. There's a lot of in-class dialogue, despite the size

My favorite professor by far. He takes time to learn everyone's name and teaches in an interesting and lively manner. On the last day the majority of the class went up and shook his hand each individually. He earned the respect of many of us.  Awesome professor!

Expect huge curves on exams so don't get too scared about getting a 50%.

The big issue I have with Jack are his exams. They are extremely difficult to do well on and it's really discouraging as you go on in the class.

reviews.comment: His lectures are generally the meat of the semester. The classes he teaches are very tough, but he walks through material very well and makes sure that students understand. Very genuine guy who really cares about teaching and about his students.

Best professor I've ever had. Only had the chance to take 1 class with him (CS331), but that class (and his teaching style) helped convince me that CS was the right career path. I've gone to several of his talks on research he does, and wow is he brilliant. If you're expecting an easy class, take something else, but if you wanna learn, take this.

Jack is probably the best professor you could wish for in this class. He doesn't post notes or homework solutions online so you have to attend lectures and take good notes to succeed. The good thing is that Jack gives very clear lectures with lots of examples so taking good notes should be easy. The textbook can also help alot with some of the hw.

reviews.comment: Jack was easily the best prof I've ever had. He is no joke though. Be ready to take as many notes as you have lead for in class and spend a lot of time on homework and a lot of time in TA office hours (which in my semester was essentially another lecture on the same topics). It's hard and he has high standards, but it's worth it. Super kind. 10/10

reviews.comment: Hardest class I took at Iowa State
this guy is tough
He never posted homework solution.

This was possibly the toughest class I have ever taken.  I made it to grad school in computer engineering and then went back to take this CS class out of curiosity and to expand my knowledge in the computer science realm.  I think this class destroyed me.  More than half the class failed the midterm and a make up exam was given which I got a 0.

Good instructor. Subject material is dense and difficult, but Jack and his TA Brad are good at explaining things when (not if) you get confused. He is surprisingly easy to talk to for someone of his credentials. I wasn't especially interested in theory of computation prior to 331, but this class made it seem much more accessible.

If you enjoy challenges, this is the teacher for you.  I remember incorrectly answering a question he asked the class on the first or second day.  Usually I feel stupid for being wrong in front of the whole class but Jack responded in such a way that encouraged me for trying and that has inspired me throughout my college career.
No Comments
Best professor ever.  How was he not reviewed before?  Expect to learn a lot (slackers/stupid people should probably avoid him).

My experience with Dr. Luo was absolutely horrible. If you have to take his class dont worry as he gives you the answers to the homework and test before you take them so that you are guaranteed a good grade. However, you will learn nothing about PDEs and he does not want to help you. Most of the time if you ask him questions he says "I don't know".

Luo is very soft-spoken. With masks due to COVID, this makes it especially difficult to hear what he has to say. But whenever I had issues with anything in the course, he was quick to help out, both in class and over email. If you want a highly-accessible professor, I highly recommend his classes.

reviews.comment: Dr. Luo is very knowledgable and is an extremely nice guy, but this class was difficult to sit through. The content is somewhat difficult to teach but overall the class isn't very entertaining. The homework sets were super easy and if you did them there's no way you should get anything other than an A.

Math 207, great professor with good slides to review from and his tests are very fair. Nice curve too (67%  C-) so you should have no issues passing class. Do the homework, and study, and youll do fine.

Calculus 3 is no laughing matter; you will have to put in a considerable amount of time in order to understand everything. The homework in this class was really long. Except for the final, the practice exams were very similar to the actual exams. I felt it was kind of hard to learn from Dr. Luo. That being said, the textbook was really helpful.

reviews.comment: His tests were decent, not hard but not easy to say the least. The homework was a huge problem. He keeps the number of questions the same but the difficulty gets harder through the course. 30 vector addition problems are no chore, but doing 30 problems on the Greens theorem is ridiculous. And homework is worth like 20%.

Best there ever was. He was a great lecturer once you understand his accent and teaching style. The class was graded almost exclusively from the 4 tests and one final. I think the homework was 10% of the grade.  Don't worry about buying the book either.

Cannot understand much due to a strong accent, however he understands that and makes it easy to do well in the class. He is helpful if you seek the help, and gave some tests that were almost directly from practice exams. You just need to put in the time to do the homework and the practice exams when you have your exams, and you will do well.
Luo's English isn't the greatest, but he more than makes up with it in how clear his lecture notes are. He's one of the best math teachers I've ever had. Would totally take his class again.
CHOOSE HIM AS YOUR PROFESSORS IF YOU CAN!!!
He is helpful and super easy. OMG, like super easy. as long as you don't mind his horrible accent and super fast writing. It's so hard to not get a good grade in his class.
Quiz every friday which is 40% of your grade. He pulls problems straight from the homework. Very lenient professor. Awesome guy. Extremely helpful.

Knowledgeable. Spends the entire class doing examples and showing proofs for each concept, which is good. Accent barrier to cross, but not terrible. Quiz every Friday, so go to class and do the homework or you will not do well. Is willing to help students and will show the class how to solve a problem they have trouble with. Pretty good at teaching

He is difficult to understand and talks and writes on the board very quickly. Most of the examples he gives are what is written exactly in the book. You have to do the practice even though its not graded if you want to do well. I hardly ever used my notes in class on assignments - they were no more help then the book itself.

Pros: He is at first quite difficult to understand, but after a while it gets better. Do the optional homework to learn the material, if you don't you likely will not understand much. Quizzes are tough, but if you find them ridiculously hard he will sometimes make them take-home. He grades generously if you take the class seriously. Lot of examples

Authoritative, confident...and clearly cares about his students learning the subject.  Provides a straightforward, but rigorous, method for  success: Do the math...get the grade.  Fair as fair is fair.

He's difficult to understand at first, and writes very fast on the chalkboard, but he uses as many examples as possible that really help you.  Quiz every Friday, go to class everyday if you want to do well.  He will answer everyone's questions and genuinely cares about his students doing well.  He's a good teacher.

Extremely kind and nice professor. You will learn a great deal from this class if you put in the work. However, she made the exams closed internet/note for the first time this year, but did not scale the difficulty, so the exams were hard but still reasonable. Put in the work, and you will be fine.

Really good class if you're serious about learning machine learning. Prof explains things super clearly and connects the math to the intuition, which helped a lot. Homework can take some time, but it actually matches what we do in lecture so it didn't feel pointless. Exams were mostly fair if you kept up.
if you don't have a religion, get one and pray (stat347)

reviews.comment: She is a great professor, would like to have her again.

The class is a moderate amount of work but you will learn so much about machine learning from her class. Chu explains things clearly and knows the material really well. Go to class and take notes. A lot of things she mentions in class make the homework and exams easier. She rewards class participation.

The class is very clear and concise, so you can clearly understand what you are learning in the class. The professor provides a review before the exam covering most of the class material. You can complete the assignments without stress if you participate in class and take notes. The exams are short, so you may need to speed up.

Lynna Chu is arguably the best professor I have had. It is obvious that she is passionate not only about machine learning, but about teaching her students. Her lectures are very thorough and provide a solid focus on the theory and application of the topic. Her assignments are well constructed and take you through step-by-step to help you learn.

Chu is good at covering the course content she needs to cover. Her homework helps learn concepts and reinforce coding practices. As a student in her class, you will have a solid understanding of the material she covers.
Great professor and has a very good understanding of the concepts she teaches, helpful outside of class, homework weekly but is sometimes hard to get feedback. Overall I really liked this class!
DS202 is nothing beyond DS201, just in R. R is worth learning, but if you can learn code online, feel free to. Dr. Chu is a good professor, but this class is not the most interesting.

Dr. Lyons is one of the best, most caring, and thorough professors I've had at Iowa State. He is incredibly intelligent and knows how to teach. He truly wants his students to succeed. This class kicked my rear end but I enjoyed every lecture and learned so much. Be prepared to take the time to memorize and come into the lab outside of class.

Excellent Professor.  Lectures were thorough.  Nice balance of homework and tests. 
Dr. Lyons made you feel like he cared about you as a person and was always flexible when problems came up.
Peak dad energy in the best way.

This is the BEST CLASS EVER. Especially if you are on the pre-health track (med/PA/PT). You go region by region through the semester by looking at human cadavers at Vet Med. Easily one of the toughest classes but graduate school is going to be hard, so you might as well start getting used to it. Dr. Lyons cares so much about his students' success!

This class changed my life in a profound way and shaped the way I view the world. It challenged my thinking and pushed me to think about things from a new perspective. I learned so much in this class and 3 or 4 years later I still remember what I learned and relate things back to this class. It was an honor to learn from Dr. Lyles.

Really fun class, it's discussion based to you're graded on participation every day. Lots of readings to do for discussions! The critical reflections are confusing but she gives examples. Everyone will have to give a presentation so you'll find that you're basically teaching one another, which can be weird.

reviews.comment: I felt that for this particular class, critical analysis of the topics was difficult because of the way the course was taught. Excellent class. Would take again. Learned about communities and cultures around the US in fashion. Pretty cool overall.
Rude

I have taken multiple classes with Dr. Reddy-Best, and she is one of my favorite professors at Iowa State. She is very smart and a very passionate teacher. She made her students feel understood and cared about, which always makes a class 100x more enjoyable. She is awesome!

Good class. Learned a lot. Quizzes, case studies, etc. open-source textbook.

Good class. Learned a lot.

This class uses an open source textbook. It was really interesting to learn about all this new information as a person from a small town in Iowa. She gave a lot of feedback for each assignment, despite the large number of students. Recommend.

The class is very easy with an open note quiz and a small case study due each week which are graded easily as long as you put thought into it. Everything is posted the first day of class so you can work ahead which is really nice.  The topics discussed are very interesting and allowed me to see clothing and society from other people point of view.
She will put a slur into the coursework and not even explain why they can't be used.

The class is an easy A the teacher does pretty much no work at all. Demands to be called Dr. and will only accept emails if you follow her special template. The class itself is sometimes interesting but there is no teaching done by the professor. Easy A, and also a waste of time.

This was one of the easiest online classes I have taken so far. Each week there's a quiz and a case study. She isn't a tough grader so not sure what everyone else is saying. Just submit assignments on time and you're good. It is a very interesting class and I'm glad I took it. Easy A and I would take again.

Dr. Reddy-Best didn't interact with the class at all during the semester. I didn't need to email her but I don't feel like she really wanted you. However, the course had a lot of good, relevant material and I feel like I learned a lot. If you read and watch what is assigned, you will do just fine!

Made this class so much harder than it needed to be. It seems that her students doing bad strokes her ego. Not clear about anything and unwilling to help at all. One of my least favorite teachers I have had at school so far. This class is so stupid do not take it. As much as it seems like an easy A she will find a way to take that away from you.
Good prof. Quizzes, case studies, discssuion board. She emails back quick. Grades within 2 week time.

reviews.comment: Would take this again in a heartbeat. Great class. The people who are super negative on here, I assume, did not email her. If you have a death or have an excuse on her policy, she let's you make up work. This course is something everyone should take due to social justice stuff. Lots of diff ways to learn: case studies, films, notes, and readings.

Kelly is a very kind professor, but she wasnt always understanding. I had several deaths in my family in one month and wasnt allowed to make up the homework I missed. I did think her class was interesting, but i wasnt a big fan. I would take her class again if I had to, but I would prefer to have a more understanding professor.

Really really great class. Learned a bunch. Had to write a lot. Big class. No textbooks, readings online. I reflected a lot and learned. Some team work stuff and a big project.

Handwriting learning activity in every lecture, mostly over 200 words. Your writing is only used as attendance, TA still grades it seriously. She only cares whether you turn in assignment on time rather than your effort and quality of your work. Late means zero! Even if you had a real internet issue and the that assignment worth two letter grades

I had a great experience in Professor Reddy-Best's class. The content is very interesting. The class consists of five quizzes and one final exam which are all open note. There are a few projects but they are not difficult. Make sure not to pack up early and do not talk during class, this agitates her a lot.

Wow - excellent. Amazing. Would def take again. This class opened my eyes to worldly stuff about - race, ability, sexuality, etc. The case studies teach you a lot. Pretty engaging and she cares a lot. There are rubrics that she uses, so you know what you have to do. Lots of teaching methods - lecture, activity, film, speakers - never boring.
Learned a lot about people I didn't know about b4. From small-town Iowa and learned about people not like me. Pretty good overall. Creates pretty open space to discuss hard stuff.
Interesting and challenging class.

She is a really sweet person who genuinely cares about her students. Although she can be a bit awkward in front of a large lecture, she tries her best. My only complaint is that some of the assignments require you to jump through some hoops. Overall, a really easy class and a well-meaning professor. Also, online quizzes are very easy!!!
Kelly Reddy-Best is a fantastic professor. She makes everything perfectly clear. She is extremely organized and I believe she truly wants her students to enjoy the class and succeed.
Great, easy, interesting. Really liked though not everybody did. Just do your work and show up. Need the book for case studies or borrow from a friend. Everything else in powerpoint

reviews.comment: The class is fairly easy. Just be careful on the projects that you meet all the criteria and formatting.

reviews.comment: She puts outside life before teaching.
As far as teaching goes, she is good and gives lots of resources. However she is VERY into PC culture and her political and ideological views saturate her classes.
Dr. B is the best! She's really entertaining and makes lecture interesting. Tests are kind of hard but I would definitely recommend.

She is a funny lecturer and I enjoyed her as a person, but her exams are super tough. She also only writes on the chalkboard so don't expect lectures to be posted. If you're looking for an easy class, this isn't it.

Having Dr. B as ur prof is like if Tina Fey decided to watch the Discovery channel, shoot up some heroin, and then break into a college lecture hall. Her Parasitology class is interesting AF, but at some point it hits you that you actually have to learn all this stuff, too. She also doesn't teach about the Government, a leech slowly killing us all.
Excellent professor! Excellent Class! Take the lab!

Tests def require time and effort put into studying. She is awesome though. Hilarious, definitely had no trouble staying awake in her class. Very interesting topic though. I just wish I'd had a little more warning about how tricky her tests were. Overall, I recommend her and her class.

Best class at ISU, hands down. She is hilarious, and her style of public speaking makes the lectures interesting and easy to follow. Attendance is mandatory - she makes exams from her notes (no book). I highly recommend this to anyone, even those not interested in insects.
AMAZING teacher. I ALWAYS looked forward to going to class. Hilarious and VERY helpful. Who knew that insects could be so cool? Will not leave class without a smile.
Best class taken at Iowa State. Hands down.

After this phenomenal class, and having Dr. B as a professor, I grew to love med. entomology so much I decided to do a research project related to it. Dr. Bartholomay is one of those professors that will change your life for the better. I highly recommend taking any class with her. She has a rockin' sense of humor, and class is always a good time.
Great class! I learned a lot and anyone that spends time in the outdoors ought to take this class. Really helpful to my aspirations in a biology research career. And TAKE THE LAB!!!!!! SO COOL!!!

No book or any other resource so you have to go to class to get all of the notes. Class is filled with her telling stupid stories. Kind of a scatter brain, this makes it really hard to know what the important stuff is on exams. Recommend taking another class unless mosquitoes somehow turn you on.
GREAT TEACHER! Always made class interesting and every class you were crying with laughter. Explains info well and if you study, tests are easy.
I'm sorry I took this class. I could have found better ways to spend my time.

Very interesting/fun class, but for some reason it was a challenge for me to do well on the tests (even when I studied). There is no textbook which can be good (saves money) or bad (must attend class to get notes). She was a big joker and learned everyones name. Her tests are tricky, which she even admits, and include all types of questions.
You won't be sorry.
My favorite professor at ISU, hands down!  She takes everything from her notes that she writes on teh board, makes an effort to learn names, and is really interesting and diverting.

Awesome awesome awesome teacher! She is funny and keeps class interesting. The only text for this class are the notes she writes on the chalkboard, so if you don't go to class, you'll miss a lot of important stuff. But the class is really fun and she's awesome!

The most useless 3 credits I have earned thus far at ISU. The lectures are TERRIBLE and just incessant stories of Lynn's days as a practicing architect- get ready to hear the same one 1,000 times. She grades on a check pluscheck minus system which will make zero sense to anyone but Lynn. She will lose your HW- keep proof that you turned it in.

Lynn is as nice as they come. The only problem I had with the class was staying awake. Attendance is important, there are no tests, just a lot of easy assignments with a couple time consuming ones at the end of the semester. Our final was to bring a Native American dish to a potluck. I just wish I actually learned something of value in the class.

Lynn is a very sweet person and is passionate about the subjet.  Although the course uses three books, the information if often contained within the lecture as well.  Very little outside work and the final is ultra fun - a potluck and a roundtable discussion.  Your participation in the discussion along with your answer determines your grade.

She is the best math teacher I've had so far and I actually loved going to her class everyday. Not only is she hilarious, but she also cares so much for her students. She thoroughly explained concepts in class, was available at office hours and basically anytime if you had questions, and allowed extension on homework. She gave lots of extra credit.

Best math professor I've had in my life. She is good at making hard concepts seem simple and understandable. I recommend taking the class to actually learn the material as well as receive a good grade. Tests not curved but are easy to pull at least a 90, quizzes are easy A's, and 2% extra credit if you show up to all the lectures. HW15% of grade.

She is the best math instructor  I had so far at ISU. Classes are really helpful and she works really hard to help you do good in this course as this is a difficult math course. The best thing about this class is its abundant extra credit quizzes and assignments.
extra credit, wants to help and you to understand, small class
she happens to be the best math teacher I ever I had. She gives a lot of extra credit.
Lydia is one of those professors who is willing to help, walk you through problems on tests, and make sure you do well if you attend her office hours. Plenty of extra credit in this course as well.
Lydia was slightly hard to understand, but it was very refreshing how much she cared. If you stay after class to complete one of her exams, she pretty much walks you through an answer.
She is very willing to help, but it takes a while to get used to it.  She doesn't teach you a lot of what will be on major exams, so make sure you do extra work to keep up with it all and do well.

Lydia is an OUTSTANDING calc 2 professor. She is the best change you will get to have a good grade. Without calculator in her exams she puts the easiest integrals to do. She gives a lot more extra credit than any math class does. She made me love calc 2. This coming from a guy who hated calc 1. I recommend taking calc 2with Lydia 100% of the time.

Was a great teacher! Helped to clarify problems during office hours and was willing to assist with homework! I would recommend her as a teacher since she understands peoples life's and is willing to work around it!

Disliked her teaching style.  She used WAY to many power points and she almost never wrote out an example and when she did it was so unorganized you couldn't follow it at all.  She has an accent but you can get over that.  Overall a bad professor, would not recommend.

If you don't like this prof, you probably hate hugs, kittens, and birthday cake.  She is VERY helpful, gives hints on the quizzes, gives extra credit, and will extend online homework due date if you ask.  She has an accent but it's easy to understand her.  SHE IS YOUR BEST CHANCE AT A GOOD GRADE.

If you show up to 90% of classes you get a 2% boost to your grade. She also gives out extra credit on homework and study guides, which count as quiz extra credit. She will go out of her way to help you and if very lenient with grading. If you show her you are trying/know what to do she will help you on quizes-if you are nice. HUGE CURVE!

Classes are so boring, especially if you have already taken calculus. All she does it put the book examples into powerpoints. Only reason to go to class is to get extra credit by being at 90% of the classes.

Strong accent, uses a powerpoint that goes too fast that its pointless to try writing anything down, every "example" problem is from the book, not helpful during class, if you have difficulty schedule office hours or find a tutor (she won't help during class). Basically just switch if you can...worst professor I've ever had.
Can be slightly hard to understand, but she's very helpful.
Chan can barely speak english, and loves to say "and then!?" hundreds of times. Sitting through lecture was torture. I would recommend not going and simply keeping up with book material.

Seriously, if you're not a complete dufus you can understand exactly what she's saying.  Sometimes she'll get stuff mixed up, but she's not that bad.  She'll help if you ask, too.  Trig is cake if you took it in hs.  My only complaint is that the students in this class (towards the back of the room) were utterly disrespectful and ignorant.
She really cares about her students and teaching.  She is tricky to understand the first few days but you get used to it.  Homework is really easy and the tests are not bad.
Her accent was hard to understand at first but you get used to it.  If you don't know the subject matter, she's helpful, but I'd taken the class before so lectures were pointless.
Kinda hard to understand her accent.  I stopped by her office once and she was extremely helpful, she probably spent an hour going over the material with me so I could understand it.
She wasn't easy to understand, she was very unorganized, and doensn't respond to emails when you need help. I do not recommend her as a teacher.

There's hardly any need to curve the grades the class is so easy.  If you're not passing, you're not trying.  She is so explicit and thorough in her examples that you may get bored though.  Her accent, like any accent, just requires a little time and effort to get used to.  I would have liked to strangle the ignorant morons who always complained that they could never understand her.  She gave 3 extra credit quizzes this semester and I got 4 pts of EC for attendance even though I quit going half-way through the semester.  She assigns anywhere from 4-10 HW problems each lecture, which are due every other Friday.  You do have to memorize all formulas/theorems/algorithms for tests because she does not allow cheat sheets for exams.  All in all, this class just requires time, but not a lot of thinking power.

She doesn't accept late work, and she has a really annoying accent. The material is pretty easy and the final isn't difficult if you study. The class isn't curved which sucks, and there's only 1 or 2 extra credit quizzes. But if you show up to class, your attendance counts as extra credit.

Lydia is such a sweetheart. Pretty choppy English, but if youre following along, you can figure out what shes saying. She really wants you to do well & goes over stuff A LOT in class & even individually if you need. Gives some extra credit quizzes & for attendance. Homework isnt that bad & is given gradually until due date (every other Fri).
Difficult to understand.  Sometimes I get lost trying to juggle copying notes and figuring out what's she saying.  Very nice and bubbly though.
Hard to understand! But very helpful! Make it a point to ask her questions during a test/exam if you feel you're stranded. She'll practically give you the answer! Got me an A!
Worlds easiest class
She is very fun to have and she really wants everyone to do well.

Prof McClung is a great person and teacher. She can be a tiny bit strict on deadlines/grading, but it's all to help you develop your skills. I took Am In 201 with Jen and I loved her! Very little homework (just 1 quiz due each week) and 2 group presentations through the semester. reviews.comment: Attendance was mandatory. It's a easy class but she grades hard. I had to fight to keep a B+. She does give a lot of extra credit. She likes the pick favorites in the class and those people will have no problem getting an A.

Nice women, accessible outside of class, and gives good feedback. Exams are pretty easy, and gives lots of participation points in class. Only criticism is that lectures are boring.

If you attend lectures and follow. along, you will get an A in the class. All exams are take home, which allows you to think about the questions. reviews.comment: Dr. McGrail is nice enough as a person and if you ask for help she will help you. The tests are take home, the only way to get a good grade  is to be super detailed and write a book for each question. She tends to fly by things that are harder and spend time on easier topics. You will need to read the book, lecture slides, and handouts to do well.

The trickiest part of the tests were the experiment questions, every time she goes over an experiment make sure you write everything down, unless it's in the book of course. She mumbles a lot, and walking to and from the laptop instead of using a pointer was rather annoying. In class activities helped a lot, it was worth going just for those.

The tests are take home and you are required to put in a lot of work into the tests to earn a good grade. If she ever references a figure in a test question, follow the journal club format to answer the question.

I took Bio 101 with Dr. McGrail this semester, and she's pretty much the reason I got an A. I hate sciences, &  but her passion for the subject made things interesting and kept me going. She always had time for my odd questions after class, and never acted like I was a bother. The study guides are a godsend too - USE THEM!

For a biology class as a Psych major, I think she did a great job. I learned a lot and I actually enjoyed the class. I would recommend her for a Biology class, especially if you struggle with science courses.
She made this class super easy. She gave out extra credit like it was her job and curved all the test grades a lot. Great professor.
she makes the class incredibly boring, but explains it pretty well
Excellent professor; knows and enjoys statistics and is able to teach both theory and application very well.

Super easy class and one of the best professors I've had. He really wants his students to succeed. The review material he gives out (which is usually a compilation of homework and practice problems) is pretty much exactly what you will see on the exams. If you get the chance take this class with him!

Troy has been one of my favorite prof's at Iowa State. He's a great conversationalist, passionate about his work, and is very open and easy to talk to. Would highly recommend taking his class if you have the option!!!!
He was really great at teaching material and being there for his students even through a rough semester.

Troy somehow makes learning statistics fun!? He is incredible approachable and treats all of his students' questions with respect, taking the time to explain concepts in depth outside of class time. His lectures are to-the-point and effective (something I wish were true about most other classes).

Troy's class was by far one of my favorite classes of the semester. TAKE STAT305 WITH TROY! He is always accessible outside of class, doesn't give lots of homework, and the exams are just like the problems he does in class. Very nice guy, tries to schedule around other exams. Also I like how he focuses on application rather than theory. 10/10

a really great professor with some infamous stories. I love the guy actually my favorite teacher of my educational career. two assignments per exam with the standard 3 exam + final format. the homeworks are a reasonable length and the exams aren't too difficult.
Troy cares so much about his students. I'd 100% take this course with him. He made funny jokes during lectures and did several in class examples. He's one of the best professors I've had.

Troy was probably the most hilarious professor I've had at ISU so far. If he sees his class getting bored, he'll tell a story to get us engaged again, then continue with class. His grading is a bit wonky, mostly based on your exam score then a bit of how well you do on homework. His actual teaching is fast, but he is highly accessible out of class.
He benches 285.

Honestly, one of the best professors I have had at ISU. He tells funny stories and can keep you engaged during lecture. As long as you do the homework, exams are just modified homework problems, and Troy will have Zoom calls where he will go over homework and will also work on problems during class.
Troy was an actual great professor. Every test question was from either homework or an example from class. As long as you put a little effort to learn for the exams, you'll be fine. Truly my GOAT.

Troy is a great guy teaching a subject he's very knowledgeable in. His fabled stats parties were endearing and were a good chuckle each time. His awareness of the, for lack of a better word, bore of his subject matter helps, he's an awesome professor. 10/10
Troy keeps class engaged through frequent anecdotes and rewards students who put in the work.
THE GOATTTTTTTTTTTTTT
He is very helpful for his students and does everything for them.

Troy has been a great professor so far this semester. Life has been throwing curveballs at him, but he has done his best to keep teaching well each and every day. He goes above and beyond to help us prepare for homework problems and exams. He also does his best to make the class interesting and keep us engaged. I highly recommend Troy.

reviews.comment: Troy is the most inspirational statistics professor to ever exist on this planet. Very understanding and helpful. Although his lectures may be disorganized at times, he takes care of his students.

Dr. Meyers is a pretty funny guy and lectures are very laid back. Course content isn't difficult to keep up with and as long as you do example problems, the exams have no surprises. Very accommodating for when life gets in the way and students need extra time or a flexible schedule.

Troy is awesome. He acknowledges that people who take 305 have other more intensive classes at the same time. As long as you give some degree of effort in studying for exams, you will be well rewarded. Very humorous guy who would tell us a crazy story once in a while. Super helpful outside of class, Sunday online help sessions were convenient.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Troy is a great person and a great professor. Sometimes during lecture, I would get a little lost in what we were doing but overall, he is good at getting across the important points and the important material. He is very understanding and always does what is best for students. He also has lots of good stories to tell during lecture.

Very kind and helpful when you have questions. Posts all suggested review material before exams. Can be a little scatter brained from time to time not knowing what to do next in lectures and jumping around between R and his notes. Very funny though with a great sense of humor and fun to talk to. Will take a month to grade exams which is annoying.

Incredibly nice guy, makes funny jokes in class, and is willing to work with students no matter what to ensure that they can get everything done. Tests are very similar to the practice exam, so if you do your studying, you'll get a good grade without fail. Would 100% take another class with him.

Great guy and a reasonable professor. He teaches you what you need to know for exams, and he has fun stories to entertain during class. Most of the grade was from exams, but lots of the exam questions were recycled from homework and example problems.

He cares about his students and puts a lot of effort into always helping students outside of lectures. It's best to utilize this as sometimes it's difficult to understand the stuff in lectures. He is forgiving on grading but it's still a class you need to dedicate some time into. Ignore the disorganization, he is a great guy
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Meyers is a great guy and makes the class enjoyable. You must take this class with Troy and he is very fair with the exams and homework. While he may be a bit all over the place, he has a great sense of humor and is totally worth it.
This professor is the sweetest man ever in the world. He deserves the best. The content was very difficult but he made it bearable. I hope both sides of his pillow are cold at night.

Lectures are a little interesting sometimes, not entirely organized, I suppose. However, Troy was ALWAYS accessible outside of class if you had a question. Multiple times he would Zoom on weekends, at night, etc. Was accessible by phone during weekdays which was amazing. Despite the disorganization, super caring if you're ready to listen.

Troy Meyers is a very friendly guy who genuinely cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Prof Meyers is a good guy. He is a very forgiving professor for his students and tries to form genuine connections with them. He's the guy for stat 305.
If you want a chaotic professor that will listen and adapt to your needs in the class this is the man you want.

He is a nice guy just very disorganized and scatterbrained. His class is so easy tho cause he makes exams exactly like review sheets. His homework and labs are the same way just pretty much exactly like the problems done in class. Very boring class but easy A.

Professor Meyers is very nice and his worksheets and handouts were very helpful. Tests were similar to the worksheets and handouts and they were open book. His class was very disorganized and was not planned out at all. Overall, I do not feel like I learned very much in Stat 301 or in the lab.

asks students he likes to give him good ratings. if you are not liked by him, then you are cooked. (its a tossup if you'll have a good time in his class)

reviews.comment: Do not be fooled by the other reviews, this is not a professor that you want if you wish to learn. He does not lecture in class and makes topics for students far more challenging than they actually are. I am unsure where the vast amount of love and respect for this professor comes from.

Mani Mina was a great professor for Phys II. He was always entertaining, engaging, and very upbeat. I think he explained things very well because he is an electrical engineer, and he knows the ins and outs of everything. He also always popped his head in during exams and waved. Interesting, informative, and entertaining, what more could you ask?
Amazing professor.  Would take another course from Mani in a heartbeat.  He truly cares about his students.

While Mina might not be the best lecturer/teacher in the world, he is a great mentor, friend, but also very great for feedback in the course. The games help reinforce the ideas, and the teaching style can be very different; however, I can not stress how much he cares about students, especially mentally!!

Doesn't tolerate nonsense and will call you out on it. Will teach you the value of critical thinking and expects neat work, not just that it's correct. Someone said he belittles people, but he does that in good fun. He drops many games because he knows people aren't perfect. Gives lots of good notes in Canvas too. Don't skip class, you will fail.
Best instructor ever at ISU. He makes the electromagnetic class easy and super interesting.

Grades on handwriting alone for assignments, extremely disorganized. Lectures do not cover course content whatsoever. You will get an A with minimal effort but you won't learn a thing. The TAs run the course for him.

The Professor is all over the place and he focuses a lot more on cracking bad jokes at the student's expense, constantly belittles students, instead of actually teaching Physics formula, derivation and other course materials.

Mani is a very good and entertaining professor, but his teaching style is bizarre and takes some getting used to. Very outstanding professor.

In touch with society and not stuck in the fake sheltered world of academia. Lot of writing but allows you to actually learn and not memorize like a typical class. Thanks Mina.

There is a lot to say about Professor Mina because he has a huge personality, but my main takeaway was that he'd rather talk about anything other than the course content. He's very responsive to emails, which is great. He is an advocate for students, which is also great. He's an energetic character but not the best teacher. Simple as that.

Absolutely one of the best professors in the department, and they are really few. Very passionate about the topics he teach. Mani is one of my favorite professors. The class by itself isn't my favorite, but his enthusiasm and sense of humor make me want to go to every single class. He teaches in way that makes learning fun. I would highly recommend taking any class with Mani.

Mani is awesome! He goes over the material many times and makes sure everyone gets it. Not to mention he is hilarious and very interesting. He is brilliant and very encouraging. Go to office hours if you are having trouble, he is very helpful. Take a class with him if you can.

Mani is the teacher to get. If you have the chance, take a class with him. He really believes in his students. He made it clear that I was in the right field. Not to mention, he's interesting and very well respected. Mani is known all across campus.  Just so you know, he's a teacher who cares as much as his students care.

Wonderful professor who cares about his students. Lectures are pretty good although he can sometimes get distracted and class will not productive at all. His teaching methods are generally good and he's genuinely trying to make students become good engineers. Humor is funny and sometimes crude but true. I would like to take another class from him

Mani is the best. The material isn't that difficult. He doesn't have the best proper vocabulary for some terms, but you'll get used to the way he explains things. Always tried to make class engaging and so you learn. The real lesson in his classes is to learn how to learn.

One of the best professors I've had at ISU. You can just tell that he cares about his students the way he jokes with them and then makes sure they truly understand the content. A truly inspirational professor.

Brutally honest and brutally entertaining. The class is an absolute breeze as long as you don't skip. Although he can be a little belittling at times, it is usually in jest. His written English is pretty awful, so be prepared for nights of trying to decipher the assignment questions.

Mani was a great help not only in the class but also in understanding the difficult concepts of Electromagnetism. He was more than willing to stay late to talk with me about any questions or ideas I had and did his best to help the class learn as much as possible.

Mani is someone that actually pays attention to each and every student. It's up to the student if they want to take the time to get to know him. Mani is a genius. He will change your outlook on whatever topic you learn from him or even life in general if you're willing to have even one conversation with him and contemplate the ideas that he mention

Mani teaches his class in a different style. Everything you learn is cumulative, he will just add on new stuff while still going over all of the old stuff. He encourages you to make mistakes, as this is how you learn. He cares about his students and wants you to learn & have fun. He'll also gladly help you if need be. My favorite professor so far!
Mani really is a great person as well as a great professor!
Let us play

Mani Mana is unlike any other professor you will meet during your college career.  At times he's a little weird and almost always unorthodox, but his classes are enjoyable and you definitely won't forget what he taught throughout the year.  With a little effort and critical thinking you will pass this class with ease.
An all around genuine genius.
Great Professor Inspirational and committed to facilitating learning.
He's not much of an engineer. "popular" but yeah guess that's what academics matters? lol

Love Mani Mina. I cannot wait to take another one of his classes next semester. He knows how to get students interested and makes class fun. All professors should be like him! If you have the chance, take a class with him.
Great professor cares about the student who atend class and HW are easy just donot leave them for the last minute and for the labs try to solve it during the lab time and you will be fine
Good professor but attendance matters. As long as you show up and show interest and try he will work with you.

The worst teacher I have had!He didn't teach anything useful but just waste time, joking with students.He didn't grade anything seriously.He give the grades randomly even you got the higher grade for sure you will get the lower letter grade.The biggest advantage to take his class is that you can cheat,and he doesn't care.

Impressive class material. He taught a lot of useful things what we may use for other class. However, he will not help you if you are the unlucky one who lost grade. He does not like absence student at all.

Best teacher I have had at ISU. Helps students and often requires you to meet with him when requested. The workload is a joke in the beginning of the semester but towards the end he gives out much more. Labs are mainly MatLab with a little circuitry. In class you basically do trig and deal with matrices.
This teacher did not teach any of the materials, he just wasted class time by presenting useless info. He favors some students and mistreats others.
Best teacher I've ever had.
Encourages learning in very unorthodox ways. Very helpful, patient, reasonable, and understanding. Try him, you'll like him!
This guy really cares about teaching. I really recommend taking one of his classes, he will change the way you look at learning.

Mani Mina is a great teacher! But really take the time to get to know him in office hours. He will definately look out for you and keep encouraging you to do your best. His classes take a lot of time and a lot of energy but he is very aware of that and it pays off in the end.

Mani is the best teacher I have ever had. If you want a teacher to truly change your outlook on engineering this is the man to talk to. He loves to discuss life as well engineering, I actually think he prefers to just talk to everyone about life. All in All Mani Mina is the best teacher I have ever had and would want him again in a minute!

The best teacher in the ECE department hands down!  Thousands of former students remember him fondly for a good reason.  A teacher of his genius only comes once in a lifetime so take at least one of his classes during your ISU career.  As another person said, be prepared to become a philosopher after getting to know him personally.
he is one of the best instructor I have.
The best professor at Iowa State.
Very entertaining
If you need a Technical or EE elective, definitely try to get into this class with him. You will NOT be disappointed.
He's very helpful and actually challenges you to learn something.  He's also a very interesting guy.  He's definitely not an easy professor, but he's definitely worth having as a professor.
Best Prof ever. He is a great leader and inspires his students to be themselves. You can see EE students becoming philosophers or any other thing after taking his class..
Coolest prof on campus.
He's a tough but understanding professor.  He challenges you to think as an engineer rather than a student.

I took his class my first semester back in fall 05.  I have not had a professor change my learning experience like Mani since.  He taught me "how" to learn, a concept I have taken with me for the rest of my classes.  Take his class and be prepared to laugh, learn a little about EE, and a lot about how to learn.
What can I say other than he is a great teacher. A really inspiring and interesting guy

One of my favorite professors, succeeds at teaching to all learning styles. Great sense of humor and tells interesting stories. He expects you to work, but will reward you for putting in the effort. Teaches beyond the level of mindlessly memorizing things, encourages students to find their own ways through material. Makes the effort to know you.
My absolute favorite professor at Iowa State!!!  Usually made class interesting and always had time to help students.

Great professor! Keeps in touch with students even after class and makes it a point to learn names. Lectures were all very good and worth going to. The lab was difficult but wasn't graded on completion but on what you learned so it was an easy A. If you have a class with him go to his office hours and get to know him.
veryyyyyyyyyyy gooddd..

Great Professor.  Cares about you and you learning even if some of his lectures are ridiculous (spent a whole lecture on the difference between nerds, geeks, and dorks; ya go figure).  Labs are rough if you don't spend some time figuring out C (make sure you have a sweet lab partner if you're not the best).  Grades easy.  Fun.
Dr. Mina is the best professor I have had this year.  He challenges his students in a positive way.

Class was amazing.  The lab doesn't seem to match the class at first, but it starts to make sense as the year goes on.  Attendance isn't "mandatory", but be prepared to be put on the spot if you miss a lecture!  He seems interested and cares about every person in his class.  Great professor!

Great teacher! His teaching concepts are a little outside the box, but they are great down the road. Took the time to get to know you as a student and understand your background and where you were coming from. Looking forward to more classes with him.
Great professor! Be sure to go in during his office hours and introduce yourself. I hope I have him again in the future. Not an easy class... still challanging but fun!

I think Mani is a mad genius of teaching. He does crazy things, but if you think about them, he usually has a good reason. The programming part of this class was odd; it was seldom mentioned in lectures, just taught in the labs. The class is always fun.
No Comments
Greatest professor of all times!!
One of the best teachers I have ever had.  Actually made me interested in what I was learning.  If you get the opportunity to take a class with this man TAKE IT!

Mani is hilarious. He really makes you think too. His grading is very easy, until the final. He purposely puts questions that have no answers on there to see what you do. Show up, do your homework and labs, and your guaranteed a decent grade. But don't be fooled, he expects a lot from you.
You love him or you hate him.  Easy grader, but he seems to choose favorites.  His classes are pretty self-taught (esp. programming).
Very good teacher, very congenial and helpful, grades pretty easily.

Mani is the man, who else can make music by sting have to do with engineering? He interests you in the field of electrical engineering. None better. He is a little "Vierd" if u take his class, u'll get it.

Mani is a great guy, good to talk to and makes you laugh. Challenges you to every extent. However, not the best prof around. He doesnt really teach in his lectures. Wont answer questions about HW unless asked a week in advance. Grading system sucks.

One of the best profs I've had at ISU, if not for the grading scheme.  How can an exam accurately measure a student's knowledge when the average is about 35% !?  Other than that one flaw, he made my MWF 8AM lecture worth waking up for.

He's a great teacher. Challenges you on multiple levels. Very outgoing, very helpful, very nice. He likes to joke around and poke fun at people, but it's all in good humor and taste. Everyone has to laugh at themselves sometimes ;)
No Comments

He makes you work hard for your grades, but he's a very good teacher. If you try hard, you'll get an A, but you have little chance at it without at least some genuine effort, no matter what your skill level is before taking the class

Challenging.  He's a great prof, loves his students and goes out of his way to understand them.  Not always the most organized.  Teaches you to learn things for yourself.  Ex. Mani quote: "Formulas are for babies."
He's a great teacher, and he really gets you to think about things you do.
Awesome professor.  I wish I had all my classes with him.  I learned a lot.  Really gets you to think "outside the box."

A man whose perception transcends humanity, dimension, and supernodes. When you learn, so is he, because he forgets the material is has a Ph.D. in. I sometimes feel that he is clare voyant, in that much of the time he seems clueless and yet, right.
Best. Teacher. Evar.

Great teacher, his class was different, but very good, an easy A as long as you do the homeworks, think about joining his learning team
Good teacher. He's fun to listen to and by far the best EE/Cpre prof I've had at ISU

a sly man.  gives random points to people who dont deserve them on tests.  questionable testing style.

makes you think which is good
Best teacher ever, makes learning fun!

His classes could've been considered for my 13th reason. He gives ‘real world' work load which is extremely stressful with other credits, working, and personal life.

He tends to come off as arrogant and often does not give helpful advice regarding projects. All of the projects this semester required copying/recreating already existing designs, so I wasn't able to add any of them to my portfolio. Overall, the assignments don't seem productive or beneficial to the students.

insanely boring class and the dude does not give any insight to your evaluations at all. just a bunch of busy work, nothing really of value or worthwhile. I recommend you take just about any other class over this steaming pile of s***... unless you like spending countless hours doing useless assignments
jesus christ his homework assignments are not only the most boring and tedious tasks known to man, they are worth nearly no points and grading unfairly. this class is god awful

I've never taken a class that assigns so much pointless busy work. Maybe if the 6+ hour assignments were interesting, fun, or teaching me something it'd be understandable, but instead it's a heavy workload every weekend for no reason. Not to mention the grading is abysmal and the scores he gives do not correlate with the rubric at all.

Crazy amount of useless busy work, gives half credit for complete assignments, and offers little to no constructive criticism, just "put more thought into it". He says he personally avoids using indesign as much as possible but is somehow teaching a course centered around it

It was "ehh" overall. He didn't really have much participation in the lectures so you could play it in the background. Overall, the class was easy, and somewhat interesting, but overall boring. Easy A if you just put some work in.

reviews.comment: I feel like some of these reviews are a bit harsh. Yes, he has a domineering personality, but I think one thing his course teaches you is how to be honest with yourself as a designer. This class has helped shed my bias, and I can now admit when something isn't working and find a solution. The workload is intense, but honestly, it makes you better.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a professor, his criticism & philosophy behind design is extremely subjective. Anything created outside of his own opinions is deemed irrelevant & unworthy. When asked questions, he shuts you down & is not flexible with extenuating circumstances. He assigns an unrealistic amount of work, disregarding other course work loads & basic life needs.

Design Ethics is the most worthless and pointless design class I have taken at ISU. We're learning about philosophy and ethics and it has nothing to do with design. Maurice's lectures are very dry, his readings make no sense, he tries to have you do discussions and it's very forced. Worst of all, the class was required for us to graduate...
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Would give a 0 if I could. Doesn't take the effort to make the lessons interesting. Hands out long poorly scanned readings.
