reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nicholas (or Nick, as he prefers) was a great professor. He is one of those rare professors who is extremely knowledgeable about his subject and is also a great teacher.

Super chill guy when you take the initiative to talk with him, really caring professor and a solid guy outside of the classroom. A good way to get on his good side is talk about running or books. He made an extremely boring class enjoyable to go to with this personality.

Professor Nie does a great job at getting students engaged and interested in MIS. He tells a lot of stories and shows a lot of interesting videos in lectures that you thinking. He is also very funny and going to class was something I looked forward to. Content-wise, it is pretty easy. If you have decent computer knowledge you will do great!

Solid professor. His in class slides were not too difficult to read and understand. The group projects are very understandable and should boost your grade. Test are harder but just follow his study guide and you'll do fine. Got 70% on both exams and still finished with an A- from doing well on HW, Group projects and solo projects.

two words, best professor ever. Lectures were amazing and hilarious. Material was easy. Let us have fun and put our own twist on the projects. Ask Cheng to pull up his youtube, he can play dr. D.R.E on the piano. Cheng is the best professor at ISU.

He is an embarrassment to ISU and the reason professors shouldn't get tenures. Expects students to answer questions and then laughs at them when they answer it in a way he disagrees with. No electronics can be used for notes and attendance required. Most boring lectures I have ever had to suffer through in my life. WASTE OF MY TUITION. DO BETTER.

Several group projects. If you know computer stuff you will pass no problem, if you don't you have to memorize everything. Often tests are not what he teaches. Lectures about irrelevant things and doesn't take constructive criticism. Doesn't really want to help students succeed. No technology so that was annoying for taking notes. He goes too fast.

Cheng is probably the best professor I've had at Iowa State yet. As an MIS major I found his course very easy. Lots of the material will come easy to anyone with any computer experience or common sense. Personally I didn't read or study at all and passed the two exams easily. Weekly work is light and the class is well organized. Cheng is the man!!

Is almost always late and will keep you until the very last minute. Not clear at all on rubrics and assignments. Takes forever to grade, the TA practically teaches the class herself. Very passive aggressive towards students. Attendance mandatory every day, with most days being lectures. Required to do the end of semester showcase.

Unreasonably difficult and time-consuming. Many "In-class" assignments, except they lecture the entire class leaving 5 minutes for the activity so we have to work on it as homework on top of the huge project. They also don't start attendance until the very end of class (6:25pm!) and attendance is mandatory so we are always there late. Harsh grades.

Linda was incredibly unorganized & had extremely high expectations. Genuinely the worst/most stressful class i have taken in events. The major project was a ton of work, & it was limited to either a partner or doing it alone. Linda takes FOREVER to grade. should not be required for events. Take in the fall so you don't have to pitch.

I did the major project by myself but would definitely recommend doing the Business Plan with a partner so the work can be split up and not as stressful. Homework itself is not difficult, but the major project takes a lot of time. Helps more with the consulting teams than the business plan people so be sure to get a friend in the class to help you.
Shes awesome

Just accept that the class is going to suck. The class is easy except for the project which I recommend doing as a big consulting group to split up the work. Tests are kind of hard because the study guide is literally no help. Also take this class in the Fall so you don't to present at the Entrepreneur Showcase which is in the spring
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not recommend any courses Niehm instructs. Awful way of teaching. Extremely unorganized.
The professor is always unprepared for classes, and it just takes her forever to grade assignments. With a hope to learn a lot of practical stuff initially but ended up feeling a waste of my time.

I feel she's rated unfairly on here. She is tough and expects a lot out of you, but at the same time, that's the real world. I will say that even though this is a required class, she treats everyone like they want to own their own business one day. Project was tough to do by myself, but she was helpful with telling me what she expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The major project is very time consuming and is graded very harshly. She means well and is a nice person but she also is very hard on her students and has high expectations. She also hands out so many printed assignments when they could just be uploaded online. Plan to have to attend every class - because something will always be due.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Linda is a very disrespectful professor. She treats students like they do not know anything, and does not respond to emails. Linda does not provide help to students, and does not talk to students with respect. This class has some exams, which she provides a study guide not relating to what will be on the exam. a Has a lot of guest speakers.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Linda means well, but is terrible in the classroom. I hated this class as an events student. Most of the time it was a waste of my time and there were so many guest speakers when we could have been doing actual work. She is very vague and confusing and piles so much on you for a 3 credit class. This should NOT be a  required class for event student
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The subject matter of the class is very interesting but by the end of the year the class just gets a little monotonous.

Dr. Niehm seems like a nice person outside of class but as a professor I couldn't stand her. Her voice was so annoying and she did not explain group projects well at all. As an events student, this class was a waste of my time since she does not relate the course to events at all. Field trip is fun but once again as an events student, waste of time

Reads directly off of the slides instead of actually teaching the information. Not helpful when you ask questions. Very unorganized and unprepared for class. Makes excuses and then makes you feel bad when things aren't graded or when things aren't up on blackboard. Very unhelpful teacher.

She has way too many guests speakers. She is very confusing and unclear. Very unorganized. Most times she is unprepared, late, and makes very little sense. She acts like you are the stupid one if you ask questions. Never prepared for class and her exams are VERY hard. The showcase is required and a ton of work. AVOID THIS CLASS!

Niehm doesn't explain things very well. The class is very had just VERY boring. I have no clue what I learned and got a B. Get a good, reliable group for the project. Also, I didn't see how this class related to events.
She is so confusing. Reads right off of the powerpoints and doesn't help when you ask for it. Not that hard of a class just boring.

AWFUL teacher. Rude and would not help, acted like you were stupid if you asked questions. Her exams are not challenging it's just trying to understand her that is the challenging thing. Easy to get a good grade though.

She is terrible.  Has tons of guest speakers.  Projects are worthless and way too much work. Slides do not help when studying for her class.  I will not take a class from her again.  Very boring and hard to pay attention.  Can't say you weren't warned
Super annoying, annoying voice, I cant stand her! Avoid her at all costs!
Outstanding professor, communicates the content clearly and is always willing to help students.
Very good. Would take again

Nordman is an amazing professor that really wants to see his students succeed. He is an easy grader and profusely apologizes if anything isn't clear or if students feel that something is unfair. His lectures were very easy to follow especially because he prints out note sheets to follow along with. Overall amazing professor and course.

Dr. Nordman is the nicest and coolest professor at Iowa State! He is very considerate with homework and exams. He knows what he is talking about. Homework assignments once a week that are kinda tough, but he went through almost all the questions before it was due.
Really great person and professor. Always willing to help outside of class. His positive outlook is contagious.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Nordman is an excellent professor. He was quick to answer questions and always maintained an upbeat and friendly demeanor. He had very clear expectations of what was expected each week of the course. He graded assignments and exams very reasonably and did everything he could to help students. He is nicest professor I've ever had.

He's very good at teaching even it's his first time to teach a new subject. He provides very good feedback to students. There are 3 exams for the semester. The best way to do good on exams is to go over his notes and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very nice guy. Don't have to go to class to get A, but you have to finish up the packets online and at least go to 1-2 classes a week so you know whats going on a little bit. Homework is a big part of the grade, you learn JMP and it was challenging but it was worth a bit of your grade so it was an easy boost. 3 exams were all fair 10-10
Probably the best instructor I had in stat. Really nice guy and tries his best to explain the materials. If you have a question he will always explain them. Really a nice guy. Highly recommended.

He is a nice guy, but sometimes the lectures are kind of dry. Be prepared to follow him writing the notes. For exam, understand the homework, practice exams and you will be in a good shape. Exam 2 is much easier than Exam 1 somehow. 50% on exams 1 and 2, 30% on the final, and 20% on HW.

Nordman radiates positivity and makes you glad you came to class every day. Tries to help as much as he can on the homework and is always willing to answer questions in class. There's big gap in difficulty between his lecture notes and exams, so don't get caught off guard.

Probably the BEST lecturer you can get. Very friendly and humorous. Lecture notes are very organized + plenty of examples. Tests are tough, but wouldn't expect anything easier for a course of this level. Have homework almost every week (which imo is a very good practice). Would definitely recommend this class!
He's brilliant,  I wish he could have a normal life
Great Professor, one of the best in the Stat department. Knows his stuff. Perhaps is too nice...he could be a little "meaner" and still be effective.

Great Professor.  Truly wants to help the student learn.  More than willing to take time out of his day for you. If you go to class he will make it possible for you to get the grade you deserve.  Highly recommended.

Truly wants to teach well but has little ability at the graduate level.  Nordman confuses himself if he strays from his pre-worked problem script.  Sadly, he cannot answer questions dynamically in class or out of class.  Again, he really wants to teach well and be helpful.  Unfortunately, he simply lacks the skill.

Great professor.  Really funny guy.  Takes the time to help the students with problems they don't understand.  Always willing to take time out of his schedule to help others.  If you can take this instructor.

This guys a little strange,but overall is a pretty good instructor. Doesnt seem likes hes been teaching long though. Long homework assignments and a few in class quizes(use notes on them!) Go to class and DO PROBLEMS IN THE BOOK. This class has some hard tests and you dont get to use notes on them. Class is a must. I might take him again next semst

Dan is a little odd, but he does a great job at teaching stat! He makes sure you understand what he's talking about and you learn a lot from his in-class activities. He's funny, you should ask him what's the best german beer. I would definitely recommend him.

Terrible Professor, Contradicts himself every other sentence, uses big words that don't apply simply to make himself feel smart, even though the words aren't applicable to the material. Shows up to class like a greasy head slob.

This was the worst math class I've ever had. We are going into the last week, we've taken 9 quizzes and never got a single one back. He takes forever to grade exams, and you get little to no feedback. When you ask him about it, he gets defensive. Won't respond to emails. Will spend entire lecture showing derivations and leaves no time for examples.

I've never fell asleep in any class before yet somehow Mr. Noren put me to sleep. Let me put it this way, I got an A in diff eq no problem and struggled to get a B+ in his class. I was more confused going to class than teaching myself. The final exam also had questions that I had never seen before. It almost seemed like he didn't want to be there.

My semester in Math207 is Steven's first time teaching so perhaps he will improve with time. However, my experience was with lectures so mis-paced and slow that I barely convinced myself to go to lecture. We would spend 30 minutes talking about the x-y coordinate plane and then be left with almost no time to actually go into the actual subject.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Steve's lectures are incredibly boring as he usually reads off the slides and has very few examples (which usually come out of the book.) We will usually do the same example for the entire week, and he usually repeats himself. Given this and the material, this should have been an easy class, but was not due to his inadequate teaching.

Heavy in theory, reads off slides and then does one example, but doesn't post the examples online - just the theory slides. Often gives very confusing answers to questions. Nice enough guy, but not a good teacher. 3 Exams + Final. Weekly take home quizzes and online homework. I personally had to use online resources as well.

Nice guy who is open to questions and office visits, but his lectures are boring and look like they're copied out of the book. Lazy when it comes to posting anything. Final exam is tomorrow, and the practice solutions are not up, which is not fathomable to me. I am thankful to the internet that I have made it this far.

As mentioned on Michigan State University's perspective on Mark Helmsing, Those who can, do. Those who cant, teach. Those who cant teach, teach teachers. Steven Noren should take that phrase to heart, as he certainly has shown no capability of teaching. I don't think the material should have been hard, at least with an actual, good teacher.

I think he is hard grader and he is messy during a class. However, he always is helpful after class and available to explain things in his office. It is not easy A class. Tests are usually harder than material in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Steve Noren gets very off-topic in lectures and the lectures are pretty much just talking about gambling. He only reads off the slides, and gives the impression that he is also learning the material in class. His tests are worth too many points, and is weighted very heavily. Overall, I would strongly recommend avoiding having him as a professor.

Man, I thought math was about practice. This guy comes to the class, opens his slides and READS over them. He reads theories and properties. Absolutely sucks at teaching. He rarely does an example. He takes everything personally. Will never recommend. I would like to thank YouTube for this class. Extremely boring and dry lectures.

Do not take this professor. He makes things way harder than they need to be because he doesn't know how to relay the information. He NEVER responds to emails and he says he will put things on Canvas and rarely follows through. He constantly forgets to put the weeks lecture slides online. His tests are needlessly difficult too.

Horrible professor. He is always messing up in class and does not seem to know what he is doing. I go to class everyday and we do the same 3 examples everyday and the test is way harder. The material is not hard but how he presents it makes it extremely difficult. I got a tutor who had never taken the class and they taught me better than he did.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: NOT a good professor. he is always messing up in class and then making jokes about it. he will wait 10 minutes in silence if no one answers his questions. he makes the concepts seem harder than they are. he does not seem very knowledgeable about what he is teaching

Steven's first teaching position after graduating. Very theory heavy lectures. Could use more examples in lecture and explaining the basics of terms/ideas before jumping straight into dry theorems and terminology. The class content is not hard, the way it is taught makes it more so. Khan Academy will explain very well in a few minutes of watching.

ENGL 445 was awesome! I would take any class with him, he's a great professor who really wants to support his students. Really made you excited to go to class each day and fostered a great classroom environment.

Took his version of ENGL 445 about blaxploitation cinema. 1 essay, 2 quizzes, a midterm & final exam. No large projects or group projects. Lots of opportunities for extra credit. 3 textbooks, 2 of which were pretty expensive & I couldn't find posted free online. An incredible professor who is unfortunately leaving Iowa State - he will be missed!

While the information was interesting, and the teacher seemed to genuinely care, the grading was terrible. He is a tough grader, and the assignments and worth very few points. Unless you want to spend two hours for every paper written that's only worth 12 points... don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: 100% would take again, great professor and really cares about the material and students as well. I recommended this class to all of my friends!!

This is by far my favorite online course I took, the professor is very understanding but expects a lot of work to be done but is very willing to work with students. The lectures are interesting, but very long. Take his class if you are truly interested in the material and you will get a lot out of it. He is a fair grader if you put the time in.
Dr Lawrence genuinely cares about the subject material as well as his students. He is quick to reply to emails and gives great feedback.

Dr. Lawrence is a phenomenal professor! I took this course to learn about the role diversity plays in the media, and I was not disappointed. There was no busy work for this course, Dr. Lawrence assigned meaningful tasks and encouraged deep, critical thinking. If you have the chance to take a class with this professor, definitely sign up!

I took this class online. Lectures every week, about 2 hours. Also a chapter of the textbook would be assigned, but he would specify which sections were important. Gives chances for extra credit and quizzes are easy if you pay attention. Tests would repeat quiz questions. Nicest guy Ive ever met; great class for an easy social science credit.

My favorite professor so far! You can definitely tell that he is passionate about what he's teaching and cares a lot about the students actually learning. Assignments aren't hard but you can't miss a whole ton if you want an A because there aren't a ton of points you can miss.

Dr. Lawrence was the very first professor I ever had at Iowa State and he did an amazing job. He lectured in front of a large lecture hall and did a great job. He truly cares about his students and wants to help students succeed. He is genuinely passionate about the subjects that he teaches and this comes across during lectures. Truly a class act.

Prof. Lawrence is amazing. Genuinely cares about students and will host extra study sessions for finals and midterms. Book isn't really needed if you go to class, except you will miss a few questions on tests that come from the book. AWESOME 8 am because he gets you pumped up. Go to class and you can pass easily.

Professor Lawrence is funny and energetic even at 8am. Very little homework in this class and if you dont show up youll be fine for the most part as long as you read the book before the quiz. All the quizzes are taken at the testing center and are pretty straightforward. He was always willing to help and gave easy extra credit options throughout.

He's a really passionate professor and really wants students to do well but obviously he won't hold your hand, his lectures are easy to sit through and his notes make sense-- just make sure you go to actually get the notes as he does not post the same slides to canvas. He's energetic and very engaging even at 8am. would really recommend.

He is a great professor who cares deeply about the course and the students. I took a course on qualitative research methods with him and although it was lighter than the courses that I am used to (at a graduate level), the class was insightful nonetheless. It was a great experience having him as an instructor.

Dr. Lawrence was my first professor I ever had in college and he provided the most amazing start to college I could ask for. Although his class was at 8am his lectures were extremely engaging because he cared about the content he was teaching so deeply. He genuinely cares about your success in both the class and in life. Truly an amazing educator.

Professor Lawrence is an amazing professor. He truly, honestly, cares about each and every one of his students, and wants more than anything to help you succeed as a student. His lectures are always engaging, he does an awesome job at including real-world examples to demonstrate the material. All in all, an AMAZING & passionate instructor.

Dr. Lawrence is one of the best professors I've had so far. His personality makes lectures engaging & you can tell he cares about his students. Assignments are minimal, easy, and oftentimes interesting/fun. The book is a useful study aid, but you can get by without it. The only negative is that he posts only a fraction of the notes, so go to class!

Dr. Lawrence is a great professor that makes class fun. He has a real passion for the subjects he teaches. He keeps his lectures interesting and finds fantastic ways to relate content to the students' lives. He's funny, intelligent, and dedicated to helping his students by any means. One of the best professors I've had the pleasures of having!

Want an easy and interesting class? 101 with Dr. Lawrence is the ticket! A couple of a quizzes, a midterm, a final, and a 4-point weekly assignment that is actually very interesting. The lectures can sometimes get dry or deviate from the initial topic, but others are phenomenal. Great in class discussion and watched a couple great films too.

Professor Norris is decent, but she does have a habit of getting snippy and aggressive with certain students. It's kind of hard to listen to the way she talks to people sometimes. She is a tough grader but her feedback is extremely useful so I can't complain about it that much. The Text Set is a pain in the a$$.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Norris is absolutely one of the best professors in the education department. She is willing to work with you if you communicate. She cares more about you as a person rather than just as her student. She is the true definition of an amazing teacher, anyone should want to teach like her in their future classrooms!

Professor Norris is the absolute best. She truly prepares you for what you need to know to teach literacy. Don't get me wrong, this class is tough. There are plenty of long projects, lesson plans, etc. that will take up plenty of your time. But, she is always willing to help and be flexible if you contact her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Super nice. If you communicate, absences dont matter much. A ton of reading. One of my favorite teachers in the education department!

If you have the chance, take it with someone other than this professor. She cares only about her class and she treats students like 5 year olds. She uses a very condescending tone and often acts as if students are idiots. She was blatantly fake all semester and played favorites with certain students who put in less than the bare minimum effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Stop. Turn around and get out of this class. Get a different professor. You've been warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lisa Norris is amazing! She is funny and very clear in expectations for class and assignments.

Lisa was awesome! She is super funny and easy to listen too. She knows that college students have a lot on their plate and makes sure we have plenty of time to complete assignments. She gives good feedback and tells you exactly where you went wrong or what you need to change. She takes the time to get to know her students. Loved her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Lisa Norris is by far the worst teacher I have ever had. I am currently a Junior at ISU, so that is saying a lot. She has the worst attitude and holds grudges. Her tone of voice and choice of words are very condescending and rude. She is a nit-picky grader on quizzes and lesson plans. She gives passive aggressive feedback not constructive at all.

Lisa is a fantastic professor, who is incredibly knowledgable in her field. She has high expectations, but is one of the most respectful professors I have had at this university. She truly cares about student learning.

While a lot of people think that her quizzes are tough, you will learn a TON of valuable information that you will be able to use in your own classroom! The lectures are long, but that doesn't change with a different instructor. Take 377&378 with her and you will be well on your way to becoming a GREAT teacher!

Lisa is the worst teacher in the School of Education Her voice tone and attitude are terrible let alone her lack of caring about tough events in life funerals etc.. You miss for any reason you get docked Her QUIZZES take 2 hours on average. Write hundreds of lesson plans, oh and did I mention she talks like a high school drama queen

She has favorites in every class.  All I did was go to class sit quietly and take notes and try my best.  I would write the same things as other people on my "quizzes" and yet I would get a worse grade than my peers.  If you want a teacher that doesn't talk like a valley girl and looks 50 then take it with the other instructor for this course.

I've never learned as much in any class at Iowa State as I have from Lisa Norris. She's enthusiastic about her job and teaching you. She talks a lot and speaks very fast but she makes class fun! If you have a chance to take a class with her, take it! You won't regret it. The tests are exactly what she covers in class.
Had lots of great stories to tell about teaching. Sometimes what she expected from us for projects and papers was kind of confusing.

Lisa is awesome! Her clarity and enthusiasm is great! She has a lot of experience in classrooms and has plenty of real-life examples and lots of anecdotes to tell her students.  You do need to know your stuff, but gradeing incredibly fair!

She really cares about her students but she is also slightly passive aggressive. I personally like her because I think she is funny and pretty entertaining. She grades extremely hard. Everyone in the other section got 100% on their text sets and no one in our class did. She gives good feedback on things though.

extremely unprofessional, disrespectful, and passive aggressive. She will not help much, cant answer emails bc she is tired or busy. if you have a funeral, unfortunately this class is more important! and don't try to talk to her about a grade, she will walk away. Be prepared for many tears shed. don't get me started on favoritism and picky grader!

Professor Norris has been by far the most impactful person I have encountered at Iowa State University. What you put into her courses is what you will get out of them. I found them to be crucial to my development as a future educator and would not choose another professor to take this course with. I HIGHLY recommend her.
Very passive aggressive and grades very hard. She is very engaging and entertaining but is hard to ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This professor was so difficult to work with. Nice enough person, but does not give enough specifics regarding assignment expectations. VERY tough grader. Be ready to work a lot and still not understand what you are doing. Would take someone else for this course.
Overall not good.  Not helpful, difficult to work with.
I learned more in this class than in all my college years.  She is definately the best choice for a 377 instructor.

very nice man, cares about students, works to make lectures interesting, can be a little disorganized and tech challenged, study guides are long but very helpful gives lots of extra credit opportunities

Definitely cares about his students and tries to make lectures engaging with the class. I mostly worked on other homework during lectures and still managed to ace the exams. Fill out the study guide - it gets pretty long, but it covers most of the exam material. Tells you ahead of time about in-class video quizzes. Gives TONS of easy extra credit!

Dr. Scott is a great teacher with a ton of experience in the field, which he brings to class to help make the course material come to life. Attendance is not mandatory, but every day you miss you miss a LOT, so go as much as you can!

He learns names and faces faster than any professor I've met! Exams are hard but his study guides tell you exactly what to study and where to find it. He has the best stories to tell during lecture. His notes are mostly a direct summery of the stuff in the book. His voice is very quiet and smooth though...easy to fall asleep to after lunch...
Interesting class, his lectures don't really reflect the tests. Lots of information covered in the text is not discussed in class.

Strange class. His lectures are interesting & I enjoyed them, but they did not prepare me at all for the tests. You have to know the textbook pretty well. I didn't like that he'd post the lecture's outline after class. Having it before would make note taking much easier. Also, he was always late posting notes on WebCT. Tests aren't too hard though.
Interesting guy, but all over the place when it comes to notes and following along with your chapters. Tests were alright if you studied, but a lot came right out of the text book.

really interesting subject matter, REALLY BORING lecturer.  Nice guy, really needs to work on lecturing style.  Rambles about basic stuff: history, dates, technical definition.  Very little about case studies, implications of disorders, treatment,  or anything interesting

Interesting class...boring PROFESSOR.  Sorry Norm.  Very nice guy but tends to ramble on about basic stuff.  He loves to tell personal stories that could be summed up in about half the time he spends.  Overall good class and easy A for being a 400 level.  Be sure to read the book
Very nice guy, easy to get along with.  Very helpful.
No Comments
Nice guy and very willing to help. Can be kind of boring, but still overall worthwhile.
No Comments

Extremely boring class and some of the assignments are hard but Professor No is extremely helpful and is in his office a lot if you email him and let him know you are coming. Really helped me a lot on a few assignments
This professor just read information off slides, I can do that at home.  I wish he made the information easier to learn by using examples.  I felt I learned very little from this course.

This was probably my least favorite class of the semester.  Understanding this professor takes time to get used to, but he can throw some fun things into the class to make it more interesting...thank goodness because this subject is boring and reminds me of MIS 330.

He can be really hard to understand sometimes, so the best thing to do is just read over the slides yourself. I'm still not exactly sure what we were supposed to get out of this class.  We used a little bit of Access and some Excel but I still don't really know how to create a working AIS.

He is difficult to understand at times. And he asks his students to 'think about it' way too much for new concepts. To be fair he wasn't really in control of the class, Janvarin was.He's a good guy if you put some effort into it you should at least get a B.
Dr. De Silva is the best! He has a great sense of humor and is really good at explaining chemistry to students of all backgrounds. Honestly would take chem 163 again if he was my professor!
He has an accent, but don't let it put you off! He is easy to understand and will walk through problems step by step in class. He is very unintentionally funny.
By far the best professor I have ever had! A real gem!
An amazing professor who engages with the whole class

De Silva was a great teacher! Does an excellent job of teaching the concepts of the problems through examples which really help when you reach the quizzes. Loves to meet with students and works in depth with you during his office hours. Would take another class with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: He is a little bit hard to understand sometimes but is fully aware and communicates well with students to make sure everyone is on the same page. There are clicker questions in almost every class, but the difficult ones he will go over with us and nearly give you the answer, so they are easy points. His lectures are interesting and he really cares.

He obviously has a passion for Chemistry that he shows through his lectures as well as how he treats the students. He is an amazing professor who is willing to help any student pass no matter how much they are struggling.

Dr. De Silva is one of the best professors I have had at ISU. He really knows his material which reflects on the way he explains complicated material in a simple way. He really cares about the students.

Mr. De Silva is a great teacher his accent is  a little awkward but you can understand him.  He loves students questions and will go through the work enough times for EVERYONE to understand.  He's a great to have and will make things funny in his own way to keep your attention.
He is a good prof. truly cares for his students. clicker Q's every class so attendance is a must.

Good teacher, always available for help, weekly hw and quizzes due once a week, but eliminates worst 5 quizzes and hw's, daily clicker q's, tests aren't bad, attend review sessions whenever possible. All in all very helpful and wants his students to have success in class

One of the few professors I have had here that genuinely cares about his student's grades. Does whatever he can to give you the benefit of the doubt and guide you through the class. 4 tests that arent bad with some studying, review all the past tests and youll be good, weekly homework due once a week along w a weekly quiz and clickers every lecture

A few tests that aren't really bad,  study the past tests that he give you and you'll be fine. Gives an entire periodic table for you to make your own personal cheat sheet, don't lose it though because you only get one. The homework gets pretty tough sometimes and the recitation quizzes are kind of annoying. But he drops your worst 5 tests, and hw.

This class is the worst class I attended during my 4 year classes, her homework is hard to understand and she gave the points very low. And she explianed concept not clearly. But her attitude is good and nice.

Extremely unorganized which makes the material more confusing. Having a prior background in SAS is useful. She does not like being interrupted even if you're just 2 minutes late to class. Her homework assignments can be confusing to understand. She gives you slips of paper to hand in when you ask questions for participation points - so annoying!

Nusser was an okay prof. She really made an effort to get to know students, and she was very respectful. Few things I didn't like was that her homework problems were worded very poorly. I had spent a while trying to decipher what the problems are asking for. She grades tests more tough than her TA does HW. Speak loudly, as she is hard of hearing.
She's one of the most boring professors I've ever had with my 4 years in college.  Her homeworks are horrible.  She's monotone, and treats her students as if they are still in 5th grade.
booooorig!!!!
Best of the best teacher IN THE WORLD!!!!!!! very talented and erudite person!!!! LIKE HER SO MUCH!!!!!!! you guys criticize her 'cause you got a bad grade!!!! jus study well!!!!she is gorgeous!!!!!
Terrible teacher. Strong accent makes it hard to understand.
No Comments

I'm sure shes a good economist, but she can't teach at all. She doesn't prepare any examples for class (atleast it seems), shes not good at answering questions, very monotone, and tests difficult. I found my self skipping class or just going over the notes on my own during class.

Bad teacher and very hard to understand.  There are a lot of aplia assignments that are nothing like what she talks about in lectures, which makes them very hard and very time consuming!  No curve so far either.  This class is super boring and sucks!

I am currently a Junior in Community and Regional Planning and had Lee my freshman year.  The man is great.  I had no art experience and learned a lot.  I got an A in the course.  He is very helpful and will help you with your drawings.  The class is a lot of work!  You earn your grade!

One of the greatest instructors I ever had. Lee was so helpful in/out of class and other stuff too like tips on putting together your portfolio or entry submissions. He is fair. I think there is a bias against him because of that. He wont hand you an A. YOU have to put  effort into it and he'll see that. I have only good things to say about Lee.
it dosent seem like we learned much. it seemed like all the class was, was a prereq for the design undergrad. drawing boxes, charcoal, still-life, perspective drawings.
CORRECTION for TYPO:*I mean you *CAN* get a A- at least.*

I know a person who had to retake this course because of him.But from my experience you can't get an A- at least if you use your time wisely in class, and re-do drawings if need be.He can be frustrating when giving drawing suggestions at time, but i really learned a lot from him, and he really cares about his students.Has weird music taste though!
very good professor, lets you redo projects for a better grade!

Lee is a fantastic teacher.  I had no drawing experience when I started the class but progressed quickly with his help.  He spends lots of time on the basics but it's worth it in the end.  He is extremely willing to go out of his way to help and answer questions.

great instructor. first concerned about the time spent on basics but am now glad that we did, seeing my other art compared to classes who started out w/ perspective, other.. order of assignments, probably the best.. put extensive out of class time to perfect your pictures (not just lees class) if you do this and listen to him you will be fine
I thought he was great.  I was not an artist entering this class, but I feel that he has helped me develop as an artist.  He is one of the best studio teachers from what I can gather!!!

Lee is truly one of the main reasons I am no longer in the CoD.  He refuses to help those who truly need it, he doesn't really share his wisdom, despite his obvious talent. It IS true--he does badmouth students outside of class-I was 1 of them.  AVOID AT ALL COSTS!  U will do nothing but draw boxes and he will show you nothing but a lack of concern

Avoid at all costs. There are many caring, talented instructors in the CoD, but Nyquist is not one of them. His assighments were lame (we drew boxes for nearly half the term), and he didn't spend enough classtime on individual feedback. One-on-one he was a bit better, but usually took the out-of-class opportunity to badmouth other students.
He would not teach those students who did not know how to draw - he simply concentrated on the students who were developed artists.  Effort does not matter to him, despite what he says.
He's just really nice, helpful, his lectures are very interesting. As long as you pay attention you will do well.

Matt is one of my favorite professors of all time. I also worked for him in the woodshop where he was an amazing boss. He is everything you want in a professor. He pushes you to be better and develop your skills, and gives you great feedback and tips on how to improve. Overall great guy that is there to help you.

He is a great professor who knows what he is talking about. He is very focused on helping you get everything right and makes sure you know what you are doing. If you have any type of questions about what materials to use or what the cut should be, he is your guy!

Matt is the best. Unlike many design professors, he actually gives helpful, practical feedback on projects and grades them fairly. He does a few big projects, with a few smaller things sprinkled in to pad your grade a bit. He also specializes in model-making so he has a lot of good advice for building your projects.

His feedback is valuable. Take final reviews seriously and clean up yourself and the space. He'll sometimes bring in his dog Edison and do fun activities as a destressor.
Great professor. Does whatever he can to ensure students have every resource available.

reviews.comment: Super easy art and humanities credit class. Fully online with no due dates (besides the end of the semester). Can be a little time consuming, but if you just do the work you will get an A+. Do not buy the textbook you don't need it. Shazam is a great tool for this class. No written assignments, grade based of multiple choice test and quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I did not interact with Dr. Oakes in-person (as I took this class online) but I thought the material was fascinating and I learned a lot. I would highly recommend it!
