reviews.comment: Very interesting and easy class to take. It's a self-guided course, so the professor wasn't super involved in facilitating the work. However, he seemed very open to answering questions if you have them.
I am taking MUSIC 304; this course has been very straightforward, and the professor is very communicative.
Dr Oakes is kind and is very willing to help you become a better player. He conducted the clarinet choir and it was very enjoyable to play in.

Dr. Northway was an AMAZING teacher. Although I wasn't interested in the class material, he made lectures extremely interesting. He was very laid back with class and often cancelled class or removed tests when our other coursework got heavy. He was one of my favorite professors and my heart absolutely broke when I heard of his passing. Rest easy.

He provides the PowerPoints from lectures but they are very basic with little to no specific info compared to his lectures. I would suggest showing up often and taking some notes from the lectures themselves, youll miss important details. Hes a cool dude whos very intelligent and easy to listen to.
One of the best professors I've ever had at ISU. Absolutely inspirational and incredible to listen to. Rest in peace.

You can tell Northway really cares about world religions. His lectures are consistently interesting, even though it may not be necessary to attend every day. As long as you check out his PowerPoints he posts online each chapter you will pass.
Take his classes!

Undoubtedly the absolute best professor, or in general, teacher, I've ever had in my life. He genuinely cares about his students, is an amazing lecturer, funny, clear grading criteria, and is incredibly educated on his subject. If his sections are full (they were when I went to sign up), just email him and you can get in. Trust me, you want to! :)
very enjoyable class. He wants his students to understand and is very willing to help out however he can. Cool dude
Religion 210, super easy class even though the material is a bit dull. However, Eric is a very good story teller and keeps you engaged. Great class to knock out a Gen Ed with.
Hes so fun and even though the material may be a little dull he sure isnt! Totally loved his class!

Mr. Northway was one of the best instructors I have had in Iowa State. The quizzes were from the book and it was easy, and we had three non comprehensive exams from the lectures' notes including the final.

Eric Northway is easily my favorite teacher so far at Iowa State. He is super friendly and easygoing. The class itself is not difficult if you copy down the slides and study for the exams. He also tells you exactly what he's testing you on so it shouldn't be too difficult. You'll need the book for the online quizzes.
Great professor.

Eric is an amazing teacher. Do the study guide and you will easily finish his tests/final in 30 minutes tops. Don't write all his notes. Just fill in the blanks he provides. Complete notes will make this class very easy. His quizzes are just his notes. Check your answers because some words look similar. Don't lose easy points. There aren't many.

He's a super chill, laid-back guy. The exams are easy as long as you fill out the study guides. We had to write about 8 journals throughout the semester, but he grades them pretty easily as long as you put some thought into them. Attendance isn't mandatory, but the lectures are kinda helpful for journal ideas and some of the ppt notes are blank.

You won't find another professor better than Eric Northway. He is very passionate about world religions and it shows in his classes. He keeps lectures interesting with personal stories and a very upbeat attitude. He is very helpful and approachable if you are struggling. By far the best professor I have ever had.

While lecture attendance is by no means mandatory, everything is online, it's worth it to attend class.  He genuinely cares about his students and wants to know their opinions on things.  He never gets boring and teaches the material almost like a story.
Fantastic professor, loved him, very organized, funny, simply nothing negative about him or the course

Flat out one of the best courses I took in my 4 years.  Northway is an amazing teacher.  He explains everything in a very down to earth (using mostly movies like the Matrix) way.  He was easy to talk to and a great professor with a love to teach.
He was the best professor that I have ever had. He makes the times go by. You will enjoy his class. Go to the lectures and you will an A

Northway is a GREAT professor. I was not interested in religion prior to coming to class, and he made it so interesting! He speaks clearly and gives you time for notes, so it's very easy to follow along in class. Know the vocab on the study guides, and you'll do great on the tests. Expectations are clear. I hope I get to take more of his classes.

Dr. Northway really knows a lot about  religion. He made the class easy but I learned a lot from the class. I was disappointed he want absent a lot because we had to cut out important information, but overall  I really liked the class an Dr. Northway is an intelligent man. If you are looking for an international perspective this is a great one!
Interesting class. He knows his stuff. Good sense of humor won't bore you to death. Exams are easy if you spend a little time on the study guide. One of my favorite professors.
Super nice guy, easy to talk to and discuss with. Open to new ideas and willing to change things up in discussion. Knows his stuff and is enthusiastic about teaching.
Very interesting class. Eric is an awesome guy and is super helpful. The class is fun and I look forward to going to it.

Very easy class if you go and pay attention. He tells you what to study for the rests. I would strongly recommend Northway for this class over some other professors. Makes learning fun and exciting. Even relates it to our everyday lives.
He really knows the material he talks about, is very helpful, funny, and super cute. :)
Best professor I've ever had! Easy going. Good sense of humer. Interesting to listen to. Willing to help you learn from any mistakes you make. Definitely take his classes!

What an awesome guy! He makes the class incredibly interesting. My major is in Engineering but I would love the opportunity to take more classes with Northway. Hands down the best class I took all year.

He was a very awesome guy! Really easy for relg 205. I would recommend this class and him highly he made things interesting as well as easy. You watch the matrix for a whole week for crying out loud. TAKE TAKE TAKE TAKE!!!

This guy is very chill. His assignments and online quizzes are pretty easy if you just skim the book. If you do the study guides for his Tests, easy A. One project about the matrix, and you watch the whole movie.

Go to class and listen. It is a lot of fun. You will learn a bunch too. He is a little impatient with student excuses, but you know what is required form the begining of class, so just do what he asks and it is pretty easy. He is a nice guy who is willing to work with you if you need it. Take his class.

Just great and the fairest professor you'll have in college.  He lets you know what he expects right away.  You'll be surprised how much you learn, because listening to him in lecture isn't punishment like typical professors.

He is an amazing teacher,a more than fair grader, and an awesome dude. He is extremely clear and will tell you what you really need to know. His exam prep is extremely relevant to the tests. If you put forth a little effort in this class you will do very well.

Eric is a very interesting person. I feel that he explains things very clearly and even if the topic was confusing, he explained it very well. Great at answering questions, fun sense of humor. Class was easy if you went to it, but not mandatory. A few online quizzes and in class tests, very easy.  Journals are easiest when done along w/ the weeks.

He is one of the best professors at ISU. I've been here for 4 years and this was one of the few classes that I enjoyed going to and I learned a lot despite having no prior interest in this (I just needed an international perspective class). The class is taught from a neutral lens. I think that he's one of the coolest people ever. Take this class!

This guy is awesome. He is always helpful, example a quiz was due a 12 PM and most people assumed it was 12 AM so he gave everyone a 3 day extension. Just one of the small things hes done for not just me but the whole class. Hes really funny and just someone you would want to sit down and drink a beer with. Without a doubt the coolest teacher atISU
best teacher ever. period
Super nice guy and definitely knows his stuff. Taking his class was actually kind of fun! He is also a more than fair grader and the material was relatively interesting.

He is one of, if not the greatest prof I've had at ISU. Knows his material like the back of his hand and loves answering any questions. Exams are simple if you study the guides he provides and quizzes are just extra easy points. He offers EC and this is great. Lectures are interesting and he's got a great sense of humor. Highly recommended!

Eric is such a blast! He is extremely clear on all of the material and is more than willing to answer questions or work with you outside of class. Always offers extra credit, which is great. Exams are a breeze if you study the study guide. Quizzes are straight out of the textbook. Take this class if you can, he is great!

He was awesome! I had him for the learning community too and he was great there! Very helpful and easy to talk to, learn a lot from him and the classes aren't boring bc he relates things to common life.  Great guy!

Great lecturer, very enthusiastic. Loves answering questions and is very good at engaging wannabe philosophers. Quizzes are very easy and straight from the text. Exams are not easy, you will definitely have to study/read assigned materials. Offered EC which was great. An A is very attainable with not too much work.
easy class, but you still learn alot, the guys awesome.
Awesome, just awesome!

I have been taking classes from Dr. Northway for a year now and he is one of the best professors out there. He is always excited about the material (even though he knows it all by heart). You will learn a ton from this man.

Northway is spectacular; his lectures are easy to follow and he has a way of explaining things the way everyone can understand it. I'm a relig major but this is an intro level class so there's a lot of kids taking it for a diversity requirement and they enjoy it as much as I do. TAKE HIS CLASS.
GREAT TEACHER
The word "awesome" cannot begin to describe how great this teacher is...also probably one of the easiest classes you'll ever take.
He was an amaizing professor. His teaching style kept me interested in class
Take this class!  You will not regret it.
Take this class. Northway is excellent, interesting, and has no tricks on tests. Every teacher would benefit from sitting in this class for a lecture.

He's the coolest professor I've ever seen. I love the strategy he uses in his teaching: if you know it, you know it. He's also interesting to listen to even though he uses ppts the whole class which usually gets boring but for him he does a great job engaging students. I loved this class!

I love this class! I just took it to fulfill my IP requirement, but ended up loving it. Northway loves what he's doing, is well-informed, hilarious, and employs an "either you know it or you don't" philosophy for his classes. One of my favorite professors from ISU! pretty good looking :)
You WILL love this class!!!
Lectures were interesting!
Smartest man alive.
You can tell he really enjoys what hes doing. Great Class!
This guy really relates to the students in his classes which helps in his teaching performance
Great prof! Easily in my top 5. He lectures with enthusiasm and obviously loves the material. Go to class, study the guides he posts online and it should be  a breeze. Again, great, great prof!

This guy is amazing. His lectures and power points are very easy to understand.  His tests are Identification and Essay, and fairly easy if you attend class.  I hope I can get him a for a few more classes.
Northway's lectures are very interesting.  He explains everything very well and keeps my attention.

I took 205 from him, and it was a relatively easy class.  A weekly journal is required, but it isn't that hard.  Tests are fairly easy.  He gives you a good study guide, and it is mostly terms and basic facts.  He doesn't put in any trick questions. I think the average was 85%.  The group project over the Matrix was a little difficult but not bad.

GREAT Professor.  I took 205 and 210 from him and loved them both.  Wonderful personality; loves to have fun and joke around.  Classes are fairly easy but you still learn a lot.  he truly loves what he does.  You do need to study for the tests, but he will give you a study sheet to use which makes it pretty easy.  Take classes from him if you can!
He is a really good teacher who make class interesting most of the time. Grade is based mainly off two test and that is about it.

Eric is Superman!!  This guy is one of the best lecturers I've ever had!!  Very objective, and says things like they are.  Just go to lecture, and you'll be just fine.  I've had more fun in this class in one week than I've had for other classes in a semester.
Clear, helpful and very, very objective. One of the best teachers in religion
Not enough positive things to say about this guy. Probably the best professor I have had on campus. Very cool guy to talk with outside of class and very friendly and helpful.

This guy is great at lecturing, but gives you loads of corse work. A 10 page paper and 2, 1 page journal entries each WEEK. Not only that he wants you to deeply analyze your thoughts on things in your journal. Gimme a break i just need to fill diversity requirments and you giving me all this to do in a 200 level course? take it if you like writing.
Great professor!!

this guy is amazing.  the class is easy and interesting.  there are 4 pop quizes the whole semester and they arent really a pop quiz because he usually tells you when they are.  the tests are really easy, everything on them he gives you a study guide.  Not only that he is just a really good teacher all around and relates well to students

This guy is the must take professor if your interested in taking any religion classes at all. It's a very do-able class and very interesting because this professor is one of the best I've run into and he just a great guy to be around.    If you can get into any of his classes, take them and you won't regret it.
Excellent teacher.. has a very nice voice and moves around a lot so it is easy to pay attention.  He's very fun and definately relates to the students well (and doesn't expect you to read anything)
Lectures are interesting and class is very little work.  Unfortunately you don't learn more than the very basics - I'm sure he'd be a great prof for a more in-depth course.

He is very passionate and knowledgeable. Homework is not difficult, just reading and journals. He makes class interesting and you learn so much from his style of teaching. Even if you don't have an interest in the subject his ability to teach allows you to learn in a great atmosphere.
This guy is awesome. Wonderful Class. Heavy Recommended. Tests are easy and projects are fun.Take this class if you can.
You'll love the class
Should have more professors like him...he's great
Great professor!! Want to take more of his classes.
Great Prof.
He is awesome. I definitely reccomend, hands down. Best professor I've had.
hE IS THE GREATESET PROF THAT I  EVER HAD.
Great lecturer.  One of the few classes I looked forward to attending on a regular basis.

One of my favorite professors!  I wrote down everything that came out fo his mouth, because he was so interesting!  I learned so much!  I'm looking to take anothe one of his classes.  MUCH RECOMMENDED!
He's a great teacher. He doesn't make the material hard. As long as you got to class you'll be fine!
Big mistake taking it with him.
eric rocks.
definitely rocks at teaching...he's a prof that actually wants his students to pass the class..i highly recommend taking any class from him
This class becomes 205 soon. Easy prof. Tests are from review sheet. Extra credit available. Matrix (the movie) project great and easy.
He is pretty solid.

Definitely enjoys the subject he's teaching, and knows A LOT about it.  The journal he assigned was a bit of a pain, but the easiness of his tests and lack of quizzes made up for it.  Lectures could get quite long and note-taking very ardous.
Yeah - a couple more readings than I would like for a 105.  But it doesn't hurt to not read them.  He's a great professor to just listen to.  He likes to teach.
drab.
Northway is a GREAT professor.  He is really passionate about what he teaches, and loves to see students connect concepts.  It is a really great class.
He does a nice job of explaining things and is one of the few professors that seems to enjoy teaching. Concepts are easy to grasp and review sheets before each test were helpful.
great, nice, helpful, hot

He made the class interesting and was always willing to talk to you if you needed help.  He also offered plenty of extra credit to those who needed it.  Definately take a class with him if you get the chance.
Awesome Person and very interesting
He gives too many reading and writing assignments for a 100 level class. Often hard to follow also.

enthusiastic- enjoys teaching. said he would give quizzes in the future though, because fall sem. 2003 he didn't give any and caught on to the fact that we weren't reading anything because we really didn't need to
No Comments
He is an awesome professor with a lot of voice. Very enthusiastic about the subject matter. Assignments are gimme points. Tests are rather simple.
Good class to take for credit.  Northway really knows the information and enjoys teaching.  Hardest part of the class was just getting the papers done.

The class isn't too difficult, but requires a lot of time-consuming busy work. Others have mentioned the required 170+ question reviews before quizzes, which are present.  The grading system is bad; it's possible to get -100% due to the "not graded" assignments. He reiterates from the book a lot, but is helpful and interesting in office hours.

This class is seriously the worst thing I've ever endured. It started out not too bad but as time went on it became unbearable. He teaches NO material, just goes over the book and make the quizzes and tests up himself, so the book becomes unhelpful then. He also requires 200 practices questions before the test. This class is just a joke.

Why this professor is still allowed to teach at any kind of institution is beyond me. He is extremely disrespectful to his students, provides zero help with the material, and requires work equivalent to a 6 credit class not a 3 credit class. He has ruined the content for me, which I was interested in. DO NOT take this class with him. He's the worst

If you enjoy doing a mandatory 500 questions before the final, then have fun with this class. This professor is honestly a joke. He's extremely rude, he doesn't respond to emails or provide help, and the amount of work he expects students to complete is beyond ridiculous. 500 MANDATORY QUESTIONS to end the class. Don't take this class with him!!!!!

This class is extremely hard. Not only that, but the teacher makes it harder. Be posts wimpy videos every week and basically spews out exactly what the book says. So, in short, he's no help at all. The content on his quizzes doesn't match the homework, so it's impossible to get a good grade. Not to mention, the final is worth 30% OF YOUR GRADE.

Worst experience I have ever had with a professor. This is a 3 credit class which should equal 3 hours of lecture for one week. He posts 20 minutes of lecture for 2 weeks. Unacceptable way of teaching. He is flat out rude to students and doesn't answer emails asking for help. Hands down the worst teacher I have ever had.

He was the worst professor I have ever had. The way he constructs the course is EXTREMELY confusing. Worst teacher I have ever dealt with. DO NOT take this class from him, whatever you do. He does not teach, and if/when he does, he makes students feel stupid for not knowing information he knows. Worst class and teacher of my schooling so far.
Good teacher, clearly knowledgeable on the subject. Class gets difficult but he's always ready to help you out.
Great professor! I took this online and they way he has it set up is really helpful. Always e-mails back when you have a question and is very clear. Good class to take.
Comment

This is an orientation class for the Greenlee School. It is only once a week so go to class for easy points as you need to get to 100 by the end of the semester. You will make your website portfolio and a four-year plan. You learn a lot in this course as there are guest speakers every week. However, she cancels class a lot, but I'm not complaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would never take a class from her again. I do not know how she has so many positive reviews. She makes up the most ridiculous reasons to cancel class and then when she decides to show up she dumps everything on us in ten minutes because she is so behind. Should not be a college professor

Oakes wants you to have all of knowledge she has. She cares a lot about her students and is always there when you need help no matter what time of the day. Explains content thoroughly and fully. Makes the hardest class at ISU actually fun!

Time management is key. Runs the class like a news room, so be ready to work. But, the course is doable. She grades hard at the beginning and gets easier as the course goes on. Went from a 65 at midterm to a 92 for the final. Just breath and you'll get through it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I liked meeting all the Greenlee professors and that Oakes didn't make this 1 cred class hard. I earned all my points just showing up to class. Easy. I plan to take 201 with Oakes because it seems like she really knows her stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Easy class. Just read the syllabus and show up and you'll pass. Lisa is easy to work with and tried to make getting through the class just a matter of showing up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Great instructor. JLMC 110 is an easy class. Prof. Oakes always had class well organized and interesting speakers. Assignments and points were all on Blackboard. Emailed back right away.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Oakes was a fine instructor for this intro/orientation course to the Greenlee School. However, she's very unorganized and the directions she gave were often very confusing. When I would e-mail her with questions her replies were very vague. If you change your major out of Greenlee (like me), don't waste your time and just drop the class.
Nice but a little unorganized. JLMC 110 is an easy class but she wasn't the most organized all the time. Overall though I would still recommend her, she's pretty easy to work with.
I took this class as an orientation for journalism. She is a great speaker that gives many opportunities for points in this pass/fail class.
Lisa is like an M n M. She appears to have a tough shell but is soft in the middle. I learned more in this class than any other ISU course.

While Munger-Oakes was great at getting students to improve their writing she did have unreasonable expectations for students. She cancelled class a lot, lost an extra credit paper and then refused to give me any credit for it. She gave feedback  but it needed to be more detailed so we could improve. End of semester didn't seem to care much at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: 414 is a journalist's capstone. If you don't take it you are lazy.
I love 414. It means you have to do your own work and produce, but I get that it's the professional world.

I've taken a few classes now with Oakes. This one is different in that it's less tightly formatted and lets students work on their own projects. I think it wouldn't work for you if you didn't have a lot of experience in journalism, but if you do, it's perfect because it lets you work on your portfolio.

Oakes isn't as tough as what a lot of people make her out to be. If you do the work, meet with her, ask questions,etc. you'll be fine. She can be intimidating because she's so pulled together, but she'll go far to help you succeed. Definitely not an easy A, but prepares you for the real world.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is also very scattered. She often forgets what she assigned or when it was due. She'll cancel class so that she doesn't have to drive to campus but expects us to then go out of our way to get things to her in alternate ways (I know it's our job but a little consideration would be nice?) She is also late frequently but expects us to be punctual.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: She really pushes you to improve your writing (by giving Ds) which is great. However, she gives feedback that is very vague and hard to apply to future writing. She can also be very condescending. It is essential to do the extra credit in order to get a decent grade in the class unless you are already VERY skilled at hard news beat reporting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This has been the most beneficial class I've taken at Iowa State U. The first day I was really intimidated but Prof. Oakes if SO put together and prepared that it makes you want to work hard so she appreciates you as a student. Do the work like you care and you'll be just fine. Stop into her office if you're struggling, I recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Amazing professor, gets to know students. She let us out early a couple times. Class time is a mix of lecture and practice work. She gives you the opportunity to catch up by offering more points in the second half of the semester but you need to work hard. Missed one class, never again. Felt relaxed leaving lecture. Would love to have her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: The thing I like about Oakes is she meets you half way. It's a lot of work, but I realize now that's what I needed to make my writing better. I met with her for help and it helped a ton. She's tough, but really cares that her students succeed. You get what you put forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Oakes is an amazing professor. She makes you work for your grade, but you really do become a better writer after taking her class. Work hard and she will respect you. Show her you are trying your hardest. Don't expect to do the bare minimum and pass.

JLMC 110 is an easy class. It's pass-fail and you just don't want to leave your 100 points until the last minute to do, but other than that, it's totally doable. Oakes worked with me to make the assignments tailored for my interest in advertising.
If you give Prof. Oakes a foot, she will give you a mile. She wants to help you, you just have to ask. If you listen and do what she says in lecture adn in with the readings, you're set.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: JLMC 110 is super easy. I liked Lisa and thought she was a sweetheart in helping me to figure out what I wanted to do with my career and what classes to take. I hope I can take more classes with her.

JLMC 201 was one of the hardest classes I've taken at Iowa State, but I think the best so far. If you want your writing to improve, take it with Oakes. She is tough, but you will really benefit from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Don't be scared of Prof. Oakes!! Stay in her class! She is beyond willing to help you if you make the effort and if you ask questions. It is evident she wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. O is the real deal. She treats you like you are headed for news and tries to prepare you for it. Don't procrasniate or you'll never make it. Ask her for help. She'll do anything to dhelp out.

Lisa is a great professor. You have to show up to class or you won't pass, but her class really improved my news writing. It was fun to write on a beat for 202; I highly recommend getting your articles published in the Iowa State Daily while taking this class. She doesn't hold your hand on assignments - you've got to put in the work.
Don't believe the stereotypes about JLMC201, it's not that bad and it will get you ready for writing at the pro level.

I wouldn't take 201 with anyone else. If you get the chance to take a class with her, do it. She will make you work hard, but you will be so thankful that you did at the end of the semester. My writing has improved so much since the beginning of this class.
She's the real deal. If you want to get a job, take her classes.

I learned more in one semester with Prof. Oakes than I have in any ISU course yet. She is tough, but she takes you step by step to achieve your goals. I was SO afraid of this course when I enrolled, but it was not as bad as everyone says. It's been my favorite class so far.
She doesn't mess around. You have to show up, but she will make you a great journalist. Highly recommend.

Prof. Munger-Oakes is, without a doubt, one of the greatest assets that the Greenlee School has to offer. This class is difficult if you don't pour your heart and soul into your pieces, but if you do, you will be rewarded. Prof. Munger-Oakes is very helpful and always willing to help students who are struggling.
Her class improved my writing so much and I'm a more confident reporter. Would recommend.

If you want to become a better writer her class is a must.  She'll make you work for your grade, but if you're struggling she's a great resource. She's always there for her students in and outside of the class room. I wouldn't recommend anyone else for 201 or 202. Trust me, if you pass her class you'll be proud of yourself.

Here is the straight deal. If you care about your journalism major at ISU, TAKE THIS CLASS. She is going to whip you into shape. She comes off as intimidating, but she is like a warm M&M, tough shell, warm sweet center. She will teach you how to actually write and what really matters. And, most importantly, she will help you advance in journalism.
Strict teacher that expects attendance and participation. If you put in the time and the effort she will do anything for you. Very helpful.

Textbook was out at bookstore for a month until we could order one, yet professor still expected us to do the readings. Some students were told they could walk into her office while she was gone to take the book for several hours, others like myself were told we could only go when she was there and make copies in 10 min...

Didn't learn anything that I hadn't already learned from experience in writing for the Iowa State Daily. The work you do in class is very helpful, but really only for the sake of repetition so you can really nail the concepts. Nice lady, though. And hey, pretty good looking.
Munger makes a simple class very stressful.
I do not like her style, also the tests have too many flaws and grading is hard, attendance is also required.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice professor but just is not good at teaching sadly, she needs to slow down and make sure students are able to understand the material.

Where do I begin, professor is a very kind person however if I must be honest teaching is not a strong suit. Somehow makes material I already understand confusing. Seriously don't take her if there are any other options. Apply at your own risk

Where do I begin, she's a great person but honestly terrible at portraying information. Somehow finds a way to make material I already know confusing.Not to mention her exams had a mean of 48% so it's obvious her exams were made hard just for the sole reason of being hard.alongside this fact she only curved the final exam

She was great at teaching ECON 102, and was especially caring and understanding of her students. Exams were extremely difficult, but were balanced out by lots of extra credit. For being the only ECON 102 instructor for all 3 sections with roughly 100 students per section, she did an excellent job with what she was given.
She does not teach anything.

For some context, I thought both Econ 101 and 102 were some of the harder classes I have taken so far here at Iowa State. This class is an introductory class, so you will be learning many new terms, making the learning curve that much harder. Like others mention, test are hard, but if you do the readings and put in the effort, you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: ur cooked
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very nice and caring lady, but not a great teacher. Lectures were very disengaging, unorganized, and fast. You also can't hear/understand her because people talk all of the time, and she does not do anything about it. You are basically on your own for studying for your exams. She does not give you a lot of helpful resources to study with.
Does not lecture well and tests are difficult

This teacher is one of the worst teachers I've had. She goes on and on about one thing all class, and no one knows what she is talking about. The average test grades in her class are around 50%-60% on every test.  She says she gave us all the test answers before, but there are so many questions, so you never know what will be on the exams.
you will never understand a word she says and has been wrong in class. there's lots of extra credit because she doesn't curve anything her work is also due at a very inconvenient time
Exams are very hard and the averages are very low. Extra credit balances it out some, but not enough.
Exams are very hard with the averages being very low.
Class is very difficult to follow at times and test questions were often hard to understand what they are actually asking.
Hard to follow and difficult to understand. Test averages are always in the 50s and often not similar to what was taught in class. Nice lady but a poor teacher.
Worst experience of my life. She cant really teach, is very hard to follow, I felt like I had to teach the class to myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's a nice lady, but not a great teacher. Very hard to understand and extremely disengaging lectures. The exams are very difficult and the materials you are given to study are not very helpful. My only friends who did good in this class only memorized the multiple-choice questions but did not retain any information.
She genuinely cares about her students and is willing to help you if you need it. She's a little eccentric and some aspects of the class setup are clunky, but overall its not difficult to figure out.

Miyoung is a great professor, however she goes pretty fast and can be hard to understand at times. She does make class fun by giving out little prizes every once in a while. If you attend class she gives you extra credit. The homework isn't too hard, and the exams are questions directly from in class activities.

Lots of extra credit to help you pass. Exams are extremely hard as far as material and time limit. Class averages are 60% and below. 20% of missed points in exams can be earned with grade boost assignments. The practice exams are free response practice (4th of real exams). The rest of it is problems selected from packets provided for each chapter.

Miyoung is a great professor for Econ 301 if you were confident in 207. If that's the case you will have no problems in the class. Lectures got dry at times but they are important to go to. The exams are structured exactly like the practice exams and you get to use your notes on them.

She cares, her lectures can be hard to follow, but if you make sure you say on track, you will do great, especially with the amount of extra credit she gives (we are talking about 10 percent extra credit). Love her

Impossible to understand and tests are insanely difficult. Test averages 50-55%. Free response is impossible the tests as she does not teach anything worthwhile in class despite giving out attendance points...only good thing going for her is LOTS of extra credit given out to boost everyone's horrible grades. WORST PROFESSOR EVER NOT EVEN KWAN CHOI

Miyoung cares a lot but overall teaches a terrible class. The averages are super low due to her lecture style. They last forever and a majority of the time are far too confusing. I would never take this class again, because although she offers lots of extra credit and cares for her students, she is ultimately a bad teacher.

She seems like a great person and is really cool, but the whole class struggled with her tests and it is far from ideal. While I think a big issue was effort and people refusing to put in a minimum standard of work, it still reflects poorly on the professor when everyone does poorly on exams.
worst professor on campus

Her lectures are very long and you don't learn very much. You do get 2 attempts on homework questions though and can get nearly 100% every time. For exams she puts out roughly 100 multiple choice questions and the ones from the exam are directly from there. If you understand that and the concepts you can do okay on exams. Very average professor.

She seems like a nice person, but her teaching is genuinely awful. Her first exam of this semester averaged at 64. Her second averaged at 50. This should be proof enough to straight-up steer away from this professor if you want to pass macro with an actual good grade.

Mi Young is very nice and very energetic. However, she does not teach well at all. Her first exam had an average of 59% and barley gave us the ability to improve it, only giving us a ten point quiz that would be added on. She gives you questions she hasn't talked about and even called our whole class lazy for not knowing how to solve it.

Professor Miyoung was a very energetic, sweet, and enjoyable teacher. If the class was struggling, she would slow down and make sure we understood before moving on. She offers lots of extra credit, and the practice exams she gives are almost exactly what are on the exams.

Miyoung is a really great professor who knows the material she is teaching and knows how to explain it well. Her lectures are very important to attend, and super helpful for exams. She is very flexible and helpful if you miss class or cannot attend for any reason. Very kind lady and great at teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is super sweet/fun to have as a professor. Really appreciates participation and gives out extra credit for it pretty often. Goes over the material at a good pace; sometimes her accent makes it harder to understand her point, but she will always slow down if you need clarification. ECON 102 isn't hard at all as long as you keep up with reading.
The easiest class I have ever taken. Attendance is mandatory, but that doesn't really matter.
Easiest class I have ever taken, just do the one assignment a week and you should get an A. Participation is graded so that plays a role too, but SUPER EASY A.

She's very friendly and does a good job teaching this mandatory pre-business class. This is a 1-credit class, so it's extremely easy. There is one assignment each week, and it is an open book. If you complete all of the assignments, you will pass!
easily one of the best professors here in the physics dept. Hail craig!
Caring, good grading sclaes
Really good teacher, listens to what you have to say, and makes sure you understand the concepts.

He teaches very passionately and tries different methods of teaching in order to help you learn.  Whether he is good or bad really depends on how you are willing to learn. If you are an individual learner, he is not for you. If you prefer to learn in group - he is the best.  I, myself, am an individual learner. However, I won't say he is bad.
Very willing to teach, very excited about what he is teaching and he definetly cares whether or not you understand the material!

Ogilvie has been the best professor I've ever had at Iowa State to date. He made the material so engaging. His lectures are very fun and very informative. He expects a lot of his students so expect to work hard. He is also very helpful during office hours. It's sad that other Physics students won't get to have him.
Best professor I've had so far at Iowa State. He made a tough subject understandable and made his grading scale and tests very fair.

This professor is really hard to follow sometimes.  No matter how well you think you know the material or how much you study for the tests, he always makes them so hard.  Tests are only around 24 points too so you miss a few and you end up with a horrible grade.  I really thought that he would have been better.
Ogilvie is a great professor.
Made a tough class much more managable, great professor!
He is awesome!!!

People either absolutely love or hate professors on here. I think Ogilvie is fantastic. If you "hate" him than you haven't had bad physics professors. He goes in depth into the CONCEPTS and not just aimless formula plugging. He goes out of his way with pre-lecture vids and all and really helps teach physics. I learned a lot and really enjoyed class

Absolute worst teacher I have ever encountered in my entire academic career. I got an A in his course and I still think this, which shows just how bad he really is. Likes to teach by stumping students, which doesn't help them learn, but rather deters them from caring about the course.

One of the best professors I've had at ISU! He knows his stuff and knows how to teach. Loved the review at the beginning of class and the bonus questions during lecture. Makes class fun. I loved his class.
Absolutely amazing prof. Truly cares about what he is doing although the class is one of the harder ones I've taken thus far. The only glaring problem is that recitations are a joke.
ive only had him for one day and the guy reeks of intelligence.
Not that great. very self centered and talked about how great he was all the time. homework and lecture was a waste of time.
Easily the the most interesting and best teacher I have ever had.  Unless you tune out everything he says, you will learn a lot from him.
Cool guy gets excited about some topics. Good Prof
Phenomenal professor. The only lecture I actually wanted to attend all last semester. The class was fairly difficult in nature but he made class an enjoyment.
He caught a spinning aluminum disc (demo) with crucible tongs. Nobody tops that.
Great prof.
Awesome guy, great professor, really understands students and their needs.  But warning his tests are extremely difficult, its the one thing that makes his class difficult.  But otherwise he's great

Quite possibly the best professor i've ever had.  he  understands how people learn, and teaches it simple enough that i could understand, but i am also able to apply it to more complicated things, too bad he doesn't teach my other classes
Took an extremely hard class, and made it seem somewhat easy.  Great guy, awesome prof.  Highly reccommended.

Great teacher, teached with passion, but the class was very difficult and time consuming...however that may just be because Phys 222 will be that way. I do recoment this teacher, he could keep my attention almost 30 min! Which is way more then most profs can. Ends the year with an awesom lecture too
Good

he is an awesome professor who tries his hardedt to make sure you understand the material.  he is always available if needed and wants everyone to pass.  i havent seen a professor work as hard as he does at making sure you understand and get physics.  you're lucky if you get him.
Best professor I've had at ISU. Great guy outside of class. The class is hard but Ogilvie is great at teaching it.

Ogilvie is the best professor that i've had at Iowa State University.  He made a subject that I disliked into one that I actually have an interest in now.  How he did this?  He's a great lecturer and I admit, his accent does a number.

Great prof...one of the best i've had at ISU.  HE keeps the lectures interesting and interactive with the 'flash cards'.  The exams were still tough, but that comes with territory.  Highly recommended.

Best prof I've had at ISU - has a real passion for phys & teaching. Material's tough, class's interesting (100x better than 221), and no matter the grade, u'll learn a ton. If you're having problems, he's more than happy to help u out.
Fantastic teacher, one of the best at ISU.
Excellent teacher. One of the best you'll have your first few years at Iowa State.
Class isn't easy - you'll really earn your grade here.  Dr. Ogilvie truly cares how students do in the course, and stives to make it more interesting/valuable for you.
Excellent teacher.  He really cares about the students.
Nice guy, decent teacher, class is not easy though, and is a lot of work to get a good grade in
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments
Cares about students and does his best to help you. That said, class still isnt easy.
Unapproachable and intimidating
As selfish as one can be. He does not listen to anyone and make all the decisions all by himself.
No Comments
Well - even though I am an alum of the program - I always thought he was a horrible professor and his classes were boring.  Never taught me anything about real life - just "theory".

Dr. Oh looks as though he will be vary hard, however he is a really funny guy and a good teacher.  Really likes people to talk in class discussions.  Go to class, take good notes, read the book and you will do fine.  Awesome guy.

Dr. Ommen did a good job teaching the material. She tends to reuse the same examples, but you'll get used to it. I liked that she teaches slowly—it gave me time to take notes. She's always willing to help, even outside of class or during office hours. Exams are fair and very similar to the sample exams.

Dr. Ommen was very kind and she made the material digestible. If you did well in calculus this class will be fairly straightforward. I personally attended every lecture though you would be fine not to. The labs were essentially useless and I never learned anything in them. She is very approachable to ask questions to.

Makes theory material that should be difficult, quite easy. You still learn everything you need to for 342 and how to apply the concepts. Also if wanting more information, she's always happy to explain more. Lots of examples help you internalize the concepts and help you apply to hw and exam like problems.

Professors are very concerned about students' grades.  Every theory is accompanied by an example, but the examples are always reused, which makes me dizzy when I encounter other problems.  Usually, the examples in class are simple, but when it comes to exams, I find it very difficult.

Dr. Ommen is super kind and sweet. Her lectures weren't all that interesting, but she made an effort to get to know her students and create a positive learning environment. She uses many examples to ensure your understanding of the subjects. She also gives you ample resources for exams and homework assignments.

Easy class, exam averages were in the B range. Poor quality lectures. Examples were either way too complicated or repeated continually for the next week. Labs are basically graded on attendance and R Studio knowledge is assumed for the labs. Homework is weekly and sometimes has a couple of tricky questions. Grading exam time is very inconsistent.

She was awful. She was petty about the entire class. She punishes the whole class just because some students didn't do a worksheet. So the whole class suffered. Switch sections if you can. She is the worst.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She ran the studio like an office. She had demands of things that needed to be done but did not offer good reason to why we were benefiting from it. I did however learn to follow the IBC in this course.

She did not explain anything. Out deadlines were dependent on her other job for response. I was told she could not help me with a project due the next day because she had a deadline for something else also. Ladan is not a professor, more a supervisor that made comments that did not help with projects to improve your grade. She is a terrible teacher

Her advice has always backfired on me later on during reviews. Explanations of projects early in semester were poor and did not help. She would tell you advice one day then the next studio forget what she told you and proceed to telling you the opposite of the day before.
She did not prod us toward any particular solutions, but challenged us in ways in which we had a more comprehensive experience of how to approach architectural design.

Ladan's grading was very objective. She basically handed you a sheet of paper with a letter on it and no explanation. You could work your butt off on a project or you could half ass it and you would get close to the same grade either way. She thinks she's helpful but she actually doesn't know what the hell she is doing.
Emotionless and offers no direction or input.

Took 387 with her and she is just way too smart to be teaching that class. She just reiterates things off of the slides and expects us to know how to fill in the cracks. Memo is graded very harshly even the second time around and is a big chunk of your grade as well.

Good class for self-paced students who can keep on track. Keeping on track for this class is the most important thing! Dr. Watanabe does not get enough credit. The course is well-organized, everything is laid out clearly, and the material is more than manageable. She responds quickly by email.

This course has a ton of material and it's harder than 3860 but Dr. Watanabe made sure to make it manageable. She teaches like she expects everyone to go for CPA license which I think is good but not easy at times. For group work she lets students select their team mates. Exams are weighed heavy, but there are practice exams that are similar.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Having real examples of CPA exam questions during class was great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked how the detailed slides and quick-paced lectures worked together. Dr. Watanabe's clear notes and genuine excitement made class fun and kept me paying attention. Her energy helped me stay focused and made it so much easier to remember what we learned all semester.

The memo is graded very harshly at first, but is resubmitted for more points. The class is tough because there's just so much to learn. Dr. Watanabe does her best to make the material easier to understand. She's very direct and may come through as harsh, but she actually very nice once you get to know her better.

Professor Watanabe breaks down tough accounting topics clearly and keeps class organized and focused. She truly knows her stuff and cares that students learn. She gives practice exams and quizzes and is always willing to help. If you're willing to put in the work, you'll learn a lot. One of the best at ISU!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Watanabe is the most rigorous yet passionate accounting professor I've had at ISU. She's not perfect, but it's obvious she truly cares about the subject, students, and how well we grasp the concepts. She also went out of her way to accommodate me when I had medical issues and was missing class.

Dr. Watanabe is well-prepared and open to questions in class.  Her lectures are well organized, and the assignments can be revised, which means we learn from them, instead of just one and done.  She expects us to learn and structures the class so we can, if we are willing to  the work.  I think she is very fair.

Watanabe is one of the worst professors at ISU. She just reads off slides, offers almost no support, and wastes time with irrelevant stories. Her lectures are confusing, unhelpful, and do nothing to clarify the already difficult material.Easily one of the most unhelpful and frustrating accounting professors at ISU.

Worst accounting professor I've had. Lectures were rushed and unclear, with examples already solved and not broken down. Explanations were overly complex; we didn't even know where to begin asking questions. While grading criteria was outlined, she was extremely harsh. The TA was excellent and made the class bearable. Take a different professor!!!!

Oena used lots of examples through PowerPoints, live walkthroughs, and TopHat plus SmartBooks for prep. She never just lectures. She frequently pauses to open the floor for questions, which I found very helpful.

Toughest accounting class ever, but Olena saved it: she breaks down complex concepts, loads Canvas with resources, and throws in jokes or stories when lectures drag. She's an accounting nerd but gets that we can't all geek out on spreadsheets 24/7. Still, Excel is king, LOL.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Intermediate Accounting is brutal and extremely divisive -you either love the professor or can't stand her. I was in the “love” camp because she genuinely cares that we learn. She breaks down insane material into bite-size chunks and always goes the extra mile to make those tough concepts click.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures mostly consisted of reading off the slides and not teaching the class content. There was only one office hour on Tuesdays. She said lots of irrelevant personal stories. Lectures were both rushed but also dragged on. The content itself is difficult, and Watanabe doesn't help out - one of the toughest and worst accounting professors at ISU.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This professor was one of the WORST teachers I have ever had in any of my accounting classes. The class material is already difficult and she makes it even hard to understand. She rushes through her lectures, reads word for word off her slides, and just does the practices problems by herself. Her teaching is about memorizing not understanding!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Olena had some of the best organized and well-thought out note slides. She is genuinely excited to teach accounting and used real CPA exam questions as examples. Lots and lots of different practice materials - homework, smart book, exams. The course was not easy but I felt my time was well spent.

Professor Watanabe was not accessible outside class and did not express that she wanted her students to do well. Her lectures consisted of personal stories that were often inappropriate and irrelevant to class content. She frequently showed up a few minutes late and kept our class late. Her office hours were not helpful.

All you need to know:

dr. Depreciation Expense- Land
               cr. Accumulated Depreciation

Dr. Watanabe is great! ACCT 387 is a hard class, but she gives clear lectures and keeps things light with occasional funny stories. Do the assignments, study hard before exams, and ask questions in class. She's always willing to help. Tip: go to her office hours early and not right before a project is due (otherwise you'll be waiting a long time).

387 is a hard class but Dr. Watanabe did a great job teaching the content. A few days of studying is much needed for the exams but otherwise its mostly just lectures outside of weekly homework and the group memo.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Watanabe is very passionate about accounting and this is a very tough course. The exams are worth 60% of your overall grade, so i wouldn't recommend her class if you don't do well on exams. 1 HW and 1 Pre Lecture Quiz each week. Studying outside of class is a MUST. She flies through her lectures, but necessary for this level of accounting.

One of the best professors at ISU. She clearly LOVES accounting! Makes a tough class so much better. Tells you exactly what you need to know or where to look if you go to office hours for help with project and FASB assignment. Lots of writing, but her notes help a lot with exams. Don't skip class because it's hard to catch up.

The lectures are great. She doesn't allow laptops and you have to bring printouts of notes, but I feel I payed much more attention to lectures this way. Extremely helpful and very responsive over email. Practice exams and MC questions were close to actual exams. The project was lengthy but not crazy hard b/c of check figures and help lab.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had her for ACCT 386. Class was difficult in general but the examples she runs through in class help a ton with the exams. The 2 projects are fairly easy but take some time to complete.

Worst intro I could have had into acct. She taught as if hearing a new topic once was enough and that we should be able to repeat it (and any variation of it) perfectly. I'm a repetition learner and she is definitely not. Her study guides for the exams (none get dropped) were almost trying to trick us into studying material we wouldnt be tested on

The class itself is a lot harder than 386. Olena herself is a good professor, and has very good note packets and examples for you to follow. she is very accessible outside of class and wants everyone to do the best they can. Class is not curved, and average on each exam was about an 80%. Great professor, hard class.

Felt as though the class was really straight forward. Lectures were posted online to watch with homework and reading assignments for each chapter. Exams are just like the practice exams so make sure you know how to do those and you will be golden. When in doubt ask questions because Olena and the GA are very helpful and will give clear answers.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Make sure that you watch her recorded lectures. It's basically a summary of the textbook chapters. She also makes sure that things not covered in her lectures are not on the test. Also make sure to watch her exam review videos and complete the practice exams. That will help you a lot when taking the real thing.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great lecturer; handwrites on projector how to do problems. It's a content-heavy, challenging class that requires solid conceptual understanding. 3 exams on 3 chapters each; 1 cumulative final. For fall sem, 1 exam is tues after holiday break which is sad. 1 easy hw per chapter. 1 takehome pre-lecture quiz per chapter.

This professor means accounting. She is ONLY good at accounting, not good at finance. If you are true to yourself and accounting really click, then you will do fine in 386 & 387. She goes over materials like the Fast and the Furious in class so, keep up. Do extra, extra studying outside of class. She gets distracted easily and lots of stories.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is one of the best accounting professors at Iowa State. She uses notes packets to go over main points in chapters and sample problems which are extremely helpful. Do show up to class to get a better understanding of the material. She is very helpful in her office hours too and helping with problems you are having. She makes accounting fun.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Would take again

reviews.comment: While class is not mandatory, it is highly recommended that you go as she goes through the process for each type of problem better than the book does.  Written assignments are graded very harshly, but come with clear feedback to rework them and/or improve on the next assignment.

Literally the best Accounting Professor I've ever had! She is funny and is able to make Intermediate accounting enjoyable. She is the reason I want to be an accounting professor one day.  Don't worry about the readings because she explains the information in class. If you participate and answer a question every so often, you will easily pass.
