This lab was straight up MISERABLE. confused 100% of the time, though I generally do well in labs. lab was frustrating to the point where I went insane & had to pace the halls. spent 6-8 hours/wk outside of lab trying to finish the lab reports which were never explained well. practicals were spent titrating random things bc no one knew what to do

reviews.comment: This lab was terrible! The lab assignments were a lot of work and difficult to understand. The experiments were overwhelming and frustrating and I often had to stay after class to finish them. Overall, I did not enjoy this lab at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Going into Chemistry, I was worried about this professor as I looked at all the low reviews. Although, she never once made an appearance in my class and only reached out to her students when we had to switch to online learning. Throughout Chem, I only ever interacted with my TA who did a great job and tried her best to make sure we did well!

These labs are insane and sometimes they make literally no sense. It made me so anxious to go to lab because the instructions were so poor that I would often have no idea what was going on. If you don't have a TA who understands that instructions are often unclear and who genuinely wants you to succeed, you will struggle.
Shes a rude inconsiderate professor completely disconnected from her students and doesn't care about her students just her own research.

Labs are written VERY poorly and are instructions are often very unclear. Practicals are nearly impossible with no prior instruction as to how or what to prepare for. The lab does not line up at all with what goes on in lecture and has no explanation most times of how to do the required calculations. Luckily I had a great TA or I would have failed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is the worst class I have ever taken in my entire life. Every assignment that we do makes no sense, and she quizzes on the smallest details that were never even mentioned in the course. It is only a 1 credit lab, but it stresses me out more than my 4 credit classes do. Expect to be frustrated with everything you do in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Labs are very poorly written and directions can be very unclear at times. The practicals are very difficult and there is no explanation prior as to what will be on them. Labs also have nothing to do with what is written in class. I would not ever take a lab by this professor again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I don't even know my professor, I only know my TA. However I did like my TA a lot. Super nice guy although the semester is almost done and I still cant figure out how to get a 40/40 on the labs which is frustrating. Labs are slightly confusing but not as much as I thought it was going to be on these reviews. Class is ok, I dont like chem though
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Labs usually don't have any correlation with CHEM177 lecture, the lab instructions are very poorly written.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Sometimes it feels as though she's trying to make student's fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Have taken 3 labs of hers. Terrible at replying to emails. Seems to almost actively avoid meeting with students. Lab doesn't match lecture. I would take a lab coordinated by ANYONE else but unfortunately she seems to have a monopoly on undergrad chem labs. Have yet to hear any fellow students say she is a proficient lab coordinator.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The labs are written poorly, and I had trouble understanding them. The content in the labs never matches up with the lecture, and there were a few labs that weren't even related to chemistry I material. A lot of students and TA's complained about the labs because of how bad they are.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She does not help much and the Chem Labs are not related to lecture that often. The TA's that are picked for any Chem Lab course are so hard to understand the and the variance between grading between TAs is ridiculous.

good grief. has a "textbook" but its just a book she wrote.I have found it to be completely useless. She is very, very biased and teaches just her thoughts and opinions. you should probably show up to class regularly, she doesn't use canvas and will spring assignments and their details on you out of nowhere and say nothing about it.

Professor Pirro is definitely a Prof you have to get used to but once you do, she is a 10/10 professor. No exaggeration. She is extremely knowledgeable in her field. Her lectures are really interesting and I enjoyed going to them. Though be warned, Canvas is rarely used so you must go to the lectures.

I enjoyed her class and am glad that I took it. I enjoyed her lectures however your grade in the class was based on 3 exams and had 0 homework. She only hands things out on paper so be careful with skipping.

Dr. Pirro is a very good professor who has alot of experience within her field, but she seems a bit tired of teaching. Lectures were concice but did feel a bit long occasionally.

Essentially only 3 "assignments" but she offered extra credit (only available if you attended lecture.) Highly advise attending lectures, not all quiz materials in text.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I personally loved taking Pirro's courses. This class in particular was one of my favorites during my time at Iowa State. Pirro is a very personable professor and has amazing stories that she tells during lectures.  No homework, but you're graded on a couple of essays and take-home exams, but coming to lectures and taking notes is enough for an A
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor did not grade a single assignment. If you ask about your grade she wont tell you. Never used canvas or stuck to the syllabus so if you miss class you will fail. Most conversations with class mates were filled with confusion over every aspect of this class. She is extremely disrespectful towards students. Do not take her classes
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she doesn’t update grades until the literal end of the semester, not a lot of points to be earned and doesn’t or rarely respond to emails at all
Avoid this professor by any means necessary. Doesn’t grade things until the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Pirro for my only "in-person" last term. I learned really quickly that attendance, though not required, was often a grade-breaker. All material covered in class was either handed to us in person or rarely through email, expect very light utilization of canvas. Dr. Pirro is an incredibly wise professor with many stories, interesting class!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: AVOID THIS WOMAN AT ALL COSTS. I literally could not say enough bad things about how she conducts her classes and how nerve-wracking she is to have as a professor. The bare minimum black and white powerpoints, she never responds to emails, never has graded assignments until midterm and final. DONT TAKE A CLASS FROM HER IF YOU CAN AVOID IT

Dr Pirro is a character. After I missed the end of one class, and then the whole next class due to sickness I went up to her to ask if I had missed anything important because I wasn't there. After she rolled her eyes at me, she continued to explain that I had missed an assignment that was never put on canvas, or emailed out.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I am also including Cpt Curtis, who co-taught the class. Dr. Pirro's slides were sparse compared to Curtis's, so luckily he covered most of the lectures. This is not your typical POL S course, the whole thing leads up to the 10 page paper at the end of the semester. If you don't get it done very early (and get feedback), you will not do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very disrespectful and rude. You wouldn't know your grades until the grades are officially posted in accessplus. You literally won't have any idea if you are geting an A or an F. I won't recommend her.
I hate this lady lol she's horrible

Shes quite literally a piece of work. Told my class we couldnt get up in the middle of class to throw away gum or go anywhere because if Beyoncé was here you wouldnt lol idk about you but im gonna go pee whether I like the person or no. She is an EXTREMELY rude person. I cant stand her or her class. Run away from this woman.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is pure lecture and note taking. On the bright side Dr. Pirro has very valuable international experience, and her stories/ lecture are incredibly interesting. I loved going to class! There is no homework. The students have a say on the exam format, which is cool! Spent over 11 hours on the midterm paper, so get ready! Enjoy!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Grade is based on attendance the midterm, a class project, and final. The class itself is lecture based, but the content was really interesting and I rarely found myself falling asleep despite it being a 9 am class. Not monotone, encourages class participation (which gives you bonus points), and she can seem intimidating, but she's v approachable.

Read everything. Answer questions in class ever now and then. Don't skip class, she'll notice. Other than that read everything. Class was tough I thought I deserved higher, but such is life. Class format was two take home tests and a big group project. Very intelligent woman, just don't get on her bad side.
Best there is

Dr Pirro, while knowledgeable, was incredibly boring. She brings no real passion to her lectures, which are all black and white power points with vague bullet points, making you write as fast as she talks. She's undoubtedly intelligent, I just don't think she cares to be there.

Super easy and interesting, until midterm hits and you find yourself writing a 7 page paper and then a 15 pager on finals with only a few days to do them.  Plan on an all nighter to finish them.  But she tells you exactly what you need for an A, so its kind of a trade off.  Definitely recommend.

She has first hand experiences in many of the countries we talked about in the Combating Terrorism class. She is very knowledgeable and expects discussion in this class. Test and Project are very involved with her opinion, but if you send it to her before hand to look it over, you will do well. Don't get too attached to the syllabus.

Lectures full of anecdotes. Allows students to have a say in the format of their midterm & final, which were always take-home, but certainly required substantial effort to score well. Keeping up with international news was way more important than keeping up with the textbook. Extremely knowledgeable, or at the very least, exudes an image of wisdom.
Tests were open note and very easy if you went to class because you must reference lecture/powerpoints.

You MUST attend class and make sure you take the dates on the notes for citing on the essay tests, but if your class votes to have essay tests, they are the easiest things! You are able to use your book (highly suggested) and every scrap of note you take. Make sure you take more notes than she puts up. You need more detail for the test for an A.

Not overly polite and moderately strict at first, but you grow to respect her because of her knowledge and teaching skills.  We had take home tests and a project, which were moderately difficult.  The book wasn't used much.  Mandatory attendance.  Overall one of my favorite professors due to her knowledge and how unbiased she is!
Her lectures are very interesting to listen to. I agree with the previous comments that say that she is a very intelligent individual. Overall I have learned a lot from this class and professor.
Best teacher I had at Iowa State.  This woman is a genius, and there is much to learn from her.  Pay close attention and visit her during her office hours.

Dr. Pirro is a brilliant professor but also very strict. Strong encourages/requires knowledge of current events each class, which was a benefit to my personal everyday life. No cell phones or pee breaks allowed- you'll be kicked out if either occur. Not incredibly demanding, but three papers are required and a lot of work through out the semester.

Dr. Pirro is one of the most knowledgeable and helpful teachers I have ever had.  The lectures are very interesting, easy to listen to, and easy to understand.  Her tests are take home essays directly from her lectures, if you attend class and take active notes, you'll be fine.

One of the 4 best professors I had at ISU (and maybe the single best).  Will let you develop a thesis (without regard to "right" or "wrong") to watch you draw your own conclusion.  You will be judged on the strength of your argument, not your conclusion.

If you want to be treated as if you're in grade school, then you may like her. Her tests are adventures in filling space with answers which could be simplified and shortened, also the tests questions are far too involved. Her lectures are worthless apart from attendance points.

She is very cynical, but one of the most knowledgeable professors on campus.  If you listen to her during lecture and take very detailed notes as well as keep up with current events, you will do well.  She expects a lot and if you are irresponsible you will not do well and she will make an example out of you.  Even still, one of my favorites.

I hated Pirro to begin with: hated her with a fiery passion for her rudeness and insensitivity. I grew to respect her, though, because she is an extremely gifted educator who demands the best out of her students. Tests are usually take home essays; attendance and detailed note taking mandatory. Do NOT call her "Mrs."; will eviscerate you for it.

BAD DEAL. Take this class at your own risk--if you like rudeness and ridicule, it's for you. Knowledgeable and astute, Pirro knows her subject very well. She also could care less about being polite or kind. The best you will get is a neutral contempt. Tests can range from easy to impossible, attendance mandatory.

Knowledgable about International Relations, but horrible at teaching.  Tests were long take-home papers, and she did not give any explanation for her grading (which was very critical).  Avoid her if you can help it.

She's a very old-fashioned teacher; she likes everything just perfect, and lets you know it. Other than that, she is actually a good teacher. She talks about interesting topics, and is pretty straight-forward about what she wants you to do.
I love the way she teaches

Tough class. Grade depended on 3-4 papers (take home tests). You must take good notes (so definitely go to class). For her take home tests just write down what was in your notes and you should get a decent grade. The topics we discussed were interesting. The thing I didn't like was we had no clue what our grade was before the class drop date.

Pirro is very interesting to listen to. She also thinks very highly of herself. In my class she marked at kid down 10 percent on a paper cause he had a typo in her name. Her tests are take home and are challenging but it is pretty easy to get a high score on them as long as you follow the directions and use her quotes from lecture.

Perhaps the most challenging professor I have had so far. She makes her class interesting, and she is very picky with papers and tests. Participation is very important for her, and if you sleep over an important class and miss a paper date for that (my fault) be ready to give her a good excuse or lose points. A+ professor in my opinion!!
Must pick up papers when returned or loss of points. Once heard her tell a girl (who couldn't pick up her paper due to a family funeral) that she shouldn't take care of family business during class.

She tries to be intimidating, but actually isn't at all.  Her lectures are interesting and I found it easy to pay attention.  There are a lot of notes, and it is necessary to take as much as you can because she gives take home exams which are essays that literally come straight from lecture.  If you go to class & take good notes, you'll get an A

Attendance is needed as the tests are based mostly off of lecture.  Lectures are hard to follow, and a laptop is helpful to type up everything that is said.  The hardest part of the class is meeting the page restrictions on tests and papers.

Go to every single class. Bring a laptop to catch everything she says. If you really sit down and work on your take home paper exams, you will be just fine. However, I have no idea what my class particip. grade is, and while I know my grades on my exams, I have no idea what that will amount to for a final grade. She thinks herself quite important.
She doesnt make any sense and really doesnt actlike she cares about what she is teaching very mono tone all the time

She comes across as really tough, but she's great when it comes to take home tests and grading.  YES SHE DOES ASK ABOUT THE NEWS!  The best way to make her happy==sit front and center and show up every day!
If you are interested in the subject and willing to work hard, she's a great professor.
I really enjoyed her class and got a lot out of it.  It's rare to miss a class but she always has something interesting to share.
Her lectures are very long, but she knows her stuff. She is a little cocky, but has insteresting stores. Not too hard to get a decent grade in her class.

If you get to know her, she will do anything to help you out. We had to write these papers that were worth a big chunk of our grade. I missed a few sections, and she e-mailed me to tell me how I could make up the points. She is a boring speaker, but as long as you go to lectures and take good notes, you will do fine in the class.

This is the most boring person to ever graze the planet.  There has not been one class that I haven't fallen asleep (along with most of the class).  She also like to tell students to do a lot of each work (read news magazines, listen to the BBC, daily newspapers) but they never come up in class or on exams.  Seems like an easy grader though.
She knows what shes talking about and the essay test make and open book makes it an easy class, I never opened the books yet and im doing awesome
She is a long winded, somewhat boring speaker, but she knows her stuff, and she gives open book tests.

The grading system for this class is very strange.  If you get 89% of your home work questions right you still end up with only around 60% of the homework points.  Don't bother with review sessions either as nothing in them is on the tests.  Tests run every 2 weeks and make up the bulk of your grade.  Passionate about Biology but ineffective prof.

The worst professor I had in college. Her class was the only class I ever dropped. Lectures are messy and unfocused. She uses phylogeny that is 20-30 years out of date (This was stated by another professor).  Not helpful at all during office hours.  Drop out if you still have time.

She is not clear ever. Obviously intelligent but all over the map. Exam every 2 weeks made up of random questions. Even when you think you've got it down you barely pass. Textbook and mastering biology are seemingly pointless and never pertain to the exams. Did not feel like a 100 level course with her. Sometimes rude to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I'm a junior so typically 100-level classes are a breeze anymore. This class, though, is anything but easy. The instructor moves too fast and doesn't cover test material effectively. She explains topics in their simplest form yet uses complicated terminology on the exams. The Blackboard page is a jumbled mess. Avoid this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The lectures are long and disorganized. It's clear she's very intelligent and passionate about chordates but I think she tends to forget basic learning styles. There's no slides to review, good references besides the book and her badly printed out notes. It's an interesting class but prepare to study and memorize! All exams are short answer.
She rambles and is very unclear. Never keeps a thought for more that a moment. EXTREMELY confusing.

Need to keep up in lab as lab is 1/2 your grade, but it's the most interesting part! She posts essay ?s a week or so prior to exam. Get a good group for lab&lecture going (I took lots of pictures). Pleasants was very nice covers more material in lecture than needed for exam so you have to weed through. Responds to emails/?s quickly.

This is one of the hardest 100 level classes that I've taken. Partly because she flew through the information way too quickly, and partly because the study guides for the tests were useless.  I was falling behind a little because I didn't go to class at first, but she met with me during her office hours and was actually very helpful.

She was the most ineffective teacher ever. This was actually the hardest 100 level class I ever took. She was barely any help during office hours and the tests were way too hard. I learned absolutely nothing.

She knows what she is talking about but the exams are really hard.  You never really know what are going to be on the exams.  There is an exam every other week.  She is very generous though.  She takes attendance points so you have to show up to class.

She seems scattered when teaching.... often goes over things that will be on the test quickly then spends more time on things that didn't show up. She does not offer extra credit but an optional final that can replace 2 bad test scores. (Her mastering biology quizzes and attendance also helps boost grades)

She takes attendance but half the time sends an email saying attendance wouldn't upload for that day. Her class is boring. Way too difficult for a 155 level course. Tests are short but have an enormous weight. Overall I'd say avoid her class.

I would love to have her as my grandma. She is funny, spunky, and caring. The exams are all essay questions chosen from the list she gives you as a study guide. Her lectures are hard to follow so to do well on the exams GO TALK TO HER OUTSIDE OF CLASS! She will help you with every question you are stuck on and tell you exactly what you need to know
In one word, terrible

Get graded on attendence. All tests are online and 25 questions long, pretty difficult. Are able to get 24 easy extra credit points, you'll need them! She is extremely boring! Need to read the textbook to get a good grade, but she drifts away from the textbook when discussing evolution. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS if you care about your GPA.
This course is not recommended. I didn't even learn anything and it was so boring. Textbook are rarely use. The professor teaching there like a robot. I really have no interest in this course.
I got an A but I really hate biology 155. I do not want to learn biology any more. If you take biol 155, then you need to change.
I hate this class.She is by far the worst teacher i have ever had....
Very easy class.  gets a bit repetitive but is worth taking.
Difficult class, very boring as well.

I was scared to take this class after reading some of the other comments mentioned here. However, it's not as bad as its cracked up to be. I personally didn't use the note packet-just read the book and took notes. The hardest part is that the course covers A LOT of material and she tends to go through it very fast. Always answers questions.

This class was way hard for an entry level Bio class. Her tests are irrelevant to things in the notes, not to mention you have to memorize mass amounts of stuff for a 25 question (and point) quiz. She was not on the students side at all. If you are up for a real challenge with a professor who doesn't understand, go ahead and take this class.

Welcome to the world's hardest 100 level class you will ever take when she is teaching.  Talks a lot for not saying much.  Practice quizzes do not help, more misdirecting than anything.  Read the book, her note packet is garbage.  Worst teacher I have ever had, avoid her at all costs.

If it wasnt for the stupid clicker being used, I would not show up to her class ever, you would be better off taking the online section, because the only way youre going to learn anything is from reading the book anyway...I dont know anyone who did well in this class, maybe if the teacher wasnt horrible it would help

This is one of the hardest classes I've ever taken. I've never learned more in my life. I thought Dr. Pleasants did an amazing job with a difficult subject. Form a study group early on and just keep plugging through. USE THE LAB CD!!!!!!

Oh Barb and her jewish accent cracked me up. She does a pretty good job of explaining everything. She really wants everyone to understand and will take extra time in class to go over a tough concept. Very willing to help. I thought the class was super easy because every test question came directly from the notes, but I know some people struggled.

I liked her a lot. She is really helpful even though class itself is prett hard for  the GenEd level. Tests are pretty hard, but there are lots of extra credits opportunities. She's pretty nice outside of class.
I liked her
I thought this class was extremly hard! I ended up with a D, which I was releaved to pass. The test are difficult, her lectures are boring, and I dont know anyone that did well in the class.
The tests in this class are extremly hard for the level of the class. If you have to take this class my only suggestion would be to definatly do the study questions in the book.
she sucks
i disagree with everyone who said they like this class, it is terrible, everyone does very bad on her tests also

Dr. Pleasants is a good teacher. You don't really have to read the book, or even pay that much attention in this class. The exams are short and fairly easy, and she primes you with in-class quizzes every day (some of which reappear directly on the quizzes). She's fairly accomodating, and genuinely seems to want to help struggling students.
This is an awesome class, and I recommend it completely!  Barbara is an awesome prof, and makes this class one of the best I have taken at ISU.  She rocks!

She is very knowledgable.  She teaches very well.  She likes to make sure everyone understands, and is very helpful if you ask.  Beware if you take this class, there seems to be a lot of freshman who don't know how to go to class and stop talking.  But this is not a professors problem, this is maturity of student problem!
She's pretty cool. Plus, the class is way easy if you half-listen to the lectures. Some of the kids in there are just idiots.
Gross.
Pretty good class.  She definitely knows her stuff and is overall a fun/good teacher to have.
lots of exta credit
Nice teacher, knows her stuff. Tests are a little hard but if you do the other assignments and extra credit it should make up for any low test scores easily.
Barb is an excellent teacher...she knows her stuff.  Don't take Zoo 320 if you are looking for an easy class.  There is lots to know...but she makes it as easy as possible.

Barb rocks! She is the best prof I've had in a long time! Her Zool 320 class was awesome as well! Just because the material is hard doesn't make the professor bad. Freshman in Bio 109, suck it up.  She's a great teacher. You just suck at college.

This class is horrible, if you can transfer to Heck's section.  Barbara Pleasants is the worst professor I've ever had.  She uses her husbands tests, so there is no guarentee that it will be over the material covered in class. Get out while you still can.

This prof. is by far the worst teacher ever.  How she got a degree I will never understand.  She is Dry, Boring, and Worthless.  She  made my Tuesday and Thursdays the worst days ever!  Her tests cover nothing we learn.  I hate Bio!
I thought this class was easy.  I never went and only skimmed the readings and got a B. Could have easily gotten an A. Lectures were kinda boring (hence not going) but Biology is pretty cool and fun.

This is by far the worst class I've taken in college thus far. Horrible, vague overheads and explanations, tests are dreadful to study for, unclear lecture voice - basically, just all around bad. I wanted to drop this class but I couldn't. Too bad.
HORRIBLE

Had no interest in teaching and assumed no one cared what she had to say--made powerpoint slides and zipped through them before you had a chance to figure them out (was good about posting them online, though).  She was wacky and let class out early every day. Tried to help people a lot, but not good at it--my tutor taught me everything.

Makes the class fun!  She is really enthusiastic, and willing to take as much or as little time to teach the material as the class needs.  Great at finding happy medium, and likes to play games in lecture.  Often lets out of class early or cancels class if we are ahead of schedule!

Dr. Polich is a great professor, but be prepared for mandatory attendance and somewhat chaotic lectures. I think she gets excited about what she is talking about at times, as others have mentioned, she paces the room, which can be distracting. I advise reading the slides and taking some light notes before class. She does care about her students.
Very critical on small details and can not teach to save her life.

vertabrate physiology at UMSL. She RAPIDLY (frantically?) paces around a lecture hall and speaks softly so it's impossible to hear half the lecture, no matter where you're sitting. Announced ( in first lecture) that she would be MUCH WORSE about pacing during exams. if you have even a sprinkle of ADHD, avoid this prof. at all costs.

This professor was unprepared and used her first classes at umsl almost as an experiment. BEWARE if possible. Her lectures are hard to hear and boring, and she does not make learning fun. Labs are way better!

Young professor, so she has a lot of room to grow. Very fixated on in class participation and discussion with group work. Lecture covers most everything on exams. She goes over any kind of equation solving work extensively. If she refines her style a bit, I would enjoy the class more. All the group discussion and feedback leads to awkward silences.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: BIO101 with this professor is no easy feat. Lectures are dense, exams are challenging, and you'll need to go beyond the slides to succeed. However, using tools like unstuck ai alongside the textbook can really help with study prep.

The wrost professor I've had in my life. Refused to round my grade even thought I was 0.02% from the cutoff. He focuses on little things and refuses to meet with you if you need help. After 5 emails, he finally met with me and told me to just try harder - I was putting in 15 hours of studying a week. NEVER TAKE HIM - you have been warned.
All this class was was NOTES ON NOTES ON NOTES, and guess what 8 EXAMS FOR BIO 101 is absolutely ABSURD. SOME BS. It was the most challenging class I have ever taken at ISU. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

Never, EVER, under any circumstances, take Bio 173 online. It is horrific. This man puts out 6-8 of lecture videos per unit, throws out one Packback every two weeks, sends a link to a $144 textbook that's not provided by the school, and says "Good luck." Questions on the tests are so random and impossible to remember. NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was easy and lectures were fine. Make sure you study before exams.

Avoid this class at all costs. Yes, it's a 101 class and yes it's a half-semester class. Sounds easy right? Not even close. Be ready for 6 to 8 hours of lectures to watch each week, 4 self quizzes to take each week, and exams that are worth 72% of your grade (lowest test score is dropped). As a senior, I've NEVER had to work so hard for an A. AVOID

Class was expected to be an easy 3 credits, but it was not such. Learning all of the slides content will, at best, get you a 75% on the exams. Added a strong curve this semester, which helps. Quizzes help very little, only good for cushion points. Exams are random, cost a majority of your grade, and some questions feel like they come out of nowhere

I am usually an A/B student, and I took this class online because I needed a science credit and thought it would be easy, but it was the opposite. There are around 8 hours of lecture videos every week. The exams are more than 80% of your grade. The quizzes you take before the exam are no help and there are no study guides as exams are just random.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm an engineering student and somehow this was one of the most difficult classes I have taken. There's 8 exams and each exam contains 15+ pages of notes of content. Exams are random and I'm pretty sure there's stuff on the exams we never covered in lecture. Everything else is easy but too bad because exams are the only thing that matters.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures are long and uninteresting, they are difficult to pay attention to which makes taking exams difficult. All of the assignments are busy work and you don't get anything out of them. I'm not entirely convinced that he grades anything and only sees whether or not you completed it.

He was a good professor for online bio. I could have used a bit more involvement from him but I think he would have answered any questions I had if I reached out. I liked the ability to pace myself and it was an easygoing course with good lectures and not too overwhelming

Took BIO101 with Pleasants to finish my prereqs for a major change. Jeez, Louise, man, his questions are just from left field sometimes, and I feel like studying the PowerPoint will objectively land you at a C, leaving it up to you to figure out the rest. There is no learning objs and no heads-up on exam content. If you can take anyone else, do so.
Would email about concerns and had no grace whatsoever with assignments, even if emailed in advance.

I took online BIO101 because I needed the credits and just wanted an easy course. Literally terrible. His exams have nothing to do with quizzes, homework, or his notes. He asks questions that are SO CONFUSING for an introductory course. I am an A/B student and have done terribly in his ONLINE class. Do not take it with him.

DO NOT TAKE ANY BIO CLASSES WITH DR. PLEASANTS. HIS CLASS IS NOT PLEASANT. I took this class for credit last semester and his quizzes are insanely hard and almost impossible to get a decent score on. Lectures are hours long per week and he does not ask questions directly related to the modules but says he wants you to study each section by yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Genuinely the hardest class I've taken. My pre-med, biochemistry major, roommate would look at the questions given and wouldn't be able to answer it. The tests are at the biol 313 level, there is absolutely no reason for this class to contain the in-depth material it does. Lectures just make everything more confusing so literally no reason to watch

Took 101 and 211, both online. Both are same format, 8 modules, each with an exam, self quizzes for participation, occasionally HW and 5-8 20-30 min lectures. If you watch the lectures(often on x2 speed) and glance over the study guide for the exams the class is an easy A. Watch the lectures and do the self quizzes and you will do fine.

4-7 hours worth of lecture videos to watch with tests every two weeks that are worth 80% of your grade. I did not buy the book or lecture packet, just watched the videos. He is kind of rude and would recommend some bio background before taking.

Do NOT take any class with him. Most of his lectures are at least 10 years old (mentioned the Bush administration in the present tense???). Provides zero learning objectives and tests you on any random detail he mentions in the lectures. The exams make up nearly all of the grades and you aren't given any indication what might be on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is by far the worst class I have taken at Iowa State. Be ready for 30-minute lecture videos (Usually around 8 per unit), no objectives for you to know what to take away from his lessons, and extremely hard exams. There is no excitement in his lectures either, so be ready to sit there and be bored to death. Notes packet doesn't help either.

For sure a 0/10. He casually assigns 3-7 hours of lectures per week. Hardly any homework because exams are worth 80% of the grade. Terrible. If you can get into any other section of BIO101 do it, because it can't get any worse.
So rude in his emails, not helpful at all, due dates always were changing for test terrible class

This class was literally the death of me. I did about 7 hours of lecture a week. There are exams every two weeks & no matter how hard I studied, most times 10 hours per test, I only got one A of the 8 tests & I actually failed 4 exams. You can make up points for homework, but just take my advice and do not take this class or any other class w/ him.

I took the 5 week version of this class during winter break. There were 8 units so I had to cover 2 units a week, which was real hard. It was entirely lecture-based with only a few hw assignments and a book that I never used. The lectures were recorded in, like, 2014, and he never talked to us, so I really didn't feel like he cared about the class.

His lectures are long, exam notes unorganized and cumbersome, tests unpredictable and solely based on luck. You can work your butt off and still get just above average (which is very low). Unhelpful with questions and concerns. Do not take this professor if you can help it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT take this class. Tests are 80% of the grade. The tests are incredibly hard, he does not post study guides, and the lectures do NOT give an idea of what will be on the tests. He asks incredibly specific questions and doesn't ask key topic questions. This is one of the hardest classes I've ever taken.

This was one of the hardest classes I've taken and was the first C I have ever gotten in my life. I took the half semester online class, and there was a large workload. There is a test every single week that has to be taken in the testing center and there is so much information for each test (5-10 modules, each 30 minutes long). Would not reccomend

I took his half semester online class (8 weeks). There was a test and a short homework assignment each week. To do well in this class I had to watch the online lectures (4-6 hours/module), do the self-quizzes (1 point each for completing), homework and review the exam guide for that module. It was a full semester worth of work in 8 weeks.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't take his class online! The class is very difficult with exams every 2 weeks and lots of homework that is worth almost nothing in the grade book. Exams are worth 70% of your overall grade and exams are 20 questions worth 4 points each. Take the in-class version!
Do your self a favor and do not take BIO 101 with Pleasants. Honestly don't take any classes with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: The information from the class was not difficult, but the way that the professor taught the class made this course an absolute nightmare for me. The tests were extremely difficult because he would not test on key subjects, but rather cherry-pick very specific information off his slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: f this class. do NOT take bio 101 online with pleasants. tests are impossible and theres no extra credit.
I HATE THIS PROFESSOR. NEVER TAKE BIO 101 WITH HIM. Worst decision I have ever made was to take his course. TERRIBLE teacher.

DO NOT TAKE HIS COURSES. He is a terrible teacher. I am literally failing his course. There are WAY better bio teachers than him. He is so old so he just does not care anymore. Hardest class I have taken at ISU so far.

I took this class because it was basically my only option to achieve full credits at the last minute. It was the hardest class I have taken. Do not think that it will be an easy A. The grading scale is nice but it is extremely difficult.

Since Environmental Biology was an online class, you should be an independently motivated student to do well, but it's really not hard to get an A. He provides audio of online lectures that go along with lecture outlines that he provides. Just keep up with the lectures and jot extra notes on the outline. Don't forget the occasional assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Test's are kind of a shot in the dark. Never really know what to expect. Lots of lectures.
Lectures were long, and it was difficult to study for tests. It was unclear what information was going to be on the tests, and no study guides were available.
Honestly there are a lot of reviews saying this was difficult and it wasn't. You literally just need to watch the lectures and you're golden.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I study pretty hard for the WEEKLY exams for this class, but still find myself not passing them. This class is very difficult and incredibly fast-paced. If you are unable to handle a LOT of information in a VERY LITTLE amount of time, do NOT take this class.

I put in a reasonable level of effort for this class. I watched all of the lectures, took my own notes, and reviewed before taking any tests. The tests are very unpredictable and unreasonably wide in scope. You will have to make connections between concepts that are not evident in the material. Tests are a complete shot in the dark. Good luck.
Class is half semester and you better be on top. Idk how he does the test but they are hard. Make sure you have time if you wanna take this class
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: First weeks are easy. Then it kicks and theres a test every week, the final test had two hours of lecture that I wrote out 8 pages of notes. His study guides are bullet points, and for test 7 it was 22 pages long undetailed in bullets, this is my 2nd time and I have failed both times. He held one review session and covered 50% of the chapter. AVOID

Ok the only reason I took this class is because I needed a class to get up to 13 credits cause I dropped a class half way through the semester and it's the worst thing I've ever done. He's a good professor don't get me wrong his lectures are interesting most of the time but his tests are extremely difficult even if you go in prepared to take it.

It's a shame the tests are such shots in the dark because I really like Pleasants and his lecture style. I felt like I learned a lot and actually enjoyed listening to the lectures and felt prepared going into about every single one of the 8 exams and the final.. hardly ever to even manage a B. Learned a lot, but probably shouldn't have taken online

This class was a nightmare. If you suck at biology or anything science related like I do, I would recommend you taking the in class section instead of the online section. He didn't make time to meet with you and when you contact him for help he basically just said figure it out. The tests are extremely difficult and that's what most of the grade is
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Unless you have extensive bio background, do NOT take the online section with Pleasants. The lectures are honestly good and he makes them fairly interesting but the 8 exams which are worth about 85% of the grade are extremely tough and unpredictable. I have a 3.7 in ChemE so I consider myself a decent student.. but this class will have you guessing
Regret taking this class. The lectures are very very boring and tests are hardly ever over what you've learned.

I took Bio 211 online and it was difficult because I did not put in time. ONLY TAKE IT ONLINE IF YOU DON'T PROCRASTINATE! His test are based on the lectures, but if you do not listen to all the lectures you will not do well. Take time to actually listen to all the lectures throughout the week before the test. Test are usually given every 2 weeks.

I took this as a filler class and I regret taking it. The online lectures can be really long and you have to listen to them otherwise you will fail the tests. Even though I did listen to the lectures and did the self-quizzes, I didn't do very well on the tests. He gives an optional final and replaced the two lowest tests with the final.

BIO 101 XV is a lot of work because it's 3 credits in 8 weeks, instead of 16. It started after midterms and went until finals. You have to stay on top of the lectures if you want to do well. They're pretty boring, though. Only take this class if you absolutely have to. Buy the lecture notes but DO NOT BUY THE BOOK. I never opened it.

DO NOT TAKE AN ONLINE SCIENCE COURSE WITH HIM. This was a huge mistake, I took it thinking it was an A+ but i ended with a C+, it was hard, lectures are long and dull. Do not even think of taking a class with him, hard tests. I am a Bio major and it was harder than 212 for me.

Took the half semester online Bio 101. It was super easy. Yeah his lectures are a little dull but he explains things well.  There are ungraded quizzes on the course website and the tests are almost word for word the same questions. Homeworks take you 15 minutes if you don't get distracted. I never used the textbook.

It is absolutely ridiculous that a class taken by most for a required science fulfillment is this hard. If you don't know anything about science you will get a bad grade. The tests, over 2 weeks of material are 20 questions and cannot be taken more than once. He's not a bad teacher, he just expects too much from a captive audience.
He didn't allow extra credit, or retakes. When I asked to meet in his office, he took a while to reply, then rejected my attempt to receive help.

You are expected to watch literally hours of boring, white background lectures every week and then are tested over very insignificant details. Knowing the "big ideas" will do you little good, he likes to test on small stuff.

THIS GUY NEVER SHUTS UP ABOUT ANYTHING AND THEN MAKES THE TEST BASED ON HOURS OF WHAT HE SAYS. I am a dietetics major and have taken ocher, biochem, and the likes and let me tell you THIS FREAKING CLASS took the most time of any. I got an A in Ochem and a C in this class. Put that in perspective. DONT TAKE IT ONLINE IF YOU LIKE YOUR GPA

HARDEST CLASS OF MY WHOLE ENTIRE LIFE. HE DOES NOT CARE ABOUT YOU OR YOUR GRADE AND EVEN WHEN YOU ASK FOR HELP HE WONT HELP YOU. I HATED THIS CLASS AND BARELY PASSED. I DO NOT RECOMMEND TALKING IT ONLINE OR FOR HALF A SEMESTER. HORRIBLE CLASS.

I took the online half semester course- DON'T DO IT. You have 5-8 hours of lectures every week and a test every week. If you don't study, you will fail. Even if you do study sometimes you still get a C. His tests are worded so poorly that even if you know the material, you won't get the correct answer.

Smoked the quizzes (had option to take numerous times) and homework (one attempt only). The exams are not like the quizzes. You MUST understand how biology WORKS/FUNCTIONS in order to do well on the exams. Few quiz questions on exams. DO the optional final at the end to boost your grade. Asked for help; didn't get any. I taught myself the material.
Very in-depth class. Tests tend to be focused around a relatively inconsequential part of the lectures. Would NOT recommend taking online!
tests were way to hard for  100 level classand very boring to listen to
Completely useless when you try to ask questions. The tests are extremely hard because they are based on one bullet out of hours and hours of powerpoints.

I took the online class...its pretty simple.  Everyone talked about how difficult it was but I didn't find this to be the case.  As long as you study off of the lecture slides and complete the 1 point quizzes you will get a good grade.

Online lectures are NOT fun to listen to but if you can retain information for a small amount of time the tests are very easy and straight forward. Not a bad class, with a little effort it would be an easy A.

NEVER TAKE an online science class unless you love science.  The class sounded easy from the beginning, but I was lucky to get a C+.  I also went and talked to him, and basically said you better figure it out.
You will learn a lot from his class I highly recommend anyone to take his class. His class is the best online class at ISU.

I had him for bio 101 and 211. I don't know why people are complaining. The tests were straight from the lectures, and the class is really easy. If you have a decent short term memory it's an easy A. My cumulative is a 3.0...not spectacular by any means. But I got an A in both his classes.

I would not recommend this class if you're looking for an easy 101 course. I maintain a 3.48 GPA and yet am not doing well here. When I e-mailed for help, he didn't tell me anything I didn't already know. He says his tests only cover what was talked about in class, but questions are too detailed. This class goes too in-depth for a 101 class.

Exams are incredibly hard. I have an excellent GPA but am doing very badly in this class. It is very frustrating. I asked him for help and he just told me to study more. He seems to know the material well but is not interested in actually teaching. I would love to know the average grade in my class, I bet my ~70% is one of the top grades :(

Not helpful at all during his office hours, very boring, do not take this class ONLINE, tests are crazy hard he says he isn't detailed but all his questions are VERY DETAILED, Study the notes, Do not get the book it won't help

Online class so you can work when you want, but do not fall behind.  I have asked questions online and the answers are useless.  He treats you like an interruption rather than a student.  The class was useful but boring.  You do not need the book study the notes.

I've taken both 101/173 online, same format and loved it. Lectures can be boring but I liked the material even though the classes were an elective for me. Tests do cover some random material but aren't too hard, homework is easy plus some E.C. at end, put in a little effort and you'll be fine. Don't buy book though, only need the lecture notes.

I never used a book for this online class, and the lectures were fairly interesting considering I took this class as an elective.  Most everything was great, except he was a little short in his e-mails.  I liked that I could listen to lectures any time I wanted to, though. Pretty easy material but tests were a little harder.

Biol 101.  (online) Do not need the textbook, just get the course notes.  REALLY, boring online lectures.  Easy to fall asleep to.  Lectures contain large amounts of non- exam relevant material.  Not as easy as it may sound.

I took 2 online biology courses with Dr Pleasants and they were the HARDEST courses in my entire undergrad studies BUT I probably learned more from his courses than many of my other classes.  He is tough, but you will learn some great stuff about biology.

I took Biology 173 online and learned a lot of interesting things I didn't know before! Dr. Pleasants was always there to answer questions whenever possible, even if he couldn't answer them right away he still got to it before a test!

If you have to take this class, DON'T take it online. He knows what he's talking about but the lectures are so boring that it's hard to get through all of them-great examples though. The tests were unfairly hard--they were very specific while the lectures were pretty broad...and there are only 40 points possible with each question worth two points!

I do not reccomend this class AT ALL. He is not helpful at all. Doesn't feel the need to help students who aren't that great at biology. The lectures are soo monotone, and the tests have NOTHING to do with the lectures.

DO NOT TAKE THIS ONLINE!! Everyweek we watch 5-10power point lectures which are extremely boring and monotone(around 15-30 minutes a piece) and read suggested material. When you go in to take the weekly tests, they are EXTREMELY hard with ANYTHING and EVERYTHING you covered in the lectures on them. DO NOT TAKE IT ONLINE!

I took Bio 101, 173, and 155 online from him and it was easy. I'm reading these comments from people talking about how he's awful and I don't know what theyre talking about. The class was way easy you just have to actually study. I thought he was really helpful and nice.
He's helpful and lenient
I took 2 biology courses online with PROF Pleasants.  All I can say is that they take their biology seriously in Iowa.  Hard course but if you put the time into it, you learn a lot.
Interesting lectures with good examples especially later in the course.  Easy to listen to voice once you get used to it.  I took this course online.
Makes lectures interesting and easy to understand voice

I took this class online and it was terrible. His voice is so monotone and each lecture is about thirty minutes. For one test you listen to about ten lectures. Wouldn't recommend it at all, plus the tests are much more detailed than the lectures.
Evolution- This is the worlds most boring teacher. His lectures are monotone but his tests are okay. I had to use my book - couldntstay awake for class.
VERY boring...I've taken his online class and unless you can sit and listen to a monotone lecture for 30 min. on average, AND you have an amazing memory, I recommend finding another professor!

I took the online version, shoulda had an A but ended up with A- cuz the quizzes are kinda hard. They ask very detailed questions for a general bio course.  lectures are super boring but watch 'em all for the quizzes, don't need book

This is the worst professor ever.  It seems he enjoys seeing how hard he can make the tests.  I have a 3.9gpa and took this class and struggled through it like crazy only to get a B-.  He asks little facts, and expects you to know details about stuff he never covered in lecture.  DONT TAKE!!!!!!!!!!
I took this class online and it was very difficult. Notes were hard to follow and confusing

ok, this is an easy A class... i slept through the lectures, and made sure to memorize the numbers that we got in class... also, it's important to go to every lecture in case there's a movie.. there is actually a bit of info on the tests from the movies... good class, although i didn't learn a lot

The lectures are incredibly boring!  If you take the class, don't buy the book- you really dont need it!  He gives you no idea what you need to study.  Everything on the tests is pretty much in the lectures, but there is so much material that it is impossible to know everything.  I hated this class!
Mean

Incredibly boring to listen to. The lectures will easily put you to sleep. The book is practically worthless. I didn't use it at all during the semester. Most of the information needed for the tests is in the lectures. Boring but easy, with a teacher who can't communicate very well.

The class is really easy but just a little long. He tends to get pretty monotone. The printed notes are really nice. If you go to class and half-way pay attention and just review your notes before the online tests you won't have a problem getting an A. He also offers ex credit for going to lectures.

Boring class, but interesting topics covered. His tests are very hard,lots of short answer. He does not tell you what to study. The good thing is is that he gives you printed notes so you don't have to take any in class.

This class was soooo boring!  It's hard to sit and listen to hours and hours of Bio lecture on your computer.  He doesn't tell you what to study or anything.  You have to be very disciplined to take this class...If you want an easy A, find something else!
I took this online, and it was a big mistake.  The tests are frequent (9 per semester), short tests, but hard!  Find a different science to fill your requirement, or atleast don't take it online
Easy class, pretty boring, but easy
This class is really hard to take online.  Even if it is an easy-level Bio class, it was difficult.
Boring but easy, not a bad teacher, it's an easy class though
Very difficult course, not a very good instructor or personable human being, robot like in nature.

Do not take biology online unless you are extremely well-disciplined. Study everything for his tests:notes for lectures, the slides, the recommended reading, the practice tests, and the practice quizes. You will fail if you don't try hard.

Do NOT take it online unless you're a bio whiz. Unfair grading system, everyone did bad, hence a problem with the teacher, yet he didn't curve it for his teaching inabilities. Impossible to sit there and listen to those lectures, very monotonous.
He teaches a boring subject and the online course gets old but he knows what he teaches.
If you're not a very motivated person, do not take the online class. It ended up being a pain in the ass and the tests were kind of difficult.

75% of your grade is exams, professor is knowledgeable but his lectures are very bad. No review guide, too much material per Exam. Optional Final (won't hurt your grade). E1 Avg: 68%, E2 Avg: 67%, E3 Avg 66%, Final: 58%. Average after curve: C+.

Lecture isn't required BUT he covers things in lecture that aren't on the slides/study material/book in lecture. He doesn't really give any helpful info for the on what to study for the essay questions so you best know everything. Unless you really want to be an insurance underwriter I would avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was the most monotone teacher ever. He seemed like he knew what he was talking about but did not convey the information well at all. He probably said um over 50 times a class period. He claims all the information on the test is from the slides directly but when the test comes around it is not even close. This is coming from a 3.9 student. DONT
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There are three exams(and an optional final) along with 4 small assignments(just have to do them). All questions on exams come from PowerPoint and lectures so make sure you watch/ go to every lecture and understand the content. Overall, class wasn't too hard but you have to study for the exams. Mark is very sweet and learns everyone's names.

Great professor. Definitely in my top 5 during my time at ISU. Don't need the textbook, but very lecture heavy so make sure you show up. Tries to involve everyone in the lectures at some point throughout the semester, so it's important to pay attention. Sometimes stuff from the lectures (outside of the slides) can show up on the test.

Power is one of my absolute favorite professors. He's super passionate about what the teaches. His exams are kind of hard but very doable of you show up to class and take good notes. He's really fun to visit in office hours if you need extra help or clarification and he's always willing to help out.

Mark is a great guy, but his teaching style was not for me. Talks a million miles an hour so it's hard to understand what he's trying to get at. He has great examples, but he writes his own exams, and he uses really complex, detailed questions. Exams are worth like 3/4 your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He has long lecture and so any things to remember
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Power can be intimidating he wants his students to actually learn the material and not coddle them. He likes to call out on students for questions, especially those who do not pay attention in class. Use his office hours to ask questions/go over materials, you can get a better explanation. There's extra credit if you miss class less than 3x.

No group projects. The textbook is not needed. Go to class and study what he says about the powerpoint slides and you'll be golden. He is extremely knowledgable and cares for his students. I would definitely take his class again. Study hard for the exams because they are definitely difficult but manageable. Extra credit awarded for attendance.

Especially hard for people who cannot follow his talking speed. He wants everyone in his class to get high grade and do well, but his class is every difficult and the test is very hard, the solution can be 5 times length than the questions itself. Careful to choose the class. BUT! He is a nice person.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mark is a very good professor with a passion for finance. His tests are really long, especially for a 75 minute class, but fair. Extra credit for articles and participation are helpful.

Mark is a great professor and cares about his students. He knows your name by the second week, so be prepared to answer questions. The book wasn't necessary so don't buy it. The tests are extremely long - 60 to 80 multiple choice questions with two short answer questions in 75 minute exam. Great class, would take again.

This class is really difficult if you aren't a finance major. He's really knowledgeable but sometimes speaks over students heads. He didn't give any extra credit when I took his class. Almost a 13 of my class got a D or lower so definitely be prepared to study hard for tests. The textbook isn't really necessary--just go to every class.

Dr. Power is an awesome professor. He definitely makes a topic that most people find mundane actually very interesting. He's extremely smart, and sometimes he talks over our heads a lot. But he's super helpful and gives a decent amount of extra credit to make up for the extremely hard tests.

Best finance professor I have ever had. Makes a topic that most people find boring very interesting. Good to every class and take good notes and you will get an A or B. Tests are a little bit tricky but overall a great test to take. Applies to all aspects of life and risk management.

Power is the best professor I've had at ISU. His class is very challenging, but he gives a fair amount of extra credit and is always willing to help out his students. Exams are very difficult. Overall, you learn a lot about stuff useful to everyone, not just finance majors. Great guy, great class.

Great guy. Really wants to see students succeed. Learns everybody's' names and gets everyone involved in discussions.  Sometimes he speaks really fast and it's hard to follow, but he's more than happy to answer your questions.  Not an easy A, but it's certainly attainable. Main advice: go to class regularly and pay attention. You'll learn a lot.

He has high but definitely reasonable standards for students in his class to attend class, take thorough notes, and ask questions.  He's a great teacher but often speaks above students' understanding of insurance.  He's very helpful if you ask questions, though.

Best finance professor at Iowa State, hands down. You can really tell he cares about his students doing well and prepares you well for all quizzes and tests. Even if you aren't wanting to go into the insurance field, the material is really useful for everyday life. It won't be the easiest A, but anyone who tries should get the grade they deserve.

Easily one of the best professors at ISU. He really knows his stuff and cares about his students doing well. It is a fairly challenging, but anyone who puts in the work will be fine. Not a great class to be lazy and not study for.

Go to class and you'll have an A if you listen. Note taking not necessary if you pay attention. Don't buy the text book. Most of the material is easy to understand and what isn't easily understood is explained well. Quizzes and exams are given with extra credit built in (30 points graded out of 25)

Great professor! Make sure to go to class because he takes attendance. Don't buy the book, I never used it and got an A. He gives a few extra credit opportunities so take advantage. Tests and quizzes can be a little difficult to understand, but just make sure you read through the questions to make sure you understand exactly what it is asking.

Phenomenal teacher and person. Will go out of his way to help you and answer any question even if it has nothing to do with class. Go to class and pay attention! He gives lots of extra credit and you have to work for your A but many should be able to pull off at least a B. Also take his 462, harder but he is a great teacher so definitely worth it.
Awesome prof!

He's great at teaching the material by keeping the class involved. Unlike most teachers at IA state, he knows everyone by name within the first couple of weeks. Paying attention in class will help you succeed on tests, as well as increasing your financial aptitutde. I would recommend his class to anyone interested in finance.

He's a good teacher. Enthusiastic and friendly, he will go out of his way to help you out. Offers plenty of extra credit. Only complaint is that his test questions can be a little unclear...he says he wants to make you think, but sometimes it is difficult just figuring out what is being asked. Good overall though.

Great teacher (best I've had),  willing to help you out and really care about students doing well.  Tests can be kinda tricky, but theres lots of extra credit.  Easy finance class to take, he makes class as fun as it can be being an insurance class... id take it!
He is a good teacher, I really enjoyed his class.
Class a little boring, but have to pay attention, cause he likes to pick on people. Pay attention to slides that he spends a lot of time on.

He is an awesome instructor. He is easy to listen to and he is really willing to help students. Studying for the tests is a must. They are hard. But lots of extra credit opportunities help out the grade a lot! Would recommend this class!!!
Very good class.  Tests are challenging but should be easy if you attend class and somewhat pay attention.

This class was a lot but he offers past exams to study with that some question will show up on this years exam. He says there might not be a curve but there always is. he also has 4 in lecture quizzes for extra credit

He struggles at updating grades and the class is insanely test heavy so no matter how well you do on homework it won't make a real difference on grade. The “practice exams” he gives are not great for preparing for exams. I did 4 practice exams and did well on each, but didn't perform well on the actual test because they didn't reflect the content.

While physics is really challenging, Dr Prell's lectures and the way he explained concepts helped me understand. Homework is hard, but mostly doable. Lots of extra credit on the homework, a little on tests, and a few extra credit in class lectures. Dr Prell feels like your fun uncle who just likes science and that shows in his teaching.
He is very hard to understand what he is saying this is the reason why I ended up dropping that and physics is hard.

I was dreading physics going into it but professor Prell made it as enjoyable as possible. The class was pretty hard but you could tell he really wanted his students to succeed and put a lot of effort in to get them there. Grades were curved at the end of semester and he also did random extra credit quizzes during lectures.

Physics is a hard class to understand with how much material you need to go over, but Professor Prell does a fantastic job of getting that information to you in a meaningful way. Show up to class, ask questions, and take good notes and you should be able to get through good enough.

I loved Prell as a professor. Physics is a very difficult class, but it was obvious he wanted us to be able to do our best. The exams are difficult so the extra credit he gives out is so important. Attendance is NOT mandatory but I highly recommend it because it will help you so much, plus, he does a few random extra credit quizzes in class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A pretty good professor who clearly explains the course content well. Lectures can be boring. The recitation quizzes were sometimes fairly difficult. Overall pretty good.

Super super difficult class for it being an entry level physics. Four night exams including the final - 4 in class quizzes for 6 pts extra credit each (on random days so go to class!). Recitation quizzes are also very difficult. You won't know your actual grade until the very end of the semester which is extremely stressful.

Great professor and is great at answering questions asked in class. Only problem with the class is the amount covered in the short periods of time available. Most of my time outside of class is spent on this class' homework

Great professor. The extra credit is very important and will really help your grade. Come to all the classes for lecture quizzes you do not want to miss them. The TAs are very helpful. I would recommend getting a tutor if you need one. It is a difficult class but he is a very good professor.

Soeren Prell's lectures are entertaining, showing demos and cracking jokes. He is also very good at helping and preparing you for exams. The class itself isn't the easiest and the four total exams make up most of the grade and were also fairly difficult. If you show up and try, you'll pass. A Lot of homework but in all, a good class and professor.

He did a really good job teaching Physics and explained things well, and always takes any questions if people are confused. The TAs influence a lot of your lab and recitation grades so thatll just depend who you get. But as long as you do the homework and go to most lectures then the exams shouldnt be horrible, but dont expect As on exams.

Tough class but he's intelligent and does good demos so attending lectures are helpful but not mandatory just random in class extra credit points. Weekly hw highly recommend getting chegg to help. Tests are very hard but study old exams they are very similar. He's a very understanding guy and wants everyone to pass so grading scale is generous

Dr. Prell is an incredible lecturer; he's extremely knowledgeable regarding physics, yet he's careful to keep things simplified and accessible for students. He uses experiments almost every lecture to demonstrate his lessons and keep students entertained, which is a welcome change of pace from typical physics lectures. Definitely would recommend!

Dr. Prell is a wonderful lecturer and does a great job making an especially difficult class interesting. He tries his best to make sure everyone understands the topics, but will speed through some info he expects you to know. The class is hard if you aren't great at math, but all it takes is a little effort. Overall a pretty good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Doesnt give many examples and class lectures are very heavy in content. Also the past exams are no help in studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Good lecturer. Does lots of experiments that help you understand what you're supposed to learn and put it into real-life perspective. Phys 222 is rough, but Prell was always happy and enthusiastic about the material.
Really amazing guy. Really cares about students and learning. Lectures can be a bit dull, but helpful. Did not use textbook. Lot's of homework, but it's all helpful. Very very curved.

He is a good teacher and his accent does not affect the way he teaches. He does a lot of experiments in class. I advise to not skip class. Tests are tough, as usual, but the class is curved. If you want a high grade with him, you have to understand how to understand every question in the homework.

He really knows his stuff, keeps lectures interesting with demonstrations and clicker questions to reaffirm topics discussed. Tests were a fair representation of the material covered, lots of mastering physics homework.

I really enjoyed physics with Dr. Prell. He gave interesting lectures, quite often with physical demonstrations. Cool accent, too. He is good at explaining the concepts and as such gives fairly tough tests. He got applause on the last day of class - never seen that happen anywhere else.
Does not give practical applications of information. The quizzes were often over material we had not learned yet. Gives you about 30 seconds to answer clicker questions.
He is a very good professor, he has a clear english and his slides are really helpful when studying for tests and quizzes.

Very passionate about physics, not originally from the United States but his English was very clear, was very helpful and always responded to email quickly, tests were difficult as was homework but help sessions were offered and there was often a curve.
His English isn't perfect, but he does speak with regularity. He's a busy professor, but if you seek him out, he's a very helpful guy.
Well! Physics is a hard class no doubt... we seriously need good professors for this class and he was ....

Does a lot of deriving of equations instead of explaining there uses in example problems. Proving the equations wasn't necessary information for any of the test, but manipulating and combining these equations definitely was. Almost all conceptual questions on tests try to trick you one way or the other. Not an awful class, but very boring lectures.

Challenging course, but he does a very good job lecturing. I think it would be more beneficial to do numerical examples that deriving the equations, but he still gets the concepts across well. The use of the TA's/ recitations, however, is in need of a change. His quality lectures are not reinforced at all in the discussion sections.
FAIR,NOT BAD,JUST SO SO

Awesome dude.Like the previous comment, it is a very hard class but Prell is great about explaining things and helping you out.  You have to put in the work or you will not pass.  You'll need to spend hrs. a night studying for this class.  Understand his lecture examples and ACTs and you'll do fine on the tests.  This class isnt supposed to be easy
Nothing sunk in. His way of explaining the material is dry and bland. I have him again this spring and plan to attend a different lecture for this class if possible.
Not a fun class. Does include a lot of examples in class but still is hard not to fall asleep. It's physics though... what can you do about it
Goaaaattttttttttt
Pranav was really approachable and helpful. Having him as the TA made the class much easier to follow, and he was always willing to clarify concepts and answer questions.

reviews.comment: First want to clarify that he is a TA, not a professor. To keep this short and sweet, go to anyone but him. 0/10 don't recommend.

Don't ever take a course with this ta. He's not even a professor he's a TA and hes stricter than the actual professor. Have had him as my TA for four classes now and he just keeps getting worse. If there are any other ta's go to them, NOT HIM!
he thinks hes the smartest person ever. he doesnt even know the subjects that he is a ta for
one of the biggest assholes at this school, avoid him please.
He acts more than a proffessor
He is very strict TA i ever seen , he is very strict more than like a professor
