reviews.comment: The lectures can get boring, but he stays focused and avoids tangents. Homework reflects the lectures and takes a reasonable amount of time, usually 6–7 problems. Tests are very easy, and the practice exam is exactly like the real exam conceptually and allows a double-sided note sheet. Very generous with late work and relaxed grading overall.

Not a bad professor considering this is his first/second semester teaching. Dry lectures but he gets the job done. He and TAs were helpful in office hours and the exams were not difficult but the homeworks were tough. online lectures are posted from a previous semester so attendance isnt mandatory. overall not bad.
Genuinely just an average professor. Lectures were a bit boring, good notes that are easy to read, doesn't seem to care too much about the material. Didn't love the class but the guy was alright.

Very good. He was very understanding of everyone's circumstances and abilities and was good at grading based on the quality of your work rather than if it is exactly what it should be related to the assignment. Assigns readings but they are more suggestive and most of what you need is done in class. Good deadlines and extends them if need be.
One of the very few profs who really values honest communication. He was very understanding of my situation and more than negotiable

Max is nice. He is very flexible with deadlines. I think he sometimes plans too many activities for one class and it can feel overwhelming. At least no reading quizzes and no homework apart from the major assignments and readings (I never did the readings and still got an A). Easy course and easy prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Max is great! I used to hate English classes in high school but he made me feel confident in my writing. He is lots of fun and very easy-going. Always prepared and comes up with cool in-class activities. Also flexible with deadlines and quick to respond to emails. Highly recommend!

A very simple class that you can definitely earn an A in. There is a decent amount of reading you must do, but the quizzes are very simple. The 3 research projects you must do are also simple and easy to follow the instructions. Participation matters, so definitely show up to class as much as possible. Just put in the effort and you'll do good.
Dr. P is very understanding and a great prof. Definitely take a class with her.

Dr. Preseau is an amazing professor. Her class was the one class I was excited to go to every day. She is a very understanding professor and is willing to give extensions if you need it. She also has a clear passion for the subject and teaches it in a natural way. She made the topics fun and interesting. I took another one of her classes after this

Very unorganized course with unclear instructions and poor lectures. The professor calls on students often, asking, “Does this make sense?” but offers little clarity. Assignments feel confusing, presentations get very short notice, and guest speakers teach more than the professor. I would never recommend this professor to anyone.

Lectures are boring and felt winged most of the time. Prof is very caring and answers emails immediately. Semester long group project & you sit with them all semester, so pick a good group. I liked her projects because they worked on problems that real Ames brands/companies had. Barely put effort into the class and had over 100 percent by the end.

Is very nice and cares about you, but has boring and sometimes confusing lectures. Her advice and recommendations are also all over the place. I'd be fine taking her again. Class overall was not hard.
idk why there is hate for her, she is such a nice and wonderful lady and she cares for your success, she is very kind and cares about her class alot.

Really easy class you just HAVE to show up. She does daily assignments that are worth a lot of your grade. The tests are open book open note, so that makes them pretty easy too. Lectures are a little dry is no one responds to her questions but they're not too bad.

Really boring lectures. Other than that, tests are take home online which is very nice. In class participation and homework assignments are very easily graded. I would suggest taking her if you are looking for a solid grade in this class but may not learn as much.
I was misgendered and names all semester and Priyanka refused to adapt. She is very self centered and rude and does not respond to emails
Priyanka is one of the sweetest professors I have had at ISU. She cares about all her students and is very responsive to emails if you have questions.

MKT 340: NEVER TAKE HER. She neglects her students, is incapable of creating exams that are accurately based on the study guide, and cant lecture to save her life. She stares students down, making them uncomfortable while she forces them to answer her odd and confusing questions. I am so glad to be done with her and hope never to see her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Terrible lecturer, bases them off of her experiences but creates exams based on poorly made PowerPoints. Cannot create study guides to reflect what will be on the test, makes mistakes on every exam.  rude and absentminded, I get called the wrong name every time even after correction. Very condescending and don care for students. Do not take her.

Jayashankar lectures on real-life marketing examples that were very abstract and confusing and are not on the exams. Her exams are open note, but nothing comes from the textbook as she says it comes from her lectures, but often doesn't. She says marketing is up to the person, but then puts questions on the exams where multiple could be correct.

MKT 340 - AVOID AT ALL COSTS. I have not had a more intolerable professor at ISU. You will fall asleep during her lectures. She interrupts students and won't let you focus on group activities because she is continuously sputtering out random things. Tests are opinion based and her answer is final, no room for negotiation, read her mind or fail.

MARKETING 340:Dr. J competes with one of the worst professors at ISU. I do not recommend AT ALL. Take course online or w/ another professor. Marketing is easy to grasp and this is the intro class. Her exams are POORLY worded which makes/breaks your grade. Can NOT Quizlet or Chegg and little time. Does NOT give back exam points @office hours. Trust.

She forced students to interact during class. Her exams were open book but the questions were not in any of her slides or the book. The questions made no sense. She grades work very easily. Lots of busy work.

454X by Dr Jayashankar is a great class. There are no tests and only a few projects. All are in teams with 2-3 people (she picks the teams). Overall she grades pretty easy and attendance was not graded

Notes are long and tests are a lot of material. Does not do well telling us what is on the exam- short exams giving less room for error. Class was not useful and asks questions that are pointless. Would not reccomend

Priyanka is a decent professor, very smart and knows what she's teaching. Her class is very easy, the tests are a little difficult but as long as you use the study guides they aren't that bad. The group project at the end of class is graded really easily.

TAKE MGMT 370 WITH HER. Her teaching skills are a little awkward and she's not the best at lecturing, but it is very easy to get an A. She outlines exactly what's on the exam, gives out a ton of extra credit, and the group + individual project are a breeze. Seriously, take this class with her.
Super disorganized. Exams are actually fairly difficult. The group project and presentation are easy.

Tons of extra credit and exams are not difficult.  You honestly need to try to not receive an A in this course.  Group project is easy so is the individual assignment, she practically gives full points for completion.

Great Professor. Gives out a ton of extra credit and easy in class assignments so go to class. Tests are very straight forward because she gives you a study guide weeks before the exam. She is very understanding, for sure take this class with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor! Gives out extra credit like it's going out of style. Don't need to buy the textbook. Exams are very clear, study guides tell you specifically what you need to know/ slides to look at. Group projects are not difficult, she basically grades them off completion. Final isn't cumulative. Much easier than alternative MGMT 370 professors.

Take mgmt 370 with her or else you'll be sad you didn't!! One of the easier classes I've taken in the CoB. Super sweet professor and overall easy going exams. As long as you read through the slides or do the study guide you should get a solid A!

Priyanka is a great teacher. She is extremely knowledgeable about Management and various leadership/motivation  strategies. Several opportunities for extra credit. End-of-semester group and individual projects along with final exam. Did not purchase 'required' textbook for this class.
Wonderful teacher! I wish I could take her class again! You learn a ton and it is not too difficult either!

This class/prof is eh. The exams do seem really hard, and I walked into the second exam being very confident and left with a 65 when the average was below. Exams should be curved in my opinion, given that no one is really doing that great. The lectures provided are thorough, though they just take time to watch.

Worst professor ive ever had ridiculous amounts of hw on top of all the other classes you have to worry about, you almost have to use AI to complete stuff on time, pulong acts like this is the only class your taking, exams have absolutely ruined my grade, I would really recommend taking this with anyone else in person

bad class would not recommend homework is extremely inconsistent with the weighting of problems completely thrown off way to much busy work the homework never seems to be guided the right direction grading is harsh the homework is pointless,requires you to take quizzes in testing centers. homework never makes sense he clearly has to big of an ego

Easily the worst professor I have had in college. The course lacks a defined goal. While it is not officially a coding class, you are required to do everything in R. The labs are a total waste of time. Grading criteria are nonexistent, and the homework prompts are vague. Take another class, especially if you are a graduate student.

Amazing professor. He is incredibly helpful, nice, and has amazing notes that actually help you learn the content in theory and with R. As long as you at least look over the notes, there is no way you will do badly. I cannot recommend him enough if you want a course where you will actually learn as well as get a good grade.

One of my friends almost quit because of Dr. Ma. As a mentor, he is very mean to students, thinking himself is the smartest guy in the world. I wish him is held responsible for his unfair treatment to students. He is also very mean and said unfair comments to other researchers' work.

reviews.comment: I took his class for mkt340 during fall 2021. I enjoyed the class. He makes marketing interesting.
I am currently taking MKT340 class. I am enjoying his class. Every assignment and exam has clear guidelines. His lectures are very interesting.
Really tough class but worth it.

test doesn't even relate to what he teaches. he bases it off of real life situations but doesn't teach you on that. hes unorganized n his ex credit is so low its not even worth it. projects suck he makes u buy a book and read it and present to class. His final was 45 mins for 60 questions (never had a 45 min exam b4) WORST CLASS n no study guide
It was my first online class. The class was really helpful. I learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lectures are interesting if you listen. Attendance is not mandatory but if you miss class then you wouldn't do well on the exams. Full points on assignments but a tough grader on exams.

Professor is really unprepared for class and is not a hard grader at all. This class is an easy A, however, did not learn much at all. Homework, projects and exams are extremely easy and do not need to come to class.
Very unprepared professor. Does not post most class materials. This is an easy class but I have not learned any of what is expected.

Pushpinder is super knowledgeable in marketing, and makes mkt340 real easy without a marketing background. Mostly lecture, but very hands on. Lots of examples/scenarios makes class super interactive. Groups are assigned and all projects/presentations are in groups. Just study the lecture slides, do the hw and it will be good!

Professor Purdy is a great professor! She is so caring and helpful with all of her students. The class requires a lot of analysis, but as long as you show up you will be happy with your grade. Love Ma Purdy!

Ma Purdy is the nicest lady here at the University! She cares so much about her students that she'll do anything to help them to succeed in not only her class but with life in general. The class is not hard, just show up and put forth an effort and you'll easily pass! Class is made up of papers, that aren't hard at all, and an attendance grade.
It is obvious she cares about her students and loves her job. She make the reading fun and something to look forward to.

Ma is one of my favorite professors because she makes it clear she cares about you as more than just a student. This class revolves around this history of education, but she also stays up to date on current issues in education, so its more relatable. Taking her class forces you to consider why you're becoming a teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Ma is such a neat lady and she genuinely cares about her students. The CI204 is a small class size which allowed us to make relationships with her and each other. There's approx. 6 reflection papers to do over the semester, but they're pretty easy. Participate in class and do those and you'll be just fine.

Ma, is a wonderful person and she is extremely invested in what she teach's, and her emotions show that. She can be a rollercoaster of emotion, so watch out for that. Also, she is dis-organized and some days can seem like she is constantly confused. She's a great professor, just make sure to ask questions if it feels as if she has not explained.

Ma is a great professor and cares deeply about her students. There is no exams, only a quiz or two and papers. Attendance is MANDATORY. Get ready to read a lot and talk in class. I loved the content of the class, and gained great friends from table discussion. She is very open to changing requirements on assignments and wants to help her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: MaPurdy was a good teacher. The only problem I had with her, was she was not very willing to accepts others' opinions. In most discussions, it was her way or the highway. Although I never had any altercations or problems with her, I did not like how she handled other students' opinions. The class was overall an easy class and was fun to go to.

I really liked Ma. She was willing to offer help to anyone and she has a very strong passion for education. If you follow the heading criteria exactly you will pass with an A no question. Definitely a great teacher and very inspiring!

Ma is the bomb. She cares very deeply about her students, and about the subject she teaches. She has a lot to share - if you open up you won't be disappointed. Attendance is mandatory,  but with the activities you do in class you won't hate being there. No tests, only papers which aren't explained very clearly, but she grades exceptionally easy.

Ma will surprise you in many ways. She definitely cares about her students and wants them to become great educators in the future. She's extremely fair with grading, sometimes too fair. Don't take advantage because she can fail you if you don't come to class or participate. There's a lot of papers to write, but once again, they're fairly graded.
Ma is amazing! Definitely take class with her, she honestly cares and it was an easy course!

Ma is a wonderful professor and I would love to take more of her classes! She is very helpful and definitely there for you. Throughout the semester, she only gave us one quiz. There isn't tests either in the class, just a lot of reading.

Ma Purdy is definitely cares about her students more than any other professor. My only problem with the course was that I felt that it was not centered around Education, and more just about society. Not very applicable to my future career.

You have a group in this class that you will do a final project with at the end of the semester, but you also work with them almost every lecture. She keeps class engaging and wants you to do well. If you have a question she will do a good job answering it. From what I have heard about the other professors I would definitely choose her.

She is a professor who likes to connect with the class. Her lectures are very interaction heavy. We are put in teams for the whole semester and we are encouraged to talk throughout class daily. Her exams are very vocab heavy but she gives you everything you need and more on the study guide. Overall, I enjoy her class and would recommend her.

I can't recommend this class/professor enough. It was the easiest A i have ever received. No more than 9 absences allowed. the entire material is common knowledge or vocab words. Almost no homework and you can talk to ppl or be on your phone in class. Super sweet professor.

Do not even consider her for your professor. Not good at teaching this course, overcomplicated ALL content, tests were unrelated. Teacher was dry and awkward and didnt know how to engage the class. Exam averages were in the 60% consistently. This was not supposed to be a hard class, get a different prof or your GPA will plummet under her wrath.

Studying for her tests does not help as I have studied before the tests and get around a 60%.

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. The first two exams had a class average of a D. Take any other professor or online if possible.

reviews.comment: Terrible teacher and couldn't inspire me to get out of bed. In person tests and they are hard for no reason at all, class is mandatory. Does not matter if you study for the exams or not, you will get the same grade if you pay attention or snipe the top hat and skip class. DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER.

THE BEST PROFESSOR EVER. She is just the most wholesome thing ever. She is so beyond caring for her students and truly the most understanding professor I've ever had. I could not recommend her enough; it doesn't even matter what she's teaching, she is incredible.
Shoba was a great professor, and during pop quizzes, she would help work through problems. Exams were very easy, and the class was fun for a finance class.
Exams taken in class, without lockdown browser. She is so funny and caring!! Just make sure to attend class, because she does quizzes, teamworks and extra credit in class.

The class was easy but the professor was horrible, she forgot to post the conceptual practice exam and the study sheet for the first exam and she blamed it un us for not telling her even though we never knew it existed. She had a yelling match with a student one day, it was funny. Exams were easy though and little homework.
We love Shoba
Good Summer Class. It was a 4-week class so very compressed and 75% of grades come from exams. But manageable and you get good exposure to a variety of topics.

the tests in the class were very hard and class averages were very low. I never learned well from class and had to spend a very long time studying. As a result my grade was very low for majority of semester however shoba than put in extra credit and curves the class weighted scale. She is an ok teacher but prepare to do a lot on your own.
Legit the goat

Shoba is extremely funny. Besides that, she is incredibly accommodating with due dates for pop quizzes and classwork. Additionally, she is more than willing to help with anything. Exams were alright, and homework was good practice. Passing is not too difficult as long as one shows up to class.
I had to leave mid-semester for a medical issue, and this professor was very accommodating. Do your homework and you will get a fine grade.

Pop Quizzes/In-class assignments. Averages on the exams were 60-70%, which is extremely low, would blame low scores on people not going to class.Called out a student for getting a 24% and then caring about missing in class assignments. Constantly telling people to drop the course if they are struggling in it when its req for all business majors

Exams were 80% HW 20%, and 2% EC. Exams, HW, and lectures were very dissimilar. Shoba did not respond to emails well and was difficult to understand. Questions were very poorly written, w/ multiple errors. The syllabus barely made sense, and the Canvas page was similarly very poorly structured. Not a terrible class, but take it at your own risk.

reviews.comment: Shoba was the funniest professor I have ever had. She is a pretty easy grader, and the class consists of a group presentation, case quizzes, in class TW assignments, and a few exams. She loves when people participate in class, but if she calls on you and you don't know the answer, she'll explain the concept more. Such a fun class, she is a gem!

While classes are not required, I heavily recommend going due to assignments due at the end of class. She is very helpful with questions during class. There is a group project which is not too difficult.
Requires too many things
Very difficult to understand. Is NOT clear about assignments whatsoever.
She always cared about us and made sure we knew what would be on the exams. Very understanding and respectful.

A majority of in class assignments are done with a group, as well as a major group project you need to prep for. The class is fairly easy and she is a wonderful professor that likes to crack jokes in class. Explains concepts very well and there are no surprises on the exams. 10/10
This class was an easy A. Take it if you are interested in crypto and want an easy class. Theres a homework every week but its easy and there is teamwork at the end of class like once a weekish.

Shoba is a great professor for this class. In class she goes over her lecture slides which hold a lot of valuable information both conceptually and mathematically. As long as you pay attention, attend class to do the very basic teamwork questions, and understand how to do all the practice exam questions you will get a good grade in the class.
You will learn nothing in this class. She rushes through lectures, doesn't take time to explain what she's teaching, and overall not the best teacher. She does care about her students.
Boring lectures but she does use the time to go over example problems which are helpful

reviews.comment: Watch her lectures. Practice the given problems in Quizzes, Extra Credits, Team Work, and meetings. The problems are short and are very similar. (Just changed the numbers or name which makes it very good practice). If you do these, then you will be guaranteed an A.

Shoba is a great professor. She's funny and her lectures are interesting. Shoba cares about her students and she makes the material fun to learn. You have to go to lecture to get team work points. Tests aren't easy but not crazy difficult, and there are some bonus points as well. Highly recommend Shoba
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shoba is a sweet professor. Lectures seem very confusing at first, but she gives practice test questions that are the same as the test. Group work is easy and you get extra credit for it. I would take more classes with her for sure!
Very difficult to contact and schedule outside of class. Has high expectations that everyone get 90%+ on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great teacher and very helpful if you go in on her office hours.
Test are worth 60% of the class grade. Also, go to class because there are a lot of team works - extra credit available if you go. Very nice and a good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Shoba is usually a pretty easy A, but this course is a little more difficult since the tests make up 60% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Shoba was an excellent professor, although I will warn you right now... you will not pass this class without a calculator. You need a BAII Plus. Usually class consisted of power points and practice problems. I would recommend this to anyone looking for a good learning experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Pick a smart group because there's a presentation and a report. A little bit of easy math on bonds/options, but mostly memorizing concepts. Lots of EC and in class points so go to class. Notes are fill in the blank. 3 exams including final, non cumulative, and worth 20% each. Straight forward teaching style while cracking some jokes here and there

Shoba is very nice and funny. This was an honors entrepreneurship seminar. She understood that a seminar should be easy and not too demanding, and she met the expectation with this. I enjoyed this class and would recommend any of her other classes.
Easy finance teacher, don't really learn much though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good professor of a class that is pretty easy. She is funny and will always help you if needed. There is in-class group works and group projects. Exams are not very difficult. Gives out enough extra credit to really help your grade. Would recommend.

Don't buy the book. This class is super easy, and Shoba will give you everything you need to know during lecture! Easy A if you work for it! There is a decent amount of group work (in class and 2 projects), so pick a good group!

Great prof! She likes to make her students laugh which is great for a finance class. She puts jokes in her PowerPoints. Who you sit by on the first day is basically who you will be working with for the rest of the semester so be careful where you sit! Two big group projects and weekly surprise group work and some group extra credit so be there!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Shoba is one of the best professors in Finance at Iowa State. Her lectures are hilarious and she seems to really care about her students. She gives fill in the blank notes. Tests consists of multiple choice questions about problems and concepts. Quizzes are simple if you complete the spreadsheet. Go to class and you will do fine.

She is a really nice professor and really wants you to succeed.  The problem is the class is basically a repeat of 310 and 320 so a she tries to make it different.  In doing that the tests have quite a few questions that aren't helpful such as who a CEO is of one of the companies we present on.  Overall it isn't to hard but not entirely helpful.

One of my favorite teachers at Iowa State. She truly cares how her students perform in the class and curves exams if necessary. You must show up to all lectures to take in class quizzes and extra credit, don't worry, if you pay attention it's pretty easy. I highly recommend taking a class with her
Gives a lot of extra credit. Has quizzes often, they are really easy if you pay attention.
She's super sweet and tells funny jokes :)
Enjoyed Prof Shoba' s class. Included real world applications and learned a lot

By far the easiest class I have taken in the College of Business. Shoba has fill in the blank powerpoints, so you need to go to class. She tries to be funny and tells jokes. There is no graded homework, and she gives practices problems that you complete in class, so you don't have to teach yourself the computational portions. Take her class!!

Each group has to do one presentation on a case study and the class has to take a quiz. They are pretty easy if you pay attention in class. Tests aren't too hard and she does give some extra credit. She tries to make the class fun and likes to joke around with the class. Would take it again.

HON321 seminar - great guest speakers, highly recommend. Professor Shoba is also clear about what the expectations are. She has a subtle sense of humor but when you recognize it, it's hilarious. Even if you're not a business major, give her honors seminar a try!
SUPER EASY.

Pretty easy class as long as you go to class. Formed groups in the first week of class so make sure to get in a good group as you will do a majority of non-test points with that group. Tests are pretty straight forward.  22 questions taken out of 20 total for the tests. Does have some dry sense of humor, just play along and you'll be fine.

Great person. Ask a questions and she will answer it for you and give you the answer half the time. Funny lady and if you show an interest in the material, she will grade easily. Provides review and formula sheets if you ask her.
She will explain each concept, then show how it works in a real world scenario.  For me, this method of teaching is helpful.
Tries to be funny and engage students. Class is easy, don't need the book at all, everything comes from her notes.

Fun teacher. She tries to make class entertaining which can be a breath of fresh air in the mornings. There is a big group project she assigns on the first day of class so make sure you are seated around people that look responsible. You will do 2 projects with the same people. Tests are very basic.
Best finance professor I've had. Took 301 and 330 with her.
Great teacher. Lectures well and class prepares you for exams. Learned a lot in this class. Best Finance teacher I've had
Very easy class. Just go to every one and make sure you don't miss teamwork. Tests are vocab and concepts word for word out of the power point slides.
Teaching good, but class is boring. A lot of "AWESOME!!!" can be heard in every class...
Lecture prepares you for the test! Awesome

She is a nice professor, but is not great at teaching this class. She is kind of hard to understand, and she just reads straight from the slides. She doesn't seem to have a great knowledge of the US financial industry. There is one group presentation on a financial company and a few tests. Overall, she is not bad professor, but I've had better.

Get her for FIN 301 if you can.  She teaches you what she wants you to know, then tests you over it.  Go to SI, if you need to, it's a good replacement for class if you have to miss.  Had to work, made about half the classes, got an A-.

GO to class and sleep so you dont miss the extra quizes. Make sure you go to exam review and understand all the problem. Exam problems are exactly the same as exam review cept different context. Then score your easiest A in life in the end of the semester.

Even though some days she seems like she hates all of us, (which i know is just a cultural difference between us students and her own socialization skills), she isn't that bad of a teacher, and her class is a breeze. Just let her get P.O.'d if no one else shopped at JC Penny's last weekend except her and you should be fine.
Cracks too many PJs. Sometimes treats students like kindergarten kids.

Super easy i got over 100%. just got to the last day before the test and to the SI review session and you'll get an A. She always makes jokes that aren't funny but she laughs at herself so it makes you laugh. really cool teacher i'd take her again
Take classes from her if you can. She is helpful, fun to listen to, not harsh but teaches the topics really good.
Has an accent that is tough to understand at times but asl ong as you go to the class before the test when she reviews you should be fine, grading is very lenient.
Easy class. She is a good teacher and cares about her students. She tries so hard to be funny; just go with it. Her husband passed away this year; everyone gives their condolences.

Go to class for the random pop quizzes! No homework. Tests aren't too bad if you go through and understand the book problems and examples in class. Unfortunately, her husband passed away near the end of the semester. Last 2 weeks of class were cancelled. The final was then made optional and replaced your lowest exam score, so many did not take it.
I would say she is one of the easiest going and easiest teachers ever... You would definitely enjoy her class!!!  She also teaches 301/310/330!!! Easy B to A teacher...
Boring class but it's way easy if you study for the tests and go to class (for the pop quizzes... there are 4; mine were between weeks 7 and 13 I believe)

Her accent is hard to understand sometimes, but overall an easy class. Go to class because she has pop quizzes which are easy points. Tests are also easy. I never used my book and aced almost every test.
If you go to class, listen, go to SI or even read the book and do the practice problems there is no reason not to get an A. There is good curve and pop quizes are  1/4 of your grade. EASY CLASS
Go to lecture and skim the textbook.  She gives random pop quizzes that don't seem to have any pattern associated with them.
Its a freaking joke one of the easiest classes ever if you do the practice test exactly the same
Good class, not too terrible difficult, but clarity and boring lectures can become an issue.  This professor though is still very good and I recommend here very much
I don't know why I'm getting a C in this class, because she really tries to make it easy.  Bleh.
easy, go to class, pay attention, and it should be an A
lame
I'm horrible with finance and accounting, but I actually did well in this class. She is very clear when she explains things and very funny. I recommend her!
Halarious!  Should be a writer for David Letterman.  I am a B student, and got an A.  She's fun.

Shoobs is awesome - I always enjoyed going to her class, I got a B+, mainly because I skipped only 2 classes the whoe semester to go snowboarding and both times we had a pop quiz... Would have easily gotten an A. You can to - go to class and do examplee, skim book, look at notes and powerpoints.
she was so easy!  tests were cake if you read the powerpoints.  easy A
Ask her for help on any questions and she'll give you the answers
Real easy. Her tests are directly from the slides. If you dont do well in this class, it is only because you didnt know what to read. Stick to her notes and you'll get an A.

The first exam is very similar to the study guide she hands out. So if you don't review it before the exam, it's your own fault. The final exam is much harder so you need to know your sh&t. If you do well in the first exam and the presentation, you can afford to slip a little on the final exam.

Overall, one of the easiest business courses at ISU, with averages in the 80's on most tests.  It's difficult to understand her in lecture, but the book can be helpful for clearing up any confusing things.
hard to understand, but slides are easy. Overall shes is easy if you follow along.
A Breeze - better than the others

Difficult to understand, and NO ONE listened in class.  It was unreal how loud the lecture hall gets.....fun class as long as you have a lot of friends to talk to, b/c your sure as hell not listening to what she says!
No Comments

i'm not sure if this was a finance class or if I was just in hell, she may know what shes talking about but can not convey it to others, i have no idea what happened..do the problems in the book and so help you god
Strong accent and hard to understand. I usually read the chapter while she was teaching and taught myself. Tests not too bad if you work practice problems.
You end up having to learn it yourself from the book because you can't understand her.

She has a strong accent but just pay attention and listen to her lectures. She has slides so just work the class problems as she goes thru them and the exams cover the same type of questions. Recitation is helpful.

the most boring teacher, heavy accent, curves everyone's test grades by a lot because everyone fails because he can't teach. Extra help is useless. He has 60+ slide notes and doesn't tell you what you need for exams and just leaves you to your own devices. Horrible. wouldn't take again

Qazi is a pretty average professor. Lectures were generally long and boring. He basically reads/underlines information on slides and tells you important information. Qazi is definitely willing to explain material and help with the homework. He's always the best at explaining material, but the class was easy, as tests were fairly standard.

Qazi's class is overall boring. He underlines the powerpoints so much you can't read them but most of the info is pretty common sense. There's pop quizzes so show up to class. If you go to his office hours he'll check your homework before it's due so you will get a perfect. Tests are not hard if you simply read through the notes.
Qazi is a very good teacher. I learned a lot in this course and his quizzestests are very easy and straightforward.

Kabir is your average grad student teacher. Knows his stuff but doesn't always explain it the best. Gives unannounced quizzes that are really easy, so just show up to class. There's a couple assignments but he is very helpful if you go to his office! Don't buy the textbook!

Rude and condescending, w/ very poor English. In lecture, she saw confused faces, asked if she should slow down, and proceeded to speed up. If you don't understand, she is very demeaning. Reasonable grader, and more points than some ACCT classes. Some of the EC took up to 3.75 hours. My grade is not thanks to Wang or her poor teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good professor! I typically have trouble with accents, but hers is not bad at all. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but she did many in-class group worksheets. She provided many extra points built into her grading scale, and, in preparation for exams, she provided helpful practice materials. She can be a tough grader and the course was lecture-heavy.

This professor is pretty good. She provides lots of example problems that are usually similar to those on exams and assignments. She always responded to emails quickly when I have questions. She prints off the lecture slides and has in class group assignments. She allows the class to correct exams for partial credit as well as extra credit reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's very nice, but doesn't respond to emails in time, so it's better if you visit office hours. Gave extra credit with lecture readings. Is willing to go over homework & exams if you make time for it & pay attention. Very hard class so pay attention during lectures.

Dr. Wang is so kind and accommodating. She offers you all the materials needed for success. I wouldn't consider the class easy, but if you try you will get an A. She is always accessible outside of class, and responds to emails promptly. Qian was so nice!

Qian is very nice and helpful with the subject matter. It was her first time teaching the class so a few times there was a little confusion. Tests are very similar to practice exams. Lectures consists of long practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very boring classes that while not required are pretty much required from in class assignments.  The semester starts as a lot of review as well.  I found her grading to be very poor as well.  For the project she would not account for early errors when grading the rest.  She also wasn't clear on formatting and took off points for that.
Prof Wang is a nice teacher, however her lectures are often long and confusing.  She is a fair grader on tests, however.  Tests are based on mostly lectures and in-class exercises.
Average difficulty course. Difficult to understand at times but has great examples. Incredibly helpful and will bend over backwards to meet with you for help outside of class.
She Is nice.  Provide useful feedback to her students :D

She is great at explaining, I like the way she taught as in she wrote the points on the board. One thing that I really dislike about her is her attitude. She is looking down at bad grade student, and try to avoid your appointment. not welcoming at all. Her exam is medium, if compared to CPA level. Be prepared to not understand her english accent.

Not an easy class, but she is well organized and make the materials clearer. She is very nice and helpful to your questions. Read the book and try not to miss class and you'll be fine. Project is not easy but you learn a lot.
Does not speak the most clear english, hard to understand at times. Project is pretty long and difficult but if you ask questions she is very helpful.
not easy course. you should always read the textbook. and project is kind of huge work. Quiz announced before taken. And please attened class regularly. She will remember every students in class.

SUPER helpful if you go to his office hours. He will help you with the homework and explain things very clearly. Very friendly guy as well. He even helped me get a job!! 
Overall a great professor, I really enjoyed his class and his teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In the whole semester effectively graded on 8 assignments counting the 2 exams that were 70% of the grade. In a class that covers material that can be hard to grasp, it felt lacking in the number assignments. More assignments would allow a student to gauge their understanding, but that was not given, leading to uncertainty going into exams.

All lectures and material had plenty of examples to learn from. While all of the lectures notes were posted online, the best way to get ready for the midterm and final exam was to attend class. Beware, only a midterm and final for this class, and homework assignments were weighted pretty low compared to the midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great class. Open note exams but you HAVE to go to lecture to take said notes. Does not read off of slides, just actually teaches you the concepts and is very engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Fantastic professor. The lecture is pretty to the point and I never felt like my time was wasted. Homework and exams actually covered the lecture material. The lecture slides he posts are more like cliff notes so while attendance isn't taken, there isn't a great way to make up the material outside of office hours.

Pretty neutral
Not bad

Dr. Qiao is great. You NEED to attend lectures because the online notes are basically bulleted talking points. You would miss a lot of examples without attending lecture. That being said his lectures are phenomenal and he answers questions often and thoroughly. Overall, I really liked his course.

I have never felt so well prepared for exams in my life. CPRE 489 with Dr. Qiao was a great experience. Everything on the homework was explicitly covered in lecture and everything on the exams drew heavily from the homeworks. He goes over many example problems. The labs were average, varied in what they covered - tedious at times.

Seems like a good professor, but honestly he does a horrible job at providing examples. He always modifies an existing example and adding/removing a bunch of things form it. Looking back at your notes you will be puzzled, and it's going to be too late by then.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite professor. You will learn a lot if you write notes with him and focus in class. Fair exams from based on notes.
Good course to learn. Good teaching and assignments, exams are easy
He is very knowledgeable about the material and has good lectures. Overall he teaches the class very well.
great
extremely not helpful  dont recommend working with him

One of the hardest classes I've taken in my life - physics was easy compared to the mind bending world of mathematical proofs.  Prof. Qiao should take the reins of CprE 310, and teach the class from now on.  This man will help you get through it if you aren't a mathematical genius.
Great.
No Comments
Tough tests, not very relevant to topics. Homework and tests  question types disconnected.

Very easy class if he didnt make the exams so TOUGH!  I had an A before taking the final exam and after final I was dropped to a B! I was shocked and very unhappy with his grading.  His lectures are totally worthless; just read the book, which is quiet boring sometimes.
Limited direct interaction, limited depth of knowledge, inconsistent grading rubric
Worst prof in the department
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Worst teaching style. He screws up himself and blames students for his mistakes.

Dr. Qin was a great professor! If you do all the homework and study the material he tells you you will end up with an A in this class easily! There is a nice curve (+2 grade bumps) at the end that is almost guaranteed! The lab portion of the class was interesting, however, the Solidworks project made all of us students cry.

248 is a very easy class, the difficult thing is paying attention to his lectures, they are incredibly boring. He gives you all the info you need to know for your exams though and he gave us hints prior to them that if you studied, you'd get an easy A. The lab portion of this class is a total joke though.

Dr. Qin is a good professor. He is very knowledgeable about what he is teaching. His lectures are very detailed and he explains most things pretty well. He responds to emails in a timely fashion and answers your questions. Tests are pretty straightforward. Not an easy A class but if you put in the work you can receive a high grade.
Dr. Qin was very knowledgeable about the topics presented in class. If you understand the homework, you will do good on the exams. Definitely not an easy A, but the class is interesting.
I didn't enjoy the course. The lectures were boring. Way too much work for a single course. Not going to take any course with him again

Worst instructor ever! You can find multiple mistakes in his slides, homework, scripts, and calculations. He asked students to act professionally but his actions are not professional at all. For example, he used abbreviations without spells out. The content of the course is scattered everywhere, which there is no consistency at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class with him was horrific. The homework was graded very harshly, the tests are way too long to complete within the class period. The last problem on the test was 60% of the exam score, and you need a 60% on tests in order to pass. The lab portion is an immense amount of work, in addition to the lecture work. Avoid him if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is an excellent professor. His lectures are not incredibly engaging, but he is definitely knowledgeable on the subject of manufacturing. If you put the work in outside of class, and attend his office hours, you will do very well in the class. If you miss class, your final grade will be heavily penalized.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin holds students to a standard he cannot keep himself. The tests are graded more on your ability to catch the little tricks he puts into them rather than the content. His lectures are dry and show his lack of confidence with the material. The class itself was interesting and my favorite in IE so far but his teaching ruined a good bit of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Qin is not the best professor, and his teaching style and course layout is the worst. Toughest grader I have ever seen. Lectures are boring and the labs as well. He does not consider any reasons if you are absent on a lab. Try to AVOID him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Boring class, sometimes funny. HE GRADE ALL THE EXAMS, SO THERE IS NO WAY YOU GET ADDITIONAL POINTS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: It is a difficult class, so plan a head fo exams. Homework and lecture notes are helpful and good preparation for exams. The class is boring but the labs are kind of enjoyable. This class has the most tough grader on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Terrible and a waste. Did not follow college's guidelines for dead week and finals week.
Mr. George is a wonderful teacher. The material is challenging but with clear, concise instructions, George makes all your problems go away.
George is one of my favorite professors at ISU.  When he dominates problems in class he can barely keep from smiling. Makes class easy and interesting.  Take him if you have the chance!
GREATEST TEACHER AT ISU
George is incredible.

George is amazing and super helpful if you go to him with questions. Online homework can be challenging but it gives U good fundamentals for understanding the material in class.He tests on what he covers in class so tests are fair. Trust me you wanna take him for all your thermal classes! "when in fact" George is my thermo hero ..."any questions?"
George is my hero.
George is awesome.

Very good professor, actually grades over what he taught in class.  He speaks well can convey the subject material in simple terms to help you understand the hard aspects of Fluid dynamics.  Go to class -> do the homework -> prepare for test from HW and class notes = Very good grade.
She tries to make the class interesting and provides plenty of extra credit if you don't do well on presentations.

Dr. Qu is a decent professor. She does an alright job explaining what you need to do for each presentation. But, when everything changed to online in the middle of the semester she wasn't too accommodating to some students who were struggling with the change. She had also made some unprofessional and unnecessary comments during lectures before.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She was very interested in helping her students succeed and deviated a bit from the other sections of this class. We had three speeches total and all of our points were from those speeches. The final ended up being a take home test and was not very difficult. I would recommend her to anyone taking this class.

Dr. Qu is very friendly and caring! Her vernacular can be a bit challenging to understand at times, which is frustrating in a speech-based class. 3 presentations all semester, with little to no prep required for each. Class is stupid easy but some effort is still required. There are times where you will feel like you are teaching content to yoself
Very funny and engaging. Made my first semester very at ease. This is can be a hard class, but she does a good job lightening the load and making it fun.
Avoid at all costs.

Fantastic professor, I took ENGR 1600 with her and it was by far my favorite class I have taken in several years. She's incredibly good with explanations of subjects, made the class very entertaining, and I would 100% take the class with her again.

Extremely prompt with feedback. Given the volume of homework due every class, it makes sense that much of it feels elementary, but does not provide a challenge or much of a chance to learn. Speaks English at least half of every class. Knowledgeable, but I hope I do not have to take another class with her. It feels like I am in high school Spanish.

Never gives 100% to everyone. Top students should expect an average of 85%-90% on every assignment. Group efforts are all collective, so if someone doesn't do their share, expect disappointment. Is not satisfied with anyone's work; very nitpicky; gives very little constructive feedback. All instructions are very vague and difficult to comprehend.

No unit exams or finals, but Haywood is the hardest grader on earth. No one in my class got 100% on a single assignment the entire semester. No paper/project/presentation is good enough for her. Expect to get an average of 85%-90% on any given assignment. Group projects are collective, so if someone doesn't do their share, expect disappointment.

Lectures were uninteresting and she uses so many filler words when speaking that it is hard to focus. Also, the tests and assignments seemed to grade students on whether they can locate information in a slide rather than applying knowledge in an engaging way. Coursework was so tedious and felt like a waste of time.

Profesora is amazing! You have to read outside of class and take notes on it, but they are interesting selections.We did two essays and a mini-presentation. The class is really interesting and engaging. There's a quiz almost every week with new information and recycled info. Take advantage of office hours, she will give amazing feedback!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, balanced work schedule and a comfortable environment in class

Overall a good professor. If you are a native speaker she tends to grade harder. Participation and attendance matters. If you miss a class without letting her know she'll give you a midterm grade. Would take again.

This was a great class. The class environment was awesome, and she made the projects very enjoyable. There is extra credit, that is very helpful, but you do need to participate in class to get a good grade.

Rachel is awesome! Even though she is a tough grader, and her courses are difficult. She really cares about her students, and her lectures are very enjoyable. I really looked forward to going to her lectures because of the great class environment that she fostered and because of how engaging her lectures were.
Assigns a lot of homework.
Such a nice person, and her classes are informative. You'll learn more than other profs in the department. so much homework though. hours of hours of work
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Loved Rachel. Very nice, wants to help, encouraging. Homework is either grammar relatedreading short stories and answering ?s online, tests are in form of quizzes, 6 per semester, pretty easy (cover grammarstories read), loves her job, makes class fun, culture aspects brought in, really great teacher for this course! speaks English fluently too

Very witty, always called me out, which I appreciate because I usually don't speak out. Very helpful in her office hours. Also taking 314 with her made 333 a lot easier. She demands a lot, but take the time to talk to her, she'll help you figure things out

Rachel was a very good professor. She is very passionate about literature. The content was difficult at times, but if you sought help, she did everything she could to aide you in getting a better grade.

Tough teacher. Intellectually, she's way overqualified to be teaching at ISU. Smart, and quite witty. It's very easy to get behind, so I'd suggest just not doing that. Use her office hours. There, you will find that her rigorous expectations aren't of sadistic nature,but because she is genuinely interested in what she teaches. Take her class.

Rachel is a tough, but fair teacher. She emphasizes in class participation. Ask questions if something is not clear, as she will assume you know something if you don't. Office hours were quite helpful. Overall very good teacher if you put in the effort.
She actually cares about her students. Do all homework, it's worth as much as the tests. Focus on getting the homework right an the tests will be easy.

If you care about Spanish at all, you will be fine in this class. She's clear about her expectations and is a very sensible person who is willing to help you with about anything if you just ask! She is always upbeat and smiling, and has a very warm personality - everyone smiles a lot in my class. She's not a native speaker, but you can hardly tell.

Fun spirited, personable, and easy to relate to.  I felt as though I had known her for years the first day I walked into the classroom.  The class is fast paced, and she expects you to be your best, participate, and ask question if needed...as any professor should.

She was a pretty stupid teacher. Shes not clear on what she expects from students and can come off as ignorant many times. I am from Puerto Rico and a native speaker and would definitly NOT recomend this class to anyone wanting to learn spanish

I took this class last semester.  She is like a tornado and is not very clear in her expectations.  She also plays favorites.   I wish I had never had her, and she certainly is one of the weakest professors in the department.

She was very hard..her accent is from Argentina. Sometimes she confuse the class. She expect too much from you even you dont understand the text. I dont recommend her for Spanish non-native. I pass the class because im native, but my friends work were failing the class.

Probably my favorite prof in the Spanish dept. Her style of teaching really makes you learn the material and she seemed to be extremely flexible with all of the students' needs. She expects a lot out of you but is always willing to help if you ask her. If you are a span major I would highly recommend her.

this class was very difficult as a freshman first semester.  however, she was very willing to help. she answered emails promptly and taught me one on one two hours a week. the class was a lot of work but very useful.  after i got a tutor and started goign in to her office hours i got an A- which was better than i was expecting!

Very good professor, can be hard to understand if you are expecting a Mexican accent,but it becomes easier. The homework is very important and practicing is even more important. Her tests are not impossible if you study. The oral work is what most of your grade is based on. Great class, highly recommended for anyone who enjoys Spanish.

Although this prof. knows her stuff, she frequently expects too much from her students.  It seems like every time one major assignment is done, she expects you to be starting another one- it's a hard class to fit into a full schedule.  Also, she grades extremely hard.  Very difficult for non-native speakers.
She just expects way too much and is rather boring.  She also plays favorites.

Hard prof. Very smart, knows her subjects well. She can grade tough. Gives out a lot of assignments and tests can be tricky. Go to office hours and she'll help you lots. She likes her students she just expects A LOT from you!! Keep up w/readings, WebCT assignments, and take notes! May be diff. if your spanish is rusty.
A lot of reading, but a good course.  If your spanish is decent and you're okay at english lit type stuff it's not too bad.
The class was way too difficult for a beginners portuguese class.  The only people that did well in it were people that had port as their first language.  It was my worst grade at Iowa State by far.

I agree with the previous entry. I would definately NOT advise taking this class w/ her. It took an incredible amount of effort to keep up with the reading and feel prepared for the lectures and tests. She's not very friendly.
Class was extremely challenging, and work was far beyond what should be expected in an elementary literature course. I would NOT suggest it.

This class was challenging but great.  It stretches your spanish knowledge and really makes you think.  Go to office hours and you'll do well.  Prof is great and wants to be involved with her students.  Highly recommended!

Regular quizzes with associated homework. Graded mostly on participation for homework with one or two problems for correctness. Mostly fine professor overall, one or two units I thought the lectures weren't that good. Not many example problems.

Ren likes to ramble in her lectures, and the content is not pieced together very well. ME411 is also a confusing tech elective. It feels like a continuation of controls. Exams were take home, and homework was not too hard. Unless you loved controls, you are better off taking a different tech elective.

ME418/518 is one of the hardest tech electives offered. Conceptually, it's cool. But practically I would recommend staying far away from this class. Lots of linear algebra and diff eq and long math. Ren also does not make the class any easier. Don't risk your GPA for this class. If you really want to learn robotics, just find the textbook online.

ME 421 is full of confusing and difficult topics, so it is very important to have a professor who knows what she is talking about and is good at teaching, which Dr. Ren is. If you want an easy A, maybe find a different professor but if you want to actually learn and understand the material, she is fantastic.

Lectures are less than useful as she tends to ramble or go in circles about the content in her slides. 
Class is graded on very few things which comes out to each point earned or lost being equal to 0.5% of your grade. 
Very tough grader for Quizzes and Exam.
Homework is straight from the textbook and way easier than the Quizzes and Exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Nice, caring professor who wants us to do well in the class. 

That said, I'd stay FAR away from this class. Its description doesn't match the catalog: there are no robots or simulations, just linear algebra. I felt like a number: I wasn't challenged to learn or rewarded to try new things. Get the textbook; every problem and slide comes from there.

She is a very good professor. If you stop into her office hours she will help you in anyway possible. She even changed her teaching style to feedback received from office hours. This class can be tedious, be useful. The lab portion is easy, but annoying, but possible to be changed in the future.

First half of the class was based off the textbook that you will need for homework and readings. Second half of the class was learning MATLAB. As long as you meet people you can work with for homework assignments and the MATLAB project you will be fine. She really cares about you and if you need help don't be afraid to reach out to her.
She is a good lecturer and she cares. The class did get confusing towards the end though. If you do the homework and understand the in -class examples before the quizzes, you will be fine.

Ren really cares about you learning the material. She goes through lots of examples in class which are helpful when doing the homework. The book is really useful when doing the homework as it has several problems like the homework. Exams weren't too bad, and the problems were very similar to the practice she posts. A hard course with a great prof.

She always answer the questions in the class. If you have a question and go to her office hour, she will help you. She is really clear in a lecture. Although the course was hard, she made it easy for us to learn. She is really kind when talking to the students or in the class. She gives good feedback on homework and the grading is fair.

She's very knowledgeable about the material, and used a lot of examples to explain the concept. Have to admit this is a hard course, and she's always there to help during the office hours. She could explain things in different ways to make sure the students could understand.
Not clear during lecture.  Be prepared to read and study by yourself.  Is helpful if you make time to go in during her office hours.   Not much homework.

Dr. Renu is a very good professor. Her class allows you to work in groups through team-based learning. She is a very good grader and also easy to approach out of class as well. Her exams have two attempts, and they're easy if you study and review. She provides enough extra credits to improve your grade, too.

Renu is a great professor who enjoys having conversating during the lecture. She likes having students answer questions and is always willing to go further in depth on a concept if it wasn't understood.
All the tests are on Quizlet, and there are 2 attempts per exam. Team Bases Learning sucks, but is required, it's not hard but annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Interactive lectures. This professor will go out of her way to help you succeed. She provides abundant resources and extra credits to help you. She is accessible and accommodating. It is hard not to succeed in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Renu is very nice and lectures well. She is engaging in class and talks to students. Course is heavy on reading outside of class and participation through Tophat.

Renu has a loyal fanbase in the biology department, and for good reason. If you do not like her, YOU are the PROBLEM. If Renu has no fans I have clearly died. This professor will fight harder for your grade than you will. You might think you're competing for points, but really you're competing against her determination to help you succeed.

She cares about her students so much. She gives out a lot of extra credit. You can redo all of the practice assignments and can retake all of the exams. If you pay attention and do your work it isn't too hard of a class.
The sweetest teacher wants you to succeed.

Dr Renu was one of the funniest professors I had and always made sure people understood things. There is a decent amount of homework, and there is a lot of reading of the textbook, but she provides a lot of extra credit opportunities (like 15 points) and chances to improve your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She's an amazing person. She gives out so much extra credit, and for her exams, you can have up to 2 attempts!

Dr. Renu is the best. I've had over 100% in her class for the entire semester. She offers a TON of extra credit. Every exam you get 2 attempts, and its the same exam both times (same questions, same order). She is so sweet, and very funny. She provides lots of resources for students, and even does Webex reviews before exams. Absolutely love her.
So much extra credit. Allows you to take tests twice, hard material, but she is the sweetest and makes it as easy as she possibly can. If you put in effort to learn, you will do just fine.
Awesome. Enjoyed the class! Easy grades.

LOTS of extra credit, but also a lot of assignments with low points that add up to a significant total. Caring professor. Content wasn't too difficult. She gives 4 exams that can each be taken twice and keeps the highest score. She also drops one of the first 3 exams, with a mandatory final.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Renu was very professional, but still kept the mood lighthearted during lectures. Most of the information necessary for exams was given during lectures, and good supplemental information was provided on her canvas page. Communication between myself, Renu, and the TA was quite smooth and there weren't any problems with contacting her.
She has an accent, so it's sometimes difficult to hear her, but she's incredibly sweet.

This teacher gives you multiple attempts at assignments and tests. She explains the coursework clearly and in a way that helps you understand it. Make sure you take notes, review the slides, and ASK QUESTIONS. The only way you will fail this class is if you don't go to the lectures or do your assignments.

Dr. Renu was one of the most passionate professors I have met at ISU. She clearly cares for the material she teaches, and is always willing to meet students who are struggling. She is also very funny, making her lectures fun to attend. She has many extra credit opportunities throughout the semester, so you really do always have resources to help!

I took this class online over the summer so it was a fast paced course but she provided lots of resources and was extremely helpful despite the difficult amount of content. She provided online lectures, supplemental videos, vocab flashcards, and practice exams which were super helpful.  Would definitely take a course with her again!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Renu is a great professor. She is always available for the students and willing to help. Be a great student and she'll be a great professor and resource for you.

Dr. Renu is an Awesome professor, she really takes her time with the lessons to ensure everyone understands what's she's teaching and she has lots of resources to help with the course as well! She's Super funny also

I took Bio 212 in Fall 2024 and this is by far the best class i've taken at Iowa State. Dr. Renu is funny, her TopHats are immersive, and the material is really well presented in class. I genuinely enjoyed coming to lecture everyday and the way she taught and cared for her students was impeccable. Overall, an amazing professor and an amazing class.

I took BIOL 212 with Dr Srivastava in Spring 2025, and she was great. She used top hat questions for participation, and she had posted her past videos to watch after the lectures. Her tests were pretty straightforward and aligned with the lectures. She provided lots of extra credit. She truly wanted her students to succeed.

Professor Srivastava was a great professor who knew the material she was teaching. She helped explain complex topics in Biology in a simple and straightforward way. She also made several jokes during class which made everyone laugh. However, make sure to pay attention because she goes through a lot of slides pretty fast, and you can get lost.
The GOAT so much extra credit
Engaging and funny. Excelled at making the work simple and understandable. Clearly passionate about teaching.

Dr. Srivastava is a fantastic professor; if you're planning on taking Bio 2120, I absolutely recommend her! There are weekly quizzes that you can work with a group on and a couple of assignments. There is a lot of content in the course, but she shares it in a very digestible way. She's always there for her students; 5/5 would recommend.

Dr. Renu cares about her students and tries to make sure everyone can get a good grade. She offers extra credit and will open some assignments past the due date. She also allows 2 attempts per exam. You do have to put in some work to succeed in this course, but as long as you attend lectures and do homework, you will be fine. I enjoyed this class!

She is an amazing professor and does an incredible job making sure everyone is successful. She cares so much and is so passionate, she wants everyone to be successful and has extra credit and consistently reopens assignments so you have everything you need to be successful

Simply excellent! I took her course in Fall 2024. She coaches her students well and carves an excellent path forward for college. She lays down clear expectations for college students. I am happy to have taken BIOL 212 from her and am now enjoying BIOL 2560!

Dr. Renu's class structure left a lot to be desired for me. She insists on reading the chapters before class,  but the homework assignments on those chapters aren't due until after class, so knowing what to read when is a bit difficult. Her canvas is confusing and she has "Team Based Learning" assignments in class which are frankly just annoying.

Dr. Srivastava was a lovely person but I didn't much like her class. Her slides regularly diverged from lecture topics and she moved very quickly in every lecture. She didn't do a very good job of creating an environment where anyone wanted to work together or answer her questions during lecture.
I loved having Dr. Renu!! She was very kind and always willing to help. Her lecture directly covers what is in the textbooks and covers everything on the exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This professor gives out lots of extra credit opportunities. Class isn't optional but does TopHat in class for points, so take that as you will. This class allows 2 attempts for every exam which was super beneficial.

Dr. Srivastava is very approachable and willing to go over the content with you if you're struggling. She gives many opportunities for extra credit. Her lectures are fast-paced but excellent for teaching you the material. Pay attention in lecture and do the homework assignments diligently, and you will score well on tests. One of my fav professors!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Renu was a great professor! I loved her enthusiasm for the lecture material and activities in class. She made the class interesting with lots of engaging material. I enjoyed taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Srivastava is very friendly and a strong lecturer. While the course is quick-paced, she lays out her expectations and will take time to explain difficult topics. You are expected to fill the gaps in your knowledge with the readings and homework, but she was willing to help by re-explaining or providing background information.

Awesome! Does a great job at teaching Biology. Slides are great for the course content.
Gives extra credits and explains topics thoroughly.

Dr. Renu is a very knowledgeable, nice, and funny professor. I do think she tried her best to teach us all well, however the slides are overwhelming and can be repetitive and confusing at times. There are MANY ways to pass this course however with extra credit offered often, 2 attempts on each test, and she opens top hats at the end of each week.

I liked taking her class, there was a great deal of extra credit at the beginning of the semester. It picked up in difficulty later in the class, but if you actually do the assigned work, then it's not hard. If you read ahead in the lecture slides, you will do WAY better in any of Dr.Renu's classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Srivastava has been a great help when understanding molecular and microbiology.the team based learnings has enhanced my social skills and allowed me to make new friends. This course is definitely difficult but with the right mentoring and teaching methods I was able to complete the course effectively.
Literally I leave this class every day with a headache. Why are we going through over 50 slides in a 50 minute lecture? Her lecture slides are very disorganized.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very easy to pass her class. You get two attempts on each test, along with a page of notes to take them. Lowest test score is dropped. She does team-based learning assignments in class, so check your canvas calendar and be there. Overall very easy and you don't need to attend class to do well.

the best professor ive ever had. gives so many extra credit opportunities (on EVERY ASSIGNMENT). if you dont pass, thats on you. she does use tophat in class for points but she also opens them after and if you missed them they can be done on your own time. tests can be taken twice with answers displayed after the first attempt.

I was terrified to take 314 after having a really poor experience in 313, but Dr. Srivastava was the best! Content is not always easy, but she cares about her students and genuinely wants you to learn the material. Her exams and assignments were very low-stress. It allowed me to do well in this course despite not being good at bio. She's the best!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She gave a bunch of extra credit and was pretty easy to learn from
Dr. Renu is so caring and is an amazing teacher.  She cares for her students so much and she is really passionate about the subject manner.  I would highly recommend her for any course :)
Great Professor! Explains everything well.

Dr. Renu was so sweet! I loved how she gave feedback on the course surveys we had to complete. You could tell she truly cared about her students and the class and has passion for what she teaches. Going to class isn't mandatory but should be because you'll miss out on points if you don't especially tophat. Tests and hw assignments were pretty easy.

The GOAT. I was very worries about bio, as I struggled with it in high school and nearly failed it, but with Dr. Srivastava it was super simple, easy exams, and even though attendance was not mandatory there were extra credit assignments available for showing up to class, would 10/10 recommend taking her class.

She was a great professor, who cared about the success of her students. She has in-class assignments, but you can make those up outside of class. She works with students to make sure that they succeed. I never read the book, but I was definitely struggling compared to some of my peers. Plenty of SI, and she holds reviews on Webex for harder topics.

Dr. Srivastava is the best professor I've had in my college career. She is truly caring and passionate, she truly wants her students to learn and succeed above all. Her exams are easy and straightforward. While attendance is not mandatory it is highly encouraged as she offers assignment make-ups and extra credit assignments. Take this course!

Prof. Renu is hilarious and caring. She is very committed to teaching every individual student and will often offer to teach a whole lecture or more content individually or for a group upon request. It's obvious that Renu loves Biology, but is also hilarious in lectures. She will even remember names of random students in lecture halls of over 100.

Dr. Stravasta is a great, humorous professor. She helps explain the course material well, loves her students, and wants them to get involved. Bio 155 was an intro course to human anatomy/functions. She started the lecture off with a smile and took the time to get to know me. Looking for an easy science credit? I highly recommend this class.

I liked the structure of the class, but it is fast-paced. She is very open to questions, nice, and funny. You get 2 tries on tests (5 total exams) and the weekly homework. Lots of EC quizzes. Didn't like how you are assigned a "team" who you have to team-based learning with and she uses Top Hat.

Dr. Srivastava makes Tophat participation, so you just have to worry about trying your best to learn and not be perfect.
