Wendy is nice lady. She does fill in the blank notes  so I would recommend going to class. There are a lot of extra credit opportunities that you can take advantage of. She takes forever to grade stuff. The lectures, while informative, can be very boring. Go to the reviews before the exam cause that's how you find out what's actually on the exam.

She does fill in the blank notes and a daily attendance tophat code. She's sweet and lectures are understandable. She has lots of extra credit opportunities. All assignments are super easy and quick to do, and we're given a ton of time to complete. Her biggest issue is grading. Takes her weeks for exams and at least a month for assignments.

Took 4 weeks to grade the first 2 exams, but 4 days to grade the finals. Took 6 weeks to grade the presentation. Always used grad school for the reason of her messiness. If it is not her priority, she will procrastinate on getting it done. Took at least 2 days to reply to emails. Get annoyed if I started asking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: All online. Lectures were very slow and boring. Class was laid out terribly and I never knew what was due or how to do it. Tests always seemed easy but I did not do well on them.

Wendy is a really nice and sweet lady, but her lectures are usually boring and dry. She has some humor which makes class more bearable, but honestly you can skip class and get an A. Grading consists of 3 exams, 2 easy assignments, and a ton of extra credit (TopHat, a few assignments, and 1 group project). I learned a lot from this class though.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is so sweet and seems like she really cares about her students. There is a TON of extra credit and it is pretty easy to get an A. You don't HAVE to go to class but there are extra credit polls in class that can bump up your grade a lot.

Dr. White is an excellent professor for FSHN 167! Her class is fun, enjoyable, informative, and rather easy. Her exams are very similar to the practice exams she posts on Canvas and the final is not cumulative! LOTS of extra credit opportunities are available and I would highly suggest taking advantage of them!

You'll be using TopHat in this class every day for attendance and polls. Make sure to take advantage of the EC options as there are so many. You will only have 2 assignments and 4 exams(the final is not cumulative, use the study guides and tests from the year b4) over the whole semester. Dr. Wendy White is a great professor and you do learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Wendy White is a sweet lady, but I would not recommend her as a professor. Goes off on frequent tangents straying from the material/curriculum, and lectures are not interesting. Uses TopHat, but does not understand how it works and refuses to help students when there is a glitch. Penalized after 5 missed classes (or attendance codes). 0/10

Great professor, easy class. Good information that is helpful for a healthy lifestyle. Lestures are easy with fill in the blank nots and she gives lots of opportunities for extra credit. A great science credit for those who are not scientific.

Wendy is great! This class is easy and interesting. DO NOT buy the book, its not required and you will never use it. She provides fill in the blank notes that you have to print yourself. She uses Top Hat. Just show up honestly.
She's a funny lady and makes the lectures interesting. Overall super easy A and holds her own test reviews before each test that go over everything you need to know. Textbook not needed at all.

Lecture was pretty dry but sometimes the professor threw in some fun games like a run on the price is right. Lots of extra credit is offered so take advantage. Go to review sessions offered before tests.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is pretty easy, her lectures are boring, but thats how you get all the notes. I didn't really pay attention in class and I finished with a good grade. Just study for the tests based on your notes and you should be fine.

Don't need the textbook, be sure to go to class for lecture notes and top hat points, tests are pretty easy as are other assignments, very sweet lady, lectures a bit boring, spends a lot of time on one topic
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher! If you just study for the exams you will be fine! She offers a lot of extra credit so it's very hard to do bad in this class. Side note- when she plays videos be ready to plug your ears (so loud)

Overall, she is my HOMIE. Attendance isn't mandatory, but she almost always does attendance polls and tophat points. The few assignments we had were very easy and the tests are easy if you do the study guide or go to the review session. Don't buy the book. She is very nice and genuinely tries to get to know her students.

She posts the tests with answers from last year to show you what to study. Easy professor who wants you to get good grades. Top hat points, but all that means is that you have to show up and participate. Highly recommend.
Really Easy Class, as long as you show up and take the notes. Attend the night before study sessions and she addresses like every question on the test
Fill in the blank notes, takes attendance everyday. She gives you previous tests to study from. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: SHE IS ADORABLE! THERE ARE CLICKER QUESTIONS, BUT THEY ARE ONLY ABOUT 1 POINT, SO YOU DON'T HAVE TO GO TO ALL.  EXTRA CREDIT IS OFFERED, BUT NOT MANY POINTS.  TESTS ARE PRETTY EASY.

The tests aren't hard if you show up to class and do the review/last year's exam as practice. She offers SO much extra credit. It's a GPA-booster class if you're looking to fulfill one of your science credits. Take it in the fall with her because she is way easier than the spring semester professor. DO NOT BUY THE TEXTBOOK! Never opened it!

The lectures aren't that bad and there is a clicker point each day, she also takes specific parts from videos she shares in class into the tests. So if you go it is easy points and tests are not bad at all if you go to her review session. Overall, if you take this class you should definitely take it with her. easy and enjoyable.

A couple group activities and opportunities for extra credit.  Clicker questions count towards attendance grades so you'll want to go to this class.  Tests are straightforward and she provides crystal clear notes.  Great class to take to fulfill a Science credit.  Focus on the non-science content and more real life applicable.

Don't pay attention to the syllabus.  It won't be followed.  Most test questions come from lecture notes but there were a few related to guest speakers or videos.  I found the tests to be easy because they are multiple choice and there's no attempt to trick you.  Textbook is very well written and interesting but not needed at all.

Her lectures can be very boring but very informatioal. She has you print off powerpoints with blank in them to take notes but you can easily just write them on paper. She has review sessions which makes it easy to study for her exams if you can go to them. Her assignments are fairly easy and many extra credit opportunities.

Wendy's class is fairly easy. fill-in-the-blank notes make note taking easy. Just go to class you you should be fine. She gives quite a bit of extra credit as well. There are 2 review sessions for each test that are really helpful. DON'T buy the textbook! Never opened it.

DO. NOT. BUY. THE. BOOK.  I read all of these entries thinking that the people that didn't buy the book are silly, but I'm the silly one that has a dusty book on my desk.  All the tests are based off of her powerpoint presentations.  Never once have a looked at the book.  There is NO outside of class reading.  Make sure to go to class.

This class is pretty boring, also really difficult and her exams are 50% things you didn't discuss in class. She throws facts at you too which makes it hard to feel like you're actually learning about nutrition. She's pretty cheesy too she does a lot of game show challenges. She also does this weird thing with her mouth when asked a question.

Wendy is very soft spoken and kind. I took this class as an elective and attended every lecture, but while taking the class I thought it was very easy but the tests were a little difficult, even when going to the test review sessions. She has fill in the blank slides and plenty of very simple extra credit assignments. Overall, a good class to take.

Do not buy the book!! Not worth it at all, she never references it. To be honest I spent the entire semester in the back on my laptop and didn't pay attention at all and got a pretty good grade. Go for the clicker points, go to her reviews and study hard and paying attention won't matter. Turn things in on time and do all the easy extra credit.
This professor is soft spoken but her powerpoint presentations are clear and exams are very easy. Don't buy the book because you don't need it at all. Overall I would recommend her for this course.

She's an alright instructor.. I wouldn't say that I actually learned anything valuable. she pretty much just talks about whatever she wants, so the book is not needed. she also does test reviews and gives you old tests so attending class isn't really necessary

first off- don't buy the book. her tests are only over her lectures (which she gives fill in the blank notes). she does give random points for attendance, so try to go. a moderate amount of extra credit available. also gives study guides, review sessions, and old tests for all exams in the class.
Overall an alright lecturer. Very nice lady who does fill in the blank notes. Super easy topic and she is very knowledgeable over it. Do not buy the book! I recommend her fully.
She didn't follow the syllabus and the notes were not consistent with the exams. I dropped the course because she was rude and not helpful.

Even though she wasn't the greatest, I'd rather have her than anyone else. Go to class because she does fill in the blank notes and always talks about things that will be on the tests. Don't buy the book, its not mandatory and whatever you need from the book she'll teach in class. Gives a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Nice professor. A lot of extra credit opportunities. DO NOT buy the book! She does not teach from it. You have to attend class because she puts spaces in her notes so if you don't go you won't do well. She is not willing to help you if you have problems with the course.

I loved having her as a teacher. She gave good extra credit opportunities, was very nice, and held review sessions before tests. She only tested over stuff we went over in class which was nice. Interesting subject.  Don't need the book though.

She was not a very good public speaker since she often forgot her train of thought or mumbled. Forget asking her for any help whatsoever because she will flat out say no. Again, i never cracked the book once so save the $

As everyone else said don't buy the book. Tests are all over the lecture notes so you'll end up with a million sheets with like 2 words on each page. Overall a pretty easy class if you are capable of tying your own shoes.

Don't buy the book, she only tests on what is covered in class which is the slides you can print out.  She is an awkward speaker/teacher but she tries and will clairfy if asked.  Tests are curved and lots of opportunites for extra credit.
This professor was challenging but you learn a lot! The book is a waste of money but the class is good. She sucks at giving you help though- I asked her for help one time and she openly told me no.

This class was very easy, don't listen to those other people. I never opened the book, definitely not worth the money. I have gotten A's on all the tests and I rarely go to class. She always curves the exams and has A LOT of extra credit opportunities (that are easy!). Just go to the review session before each exam and study last year's exam.

She was really stuck up and acted like she was better than her students. The classes were hard to follow and the tests very hard to study for. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME AND MONEY ON THE BOOK!!!! Oh and i could never eat before the class or within an hour or so after class because she made me feel fat

She was a very clear teacher and made sure you knew when everything was due.  Tells you exactly whats on the test within the slide notes for each class.  Sucks to print them off all the time, but worth it.  Don't even use textbook. People who complain about it being hard are only those who don't try. Lots of extra credit opportunities as well.

This class was very boring....She would post the lecture notes online but leave blanks in them so you could fill them in however it was a waste of paper because she would not follow the notes she posted. It was very frusterating and made me so mad. I found the class pointless, she wasnt very helpful but she does offer a lot of extra credit.

I found this class very difficult.  Her lecture was hard to follow, its hard to get her detailed notes and be able to understand them.  If you aren't an FSHN major it is extremely difficult, and the worst part about it is that this is the introductory class!  I found her very unapproachable, very nice lady but hard to talk to.
This class sucked along with the exams.  I dropped the class because I know the other teacher is alot easier and she doesn't have exams.
SOOO easy...dont bother reading the book...just study notes and do all the extra credit...in fact dont even buy the book

Study the old tests and you'll be fine.  I once slept through a test and came in at the end and she let me make it up...so she's pretty nice just go up and talk to her and make sure she knows who you are, it'll help.  You don't really need the book.
Kind of boring lecture, but old tests are posted online and study guides are both great study guides for tests.
No Comments
Casey is very easy to work with and cares about student success. Do your work, don't push it off until the last minute, and you can easily get an A in this class.

Casey was honestly the best professor I have ever had. He is so funny and chill but clearly cares about his students and what he teaches. He allows a good amount of time for each project and is a mildly tough grader but not difficult by any means. He made a class that may have been boring fun to come to every day.

Doctor White was an amazing professor. I learned a lot with this class especially as a senior who is graduating. This class really helps you prepare for real world reports and consulting proposal. The tools given to us made everything easier to understand. He is a professor that actually breaks the sections of the paper so its not overwhelming!

Great guy! He's super funny and really wants to help students succeed. He will give you the opportunity to revise almost every paper you don't get an A on and is super laid back. Took ENGL 314 last semester with a different professor had had to drop halfway through the semester but Dr White made the class so much better the second time around.
Great guy. He honestly wants to help you succeed

He was one of my favorite professors! I usually don't enjoy English classes, especially when there is a lot of writing involved, but I did enjoy 250H with him. He made class interesting and lets you write your papers about whatever you're actually interested in.

I had Casey during his first semester teaching this class. He asked for a lot of feedback on everything we did in class which led to almost letting students help design the cirriculum. He is very sensitive to what students are feeling, and moved a couple of deadlines when we were all busy. Very funny guy and awesome professor.
He is the best!! Highly recommend, I'm taking him again next semester, that should tell you how awesome he is!
Casey is an awesome teacher who clearly cares a lot about his students. He's always super clear about what he expects from you. He's pretty funny too.

Casey is great! I hate english normally, but this was my favorite class so far at ISU. He is very helpful, funny, geeky, and he really cares about his student and what  he teaches. I have learned so much from him about not only english, but also being aware of social issues. He is an absolute gem.

Best english teacher I have had. He assigns pretty big projects but he provides a lot of help, encourages creativity and is a nice grader.  Overall he's really funny in a geeky sort of way and very personable. you'd be luck to have him.

Casey is one of the finest instructors you can find at ISU. Very lively and friendly to students. All you have to do is attend the class, have fun and put some hard work. He always appreciates students who puts in good efforts and willing to help them at all times :)
Casey was a great help. If you do your work, come to class and really try the class isn't hard.
Even though the class was a bit harder than it should have been, Casey did a great job of teaching it. I really learned a lot from him.
He is always crystal clear about what he expects from you and is always willing to help.  He is very approachable, and is always well prepared.
Hes a nice and funny dude. He grades pretty tough, but he is clear about what he wants from you.
He is a really good teacher
Casey is an excellent professor and knows his stuff. He is very clear about his expectations and made the class interesting.
Great professor. Always made sure that you knew what was expected and always willing to help at anytime.
Great teacher. Very fun in class and has a great attitude. He is always willing to help you outside of class.

One of my favorite professors. Exams are focused on reflection and what you learned rather than regurgitating information which felt more appropriate for the course. He's flexible to the needs of students and very kind. Up to date coursework, two assignments included playing a game and watching the new knives out movie. Awesome, knowledgeable guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Wheatley is one of my favorite professors I've had so far. He is passionate about what he teaches and makes class engaging through discussions and fun projects. The coursework is manageable, and the class encourages you to think critically and grow.

He is an amazing teachers and I'll be taking classes with him in the future. I really enjoyed learning about religion with him. He does sometimes have a reading quiz to count for attendance so make sure you do the readings
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Great professor and interesting class. Expect to put in some work for the class, but still an easy A if you attend class and do the 2 essays and semester-long project (no presentation).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wheatley was a fantastic professor. He was passionate about the subject. The media analysis in the class was amazing, and the themes were super interesting. The final project wasn't necessary and was just a time waster, but he listened to our feedback and plans to get rid of it in future semesters, which I appreciate. Loved this class!

Wheatley was very passionate about the subject matter, so it was easy to listen and absorb the information and the assignments were very clear and easy to do. Instead of tests he has you do media analysis which I enjoyed and was happy to do. Would take class again if I could!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor. Uses a novel rather than expensive text book and provides the other readings to us. Very good lecturer that makes you want to pay attention. For our final we were allowed to pick between a final project we wanted to do or the exam. One of my favorite professors, in my top 3 at ISU.

Professor Wheatley is great at giving feedback and is always helpful if you have missed a couple classes due to illness. He is leanyent but don't take that for granted. He allows you catch up but if you do not participate the class will not be as fun and understanding and he does grade specifically on participation in some classes.

Easily my favorite professor I have had at college thus far. He is super relaxed and made the class really fun. He tries to connect to students more by chatting with them about his life & other things before class time. Class is required, but I never minded it. I actually wanted to show up.

Jeff was very accommodating to our all freshmen class. His lectures were well prepared and informative. While I didn't find the class to be very fun, the content was very interesting and I would recommend everyone to take a class of his. About 5% extra credit was offered. Religion in America The Basics by Michael Pasquier can be found online.

Definitely will take one of his classes again! His lectures are engaging as well as fun to learn about. Discussions happen a lot, however, he makes sure that everyone has a chance to say what they are thinking and is very fair. 10/10!

Prof. Wheatley is a really solid dude. You don't need the books really, but be sure to do the readings that are assigned because there are pop quizzes. The tests were pretty big but he was a reasonable grader. The content is really interesting and there are some cool things you do in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: go on youtube and search "that's why he's the goat" Professor Wheatley made every class fun and interesting and change the course by what we wanted to learn. You feel his energy and that he enjoys the class.

Excellent Professor. He deserves a promotion. As a student with strong religious convictions, he taught the course with great objectivity and limited bias. I have never met someone I'd trust so much to teach a topic as sensitive and diverse as religion.

Professor Wheatley is very passionate about his profession, which makes his lectures really interesting and fun. He is big on analysis, so the answers to exams are based off of that, not necessarily on the notes. Make sure you listen in lecture to hear the ideas he discusses so you know them for the exams or quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Wheatley maintains a perfect balance of specifically covering what will be on the exam AND keeping the class interesting with personal anecdotes and interesting relevant information. Pay attention, take notes in class and do the study guides, and you'll do fine on his exams.
Professor Wheatley is an excellent professor. I loved my time in lecture and he made sure to make it interesting.
Pop quizzes are about the readings, so make sure you at class and do the readings. He is open to talking to you about anything outside of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You get out of this class what you put in it. It's a discussion-based course so it is easy to learn from your classmates and grow with them. Professor Wheatley was so great at guiding was knowledgeable about the topics. A great class for those in the major as well as outside the major. It was a very safe environment and a great way to branch out!

I enjoy this class and the professor quite a bit. He is really accommodating to students' needs and really cares about his students' interests and wellbeing. He is also encouraging of curious questions and I really love how he is willing to have discussions with his students to teach us and learn new perspectives himself.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Wheatley is one of the kindest professors I've met, and his excitement for the content is palpable. It is clear to all of the students that he thoroughly enjoys what we do in class and wants us to enjoy it too. He seems to have a good understanding that this class was supposed to be easier and so he didn't assign too much work or anything

Professor Wheatley is a very dedicated and relatable professor. He cares about his students and the classes hes teaching; he wants his classes to be the best they possibly can be for his students. If youre experiencing any difficulties, he goes out of his way to work with you. Take a class with him if youre looking to both learn and have fun.

Professor Wheatley is one of my favorite professors. He is very considerate of the workload he gives and the circumstances students are under. The class includes a bit of out of class work, but the only homework is writing discussion posts and a lot of the material is quite interesting. His lectures are very engaging and the class is quite fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Wheatley is my favorite professor at Iowa State so far. He is laid back and understands students have more going on in their lives and was lenient with deadlines if there is a personal matter. He is funny and makes class enjoyable to attend. The work load was so easy to manage.

Professor Wheatley has by far been my favorite professor at Iowa State in my first semester here. He not only does a exceptional job at laying out the homework and readings for the week but he gives students questions and examples they should be looking for in their material. He appreciates the effort you put in and understands student's workload.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: I learned so much from taking his Religious Intolerance in America course. He is very knowledgeable and he understands that his students have a lot going on!

Professor Wheatley is someone who obviously cares about what he is teaching and makes sure that his students are understanding while enjoying the class as well. Assigns lots of reading/podcasts/videos but you can get away with skimming. Only graded on two exams and a weekly discussion post but a very easy grader if you show you actually tried.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is more focused on analysis, reading, and papers rather than memorization. Likewise there is a decent amount of class participation in discussions and such. Overall, he is very passionate about the subject and is great at explaining the different topics covered.
I havent finished this course yet, but Professor Wheatley seems like a really amazing teacher. He is very engaging, but you have a lot of reading and videos to watch each week. (Online School Year)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not sure why shes getting bad reviews on here. If you show up for class (many students don't and then complain about being confused or having bad grades), pay attention and participate this class is am easy A. Shes kind, her lectures are not difficult to follow and really does a great job. I would take her again in a heartbeat.
She seems to care a lot about students doing well and is generally nice but not a good lecturer at all. Very difficult to follow along and didn't put lecture notes on slides.

Nina is incredibly caring but I highly suggest to not take this class. She has no idea what she is talking about and can't answer anyone's question. She genuinely cares about her students and tries to help you, but she makes no sense and is incredibly unqualified. I learned nothing from this class. Also be prepared, there is hardly any biology.
Lies about syllabus rules. Should be on probation with the University. Extremely unprofessional and doesn't care about students.

Whisnant was a pretty solid lecturer for 221. I probably would have done worse in the class if I had a different professor, as I hear Whisnant was the best. I would definitely recommend him. Phys 221 at ISU is quite difficult (exam averages are usualy around 50-70%), but note that if you do well on the homework, quizzes and labs, then you're okay.

The lectures for this class were very intense. They moved so fast that I never learned anything in class. The recitations were the same way. The best way to learn was through the online homework and practice exams. Also, don't buy the book because you can find the previous edition as a pdf online for free.

This class was one of the more difficult classes I've taken at ISU.  I would say that if you have to take PHYS 221, try to get Whisnant, as he does go through the material fairly thoroughly in lecture.  Try not to miss class as much as possible though, as even though the slides are online, he does cover some valuable things outside them in classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I loved physics so it was easy for me. I went to lecture every class for the first half of the semester until i realized how little attention i actually paid. Top hat is extra credit though so go to class. Whisnant is an okay lecturer but focuses too much on equations and not enough on actual material
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Honestly I don't care if I get reported. Fuuck this class. Terrible format. Terrible material. Taught TERRIBLY(except by Whisnant, who MIGHT crack mediocre). Test worth about 85% of the grade even though you waste 5 credit hours doing tons of other tedious shiit like labs and recitation quizzes. WORST class at Iowa State. Take it online at IWCC.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Physics 221 is an absolutely horrible class. But, if you want to do well, get into his section. He mostly just runs through the powerpoints, but they are helpful with the homework and the clicker questions are actually good to know. I would definitely recommend getting a tutor. Study hard and do the practice exams and you should pass. Good luck.

PHYS221 is an atrocious class. I would only call Whisnant a decent professor, but as far as 221 teaching goes, decent is a blessing. If you took AP Physics in HS you'll be fine, but otherwise prepare to work your butt off. If you have to take 221, TAKE WHISNANT.
He basically just reads off of tis power points but the power points are clear and have helpful equations that are necessary and aren't on the equation sheet.

Physics 221 is a difficult class, but with Dr. Whisnant as your professor you'll be fine. As a whole, all physics 221 classes require tons of work but Dr. Whisnant actually explains the material and does relavent examples. Attend all the exam review sessions, do practice exams, and use the physics help room. He is the best 221 professor there is.

Whisnant is a great guy and if you have to take physics 221 he's the guy for it. His sections always have the highest exam class averages which were 68% this past semester. I recommend a tutor or going to SI because its a tough course. He goes through lecture fast but he posts the powerpoints online. I recommend going to class everyday.
It's a hard class, but he's one of the better lecturers. Notes are all posted online and they are very relevant for the homework.
Boring lectures but he knows his stuff. He is very average. The biggest part of the class is reviewing past exams and learning from those. Good luck!

phys 221 is a horrible class and none of the teachers are good for it.  I guess if you have to take the class, Whisnant would be your best bet because he at least speaks english without a thick accent no one can understand. good luck my friend.

Whisnant is definitely the teacher I'd recommend for Phys 221.  He knows what he is talking about, and is not as boring as the other professors.  Sometimes he goes through the math of example problems in lecture extremely fast, but overall his lectures are useful.  This class isn't as bad as people make it out to be, either.
Phys 221 is a horrible class but Professor Whisnant is definetly your best choice for a professor.

He is the most boring lecturer in the whole university, but he has really good intentions.  His tests are very hard, but he curves it along with an adjusted grading scale.  If you have another option for a professor, go with the other.  If not, you won't be in too much trouble.
Not the best, but not the worst. It is hard to get a good grade. Tests were almost the whole grade. He is boring to listen to, and he makes you want to skip class but you will be better off going.
Not the most intersting lecturer, but good at teaching.
Traditional physics professor. Lectures can be kind of tedious, but he's willing to help you out. He doesn't have any set office hours so you can talk to him whenever you want.
No Comments

White is a good professor and makes class engaging. I will say though if you are shy and do not like speaking up in class, you will not have a fun time in this class. I tend to not like speaking in class and get anxiety from it. White would point people out to speak. He needs to realize that not everyone is comfortable with that.

Attendance and participation matters a lot. If you're shy, be ready to go outside your comfort zone, because if you don't participate, good luck getting an A. Tests are pretty difficult, as there are no study guides, and since there's a lot of in-class activities, there's not much content from the slides to study. Otherwise an amazing teacher.
Get ready for sound malfunctions and quirky activities, Mr. white is a character.

More engaging than 99% of classes you'll take, but he doesn't take into consideration that many students just have different personalities. If you are outspoken you will easily get an A, if you are shy/quiet you WON'T do well in this class even if you study and do the work. He just needs to make your grade less dependent on how much you talk.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lets his students create the breakdown of class points--not ideal if you're a good test taker but don't like participating. Study for quizzes. Cases were bearable. Relatively easy grader. Offers extra credit through various activities you do in class. I really liked that he incorporated activities into lecture to make the class more interesting.

Not a bad professor. Participation is a huge part of your grade, and you can not skip class. He does a lot of engaging activities, and keeps class interesting. Case study's are the worst part of the class, but not a huge part of your grade. Some what a tough grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is a fabulous teacher! Top 3 best at ISU, participation is the most important thing and can make the different between a A- and a B-. He does fun class exercises and he's pretty charming and intelligent, a great mentor as well. The case study's are the worse but just read and try your best, they won't make or break you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Really great professor.  Really beneficial class where you can learn how the business world works.  Everyone can participate and learn  I don't like talking in class, but consistently found myself participating.

Prof. White was probably my favorite professor at ISU. He lets you choose the grading criteria within certain perimeters which was really cool. Participation is huge, so while attendance isn't mandatory, I wouldn't miss more than a few . He uses good illustrations of class material and great at engaging the class. I would definitely recommend him.

His class is hit or miss. I really like his lectures but some of his material can be a little challenging. He has in class exercises to supplement our learning and they are always spot on.  Participation is huge in his class so talk in every lecture and you should be fine. I would recommend him.

Super Duper Easy to Understand. He focuses on your understanding more than throwing all the knowledge to you. 1000000000000000 Thumbs up! I do not know whether I am going to get A in this class, but I understand most of the concepts he taught. :D

Dr. White was among my favorite teachers in the College of Business. He is very sincere and easy to understand. He has a dry sense of humor which I can really relate to. I read the chapters but not in depth and still did well on the RATs.

This class was a great balance.  It was hard but fair.  Dr. White is the most organized teacher I have had.  Everything went according to the syllabus, everything was clearly explained and I learned in every class.  Among the best teachers I have had ever.

Hands down, best class I ever took at ISU. I thought management classes were a joke, but I see class topics over and over in the "real world." Put in the time; your grade will reflect your effort. Dr. White cares about his students and loves to know where you're going in life and gives fantastic advice.

MGMT 478-- He is awesome! He keeps the class really entertaining and makes sure everybody gets involved in the conversations. Do the readings because the RAT scores make a difference... Loved him- one of my favorite professors at ISU!

Would not recommend unless you want to spend every hour working on classwork. Professor takes whole class time talking about pointless instruction. Harsh grader for seeming to not understand the material. Have to make everything abstract- throw your own ideas out the window. You also have to do more than what the assignment is asking to get full pt

- Did not grade anything until grades were due at the end of the semester
- Would tell you everything she didn't like/want, but nothing she does want
- Does not know the project or any deliverable details
- Very tough grader with ineffective critics
- Presents her own work the entire class wasting your in-studio time

Really seems to not know what she's doing. Spends HOURS of studio time talking about the assignment, somehow leaving you with no clarifying information and more questions. For all of the assignments, all of the professors changed or removed significant portions. Alicia only ever added or clarified to make things more difficult.

Brings down your want and confidence to a 0. Waited to give feedback on our semester long project until 2 nights before final presentations. Liked to think very abstractly, but then could not explain things or help those who think more literally.

While Alicia is nice, it's difficult to determine what her expectations are, as they remain unclear even after asking questions. We also didn't receive grades until after the semester was over, and even then, she didn't provide actual feedback on the project or assignments.

Alicia doesn't give clear expectations to her students and waits until the last week of the semester to grade so you have no idea how you're doing in the class. Her feedback is never helpful, it is always negative or insanely confusing. Most of your studio work time will be wasted. At least her grading isn't too harsh from what I've seen.

This professor is very self-centered, constantly telling stories about his life throughout each and every lecture. He scheduled an exam at 3pm on the Friday before spring break, made no accommodations for students with pre-planned trips and was very rude when asked about accommodations. He was not very responsive outside of the classroom either.

Professor frequently boasts about his accomplishments during class instead of covering class material. Is not very responsive to messages to the phone number he recommended the entire class to message. Professor scheduled an exam at 3 pm on the Friday before spring break, and did not allow for any accommodations.
Chillest class I have ever taken.

This is by far the worst class you could take at ISU. The slides have paragraphs of notes that you are supposed to write down in seconds before they are skipped. The exams test you over topics not covered in class and are designed to trick you. Just memorize and forget. Calc 2 and chemistry for engineers are both easier than this class.
Good lectures, makes an attempt to talk and get to know all the students in the class. You need to pay attention to lectures; she moves fast. Tests are hard but manageable.
She doesnt care if you fail multiple tests when she literally doesnt teach you guys anything

Dr. Wiedenhoeft is passionate about what she teaches, and I can tell she is very smart and knows a lot. This class is super easy if you have a strong background in biology (gen bio 1 and 2). I found the lectures interesting, but it is mostly base level stuff. She cares about all students and getting to know you. Assignments were quick and easy.

Dr. Mary is one of my favorite professors out of 3 colleges I have been to. The way she speaks made it easier for me to follow along. Guess we all learn differently. Some say she's strict, but she wasn't unreasonable, just holds everyone to the same standards. Though obviously she would not dock points for missing attendance due to a school event.

She cares a lot about her students and wants everyone to be successful... but how much information is too much. She crams very detailed information in a unorganized manner that makes it hard to understand. She purposely tried to trick you on test questions. As someone who likes crops and was excited for this class, I am disappointed.

Mary cares a lot about her students and wants them to all do well in her class. The material is hard but you are provided with many resources such as office hours multiple times a week, review sessions, extra optional videos and readings, as well as recorded lectures. I do recommend attending the office hours if you have questions or need help.

It was a tough class but it wasn't too bad after I went to a few office hours. I would recommend taking Biology before or during this class since there is some of the same content. Go to office hours and review sessions and you will do pretty good on the exams. Professor Wiedenhoeft is super easy to work with and she cares about her students.

I absolutely loved this class. Dr. Mary is a very caring person who is very passionate about what she teaches. She does tend to go speed through the lectures but you can ask her to slow down and she will. Additionally, tests are purposefully hard but she gives plenty of study material and reuses questions from pre exams so you aren't left drowning.

Absolutely awful teacher. She just zooms through her slides and doesn't give good examples. Purposely makes test questions confusing. Unclear directions for all assignments. Impossible to take notes. She doesn't connect her teachings, she just throws information at you. Such inconsistent material and lack of direction it makes it hard to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH THIS PROFESSOR!  She knows a lot about plants, but she has about 60 slides per lecture and goes very fast. She does not actually teach the material to you. Then, to make matters worse, she makes the exam very tricky because the questions are worded in order to trip you up and make you get them wrong. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS

The course requires a lot of effort and strategy. Due dates are clear and elaborated on, but many things are assigned. The lectures were jam-packed with information, and the tests had purposefully tricky questions, but Dr. Wiedenhoeft was nice and informative. It's manageable if you pay attention and study, but prepare to work for a good grade.

She's a horrible professor. The lectures didn't include all of the information that was needed. Homework was hard. She goes too fast for everyone to write anything down that was missed in the lecture outlines. Pre-exam were not relating to the information we learned in class. Don't take this class if you don't have to.

While taking her class I seriously considered changing my major because her class made it seem like agronomy would be too hard. Most of the things I learned for exams was done on my own outside of class. The class average on exams is usually 60% or lower. She words the questions in a way that makes you get them wrong.

This was her first time teaching this class and it should be her last. This is a senior class that should be an easy A, but it was not. Her assignments were worth a lot of points and she graded based on her personal opinion instead of true grading. She was very rude and did not care about how her students felt or wanted to learn about.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures and extra work did nothing to help me with the class I feel as if the exams we briefly related to the material covered in class but not to Pre exams or quizzes. Go to the review sessions/office hours that is the only way you get the information broken down to understand it.

she talks really fast but she post the lecture notes before and after class so focus on what she says cause you will have access to slides later. She also talks really fast so it's useless to try and write everything done. The grades are curved and she drops your lowest test, quiz and HW. She reeky cares about your success and is very caring

Hard class for seemingly no reason. Intro level Agronomy class that is stupidly specific. Exams are difficult, but don't bother studying your notes because she won't give you the time to right anything down, which she knows but apparently just thinks it's quirky and does nothing to improve it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ms. Wiedenhoeft is one of the best professors I have have she cares about the students and whether or not they are understanding the information if you aren't just ask her she will take the time to help unlike other professors I've had. she makes the lectures fun and informative the exams can be hard but pay attention in class and go to the reviews
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is incredibly knowledgable in agronomy, and you can tell she is super passionate about it. BUT, she treats her level 100 classes like they are a 400 level class. This is one of the harder classes I've taken here at Iowa State, and it's a 100 level class! She also gets very detailed in her tests, so make sure you are studying, A LOT!

Honestly one of the sweetest teachers I've ever had. I can tell she's passionate about the subject and cares about her students. I came in not knowing a lot about agronomy besides what I'd learned in high school, so I needed to work to understand the class. She was understanding and extremely helpful. I would 100% recommend Mary as a teacher.

She is very knowledgable about what she is teaching, but she doesn't know how to teach it to others. She teaches this class like a 400 level one. She gives weekly quizzes that don't have anything to do with what was learned during the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Best teacher I have ever had here. She is so patient. Try to ask questions and study with classmates. Easy to get A

I really liked this class! Mary is a little quirky but a great teacher. Short but not easy quizzes once a week on canvas and an assignment every other week. No busywork and best organized of all my big lecture classes. I hadn't taken a science class since 9th grade biology and I got by okay and learned a ton.

Unless you are required to take this class, do yourself a favor and dont take this class. She is the single worst professor at ISU and should not be teaching this class. Tests, homework, and quizzes are worded to intentionally trick students into answering incorrectly. Lectures are unorganized and she teaches like it is a 400 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Not the best at explaining things or teaching in general. Expects you to know a lot of things that you don't know. But if you find some friends, you can do alright.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Awful class. She is very knowledgeable, but its too much for an entry level course. Coming from masters students, material should be taught in 400-500 level courses. False and outdated material and presentations. Extremely hard and wordy tests. Dont take this class, more of a burden than anything else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mary is a GREAT professor! She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She is always asking what she can do better as a prof. However, you have to work a little for an A. If you pay attention in class you will do fine! There is NOT a lot of homework and it is super easy if you go to office hours (there are a lot of office hours).
terrible class organization, valuable info during lecture but not in slides.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is awful and is why I'm not Agron anymore. Mary is a really caring person and wants to see her students do well, but other than that she lacks in every area. Her lectures are all over the place. Tests are near impossible. Class average was usually 40%-60%. Does not follow syllabus. Makes the content way too difficult for an intro class.
Excellent professor, but a difficult intro class. The true/false correct the false questions on the tests are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Good prof, difficult but in a good way, what I thought college would be like honestly. The lead session is critical, the guy there is super helpful. I wish hw and tests were %50 each of the grade instead of %85 and %15 where tests are way more important. It is first time teaching this class, I can tell, but I think he will get better. I like him.
He's not a bad profesor. He just gets stuck with the low level courses. He can be a bit dry at times, but he's willing to help those who ask.
Not an enjoyable experience. He doesn't seem to have the students best interests in mind while in front of the class.

Very condescending and arrogant. I didn't learn very much from this course but the lab was really fun. If you get the opportunity to have Clay Anderson he is wonderful. Wlezien asks questions and then spends 20 minutes of class being disappointed because no one knows the answer.

Dr. Wlezien can be very condescending to students and acts like he is better than everyone else. He tells students not to ask him questions because he has more important things to do. The class is pretty easy and enjoyable most of the time since he only actually teaches about 6 of lectures.

Very arrogant and condescending. Makes people figure out their own questions or ask another person. Changed out flight date to a day earlier and eliminated very much needed practice and added a final the week before.
He is ok in teaching, but quite strict
He has zero interest in teaching, and will not answer any questions you have, be it aerospace related or even class structure. He is also incredibly condescending.
He doesn't really help with answering questions.
Condescending and likes to bully. He shouldn't teach. Not very approachable.
The worst! Very arrogant
Guy is a legend but prepare to read the material and do alot of notes to prep for quizzes.
Reading heavy and lecture heavy - class attendance is not mandatory, per se - but it is extremely helpful to be there. He is understanding if you have personal issues going on.

By far and away one of the best Professors at Iowa State. Very easy to talk to and is also very understanding. Even for someone not as interested in the class as others, it was a delight to be a part of it all year. I feel this professor could make any class enjoyable. (Took HIST 3500X but was not a rating option)
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Wolters is very lecture-heavy, and you must attend class to do well. You do need a textbook, but you don't need to memorize anything in there. It's mostly used for references on papers. The papers are around 1000 words, but he gives great feedback on how to improve. Exams are open note and as long as you take good notes in lecture, you will do well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are pretty standard for history classes meaning there are no words on the slides but not terribly hard to follow. Recitation attendance is required but it isn't hard. Exams are open book and open note but you take them in person so no access to internet. Overall pretty easy class with a professor who really cares and is approachable
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There are only 6 assignments so if you do bad on one say good bye to your 4.0. Very tough grader on papers, I haven't heard of anyone who has gotten 100% on a paper in this class. A lot of reading that is very boring
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Wolter's lectures are a breath of fresh air in academia. Dr. Wolter abandons the dense modern PowerPoint standard and rather utilizes images as an accessory to what he is saying in the presentation. The grading schema could do with some improvement. The quizzes have too short of a time limit and contain obscure specific questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As someone who hates history, Dr. Wolters succeeded in making his 284 class interesting. He is very knowledgeable and cares about his students. It's important that you attend every lecture to take notes because his PPTs are only images. Exams are easy. 5 papers to write, articles are lengthy and wordy- learn how to skim! 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: My class was the first 284 class he taught so we were an ad lib class. That said, Dr. Wolters really knows his stuff and wants you to do well. He cares about grammar in your papers but always gives good feedback to help you improve. Hist284 was really fun and I learned a lot from Dr. Wolters.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Not a bad professor on the whole. Tests are pretty average in difficulty. Assigns 3 or 4 papers, 3 to 4 pages. Couple flaws. Lectures are info-heavy, but he barely uses PowerPoint as a guide, which leads to scrambling to take notes. Textbook readings are obnoxiously dense and long, not worth reading- just skim it to study and do the papers.

Dr. Wolters is a great lecturer, he makes history relevant and fun! I would suggest definitely reading the text, it compliments lectures and that material will be on exams. Tests and papers are not the easiest, but once you get a hang for the format and requirements they're fine. There isn't a lot in the grade book, so every point counts!

I absolutely loved taking his course! As someone who isn't very interested in history, I was a bit nervous going into the course at first. However, he made this course so interesting to sit through! There are a few papers throughout the course, but if you go to class and take good notes, the papers should be no problem -only about 3-5 pages.

This guy is awesome.  Takes a huge interest in students and clearly loves teaching this stuff. I'm not a history major but this was an easy A for me. The reading can be a bit overwhelming but the quiz and test questions are not hard at all. Make sure you go to class, take good notes and read and you're set.

Attendance part of your grade, small quizzes on assigned books. Lenient grader on the first test, less so as they go on. His lectures are clear are comprehensive. The only negative aspect was a misleading portion of the final: described as a "big picture" assessment of the content of the course, it asked for more specific info than he lead on.

Dr. Wolters has a way of teaching that makes learning US history very interesting and enjoyable to go to class. He has a clear style of lecturing and makes it clear when quizzes will be held in class. He does not believe in pop quizzes. The textbook was an easy read. I would recommend taking HIST221 with Dr. Wolters.

Dr. Wolters is an amazing professor focuses on the big picture topics for us to ponder and question consequences in history. He is willing to help any student and makes it obviously how passionate he is about his study of work. I would highly recommend any of his courses!

By far one the better professors I've had at Iowa State.  The man made the class interesting, focusing on broader topics and themes instead of pointless date memorization.  He has a great passion for the subject, and I would recommend him highly

Weekly assignments are pretty easy and he is an easy grader with good feedback. Exams are in the testing center but pretty easy if you study the terms he gives you and watching the exam reviews he does help a lot too, although he can be difficult to understand. 15 page paper with a group for final which wasn't fun but doable

Poor syllabus. Easy grading on cases/reflections, be aware that the number of "thumbs up" received correlates to work quality, and that the final essay will be similar but graded more harshly. You should receive 5 "thumbs up" on your cases to be confident in getting an "A". Nice guy, and he gives good study guides. Be sure to attend exam reviews.

Never watched a lecture video. The weekly homework you will have is very easy. The lecture slides tell you everything that will be on exams, which is helpful. Exams are in the testing center. There are two papers at the end of the semester, one group and one individual (both easy). Would highly recommend taking online rather than in person.

Never watched a lecture video. 2 easy "homework" that you do each week. 2 or 3 exams that he gives you the exact information of what will be on them but they are in the testing center. One group project at the end (easy essay) as well as a personal essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Taking his MGMT 372 online class and it was an amazing experience. There are multiple reflections and exercises but it will be easy to get a full point. There are 3 exams worth 150 points, you will get a good grade if you follow his study guide. I even did not watch his recording lectures every week, followed his study guide and got an A.

Professor Wo is one of the nicest professors I have ever had. His teaching style is laid back and he is a very reasonable grader. He cares a lot about his students and is willing to help you out if you ask.

Professor Wolter may be my least favorite professor I've ever had. He was often combative and snippy when students approached him for help in lab. He would often interrupt students when trying to explain their issues in ArcPro. His lectures were filled with technical jargon, and he didn't elaborate on key concepts.

Took this class for my GIS Minor. He had just switched over to Trimble GNSS receivers and ArcPro which is great. Fun class, you get to be outside collecting points and such for labs. Only issue with him was I was not a huge fan of his exams, but they weren't too bad. Kind of trick questions that made you think a lot. Would highly rec him and 446

Took this course for the GIS minor, but my major is Animal Ecology. This was my first course with Wolters and it was pretty intense because there is a lot to learn about GPS fundamentals. The second half of the course is focused more on using GIS, but we only used ArcMap when I took the course. He is rewriting the course to use ArcPro.

reviews.comment: Took this class for the GIS minor. It was not worth it. The class is very focused on GPS and is very difficult, I would not recommend unless you are an nrem major or have a good science background. He is also very picky on map design and uses arcmap cause he wont switch to Pro.

reviews.comment: You'll be a better student because of his class. Go to platoon, go to office hours, go to exam reviews. The class is more difficult than anything freshmen take.
He's a good professor.

Absolutely do not take his class. Worst decision I have ever made. Might be the most rude professor in existence. He might be the worst lecturer to ever exist. Works faster than anyone can comprehend, and doesn't clarify misconceptions the whole lecture hall has. He does not care if you pass his class at all, and is only here for a paycheck.

Wibowo knows the material very well, too well.  He forgets that students are seeing the material for the first time.  VERY harsh person.  Instead of helping in office hours he will insult your intelligence before telling you "you did something wrong in your work" and sending you on your way.

Literally avoid him at all costs and go to Hosteng or Miner. Teaching-wise, he's fine, but he's condescending and rude. Berates students for not asking questions, but then belittles you when you do. Left his office hours once bc all he did was tell me everything I did was wrong instead of giving me feedback on how to fix it. Very rude instructor.

That guy can not be a professor He did not respect that I needed a religious accommodation He literally gave me a side eye and told me "then go register for another professor" Secondly trying to understand why I lost points in an exam he told me "I'm not here to bargain this is the grade" Register for other professors Do not make same mistake as me

I really enjoyed taking this class with Prof Wibowo. I wont sugar coat it, yes, the class is hard, yes it takes a lot of time, but you have to realize that the class is supposed to be. Prof. Wib. would help me outside of class whenever I needed it and always pushed me to be my best in class. Wibowo is very helpful walking through problems in class!
Horrible professor, very bad.  DONT TAKE
There's a reason why people outside his section get more grades/pass than people in his section.

I had this professor a few semesters ago, but after reading these reviews, I wanted to give him the credit he deserves. He can come off intimidating at first, but if you put in the effort he warms up to you a lot. He genuinely cares about his students and wants every single one of them to succeed, all you have to do is seek out his help.
There are two other professors that teach statics, and I would recommend them even though I have never met them.

treats students who get good grades better.he will talk about how students should feel free to ask questions but if you ask him a question he will stare at you for a good 5 seconds making you feel bad that you asked a question as if it was a bad question,telling you that you should know this by now.then gives you a non-detailed general answer
Challenging course with a lot of work. Very few graded items, exam-heavy, and harsh grading. Wibowo is awful.

reviews.comment: This professor is genuinely the worst form of instructor I've ever had. He preaches an attitude of hard work and progress, but does not provide any of the help you will need to find it. His responses to questions are the equivalent of saying, “Why aren't you smarter? Just be smarter. You're wrong.”

Okay. This professor seems rough when u first meet him but OMG HE EXPLAINS THINGS SO WELL. Do the examples, it's super easy to understand, and if u need help, make a mistake like screw up a submission TALK TO HIM HE WILL HELP YOU.

He wants you to succeed and he may seem like a jerk, but he is 10/10 wants u to succeed and understand material
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Wibowo gets so much unnecessary backlash from students. He is one of the most helpful professors I have had but can only do so much if you do not seek help/understanding in the first place. Statics is hard and will not become much easier if you do not dedicate sufficient time and effort to understanding the material. Stick with it!

I thought he covered the content well; he gave many examples that related well to homework and test questions. he is very responsive over email and will check homework answers in person. He is not the best at answering questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Had Wibowo for Statics Fall 2021. Expects you to watch videos outside of class, but goes through many examples in class. Can be very hard to follow, but they're good examples. Exams are tough and graded tougher. Wibowo is arrogant and sometimes shows students up. Platoons were helpful depending on your leader.

He knows the material well, and conveys fairly well. HOWEVER, he is the most condescending person I have met in my entire life. I can count on one hand the number of times he answered a question nicely the entire semester. Naturally no one wants to ask questions. But then when no one asks questions, he has to make a snide comment.

Challenging course with a lot of work. Not a lot of graded items, exam heavy, and harsh grading. Be prepared to truly experience the grind of college and the toll of getting a good grade. You can pass as long as hours are spent studying and reviewing work. Lectures & platoons are super helpful. He'll give valuable feedback when you go for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a hard class and some students do not want to put in the effort required. The professor is very honest and blunt, but definitely means well.
Easily the worst professor I've had in my life. What a nightmarish experience he creates.

The class isn't bad and the content is pretty easy to understand. Wibowo is awful though, when you ask him a question he scans you up and down making it look like you asked a dumb question when you actually didn't and is extremely sexist. Like if you aint't a female he ain't gonna take you seriously. Exams recently have been hard and the avg are 50
Has favorite and is not afraid to show it.

The material in this class is arguably easier than calculus, why then did 25% of people have to drop before the deadline? Hartanto also clearly prides himself on being a 'straight shooter' and being brutally honest, but only succeeds at being a rude, arrogant man. He waltzes around before class talking to almost exclusively women in his class.

Very accessible outside of class, always answers emails (even at 1 am), fun to talk to at his office hours, will do his best to explain topics if you come to him 1 on 1. In class though not so great. He did warm up toward the end of the semester when he met knew most people in his office hours. In my opinion he was not that bad, I enjoyed his class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class itself is not too bad, you just need to put in the work. Wibowo however, can be a rude professor. He appears to be open and tells people to ask questions, but often shuts down people and acts condescending. His "lectures" are also just him putting up examples on the screen and giving little explanation behind the problems or the concepts.

He is very knowledgeable but is extremely condescending and rude in the delivery of his teaching. Will belittle you for asking questions he deems obvious but will also judge you for not asking him questions. He is extremely unhelpful during office hours as he just ridicules you for not knowing something. Avoid him at all costs, he has no remorse.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. WIbowo isn't a bad professor but also he is not good either. The material isn't actaully that bad besides the first exam, and overall straight forward. My problem was timing, the exam is 90 min and it's 4 questions and almost nobody finishes before time and a lot of people skip a question so they can finish the other questions  on time.

Hart is a terrible professor. He doesn't understand how to communicate a basic course to undergraduate students. He shows no care for how much effort you put into the class. Make sure to drop this class, or change professors if you see his name on your schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Kinda of mean and tests are really hard with very little time given to take them
Has zero empathy for students, and only sees issues in black or white, no gray area ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: this professor is that he only cares about himself. He will tell the class that if they are not doing well they should drop the class. He calls students "dead weight" in class if they do not understand. He asks the class questions, and if you answer incorrectly he will degrade you in front of the class, saying "how do you not know this by now"

Gets undeserved flack from students, he cares and wants you to pass. Statics is a hard class no doubt but blaming Dr. Hart is not the way to go. Use the resources to pass like the newish CE help hours that ran from 5-8 everyday of the week when I took it, otherwise go to his help hours and platoon. He will also respond instantly at 1am emails.

I have never felt compelled to write a review about a professor, until Hartanto Wibowo. His lectures use simple examples that look NOTHING like the HW and you are better off praying then studying for the exams (they're 99% of your grade) because exams won't look like ANYTHING you've seen! He is condescending and pretends to care about his students.

The actual material that is being taught is fairly easy to understand. The professor, however, makes the class unreasonably difficult. He makes us attend a SECOND class every week (even though it doesn't count as an additional credit) and gives way too many homework examples in each assignment than needed. He is very harsh when grading them too.

Was this class fun? No. Did I enjoy myself? No. Did I learn a lot? Yes. Did I hate every second of it? Yes. Was it a beneficial experience for my future? Yes. Overall, Hartanto is a hard teacher, but you will learn a lot and benefit greatly from his classes. Make sure to work hard and set lots of time for studying and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dude was honestly kinda funny at first and I liked him. Then the first test came around and it wasn't even possible. Studied a minimum of infinity hours to most likely get a .1%. Probably just don't t even study because you'll do just as good. If you want a 1% start studying before you even get to the class.

Don't even bother studying the in class examples. Take any example problem he gives you and flip it upside down and add a few obscure shapes to it and that is what you will be tested over. This man is evil.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hartanto is one of my favorite professors. He does go very fast, but he does so under the expectation that you watched the lecture video for the class beforehand. He was always willing to explain his steps during lecture. Go to lecture, go to platoon, you'll do well

He teaches solely through examples and moves fast through some material, but he is very willing to meet with you outside of class. He definitely cares about his students and wants to help them succeed. I highly recommend going to class and all the platoons (they help more than you can imagine).
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He moves so fast through new material and doesn't explain anything. You will only do examples in class and no instruction

I was told not to get this professor before going into the class but he turned out to be great. Was very willing to give back points on exams and homework. Made time on weekends and after class if you needed to meet with him. He does go through a lot of examples in class which was nice to have for the homework. Overall was pretty good.

There were no example problems with work shown on his website before homework was due. He also told graders to grade work as hard as possible even if an answer was right a large majority of the points for the question were lost. I would not suggest to have this professor.

Homework every week, its quite good practice. Wibowo goes through a lot of examples really quickly so be prepared for class. You must watch the lecture videos before class, because he goes through examples in class. If youre confused, TAs and the textbook are very useful as well. Class is doable but hard: just gotta show up and work for it!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Wibowo was the worst experience I've ever had when it came to accomidations. My learning disability isn't that severe, all I really need is more time and he went out of his way to tell me that it would be too hard for platoon leaders and himself to keep track of it. Went out of my way to offer solutions and his blatant refusal made it hell
Very condescending.

This professor is the worst professor I had at ISU. He pretends he cares about his students when in reality, he does not care much about helping his students pass and make it extremely difficult to pass the class. Things discussed on homework, platoon meetings, and lectures are unrelated to what is given on the exam. Lecture videos are confusing.

Wibowo is a very misunderstood professor at Iowa State. I had heard nothing but negative reviews of his teaching style but was desperate and went up to his office for help. He was very open to helping me learn even though I was in a different section. He is patient in answering my questions and is the only reason I am able to learn in this class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Mr. Wibowo does not make time for students outside of class, does not provide any example problems for reference, compiles terrible lecture videos, and does a poor job of teaching nearly anything. Good luck.
I'm going to make this short, DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH THIS GUY HE IS AWFUL.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Hardest class I've ever taken only because of this professor. The weekly homework always took between 6-12 hours, the exams were impossible to finish on time and were nothing like what was in the homeworks, the quizzes were over things nobody understands yet are worth the same as a homework. I could write a novel about everything. Avoid this prof.

Wibowo is a great guy. He is super nice and tries his best to teach. Asynchronous online statics was an absolute dumpster fire. Half the class failed or dropped. They would not curve the class. The worst class I have taken.

Like many, I dropped this class. Tests were based on obscure things covered in the poorly recorded lectures, which had almost no practical usage outside of a classroom (such as an A beam??). Class was organized so you would fail-watch a video, get quizzed, then do the 12 hour homework assignment. Avoid this class at all costs.

Worst professor I've had at Iowa State. Avoid at all costs. Spent 80% of my weekly studying/work on his class just to keep up with assignments, which hurt my learning in other classes significantly. Quizzes every week, that could be on several completely different topics. Homework problems are nothing like examples or lectures. Overall, ridiculous.

Statics was the worst online class I had to take. They were completely unorganized and unprepared for online classes. They loaded up on more homework assuming the students have more free time since everything is online. The exams consistently had terrible averages but Wibowo refused to curve anything and blamed it on the students.
Worst professor ive ever had. He expects you to teach this class like a full time job and doesnt seem to realize we have other classes we are taking. Homework is extremely difficult.

He was extremely tough but I learned statics better than anyone else. He is very nice and fun, so you don't mind the pain of statics. He is available any time of day or night(ie. 2am). His hw was very long but prepared us well so the exams were easy while other professors' students struggled a lot with them and didn't learn the material well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Wibowo is not ideal for online statics, exam averages were consistently in the low fifty-percent range and he refuses to curve. He preaches about putting in more work, but doesn't prepare you enough for the exams that come from a third party. Contributed far less to the course than other profs. Few of us passed (former 3.8-4.0 students)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Hart is one of the best professors I've had! He is pretty intimidating at first, but he truly cares about his students. Take notes and listen to his predictions before exams! Go to office hours, it helps a lot!! If you ask for extra credit he will more than likely give it to you. He believes in tough love, so show him you care about your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Wibowo is an excellent professor who genuinely cares about his students and is great at preparing you for the departmental exams. Be prepared for some very difficult homework as he uses this to prepare you for exams. He doesn't post his lecture notes, but he is great at making time outside of class for questions and responds to emails very fast
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Wibowo is easily one of the best professors at Iowa State. He goes quick in the lecture but is very accessible outside of class. The homework is intense and as difficult as the exams; prepare to think and work hard. He will absolutely give you everything you need to succeed and works hard to make the course doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Wibowo's statics is by far the hardest statics section offered, and the homework assignments he gives are easily twice as hard as the other professors. However, his office hours are the key to doing well, and all the time and effort on homework pays off because his sections always do the best on each exam and get the best grades!
