The material is somewhat difficult but she does a great job at explaining everything and breaking it down. If you do the practice questions and go to lectures, you will do well.

Dr. Yandeau-Nelson was one of my favorite professors I have had at Iowa State. She is very knowledgeable and is always very kind and helpful when answering questions. Her lectures are great and she makes hard topics very digestible. Overall, a very caring professor who really tries to get to know her students even in a big lecture.
Dr. Yandeau-Nelson is extremely knowledgable and cares that her students have a great experience and really learn something. She is a wonderful teacher!

Kind, very knowledgeable teacher. Grading consisted of 2 exams, weekly quizzes, and 3 case studies (about 1-1.5 pages each). All exams and quizzes are in lockdown browser. Not a tough class if you read the textbook and watch her lecture videos. I emailed her all 3 of my papers to review before submitting, and she gave great feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easiest class ever! Review sessions are extra credit and exams are super easy. Would recommend!

Taking this class online was a breeze. If you watched the videos for the week you were fine. The case studies looked intimidating on the outside but from my experience as long as you need the 1 page criteria then you were almosy guaranteed full credit. Extra credit for attending exam review sessions. Was great!

Yan is a good professor, but the class itself is set up pretty bad. A lot of your grade goes into group projects, which can be stressful as it's randomly assigned. Yan has it set up where you can "fire" group members, which I found very beneficial if a specific member was slacking off the whole semester. Would recommend her as a prof, take online.
She was incredibly hard to understand with her accent. She pronounces words wrong throughout the whole class which are unfortunately her most used words.

After the first quiz was done, Professor Huang proceeded to berate the class for about half of the lecture time. She would teach for a bit, and then take a break to tell our class that we had no chemistry and that her morning class was so much better. This is a required capstone class to graduate as a business major.

Not too hard, doing the case studies thoroughly was the only important thing. Tests are taken on lockdown browser with camera on so you really have to study for them. Easy enough to get full credit on all homework assignments and discussions so only have to worry about the exams
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Not a very good professor. She can barely speak english so it's hard to understand what she is saying. She doesn't go over the material well if you read the chapter than attend her class she doesn't really understand the concepts. Group speeches are over the same company each time and there are 4 so it gets really repetitive.
Yan is a really nice professor. She teaches well and the class is pretty simple. Lots of group projects, but she grades them easily and I thought the class wasn't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class is kind of a joke. 4 case study presentations throughout the semester where as long as you follow what the lectures outlined, youll be graded well. Tests are word for word questions she has in her lectures. You wont learn much, but youll get the grade.

I liked her for this class, our only assignments were group presentations through zoom which were pretty easy, she isn't a tough grader. Plus all the questions on the first exam were questions on her power points so just review those, she's really nice and seems to really enjoy the topics covered.

Yijun has made tons of progress as a professor since her first semester at Iowa State. She is very personable and will help you out in any way she can. If you get confused, she will try her best to answer any questions.

She is a lovely professor! Sometimes her instructions can get a little confusing but if you ask her for clarification she will gladly re-explain until you understand. Homework is not too overwhelming but get ready to read and take notes every week. Be prepared to work fast on quizzes. Not too difficult since tests are open note! Super sweet!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard to understand, she was often confused by questions, made incorrect assumptions about projects and failed to listen to students explanations. She gave rude comments to students and degraded projects without offering suggestions. Her grading was inconsistent and she never used canvas which made accessing rubrics and assignment details difficult.

Yijun was difficult to understand and work with. She struggled telling me what I did wrong, but continued to give out low grades after we would ask what we did wrong. Additionally, she is also brutally honest with rude comments.
Yiming cares about students. He has extended office hours before each exam and it is very helpful.

The class itself is not bad. But, Yiming makes things too difficult sometimes. He would focus on slides, but wouldn't go through the calculations a lot. So when it came to the exam, you had to teach yourself. The quizzes are super easy if you go to class and the homework is a little challenging but prepares you for the exam. One exam was 2 parts.

Yiming is a nice guy who wants you to succeed. He does not assign reading, but the book helps (you can get an older edition). He puts his lecture slides online so you can follow along, but what he says in class is more important because he walks you through practices very specifically. He also gives and takes feedback well. I almost switched to SCM
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

Her English is not bad at all and shes funny and sweet and a really good teacher. Love ya Ye (move back to Roll Tide city away from diks

She's not mean, however she has a hard time speaking english and doesn't convey any real knowledge about MIS. Going to class was brutal and unnecessary. Tests were not always over what she said they were going to be over. Directions for the group project were vague and not helpful. Take MIS with someone else

She is really repetitive when she speaks, so it is hard to pay attention to her. She gives pop quizzes each week, but 2 drop at the end. There's a group project, but no presentation at the end the of the semester, and she's a very easy grader. Same with the homework, if you do it, you'll get full credit.

She's nice and means well, but she spends about 10% actually lecturing, so sitting in class is frustrating. She spends most of her time repeating a word four times or talking about China, the weather, restaurants in Atlanta, and other completely random things. Go to class because there's pop quizzes. Otherwise just read the book and you'll be fine.
She is great teacher. She is very nice, responds to students quickly extending homework due dates, if requested. Economics can be dull at times so she likes talk about random personal stories.

Nice lady, but horrible teacher. She talks a lot about Wendy's and Steve Nash which don't pertain to Economics at all. The content we learn in class is not over the same content as the homework or the book. Very frustrating to go to class and try to make sense of what she is explaining.

The worst professor I have ever had at ISU. Her English, for the most part, is fine. But her constant use of filler words and repeated points makes concentrating in class a struggle. If she did not have quizzes after each chapter I would have never showed up to class.

She was an extremely helpful and easy to understand teacher. She turned economics into an art. She is very educated and has a lot of clear background knowledge of economics. This class was my favorite class in all of my career at Iowa state! And she likes rice crispies.

I was amazed that this lady ended up a professor at ISU. I expected the poor English, but she forgot her laptop at least once a week and made the class so easy that it really gives a poor barometer of what you actually know about econ. I would say that if you just need good grades, then this is the teacher for you.

She was extremely hard to understand. For the first month and a half of class she taught by only hand writing on the board while talking toward the wall, no students past the third row could hear. She often blamed poor test scores completely on student laziness and assumed that everyone in the class took econ 101 the semester before.

Do not take this class with her. Her lectures are absolutely pointless. The only reason to show up is for the random quizzes she has. The class has changed so the tests are no longer mostly quiz questions, only about 1/3 of the questions are the same as the ones on the quiz. Get a different professor no matter what. She should not be a prof at ISU

One of the worst teachers ever. She can not speak english very well and you can not hear her. The lectures are so boring and you get nothing out of them. If you are there when there is a pop quiz you get a 100% no matter what

She cannot speak English. She struggles to teach an easy subject. Take anyone else, even if it is a little bit harder. Attendance is mandatory due to pop quizzes that are spread out through the semester.
good teacher, and easy class

Easiest class, worst professor I've had in my life. In class quizzes are the only reason to show up, and regardless of how you actually do on them she gives you 100%. Most exam questions come straight from the quizzes. If you like econ, don't take her class. If you like good grades, take her class.
Can't understand her at all. Just go to class for the quizzes and make sure you do the practice exams online. Almost every exam question is from quizzes or practice exams.

She's really a sweet lady, just not a great lecturer. She is trying to get better though so we will see how that turns out. The grading scale is super lenient, but the test questions are sometimes hard to comprehend. Not a bad class, but if you could get another instructor, may be in your best interest.

Easy class. You need to go to class because of randomly quiz.As long as you take the quiz, you can get full mark. Exam questions are mostly from quiz, homework and practice exam. You can drop two quizzes  and one exam.
worst teacher I have ever had. period.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER! She can't talk. The uses filler words all the time like right and mckay. Going to lecture is pointless. The only good thing is ever quiz is 100%. She's lazy and reads off the books power point. She forgets stuff all the time, like her computer, so she borrows a students. How is she a professor I'll never know.

Easy prof, but her extreme accent makes going to class essentially pointless. She says that the textbook is "optional", but with a useless lecture, that's the only way to pass this class. While attendance isn't "mandatory" pop quizzes mean you have to show up anyway. DO NOT TAKE ECON WITH THIS PROF.

The workload is 2x more than other courses, the lectures of very uninspired and long with inappropriate gifs and no visual aids, sometimes things are unclear on his instructions for homework and if you ask for clarification he snaps rudely and defensively (and will most likely insult you in the process). I would never recommend this teacher.

reviews.comment: My class with Dr. Yildirim has been frustrating, the workload is too high and he expects a lot from students. The lectures are very dry and long, lots of pop quizzes (and quizzes in general), you have to attend every one of the lectures. His homework instructions are poor and his feedback is always extensive.
The workload is more than any normal graduate level course.

I think the best word to describe Professor Lee is "decent." No more; no less. He did not always communicate clearly, occasionally confused even himself, and did not provide very many materials to help actually learn the content. reviews.comment: Dr Zambreno is absolutely the best professor you could ever ask for. The class CPRE 381 is hard, but he makes it enjoyable. He dedicate his time to stop by the lab even at late hours to check on students. I am sure that if I have taken it with any other professor other than Zambreno, I won't pass. Very helpful during office hours too.

Here's my two cents on Dr. Zambreno: he teaches one of the most time intensive classes I've ever been in (be prepared for a part time job finishing up your lab projects), but he is a really nice guy with good lectures and is very approachable. You can tell he is passionate about the material, but that doesn't mean he won't make you work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: His style of teaching is very unique so it may be an acquired taste for some. I thought his lectures were engaging and interesting though he doesn't spend a lot of time on examples to prepare you for tests. Labs were VERY time consuming but still enjoyable.

A hard class, and takes more work than usual. That said, Professor Zambreno is amongst the best teachers I've ever had. Most of the bad reviews are from salty kids who procrastinated on projects and didn't finish in time.
Class structure is terrible and so is the professors teaching style, if you dont know what youre doing prepare to be patronized by your teacher and your peers!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not a good prof, stay away if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Joe is a great professor and clearly knows the material very well. Many people seem to be struggling this semester (notice the high number of negative reviews) but I don't think it's Joe's fault. The class is very difficult, and requires a lot of time, especially to debug the final project. Not difficult to pass, but you'll really work for an "A".
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Look. 381 is always a hard grind to begin with. Everyone knows that you have to spend a substantial amount of time for the labs. You're expected to build a processor in a semester. Dr. Zambreno is an amazing person. Probably one of the best professors I've had. He will listen to your story and put that into consideration. 10/10 professor.

Im not sure about other years but it felt like 381 was unreasonably difficult this year. Probably part of it is how the course is out together but Zambreno isnt the best help either, hes not good at teaching material related to the exams or labs. Very heavily based on yourself and if you dont know whats going on, youre helpless.
Really cares about students performance, but the class requires a long time commitment for labs.

Insane amount of reading given in the first week, something like 140+ pages that he expected us to finish in a weekend and retain all knowledge of what we read. AVOID ZAMBRENO AT ALL COSTS if youre taking even a gen ed besides this class. Chances are, youll fail both.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. has a hard time understanding that students take more than just his class. Ive basically lived in the lab for the last month because TAs dont know what theyre doing and I have nowhere else to turn to for help. Ive considered giving up multiple times but Ive come too close at this point to quit. Do yourself a favor and dont take zambreno
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Exams and whats taught in class/labs have no correlation, whatever he says will be on the exam is never on the exam and whatever he doesnt cover ends up being the biggest topic on that exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Extremely time consuming, beware about taking this class with Zambreno if you have other heavy classes this semester, youve been warned!!

Worst class Ive taken at Iowa state to date. Dont take 381 with Zambreno if you can help it!!! Its already a hard class and he makes it worse due to lack of proper lectures and weak correlation between labs, exams, and whats taught in class. Worst class experience Ive had to date...
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Boring lecture, professor is cringey and tries to act like the cool kids. Class isn't too difficult if you have 20+ hours to put aside every week just to be frustrated by something you can't do because it was taught poorly or not at all. Had to quit my part time because of this class, an it has caused my other grades to drop. Don't take it with him
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Zambreno is one of my top favorite professors of all time! I love going to his class. He is hilarious, cares about his students, is a great teacher and is just an overall great guy. The labs are pretty difficult but theyre very interesting and teach you a lot. If you get Zambreno then youre very lucky and in for a great semester!

This class is not too hard... if you do not want a social life or sleep schedule. Lectures are dull and prepare for endless nights working on labs, homework, and the final projects. Most TAs do not know how to answer questions. No review for exams and what you do study most times wont appear on the actual exam.

I am writing this just because I saw a bad review and want to put my two cents in. Zambreno is a very smart and nice guy. He is very understanding about other classes and commitments. He hears our feedback and BROUGHT US COOKIES. If you don't go to lecture and don't put in effort you won't pass but that's typical. Best CPRE class I've taken so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Definitely the worst class experience I have had so far. 381 is expected to be a difficult course but taking it with Zambreno is definitely making it worse. No exam review materials are provided. Lecture, Homework and Labs (45% of the grade) have absolutely no correlation. Definitely dont take this course with him
Great prof. Tough grader. Very helpful and approachable. Tough class.

One of the best professors I have come across in my life. He's humorous , easy-going, knowledgeable professor. He's some one who likes to play hard and party hard. The course was like an adventurous roller-coaster ride throughout the semester with a little time to spare, yet he was always there to help, anytime, anywhere!

Has a great sense of humor. Homework, exams and labs are a lot harder comparing to other professor teaching the same class but will force you to learn a lot. He is the guy who enlightened me in computer architecture and FPGA design. Definitely a great teacher!

Course contains three interesting projects, two homework and a lot of weekly reflections. Very nice professor, he knows a lot about his area. I really like the practical side of the course specially. The course is mainly about FPGAs and VHDL.
Made some very dry topics interesting and always kept class light. Labs and projects were definitely harder than normal class work but they were also where I learned the most

Has been my favorite teacher at Iowa State so far.  Entertaining to listen to even if the topics aren't always interesting.  Great sense of humor.  If you're struggling understanding the class or keeping up with the work, he is very helpful and will allow you to turn in things late as long as you make an effort.  Great teacher
Inspired an interest in the material.  Enjoyed teaching, which made learning all the more easier and interesting.
Few homework assignments. Typical final project. Fun prof. I'll take him again.
No Comments

Li was my first real introduction to the college of design after I switched majors my sophomore year. She is so fun and caring and sweet, and she always makes sure we're following along and getting what we need from the course. She asks for feedback and is crazy talented. She also is helpful to those who are new to drawing. My favorite teacher yet!

She is so caring and so understanding. The class is long, but she gives us breaks. As long as she sees or hears you putting in the effort, she will grade you well. She does want you to challenge yourself and she will give you critiques but she's very kind about it. If anything, please take her for your classes!

Li is a super great professor and overall human being. She is always able to give helpful constructive feedback no matter what your skill level is. I had very little drawing experience before this class and she helped me become more confident with great feedback and help. She is also one of the kindest and caring people I have ever met.

always gives clear feedback and clear suggestions on your work. Always pushes you to do your best work and grades partially on how hard you are trying to achieve your best. Her grading policies are pretty clear, although might seem a little harsh. She actually teaches you how to draw instead of expecting you to already be perfect.

She is an absolutely fantastic professor. She gives amazing feedback with proposals and solutions to fix and better your drawings. She is understanding, but still firm with her grading procedures. There is a lot of outside work, but never gives an insane amount of work. Made this course 100 times better. Also just an amazing and wholesome human.
Love this queen

She is a great professor. Caring and always willing to answer questions. When critiquing work, she does it without letting you feel bad about it and gives great advice for completing the work or how/where to improve. I would absolutely take again.

The best 1310 instructor imo!! The projects she assigns are a perfect blend of studies for technical skills and creative projects that grow conceptual skills. She is so friendly and genuinely cares about the students. She provides very helpful feedback and encourages students to do their best without judging or being harsh. Totally recommend her!

Li is great! She always has time to help her students and gets to know all of us. I had her after already having a good amount of drawing experience and she still was able to challenge me while helping those who had very little experience. She gave us advice on how to fix our mistakes instead of just telling us to start over.

Shes super nice and inspirational! The drawing assignments are super-fast paced, but they're really fun! She becomes like friends with most of her students and always pushes her students to do their best no matter the experience. She grades on progress rather than result. 10/10 recommend!
Wonderful professor! The best ISU has to offer.
Mr. Zimmerman is amazing, smart, and down-to-earth. He's a little unorganized, but he's a writer not a boring professor. If you want to learn about writing and about the real world, take his classes1

Dr. Zimmerman is totally amazing! Hes such a talented writer and its easy to listen to him b/c hes so handsome! But more, he knows his stuff and just being in the room with him makes you smarter. Dont take if you are afraid of REAL LIFE!
Mr. Zimmerman is inspirational - so smart and insightful. You can learn from him just by listening to him talk about his life. Great comments on your writing too. Take him if you can. True genus.

I was extremely excited to take this class and was sorely disappointed. He was so disorganized, lost students assignments, was constantly late to class, and didn't have a canvas and NEVER gave us a grade update. He was rarely accessible during his office hours and to be honest I learned absolutely nothing about screenwriting.

One of the most enjoyable classes I've taken at ISU! Lectures and writing prompts are fun, and he clearly enjoys pushing students and hearing what they come up with. You'll have to write a 20 page story and prompts on a weekly basis, so don't take this course if you don't like writing. But if you have any interest in it, take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: David is great! He is literally so funny and makes the class fun! Don't take this class if you don't like to write (obviously) and if you don't like speaking out loud. You get three free absences, but towards the end of the semester he stops taking attendance so you could probably miss more. Very enjoyable class with a great professor.

Good guy. Will teach you a lot about writing if you can ignore the disorganization and inconsistency. Happy to talk to you. Not easy to get a hold of. Fun class, but if you're looking for structure, you're not going to find it. He says attendance is mandatory, but it really isn't.

This class is very enjoyable, but don't expect to watch many movies made after 1980. He is an easy grader. Take notes in class and look over the main points in the book before the test and you will do great. I strongly recommend this course.

Good: He is helpful when you ask questions. He also seems to be a very easy going guy.               Bad: Never prepared for class. All of the reading is impossible to finish because it is so dense and there is so much of it. He doesn't explain anything in class. Not study guide, not even a hint as to what to focus on.

Yes, his spewing of information during lectures comes close to rambling, but it's about film, so what's there not to like? Lets you eat in class, which is only fair when you want to snack while watching a movie. Exams are straightforward. The tone of his class was light, inviting student input and projecting a great sense of humor. Take.

Zimmerman was a great teacher.  I was dreading 250 but actually enjoyed it solely due to him. He really does help to improve your writing.  His teaching still is different but effective.  I lucked out with getting him for a teacher.  Take 250 with Zimmerman.

HE IS TERRIBLE!!!! do not take this class with him...he doesn't know what he is talking about, doesn't return papers, doesn't use a webiste or webct to communicate with students and you never know how you actually are doing till the end...he is TERRIBLE!!!!! and not nice at all...and doesn't explain anything he wants you to do!!! BAD TEACHER!!!!!!!

THE GROUP PROJECT SUCKS. He is really a great professor and really knowledgeable and if you let him will really teach you a lot about writing. And the class was a ton of fun. But the group project he makes you do will suck hard. Also you won't have any idea what your grade is until it's over and all the assignments are at the end of the semester.
Really nice guy. The more you talk, the better this class will work out. Grades relatively easy as well.

Beware!!  He has favorites in his class and seems to grade on a pretty arbitrary basis.  You won't know how you're doing in the class until final grades are released.  Very unclear when describing assignments.  Extremely jaded from his years of writing.  It's his way or the highway.
Interesting guy.  Don't take his class if you long for organization, but do take it if you're willing to work hard and try new/different things.  He's fun if YOU let him be.

Enthusiastic for teaching. Class is disorganized and unbalanced. I had no idea of my grade until the final grade came out. Doesnt return work on time or sometimes at all. Show up late and keeps class late. Doesnt seem to recognize or grade for extra effort. It seems like he gives work just for the sake of giving it, not because it is relevant.

He is very helpful and willing to meet with you. Didn't like the group project AT ALL! Would rather write by myself than with 4 other people who all want to take the project in different directions...Homework due dates were compacted in the end. Unbalanced.

Wow, this got old fast.  He didn't seem to want to do much reading so he clumped us together for group projects.  I thought he came off as funny but a little snotty. Also, as a general note, any sort of writing class taken with students who have no background in writing is going to suck long and hard. Avoid writing classes with amatures at all cost
Great guy. Funny stories. I dug his writings.
No Comments

Really didn't enjoy his class or his teaching style. He seemed to know the technical aspects of screenwriting, but he really didn't help with the creative process or strike me as a particularly dedicated teacher. Helpful but not wonderful.

I had a rough time with Zimmerman for the majority of the class.  He pretty much made me dislike something I enjoyed.  He at times was patronizing and unflexable.  Toward the end, we began to get along better and I like him now.  Be prepared to work hard in this class.  Fairly easy grading.

I was extremely pleased with his class, and he is a remarkable individual.  I'm looking forward to taking more of his classes in the future.  He's a very great instructor, and I highly recommend enrolling in anything he teaches.

Requires a lot of work (ie writing)! But it is a fun and interesting class if you're interested in screenwriting. He knows his stuff and works outside of class to help students. Projects/deadlines are due fast in his class so you'd want to stay on top of things.
I took Psych 320 and 360 with Zlatan Krizan. He is an awesome lecturer and a very interesting person. I received an A and an A- in his classes. Exams are all online and at home.

His lectures are not worth attending. Nothing that he talks about on in the lecture is on the test. Definitely read the textbook. All exams are open note and online, but they are very difficult. There are articles that you will have to read each week.
Read and/or attend lectures otherwise you won't pass.
His lectures are kinda helpful. It's best to read the book. He's pretty chill.

Krizan is a good professor, but he comes off pretentious and aloof towards his students. The tests come directly from the lecture slides so if you're comfortable with the material you'll do fine. There's one paper that's graded by the TA and if you put any effort into it you'll be fine. I would just go to the TA for help rather than Krizan.

This class was meh. Not what I thought. 2 exams, a 4 page paper (max), weekly online group activities and book quizzes. Not super hard. The exams have no study guide, so the material for the exam is usually ambiguous. Studying the slides will allow you to get at least a C, I'm guessing reading the book will get you an A.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is very easy. All the slides are online and the book really is not that much help. There are weekly reading quizzes (2pts) and weekly group journals which are very simple. Only two tests and they are worth less than half 20% of your overall grade. Such an easy A and he is a great funny professor who makes things very clear.
Krizan was very clear and there were no surprises on the test. I didn't miss a point in the class and I barely went. He also gives a lot of extra credit

If you have a question, ask the TA. Practically ran from a conversation in the hall. Doesn't care to actually educate, cares more about research and DJing (yes, music). You will need an eidetic memory andor psychic abilities for exams. Memorize the book and look at powerpoints. Do the online group journal. Love the material, hated the prof.
Boring Lecturer. Read the book.
One of the hardest classes I've taken. The tests were ridiculously hard. Grades very difficultly and hard to pass tests. Do NOT RECOMMEND.

It's hard to get past his accent at first, and sometimes he can't form a sentence the right way. His study guides are almost useless because everything from lecture is on there.  He never once responded to my e-mails. I never once opened the book and still made it out of there with a B+.  His lectures were, for the most part, interesting.

Most of the lectures are enjoyable, but it's almost all what we've covered previously in other psych classes.  I enjoy his enthusiasm.  Fill in the blank slides and he offers non-graded quizzes that help.  I enjoyed the class overall and the topics covered. The test questions did at time trip me up.
He's a nice prof. Lectures are organized and "fill-in-the-blanks" style. Two papers and lots of mini quizzes on webct.
Good Prof. Interesting classes and you can tell he enjoys what he teaches.

He is a good professor. Go to class, and glance in the textbook once in a while, and look over your notes when studying, and you'll be fine. He provides lots of extra credit and has two papers, but I enjoyed the paper topics, though I've heard he changes them every semester. Good prof.

Great class. Very interesting. There are print-outs for the notes, but you have to attend lecture to fill in the important blanks. The reader isn't important at all. The textbook is worth reading, but as long as you attend lecture and take notes, you should be fine without it.

He is DEFINITELY NOT hot! Class is boring [take something to work on]. Posts fill-in-the-blank slides onto webct fill them out during lecture and you've got everything you need for the test. Haven't read once and have barely studied and I've gotten at least  B on every exam. Grades pretty easily on the papers which is a nice bonus.

He is very informative but it's a little hard to follow his slides sometimes. The tests are not too bad though. I would suggest just going over your notes and reading the book and forgetting about filling out the study guides for the tests that are forever long

He's a very good prof, and part of the "list of best ISU professors" (google it). He's very entertaining, and his lectures are never boring. Read the book and go to class, you should get at least a B+.

Very interesting, energetic & fun professor. The best strategy is to summarize the chapter before lecture (don't just read!), attend lecture & take good notes, & go over it all before exams. The Reader isn't as important. Then, do the (very generous and easy) extra credit. That's what I did and got an A+. I strongly recommend him.

Zlatan has a sense of humor, makes the class interesting. He's down to earth, nice, smart..etc. Oh and my first day of class when he walked in I was like: OMG it's Friday night in NYC! This guy is a stud. I haven't missed one class yet.

Zlatan is an Awesome teacher!!!!  He makes everything easy to understand, even for someone who is not a psychology major.  Even though he just started teaching, he is one of the best teacher I've had!  KEEP UP WITH READING AND YOU WILL DO BETTER!

Likes to go by Professor "Z" since his name is a little hard to pronounce for some. Accent is there, but after the first day I didn't ever find it difficult to understand him. To get a good grade you'll have to do a normal amount of studying, but I enjoyed his style and tests weren't discouraging.
Really good teacher.  Tests are kind of hard, but he makes class really interesting.
friend thinks he's accent is really hot, but i don't.  He's not too hard to understand and he is a really nice and friendly person. He does have  you do the reading about a chapter a period.
No Comments
Pretty good professor at giving feedback but super slow at grading things, I understand that stuff happens but if my essay from 2 1/2 months ago still hasn't been graded, I get a little worried..
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was EXTREMELY boring. You must be self discipline to attend class because there is nothing exciting going on. I would advise taking this class on a MWF vs TTR as the longer lectures are filled with useless activities in order to "fill up time." Other professors allow students to leave early if they don't use up the time teaching.
Zoe is cool but sometimes can be fuzzy on grading criteria and making goals for assignments clear. Overall though she will help if you got questions and will try to make your life easier
The expectations for major assignments were not always clear, but Zoe is super nice and will answer any questions if you ask her.

Dr. Zuck made me appreciate literature so much more with this class. A lot of reading was expected of you before every class period, but it is manageable. She always comments on all assignments and gives good feedback on essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I've taken 2 classes with Dr. Zuck and have had issues with her both times. She's a fine teacher but my issue does not lie with her teaching methods, it's how she runs her classroom. She's insistent that you stay home when sick, but you can only miss class twice before impacting your grade. Her syllabus is confusing and there is no direction.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class is an easy A if you do all the work. It does require a lot of reading. If you read once through everything you can pass with an A. You do have to attend zoom meeting in order to get class points but its only once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.
